title: KVBoost: Chunk-Level Key-Value Cache Reuse with Deviation-Guided Recomputation for Efficient Large Language Model Inference
summary: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) incur high prefill latency because key-value (KV) tensors must be recomputed for each request. Existing prefix-caching systems reduce this cost but require prompts to share a leading contiguous prefix, limiting effectiveness when shared content appears at arbitrary positions. We present KVBoost, a chunk-level KV cache reuse system for HuggingFace-compatible decoder models that enables reuse regardless of content position. KVBoost introduces a dual-hash keying scheme that separates positional identity (prefix hash) from content identity (content hash), supporting both exact and approximate cache matches. To address attention boundary errors from independently cached chunks, KVBoost employs two repair strategies: SelectiveRecompute, which re-encodes boundary regions, and CacheBlendRecompute, which identifies and recomputes high-deviation tokens after a probe pass. The system further incorporates asymmetric KV quantization (int8/int4), adaptive chunk boundary splitting, and importance-weighted eviction under a fixed memory budget. Evaluated on Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B over 1,000 bug-localization samples, KVBoost achieves a 4.49x reduction in time-to-first-token (142.4 ms vs.\ 639.1 ms) and outperforms prefix caching by 16%, with no loss in accuracy (99.2% vs.\ 99.1%). KVBoost provides a practical, memory-bounded inference acceleration layer compatible with RoPE-based models without architectural modification.

AI.tldr: KVBoost是一个针对HuggingFace兼容解码器模型的块级KV缓存复用系统，通过分离位置身份与内容身份的双哈希方案，实现任意位置的内容复用，配合选择性重计算、缓存混合重计算、非对称量化等策略，在Qwen2.5-3B上实现4.49倍的TTFT加速（142.4ms vs 639.1ms），比前缀缓存提升16%，且准确率无损失（99.2% vs 99.1%）。
AI.motivation: 基于Transformer的大语言模型由于每个请求都需要重新计算KV张量，导致prefill延迟很高。现有的前缀缓存系统要求提示词共享连续的前缀，当共享内容出现在任意位置时效果有限，无法充分利用缓存复用的潜力。
AI.method: KVBoost的核心贡献包括：1) 双哈希键控方案，将位置身份（前缀哈希）与内容身份（内容哈希）分离，支持精确和近似缓存匹配；2) 两种修复策略——SelectiveRecompute（重新编码边界区域）和CacheBlendRecompute（探测后识别并重新计算高偏差token）来解决独立缓存块带来的注意力边界误差；3) 非对称KV量化（int8/int4）、自适应块边界切分以及固定内存预算下的重要性加权淘汰策略。
AI.result: 在Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B模型、1000个bug定位样本上的评估显示：TTFT从639.1ms降至142.4ms（4.49倍加速），比前缀缓存提升16%，准确率99.2% vs 前缀缓存的99.1%，无精度损失。
AI.conclusion: KVBoost提供了一种实用、内存受限的推理加速层，与RoPE-based模型兼容且无需架构修改，有效解决了任意位置KV缓存复用的问题，为LLM推理中的缓存复用提供了新的思路。

title: AIREP: A Protocol for Per-Decision Evidence in AI Runtime Governance
comment: 8 pages. Reference implementation and two-verifier conformance kit: https://github.com/halvrenofviryel/ai-runtime-evidence-protocol
summary: A protocol is presented for recording the governance decisions of automated AI runtimes. When a runtime releases, blocks, defers, redacts, or escalates an individual output, AIREP records that decision as a single signed object that any party can check offline, independent of the runtime that produced it. A record carries the decision as one of a closed set of verbs under a stated policy basis, references its input, output, and evidence by hash rather than by value, and declares both what its evidence covers and what it does not. Records form a SHA-256 hash chain that binds each record to its position, so that tampering and gaps are detectable by recomputation. Vendor-, model-, and domain-specific content is confined to a single optional namespace, and a mechanical neutrality test keeps the shared format free of it. A reference implementation and a two-language conformance kit are described. Some implementation issues are considered, and problems such as alignment of the canonical form across implementations, freshness witnesses, and multi-runtime chains are exposed. The format is offered for adoption by any AI runtime that records governance decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AIREP协议，用于记录自动化AI运行时的治理决策（如发布、阻止、延迟、编辑或升级单个输出）。每个决策以签名的单一对象记录，可离线独立验证，并通过SHA-256哈希链绑定记录位置以实现防篡改和缺口检测。
AI.motivation: 随着AI运行时需要做出越来越多的治理决策（发布、阻止、延迟、编辑或升级输出），需要一个标准化、可审计、跨实现兼容的格式来记录这些决策，使得任何一方都能独立验证，且不依赖产生记录的运行时。
AI.method: AIREP协议：每条记录包含一个封闭的动词集合下的决策、基于哈希引用的输入/输出/证据、证据覆盖范围的声明；记录形成SHA-256哈希链；通过单一可选命名空间隔离厂商/模型/领域特定内容，并通过机械中立性测试保持共享格式纯净。
AI.result: 提供了参考实现和双语言一致性测试套件（conformance kit），并探讨了实现中的问题，如跨实现的规范形式对齐、新鲜度见证、多运行时链等挑战。
AI.conclusion: AIREP格式可供任何记录治理决策的AI运行时采用，作为一个开放标准来增强AI治理的可审计性和透明度。

title: Reviewing Model Collapse and Countermeasures
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, Accepted and published in Proceedings of IEEE AAIML 2026
summary: Driven by massive amounts of web-scale data, generative AI (GenAI) has achieved remarkable progress, enabling various applications in diverse sectors. The advances of GenAI have actuated practitioners to use AI-synthesized data for training next-generation AI models. Undeniably, using synthetic data has alleviated the increasing stringent demand for data supply. Unfortunately, it also introduces a new critical issue: in a self-consuming cycle between model and data, the model ultimately collapse, raising more trustworthiness concerns to GenAI. In recent years, increasingly more studies have investigated the phenomenon of model collapse (MC) and explored potential solutions to mitigate it. However, the review of the phenomenon of MC still remains blank. To fill this gap, this paper provides an up-to-date overview of these studies for consolidating and reviewing the progress of MC in different application scenarios and countermeasures for mitigating MC. We also highlight challenges and future research opportunities.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统综述了生成式AI中的"模型崩溃"（Model Collapse）现象，涵盖其在不同应用场景中的研究进展、缓解策略以及未来挑战与研究方向。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI的快速发展促使人们使用AI合成数据训练下一代模型，但这种自我循环（模型-数据）会导致模型最终崩溃，引发可信度担忧。然而，目前关于模型崩溃现象的系统性综述仍然缺失，因此需要填补这一空白。
AI.method: 本文采用综述性方法，对近年来关于模型崩溃现象的研究进行系统整理与回顾，涵盖不同应用场景下的模型崩溃进展以及缓解模型崩溃的应对措施，并对现有研究进行归纳总结。
AI.result: 文章整合了模型崩溃在不同应用场景下的研究进展和缓解策略，并指出了当前研究面临的挑战以及未来的研究机会。
AI.conclusion: 本文填补了模型崩溃现象综述研究的空白，为研究人员提供了最新的研究概览，并指明该领域未来的研究方向。

title: AI Learning and Conceptual Transfer in the Game of Hidden Rules
summary: This report summarizes the work conducted on the Game of Hidden Rules (GOHR), focusing on reinforcement learning agents trained to infer hidden rules from trial-and-error feedback, representation design, rule difficulty analysis, transfer learning, generalization, and pseudo-bot-assisted human learning analysis. The report focuses on the Transformer-based A2C framework, Feature-Centric and Object-Centric representations, experimental findings, and classification of human learning data.

AI.tldr: 本文总结了关于"隐藏规则游戏"(GOHR)的研究工作，涉及强化学习智能体通过试错反馈推断隐藏规则、表征设计、规则难度分析、迁移学习、泛化能力以及伪机器人辅助人类学习的分析，重点聚焦于基于Transformer的A2C框架和不同表征方式。
AI.motivation: 训练强化学习智能体从试错反馈中推断隐藏规则，并研究不同表征设计（特征中心与对象中心）对智能体学习效果的影响，同时探索规则的难度差异、迁移学习和泛化能力。
AI.method: 采用基于Transformer的A2C（Advantage Actor-Critic）强化学习框架，对比Feature-Centric和Object-Centric两种表征方式，通过实验分析规则难度、迁移学习和泛化性能，并对人类学习数据进行分类分析。
AI.result: 实验发现了不同表征方法对规则推断的影响，揭示了规则难度之间的差异，评估了迁移学习和泛化能力，并对伪机器人辅助下的人类学习数据进行了分类和总结。
AI.conclusion: 该工作在GOHR环境下系统性地评估了强化学习智能体隐藏规则推断能力，为理解表征设计、规则复杂度及人机协作学习提供了有价值的实验证据和分析框架。

title: Topology of a Smile: Persistent Homology in Dental Imaging
summary: CBCT (Cone Beam Computed Tomography) scans provide detailed three-dimensional images, widely used in dentistry for diagnostic and treatment planning tasks. While invaluable, analyzing and documenting these scans is labor-intensive, prompting efforts to automate key steps like the classification and segmentation of anatomical structures to identify tooth types and associated pathologies. In this article, we propose an approach to automation that leverages persistent homology, a framework from topological data analysis that studies the shape of data by identifying features like connected components, holes, and voids across multiple scales. Persistent homology, together with a support vector machine, allows us to classify teeth in a CBCT scan and to perform diagnostics. Our method advances the state of the art, reaching average accuracy scores of 97.67% for tooth-labeling and 96.77% for diagnostic tasks, outperforming a CNN trained on the same data with accuracy of 70.27% and 86.67%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于持续同调（persistent homology）和支撑向量机（SVM）的方法，用于CBCT扫描中牙齿的自动分类与病理诊断，在牙齿标注和诊断任务上分别达到97.67%和96.77%的平均准确率，显著优于在同一数据上训练的CNN（70.27%和86.67%）。
AI.motivation: CBCT扫描在牙科诊断中广泛使用，但分析和记录这些扫描数据非常耗时耗力。虽然已有自动化分类和分割的尝试，但现有方法（如CNN）在牙齿标注和病理诊断任务上的准确率仍有限（分别约70%和87%），需要更有效的方法来提升自动化性能。
AI.method: 利用拓扑数据分析中的持续同调框架来研究CBCT数据的形状特征，通过多个尺度识别连通分量、空洞和空隙等拓扑特征；将持久同调特征与支撑向量机结合，实现牙齿分类和病理诊断。
AI.result: 该方法在牙齿标注任务上达到97.67%的平均准确率，在诊断任务上达到96.77%的平均准确率，显著优于在同一数据上训练的CNN（分别为70.27%和86.67%）。
AI.conclusion: 基于持续同调的拓扑数据分析方法在CBCT牙齿分类和诊断任务上展现出优越性能，比传统深度学习方法（CNN）具有明显优势，为牙科CBCT自动化分析提供了新的有效途径。

title: RoboShape: Information-Theoretic Point Cloud Representations for Privacy-Aware Robot Perception
summary: With the increased adoption of robotic agents operating in human environments by scanning and sharing 3D representations (e.g., for fleet learning, cloud-based planning, or collaborative mapping), collected point clouds reveal not just the objects in a scene but also sensitive spatial context, such as room function or information that occupants never consented to disclose. Traditional point cloud encoders offer no principled control over this: either all is preserved, or none. Hence, we introduce RoboShape, an information theory guided compression head following the frozen {\tt Sonata} encoder. We project voxel-level embeddings using the Donsker-Varadhan formulation of mutual information (MI). Specifically, we maximize the MI between embeddings and object-level understanding while minimizing it for private attributes. RoboShape leads to 87.5\% smaller embeddings that retain 98.7\% of object classification utility while collapsing sensitive attribute predictions by 39.3\% across the three real-world indoor LiDAR datasets. Its privacy-preserving embeddings are cheaper to transmit over the network or to train a model for any downstream tasks. We release the RoboShape codebase to give the robotics community a practical, encoder-agnostic tool for building perception pipelines that are compact, privacy-aware, and deployment-ready.

AI.tldr: RoboShape 是一个基于信息论引导的压缩头，附加在冻结的 Sonata 编码器之后，通过 Donsker-Varadhan 互信息公式投影体素级嵌入，在保留物体分类能力的同时最小化敏感属性信息，实现更小、更具隐私保护性的3D点云表示。
AI.motivation: 随着机器人在人类环境中部署，扫描和共享的3D点云不仅包含场景物体，还泄露了敏感空间上下文（如房间功能等未获用户同意的信息）。传统点云编码器无法对此进行原则性控制——要么全部保留，要么全部丢弃。
AI.method: 引入 RoboShape，一个信息论引导的压缩头，跟随冻结的 Sonata 编码器。使用 Donsker-Varadhan 互信息公式投影体素级嵌入：最大化嵌入与物体级理解之间的互信息，同时最小化与私有属性的互信息。
AI.result: RoboShape 将嵌入体积缩小 87.5%，同时保留 98.7% 的物体分类效用，并在三个真实室内 LiDAR 数据集上将敏感属性预测崩溃 39.3%。隐私保护嵌入在网络传输和下游任务训练上成本更低。
AI.conclusion: RoboShape 为机器人社区提供了一个实用、编码器无关的工具，用于构建紧凑、隐私感知且可部署的感知管道，并已开源代码库。

title: LitReview Arena: Evaluating Literature Review Agents with Battle-Style Peer Review Platform
summary: Literature reviews are essential to scientific progress, but rigorously evaluating automatically generated reviews remains difficult because many aspects of research utility depend on expert judgment rather than reference-overlap metrics. We introduce LitReview Arena, a battle-style evaluation platform with a structured protocol tailored to literature review quality: domain experts with AI paper-writing experience compare anonymized drafts, are matched to topics within their expertise, and provide dimension-wise outcomes over five literature-review-specific criteria. From this protocol, we collect approximately 3k expert judgments, each containing five dimension-wise outcomes, and show that even the strongest current systems win only 23.0% of decisive matches against human drafts on overall utility, while agentic LLMs such as Sonar Deep Research substantially outperform base language models by over 60%. We further find that existing LLM-as-a-judge methods are substantially misaligned with human experts (Spearman's rho=0.467), especially on synthesis-heavy criteria such as paper structure and research suggestions. Using the collected preference data, we provide an expert-calibrated evaluator, LitJudge, which improves alignment to Spearman's rho=0.78, comparable to inter-expert consistency; code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/VanellopeAsher/LitReview-Arena.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LitReview Arena，一个针对文献综述质量的擂台式评估平台。通过领域专家对匿名草稿进行多维度比较，收集约3000条专家评判，发现现有系统在整体实用性上仅能战胜23.0%的人类草稿，且现有LLM-as-judge方法与人类专家严重不一致（Spearman rho=0.467）。基于收集的偏好数据训练了专家校准评估器 LitJudge，将对齐度提升至rho=0.78，与专家间一致性相当。
AI.motivation: 文献综述对科学进步至关重要，但自动生成的综述难以严格评估，因为研究实用性的许多方面依赖专家判断而非参考重叠指标。现有评估方法缺乏针对文献综述质量的专门协议和专家校准，导致难以准确衡量系统性能。
AI.method: 提出 LitReview Arena 战斗式评估平台：采用结构化协议，由具有AI论文写作经验的领域专家比较匿名草稿，按专家专长匹配主题，并在五个文献综述特定标准上进行维度级比较。基于收集的偏好数据训练 LitJudge 评估器。
AI.result: 收集约3000条专家评判（每条含五个维度结果）。最强系统在整体实用性上仅胜23.0%的人类草稿；智能体LLM（如Sonar Deep Research）比基础语言模型性能提升超60%。现有LLM-as-judge方法与人类专家严重不一致（Spearman rho=0.467），尤其在合成密集型标准（如论文结构、研究建议）上表现更差。LitJudge将对齐度提升至rho=0.78，与专家间一致性相当。
AI.conclusion: 现有LLM生成的文献综述与人类专家相比仍有显著差距；LLM-as-judge方法不可靠；通过专家校准的评估器（LitJudge）可以大幅提升评估对齐度至接近专家间一致性水平。代码和数据已公开。

title: EditStream: A Unified Autoregressive Framework for Interactive Video Generation and Editing
summary: Interactive video generation and editing are becoming increasingly important for creative design. In this report, we introduce EditStream: a unified framework for interactive video generation and editing. EditStream unifies multiple video creation and manipulation tasks within a single DiT-based model through flexible task-specific conditioning, and further transforms it into a fast, few-step autoregressive model for efficient streaming. It supports Text-to-Video, Image-to-Video, Video-to-Video, Editing Propagation, Reference-guided Video Editing, and Camera Pose Change, enabling flexible control over video generation, transformation, and editing within one system. To make the unified model practical for interactive use, we develop a two-stage distillation approach that combines Velocity Moment Matching (VMM) with autoregressive unrolling. VMM matches conditional velocity moments at student-reached intermediate states to preserve generation quality and motion, while unrolling exposes the student to its own autoregressive predictions to improve temporal stability. Together, they alleviate common challenges in few-step autoregressive video generation, including over-saturation, degraded motion, temporal instability, and complex training. EditStream provides a practical and scalable solution that bridges high-quality diffusion-based video models with interactive creative workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EditStream，一个统一的交互式视频生成与编辑框架，基于DiT模型通过灵活的任务特定条件实现多任务统一，并采用两阶段蒸馏（VMM + 自回归展开）将其转化为快速少步自回归模型，支持文本到视频、图像到视频等多达六种视频创建与编辑任务。
AI.motivation: 交互式视频生成与编辑对创意设计日益重要，但现有方法通常将不同视频任务分开处理，且高质量扩散模型推理速度慢，难以满足交互式工作流的实时性需求。
AI.method: 1) 统一的DiT框架：通过灵活的任务特定条件（conditioning）统一多个视频创建和编辑任务。2) 两阶段蒸馏方案：结合Velocity Moment Matching（VMM）匹配学生模型在中间状态的条件速度矩，保持生成质量和运动；结合自回归展开（autoregressive unrolling）让模型暴露于自身预测以提高时间稳定性，从而获得快速少步自回归模型。
AI.result: EditStream支持Text-to-Video、Image-to-Video、Video-to-Video、Editing Propagation、Reference-guided Video Editing和Camera Pose Change六种任务，有效缓解了少步自回归视频生成中的过饱和、运动退化、时间不稳定和训练复杂等问题，为交互式视频工作流提供了实用且可扩展的方案。
AI.conclusion: EditStream弥合了高质量扩散视频模型与交互式创意工作流之间的差距，提供了一个统一、高效且可扩展的交互式视频生成与编辑解决方案。

title: Multimodal-Language-Model-Driven Interaction and Companionship for Service Robots in Elderly-Care Facilities
comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/ASME International Conference on Advanced Intelligent Mechatronics (AIM)
summary: Service robots are increasingly deployed in elderly-care facilities to alleviate caregiver workload and enhance the quality of daily care. However, most existing studies focus on isolated service functions and lack integrated capabilities for continuous companionship, natural interaction, and safety monitoring. In this paper, we present an intelligent companion robot system that unifies active visual human-following, real-time LLM-driven speech interaction for intent understanding and task execution, and VLM-based safety monitoring for fall detection and abnormal posture assessment. The perception layer ensures robust human tracking and uses an active gimbal to maintain the user in view during occlusions or abrupt movements. At the interaction layer, a Large Language Model interprets spoken requests and maps them to robot actions, enabling escorting and semantic navigation. Simultaneously, a VLM-based safety agent continuously analyzes visual observations to detect fall-related or abnormal postures and triggers emergency responses when necessary. Experimental results demonstrate the system's ability to reliably follow and interact with humans, while effectively detecting potential falls to ensure user safety.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向养老院场景的智能陪伴机器人系统，统一了主动视觉人跟随、基于LLM的实时语音交互和基于VLM的安全监控三大功能，实现了连续陪伴、自然交互和安全保障的一体化。
AI.motivation: 现有服务机器人研究大多聚焦于单一服务功能，缺乏将连续陪伴、自然交互和安全监控整合于一体的能力，无法满足养老护理场景中对机器人综合服务能力的实际需求。
AI.method: 系统包含三层架构：感知层通过主动云台维持用户在视场内的鲁棒跟踪；交互层利用LLM理解语音请求并映射为机器人动作（如护送和语义导航）；安全层使用VLM持续分析视觉观测以检测跌倒和异常姿态并触发应急响应。
AI.result: 实验结果表明该系统能够可靠地跟随和与人类交互，同时有效检测潜在跌倒事件，保障用户安全。
AI.conclusion: 该系统成功验证了将视觉跟随、LLM语音交互和VLM安全监控整合于一个机器人平台的可行性，为养老护理机器人的一体化设计提供了有效方案。

title: SchemaRouter: Field-Aware Tool Routing for Efficient Heterogeneous Agentic RAG
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Code, benchmark, and fixtures: https://github.com/JDeun/SchemaRouter_research
summary:
Heterogeneous agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems increasingly orchestrate external APIs, internal databases, vector stores, and graph stores. Exposing all tool descriptions to an LLM agent, or selecting tools only by vector similarity, causes two costly failures: over-fetching, which increases payload size, token use, and latency, and under-fetching, which omits fields needed to answer the query.
  We present SchemaRouter, a lightweight routing layer that represents tools, endpoints, parameters, response fields, domain concepts, units, provenance, and license policies as a schema graph. Given a query, SchemaRouter emits an executable tool plan specifying which tools to call and which fields to retrieve. A small LLM extracts intent, concepts, and source constraints, while field selection is deterministic over the graph through intent-group projection and concept-field matching with an alias layer.
  On a materials-science benchmark of 110 queries, SchemaRouter achieves answer accuracy of 0.71, matching fetch-everything within overlapping confidence intervals and exceeding prompt-all's 0.66, though their intervals overlap. It uses 227 retrieved-context tokens versus 2,066 for fetch-everything and achieves 2.7x lower end-to-end latency than prompt-all. It also obtains the best tool-exact rate of 0.93 and parameter validity of 1.0. SchemaRouter grounds provenance and license information in 62 percent of answers, compared with approximately 0 percent for all baselines.
  We also find that minimizing selected-field count is counterproductive: it reduces answer accuracy to 0.56 with negligible token savings, while recall-preserving projection restores top accuracy. SchemaRouter improves efficiency, schema-size-independent scaling, and verifiable provenance/license-grounded answering at competitive accuracy.

AI.tldr: SchemaRouter是一个轻量级路由层，通过将工具、端点、参数、响应字段等表示为模式图（schema graph），结合小型LLM提取意图和确定性字段选择，实现高效且可验证的异构智能体RAG系统工具编排，在保持竞争性准确率的同时大幅降低token使用和延迟，并提供可验证的来源与许可信息。
AI.motivation: 异构智能体RAG系统需要编排多种外部API、数据库和向量存储，但现有方法要么暴露所有工具描述（导致过度获取：payload增大、token浪费、延迟高），要么仅靠向量相似度选工具（导致欠获取：遗漏回答查询所需的关键字段）。这两种失效模式分别造成效率和准确性的成本。
AI.method: SchemaRouter将工具、端点、参数、响应字段、领域概念、单位、来源和许可策略表示为模式图。对于给定查询，它发出可执行的工具计划，指定调用哪些工具和检索哪些字段。架构分为两部分：小型LLM负责提取意图、概念和来源约束；字段选择是确定性的，通过意图组投影（intent-group projection）和带别名层的概念-字段匹配在图上完成。
AI.result: 在材料科学110个查询基准上，SchemaRouter达到0.71的答案准确率（与fetch-everything在置信区间内相当，超过prompt-all的0.66但区间有重叠）。仅使用227个检索上下文token（对比fetch-everything的2,066），端到端延迟比prompt-all低2.7倍。工具精确率0.93，参数有效性1.0。62%的答案包含来源和许可信息（基线接近0%）。额外发现：最小化选取字段数反而将准确率降至0.56且token节省可忽略，而保留召回率的投影可恢复最佳准确率。
AI.conclusion: SchemaRouter以竞争性准确率实现了效率提升、与模式规模无关的可扩展性，以及可验证的来源/许可信息锚定的回答能力。设计启示是字段选择不应以最小化为目标，而应以保留召回率的投影为目标。

title: Aligning Human Sense: Calibrated Distributional Reward Learning for Video Generation
summary: Video generation is central to AI-powered content creation. Aligning generated videos with human preferences is a key criterion for evaluating generation quality. Despite significant progress in visual quality, three key challenges remain. First, the reliability of reward signals is constrained by the quality of human preference data, which is often affected by subjective noise and bias. Second, standard scalar reward models collapse multi-aspect human preferences into a single value, leading to the loss of dynamic trade-offs across multiple preference dimensions. Third, in policy optimization, the widely adopted KL divergence imposes primarily local constraints and may fail to capture the global structure of human preferences. To address these challenges, we propose a unified preference-aware learning framework for video generation. First, we introduce elite-guided filtering to calibrate preference data and construct reliable supervision for reward model training. We then model video quality as a multidimensional reward distribution to capture the uncertainty inherent in human preferences, and use the Wasserstein distance to align the learned reward distribution with the empirical human preference distribution. Finally, we introduce Wasserstein-based distributional alignment into GRPO, guiding policy optimization to better match the global structure of human preferences over videos. Experiments on reward modeling and video generation demonstrate that our approach improves the reliability of reward signals and the perceptual consistency of generated videos. Our code is available at https://github.com/alignhs26/ahs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的偏好感知学习框架（AHS），用于视频生成中的奖励建模与策略优化。该框架通过精英引导过滤校准偏好数据、用多维奖励分布配合Wasserstein距离捕捉人类偏好的不确定性，并将基于Wasserstein的分布对齐引入GRPO策略优化，以更好地匹配人类偏好的全局结构。
AI.motivation: 视频生成质量评估需要与人类偏好对齐，但现有方法面临三大挑战：(1) 人类偏好数据受主观噪声和偏差影响，奖励信号可靠性受限；(2) 标准标量奖励模型将多维偏好压缩为单一值，丢失了多个偏好维度间的动态权衡；(3) 策略优化中广泛使用的KL散度仅施加局部约束，无法捕捉人类偏好的全局结构。
AI.method: 提出统一偏好感知学习框架，具体包含三个核心组件：1) 精英引导过滤（elite-guided filtering）用于校准偏好数据，构建可靠的奖励模型训练监督信号；2) 将视频质量建模为多维奖励分布以捕捉人类偏好固有不确定性，并使用Wasserstein距离对齐学习到的奖励分布与经验人类偏好分布；3) 将基于Wasserstein的分布对齐引入GRPO，引导策略优化更好匹配人类偏好的全局结构。
AI.result: 在奖励建模和视频生成实验上，该方法提升了奖励信号的可靠性以及生成视频的感知一致性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的框架有效解决了偏好数据噪声、多维偏好权衡丢失和KL散度局部约束三个问题，提升了视频生成与人类偏好的一致性。

title: Gimbal-Based Human Tracking for Companion Robots Using Continual Learning
comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/ASME International Conference on Advanced Intelligent Mechatronics (AIM)
summary: Reliable and continuous human tracking is essential for natural human-robot interaction, particularly for companion robots. However, many existing approaches rely on wearable tags or fixed cameras with limited fields of view, which reduces system flexibility and often causes tracking failures when the target moves outside the sensing range. In this paper, we present a human tracking approach based on a gimbal-mounted camera integrated into a mobile robot. By actively controlling the gimbal mechanism, the camera can dynamically adjust its viewing direction to maintain the target within the field of view, even under substantial relative motion between the robot and the human. Furthermore, a continual learning strategy is applied to the person re-identification (ReID) task to adapt to changes in appearance and environmental conditions during long-term tracking. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed system significantly improves the stability and continuity of human tracking, enables real-time re-identification, and provides responsive feedback for reliable tracking of human motion from walking to running. User studies further indicate that the proposed approach enhances user comfort by eliminating the need for wearable tags.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于云台相机与移动机器人集成的人体跟踪方法，通过主动控制云台保持目标在视野内，并结合持续学习策略进行行人重识别，以应对长期跟踪中的外观和环境变化。实验表明该系统显著提升了跟踪的稳定性和连续性，支持实时重识别，且无需用户佩戴标签，提升了用户舒适度。
AI.motivation: 现有的人体跟踪方法依赖可穿戴标签或固定相机，存在视野受限、灵活性差的问题，且当目标移出感知范围时容易导致跟踪失败。作者旨在解决自然人机交互中可靠性和连续性不足的挑战。
AI.method: 1) 在移动机器人上集成云台相机，通过主动控制云台动态调整视角以维持目标在视野内；2) 对行人重识别（ReID）任务采用持续学习策略，适应长期跟踪中外观和环境的动态变化。
AI.result: 实验表明系统显著改善了人体跟踪的稳定性和连续性，支持实时重识别，并能对从走路到跑步的人体运动提供响应式反馈；用户研究显示该方法免除了穿戴标签需求，增强了用户舒适度。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过云台主动控制与持续学习ReID相结合，实现了无需标签的可靠、连续人体跟踪，为人机交互中的陪伴机器人提供了更灵活和舒适的解决方案。

title: RIACT: A Responsible AI System for Personalized Study Habit Tracking and Early Burnout Signal Detection in University Students
comment: 11 pages. Also available on EdArXiv: https://doi.org/10.35542/osf.io/94hr5_v1
summary: Student burnout is highly prevalent in higher education, with reported rates ranging from 12% to over 70% and consistently exceeding those of the working population - yet it is typically identified only retrospectively, after academic decline has already occurred. A contributing factor is that students have little structured visibility into their own study behaviour, and existing productivity tools record activity without interpreting it. This paper presents RIACT (Record, Insight, Analyze, Coach, Track), a web-based application that combines structured study session logging with a hybrid AI architecture to surface personalized insights and early burnout signals. Students log sessions by location and time; the system computes net focus time by accounting for breaks, detects burnout signals through transparent, deterministic rules operating on week-over-week behavioural comparisons, and uses a large language model - constrained to a fixed output schema - to contextualize patterns and generate personalized recommendations. The design embeds responsible AI principles throughout: warnings are governed by auditable rules rather than model judgement, all output is framed as an observation rather than a diagnosis and data collection is limited to self-logged behavioural fields. We describe the system's design rationale, situate it within the literature on student burnout and explainable AI in education and propose an evaluation framework for validating its behavioural signals against established burnout instruments.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍RIACT，一个结合结构化学习会话记录与混合AI架构的Web应用，用于检测学生倦怠的早期信号。系统通过确定性规则计算净专注时间并识别倦怠信号，同时使用受限输出模式的大语言模型生成个性化建议，全程嵌入负责任AI原则。
AI.motivation: 学生倦怠在高等教育中高度普遍（12%-70%以上），但通常只能在学业衰退发生后被追溯性识别。现有生产力工具只记录活动而不进行解读，学生缺乏对自身学习行为的结构化可见性，因此需要能主动提供早期倦怠信号的工具。
AI.method: RIACT采用混合AI架构：1）学生按地点和时间记录学习会话；2）系统通过考虑休息时间计算净专注时间；3）基于周与周之间的行为比较，用透明确定性规则检测倦怠信号；4）使用受固定输出模式约束的大语言模型进行情境化分析和个性化建议；5）全程嵌入负责任AI原则（可审计规则、观察而非诊断框架、最小化数据收集）。
AI.result: 论文描述了系统的设计原理，将其定位于学生倦怠和可解释AI教育文献中，并提出一个评估框架用于对照既有倦怠工具验证其行为信号的有效性。目前尚未报告实证验证结果。
AI.conclusion: RIACT通过为倦怠检测提供一种可解释、透明的替代方案来补充现有方法，强调规则驱动的信号检测而非模型判断，并规划了未来对行为信号与标准倦怠测量工具进行系统验证的路径。

title: AI Visual Inspection for Garment Production
summary:
The garment manufacturing industry is under increasing pressure to improve product quality, reduce costs, and accelerate digital transformation toward Industry 4.0. One of the most challenging quality-control activities is sewing-line inspection, where defects such as broken stitches and skipped stitches are difficult to detect consistently through manual inspection. Human-based inspection is often affected by fatigue, subjective judgement, and inconsistent performance, resulting in defect leakage, rework, and reduced production efficiency.
  This study presents the development and validation of an Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based visual inspection system for garment sewing-line quality control. The system utilizes Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to detect sewing defects and was initially trained using black fabric and black sewing thread samples. Experimental testing was conducted on black, red, dark green, light blue, silver, and fluorescent yellow fabrics. The results demonstrated successful detection of jump sewing-line defects on black, red, and dark green materials, while performance limitations were observed for broken sewing-line defects and fabrics with significantly different visual characteristics, including light blue, silver, and fluorescent yellow colours. These findings indicate that model accuracy is strongly influenced by the diversity of training data and the ability to generalize across different fabric and thread colours.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并验证了一种基于人工智能（CNN）的服装缝纫线质检视觉检测系统。系统最初使用黑色布料和黑色缝线训练，实验测试了六种不同颜色的面料。结果显示该系统能成功检测黑色、红色和深绿色面料上的跳线缺陷，但在检测断线缺陷以及浅蓝、银色和荧光黄等视觉特征差异显著的面料时表现受限，表明模型准确性受训练数据多样性和泛化能力的强烈影响。
AI.motivation: 服装制造行业面临提升产品质量、降低成本及推动工业4.0数字化转型的压力，而缝纫线质检是最具挑战性的质量控制环节之一。人工检测容易受到疲劳、主观判断和表现不一致的影响，导致缺陷漏检、返工和生产力下降，因此需要开发自动化检测系统。
AI.method: 本研究开发了一个基于卷积神经网络（CNN）的AI视觉检测系统，用于服装缝纫线质量控制。系统最初使用黑色面料和黑色缝线样本进行训练，随后在黑色、红色、深绿色、浅蓝色、银色和荧光黄色六种不同颜色的面料上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该系统能够成功检测黑色、红色和深绿色材料上的跳线缺陷，但在检测断线缺陷以及浅蓝色、银色和荧光黄色等视觉特征差异显著的面料时存在性能局限。不同颜色面料上的检测效果存在明显差异。
AI.conclusion: 模型准确性强烈依赖于训练数据的多样性以及模型在不同面料和缝线颜色间的泛化能力。未来需要扩充训练数据的多样性，以提高系统在实际生产中跨颜色、跨材料的检测性能。

title: On the Optimized Use of Non-Orthonormality Constraints for the Quasi-Static INS Alignment of Autonomous Underwater and Surface Vehicles
summary: Inertial navigation systems are specialized navigation apparatuses that equip almost all autonomous underwater and surface vehicles. They require precise initial alignment, i.e., determination of their initial attitude, which is typically achieved: (a) in quasi-static conditions (whenever possible); and (b) in two stages: Coarse Alignment (CA), using methods like TRI-axis Attitude Determination (TRIAD), and Fine Alignment (FA), via Zero Velocity Update (ZVU)-based Extended Kalman Filtering (EKF). However, conventional methods suffer from slow convergence and limited bias estimability. In response, this paper introduces: (a) an optimized version of a recently proposed CA method, namely, TRIAD with Coarse Bias Estimation (TRIAD-CBE); and (b) a novel FA EKF observation model that incorporates Non-Orthonormality (NON) error constraints derived from TRIAD, directly linking these errors to the inertial sensor biases. As validated through extensive Monte Carlo (MC) simulations, as well as real-world experiments using two Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs) of different grades, our approaches substantially accelerate the convergence of misalignment and bias estimates (from minutes to seconds), while maintaining accuracy/precision comparable to traditional techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文针对惯性导航系统的初始对准问题，提出了一种优化版的三轴姿态确定粗对准方法（TRIAD-CBE）以及一种融合非正交性误差约束的精细对准扩展卡尔曼滤波观测模型，通过蒙特卡洛仿真和两种不同等级IMU的真实实验验证，将失准角和偏置估计的收敛时间从分钟级缩短到秒级，同时保持与传统方法相当的精度。
AI.motivation: 传统惯性导航系统初始对准方法（粗对准TRIAD + 精细对准基于ZVU的EKF）存在收敛速度慢和偏置可估性有限的问题，亟需改进以加速对准过程并提高偏置估计能力。
AI.method: (a) 提出优化的TRIAD-CBE（带粗偏置估计的TRIAD）粗对准方法；(b) 提出一种新颖的精细对准EKF观测模型，纳入从TRIAD导出的非正交性（NON）误差约束，将这些误差与惯性传感器偏置直接关联。
AI.result: 通过大量蒙特卡洛仿真以及使用两种不同精度等级的IMU进行的真实世界实验验证，所提方法显著加速了失准角和偏置估计的收敛（从分钟级缩短到秒级），同时保持了与传统技术相当的精度/精密性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的优化粗对准方法和融合非正交性误差约束的精细对准模型，有效解决了传统对准方法收敛慢和偏置可估性有限的问题，在保持精度的前提下大幅提升了对准效率，适用于不同等级的惯性测量单元。

title: There Is No Neutral Harness: Modern LLM Leaderboards Are Manufactured by Config-Fragile Items
summary: Multiple-choice benchmarks fix the questions and the correct answers, but not the harness: the order of the options, the wording of the prompt, and whether a language model's answer is read from generated text or from per-option likelihoods. Work on this harness sensitivity reports it as aggregate score variance, leaving unexamined which items the variance falls on and whether they are the items that separate one model from the next. We treat the evaluation harness of large language models (LLMs) as an independent variable and resolve its effect to single items. We introduce the \textit{fragility grid}: 12 open-weight instruction-tuned LLMs from 4 families answer the same 3{,}679 items from 4 benchmarks (ARC, HellaSwag, MMLU, TruthfulQA) under 26 equally defensible harness configurations, recording one correctness bit for every model, item, and configuration. The comparison is matched, since the items, the weights, and the greedy decoding stay fixed while only the harness varies. Under the grid a model's score is a band rather than a point: gemma4-31b scores between 31 and 89 percent depending only on the harness. Three results follow. On the items that two adjacent models both answer stably the pair is tied, and config-fragile items carry 95.7 percent of a pair's gap on average. Four of the 12 models reach rank one under some configuration, so the harness selects the winner. Item discrimination, the property that benchmark-compression methods maximize, correlates with fragility at 0.28 (95 percent CI 0.25 to 0.30), so compression keeps the fragile items rather than removing them. The scoring choice, not the option order that protocols usually fix, is the load-bearing axis. We release the per-item records and the analysis script, from which every number regenerates on a CPU in seconds, and we position the fragility grid as a check a leaderboard can run before it reports an order.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"脆弱性网格"(fragility grid)概念，将LLM评测基准的harness（选项顺序、提示措辞、评分方式）作为自变量，对12个开源指令微调LLM在4个基准的3,679个题目上、26种配置下进行匹配比较。结果发现模型得分是一个区间而非点（如gemma4-31b得分在31%到89%之间），脆弱性题目承载了模型间差距的95.7%，4/12模型可在不同配置下排名第一，并且当前的基准压缩方法倾向于保留脆弱题目而非去除它们。
AI.motivation: 现有的多项选择基准虽然固定了问题和正确答案，但没有固定评测harness（选项顺序、提示措辞、答案读取方式）。以往工作仅报告harness敏感性导致的总体得分方差，未考察方差落在哪些具体题目上，以及这些题目是否是区分不同模型的关键题目。因此需要将harness作为独立变量，将其影响解析到单个题目层面。
AI.method: 构建"脆弱性网格"：选取12个来自4个模型家族的开源指令微调LLM，在4个基准（ARC、HellaSwag、MMLU、TruthfulQA）的3,679个题目上，以26种同样合理的harness配置进行评测。每次记录每个模型-题目-配置组合的一个正确性比特。所有比较均为匹配设计：题目、权重、贪心解码保持固定，仅变化harness。
AI.result: 三个主要发现：(1) 相邻两个模型都稳定作答的题目上两者是平局，配置脆弱性题目平均承载了模型差距的95.7%；(2) 12个模型中有4个在某种配置下达到排名第一，harness决定了冠军；(3) 题目区分度与脆弱性相关度为0.28（95% CI 0.25-0.30），基准压缩方法保留了脆弱题目而非移除它们。评分方式的选择是承重轴，而非通常被协议固定的选项顺序。
AI.conclusion: 评测harness的选择会实质性改变模型排名，模型得分应被视为区间而非点。作者发布逐题目记录和分析脚本（可在CPU上秒级复现所有数字），并将脆弱性网格定位为排行榜在发布排名前应运行的一项检查。

title: Few-Shot Cross-Dataset Adaptation for Tuberculosis Detection Using DenseNet
summary: Tuberculosis (TB) is one of the most common and dangerous bacterial ailments. Every year, it causes a large number of deaths worldwide. Although many deep learning models can detect tuberculosis from chest X-rays quite accurately, severe domain shift across datasets makes the task challenging. Different imaging protocols, patient demographics, and equipment across domains make the task of generalization difficult. In real-world settings, a model may perform well on one dataset but show a noticeable drop in performance when tested on another. In this work, we address this domain adaptation challenge through a few-shot scaling study. A controlled cross-dataset evaluation is presented in this paper using TBX11K as the source domain and the Mendeley TB dataset as the target domain. It is investigated how varying the number of target samples affects model performance under three training regimes: frozen backbone adaptation, full fine-tuning of a source-pretrained DenseNet121 model, and training from scratch. The results indicate that the model can perform well even with limited data and can achieve 98.36\% accuracy with just 75 labeled samples per class. The adaptation curves demonstrate how fine-tuning effectively mitigates domain shift. These findings establish full fine-tuning of pretrained models as a highly effective and practical strategy for mitigating domain shift in low-resource clinical deployment scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文针对结核病胸部X光片检测中的域偏移问题，通过少量样本缩放研究，比较了冻结骨干、完全微调和从零训练三种训练策略在跨数据集（TBX11K→Mendeley）上的表现，发现完全微调源预训练的DenseNet121模型仅需每类75个标注样本即可达到98.36%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 结核病是全球最常见的危险细菌性疾病之一，虽然深度学习模型在胸部X光片上检测结核病已相当准确，但不同数据集之间存在严重的域偏移（如成像协议、患者人口统计学特征、设备差异），导致模型在实际部署中泛化能力下降，需要解决域适应挑战。
AI.method: 本文采用受控的跨数据集评估：以TBX11K为源域，Mendeley TB数据集为目标域，通过改变目标域样本数量，系统比较三种训练机制——冻结骨干适配、源预训练DenseNet121模型的完全微调、以及从零训练。
AI.result: 模型在有限数据条件下也能表现良好，仅用每类75个标注样本即可达到98.36%的准确率。适应曲线表明微调能有效缓解域偏移问题。
AI.conclusion: 完全微调预训练模型是缓解低资源临床部署场景中域偏移的高效且实用的策略。

title: ODG-NoMaD: Overhead-Camera Direction-Guided NoMaD
summary: NoMaD [31] is a learned vision-navigation policy that unifies goal-conditioned navigation and exploration in a single goal-masked diffusion policy. In an unseen environment, however - where neither a goal image nor a topological map is available - it can only explore undirectedly, wandering without global awareness. We present ODG-NoMaD, which gives NoMaD's exploration mode a global sense of where to proceed, without retraining the policy. An overhead depth camera is used once on deployment to build an occupancy map and plan a global path, which is segmented to yield a desired heading; a per-frame traversability map from the robot's onboard depth then refines this into a collision-free direction. The gradient of a cosine direction cost is injected into the final denoising steps, rotating sampled trajectories toward this direction while preserving the multimodality of exploration. In simulated office environments with and without random obstacles, ODG-NoMaD reduces the residual distance to the target by up to an order of magnitude over unguided exploration, outperforms the point-goal cost guidance of NaviDiffusor [37], and is the only configuration that remains collision-free on every trial.

AI.tldr: ODG-NoMaD在无需重新训练的前提下，通过一次性部署的顶视深度相机构建占用图并规划全局路径，将期望航向注入NoMaD探索策略的扩散去噪过程中，从而赋予无目标探索模式全局方向感，显著减少残余距离并保持无碰撞。
AI.motivation: NoMaD虽然在统一目标条件导航与探索方面表现出色，但在没有目标图像或拓扑图的未知环境中只能进行无方向的盲目探索，缺乏全局感知，导致效率低下。
AI.method: 1) 部署时用顶视深度相机一次构建占用图并规划全局路径，将其分段得到期望航向；2) 利用机器人机载深度获取逐帧可通行性图，细化出无碰撞方向；3) 将余弦方向代价的梯度注入扩散模型的最后去噪步骤，使采样轨迹朝向期望方向旋转，同时保留探索的多模态性。
AI.result: 在带/不带随机障碍物的模拟办公环境中，ODG-NoMaD相比无引导探索将目标残余距离最多降低一个数量级，优于NaviDiffusor的点目标代价引导，并且是唯一在所有试验中保持无碰撞的配置。
AI.conclusion: 通过轻量级的全局路径引导注入，无需重新训练即可显著增强现有视觉导航策略在未知环境中的探索能力与安全性。

title: Spyre-Accelerated Retrieval-Augmented Generation on IBM LinuxONE: A Cloud-Native Architecture for Secure, High-Throughput Enterprise AI Inference
summary:
Running large language models inside enterprise environments has always bumped up against a practical wall: the data lives in one place, the AI horsepower sits somewhere else, and moving sensitive records between the two creates real headaches around latency, security, and regulatory exposure. IBM's Spyre accelerator PCIe inference card built for LinuxONE and the broader IBM Z family changes that equation.
  In this paper we lay out a six-subsystem RAG architecture that runs entirely on IBM LinuxONE, using Spyre for generative inference, the Telum II on-chip accelerator for lightweight classification tasks, and Red Hat OpenShift for container orchestration. Every piece of the pipeline from query intake through vector retrieval, prompt assembly, LLM inference, compliance filtering, and response delivery stays within a single LinuxONE system, so sensitive data never has to leave the hardware perimeter.
  We walk through the design choices behind each subsystem, dig into the Spyre compilation and serving stack, explain how LinuxONE's Secure Execution technology extends confidential-computing guarantees to AI workloads, and benchmark the architecture against cloud-GPU and on-premises alternatives. Early analysis points to end-to-end RAG latencies under two seconds and up to a 20x reduction compared to off-platform inference, all while keeping the strong encryption and auditability posture that regulated industries actually need.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个完全运行在IBM LinuxONE平台上的六子系统RAG架构，利用Spyre加速器做生成推理、Telum II芯片做轻量分类、Red Hat OpenShift做容器编排，实现数据不出硬件边界的企业级AI推理，端到端延迟低于2秒，相比跨平台推理最多降低20倍。
AI.motivation: 企业环境中运行大语言模型面临核心痛点：数据存储位置与AI算力分离，跨平台传输敏感数据带来延迟、安全和合规风险。需要一种将数据与推理能力放在同一硬件边界内的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出六子系统RAG架构，全部部署在单一LinuxONE系统内：查询接收、向量检索、提示词组装、LLM推理（Spyre）、合规过滤、响应交付。利用Telum II片上加速器处理轻量分类任务，Red Hat OpenShift负责容器编排，并通过Secure Execution技术提供机密计算保障。
AI.result: 端到端RAG延迟低于2秒，相比跨平台推理最多降低20倍，同时保持强加密和可审计性，满足受监管行业的合规需求。
AI.conclusion: 通过将全部AI流水线收敛在单一LinuxONE硬件系统中，该架构有效解决了企业LLM部署中数据安全、延迟和合规的核心矛盾，为受监管行业提供了一种可行的本地化AI推理方案。

title: Measuring Gender Representation in Animated Films
summary: Animated films--often developed with an audience of children in mind--are an important vector for enculturation, and empirical work that has examined the representation of gender at scale in these films has largely focused on counting the gender composition of the cast rather than deploying a more fine-grained instrument (such as assessing the visibility of those characters in overall screentime). In this work, we develop a computational pipeline for recognizing animated characters in these films, and use it to test several hypotheses about gender representation in a corpus of 224 popular animated movies. We find that while the overall representation of female characters in animated films largely tracks with those of live-action films (over the period 1980-2025), we see stark differences between the representation of human characters (much greater representation among women and girls) and non-humans (largely male). Contrary to past work on Disney, we do not see female characters declining in antagonist roles in animated films, and characters who are women and girls are much more likely to share scenes together than their live action contemporaneous counterparts.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个计算流程用于识别动画电影中的角色，并在224部热门动画电影语料库中检验性别表征假设。研究发现：整体女性角色比例与真人电影趋势一致（1980-2025），但人类角色（女性/女孩比例更高）与非人类角色（以男性为主）存在显著差异；与以往迪士尼研究相反，未发现女性角色在反派角色中比例下降；女性角色更倾向于与女性角色共享场景。
AI.motivation: 动画电影是文化教化的重要载体，但以往关于性别表征的大规模实证研究主要关注角色数量的性别构成，缺乏更精细的分析工具（如评估角色在总屏幕时间中的可见性），因此需要开发更精细的量化方法来深入理解动画电影中的性别表征问题。
AI.method: 开发了一个用于识别动画电影中角色的计算流水线（computational pipeline），并利用该工具对224部热门动画电影进行系统性分析，检验关于性别表征的多个假设。
AI.result: 1) 动画电影中女性角色的整体表征与真人电影大致同步（1980-2025年期间）；2) 人类角色与非人类角色之间存在显著差异——人类角色中女性/女孩的代表性更高，而非人类角色则以男性为主；3) 与以往迪士尼研究相反，未发现女性角色在反派角色中比例下降的趋势；4) 女性角色比真人电影中更倾向于与其他女性角色共享场景。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过更精细的计算方法揭示了动画电影中性别表征的复杂图景，挑战了以往基于迪士尼研究的部分结论，并指出动画电影中性别表征并非单一趋势，而是因角色类型（人类vs非人类）和角色功能（如反派）而异。

title: Active Interaction-Aware Model Predictive Path Integral via Ego-Conditioned Generative Predictions
summary: Dense traffic is inherently interactive. The ego vehicle and surrounding agents continuously influence each other's reactions, making "what-if" reasoning essential for safe and efficient driving. To enable such an active interaction-aware behavior, we propose a planning framework that integrates an ego-conditioned generative autoregressive prediction model within Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control. The generative prediction model outputs stochastic, multi-modal predictions of surrounding agents conditioned on each of the ego's considered future actions. A nested sampling scheme enables tractable evaluation of expected cost and collision risk under the induced distribution. This formulation allows the ego to actively probe how different candidate actions shape the interaction outcomes and to identify actions that reduce ambiguity in uncertain interactions. Closed-loop simulations demonstrate improved safety and efficiency compared to conventional predict-then-plan and passive interaction-aware approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个交互感知规划框架，将自我条件生成自回归预测模型集成到模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制中，通过嵌套采样方案评估预期成本和碰撞风险，实现主动探测候选动作如何影响交互结果，在闭环仿真中相比传统"先预测后规划"和被动交互感知方法在安全性和效率上均有提升。
AI.motivation: 密集交通本质上是交互性的，自我车辆与周围智能体持续相互影响。传统"先预测后规划"方法忽略了自我动作对周围智能体反应的影响，而被动交互感知方法未能主动利用交互信息，因此需要一种主动交互感知的规划框架。
AI.method: 1) 将自我条件生成自回归预测模型集成到MPPI控制中；2) 生成预测模型以自我每个候选动作为条件，输出周围智能体的随机多模态预测；3) 采用嵌套采样方案，在诱导分布下实现预期成本和碰撞风险的可计算评估。
AI.result: 闭环仿真表明，所提出框架相比传统"先预测后规划"方法和被动交互感知方法，在安全性和驾驶效率方面均有显著改善。
AI.conclusion: 通过让自我车辆主动探测不同候选动作如何塑造交互结果，并识别能减少不确定性交互中歧义的动作，该框架能够实现更安全、更高效的交互感知驾驶行为。

title: Hate Speech Classification In Roman Urdu: A Comparative Study On Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning And Prompt Engineering
summary: Due to the widespread accessibility of the internet and social media, toxic and hateful con-tent has grown exponentially, causing significant distress and negative societal impacts. Ro-man Urdu, a low-resource language used in Pakistan and among Urdu-speaking communities worldwide, presents additional challenges because of its informal grammar, inconsistent sen-tence structures, and multiple variations in word spellings. This research aims to identify the most effective techniques for hate speech classification in such low-resource settings with limited data. To address this, the study investigates and compares the latest approaches, in-cluding prompt tuning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) using LoRA, and prompt en-gineering, under various experimental configurations. To achieve this objective, four exper-iments were designed. The first experiment involved direct inferencing with LLMs without any fine-tuning, to evaluate how well these models understand Roman Urdu in a zero-shot setting, especially given limited data. The second experiment utilized parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) with LoRA, which updates only a small subset of parameters, thereby reducing computational cost. The third experiment explored prompt tuning with both mixed and manually crafted prompts, using very small sets of training examples relative to the entire dataset, making it computationally efficient as well. Finally, the fourth experiment applied prompt engineering through zero-shot and few-shot learning, relying solely on care-fully designed instruction prompts for classification without further training.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对罗马乌尔都语（一种低资源语言）中的仇恨言论分类问题，系统比较了四种最新技术：零样本LLM直接推理、基于LoRA的参数高效微调（PEFT）、提示调优（prompt tuning）以及提示工程（prompt engineering），在有限数据条件下评估各方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 互联网和社交媒体上毒性和仇恨内容呈指数级增长，对社会造成负面影响。罗马乌尔都语作为一种低资源语言，存在非正式语法、不一致的句子结构和多种拼写变体等挑战，使得仇恨言论检测更加困难。研究旨在有限的低资源数据条件下，找到最有效的仇恨言论分类技术。
AI.method: 设计了四个实验：(1) 零样本直接推理——不进行微调，评估LLM对罗马乌尔都语的理解能力；(2) 使用LoRA的参数高效微调（PEFT）——仅更新少量参数以降低计算成本；(3) 提示调优——使用混合和人工构件的提示，利用相对于整个数据集非常少的训练样本；(4) 提示工程——通过零样本和少样本学习，仅依赖精心设计的指令提示进行分类，无需额外训练。
AI.result: 论文对四种不同方法在多项实验配置下进行了系统比较，以确定在低资源、数据有限的罗马乌尔都语仇恨言论分类任务中的最优技术方案。（摘要中未提供具体实验结果数据）
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过系统比较零样本推理、PEFT/LoRA微调、提示调优和提示工程四种方法，为低资源语言场景下的仇恨言论分类提供了技术选择参考，兼顾了计算效率与分类性能之间的权衡。

title: Boosting Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering with Structured Context Reasoning
comment: Accepted by ICME 2026. Source code is available at https://github.com/WISLab-GDUT/SCoRe
summary: Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering aims to answer questions about an image by integrating external knowledge with visual and textual information. Recent approaches often rely on in-context learning to prompt Large Language Models (LLMs) with multimodal context in a zero-shot or few-shot manner. However, we observe that directly concatenating heterogeneous visual descriptions and retrieved knowledge into long, unstructured prompts often degrades reasoning performance, due to both excessive irrelevant context and the lack of explicit relational structure. In this paper, we propose an LLM-based Structured Context Reasoning (SCoRe) framework that infers both explicit and implicit relationships for prediction. SCoRe consists of three stages: Context Acquisition, which generates diverse visual notes and retrieves explicit knowledge via an efficient two-stage multimodal retrieval strategy; Context Selection, which filters relevant visual, explicit, and implicit knowledge using LLM-guided selection; and Context Compression, which performs Relational Logic Distillation (RLD) to transform raw text into explicit entity-relation triplets. These relational triplets serve as a concise and structured prompt for final answer prediction. Extensive experiments on the OK-VQA and A-OKVQA benchmarks demonstrate that SCoRe consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCoRe框架，通过三个阶段的上下文结构化推理（获取、选择、压缩）来优化知识型视觉问答，将异构的视觉描述和检索知识转化为显式的实体-关系三元组作为压缩提示，在OK-VQA和A-OKVQA基准上超越现有最先进方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的知识型VQA方法通常直接拼接异构视觉描述和检索知识，形成长而无结构的提示，导致推理性能下降，原因在于过多的无关上下文和缺乏显式的关联结构。
AI.method: SCoRe框架包含三个阶段：(1) 上下文获取（Context Acquisition）：生成多样化视觉笔记，并通过高效的两阶段多模态检索策略获取显式知识；(2) 上下文选择（Context Selection）：利用LLM引导选择相关的视觉、显式和隐式知识；(3) 上下文压缩（Context Compression）：通过关系逻辑蒸馏（RLD）将原始文本转换为显式的实体-关系三元组，作为简洁结构化的提示用于最终答案预测。
AI.result: 在OK-VQA和A-OKVQA基准上的大量实验表明，SCoRe始终优于最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将上下文转化为结构化关系三元组，可以有效解决长提示中无关上下文和缺失关系结构的问题，从而提升LLM在知识型VQA任务中的推理性能。

title: Selective Cross-View Consistency for World Action Models: Held-Out Viewpoint Robustness Without Test-Time Camera Information
summary: World action models (WAMs) jointly denoise future video frames and robot actions, and the video prior is expected to generalize their control. Camera viewpoint change remains one of their hardest perturbation axes. We study a question specific to this model class: when training with same-state cross-view image pairs, on which output coordinates should a consistency loss be imposed? The WAM denoising target mixes view-covariant coordinates, namely the predicted future scene, with view-invariant coordinates, namely the action chunk, future proprioception, and value. We show that consistency applied to the covariant block is provably harmful, shrinking legitimate view-specific content to a fraction $1/(1+4λ)$ of its true value, and we verify this shrinkage law in controlled experiments. Selective cross-view consistency (SCVC) therefore constrains only the invariant block, requires no camera labels, extrinsics, depth, or view synthesis at training or test time, and leaves the deployment interface unchanged. We introduce a carve-and-hold-out evaluation protocol on the LIBERO-Plus camera track that separates a distribution-matched ceiling from genuine interpolation and extrapolation to held-out viewpoints, with a matched pair-trained control isolating the effect of the consistency term from pair exposure. On held-out orbital viewpoints beyond the training envelope, SCVC improves closed-loop success over the matched control by 12.2 points (95% CI [7.4, 17.0]; +15.5, CI [11.7, 19.4], under an independent second seed) -- an effect two further camera axes replicate -- while interpolation within the envelope shows no gain in either seed (-1.2 and -4.3 points) and in-distribution competence is preserved (-0.6, -0.2). We also report a cross-backbone audit showing that published camera-robustness numbers are confounded by wrist-camera pose stability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究世界动作模型（WAMs）在跨视角一致性训练中的损失施加位置问题。理论证明对视角协变坐标（预测未来场景）施加一致性损失会损害模型性能，并提出选择性跨视角一致性（SCVC）方法，仅约束视角不变坐标（动作块、未来本体感觉、价值）。在LIBERO-Plus相机轨道的保留视角上，SCVC相比匹配对照提升12.2个百分点的闭环成功率，同时保持插值能力和分布内性能。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型通过联合去噪未来视频帧和机器人动作来利用视频先验泛化控制，但相机视角变化是其最难应对的扰动之一。当使用同状态跨视角图像对训练时，需要明确一致性损失应施加在哪些输出坐标上，才能有效提升视角泛化能力。
AI.method: 1. 理论分析：证明对WAM去噪目标中的视角协变坐标（预测未来场景）施加一致性损失会产生有害的收缩效应，将合法视角特定内容压缩至真实值的1/(1+4λ)比例。2. 提出选择性跨视角一致性（SCVC）：仅对视角不变坐标（动作块、未来本体感受、价值）施加一致性约束，无需相机标签、外参、深度或视图合成。3. 设计carve-and-hold-out评估协议：分离分布匹配的上界与真实的插值/外推能力，并通过匹配的成对训练对照隔离一致性项与成对暴露的效果。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-Plus相机轨道的保留轨道视角上，SCVC相比匹配对照提升12.2个百分点（95% CI [7.4, 17.0]），第二个独立种子下提升15.5个百分点（CI [11.7, 19.4]）。另两个相机轴复制了该效果。插值范围内无增益（-1.2和-4.3），分布内性能保持（-0.6和-0.2）。此外发现已发表的相机鲁棒性数字因腕部相机姿态稳定性而存在混淆。
AI.conclusion: 对WAMs而言，跨视角一致性损失应仅施加在视角不变坐标上，而非协变坐标。SCVC能有效提升外推视角的闭环控制性能，且不改变部署接口、无需额外传感器信息。研究还揭示了现有相机鲁棒性评估中腕部相机姿态稳定性这一混淆因素的重要性。

title: The Abstention Protocol: RCA for Clos Fabrics
comment: Presented at Usenix OSDI 2026. 17 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables
summary:
Root cause analysis (RCA) in large datacenter networks is challenging because telemetry is noisy, partial, and asynchronous. Score-based approaches degrade under these conditions, often yielding unstable or incorrect attributions.
  We present \textsc{CoreSec}, a production RCA system that replaces weighted fusion with a PAM-style abstention algebra. Telemetry agents are composed using control flags that yield deterministic decisions and explicit abstention when evidence is ambiguous. CoreSec combines this algebra with topology-aware configurations that capture failure surfaces across Clos fabrics and converge monotonically as evidence accumulates.
  Deployed at hyperscale, CoreSec provides stable and explainable RCA behavior across diverse environments without retuning. Our experience shows that structured composition with abstention forms a practical foundation for automated RCA in real-world cloud networks.

AI.tldr: CoreSec是一个面向超大规模数据中心网络的根因分析（RCA）系统，用PAM风格的弃权代数（abstention algebra）替代传统的加权融合方法，通过控制标志组合遥测代理，在证据模糊时明确弃权，并结合拓扑感知配置在Clos架构中单调收敛，实现稳定且可解释的RCA行为。
AI.motivation: 大型数据中心网络中的根因分析面临遥测数据噪声大、不完整和异步的问题，基于分数（score-based）的方法在这些条件下会退化，产生不稳定或不正确的归因结果。因此需要一种更鲁棒的RCA方法。
AI.method: CoreSec采用PAM风格的弃权代数替代加权融合：遥测代理通过控制标志组合，产生确定性决策；当证据模糊时明确声明弃权。同时结合拓扑感知的配置来捕捉Clos架构中的故障表面，并保证随证据积累单调收敛。
AI.result: CoreSec已在超大规模环境中部署，能够在多样化环境中提供稳定且可解释的RCA行为，且无需重新调参。
AI.conclusion: 结构化组合配合弃权机制为真实世界云网络中的自动化RCA提供了一个实用的基础。

title: DesignAgent3D: Interactive 3D Scene Editing via Designer-like Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Text guided 3D scene editing provides an intuitive interface for modifying reconstructed environments, but remains difficult because natural language design requests are often semantically underspecified and must be grounded in cluttered 3D scenes. Existing methods typically formulate the task as one-shot conditional generation from a single prompt, failing to resolve ambiguous user intents or achieve precise spatial grounding. Consequently, they suffer from severe object localization drift, tracking failure under occlusions, and the notorious multi-view "sticker effect." To overcome these limitations, we present DesignAgent3D, an interactive multimodal agentic framework that reformulates 3D scene editing as a designer-like Plan-Perceive-Act paradigm. The agent first plans by interacting with the user to clarify underspecified design goals, then perceives by grounding the intended edit to specific objects or regions in the 3D scene, and finally acts by applying controlled visual modifications while preserving scene consistency. The edits are further integrated into the underlying 3D representation, supporting persistent and multi-view consistent novel-view rendering. Extensive experiments across both NeRF and 3D Gaussian Splatting backbones demonstrate that DesignAgent3D significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, delivering superior semantic intent alignment, impeccable spatial localization accuracy, and high-fidelity multi-view consistency.

AI.tldr: 提出了DesignAgent3D，一个交互式多模态智能体框架，将3D场景编辑重构为"规划-感知-行动"的设计师范式，通过用户交互澄清模糊意图、空间定位目标物体、执行受控视觉修改，在NeRF和3D高斯泼溅两种主干上均显著超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景编辑方法将任务视为从单个提示词进行一次性条件生成，无法解决用户意图模糊（语义欠指定）和杂乱3D场景中的精确空间定位问题，导致物体定位漂移、遮挡下跟踪失败以及多视角"贴纸效应"。
AI.method: 采用Plan-Perceive-Act三段式智能体范式：1）Plan阶段通过与用户交互澄清欠指定的设计目标；2）Perceive阶段将编辑意图定位到3D场景中的具体对象或区域；3）Act阶段在保持场景一致性的前提下应用受控视觉修改，并将编辑结果集成到底层3D表示中以支持持久且多视角一致的新视角渲染。
AI.result: 在NeRF和3D Gaussian Splatting两种骨干网络上进行大量实验，DesignAgent3D显著优于最先进基线，在语义意图对齐、空间定位精度和多视角一致性方面均表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 通过将3D场景编辑重新定义为人机交互式智能体任务而非一次性生成任务，可以有效解决模糊意图和空间定位两大核心难题，为3D场景编辑提供了一种更可靠、更可控的新范式。

title: Tolerance-Dependent Inspection Disagreement Between a Fixed CMM and a Portable Articulated-Arm CMM
summary: Fixed coordinate measuring machines (CMMs) and portable articulated-arm CMMs are often assigned to the same inspection task, but their nominal accuracy specifications do not show whether a change of instrument will preserve the disposition of a part. The question is not simply how far the two results differ, but whether that difference crosses the tolerance boundary. We examined this issue with recorded measurements of cylindrical, cubic, and spherical features under nominal 20 °C and 30 °C conditions. Repeated records and two roughness profiles without sufficient acquisition information were removed, leaving six dimensional and four form profiles. For each dimensional feature, the distances of the two system means from nominal define the exact tolerance interval in which the systems receive opposite direct labels. The fixed-CMM stream was approximately 11.2 μm higher than the articulated-arm stream at both conditions. All four form profiles fell on opposite sides of the recorded 10 μm upper limit. The dimensional disagreement intervals also overlapped strongly; their mean widths were 6.573 μm at 20 °C and 4.995 μm at 30 °C. The results clarify why an average difference between instruments is not, by itself, a measure of substitution risk. The proposed tolerance map identifies the feature-tolerance combinations for which instrument choice can change the recorded inspection label and, therefore, where a controlled equivalence study and a task-specific uncertainty budget are needed before substitution.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了固定式坐标测量机（CMM）与便携式关节臂CMM在相同检测任务中的替代风险，提出了一种公差映射方法，用于识别仪器更换是否会导致检测结果跨越公差边界而改变判定结论。
AI.motivation: 固定式CMM和便携式关节臂CMM常被指派执行相同的检测任务，但二者的标称精度规格无法表明更换仪器是否会保持零件的判定结果。仅比较两种仪器的平均差异不足以衡量替代风险，关键在于差异是否跨越公差边界。
AI.method: 利用在20°C和30°C标称条件下对圆柱、立方体和球面特征的记录测量数据，剔除重复记录和缺少采集信息的粗糙度轮廓后，保留六个尺寸轮廓和四个形状轮廓。对每个尺寸特征，通过计算两个系统均值与名义值的距离来确定公差区间，在此区间内两个系统会得到相反的判定标签。构建公差映射以识别仪器选择可能改变检测标签的特征-公差组合。
AI.result: 固定式CMM流在两种温度条件下均比关节臂CMM流高约11.2 μm。所有四个形状轮廓均落在记录的10 μm上限的相反两侧。尺寸分歧区间高度重叠，平均宽度在20°C时为6.573 μm，在30°C时为4.995 μm。
AI.conclusion: 平均仪器差异本身不能作为替代风险的度量。所提出的公差映射能够识别仪器选择可能改变检测标签的特征-公差组合，在这些组合中，替换前需要进行受控等价性研究和针对任务的特定不确定度预算。

title: Retrieval-grounded robot program generation and simulation-based correction via Model Context Protocol
comment: Accepted by CIE53; to appear in the CIE53 Proceedings, Khalifa University, Abu Dhabi, UAE, October 20-23, 2026
summary: Flexible manufacturing requires industrial robots to be reprogrammed rapidly as product variants change. This paper presents a language-model-based workflow that generates, validates, and iteratively corrects ABB RAPID robot programs from natural language task descriptions. A dual-stream retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline grounds code generation in verified technical documentation and production templates, reducing domain-specific errors produced by ungrounded language models. A custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) server connects the language-model client directly to ABB RobotStudio for automated code upload, simulation execution, and diagnostic feedback. The evaluation combines a 30-query retrieval benchmark, scoped code-generation checks, and RobotStudio case studies in a simulated pickand- place manufacturing cell. The simulation loop exposes execution failures that static and semantic checks alone cannot catch, including suction release-height errors, unreachable placement targets, and configuration-dependent recovery motions. The results show how RAG and MCP can connect grounded code generation with executable feedback from industrial robot simulation software, while reducing but not eliminating expert setup and final supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于语言模型的工作流程，用于从自然语言任务描述中生成、验证并迭代修正ABB RAPID机器人程序，通过双流RAG管道和MCP服务器连接RobotStudio实现自动化代码上传、仿真执行和诊断反馈。
AI.motivation: 柔性制造要求工业机器人随产品变体快速重新编程，而纯粹的语言模型生成代码缺乏领域知识，容易产生特定领域的错误，静态检查无法捕获所有执行层面的问题。
AI.method: 采用双流RAG管道将代码生成建立在已验证的技术文档和生产模板之上；构建自定义MCP服务器连接语言模型客户端与ABB RobotStudio，实现代码上传、仿真执行和诊断反馈的自动化；通过仿真循环暴露静态和语义检查无法发现的执行失败。
AI.result: 实验包含30个查询的检索基准、范围化代码生成检查和模拟拾放制造单元的RobotStudio案例研究。仿真循环成功暴露了吸气释放高度错误、不可达放置目标和配置相关恢复运动等执行故障。
AI.conclusion: RAG和MCP能够将基于grounded代码生成与工业机器人仿真软件的可执行反馈连接起来，减少但并未消除专家设置和最终监督的需求。

title: WorldMind: Decoupled Game World Model for State-Aware NPC Behavior
summary: Game world models have recently demonstrated promising capabilities in generating visually coherent and action-controllable gameplay videos. However, non-player character (NPC) behavior in existing models is either implicitly entangled with video generation or explicitly prescribed through external control signals. Consequently, a game world model has to jointly understand the state, plan the NPC's response and render its visual outcome, limiting its ability to produce responsive and state-aware NPC behavior. The challenge lies in the lack of an explicit interface for state-grounded decision-making. To this end, we introduce WorldMind, to our knowledge the first decoupled framework for state-aware NPC behavior in game world models. WorldMind separates interactive world modeling into four layers: an Understanding Layer that constructs a compact state from generated frames; a Decision Layer that reasons over the compact state to plan the NPC's next action; a Control Layer that translates the actions into temporally aligned conditions; and a Generation Layer that synthesizes their visual outcomes. By reconnecting layers in a closed interaction loop, WorldMind grounds NPC behavior in the evolving game state. We further introduce BOSS-140K, a dataset of gameplay videos paired with rich internal game states, together with an agent that automates the collection at scale. Experiments on BOSS-140K demonstrate reliable compact state reconstruction and mechanics-grounded planning, with WorldMind preferred over the baselines in approximately 70% of pairwise comparisons for its more tactically appropriate and coherent NPC behavior. Project page: https://teawhite.cn/worldmind_projectpage/

AI.tldr: 本文提出WorldMind，一个将NPC行为决策从游戏世界模型视频生成中解耦的框架，通过四层架构（感知、决策、控制、生成）构建闭环交互，并配套发布BOSS-140K数据集（含内部游戏状态的游戏视频），实验证明其能生成更战术合理且连贯的NPC行为。
AI.motivation: 现有游戏世界模型中，NPC行为要么与视频生成隐式耦合，要么通过外部信号显式指定，导致模型需同时理解状态、规划响应和渲染结果，难以产生响应式且状态感知的NPC行为。核心问题在于缺乏状态接地决策的显式接口。
AI.method: WorldMind将交互式世界建模解耦为四层：理解层（从生成帧构建紧凑状态）、决策层（基于紧凑状态规划NPC下一步动作）、控制层（将动作转化为时间对齐的条件）、生成层（合成视觉结果）。各层通过闭环交互循环重新连接，使NPC行为基于不断演化的游戏状态。同时提出BOSS-140K数据集和自动化采集agent。
AI.result: 在BOSS-140K上验证了可靠的紧凑状态重建和机制接地规划能力；在成对比较中，约70%的情况下WorldMind因更战术合理且连贯的NPC行为被优先选择。
AI.conclusion: WorldMind通过显式解耦NPC决策与视频生成，为游戏世界模型提供了状态接地决策的接口，显著提升了NPC行为的响应性和状态感知能力，为该方向提供了新范式和大规模数据集支持。

title: Mamba-based Selective State Space Modeling Improves the Accuracy-Complexity Tradeoff of SmolVLA Vision-Language-Action Experts
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models face a crucial tradeoff between their task success rate and the policy-call frequency. Executing a single action per inference ($N=1$) enables accurate robot control but comes at the cost of huge compute time overheads, making real-time implementation infeasible. On the other hand, executing longer action horizons before replanning ($N\gg1$) reduces compute complexity, but inevitably degrades the system's success rate. In order to improve the VLA accuracy-complexity tradeoff, this paper investigates Mamba's selective state-space modeling as an alternative to causal self-attention within the action expert of the popular SmolVLA model, widely used as a reference model for its highly accurate yet low complexity nature. We evaluate both the Mamba- and Transformer-based experts on the widely-adopted LIBERO benchmark suites across three execution horizons $N\!\in\!\{1,25,50\}$, respectively corresponding to high, moderate and low compute complexities. Our results remarkably show that the advantage of the Mamba expert increases with the execution horizon, indicating significant success retention under long execution horizons $N = 50$ and $N = 25$. When $N = 50$ actions are executed before replanning (i.e., corresponding to feasible real-time deployment), the Mamba expert outperforms the Transformer baseline by $7.8\%$. In addition, when $N = 25$ actions are executed before replanning, our Mamba expert outperforms the Transformer baseline by $3.7\%$. Finally, under per-action replanning ($N=1$), our Mamba variant matches the Transformer-based mean success rate while significantly reducing the overall model parameter complexity by $24\%$ thanks to Mamba's compute-efficient nature.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在VLA模型的action expert中用Mamba选择性状态空间建模替代因果自注意力，以改善任务成功率与策略调用频率之间的权衡。在LIBERO基准上，Mamba专家在长执行视野（N=50和N=25）下分别比Transformer基线高出7.8%和3.7%，在N=1时匹配基线性能同时参数减少24%。
AI.motivation: VLA模型面临关键权衡：单步执行（N=1）精度高但计算开销大，无法实时实现；长视野执行（N≫1）降低计算复杂度但会损害任务成功率。需要改善这一精度-复杂度权衡。
AI.method: 在SmolVLA模型的action expert中，用Mamba的选择性状态空间建模替代因果自注意力机制，并在LIBERO基准上评估三种执行视野N∈{1,25,50}下的表现，对比Mamba专家与Transformer专家的性能。
AI.result: Mamba专家的优势随执行视野增加而增大：N=50时比Transformer基线高出7.8%，N=25时高出3.7%，N=1时性能匹配但参数复杂度降低24%。
AI.conclusion: Mamba作为VLA action expert中的替代架构能够显著改善精度-复杂度权衡，尤其适合需要长时间执行视野才能实现实时部署的场景，同时保持或超越Transformer基线的性能。

title: Composable Trust Infrastructure for Manufacturing Knowledge Graphs: Cross-System Provenance, Temporal Reasoning, and Decision Traceability
summary: Manufacturing knowledge graphs that integrate data from heterogeneous industrial systems face a trust deficit: consumers cannot determine whether queried data is valid, whether it was valid when a decision was made, where it originated, or how it was acted upon. We argue that four trust capabilities -- SHACL validation, PROV-O provenance, domain-aware bi-temporal versioning, and graph-native decision objects -- compose through shared correlation identifiers to produce emergent trust properties that no single capability delivers alone. We present a composable trust infrastructure that integrates these four capabilities into a unified RDF architecture. Capabilities compose through shared entity URIs, ingestion activity identifiers, and temporal correlation keys, enabling compound queries spanning all four dimensions. An experimental ablation confirms that removing any single capability causes exactly three of six composition queries to fail, demonstrating that all four are equally load-bearing. Analysis of higher-order compositions reveals four emergent three-way properties and one irreducible four-way property (full-chain auditability, 31ms execution). The infrastructure is validated on a testbed integrating eleven industrial sources -- OPC UA, TIA Portal, eClass, AAS, ISA-95, ISA-18.2, SAP S/4HANA, Teamcenter, Opcenter EX, Insights Hub, and SCM -- under an 89-class ISA-95-aligned ontology. The unified graph contains 8,743 triples across five named graphs, stitched by 81 owl:sameAs identity edges. Evaluation uses simulated but structurally realistic data from purpose-built emulators; data structures and cross-system linkage patterns are representative of real industrial installations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可组合的信任基础设施，通过共享关联标识符将SHACL验证、PROV-O溯源、领域感知双时态版本控制和图原生决策对象四种能力集成到统一RDF架构中，产生单独能力无法实现的涌现信任属性。通过11个工业数据源的测试验证，消融实验表明四种能力同等重要。（全链路可审计性，31ms执行）
AI.motivation: 制造知识图谱集成异构工业系统数据时面临信任赤字：消费者无法判断查询数据的有效性、决策时点数据的有效性、数据来源及数据处置方式。四种信任能力单独使用时均无法解决这一系统性信任问题。
AI.method: 提出可组合信任基础设施，将四种能力（SHACL验证、PROV-O溯源、领域感知双时态版本控制、图原生决策对象）通过三种共享关联机制（实体URI、摄取活动标识符、时序关联键）集成到统一RDF架构中。在89类ISA-95对齐本体下，用11个工业数据源（OPC UA、TIA Portal、eClass等）构建测试平台验证。
AI.result: 消融实验显示移除任一能力导致六个组合查询中的三个失败，证明四种能力同等关键。高阶组合分析揭示四个涌现三元性质和1个不可约的四元性质（全链路可审计性，31ms执行）。统一图谱包含5个命名图的8,743条三元组，由81条owl:sameAs身份边缝合，使用仿真但结构真实的数据验证。
AI.conclusion: 四种信任能力通过共享关联标识符组合可产生单个能力无法提供的涌现信任属性，且四种能力在系统信任中均为承载性要素。该基础设施在仿真但结构真实的数据上完成验证，数据结构与跨系统关联模式可代表真实工业部署。

title: Text-Guided Visual Dependency Graph Learning with Cross-Modal Attention Priors
summary: Estimating interpretable conditional-dependence structures from multimodal visual-linguistic features remains largely unexplored. We propose CM-GLasso (Cross-Modal Graphical Lasso), a framework that bridges vision-language representation learning and sparse Gaussian Graphical Models. CM-GLasso introduces three key components: (i) a text visualization strategy that renders class-attribute descriptions as images and processes them through the same SigLIP-2 vision encoder as natural images, yielding prototype-indexed patch-level attention footprints in a shared feature coordinate system; (ii) a cross-attention distillation mechanism that condenses high-dimensional patches into a small set of semantic graph nodes, whose attention-footprint similarities yield cross-modal structural priors for non-uniform L1 penalization; (iii) a joint ADMM formulation that estimates shared and class-specific precision components within a single convex objective, avoiding the need to first estimate and then decompose separate class-wise graphs. The learned sparse graph topologies directly support a parameter-free, precision-based classification rule and a lightweight topology-aware segmentation head. Extensive experiments on eight benchmarks demonstrate that CM-GLasso achieves competitive or superior performance compared with strong feature-based and task-specific baselines. Under the matched controlled protocol, it attains the highest average classification accuracy (91.97%) and the highest segmentation mIoU among the controlled baselines on VOC (74.75%) and ADE20K (64.01%), while also yielding explicit sparse conditional-dependence graphs with common-specific decomposition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CM-GLasso框架，将视觉-语言表示学习与稀疏高斯图模型相结合，通过学习可解释的条件依赖结构来实现跨模态图像分类与分割任务。
AI.motivation: 从多模态视觉-语言特征中估计可解释的条件依赖结构仍未被充分探索，已有方法多依赖黑盒特征而非结构化的图拓扑。
AI.method: CM-GLasso包含三个关键组件：(i)文本可视化策略，将类别属性描述渲染为图像并经过与自然图像相同的SigLIP-2视觉编码器处理，生成原型索引的patch级注意力足迹；(ii)跨注意力蒸馏机制，将高维patch压缩为语义图节点，利用注意力足迹相似度构建非均匀L1惩罚的跨模态结构先验；(iii)联合ADMM求解框架，在单一凸目标中同时估计共享和类别特定的精度矩阵。
AI.result: 在八个基准上达到竞争性或更优性能。受控协议下，平均分类准确率91.97%最高，VOC分割mIoU 74.75%和ADE20K分割mIoU 64.01%均为受控基线中最高，同时产出具有共享-特定分解的显式稀疏条件依赖图。
AI.conclusion: CM-GLasso成功融合了视觉语言表示学习与稀疏图模型，不仅提升了分类和分割性能，还提供了可解释的稀疏图拓扑（含共同与特定成分的分解），并直接支持无需参数的分类规则和轻量级拓扑感知分割头。

title: Position: Robot Privacy as Embodied Boundary Work. Connecting Capabilities, Contexts, and Design Responses in Everyday Robotics
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Accepted for publication in UbiComp Companion '26
summary: Robots are increasingly entering everyday environments where privacy is shaped not only by data practices, but also by spatial, bodily, social, and relational boundaries. Their embodied capabilities allow them to reshape these boundaries through situated action, challenging privacy framings centered on data flows, interface settings, or one-time consent. Prior work has examined robot privacy through sensing, data collection, telepresence, transparency, consent, bystander awareness, and multi-stakeholder governance. Building on this work, we propose embodied boundary privacy as a capability-by-context framing for examining how physically present robots may reshape privacy boundaries in situated interaction. Specifically, this framing organizes privacy risks across seven robot capabilities and five deployment contexts, asking how embodied capabilities enable boundary crossings and how situated contexts shape who is affected, how these crossings are interpreted, and when they become contested. We use this perspective to outline design and research implications for embodied privacy mechanisms, including boundary checkpoints, viewpoint-aware sensing control, remote-presence disclosure, object- and body-level access rules, constraints on socially persuasive privacy influence, and local interruption rights. We encourage HRI research, design, and governance to treat robot movement, orientation, proximity, object access, remote presence, and social expression as privacy-relevant actions whose meaning depends on context.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"具身边界隐私"（embodied boundary privacy）框架，用以分析物理在场机器人如何通过其具身能力在情境化互动中重塑隐私边界。该框架将隐私风险组织为七种机器人能力与五种部署情境的组合，并探讨具身能力如何促成边界跨越，以及情境如何影响受影响者、解读方式和争议时机，最后提出相应的设计与研究启示。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人隐私研究多聚焦于数据流、界面设置或一次性同意，但机器人进入日常环境后，其具身动作（移动、朝向、接近、物体接触、远程在场、社会表达等）能够通过情境化行动重塑空间、身体、社交和关系层面的隐私边界，这超出了传统以数据为中心的隐私框架所能涵盖的范围。因此需要一个新的框架来理解和应对这一问题。
AI.method: 提出"具身边界隐私"框架，采用能力-情境（capability-by-context）的分析视角。具体而言，该框架将隐私风险按七种机器人能力与五种部署情境进行组织，并提出两个核心问题：具身能力如何促成边界跨越，以及情境如何影响受影响者、解读方式与争议时机。
AI.result: 基于该框架，论文得出设计与研究启示，包括：边界检查点、视角感知的感知控制、远程在场披露、物体与身体层面的访问规则、对社交说服性隐私影响力的约束，以及本地中断权等具身隐私机制。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁HRI研究、设计与治理将机器人的移动、朝向、接近、物体访问、远程在场和社会表达视为隐私相关行动，其含义取决于具体情境。

title: Evaluating Multimodal Narrative Understanding of Popular Hollywood Films
summary: Multimodal language models increasingly show promise for enabling the large-scale computational analysis of film, opening up new avenues for learning about film history and the evolution of narrative techniques. But the creation of stable benchmarks built around Hollywood films is complicated by copyright protections. In this work, we address these concerns directly, by building a new collection of Hollywood films defined by two criteria: box office popularity (where we publish the first large-scale, open collection of weekly box office earnings reported by Variety magazine from 1922-1979); and likely public domain status (by researching copyright registrations and renewals in the US Catalog of Copyright Entries). We build a new multimodal MCQ benchmark on top of this collection that focuses on narrative elements that directly evaluate the abilities of models to inform meaningful research on film narrative; we find that many vision-language models struggle on this task (with many performing at near-chance levels of accuracy), while audio-visual models (including those that use audio in captioning scenes) reach a maximum accuracy of 61.1%, well below human-level performance.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个基于好莱坞电影的基准数据集，该数据集通过两个标准筛选影片：票房知名度（收录1922-1979年Variety杂志周票房数据，这是首个大规模公开的此类数据集）和公版状态（通过查询美国版权登记目录确认）。在此基础上建立了一个多模态多项选择题基准，评估模型对电影叙事元素的理解能力。结果显示许多视觉-语言模型接近随机水平，音频-视觉模型最高准确率仅61.1%，远低于人类表现。
AI.motivation: 多模态语言模型有望实现电影的大规模计算分析，推动电影史和叙事技术演变研究。然而，围绕好莱坞电影构建稳定基准受版权保护限制，这成为该领域发展的主要障碍。
AI.method: 1) 依据两大标准构建好莱坞电影集合：票房热度（整理发表1922-1979年Variety杂志周票房数据）和公版状态（研究美国版权登记与续期目录）；2) 基于该集合构建多模态多项选择题基准，聚焦于能评估模型对电影叙事理解能力的叙事元素。
AI.result: 许多视觉-语言模型在该任务中表现接近随机水平；音频-视觉模型（包括利用音频进行场景字幕生成的模型）最高准确率达61.1%，但仍显著低于人类水平。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态模型在电影叙事理解方面仍存在显著不足，该基准为评估和改进模型在此方向的能力提供了重要测试平台，同时也为电影计算分析领域贡献了首个大规模公开的票房数据集。

title: ViTexSZ: Heterogeneous Vision-Text Knowledge Distillation for EEG Seizure Detection
summary: Automated seizure detection from electroencephalography (EEG) is essential for continuous neurological monitoring, particularly for subclinical epileptic seizures that may exhibit only subtle electrographic changes. Existing time-series methods are often designed for fixed EEG channel configurations, thereby limiting their applicability to heterogeneous EEG recordings with irregular channel layouts. Although visual and language modeling offer promising alternatives, aligning heterogeneous EEG representations with clinical semantics remains challenging. We introduce ViTexSZ, a heterogeneous Vision-Text knowledge distillation framework for EEG seizure detection. ViTexSZ converts EEG recordings into structured waveform images and introduces a query-based multi-channel alignment module that maps source-dependent visual features into a unified token space. A heterogeneous teacher further integrates the aligned EEG representations with clinical prompts through a multimodal large language model, associating high-level clinical semantics with seizure-related evidence. Vision-text knowledge distillation then transfers the teacher representations to a lightweight student during detection. Experiments on four EEG seizure datasets demonstrate the generalizability of ViTexSZ across both subclinical and general seizure detection scenarios, achieving the highest accuracy on all datasets and relative improvements of up to 12.9% over the second-best baselines, showing its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: ViTexSZ是一个异构视觉-文本知识蒸馏框架，用于EEG癫痫发作检测。它将EEG记录转换为结构化波形图像，引入查询式多通道对齐模块将源相关的视觉特征统一到token空间，并通过多模态大语言模型作为异构教师整合临床语义，最后通过视觉-文本知识蒸馏将教师表征迁移到轻量级学生模型中。在四个EEG癫痫数据集上取得了最佳准确率，相对提升最高达12.9%。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG癫痫检测方法多为固定通道配置设计，难以适用于通道布局不规则的异构EEG记录；同时视觉和语言建模方法在将异构EEG表示与临床语义对齐方面仍面临挑战。
AI.method: 1) 将EEG记录转换为结构化波形图像；2) 提出查询式多通道对齐模块，将源相关的视觉特征映射到统一token空间；3) 利用多模态大语言模型作为异构教师，整合对齐的EEG表示与临床提示词；4) 通过视觉-文本知识蒸馏将教师表征迁移至轻量级学生模型。
AI.result: 在四个EEG癫痫数据集上，ViTexSZ在所有数据集上均取得最高准确率，相比第二好的基线方法相对提升最高达12.9%，在亚临床与一般癫痫检测场景中均表现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: ViTexSZ通过异构视觉-文本知识蒸馏框架有效解决了EEG通道异构性和临床语义对齐问题，为亚临床和一般癫痫发作检测提供了一种通用且高效的解决方案。

title: Social Graph Mamba: Forecasting Pedestrian Movements Based on Social Context
summary: Forecasting pedestrian motion has always been fundamental for autonomous navigation in crowded environments. While attention-based methods achieve strong performance, they suffer from quadratic computational complexity in modeling social interactions, limiting scalability. Additionally, the existing methods often achieve high accuracy on prediction benchmarks at the individual level, but fail to fully capture the natural movement behaviors of crowds in real-world scenarios, particularly group structures. In this study, we propose Social Graph Mamba (SGM), a novel architecture that replaces attention-based social reasoning with Selective State Space Models (SSMs) operating on dynamically constructed interaction graphs. SGM introduces a dynamic interaction graph with social triplet factorization to decompose crowd interactions sequentially, and a community-aware module to effectively discover group structures via differentiable MinCut optimization and conditions both the embedding space and multi-modal decoder on group membership. Our experiments on standard benchmarks (ETH/UCY, SDD) demonstrate competitive performance with linear sequence complexity compared to quadratic attention-based methods. We further validate SGM in physical robot experiments by integrating predicted trajectories into a Social Force Model (SFM) for real-world implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Social Graph Mamba (SGM)，一种用于行人轨迹预测的新型架构，利用选择性状态空间模型（SSMs）替代基于注意力的社交推理，在动态构建的交互图上运行，实现了线性序列复杂度。SGM通过社交三元组分解动态交互图，并采用基于可微MinCut优化的社区感知模块发现群体结构，在多模态解码器中条件化群体成员信息。实验在ETH/UCY和SDD基准上达到与基于注意力的方法相当的竞争性能，并在真实机器人实验中通过Social Force Model验证了实际应用效果。
AI.motivation: 现有注意力机制的行人轨迹预测方法存在两个核心问题：（1）社交交互建模的二次方计算复杂度限制了可扩展性；（2）现有方法在个体层面精度高，但无法充分捕捉真实场景中人群的自然运动行为，尤其是群体结构特征。
AI.method: SGM架构包括三个核心组件：（1）用选择性状态空间模型（SSMs）在动态构建的交互图上进行社交推理，替代注意力机制，实现线性复杂度；（2）动态交互图结合社交三元组分解，将人群交互序列化分解；（3）社区感知模块通过可微MinCut优化发现群体结构，并将群体归属信息条件化到嵌入空间和多模态解码器中。
AI.result: 在ETH/UCY和SDD标准基准上，SGM取得与基于注意力的方法相当的竞争性能，同时序列复杂度从二次方降为线性。此外，通过在物理机器人实验中集成Social Force Model进行真实世界验证，证明了方法的实际可行性。
AI.conclusion: SGM证明了状态空间模型可作为注意力机制的高效替代方案用于行人轨迹预测，在保持预测精度的同时大幅降低计算复杂度，并且通过群体结构建模提升了社交交互的自然性，为大规模拥挤场景下的自主导航提供了更可扩展的解决方案。

title: Agentic AI for Safety-critical Multi-drone Systems: Challenges and Opportunities
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, presented at the AgentCraft Workshop at IUI2026 Conference, https://agentcraft-iui.github.io/2026/ - CEUR-WS.org proceedings forthcoming
summary: Multi-drone systems are increasingly positioned for safety-critical missions such as search and rescue (SAR) and critical infrastructure monitoring. Yet, real-world adoption remains constrained not only by autonomy performance, but by the difficulty of integrating agentic behavior into professional work: operators must understand, trust, and govern automation under uncertainty, time pressure, and accountability. This position paper synthesizes the ambitions and lessons from two ongoing efforts: NAMUR, which explores LLM-supported robot control in SAR and firefighting contexts, and PERSIST, which explores persistent drone operations for monitoring and security at critical infrastructure sites. We argue that agentic AI should be approached as a socio-technical design problem, where interfaces, oversight mechanisms, and evaluation practices are as critical as algorithms. We outline a human-centered, participatory, and iterative research approach aimed at uncovering stakeholder needs, shaping agent capabilities through successive prototypes, and producing transferable proof-of-concept systems and evaluation strategies for other safety-critical contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文，基于NAMUR和PERSIST两个正在进行的研究项目，主张将多无人机系统中的智能体AI视为社会技术设计问题，强调人机交互、监管机制和评估实践与算法同等重要。
AI.motivation: 多无人机系统在搜救和关键基础设施监控等安全关键任务中日益重要，但实际应用受限于将智能体行为整合到专业工作中的困难——操作员需要在不确定性、时间压力和问责制下理解、信任和管理自动化。
AI.method: 采用以人为本、参与式和迭代式的研究方法，通过连续原型设计来满足利益相关者需求，结合两个项目（NAMUR探索LLM支持的搜救与消防机器人控制，PERSIST探索关键基础设施的持久无人机监控）的实践经验。
AI.result: 提出了一个社会技术设计框架，强调接口、监管机制和评估实践与算法同等重要，并产出可迁移的概念验证系统和评估策略。
AI.conclusion: 智能体AI的部署不仅是技术问题，更是社会技术设计问题，需要将人为因素融入到系统开发全过程中，才能实现安全关键环境中的实际应用。

title: BIMScript: Material-Aware Structured Scene Programs for BIM Ingestion
comment: Project Page: see https://bimscriptworld.github.io/BIMScript/ ; to be published in ECCV 2026 TwinWorld Workshop
summary: Structured-language models such as SceneScript reconstruct a scene as a short program of parametric commands, an inherently editable and semantically explicit representation. We ask three questions that stand between such models and their most compelling application, automated ingestion of existing buildings into BIM tools, studied here on synthetic scans: \emph{what} is the scene made of, \emph{how fast} can it be produced, and \emph{exactly where} is each element. BIMScript answers all three within one grammar.
