First, we extend the layout language with per-element \emph{material} and \emph{condition} attributes, supervised by a vision-language-model material-passport corpus we build over 100k synthetic scenes (1.9M pseudo-labeled elements), and route image appearance to the material tokens through a lifted-feature point encoder. Second, we show that autoregressive decoding of these programs is dominated not by compute but by kernel-launch and host-synchronization overhead, and remove it with an output-exact CUDA-graph decoder (1.9 vs 6.4\,ms/step, $3.4\times$) plus a grammar-parallel, tolerance-verified draft-and-verify scheme that exploits the deterministic entity schema. Third, we address the model's 5cm token-grid granularity with training-free geometric snapping and a hybrid discrete--continuous decoder head that regresses a sub-bin offset, and measure how much of the residual error each recovers. Because each command maps one-to-one onto a native Revit object, we validate direct ingestion into a BIM authoring tool end to end with a working add-in and its IFC4 export, and the same program's language form is designed to support LLM-driven, sustainability-aware reasoning over the built asset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BIMScript，一种用于建筑信息建模（BIM）的结构化语言模型，通过单一语法同时回答三个问题：场景由什么构成（材质与条件属性）、生成速度多快（CUDA-graph解码器+草稿-验证加速）、每个元素精确位置（几何吸附+混合离散-连续解码头）。在100k合成场景上验证，并实现了到Revit的真实端到端导入。
AI.motivation: 结构化语言模型将场景表示为可编辑的参量命令程序，最有吸引力的应用是将现有建筑自动导入BIM工具。但此类模型存在三个关键障碍：不知道场景由什么材料构成、生成速度受非计算开销主导、以及5cm标记网格的精度不足。这些问题制约了模型在实际BIM工作流中的可用性。
AI.method: 1) 扩展布局语言，加入逐元素的材质和状态属性，通过构建100k合成场景（190万伪标签元素）的视觉语言模型材质护照语料库进行监督，并用提升特征点编码器将图像外观路由到材质token；2) 发现自回归解码瓶颈是内核启动和主机同步开销而非计算，用输出精确的CUDA-graph解码器（1.9 vs 6.4 ms/步，3.4倍加速）以及利用确定性实体schema的语法并行、容差验证的草稿-验证方案来消除；3) 针对5cm token网格粒度，采用免训练的几何吸附和回归亚网格偏移的混合离散-连续解码头，量化各自恢复的残差误差。
AI.result: CUDA-graph解码器实现3.4倍加速；几何吸附和混合离散-连续解码头有效恢复网格量化残差；每个命令与原生Revit对象一一对应，通过可用的Revit插件及其IFC4导出验证了端到端直接导入BIM创作工具。
AI.conclusion: BIMScript在单一语法内同时解决了场景构成、生成速度和几何精度三个问题，实现了从合成扫描到BIM创作工具的直接自动导入。程序的语言形式还支持由LLM驱动的、面向可持续性的既有资产推理，展示了结构化语言模型在建筑领域实际应用的价值。

title: RiskWorld: Object-Centric Latent World Modeling for Autonomous Driving Risk Identification
summary: Autonomous driving risk identification aims to determine which observed object is likely to become safety-critical to the ego vehicle. Existing approaches typically predict scene-level accidents, infer risk objects indirectly from ego behavior, or apply geometric checks after trajectory forecasting, without directly using predicted ego--object relations for risk-source localization. We propose RiskWorld, an object-centric latent world model that identifies risk from the imagined evolution of each candidate relative to the ego vehicle. RiskWorld combines pretrained predictive video representations with structured ego--object histories, contextualizes observed interactions, and rolls relation-aware object states into the future using RSSM-style latent dynamics. It decodes the rollout into object-level risk scores, supported by auxiliary future-relation and temporal-risk predictions. Inference uses only observations up to the current time, while logged futures provide training supervision. On RiskBench, RiskWorld achieves the best overall F1 of 63.0\% and the lowest false-alarm rate of 2.1\%. Further analyses show that the learned rollout captures the evolution of object-level risk before critical events, while RiskWorld's selections preserve planning-critical information under filtered observation.

AI.tldr: RiskWorld是一种以物体为中心（object-centric）的潜在世界模型，用于自动驾驶风险识别。它利用预训练视频表示和结构化自车-物体历史，通过RSSM风格潜在动力学预测物体相对自车的未来演化，直接输出物体级风险评分，在RiskBench上取得最佳F1（63.0%）和最低误报率（2.1%）。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶风险识别方法要么预测场景级事故、要么从自车行为间接推断风险物体、要么在轨迹预测后进行几何检查，缺乏直接利用预测的自车-物体关系来进行风险源定位的方法。因此需要一种能够直接基于物体与自车未来关系的演化来识别风险源头的方法。
AI.method: RiskWorld结合了预训练预测性视频表示与结构化的自车-物体历史信息，对观察到的交互进行上下文建模，并使用RSSM风格的潜在动力学将关系感知的物体状态滚动到未来。随后将滚动结果解码为物体级风险评分，同时辅以未来关系和时域风险的辅助预测。推理时仅使用截至当前时刻的观测，训练时利用记录的轨迹未来作为监督信号。
AI.result: 在RiskBench基准上，RiskWorld取得了最佳的整体F1分数63.0%，以及最低的误报率2.1%。进一步分析表明，其学习到的滚动预测能够捕捉关键事件前物体级风险的演化过程，且在过滤观测条件下，RiskWorld的选择保留了规划关键信息。
AI.conclusion: RiskWorld证明了以物体为中心的世界模型结合潜动力学能够有效地进行风险源定位，其直接利用预测的自车-物体关系而非间接推断，在性能和误报率方面均优于现有方法。该工作为自动驾驶风险识别提供了新的范式，未来有望在更大规模数据和真实场景中进一步验证。

title: Software Frameworks for Explainable AI in Time Series Classification: A Systematic Review
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures, to be published in ECML PKDD 2026, XKDD and Beyond Workshop, LNCS
summary: Time series arise in a wide range of application domains and are analyzed using machine learning in decision-critical settings. Time series classification (TSC) is one of the most widely studied and relevant tasks. In this context, ensuring the transparency and trustworthiness of TSC models has become an important requirement, motivating the use of explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) methods. Despite growing interest, research on XAI for TSC remains fragmented, and a systematic understanding of the available software frameworks for explanation generation, their evaluation practices, and practical limitations is still lacking. Prior work largely focused on individual explanation methods, while cross-framework consistency, time-series-specific evaluation, and reproducibility have received little attention. In this survey, we analyze existing software frameworks for explanation generation and evaluation in TSC. We compare them along multiple dimensions, including supported XAI methods, evaluation metrics, usability, benchmarking support, and reproducibility, providing the first time-series-specific survey of frameworks with implementation comparisons and an analysis of frequency-domain support. We identify six frameworks that explicitly support time series and reveal common limitations: only one method supports frequency-domain explanations despite their relevance; only two evaluation metrics have been developed specifically for time series; and identical XAI methods can yield substantially different explanations across frameworks. Based on these findings, we discuss open challenges and outline directions for future research, highlighting the need for unified, time-series-specific XAI frameworks that enable faithful, reproducible, and time-series-aware explanations.

AI.tldr: 本文是首个针对时间序列分类（TSC）中可解释人工智能（XAI）软件框架的系统性综述，评估了六个显式支持时间序列的框架，发现频率域解释支持不足、仅有两个时间序列专属评估指标、且跨框架相同XAI方法产生不一致解释等关键问题，并提出了统一、可复现、时间序列感知的XAI框架发展方向的建议。
AI.motivation: 时间序列分类在决策关键场景中广泛使用，XAI方法的透明性和可信赖性需求日益增长。然而当前XAI for TSC研究碎片化，缺乏对可用软件框架、评估实践和实际限制的系统性理解。已有研究大多聚焦单一解释方法，跨框架一致性、时间序列专属评估和可复现性被忽视。
AI.method: 采用系统性综述方法，对现有TSC解释生成与评估的软件框架进行多维度比较，包括支持的XAI方法、评估指标、易用性、基准测试支持和可复现性。特别进行首次时间序列专属框架调查，包含实现比较和频率域支持分析。
AI.result: 识别出六个明确支持时间序列的框架；发现仅有一种方法支持频率域解释；仅有两个评估指标为时间序列专门开发；相同的XAI方法在不同框架中产生显著不同的解释。基于这些发现指出了共同局限性。
AI.conclusion: 强调需要统一的、时间序列专属的XAI框架，以实现忠实、可复现且时间序列感知的解释。论文讨论了开放性挑战并勾勒了未来研究方向。

title: Beyond Visual Similarity: Entity-Aligned Retrieval for Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering
summary: Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering (KB-VQA) relies on retrieving external information to answer queries involving long-tail entities. However, existing retrieval pipelines predominantly employ CLIP-style dual encoders, which prioritize surface-level visual similarity over entity-level semantic alignment. This paradigm often fails when semantically identical concepts exhibit large visual variations or when distinct entities appear visually similar. To address this, we propose KBMR, the first MLLM-based embedding retriever tailored for KB-VQA. Leveraging the robust autoregressive capabilities of MLLMs, KBMR maps images into a semantic space that better preserves concept identity. To tackle the challenge of noisy supervision in Wikipedia-scale retrieval, we introduce an MLLM-based semantic discriminator that generates continuous entity-consistency weights. These weights guide a novel continuous semantic distillation objective, enabling effective hard negative sampling and soft supervision beyond rigid binary labels. Extensive experiments demonstrate that KBMR significantly outperforms CLIP baselines, yielding up to a 14.7% improvement in retrieval Recall@1 and a 9.4% gain in end-to-end VQA accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/realHarryX/KBMR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KBMR，首个面向知识库视觉问答（KB-VQA）的基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的嵌入检索器，通过语义判别器生成连续实体一致性权重并指导连续语义蒸馏目标，显著优于CLIP基线，在检索Recall@1上提升14.7%，端到端VQA准确率提升9.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有KB-VQA检索管线主要采用CLIP风格的双编码器，倾向于表面视觉相似性而非实体级语义对齐，在概念视觉变化大或不同实体视觉相似时容易失败。
AI.method: 1）提出KBMR，利用MLLM的自回归能力将图像映射到能更好保留概念身份的语义空间；2）引入基于MLLM的语义判别器，生成连续实体一致性权重；3）提出新的连续语义蒸馏目标，实现有效的硬负样本采样和超越二元标签的软监督。
AI.result: 实验表明KBMR显著优于CLIP基线，检索Recall@1提升最高14.7%，端到端VQA准确率提升9.4%。
AI.conclusion: KBMR证明了MLLM作为KB-VQA检索器的有效性，通过连续语义蒸馏解决了维基百科规模检索中噪声监督的挑战，为KB-VQA检索范式提供了新方向。

title: Operational digital twin clinics enable task-based evaluation of embodied AI
summary: Embodied artificial intelligence (AI) must be tested in the clinical environments where it will operate, but building realistic, robot-testable settings is costly and difficult to scale. Here we show that routine clinic images can be transformed into operational digital twins for task-based evaluation of embodied AI. Using 39 ophthalmic clinic scenes, we converted single photographs into editable, simulator-ready environments and assessed reconstruction quality, room-scale geometry, mesh grounding, multi-robot feasibility, perturbation sensitivity and closed-loop policy performance. The reconstructed scenes preserved workspace structure, while local editing enabled controlled device reconfiguration. Device meshes, collision proxies and semantic anchors converted visual reconstructions into contact-aware simulation scenes. Across three robot embodiments, shared task targets showed different patterns of reachability and contact feasibility. Small device translations and rotations produced task-specific changes in contact margins that were not captured by visual similarity alone. Digital-twin trajectories also supported local policy learning and closed-loop evaluation. These findings establish operational validity as a key principle for clinical digital twins and provide an intermediate layer between offline development and physical deployment of embodied AI in healthcare.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将常规诊所图像转化为可操作的数字孪生环境，用于具身人工智能的任务级评估。基于39个眼科诊所场景，将单张照片转换为可编辑、可模拟的环境，并评估了重建质量、几何精度、多机器人可行性和闭环策略性能，确立了临床数字孪生的操作有效性原则。
AI.motivation: 具身人工智能必须在实际临床环境中测试，但构建逼真且可被机器人测试的环境成本高昂且难以扩展，缺乏可规模化、低成本的任务级评估平台。
AI.method: 利用39个眼科诊所场景，将单张照片转换为可编辑、可模拟的数字孪生环境。评估维度包括：重建质量、房间尺度几何、网格接地、多机器人可行性、扰动敏感性和闭环策略性能。通过设备网格、碰撞代理和语义锚点将视觉重建转化为接触感知模拟场景。
AI.result: 重建场景保持了工作区结构，局部编辑支持可控的设备重构。三种机器人主体对共享任务目标表现出不同的可达性和接触可行性模式。小的设备平移和旋转产生任务特定的接触余量变化，这些变化无法仅通过视觉相似性捕捉。数字孪生轨迹还支持局部策略学习和闭环评估。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了操作有效性作为临床数字孪生的关键原则，为医疗保健中具身AI的离线开发与物理部署之间提供了中间层。

title: Enhanced Artificial Neural Networks Using QHAdamW in Air Quality Forecasting
comment: 20 pages, 16 tables, 15 figures, Published with International Journal of Engineering Trends and Technology (IJETT)
summary: The study employed an Artificial Neural Network in combination with the optimized Adaptive Moment Estimation (Adam) algorithm, currently the only AQI forecasting model available in the Philippines. The modified QHAdamW - Quasi-Hyperbolic Momentum (QHAdam) and Adam with decoupled weight decay (AdamW) were both extensions of the Adam optimizer, and both offer unique advantages for training ANN. The proposed QHAdamW optimizer addresses the issues on convergence, generalization, and forecasting performance of Adam. Hyperparameter tuning results revealed that 0.01 and 0.001 were the most effective optimal values for the generalization performance of QHAdamW. The comparative analysis results using seven evaluation metrics revealed that the error value range is lower, and the regression coefficient, having a value approximately equal to 1, improved the model accuracy performance. Likewise, the model converges to a satisfactory level of performance with the convergence performance results of lower loss values as obtained from training and validation losses. Based on data from a real-time air quality tracking station in Manila, a feed-forward neural network is used to predict the AQI of PM2.5 and PM10 separately. This model can be used to forecast Particulate Matter (PM), to help the Department of Environment and Natural Resources-Environmental Monitoring Bureau (DENR-EMB) implement a comprehensive air quality management.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了QHAdamW优化器（结合QHAdam和AdamW的扩展），用于训练人工神经网络以预测菲律宾马尼拉地区的空气质量指数（AQI），特别是PM2.5和PM10颗粒物浓度，这是菲律宾目前唯一的AQI预测模型。
AI.motivation: 解决Adam优化器在ANN训练中存在的收敛性、泛化能力及预测性能问题，并填补菲律宾缺乏AQI预测模型的空白。
AI.method: 采用前馈神经网络结合改进的QHAdamW优化器（融合QHAdam的准双曲动量与AdamW的解耦权重衰减），分别预测PM2.5和PM10的AQI；通过超参数调优确定最优学习率，并使用7种评估指标进行性能比较。
AI.result: 超参数调优发现0.01和0.001是最优泛化性能的学习率值；与Adam相比，QHAdamW的误差值范围更低，回归系数接近1，模型精度显著提升；训练和验证损失均较低，收敛性能令人满意。
AI.conclusion: QHAdamW优化器在AQI预测中表现出优于Adam的性能，该模型能为菲律宾DENR-EMB提供有效的PM预测工具，支持全面的空气质量管理。

title: Multi-Scale Fruit Capsules: Dilated Convolutions and Dynamic Routing for In-the-Wild Explainable Fruit Recognition
summary: The same fruit appears in a bunch, unpicked, peeled, bagged in plastic, or sliced on a dish, so automated fruit classification in the wild (AFCW) must absorb wide intra- class and narrow inter-class variability in shape, size, colour and texture. Convolutional networks route information through pooling, which discards the pose and location of the region of interest and therefore generalises poorly across these presentations. We propose FruitCapsNet, a capsule network whose Fruit Capsules replace the standard convolutional front end with dilated convolutions: the receptive field grows exponentially at constant parameter cost, so each capsule encodes multi-scale context before dynamic routing resolves part whole spatial agreement. Hyper-parameters, including the dilation factor, are selected by Bayesian optimisation rather than grid search. On three public datasets (SMP, FruitsGB, Fruits-360) and a new 19-class, 10,639-image in-the-wild dataset (PD-19), FruitCapsNet exceeds ten fine-tuned transfer-learning backbones at one-third the depth, with the largest margin (+2.7% over the nearest competitor) on the hardest set. Grad-CAM saliency propagated from the DigitCaps layer shows that the improvement comes from attributing decisions to whole-fruit regions rather than to object edges, giving post-hoc evidence that the gain is not a dataset artefact.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FruitCapsNet，一种用于野外水果分类的胶囊网络，用膨胀卷积替代标准卷积前端，使感受野以恒定参数代价指数增长，每个胶囊编码多尺度上下文后通过动态路由解决部分-整体空间一致性。在三个公开数据集和新提出的PD-19数据集上，FruitCapsNet以三分之一的深度超越了十个微调迁移学习骨干网络，在最具挑战性的数据集上以+2.7%的最大幅度领先。Grad-CAM分析证实其改进源于将决策归因于整个水果区域而非物体边缘。
AI.motivation: 野外水果分类（AFCW）面临巨大的类内变异和狭窄的类间变异（同一水果出现于整串、未采摘、剥皮、装袋、切片等多种形态）。传统卷积网络通过池化丢弃感兴趣区域的位置和姿态信息，导致在多样呈现方式下泛化能力差。
AI.method: 提出FruitCapsNet胶囊网络：用膨胀卷积替代标准卷积前端，使感受野以恒定参数代价指数增长，每个胶囊编码多尺度上下文后再经动态路由解决部分-整体空间一致性。使用贝叶斯优化（而非网格搜索）选择超参数（包括膨胀因子）。
AI.result: 在SMP、FruitsGB、Fruits-360三个公开数据集及新的19类、10,639张图像的PD-19野外数据集上，FruitCapsNet以三分之一的深度超越十个微调迁移学习骨干网络。在最具挑战性的PD-19数据集上取得最大优势（+2.7%）。Grad-CAM从DigitCaps层传播的显著性图显示改进来源于将决策归因于完整水果区域而非物体边缘。
AI.conclusion: FruitCapsNet通过胶囊网络结合膨胀卷积，有效解决了野外水果分类中因形态多变导致的泛化问题。Grad-CAM的后验证据表明性能提升并非数据集伪影，而是源于模型对整体水果区域的正确归因，为胶囊网络在细粒度视觉分类任务中提供了有力的实证支持。

title: Evaluating Human and LLM-Generated Thematic Analysis in HRI for Vulnerable Populations: A Comparative and Ethical Analysis
comment: Accepted at 35th IEEE International Conference on Robot and Human Interactive Communication (RO-MAN), Kitakyushu, Japan
summary: Thematic analysis (TA) has long been regarded as an inherently human, reflexive, and interpretive process. However, the extent to which LLM-generated TA is appropriate for Human-Robot Interaction (HRI) research involving vulnerable populations remains largely unexamined and raises critical questions about validity and ethics, particularly in sensitive research contexts. This paper presents a comparative study of human- and LLM-generated TA in an HRI context with a focus on vulnerable populations. We evaluate both objective and semantic agreement between human- and LLMgenerated themes, and examine whether observed divergences reflect systematic interpretive patterns with ethical significance. Our analysis investigates whether LLM-generated TA risks marginalising or misrepresenting the experiences of vulnerable participants, with implications for researchers employing LLM-assisted TA in HRI.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了人类与LLM在人机交互（HRI）研究中对弱势群体访谈数据进行主题分析（TA）的差异，评估客观与语义一致性，并探讨LLM生成的主题是否存在边缘化或歪曲弱势参与者经历的风险。
AI.motivation: 主题分析传统上被视为人类独有的反思性与解释性过程，但LLM生成的主题分析在涉及弱势群体的HRI研究中是否适用尚未得到充分检验，这引发了对有效性和伦理性的关键质疑。
AI.method: 采用比较研究方法，在HRI情境下以弱势群体为研究对象，分别由人类和LLM生成主题分析，从客观一致性和语义一致性两个维度进行评估，并考察分歧是否反映具有伦理意义的系统性解释模式。
AI.result: 研究了人类与LLM生成主题之间的客观与语义一致性程度，并分析了分歧中是否包含系统性的解释模式及其伦理含义。
AI.conclusion: 研究指出LLM生成的主题分析可能面临边缘化或误述弱势参与者经历的风险，对研究人员在HRI中使用LLM辅助主题分析具有重要启示。

title: Let Credit Follow Computation: Architecture-Aware Credit Transport for Large Language Model Reinforcement Learning
summary: Credit assignment in large-language-model reinforcement learning (LLM RL) can be separated into three objects: evidence about success, a transport operator that converts this evidence into token-level advantages, and an update geometry that turns advantages into policy changes. Recent work has greatly improved evidence, sampling, and update geometry, but the transport operator is usually architecture-agnostic. Fixed-discount GAE applies a stationary geometric kernel along token time; group-relative methods broadcast an outcome statistic across an entire response. Neither operator represents the trajectory-specific computation used by the Transformer policy itself. We introduce computation-conditioned credit transport (CCT), a general framework in which a detached statistic of the behavior policy's internal computation parameterizes the causal kernel that transports downstream value through a rollout. Our concrete algorithm, CompPO, maps native attention concentration to a bounded per-token retention gate, uses the gate in both the one-step bootstrap and a path-dependent generalized-advantage trace (Comp-GAE), and co-designs a transport-aligned critic (TAC) that reuses the actor's hidden states and routing information without a second same-scale Transformer. The task reward and clipped PPO policy objective remain unchanged; a constant gate recovers fixed-coefficient GAE. Across five Qwen3-4B seeds, CompPO reaches 61.4% final held-out accuracy (95% CI [60.8,62.0]) versus 53.8% [52.9,54.7] for tuned GRPO. Neither Comp-GAE with a standard critic (55.2%) nor TAC with a fixed gate (56.4%) matches the full model (interaction +2.4 [1.9,2.9]). Shuffle and position controls confirm trajectory-specific alignment; CompPO is stable in 10/12 PPO-grid runs versus 3/12. Frozen evaluation improves over GRPO by 4.3 and 3.9 greedy pass@1 macro points on Qwen3-4B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct.

AI.tldr: 本文提出计算条件信用传输（CCT）框架及其具体算法CompPO，利用行为策略内部计算的解耦统计量来参数化因果核，将下游价值通过轨迹传输。CompPO将注意力集中度映射为逐token的保留门控，用于一步引导和路径依赖的广义优势追踪（Comp-GAE），并设计了传输对齐评论家（TAC）复用actor的隐藏状态。在Qwen3-4B上CompPO达到61.4%的最终保留准确率，远超调优的GRPO（53.8%），并通过消融、位置控制和稳定性测试验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: LLM强化学习中的信用分配可分为证据、传输算子和更新几何三个对象。现有工作大幅改进了证据、采样和更新几何，但传输算子通常是架构无关的：固定折扣GAE沿token时间应用静态几何核，组相对方法则跨整个响应广播结果统计量。两者都未能表征Transformer策略自身使用的轨迹特定计算，这构成了论文的核心动机。
AI.method: 1) 提出CCT框架，用行为策略内部计算的解耦统计量参数化因果核；2) CompPO将原生注意力集中度映射为有界逐token保留门控，同时用于one-step bootstrap和Comp-GAE；3) 设计传输对齐评论家（TAC），复用actor的隐藏状态和路由信息，无需第二个同规模Transformer；4) 任务奖励和裁剪PPO策略目标保持不变，常数门控可恢复固定系数GAE。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B五个种子上，CompPO达到61.4%最终保留准确率（95% CI [60.8,62.0]），对比调优GRPO的53.8% [52.9,54.7]。完整模型优于仅Comp-GAE+标准评论家（55.2%）和仅TAC+固定门控（56.4%），交互增益+2.4。CompPO在PPO网格中10/12次运行稳定（对比3/12），冻结评估在Qwen3-4B和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上分别超过GRPO 4.3和3.9个贪婪pass@1宏平均点。
AI.conclusion: 计算条件信用传输代表了对LLM RL中传输算子的一次重要重新设计，证明了架构感知的信用分配能显著提升策略优化效果。轨迹特定对齐（通过shuffle和位置控制实验确认）、与评论家的协同设计以及训练稳定性方面的改进，共同表明利用Transformer策略内部计算来引导信用传输是有效的方向。

title: Tomatoes, Potatoes, and Onions: Questioning the Need for Faces in Face Presentation Attack Detection
summary: Face presentation attack detection (PAD) is traditionally formulated as a face-specific problem, although many of the visual artifacts introduced by print, replay, and recapture processes are not inherently tied to facial appearance. In this work, we investigate whether transferable PAD representations can be learned without using faces during downstream PAD training. To this end, we introduce TPO, a controlled face-free presentation attack dataset consisting of bona fide, print, and replay recordings of, almost randomly chosen, tomatoes, potatoes, and onions acquired under protocols that closely mirror conventional face PAD datasets. Using a foundation-model-based PAD architecture, we demonstrate that a detector trained on TPO achieves an average AUC of 92.70% across four standard cross-dataset face PAD benchmarks, outperforming training on synthetic faces and remaining competitive with models trained on real face datasets. Conversely, models trained on face PAD datasets transfer consistently above chance to TPO, suggesting that the learned representations capture characteristics of the presentation process rather than object semantics. Furthermore, incorporating TPO into conventional face PAD training consistently improves cross-dataset performance under fixed optimization budgets, indicating that face-free data provides complementary information rather than simply additional training samples. Finally, representation and frequency analyses provide further evidence that transferable PAD representations cannot be explained by a single spectral artifact but instead encode richer presentation cues shared across object categories. Together, these results provide empirical evidence that transferable presentation attack representations can be learned independently of facial content, opening new opportunities for privacy-preserving and identity-independent PAD development.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TPO数据集（西红柿、土豆、洋葱的攻击演示记录），证明无需人脸即可学习可迁移的人脸呈现攻击检测（PAD）表征。基于基础模型的PAD架构在TPO上训练后，在四个标准跨数据集人脸PAD基准上平均AUC达92.70%，优于合成人脸训练，且与人脸数据集训练相当。将TPO融入传统人脸PAD训练可稳定提升跨数据集性能，表明人脸无关数据提供互补信息。
AI.motivation: 传统人脸PAD被表述为一个人脸特有问题，但打印、重放和翻拍等过程引入的视觉伪影本质上与人脸外观无关。作者希望探究：是否可以不依赖人脸内容学习具有可迁移性的PAD表征，从而为隐私保护和身份无关的PAD开发开辟新途径。
AI.method: 1) 构建TPO数据集：采集西红柿、土豆、洋葱的真伪、打印和重放记录，协议设计紧密对标常规人脸PAD数据集；2) 使用基于基础模型的PAD架构在TPO上训练检测器；3) 在四个标准跨数据集人脸PAD基准上进行评估；4) 进行双向迁移实验（人脸→TPO和TPO→人脸）；5) 将TPO融入人脸PAD训练以验证互补性；6) 通过表征和频率分析探究可迁移性的内在机制。
AI.result: 1) TPO训练的检测器在四个人脸PAD基准上平均AUC为92.70%，优于合成人脸训练，与人脸数据训练竞争相当；2) 人脸PAD模型迁移到TPO上持续高于随机水平；3) 将TPO融入人脸PAD训练在固定优化预算下稳定提升跨数据集性能；4) 表征和频率分析表明可迁移表征不能由单一频谱伪影解释，而是编码了跨物体类别共享的更丰富呈现线索。
AI.conclusion: 可迁移的呈现攻击表征可以独立于人脸内容学习，这为隐私保护和身份无关的PAD开发提供了经验证据和新的可能性。

title: The Setting of IMU Parameters in Kalman Filtering-based Information Fusion
comment: 2026 International Conference on Guidance, Navigation and Control
summary: The setting or tuning of specifications for the inertial measurement unit (IMU) is tricky in sensor fusion. The underneath conundrum is caused by the fact that the working condition of IMU is more complex than the stationary calibration scenario. Since the noises and biases instabilities calibrated under static condition cannot accommodate other cases, the effective tuning of IMU parameters largely hinges on the experience or profound understanding of the system. In the current work, the setting method of IMU parameters based on Allan variance calibration is delved into within the Kalman filtering framework. Specifically, the relationship between the power sepctral density and Allan variance is leveraged in formulating the process uncertainty in continuous-time filtering. Two typical IMU-based sensor fusion systems are considered to show the feasibility and effectiveness of this parameter setting process.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于Allan方差标定的IMU参数设置方法在Kalman滤波框架中的应用，通过利用功率谱密度与Allan方差之间的关系来构建连续时间滤波中的过程不确定性，并在两个典型的IMU传感器融合系统中验证了该方法的可行性和有效性。
AI.motivation: IMU规格参数的设置或调优在传感器融合中非常棘手，因为IMU的实际工作条件比静态标定场景复杂得多。静态条件下标定的噪声和偏置不稳定性无法适配其他场景，因此IMU参数的有效调优很大程度上依赖经验或对系统的深入理解，缺乏系统性的方法。
AI.method: 本文基于Allan方差标定来设置IMU参数，具体利用了功率谱密度与Allan方差之间的关系来构建连续时间滤波中的过程不确定性模型，并在Kalman滤波框架内实现参数设置。
AI.result: 通过两个典型的基于IMU的传感器融合系统验证了该参数设置方法的可行性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: 基于Allan方差标定的参数设置方法能够在Kalman滤波框架中有效地设置IMU参数，为传感器融合中的IMU调优提供了一种系统化的替代方案。

title: Quantifying geographic domain shift to decouple the geospatial transferability of human mobility flow generation models
summary: Human mobility serves as an essential proxy for understanding social, economic, and environmental dynamics in urban systems. Geospatial transferability, which measures a model's capability in a new location or unseen region, is a critical dimension for comparing different human mobility generation models. However, few studies have studied the intrinsic characteristics of geospatial transferability. To this end, this study systematically investigates the geospatial transferability of four representative human mobility generation models using a large-scale benchmark dataset of census tract level commuting flows across 2265 counties in the United States. Inspired by the domain adaptation theory in machine learning, we introduce geographic domain shift to describe the intrinsic differences in geographic feature distributions and spatial structures between source and target regions, which may jointly affect model transferability. Moreover, we propose two metrics, mutual information and spatial shift, to quantify the geographic domain shift. To examine their associations with model transferability, we employ linear mixed-effects regression to analyze the associations between geographic domain shifts and transferability. Our results reveal substantial spatial heterogeneity and asymmetry in transfer performance across regions. Both information shift and spatial shift exhibit statistically significant and complementary explanatory power. This indicates that geospatial transferability depends not only on model design but also on intrinsic geographic differences. These findings provide a novel methodological framework for evaluating and improving the geospatial transferability of human mobility generation models and support more robust and fair human mobility data synthesis across diverse regions. It also offers insights on spatial transferability for GeoAI model development.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统性地考察了四种人类移动性生成模型在美国2265个县域通勤流数据上的地理空间可迁移性，引入"地理域偏移"概念（通过互信息和空间偏移两个指标量化），发现模型迁移性能存在显著空间异质性和不对称性，且信息偏移与空间偏移对可迁移性具有互补的解释力。
AI.motivation: 地理空间可迁移性是评估人类移动性生成模型能力的关键维度，但现有研究很少探究其内在特征，缺乏对影响模型跨区域迁移性能因素的深入理解。
AI.method: 1) 使用覆盖美国2265个县域的人口普查区通勤流大数据基准；2) 借鉴机器学习中的域适应理论，提出"地理域偏移"概念以刻画源区域与目标区域在地理特征分布和空间结构上的差异；3) 提出互信息和空间偏移两个量化指标；4) 采用线性混合效应回归分析地理域偏移与模型可迁移性之间的关联。
AI.result: 研究发现：迁移性能在区域间存在显著的空间异质性和不对称性；信息偏移和空间偏移均具有统计学显著的、互补的解释力，表明地理空间可迁移性不仅取决于模型设计，还受内在地理差异影响。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了评估和改进人类移动性生成模型地理空间可迁移性的新方法框架，支持在多样区域中进行更稳健公平的移动数据合成，并为GeoAI模型的空间可迁移性开发提供了见解。

title: CLSC DETR: Reliable Candidate Ranking via Cross Layer Geometric Support for UAV Small Object Detection
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) object detection is critical for applications such as target search, where accurate detection of small objects in complex aerial scenes remains challenging. The limited spatial extent, dense distribution, and frequent occlusion of small objects make reliable candidate ranking particularly difficult. Existing Detection Transformer (DETR) based methods improve ranking by estimating localization quality from individual queries and incorporating it into classification scores. However, a single query often lacks sufficient geometric evidence for small objects with weak boundary cues, resulting in unreliable quality estimation and unstable ranking. To address this limitation, we propose Cross Layer Local Support and Consistency Calibration for DETR, termed CLSC DETR. Specifically, the Cross Layer Local Support module establishes correspondences between final layer queries and intermediate layer candidates to aggregate complementary geometric evidence for more reliable localization quality estimation, while the Classification and Localization Consistency Calibration module adaptively adjusts classification scores according to localization quality and classification reliability to improve candidate ranking. Experiments show that CLSC DETR improves AP and AP$_{75}$ over the baseline by 1.5\% and 2.0\% on VisDrone, respectively, while achieving consistent improvements on UAVDT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CLSC DETR，通过跨层局部支持和分类-定位一致性校准两个模块，解决无人机小目标检测中单查询几何证据不足导致的排序不可靠问题，在VisDrone和UAVDT数据集上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 无人机小目标检测中，小目标空间范围有限、分布密集且易遮挡，导致候选排序困难。现有DETR方法依赖单个查询估计定位质量并融入分类分数，但单个查询对边界线索弱的小目标缺乏足够几何证据，造成质量估计不可靠和排序不稳定。
AI.method: 提出CLSC DETR，包含两个核心模块：(1) Cross Layer Local Support模块，建立最终层查询与中间层候选之间的对应关系，聚合互补的几何证据以提升定位质量估计的可靠性；(2) Classification and Localization Consistency Calibration模块，根据定位质量和分类可靠性自适应调整分类分数，以改善候选排序。
AI.result: 在VisDrone数据集上，CLSC DETR相比基线在AP上提升1.5%，在AP75上提升2.0%，并在UAVDT数据集上取得一致的改进。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨层聚合几何证据和一致性校准机制，有效解决了小目标检测中单查询证据不足的问题，显著提升了无人机场景下的检测性能。

title: Geo-VLA: Geometry-Aware Vision-Language-Action Planning via Internalization of Map Semantics
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have advanced end-to-end autonomous driving by leveraging foundation models for semantic reasoning and long-tail generalization. However, their planning performance remains limited in complex driving environments because image-only representations inadequately capture planning-relevant road geometry and topology. In this paper, we propose Geo-VLA, a plug-and-play framework that enhances VLA models by learning geometry-aware visual representations. During training, Geo-VLA internalizes geometric map semantics to strengthen road-structure representations, while requiring no HD maps or additional lane information during inference. To support this approach, we introduce Geo-QA, a geometry-focused question-answering dataset that injects road geometry into vision-language representations through contrastive learning and instruction tuning. Experiments on NAVSIM v1 demonstrate that Geo-VLA consistently improves VLA planners with distinct action-generation architectures, achieving 92.1 PDMS and establishing a new state-of-the-art among single-camera VLA planners.

AI.tldr: Geo-VLA是一个即插即用的框架，通过引入几何感知的视觉表示来增强Vision-Language-Action（VLA）模型在自动驾驶中的规划性能。它利用Geo-QA数据集在训练阶段内化几何地图语义，推理时无需HD地图，在NAVSIM上达到92.1 PDMS，创下单相机VLA规划器的新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有的VLA模型在复杂驾驶环境中规划性能有限，因为仅基于图像的表示不能充分捕捉规划相关的道路几何和拓扑信息，这限制了模型对道路结构的理解和长尾场景的泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出Geo-VLA框架：(1) 在训练阶段通过Geo-QA数据集（几何聚焦的问答数据集）进行对比学习和指令微调，将道路几何语义内化到视觉-语言表示中；(2) 推理时无需HD地图或额外车道信息，实现即插即用。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM v1基准上，Geo-VLA一致性地提升了具有不同动作生成架构的VLA规划器性能，达到92.1 PDMS，在单相机VLA规划器中建立了新的最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 通过在训练阶段注入几何感知能力而无需推理时额外地图依赖，Geo-VLA有效解决了VLA模型在复杂场景中因缺乏道路几何信息而导致的规划性能瓶颈，展示了即插即用框架对多种VLA架构的通用增强效果。

title: A Reproducible, License-Aware Distillation Recipe for CPUDeployable Safety Classification
summary: Deploying a safety layer for large language models on commodity hardware is constrained by the guards available to do it: current open guard models hold between 1 and 9 billion parameters, are oriented toward the graphics processing unit, and answer in seconds per request on a central processing unit. This paper presents a reproducible, license-aware knowledge-distillation recipe addressing that constraint. A strong open guard labels a corpus of roughly 97,000 prompts, drawn from 24 public datasets, into seven safety categories aligned to a public hazard taxonomy, and a fleet of small students spanning lexical, shallow, encoder and generative architectures is trained to reproduce that signal. The corpus is partitioned at the license boundary, so that a deployable and a research model differ only in their training data and the cost of that restriction becomes measurable. Every model is scored against an independent gold benchmark of 6,361 rows over four slices, labeled apart from the teacher and including a slice of harmless prompts that makes over-defense measurable. The distilled students match the teachers on adversarial text within overlapping confidence intervals and reduce false alarms on harmless prompts, the smallest generative student reaching 3.8% against 4.8% for the 8-billion-parameter teacher, while the encoder classifies in roughly 24 ms per request on CPU. Per-class rebalancing is the only decisive ingredient of the recipe. No superiority over the distilled guards is claimed; on the clean reference slice they remain ahead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可复现、许可证感知的知识蒸馏方法，将强大的开源安全模型（guards）蒸馏为可在CPU上高效运行的小型学生模型用于大语言模型安全防护。基于约97,000个提示词（来自24个公开数据集，覆盖7类安全类别）训练多种架构的学生模型，在对抗性文本上匹配教师模型性能，同时在无害提示上减少误报，最小生成式学生模型误报率3.8%（教师为4.8%），编码器模型在CPU上每请求约24ms。
AI.motivation: 在商品硬件上部署大语言模型安全防护层受限于现有防护模型——当前开源防护模型参数规模在1-90亿之间，面向GPU优化，在CPU上每请求需数秒响应，难以满足资源受限场景的部署需求。
AI.method: 提出可复现、许可证感知的知识蒸馏流程：(1) 一个强开源防护模型为约97,000个提示词（来自24个公开数据集）标注7类安全类别（对齐公共危险分类体系）；(2) 训练一组涵盖词法、浅层、编码器及生成式架构的小型学生模型；(3) 语料库在许可证边界分区，使可部署模型与研究模型的差异仅在于训练数据，从而可量化这一限制的成本；(4) 用独立金标准基准（6,361行，4个切片，含无害提示切片以衡量过度防御）评估所有模型；类别级重平衡是流程中唯一关键要素。
AI.result: 蒸馏后的学生模型在对抗性文本上于重叠置信区间内匹配教师模型性能；在无害提示上误报率更低（最小生成式学生3.8% vs 80亿参数教师4.8%）；编码器模型在CPU上每请求约24ms即可完成分类。类别级重平衡是唯一决定性的配方成分。
AI.conclusion: 通过知识蒸馏可以在保持安全检测性能的同时显著降低模型体积和计算开销；在干净的参考切片上教师模型仍保持领先，作者不声称蒸馏防护模型具有超教师性能，但证明了蒸馏方案在商品硬件部署中的实用可行性。

title: FigmaTrace: Capturing Creative Nuances in Human Figma Design Workflows
summary: Vision Language Models have recently shown improvements in several objective and verifiable domains such as object detection but continue to underperform on subjective and creative design tasks. A major contributor to this performance gap is the lack of high quality human workflow data that captures a diverse set of preferences and decisions that make human experts good at design tasks. In this work, we first define a unique, expert curated taxonomy of design skills and best practices which we further expand into a set of 126 open ended, subjective, long horizon tasks. Built on top of this and expert solutions, our dataset FigmaTrace contains over 200 hours of human captured video data converted into 3469 design trajectories using a novel design phase-based method. We use our dataset to train four models and show that training on FigmaTrace leads to a performance improvement comparable to frontier closed models such as \textsc{Claude-Opus-5} and \textsc{GPT-5.6-Sol} on four out of distribution agentic GUI environments. We further perform a useful ablation to attribute these performance improvements to a design phase-based video to trajectory conversion which outperforms prior length-based conversion approaches. Finally, we perform a qualitative analysis on the best performing \textsc{Qwen3.8-27B} outputs to better correlate performance improvements to FigmaTrace's trends. We open source our dataset and the best model for the community.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FigmaTrace数据集，包含由专家策展的126个开放式设计任务和3469条设计轨迹（来自200小时人类操作视频），用于训练视觉语言模型完成主观创意设计任务。训练后的模型在4个分布外GUI环境上达到了与Claude-Opus-5和GPT-5.6-Sol等前沿闭源模型相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在客观可验证领域（如目标检测）已有显著进步，但在主观性和创造性设计任务上表现不佳。主要原因是缺乏能够捕捉人类专家多样偏好和决策过程的高质量工作流数据。
AI.method: 1) 定义专家策展的设计技能与最佳实践分类体系；2) 扩展为126个开放式、主观、长时程任务；3) 收集超过200小时人类操作视频，通过新颖的设计阶段（design phase-based）方法转换为3469条设计轨迹；4) 使用该数据集训练四个模型。
AI.result: 训练于FigmaTrace的模型在4个分布外agentic GUI环境中达到了与Claude-Opus-5和GPT-5.6-Sol等前沿闭源模型相当的性能提升。消融实验表明基于设计阶段的方法优于先前的基于长度（length-based）的转换方法。
AI.conclusion: FigmaTrace数据集能有效提升VLM在主观创意设计任务上的表现，基于设计阶段的轨迹转换方法更优，且数据集和最佳模型已开源供社区使用。

title: Constructing Predictive Surgical Path for AI-based Capsulorhexis Skill Transfer
summary: Automated training of surgeons is one of the most crucial factors that significantly minimize surgical training risks and expenses. With recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) knowledge and available data from various surgeries, AI's involvement in surgical training is becoming very promising. It is recommended that at the early stages of AI development, it interferes in the surgery as a third agent alongside the trainer. As trust in AI increases, this process will lead to an AI agent acting as a trainer in the future. The first phase in which AI can intervene in the training process is to suggest an improved surgical path to the trainer. A platform must be constructed in the first step, to accomplish this task and to enhance the movement path of trainee surgeons. This paper introduces this platform along with an annotated capsulorhexis surgery dataset called the ARAS-Farabi dataset. In this research, a deep convolutional neural network is pre-trained with JIGSAWS and ARAS-Farabi surgical datasets that can extract surgical skill characteristics from surgery tool tip motion data. The proposed platform develops a reference model from the feature space of an expert surgeon's movement trajectory and proposes an improved path to enhance the skill of a novice surgeon. An optimization with two loss functions is utilized to create a path that raises the skill level of the novice surgeon's path while simultaneously predicting and preserving his/her intent. The results of this study reveal that, with the assistance of an AI agent, the trainee surgeon's movement path can be enhanced by at least 20 percent while maintaining his intentional objective. In addition to the recommended deep network, various tangible indicators have also been developed in this research to verify the level of trainee improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个用于外科手术训练的平台（ARAS-Farabi），通过预训练的深度卷积神经网络提取手术工具运动轨迹的技能特征，并利用优化算法为新手外科医生生成改进的手术路径，实验表明该方法可将受训者的运动路径提升至少20%，同时保持其手术意图。
AI.motivation: 外科医生培训成本高、风险大，人工智能有望介入手术训练过程。早期阶段AI可作为第三方助手为培训师提供建议，而第一阶段就是改进受训外科医生的手术路径，因此需要构建相应的平台和数据集。
AI.method: 构建了一个手术训练平台，包含注释过的capsulorhexis手术数据集（ARAS-Farabi数据集）。使用深度卷积神经网络（在JIGSAWS和ARAS-Farabi数据集上预训练）从手术工具尖端运动数据中提取技能特征，建立专家运动轨迹的参考模型，并通过带两个损失函数的优化方法来生成改进路径，在提升受训者技能水平的同时预测并保持其意图。
AI.result: 在AI代理的辅助下，受训外科医生的运动路径可至少改进20%，同时保持其手术意图目标。研究还开发了多种可量化的指标来验证受训者的改进程度。
AI.conclusion: 该平台验证了AI作为第三方代理人辅助外科手术训练的可行性，能够有效提升新手外科医生的手术路径质量，为未来AI逐步承担训练师角色奠定了基础。

title: Robust Lightweight Deep Learning Models for Oral Cancer Screening
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, Paper accepted for the 6th International Conference on AI-ML Systems, 2026
summary: Oral cancer is a leading cause of mortality in low-to-middle-income countries, where a shortage of specialists delays diagnosis. While point-of-care screening via smartphones offers a scalable solution, developing robust AI for resource-constrained settings poses significant challenges, including class imbalance in training data, variable data quality, and computational constraints on edge devices. In this paper, we present the optimisation of lightweight deep learning models for smartphone-based oral cancer screening. Using a diverse, multi-centre retrospective dataset of approximately 30,000 images acquired over a decade, we systematically evaluate state-of-the-art convolutional, transformer, and hybrid architectures. Through rigorous pipeline ablation, we demonstrate that directly optimising hybrid architectures for the edge strictly outperforms computationally heavy paradigms, such as large models or knowledge distillation. Furthermore, interpretability analysis and simulated noise-stress tests revealed that the system anchors on clinical features and remains robust to unstructured sensor noise, despite vulnerabilities to impulse bit errors. In the held-out test set, our optimised MobileViTv2 models achieved an average sensitivity of 83.2 $\pm$ 1.5% and an average specificity of 86.0 $\pm$ 0.8%, with the best model exhibiting 87.4% sensitivity, 86.5% specificity, and a critical negative predictive value of 97.2% with reference to specialist labels. These results confirm that with targeted architectural selection and streamlined optimisation, interpretable and robust lightweight AI models exhibit high potential for edge deployment to enable automated triage in primary care settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究面向智能手机口腔癌筛查的轻量级深度学习模型优化，系统比较了卷积、Transformer和混合架构，证明针对边缘设备直接优化混合架构（MobileViTv2）优于大型模型或知识蒸馏。在约3万张多中心回顾性图像上，最优模型达到87.4%敏感度、86.5%特异性和97.2%阴性预测值，且具有可解释性和对传感器噪声的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 中低收入国家口腔癌死亡率高且专家短缺导致诊断延迟，智能手机床旁筛查是可行方案，但资源受限场景下开发鲁棒AI面临类别不平衡、数据质量差异和边缘设备计算约束等挑战。
AI.method: 使用约3万张、跨越十年、多中心回顾性数据集，系统评估卷积、Transformer和混合架构；通过严格的pipeline消融实验，直接优化用于边缘设备的混合架构；结合可解释性分析和模拟噪声压力测试验证系统可靠性。
AI.result: 优化后的MobileViTv2模型在独立测试集上平均敏感度83.2±1.5%，平均特异度86.0±0.8%；最优模型达到87.4%敏感度、86.5%特异性和97.2%阴性预测值。系统锚定临床特征，对非结构化传感器噪声鲁棒，但对脉冲位错误存在脆弱性。
AI.conclusion: 通过针对性的架构选择和精简优化，可解释且鲁棒的轻量级AI模型在边缘部署方面展现出高潜力，可实现初级医疗环境的自动化分诊。

title: Complexity Induction: Compositional Generalization via Structured Label Distortion
summary: We demonstrate that structured distortion of training data - which we term complexity induction - can induce compositional generalization in a standard CNN classifier without architectural modification. Using synthetic images of colored geometric shapes, we encode classes as flat string labels (e.g., "red-circle") with no explicit attribute decomposition, and exclude certain color-shape combinations from training entirely. We apply two distortion methods derived from Jaccard string similarity between class names: mixed labels (soft target distributions encoding inter-class overlap) and expanded dataset (false training samples with structurally motivated incorrect labels). Both methods induce the ability to predict unseen class combinations, and act at different levels: mixed labels activate the classifier for unseen combinations by exploiting the CNN's natural embedding structure, while expanded training improves the embedding factorization itself. A control with random (unstructured) false labels confirms that the effect depends on the structure of the distortion, not on noise per se. These results suggest that structured complication of training signals can influence both the internal organization of learned representations and their compositional interpretation - a principle that may underlie the role of natural language in cognitive development.

AI.tldr: 本文证明通过对训练数据进行结构化扭曲（称为"复杂度诱导"），可以在不修改标准CNN架构的情况下实现组合泛化。使用合成彩色几何图形图像，通过两种基于Jaccard字符串相似度的方法（混合标签和扩展数据集），成功预测了训练中未见过的颜色-形状组合。
AI.motivation: 探索如何在不改变神经网络架构的前提下，通过结构化数据扰动诱导组合泛化能力。研究训练信号的复杂性是否能够影响表征的内部组织和组合解释，并推测自然语言在认知发展中的作用可能与这一原则相关。
AI.method: 使用合成图像（彩色几何形状），将类别编码为扁平字符串标签（如"red-circle"）且不进行显式属性分解。排除部分颜色-形状组合不参与训练。采用两种基于Jaccard字符串相似度的扭曲方法：（1）混合标签——编码类间重叠的软目标分布；（2）扩展数据集——使用结构化错误标签的虚假训练样本。并使用随机（非结构化）错误标签作为对照。
AI.result: 两种方法均能诱导对未见类组合的预测能力，但作用层面不同：混合标签通过利用CNN的自然嵌入结构激活分类器对未见组合的响应，而扩展训练则改善了嵌入分解本身。随机标签对照实验证实效果依赖于扭曲的结构而非噪声本身。
AI.conclusion: 训练信号的结构化复杂化能够同时影响学习表征的内部组织及其组合解释能力。这一原则可能解释了自然语言在认知发展中的基础性作用。

title: Model-Free Adaptive Parameter Tuning for Efficient Multi-Robot Warehouse Operations
summary: Robotic Fulfillment Centers (FCs) store inventory on shelves (pods) arranged in dense blocks. Retrieving a target pod that is buried deep in a block requires moving obstructing pods out of the way (i.e., digout). Multi-robot planners use parameterized cost functions to control digout behavior, producing a spectrum of strategies: at one extreme, obstructing pods are sent to other blocks (using more robots in travel lanes); at the other, pods are shuffled within the block (avoiding lane congestion but increasing extraction time). Each point on this spectrum has different downstream consequences for floor congestion and throughput. The optimal operating point depends on the specific facility configuration and shifts with operational conditions such as varying station demand and congestion patterns, making offline tuning impractical. We present an adaptive parameter tuning framework based on Extremum Seeking Control (ESC) that continuously adjusts planner parameters in response to measured throughput. ESC performs model-free optimization by perturbing parameters with sinusoidal dither signals and correlating perturbations with performance changes to estimate gradients, making it robust to the multi-minute delayed effects and credit assignment challenges inherent in large FC operations. Simulation studies demonstrate that the adaptive policy improves upon fixed policies across several conditions. We observe an improvement in throughput by an average of 5.0% across map and robot fleet size variations, and by 8.4% under dynamic operating conditions. This work eliminates manual parameter provisioning and enables real-time adaptation, providing a self-tuning paradigm for FC storage operations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于极值搜索控制（ESC）的自适应参数调优框架，用于机器人履行中心（FC）中多机器人规划器的挖掘（digout）行为参数实时调整。该方法通过正弦扰动信号进行无模型优化，在仿真中相较于固定策略实现了平均5.0%（地图和机器人数量变化）和8.4%（动态运行条件）的吞吐量提升。
AI.motivation: FC中检索被埋藏的目标pod需要移动阻碍pod（挖掘操作），多机器人规划器用参数化代价函数控制挖掘行为，产生从"将pod送往其他block"到"在block内洗牌"的策略谱系。不同工作点对地面拥塞和吞吐量有不同影响，而最优工作点取决于具体设施配置并随操作条件（站点需求、拥塞模式）变化，导致离线调优不切实际，需要自适应在线调参方案。
AI.method: 基于极值搜索控制（ESC）的自适应参数调优框架。ESC进行无模型优化，通过正弦抖动信号扰动参数，并将扰动与性能变化相关联来估计梯度，从而实现对规划器参数的连续调整。该方法对大规模FC操作中固有的多分钟延迟效应和信用分配挑战具有鲁棒性。
AI.result: 仿真研究表明自适应策略在多种条件下优于固定策略：在地图和机器人数量变化下吞吐量平均提升5.0%，在动态运行条件下提升8.4%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作消除了手动参数配置的需求，实现了实时自适应，为FC存储操作提供了一种自调优范式。

title: Data-Driven Dynamic Algorithm Dispatch with Large Language Models
comment: 3 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the 2025 IEEE High Performance Extreme Computing Conference (HPEC). Outstanding Short Paper Award
summary: We introduce a large language model (LLM)-driven approach for generating dynamic algorithmic dispatch heuristics in high-performance linear algebra. By combining prompt engineering with LLaMA 3 and a curated performance database, the model learns to synthesize selection heuristics that exploit structural patterns to identify fast algorithmic choices. A case study on LU factorization demonstrates the model's ability to replicate expert-designed strategies. This work, developed as part of the DARPA-MIT SmartSolve project, highlights the promise of LLMs for algorithmic discovery and the development of more adaptive, fast linear algebra software.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于大语言模型（LLaMA 3）的方法，通过提示工程和性能数据库驱动，自动生成高性能线性代数中的动态算法调度启发式规则。以LU分解为案例，展示了模型能够复现专家设计的调度策略，属于DARPA-MIT SmartSolve项目的一部分。
AI.motivation: 高性能线性代数软件中，算法选择（调度）通常依赖专家手工设计的启发式规则，这些规则难以覆盖多样化、动态变化的结构模式，且人工设计耗时费力。本文旨在利用LLM的代码生成和模式识别能力，自动化地合成算法调度启发式规则。
AI.method: 结合提示工程（prompt engineering）与LLaMA 3大语言模型，利用一个精选的性能数据库（curated performance database）提供训练/参考数据，使模型学习如何合成选择启发式规则，从而利用输入矩阵的结构特征来识别快速算法选项。
AI.result: 在LU因子分解的案例研究中，该方法能够复现专家设计的调度策略，验证了LLM驱动的算法调度启发式生成方法的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了LLM在算法发现方面的潜力，为实现更具自适应性、更快速的高性能线性代数软件开辟了新路径，并为DARPA-MIT SmartSolve项目提供了技术支撑。

title: 3D Point Cloud from Close-Range Photogrammetry for Defect Characterisation of Rubberised Concrete
comment: 8 pages, 10 figures. Published in the International Archives of the Photogrammetry, Remote Sensing and Spatial Information Sciences, XXV ISPRS Congress 2026, Toronto, Canada
summary: While three-dimensional (3D) point clouds are widely used in civil engineering, mainstream LiDAR systems such as Terrestrial Laser Scanning (TLS) are physically constrained to laboratory environments. Since their laser spot size typically exceeds the width of microcracks, the beam physically bridges over voids, rendering TLS unsuitable for fine-scale defect analysis. Alternatively, close-range photogrammetry utilising Structure-from-Motion (SfM) and Multi-View Stereo (MVS) algorithms offers a solution for testing highly tortuous materials, and its utility at fine-scale remains underexplored. This study adapts photogrammetric workflows specifically for rubberised concrete (RuC), a sustainable composite exhibiting high ductility and complex fracture morphologies. High-resolution image sets were captured using a Canon DSLR and an iPhone 16 to generate dense 3D models. Comparisons revealed that the DSLR-based reconstruction achieved sub-millimetre resolution, demonstrating superior performance for fine-scale surface monitoring. An RGB-guided crack extraction method was developed to enhance the identification of surface defects and isolate potential crack areas from the background. The extracted crack regions were visually distinguishable and provided a well-structured geometrical representation of defect morphology. Furthermore, a Pre and Post-Test deformation analysis was conducted to quantify surface displacement across testing stages. The results confirm that this close-range photogrammetry workflow is a flexible, high-resolution alternative to LiDAR for surface inspection and deformation monitoring of specimens in laboratory settings. Ultimately, this approach establishes a robust geometric baseline for future automated 3D feature characterisation and material performance evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本研究将近距离摄影测量（SfM/MVS）工作流应用于橡胶混凝土（RuC）的细尺度缺陷分析，开发了RGB引导的裂缝提取方法，并通过智能手机与DSLR相机生成高分辨率3D模型。结果表明该方法达到亚毫米级精度，可作为LiDAR在实验室表面检测与变形监测中的高分辨率替代方案。
AI.motivation: 主流LiDAR系统（如TLS）受限于激光光斑尺寸大于微裂缝宽度，无法进行细尺度缺陷分析；而基于SfM/MVS的近距离摄影测量在高延性、复杂断裂形态材料（如橡胶混凝土）上的细尺度应用尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 1) 针对橡胶混凝土定制摄影测量工作流；2) 使用Canon DSLR和iPhone 16采集高分辨率图像集以生成密集3D模型；3) 开发RGB引导的裂缝提取方法以增强表面缺陷识别并隔离裂缝区域；4) 进行测试前后变形分析以量化各测试阶段的表面位移。
AI.result: DSLR重建达到亚毫米级分辨率，性能优于智能手机方案；RGB引导裂缝提取方法能够清晰区分裂缝区域并提供结构化的缺陷形态几何表示；测试前后变形分析成功量化了表面位移。
AI.conclusion: 近距离摄影测量工作流是LiDAR在实验室表面检测和变形监测中的灵活、高分辨率替代方案，为未来自动化的3D特征表征和材料性能评估建立了稳健的几何基线。

title: GOLEM: Modular Humanoid Autonomy Towards Electric Vehicle Battery Disassembly
summary: Disassembling end-of-life electric vehicle (EV) battery packs is dull and dangerous work, performed almost entirely by humans. We present GOLEM (Generalized Open Library of Embodied Modules), an end-to-end, open-source system architecture for EV battery disassembly with the Unitree H1-2 humanoid robot in which walking, manipulation, dynamic stability, navigation, and spatial memory are independent modules with abstract interfaces, so that methods are easily developed, interchanged, and compared. GOLEM is deployed as a Docker-based ROS 2 abstraction in which MuJoCo and IsaacLab digital twins expose interfaces matching the physical robot. GOLEM's composability and per-module customization enable development and demonstration of humanoid EV battery disassembly, from simulation to reality. GOLEM provides fair comparison between humanoid modules, enabling evaluation as a capability ladder, in which one module is characterized at a time and added as a rung: LiDAR-inertial navigation places the robot within 13.0cm of a 6m goal; a learned standing controller recovers from external disturbances that sampling-based lower-body MPC does not; and grasping loosened fasteners from a real Hyundai Ioniq 5 pack degrades from 97% tethered to 87% free-standing to 37% under navigation-induced pose variance. Source code is available at the project page https://golem-humanoid.github.io

AI.tldr: GOLEM是一个开源、端到端的模块化系统架构，用于Unitree H1-2人形机器人进行电动汽车电池拆解，通过Docker-based ROS 2抽象层将行走、操作、动态稳定性、导航和空间记忆作为独立模块，并在MuJoCo和IsaacLab数字孪生与物理机器人之间提供接口兼容，从仿真到现实实现完整的人形机器人电池拆解。
AI.motivation: 报废电动汽车电池组的拆解工作枯燥且危险，目前几乎完全由人类完成，缺乏自动化的人形机器人解决方案，因此需要一种可泛化、可组合、便于模块间公平比较的系统架构。
AI.method: 采用模块化架构设计，将行走、操作、动态稳定、导航和空间记忆分离为具有抽象接口的独立模块；基于Docker构建ROS 2抽象层；使用MuJoCo和IsaacLab数字孪生环境模拟物理机器人接口；采用"能力阶梯"评估方式，每次只表征一个模块并将其作为阶梯的一级。
AI.result: LiDAR-惯性导航将机器人定位在6米目标的13.0cm范围内；学习型站立控制器比基于采样的下肢MPC更能从外部干扰中恢复；从真实现代Ioniq 5电池组抓取松动紧固件的成功率从有缆线时的97%降至自由站立时的87%，在导航引起的位姿变化下进一步降至37%。
AI.conclusion: GOLEM展示了模块化人形机器人架构在EV电池拆解这一危险任务中的可行性，通过系统级组合和逐模块公平评估，验证了从仿真到现实迁移的能力，为未来人形机器人在工业拆解领域的应用提供了开放框架。

title: K-Bench: measuring model performance on real scientific agent requests
summary: Benchmarks for scientific artificial intelligence are mostly written to be scored: multiple-choice questions, curated agent tasks with reference solutions, or simulators with a known generative structure. Real scientific requests arrive differently. They are underspecified, they carry attachments, and lack ground truth. We report K-Bench 01, an evaluation built from first-turn requests sampled from live user traffic on K-Dense Web and run end to end by nine frontier models in identical sandboxes, yielding 1,602 completed agent runs. Three blinded language-model judges scored every run against an eight-dimension rubric. On a rubric whose 8-anchor instructs judges that a domain scientist would accept the work with minor edits, no model clears the line under all three judges. gpt-5.6-sol has the highest pooled mean, 8.04, but its 95% interval [7.80, 8.23] spans the threshold, and two of the three judges rank claude-opus-5 first instead. We therefore report the ordering of systems as the reproducible quantity, the absolute level as an attribute of the instrument, and the top of the table as unresolved. Across all 39,934 scored judgments -- the eight dimension scores plus a holistic overall for each assessment, excluding not-applicable cells -- 47.6% fall below the 8-point threshold. Difficulty is not uniform across the rubric: scientific accuracy averages 6.22 against 7.33 for communication, on identical denominators and in the same direction within every one of the nine models. The single leading failure tag is overclaiming, on 31.4% of assessments. We argue that the informative quantity for scientific agents is not a leaderboard position but the joint distribution of what was delivered, what was claimed, and what artifacts were produced.

AI.tldr: K-Bench 01 是一个基于 K-Dense Web 真实用户流量构建的科学人工智能基准测试，由九个前沿模型在相同沙箱中完成 1,602 次代理运行，并经三位盲审语言模型法官按八维度评分。结果显示没有模型能在所有法官下达到"领域科学家接受"阈线（8分），gpt-5.6-sol 均分最高（8.04）但置信区间跨越阈值，排名存在分歧。论文主张科学代理的有效信息不是排行榜位置，而是交付内容、声明内容与生成产物的联合分布。
AI.motivation: 现有科学AI基准（选择题、有参考解的代理任务、已知生成结构的模拟器）都是为"可打分"而设计的，而真实科学请求具有欠规格化、附带附件、缺乏真值的特点，导致基准分数无法反映真实科学工作场景的表现。
AI.method: 从K-Dense Web的真实用户流量中取样第一轮请求，由九个前沿模型在相同沙箱中端到端运行，共完成1,602次代理运行；三位盲审语言模型法官按八维度评分标准对每次运行打分，并统计失败标签与维度差异。
AI.result: 没有模型能在三位法官一致认可下跨越8分阈值；gpt-5.6-sol 池化均分最高（8.04，95%CI [7.80, 8.23]），但三位法官中有两位将 claude-opus-5 排第一；全部39,934项评分中47.6%低于8分；科学准确性平均6.22远低于沟通的7.33；最普遍的失败标签是过度声明（31.4%的评估）。
AI.conclusion: 科学代理的评估应将系统排序作为可复现的度量、绝对水平视为仪器属性、榜首视为未决问题；并主张以"交付了什么、声明了什么、产出了什么"的联合分布作为科学代理的关键信息量，而非简单的排行榜位置。

title: EXPL-FR: Explaining Face Recognition Models via Vision-Language Alignment
summary: Deep face recognition (FR) models reach near-saturated accuracy but remain opaque: a practitioner cannot ask which semantic attributes a similarity score relied upon. EXPL-FR answers this inside the FR model's own embedding space. A lightweight adapter aligns a vision-language model's (VLM) image encoder with the frozen FR space, trained on face images alone and never on text. Because the VLM's encoders share one space, the same adapter applies to the text encoder, turning 978 attribute prompts in 22 categories, also extendable, into FR-space anchors at no extra cost. We do not assume this transfer works: a face-verification protocol measures it, and an ablation changing only the adapter isolates its contribution. Not every concept survives, because an FR model earns its invariances by discarding the factors it must verify identities across. A label-free detectability measure compares each concept's separability in FR space against the VLM space, and the 100 most detectable form the model's readable semantic signature, which separates identities better than the full vocabulary. We cover four FR backbones and two VLM encoders, EXPL-FR needs no architecture access, and supports identity-level, per-image, and differential explanations. We benchmark attribute-level auditing under three supervision settings, human labels (current practice), VLM pseudo-labels, and our fully prompt-driven audit, against real verification behavior. With no labels, the prompt-driven audit ranks four FR models by their measured per-ethnicity RFW errors and ranks controlled attribute changes by their true verification cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EXPL-FR，一种在深度人脸识别模型自身嵌入空间内提供可解释性的方法。通过轻量级适配器将视觉-语言模型的图像编码器与冻结的人脸识别空间对齐，仅用面部图像训练，从而将文本属性提示转换为无关成本的FR空间锚点。论文还提出了无标签可检测性度量、可读语义签名及提示驱动的审计方法，实证表明该方法能按真实验证行为排序模型和属性。
AI.motivation: 深度人脸识别模型精度已接近饱和，但其预测过程不透明，实践者无法得知相似度分数依赖了哪些语义属性。现有FR模型缺乏可解释性，需要一种能在FR模型自身嵌入空间中回答"相似度依赖哪些属性"的方法。
AI.method: 1) 轻量适配器将VLM图像编码器与冻结的FR空间对齐，仅用面部图像训练，不涉及文本。2) 由于VLM的文本与图像编码器共享同一空间，同一适配器可直接应用于文本编码器，将978个属性提示（22类，可扩展）转为FR空间锚点。3) 通过人脸验证协议和仅改动适配器的消融来验证文本到图像迁移的有效性。4) 提出无标签可检测性度量，比较每个概念在FR空间与VLM空间中的可分离性，选取100个最可检测概念构成模型的"可读语义签名"。5) 支持身份级、每图像和差分解释，且无需访问FR模型架构。
AI.result: 在四种FR骨干网络和两种VLM编码器上验证了EXPL-FR。可读语义签名（100个最可检测概念）比完整词汇表能更好地区分身份。在三种监督设置（人类标签、VLM伪标签、完全提示驱动）下进行属性级审计。无标签提示驱动审计能按实测的每族裔RFW错误率排序四个FR模型，并能按真实验证代价排序受控的属性变化。
AI.conclusion: 并非所有语义概念都能在人脸识别空间中保留（因为FR模型通过丢弃某些因素来获得跨身份验证的不变性），但EXPL-FR能识别出哪些概念可迁移、哪些不可迁移，并以无标签方式提供模型的可读语义签名，实现属性级审计和可解释性。

title: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning for Heterogeneous Multi-Robot Task Assignment Under Distribution Shifts
summary: Heterogeneous multi-robot service systems must assign requests to compatible robots, construct feasible schedules, and adapt as new tasks arrive online. Historical data can help anticipate future demand, but relying too heavily on inaccurate predictions can degrade performance under distribution shifts. We develop a prediction-aware adaptive rollout framework for heterogeneous multi-robot task assignment with scheduled and real-time requests. The problem is formulated as a finite-horizon stochastic dynamic program incorporating robot-task compatibility, ordered service requirements, routing constraints, service windows, and end-of-horizon return requirements. The proposed policy evaluates current assignments using sampled future request scenarios while restricting immediate commitments to requests already observed. To enable online use, the framework combines pruned candidate controls, wait actions, and an interaction-aware base policy for efficient future-cost estimation. Robustness to forecast error is provided by adaptively reweighting predicted requests based on recent prediction mismatch and selectively re-optimizing assigned but unstarted requests. We also introduce a historical-data-driven procedure for selecting the heterogeneous fleet composition before deployment. In a case study using real nursing-task requests from hospital inpatient floors, the proposed approach achieves near-complete service and reduces serviced-request wait times relative to reactive, token-passing, prediction-positioning, and myopic greedy baselines, with the largest improvements in tail-delay metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向异构多机器人任务分配与调度的预测感知自适应滚动（rollout）框架，基于有限时域随机动态规划，结合预测请求场景采样、自适应预测重加权与选择性重优化机制，在真实医院护理任务数据上实现了近乎完整的服务覆盖率，并显著降低了请求等待时间。
AI.motivation: 异构多机器人服务系统需要在线的任务分配与调度，历史数据可用于预测未来需求，但过度依赖不准确的预测会在分布偏移下导致性能下降。作者希望设计一种既能利用预测信息、又能对预测误差保持鲁棒性的自适应在线决策框架。
AI.method: 将该问题建模为有限时域随机动态规划，包含机器人-任务兼容性、有序服务需求、路径约束、服务时间窗以及期末返回要求。策略通过采样未来请求场景评估当前分配，同时仅对已观测到的请求做出即时承诺。在线执行中采用剪枝候选控制、等待动作，以及交互感知的基策略进行未来成本估计。鲁棒性通过基于近期预测偏差的自适应重加权预测请求和选择性重优化已分配但未开始的任务来实现。此外还引入了基于历史数据选择异构车队配置的程序。
AI.result: 在真实医院住院楼层护理任务数据的案例研究中，该方法相比反应式、令牌传递、预测定位和贪心等基线方法实现了近乎完整的服务覆盖率，并减少了已服务请求的等待时间，尤其在尾部延迟指标上改进最大。
AI.conclusion: 预测感知的自适应rollout框架能有效平衡预测利用与鲁棒性，在异构多机器人任务分配中同时实现高服务覆盖率和低等待延迟，特别是在延迟分布的极端情况下表现突出。

title: Generate in the Chart, Not on the Boundary: Function-Symbol Grounding for Hard Constraints in LTN-GANs
summary: Logic Tensor Network-Enhanced Generative Adversarial Networks (LTN-GANs) inject background knowledge by grounding each logical axiom as a predicate and training the generator to raise its satisfaction, a fuzzy truth value in $[0,1]$. Previous LTN-GAN work grounded every constraint this way, at the predicate level, and improved constraint satisfaction. A predicate, however, only scores a sample, so it cannot embed hard structural constraints, rules such as orderings, positivity, and definitional identities that must hold in every generated sample. In this work, we investigate grounding each axiom as a function symbol inside the LTN framework. We compare against the state-of-the-art alternative, a constraint layer that clamps each violating sample onto the feasible boundary and so produces outputs that are always valid. Our investigation shows that a valid sample is not always a realistic one. An inequality is not merely satisfied or violated. It holds by a margin, and a faithful generator should also reproduce the margin's real distribution. We find that the resolution ratio $R$, the data's scale over the margin's spread, is a diagnostic, computable before training, of which constraints a chosen grounding can learn. When $R$ is large, the predicate receives no learning signal, the clamp pushes every sample onto the boundary, and the margin distribution is lost while every standard metric still looks fine. A function symbol avoids both failures, computing the constrained variable rather than scoring it. Together the function symbols form a chart, a coordinate system inside the feasible region, where every sample is valid by construction and the margin is learned like any other quantity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在逻辑张量网络-生成对抗网络(LTN-GAN)中，将逻辑公理作为函数符号而非谓词进行grounding，从而构造可行域内的坐标系（chart），使生成样本天然满足硬约束，并能学习约束边界的余量(margin)分布。
AI.motivation: 以往的LTN-GAN将每条约束作为谓词grounding，但谓词只能对样本打分，无法嵌入硬结构约束（如排序、正性、定义恒等式）。此外，已有的约束层（clamp到可行边界）虽能保证输出有效，但有效样本不等于真实样本——不等式存在余量分布，强制clamp会丢失该分布。
AI.method: 将每个逻辑公理grounding为函数符号（而非谓词），函数符号直接计算受约束的变量而非对其打分。多个函数符号组合形成可行域内的坐标系（chart），样本在此坐标系下天然满足约束，余量作为普通量被学习。同时提出分辨率比R（数据尺度/余量跨度）作为训练前可计算的诊断指标，用于判断所选grounding能否学习某约束。
AI.result: 当R较大时，谓词grounding收不到学习信号，clamp方法将样本强制推到边界，余量分布丢失，但所有标准指标看似正常。函数符号方法避免了这两种失败，样本始终有效且余量分布被正确学习。
AI.conclusion: 函数符号grounding比谓词grounding和约束层方法更能处理硬结构约束，且R可作为预测学习方法效能的先验诊断指标。

title: TASSO: TAsk-Specific Subspace Optimization for Continual Learning of Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit strong zero-shot capabilities, making them an attractive solution for continual learning across diverse tasks. However, during continual adaptation, both catastrophic forgetting and zero-shot degradation occur, severely degrading performance. In this paper, we introduce TASSO, a new paradigm that efficiently preserves the latent space geometry while ensuring network plasticity. We achieve this with two complementary techniques: subspace learning and geometry-aware knowledge distillation. Specifically, we first learn a sequence of task-specific low-rank projectors, which we use to project the latent representations before optimizing cross-entropy. Secondly, we employ a geodesic-distance-based loss that distills knowledge from the previous-task model while effectively preserving the latent space geometry. These design choices not only avoid unnecessary parameter updates along the full embedding dimensions but also improve learning by focusing on task-specific manifolds. Moreover, the geometry-aware distillation provides strong regularization and significantly reduces both catastrophic forgetting and zero-shot degradation throughout the continual learning sequence. Experimental results with the CLIP vision language model in the multi-domain task incremental and class incremental learning benchmarks demonstrate clear improvements over state-of-the-art methods in mitigating forgetting and preserving zero-shot capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TASSO方法，通过子空间学习和几何感知知识蒸馏，在CLIP视觉语言模型的持续学习中同时缓解灾难性遗忘和零样本能力退化。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在持续学习中面临两个核心挑战：灾难性遗忘（catastrophic forgetting）和零样本能力退化（zero-shot degradation），这严重限制了模型在跨任务持续适应中的性能表现。
AI.method: TASSO包含两个互补技术：（1）子空间学习——学习一系列任务特定的低秩投影器，在优化交叉熵前对潜在表征进行投影，避免沿完整嵌入维度的不必要参数更新；（2）几何感知知识蒸馏——采用基于测地线距离的损失函数，从先前任务模型蒸馏知识，同时有效保持潜在空间的几何结构。
AI.result: 在CLIP视觉语言模型的多领域任务增量学习（multi-domain task incremental）和类增量学习（class incremental）基准上，TASSO在缓解遗忘和保持零样本能力方面均显著优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过聚焦任务特定流形的子空间学习和保几何的知识蒸馏，TASSO高效地保持了潜在空间的几何结构，同时保证了网络的可塑性，有效解决了VLM持续学习中的双重退化问题。

title: Betting for Sim-to-Real Performance Certificates
summary: Consider a typical test of a robot system: one observes a sequence of outcomes concerning some aspect of interest (crash or no crash, tracking error, time to completion), and reports a mean (crash risk, average error, mean time to completion) and, more importantly, an interval guaranteed to contain that mean at a prescribed confidence, referred to as a performance certificate. Given expensive real-world trials, the sample size is therefore small, and the certificate is often loose. Now consider the same procedure, except that before each real outcome is revealed, the operator ``peeks'' at a large bank of simulated results, and places a bet on where the real outcome will land. As the real outcomes settle the bets, the operator gains or loses wealth. One's ``trust'' over simulators also shifts within the portfolio. This paper develops that idea into a sim-to-real betting certificate framework with three contributions: (i) An algorithm that links a scalable bank of simulators to effective bets, and the accumulated betting wealth to the certificate. (ii) A proof that the returned certificate is anytime valid, covering the true mean with the prescribed probability, using any simulator bank. (iii) The guaranteed wealth-regret bounds yield configuration principles for the proposed algorithm and simulator bank design to deliver tight certificates. Experiments across synthetic distributions and real-world robot tests, covering both replayed standardized testing outcomes and online runtime evaluation, show the proposed method narrows the certificate by $51.6\%\pm16\%$ against classic and state-of-the-art baselines, and by $32.26\%\pm8\%$ in the extremely limited-sample regime ($\leq30$ samples).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"模拟到现实"（sim-to-real）的投注式置信区间（certificate）框架，通过在大规模仿真结果上"下注"来利用仿真数据，从而在少量真实样本条件下生成更紧致的性能证书（保证以给定置信度覆盖真实均值的区间）。算法将仿真器库转化为有效赌注，累积赌资与证书相关联，并证明证书具有任意时间有效性（anytime valid）及财富遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 机器人系统的真实世界测试代价高昂，样本量通常很小，导致基于真实样本的性能证书（置信区间）非常宽松。而仿真数据虽然丰富但存在域差（sim-to-real gap）。作者希望利用大量易得的仿真结果来收紧仅基于少量真实样本的置信区间，从而在有限试验预算下获得更精确的性能保证。
AI.method: (i) 提出一种算法，将大规模仿真器库与有效赌注（bets）相连接，并将累积的投注财富转化为性能证书；(ii) 通过理论证明保证返回的证书是任意时间有效的（anytime valid），即无论使用何种仿真器库，都能以规定概率覆盖真实均值；(iii) 通过保证的财富遗憾界（wealth-regret bounds），给出所提算法的配置原则以及仿真器库的设计准则，以实现紧致证书。
AI.result: 在合成分布和真实机器人测试（包括重放标准化测试结果与在线运行评估）上的实验表明，相对于经典基线和最先进基线，所提方法将证书宽度平均收窄51.6%±16%；在极限小样本场景（≤30个样本）下收窄32.26%±8%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架证明了利用大量仿真数据可以通过投注机制系统性地收紧真实环境下的性能证书，且无需对仿真器质量作任何假设，同时提供了算法与仿真器库设计的理论指导，为机器人系统在昂贵真实样本下提供更精确的性能保证开辟了新途径。

title: Semantic Compression Trees: Multi-Resolution Knowledge Retrieval via Hierarchical Semantic Residuals
summary:
Retrieval-augmented generation relies mostly on flat, fixed-granularity indexes: documents are cut into uniform chunks and retrieved by similarity, discarding the hierarchical structure of the source. We introduce Semantic Compression Trees (SCT), a hierarchical index in which each node stores only its semantic residual -- the information it adds beyond its parent -- and retrieval proceeds by progressive descent from the root, so that per-query cost is governed by tree depth rather than collection size.
  We evaluate on QASPER (50 papers, 173 questions) under two protocols differing only in whether the benchmark supplies the relevant document, with bootstrap confidence intervals and paired significance tests throughout. The results are mixed and we report them as such. When the document is given, SCT with a zero-LLM extractive compressor matches dense retrieval on answer quality (0.274 vs. 0.277 F1, $p = 0.37$) using 30% fewer context tokens and no LLM calls to build the index, and residual storage beats storing full summaries at each node (0.274 vs. 0.205, $p < 0.001$). Increasing the collection fifty-fold multiplies flat retrieval's per-query scoring work by 48.9x and SCT's by 6.4x.
  Progressive descent itself is not supported. Retrieving the same residuals without the tree performs identically when the document is given ($p = 0.27$), and descent is substantially worse when the system must select the document (0.122 vs. 0.165, $p < 0.001$). Routing accuracy localises the cause: descent selects the correct paper 20.2% of the time against 39.3% for flat retrieval, because that choice is made from the root residual, the most compressed node in the tree. We conclude that the residual representation is worth keeping and top-down routing is not.

AI.tldr: 本文提出语义压缩树（SCT），一种利用层级结构与语义残差构建的检索索引，每个节点仅存储相对父节点的增量信息，检索时自根节点逐层下降，使查询成本取决于树深度而非集合规模。实验结果表明，残差表示在给定文档场景下有价值（匹配稠密检索且省30%上下文token），但逐层下降的路由机制效果不佳（选错文档，20.2% vs 39.3%），作者诚实地报告了混合结果。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统采用扁平、固定粒度的索引，将文档切成均匀chunk并用相似度检索，丢弃了文档的层级结构，导致查询成本随集合规模线性增长，且无法有效利用文档的语义组织。
AI.method: 提出Semantic Compression Trees（SCT）：1）构建层级索引树，每个节点只存储相对父节点的语义残差（即新增信息）；2）检索时从根节点逐层向下路由，每次只需比较少量候选；3）支持零LLM的抽取式压缩器构建索引。
AI.result: 在QASPER上：给定文档时SCT匹配稠密检索F1（0.274 vs 0.277，p=0.37），节省30%上下文token且零LLM调用构建索引；残差存储优于全摘要存储（0.274 vs 0.205）。但缩放50倍时SCT查询计算量仅6.4x（vs扁平48.9x）。然而渐进下降路由不被支持：无树时效果相同（p=0.27），需选文档时显著更差（0.122 vs 0.165），路由准确率仅20.2% vs 39.3%。
AI.conclusion: 结论是残差表示值得保留（高效压缩、不失质量），但自顶向下的路由机制不可行（根节点残差过于压缩导致文档选择失败）。作者强调如实报告混合结果，不掩盖负面发现。

title: DamageScope: Vision-Language Retrieval at Scale for Disaster Damage Assessment from Satellite Imagery
summary: Timely and accurate assessment of property damage is critical following natural disasters. Traditional on-site inspections are labor-intensive, costly, and often pose safety risks. Advances in satellite imagery and vision-language models (VLMs) enable scalable remote damage assessment; however, integrating VLMs into large-scale Earth observation pipelines presents challenges in computational efficiency, data organization, and information retrieval. To address these challenges, we present DamageScope, a retrieval-augmented framework that combines satellite imagery with Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and Large Language Models (LLMs) to automate property damage analysis. Built on a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework, DamageScope extracts structured visual representations from satellite imagery to support interactive natural language queries for damage assessment. To address scalability, we introduce a novel multi-vector embedding-based clustering algorithm that outperforms traditional single-vector embedding approaches while reducing indexing time by up to 14x. Furthermore, a dual-store data architecture minimizes LLM API calls, reducing both operational cost and response latency by up to approximately 3x. By effectively balancing scalability and operational efficiency, DamageScope provides a robust and practical solution for real-world damage assessment tasks.

AI.tldr: DamageScope是一个基于检索增强生成（RAG）框架的自动化灾损评估系统，结合卫星影像、视觉语言模型（VLMs）和大语言模型（LLMs），通过多向量嵌入聚类算法和双存储数据架构，实现高效、可扩展的自然语言交互式灾损分析。
AI.motivation: 传统的自然灾害财产损失评估依赖人工现场检查，耗时、昂贵且存在安全风险。尽管卫星影像和视觉语言模型（VLMs）为远程评估提供了可能，但将VLMs集成到大规模地球观测管线中面临计算效率、数据组织和信息检索三大挑战。
AI.method: DamageScope构建于RAG框架之上：1）从卫星影像中提取结构化视觉表征，支持自然语言交互查询；2）提出新颖的多向量嵌入聚类算法，相较传统单向量嵌入方法在索引时间上最多减少14倍；3）设计双存储数据架构，将LLM API调用降至最低，使操作成本和响应延迟最多降低约3倍。
AI.result: 多向量嵌入聚类算法在性能上优于传统单向量嵌入方法，索引时间最多减少14倍；双存储架构使响应延迟和操作成本最多降低约3倍。
AI.conclusion: DamageScope在可扩展性与操作效率之间取得了有效平衡，为真实世界灾损评估任务提供了稳健且实用的解决方案。

title: Force/Torque-Based Kinematic Adaptation for Robotic Manipulation Tasks
summary: Contact-rich robotic manipulation requires an accurate model of the kinematic relationship between a robot's joints and the task features it senses. This relationship is rarely known exactly: it changes with each tool the robot picks up and shifts, sometimes almost instantaneously, as contact modes change --- especially for multi-fingered hands that make and break contact at points that are not exactly prescribed, as in full-hand grasping. This paper develops an adaptive scheme that estimates that relationship online, using only joint-angle sensing and a wrist-mounted force/torque sensor, with no exteroceptive measurement of the tool tip. We derive a provably stable kinematic update law that identifies the kinematics of an unknown tool from force/torque feedback alone, and prove stability of both the rigid case and the case with a compliance controller as an inner loop. We show that identification is confined to the directions the motion excites --- so that, for example, a tool's length is unobservable under a rigid insertion push, while a compliant loop's passive yielding partially excites it; and that with a second-order admittance the compliant certificate holds unconditionally in continuous time. We also pose the combined control and estimation problem as a Quadratic Program (QP): the formulation yields the prediction term of the update law exactly but, instructively, cannot reproduce the tracking adaptation term. We validate the scheme in simulation on a peg-in-hole insertion. This work is the first step in a research program aimed at factoring manipulation learning into a task policy which can be learned in isolation of the robot, for instance by reinforcement learning, and an adaptive kinematic component that adapts online to the particular robot, hand, or tool in use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自适应方案，仅利用关节角度传感和腕部力/力矩传感器在线估计机器人与任务特征之间的运动学关系，无需外部传感器测量工具末端。方案推导了可证明稳定的运动学更新律，适用于刚性情况和带柔顺控制内环的情况，并在插孔（peg-in-hole）仿真中验证。
AI.motivation: 接触丰富的机器人操作需要精确的关节与任务特征之间的运动学模型，但该关系很少被精确知晓：它随每次拾取工具而变化，且接触模式改变时可能瞬时漂移（尤其对于多指手全手抓取）。传统方法依赖外部传感器或精确建模，难以应对这些不确定性。
AI.method: 推导了一个可证明稳定的运动学更新律，仅凭力/力矩反馈识别未知工具的运动学。分析刚性情形和带柔顺控制器作为内环的情形；证明识别被限制在运动激励的方向上；将控制与估计联合问题建模为二次规划（QP）并分析其与更新律的关系；在插孔仿真中验证。
AI.result: 运动学辨识被限制在运动激励的方向上（例如刚性插入推动下工具长度不可观测，而柔顺环的被动屈服会部分激励它）；带二阶导纳时柔顺证书在连续时间下无条件成立；QP公式精确产生更新律的预测项但无法复现跟踪自适应项；插孔仿真验证了方案有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作是更大研究计划的第一步，旨在将操作学习分解为可在机器人之外独立学习的任务策略（如强化学习）和在线适应特定机器人、手或工具的动力学自适应组件。

title: SAEM: Stage-Aware Expert Management for Memory-Efficient MoE Inference in Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
comment: Extended version of the paper accepted at DAC 2026. Extends the conference version with evaluations on AIME 2024 and GPQA-Diamond and a prediction-oracle upper-bound analysis
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting improves LLM reasoning by decomposing complex problems into intermediate steps, but its sequential nature increases decoding latency and memory usage. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale capacity through sparse expert activation, yet their full expert weights often exceed GPU memory and require costly GPU-CPU transfers. Existing runtimes treat all tokens uniformly, overlooking a key structural property of CoT traces: consecutive reasoning stages exhibit coherent and predictable expert activation patterns. Ignoring this stage-level regularity leads to inefficient caching and unnecessary data movement. We propose SAEM, a stage-aware MoE inference runtime that detects reasoning stage boundaries and exploits stage-level activation coherence to guide expert placement. SAEM combines stage-aware caching, expert-aligned token repacking, and in-situ CPU execution to reduce data transfer and kernel fragmentation. On mathematical and scientific reasoning workloads, SAEM achieves an average 1.33x throughput improvement over the strongest state-of-the-art caching and offloading baselines under constrained GPU memory, rising to 1.54x when calibration data matches the workload, demonstrating the effectiveness of stage-aware, locality-driven MoE inference for CoT reasoning.

AI.tldr: SAEM是一个面向MoE推理的阶段感知运行时系统，通过检测思维链（CoT）推理阶段边界并利用阶段内专家激活的连贯性来优化专家放置与缓存，在GPU内存受限条件下相比最强基线平均提升1.33倍吞吐量（校准数据匹配时可提升至1.54倍）。
AI.motivation: 现有MoE推理运行时对所有token一视同仁，忽略了CoT推理轨迹中相邻推理阶段具有连贯且可预测的专家激活模式这一关键结构特性。这种忽视导致缓存效率低下和不必要的数据移动，同时MoE完整专家权重常超出GPU内存，需要昂贵的GPU-CPU传输。
AI.method: SAEM包含三大核心组件：1）阶段感知缓存（stage-aware caching），利用推理阶段的激活连贯性指导专家放置；2）专家对齐的token重打包（expert-aligned token repacking），减少kernel碎片化；3）原位CPU执行（in-situ CPU execution），减少数据传输开销。系统首先检测CoT推理阶段边界，再据此优化专家调度。
AI.result: 在数学和科学推理负载上，SAEM在GPU内存受限条件下相比最强的缓存与卸载基线平均实现1.33倍吞吐量提升；当校准数据与工作负载匹配时，提升可达1.54倍。
AI.conclusion: 阶段感知、局部性驱动的MoE推理方法对CoT推理是有效的，展示了利用推理阶段结构特性优化MoE大规模推理性能的可行性。

title: presto: Efficient, Training-free, and Open-world Object Placement via Imaginary Search
summary: Object placement is critical in image composition, requiring spatially and semantically coherent positioning of objects within diverse scenes. Existing approaches typically rely on hand-crafted rules or supervised learning on limited datasets, which restricts their generalization and interpretability, especially in open-world scenarios involving novel objects and scenes. In this work, we reformulate open-world object placement as a heuristic search task guided by reasoning from a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM). We introduce \textsf{presto}, a zero-shot, training-free framework that operates within an imaginary action space to iteratively refine object position and scale. Our coarse-to-fine search strategy ensures fast convergence, and we evaluate two decision-making variants: Metric-guided Selection and MLLM-as-a-judge. Experiments across multiple benchmarks show that \textsf{presto}~achieves state-of-the-art performance, particularly in previously unseen, open-world settings. Human studies further reveal that the MLLM-as-a-judge variant produces more perceptually coherent placements than metric-driven approaches, highlighting a gap between standard evaluation metrics and human visual judgment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出presto框架，将开放世界物体放置问题重新定义为由多模态大语言模型(MLLM)推理引导的启发式搜索任务，通过零样本、无需训练的方式在想象动作空间中迭代优化物体的位置和尺度，实现了开放世界场景下的最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有物体放置方法依赖手工规则或在有限数据集上监督学习，在包含新颖物体和场景的开放世界情境下泛化能力和可解释性受限。
AI.method: 将开放世界物体放置重构为MLLM推理引导的启发式搜索任务，在想象动作空间中迭代优化物体位置与尺度；采用由粗到细的搜索策略加速收敛；评估两种决策变体：Metric-guided Selection和MLLM-as-a-judge。
AI.result: 在多个基准上达到最先进性能，尤其在未见过的开放世界设置中表现突出；人类研究表明MLLM-as-a-judge变体产生的放置比基于度量的方法更具感知连贯性，揭示了标准评估指标与人类视觉判断之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: presto证明了利用MLLM推理驱动搜索的方法能有效解决开放世界物体放置问题，同时指出当前评估指标与人类感知之间存在鸿沟，MLLM作为评判者更贴近人类审美判断。

authors: Ruan Rithelle Chagas de Faria Carminati
title: Why Personalization Matters: Cross-Subject Challenges in EMG-IMU-based HRI Activity Recognition
comment: Data collection was approved by the Federal University of Technology-Paraná Ethics Committee (CAAE 91430125.0.0000.0177). The MAGIC-HRI (Multimodal Activity, Gesture, and Intention Collection for HRI) dataset is available at [https://github.com/ruancarminati/MAGIC-HRI-V01.git](https://github.com/ruancarminati/MAGIC-HRI-V01.git). This paper will be presented at IEEE RO-MAN 2026
summary: This paper investigates wearable-based recognition of human activities and gestures to support Human-Robot Interaction (HRI) in object-handover and assembly-like scenarios. Electromyography (EMG) and Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) signals were collected using a Myo armband, culminating in a novel dataset introduced as MAGIC-HRI (Multimodal Activity, Gesture and Intention Collection) with a large taxonomy of 53 movement classes, including Brazilian Sign Language (LIBRAS) numbers (0-9), hand gestures, object/tool handover actions (pick up/give/hold), tool-manipulation tasks, and generic assembly/idle motions, collected from 11 participants with 10 samples per class (530 samples per participant). Signals are segmented by detecting muscle activation via an EMG energy envelope, then processed using sliding windows; time- and frequency-domain features are extracted. Multiple classical classifiers are tuned via cross-validated grid search, with Random Forest as the strongest baseline. A Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) protocol reveals a large generalization gap, indicating substantial subject dependence. A personalized adaptation experiment suggests that injecting a small number of samples from a new user can markedly improve recognition. Overall, the study contributes a broad, HRI-driven multimodal dataset, a rigorous evaluation emphasizing generalization, and practical evidence that personalization is likely required for robust deployment in practical HRI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAGIC-HRI多模态数据集，基于Myo臂环采集EMG和IMU信号，涵盖53类人类活动/手势（含LIBRAS手语数字、物体交接、工具操作等），并通过LOSO评估揭示显著的个体泛化差距，证明个性化适应是实际HRI部署的关键。
AI.motivation: 在人与机器人交互（HRI）场景（如物体交接和装配）中，需要可靠地识别人类活动和手势。当前缺乏覆盖广泛动作类别、面向HRI的多模态可穿戴数据集，且现有方法在跨受试者泛化方面存在不足，亟需系统评估和数据支撑。
AI.method: 使用Myo臂环采集EMG和IMU信号；通过EMG能量包络检测肌肉激活进行信号分段，再以滑动窗口处理；提取时域和频域特征；采用交叉验证网格搜索调优多种经典分类器（以随机森林为最强基线）；使用LOSO协议评估跨受试者泛化，并进行个性化适应实验（注入少量新用户样本）。
AI.result: 构建了包含53类动作、11名参与者、每人每类10个样本的MAGIC-HRI数据集；随机森林取得最强基线性能；LOSO评估显示显著的泛化差距（表明主体依赖性强）；注入少量新用户样本的个性化适应实验能明显提升识别准确率。
AI.conclusion: 该研究贡献了一个面向HRI的广泛多模态数据集、强调泛化性的严谨评估框架，并提供了实际证据表明：在实用HRI部署中，个性化（适配新用户）是获得稳健性能的必要条件。

title: Measuring Activation Control in Large Language Models
summary: Safe deployment of increasingly capable models will likely come to rely on latent-space monitoring as a complement to behavioral evaluations, especially when evaluation-aware models exhibit scheming or deception.
