However, if models can also control their own activations, deception could extend into the latent space itself. With this in mind, we introduce the Activation Controllability Benchmark to quantify the extent to which models can modulate their residual stream via natural-language instruction. Across model families and capability levels, we find that most LLMs can control the direction and magnitude of their residual stream activations with some degree of temporal resolution, though performance varies considerably across models. In simple tasks, this level of control can evade activation-based monitoring methods (including linear probes, natural language autoencoders, activation oracles, and the Jacobian lens), albeit imperfectly. These results suggest that control over the activation space itself could become a confound for monitoring as introspective capabilities increase; therefore, we recommend that frontier labs and evaluators track activation controllability in future models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出激活可控性基准（Activation Controllability Benchmark），用于量化大语言模型能否通过自然语言指令调控自身残差流激活。研究发现多数模型具备一定程度的激活方向与幅度控制能力，且这种控制可部分规避基于激活的监控方法，警示前沿实验室需跟踪模型对激活空间的操控能力。
AI.motivation: 随着模型能力增强，隐性空间监控（latent-space monitoring）被视为行为评估的重要补充，尤其当模型展现出欺骗或阴谋行为时。然而，若模型能控制自身激活，欺骗可能延伸到隐性空间本身，从而削弱监控可靠性。作者旨在量化这种风险。
AI.method: 构建激活可控性基准（Activation Controllability Benchmark），通过自然语言指令让模型调控其残差流（residual stream）激活的方向、幅度与时间分辨率，并在多个模型家族与能力层级上评估该控制能力。同时测试这种控制能否规避多种激活监控方法（线性探针、自然语言自编码器、激活预言机、Jacobian lens）。
AI.result: 大多数LLM能以一定程度的时间分辨率控制残差流激活的方向和幅度，但各模型间性能差异显著。在简单任务中，这种激活控制可（虽不完美地）规避包括线性探针、自然语言自编码器、激活预言机和Jacobian lens在内的激活监控方法。
AI.conclusion: 对激活空间的直接控制可能成为监控系统的混淆因素（confound），随着内省能力增强风险更大。作者建议前沿实验室与评估机构在未来的模型中跟踪激活可控性水平。

title: Extending the Horizon of Early Diagnosis: Lung Cancer Prediction with Vision Transformers
summary: Lung cancer remains a leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, and early diagnosis is critical for improving survival. However, early-stage malignancies can be subtle on chest X-rays, creating challenges for radiologists. This study evaluates Vision Transformers (ViTs) for predicting lung cancer one to two years before clinical diagnosis. We analyzed 259,361 chest X-rays from 91,020 imaging studies at the Jamaica Plains VA Hospital in Boston, MA. The dataset showed extreme class imbalance, approximately 1:150 cancer to non-cancer, which was addressed using hybrid under- and over-sampling and class-weighted loss optimization. Three ViT configurations were evaluated: a model trained from scratch, an ImageNet-pretrained model, and a Corona-pretrained model fine-tuned on the lung cancer dataset. Transfer learning improved performance, with pretrained models exceeding the scratch baseline by 6-10 percentage points in AUC and about 10-12 percent in balanced accuracy. ImageNet-pretrained models showed the most stable overall performance, while Corona-pretrained models achieved higher sensitivity in some settings but greater variability. Moderate resampling ratios, including 1:1 undersampling and 1.5:2 oversampling, provided favorable trade-offs between sensitivity, precision, and computational efficiency, reducing runtime by up to 70 percent without major performance loss. These findings demonstrate the potential of ViTs for early lung cancer risk prediction from routine chest X-rays. Although performance remains below clinical deployment thresholds, the results support further development of ViT-based triage systems to flag high-risk patients for earlier evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了Vision Transformers (ViTs)在临床确诊前1-2年预测肺癌的能力，使用了波士顿VA医院259,361张胸部X光片（91,020项影像研究）。通过混合采样和类别加权损失解决约1:150的极端类别不平衡问题。三种ViT配置中，预训练模型（ImageNet和Corona）比从头训练的模型AUC高出6-10个百分点，准确率高出10-12%。中等重采样比例在灵敏度和计算效率之间实现良好平衡，可将运行时间减少多达70%。
AI.motivation: 肺癌是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因，早期诊断对提高生存率至关重要。然而早期恶性肿瘤在胸片上表现微妙，放射科医生难以识别。作者希望利用ViT模型从常规胸片中提前1-2年预测肺癌风险，以弥补早期诊断的不足。
AI.method: 分析了259,361张来自91,020项影像研究的胸片，采用混合欠采样和过采样及类别加权损失应对1:150的极端类别不平衡。评估了三种ViT配置：从头训练的模型、ImageNet预训练模型、Corona预训练模型（在肺癌数据集上微调）。同时探索了不同的重采样比例对性能与计算效率的影响。
AI.result: 迁移学习显著优于从头训练，预训练模型AUC高出6-10个百分点，平衡准确率提高10-12%。ImageNet预训练模型整体表现最稳定，Corona预训练模型在某些设置下灵敏度更高但变异性更大。中等重采样比例（1:1欠采样和1.5:2过采样）提供了灵敏度、精确度和计算效率之间的良好平衡，运行时间减少多达70%而无明显性能损失。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明ViT在从常规胸片进行早期肺癌风险预测方面具有潜力，尽管性能尚未达到临床部署阈值，但结果支持进一步开发基于ViT的分诊系统，以标记高风险患者进行更早评估。

title: OpenSCvx: An Open-Source Modular and Extensible Nonlinear Trajectory Planning Package
summary: Trajectory optimization computes dynamically feasible motions that enable autonomous systems to accomplish complex tasks while satisfying operational and environmental constraints. This tutorial presents OpenSCvx, an open-source Python framework that bridges the gap between high-level problem specification and efficient numerical optimization. Rather than requiring users to derive solver-specific mathematical formulations, OpenSCvx provides a symbolic modeling interface that automatically constructs and solves trajectory optimization problems from modular descriptions of objectives, dynamics, and constraints. Beyond simplifying problem formulation, OpenSCvx supports (i) continuous-time constraint modeling, (ii) temporal and logical specifications, (iii) automatic vectorization for scalable and batched optimization, and (iv) a modular architecture that enables new algorithms, models, and solver backends to be incorporated with minimal effort. These capabilities allow researchers and practitioners to rapidly prototype, solve, and extend state-of-the-art trajectory optimization methods.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍OpenSCvx，一个开源Python框架，通过符号化建模接口自动构建和求解轨迹优化问题，桥接高层问题描述与高效数值优化之间的鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 轨迹优化问题通常需要用户推导特定于求解器的数学公式，过程繁琐且易出错。本文旨在提供一个框架，让用户无需深入了解底层求解器细节，即可从目标、动力学和约束的模块化描述中快速构建和求解轨迹优化问题。
AI.method: OpenSCvx提供符号化建模接口，自动构建和求解轨迹优化问题。其核心特性包括：(i)连续时间约束建模；(ii)时间和逻辑规范支持；(iii)自动向量化以实现可扩展和批量优化；(iv)模块化架构，使得新算法、模型和求解器后端可以以最小努力集成。
AI.result: OpenSCvx使研究人员和实践者能够快速原型化、求解和扩展最先进的轨迹优化方法，具体结果体现在其简化问题表述和上述四项关键能力上。
AI.conclusion: OpenSCvx作为一个开源框架，有效弥合了高层问题规范与高效数值优化之间的差距，为自主系统的轨迹优化提供了灵活、可扩展的解决方案平台。

title: From Mastery Profile to Simulated Response: Stochastic Student Knowledge Graphs (SSKG) for Faithful LLM Student Simulation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate students at different mastery levels. These simulations can generate synthetic training data and stress-test tutoring systems. However, common prompt-based approaches leave the answer decision to the LLM, which tends to perform according to its built-in capabilities even when instructed to simulate a student with low mastery. As a result, these approaches may have difficulty distinguishing students with low and high levels of mastery. We demonstrate this limitation using 379 College Board-calibrated SAT Algebra items and five archetypal mastery profiles. Three LLMs from three vendors (Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite, Claude Haiku 4.5, and GPT-5.4-mini) achieve 96.8-100% accuracy across all profiles. To address this limitation, we introduce a method grounded in a Stochastic Student Knowledge Graph (SSKG). A curriculum knowledge graph (CKG) is extracted from an open algebra textbook, and each SAT solution is decomposed into a chain of required triples. The SSKG assigns a mastery probability to each triple, which is sampled to determine question correctness. An LLM then generates a first-person rationale consistent with the outcome. The simulation reduces accuracy to 44.1-85.2% across profiles and produces a clear monotone mastery gradient.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了用LLM模拟不同掌握水平学生的局限性，并提出基于随机学生知识图谱（SSKG）的方法来解决这一问题。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型被广泛用于模拟不同掌握水平的学生以生成合成训练数据和压力测试辅导系统，但常见的基于提示的方法无法有效区分低掌握和高掌握水平的学生，因为LLM即使被指示模拟低掌握学生，仍倾向于按其内在能力表现。
AI.method: 提出基于随机学生知识图谱（SSKG）的方法：从开放代数教科书中提取课程知识图谱（CKG），将每个SAT解答分解为所需三元组链，SSKG为每个三元组分配掌握概率，通过采样确定问题正确性，再由LLM生成与结果一致的第一人称推理。
AI.result: 传统提示方法在379道College Board校准SAT代数题和五种原型掌握画像上达到96.8-100%的准确率，无法区分掌握水平；而SSKG方法将准确率降至44.1-85.2%，并产生清晰的单调掌握梯度。
AI.conclusion: 基于提示的模拟方法无法有效模拟低掌握学生，而基于知识图谱的概率采样方法能更好地生成区分不同掌握水平的学生模拟数据。

title: Perturb the Thought, Not the Pixels: Latent-Space Rollout Diversification for Reinforcement Learning of Vision-Language Models
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning ability of vision-language models (VLMs), and diversifying the rollouts within each optimization group amplifies its gains. Existing approaches diversify through decoding temperature or pixel-space image distortion; we ask whether the perturbation belongs in the model's latent space instead. We introduce Noise-Contrastive GRPO (NC-GRPO), which injects scale-calibrated Gaussian noise into the last hidden layer of the prompt-encoding pass for half of each rollout group, branching those rollouts from a displaced departure state. Branches that reach the answer despite the displacement are reinforced over those derailed by it, converting sensitivity at the branch point into policy-gradient signal; the objective, reward, and inference protocol are untouched. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B trained on Geometry3K, NC-GRPO significantly improves out-of-domain mathematical reasoning over vanilla GRPO across five held-out benchmarks (pooled McNemar $p \le 0.001$) while also improving in-domain accuracy and hallucination robustness -- the latter an axis on which image-space noise regresses even while posting a larger OOD average on perception-heavy benchmarks. Mechanism ablations indicate that independent stochastic diversity, not noise budget or direction, is the active ingredient, and a noise-scale study exposes a dial between reasoning specialization and general capability. NC-GRPO is designed to be modality-agnostic and integrates into a standard RLVR pipeline as a ~50-line change to the inference engine.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NC-GRPO，一种在视觉语言模型潜在空间中注入噪声来增强RLVR训练多样性的方法。与现有的解码温度或像素空间图像扰动不同，NC-GRPO在提示编码阶段的最后一层隐藏层注入尺度校准的高斯噪声，使一半的rollout从偏移的出发状态分支出来。该方法在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上显著提升多基准的数学推理能力和幻觉鲁棒性，且仅需约50行代码改动。
AI.motivation: 强化学习中的rollout多样性对RLVR训练至关重要，现有方法仅通过解码温度或像素空间图像扰动来实现多样化，作者质疑扰动应放在模型潜在空间中而非图像空间，以更有效地突破感知层面的限制。
AI.method: NC-GRPO在提示编码阶段向最后一层隐藏层注入尺度校准的高斯噪声，对每个rollout分组的一半施加扰动使其从位移的出发状态分支。通过对比学习思想，奖励到达答案的分支、惩罚偏离的分支，将分支点的敏感性转化为策略梯度信号。目标函数、奖励和推理协议均保持不变，方法具有模态无关性。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上于Geometry3K训练后，NC-GRPO在五个保留基准上显著优于vanilla GRPO（McNemar p≤0.001），同时提升域内准确率和幻觉鲁棒性。相比之下，图像空间噪声在感知密集型基准上取得更大的OOD均值但幻觉鲁棒性反而退化。消融实验表明独立的随机多样性（而非噪声预算或方向）是有效成分。
AI.conclusion: 潜在空间扰动为VLM推理中的rollout多样化提供了优于图像空间扰动的方案，在提升推理能力的同时保持甚至改善幻觉鲁棒性。噪声尺度可作为推理专门化与通用能力之间的调节旋钮，方法易于集成到现有RLVR流水线。

title: Lifelong Robot Recomposition via Persistent Categorical Modeling for Unified Task-Driven Co-Design, Verification, and Planning
summary: Robotic systems are traditionally designed and deployed in static configurations, with assumptions made at design-time becoming immutable constraints during runtime. This design-then-deploy paradigm produces performant systems under narrow operating conditions, but renders robots brittle when qualities of themselves, their tasks, or their environments unexpectedly change. We address this challenge with a compositional framework that formalizes robotic systems as abstract circuits within a strict symmetric monoidal category, in which design and runtime composition of hardware, software, and behavior are synthesized simultaneously via an SMT-based solver, with monoidal functors projecting the system into lifecycle-specific views and free symbolic variables simultaneously solving for parameters and entire component specifications within larger compositions. This persistent model also supports queries a long-lived system needs beyond plan existence across its entire lifecycle, including mapping Pareto fronts over candidate compositions, diagnosing why a composition has become infeasible, finding its minimal restoration, and reconfiguring with limited change to the deployed system. We evaluate against official implementations of optimal numeric, stream-based, and SMT-based planners all measured onboard a deployed robot and demonstrate the approach end-to-end in a search-and-rescue scenario in which the robot recognizes when it has become unfit and synthesizes and assumes new holistic configurations to restore operation. We release our solver and supporting software open-source.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于严格对称幺半范畴的复合框架，将机器人系统形式化为抽象电路，通过SMT求解器同时综合设计期和运行期的硬件、软件与行为组合，并利用幺半函子投影到生命周期特定视图，支持整个生命周期内的查询（如Pareto前沿映射、不可行诊断、最小恢复和有限变更重构），在真实机器人上端到端验证于搜索救援场景。
AI.motivation: 传统机器人采用"先设计后部署"范式，运行时假设不可变，导致系统在自身、任务或环境发生意外变化时变得脆弱，缺乏跨生命周期的自适应能力。
AI.method: 1) 将机器人系统形式化为严格对称幺半范畴中的抽象电路；2) 通过SMT求解器同时综合设计与运行时组合（硬件、软件、行为）；3) 幺半函子将系统投影到生命周期特定视图；4) 自由符号变量同时求解参数与更大组合中的组件规格；5) 支持生命周期级别的持久查询（Pareto前沿、不可行诊断、最小恢复、受限重构）。
AI.result: 与官方实现的最优数值、流式和SMT规划器在部署机器人上对比评估，并在搜索救援场景中端到端展示：机器人能识别自身功能丧失并综合新整体配置以恢复运行。
AI.conclusion: 该框架打破设计-部署僵化范式，使机器人具备跨生命周期的持久自省与自适应重构能力，且开源求解器与软件以促进复现与社区应用。

title: Context as an Environment: Programmatic Context Management for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: LLM agents increasingly take on long-running tasks whose history grows far beyond a single model context window. Existing approaches compress earlier interactions or extract selected information into fixed memory representations, committing to what to preserve before future needs are known. We present Scroll, a context manager that treats each agent session as an executable Session Environment. The environment is backed by an append-only Event Log and a sandboxed, persistent Python kernel. The kernel maintains a typed namespace across model calls, allowing tool outputs, retrieved history, and derived state to be bound to variables rather than serialized into the prompt at each call. Model-written code searches, materializes, and transforms session state through exec; only explicitly printed projections enter the model's working view for the next call. Context management thus becomes a programming task that inherits the improving coding abilities of LLMs, while the Event Log preserves lossless historical ground truth. As the working view approaches its budget, stale spans are evicted but remain recoverable: an eviction index keeps compact landmarks tied to exact Event Log addresses, so that the agent navigates directly to evicted regions instead of searching the full log. With Qwen3.8-Max as the backbone, Scroll achieves 94.8% on LongMemEval_S; 73.1% on BEAM_10M, surpassing the best published memory system by 5.1 points; and 86.7% on LOCA_256K, exceeding the best published long-horizon agent by 37.4 points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Scroll，一个将LLM智能体会话视为可执行"会话环境"的上下文管理器。它通过持久化Python内核维护类型化命名空间，以编程方式管理上下文，并在逼近预算时通过索引驱逐陈旧片段但保持可恢复性，显著超越现有记忆系统。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体执行长期任务时，历史记录远超单个模型的上下文窗口。现有方法要么压缩早期交互，要么将选定信息提取到固定记忆中，但都在未来需求未知之前就决定了要保留什么，导致信息丢失或浪费。
AI.method: Scroll将每次智能体会话视为可执行的Session Environment，由追加式事件日志(Event Log)和沙箱化持久Python内核支撑。内核跨模型调用维护类型化命名空间，工具输出、检索历史和派生状态绑定到变量而非序列化进提示。模型编写的代码通过exec搜索、物化和转换会话状态，仅显式打印的投影进入模型的下一轮工作视图。当工作视图接近预算，陈旧片段被驱逐但通过驱逐索引保留可恢复的压缩地标，指向精确的事件日志地址。
AI.result: 以Qwen3.8-Max为骨干，Scroll在LongMemEval_S上达94.8%，在BEAM_10M上达73.1%（超过最佳已发布记忆系统5.1分），在LOCA_256K上达86.7%（超过最佳已发布长期任务智能体37.4分）。
AI.conclusion: 将上下文管理转化为编程任务可继承LLM不断提升的编码能力，同时事件日志保留无损的历史真值；驱逐索引使代理能直接导航到驱逐区域，而不是搜索完整日志，实现高效且可恢复的长期上下文管理。

title: Semantic Slots for Video Object-Centric Learning
summary: Video Object-Centric Learning (OCL) has traditionally focused on refining the encoder architecture to ensure temporal consistency. In this paper, we argue that the primary bottleneck lies in the decoder. We show that traditional decoders force slots to be spatially anchored, hindering their ability to adapt to motion. We propose SemanticSlots, which uses a Transformer-based decoder that leverages image context, relieving slots from encoding boundary precision and spatial location. This allows slots to function as semantic queries that are inherently object position invariant, retrieving matching features rather than memorizing coordinates. More importantly, this property allows slots computed from a single frame to decompose subsequent video frames, eliminating the need for complex temporal predictors or auxiliary temporal losses. Results on YouTube-VIS show that SemanticSlots improves upon VideoSAUR by 31 points in mBO and outperforms current state-of-the-art methods by 21 points, achieving 86.6% ARI and 62.8% mBO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SemanticSlots方法，指出视频目标中心学习（OCL）的主要瓶颈在于解码器而非编码器。传统解码器迫使slot空间锚定，限制了其对运动的适应。SemanticSlots采用基于Transformer的解码器，利用图像上下文使slot成为语义查询，具有位置不变性，能用单帧计算的slot分解后续帧，无需复杂的时间预测器。在YouTube-VIS上较VideoSAUR提升31点mBO，超过SOTA方法21点，达到86.6% ARI和62.8% mBO。
AI.motivation: 传统视频OCL方法专注于改进编码器来确保时间一致性，但作者论证真正的瓶颈在于解码器。传统解码器使slot空间锚定，妨碍其适应运动，因此需要引入一种新的解码机制来解除这一限制。
AI.method: 提出SemanticSlots方法，核心是采用Transformer解码器利用图像上下文，使slot不再承担边界精度和空间位置的编码负担，从而作为语义查询工作，天然具备目标位置不变性，通过检索匹配特征而非记忆坐标来实现分解。单帧slot即可用于分解后续视频帧，免去复杂的时间预测器或辅助时间损失。
AI.result: 在YouTube-VIS数据集上，SemanticSlots相比VideoSAUR提升31点mBO，超过当前最先进方法21点，达到86.6% ARI和62.8% mBO。
AI.conclusion: 解码器架构是视频目标中心学习的关键瓶颈，通过让slot从空间编码中解放出来成为语义查询，可以大幅简化时间建模并显著提升性能。

title: In-Situ Reconstruction of the International Space Station Using 3D Gaussian Splatting and Astrobee
summary: This article presents a novel 3D reconstruction and mapping of the interior of the International Space Station (ISS) using 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). Using existing grayscale images from the Astrobee free-flying robot dataset, we construct a full 3D splat of the ISS' Kibō or Japanese Experiment Module (JEM). 3DGS has in recent years shown promise in providing novel view synthesis of scenes captured from many images or videos, this article applies this approach to human spaceflight systems. We compare our 3DGS architecture to existing methods such as Nerfacto and TensoRF and show that reconstruction improves the state-of-the-art in both scene quality and rendering speed. We show that with as little as 500 in-situ images, a high-fidelity map can be constructed using Astrobee's Navigation Camera (NavCam) during free-flight in the JEM. These reconstructions could enable free-flyers to rapidly create and update interior maps for intra-vehicular habitats like the ISS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）技术，基于Astrobee自由飞行机器人的灰度图像数据集，构建国际空间站（ISS）日本实验舱（JEM）内部的高保真三维重建与地图。与Nerfacto和TensoRF等现有方法相比，3DGS在场景质量和渲染速度上均实现了最先进的性能，仅需500张在轨图像即可完成高保真地图构建。
AI.motivation: 自由飞行机器人在国际空间站等舱内环境中需要快速、准确地构建和更新内部地图，以实现自主导航和任务执行。现有的3D重建方法在场景质量和渲染速度方面仍有不足，且尚未充分探索如何将新兴的3DGS技术应用于人类航天系统。
AI.method: 采用3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）架构，利用Astrobee机器人数据集中的现有灰度NavCam图像，对ISS的Kibō/JEM模块进行全三维高斯斑点重建，并与Nerfacto和TensoRF等基线方法进行对比评估。
AI.result: 实验表明3DGS在场景重建质量和渲染速度两方面均优于Nerfacto和TensoRF等现有方法；仅需约500张在轨图像即可利用Astrobee的NavCam在JEM内自由飞行时构建高保真地图。
AI.conclusion: 3DGS技术能够为舱内自由飞行器提供快速、高保真的空间站内部地图构建与更新能力，有望支持未来Intra-Vehicular任务中的自主导航与态势感知。

title: From Association to Causation: Improving Retrieval Precision of Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Causal Relations and an Attention Mechanism
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables, 1 algorithm. Code available at https://github.com/Silk-Road/causal-rag-rerank
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds LLM generation on retrieved documents, but the standard terminal retrieval stage--dense-vector similarity, optionally followed by reranking--often returns documents that share keywords with the query without containing the needed information, a failure mode that grows with the knowledge base. We trace it to a conceptual gap: similarity captures only associational relations, whereas the documents that matter are linked to the query causally. We model the terminal retrieval stage with a causal graph grounded in Reichenbach's common cause principle: the keywords shared by the query and a retrieved document form a latent common cause A, and the document's residual keywords form a latent set B linking the document to the ideal output. Since a retrieved document is a collider (A -> d <- B), retrieval itself opens an associational path between the query and B, which licenses a training-free, attention-style re-scoring rule: the cosine similarity between the query embedding and the weighted centroid embedding of B. Unlike causality-enhanced RAG variants that model causal relations inside the knowledge content, our graph models the causal structure of the retrieval process itself. On a real 471-document enterprise knowledge base, the method promotes a relevant guideline from rank 6 to the top 3; on a controlled diagnostic corpus reproducing the keyword-stuffing regime, it improves the mean target rank from 2.88 to 1.25, while a trained cross-encoder reranker barely helps (2.63). Conversely, on three BEIR benchmarks the score underperforms the similarity baseline, delineating the applicability boundary: the method guards the keyword-stuffing regime of growing proprietary knowledge bases and complements neural rerankers; a corpus-level calibration gate selects the correct regime with >= 95% reliability. A fully local testbed demonstrates deployability.

AI.tldr: 本文指出RAG终端检索阶段（稠密向量相似度+重排）存在"关键词匹配但信息缺失"的失效模式，将其归因于相似度只捕捉联想关系而非因果关系的概念缺口。作者用因果图（基于Reichenbach共因原理）建模检索过程，将检索文档视为collider，并提出一种无需训练的注意力式重打分规则（利用查询嵌入与B的加权质心嵌入的余弦相似度）。实验表明该方法在关键词填充（keyword-stuffing）场景下显著优于基线（目标排名从2.88提升至1.25），并与神经网络重排器互补；但在BEIR标准基准上不如相似度基线，适用边界通过语料库级校准门控（≥95%可靠性）确定。
AI.motivation: 标准RAG检索（稠密向量相似度+可选重排）常返回与查询共享关键词但不含所需信息的文档，且该失效模式随知识库规模增长而加剧。作者将原因追溯为概念性缺口：相似度只捕捉联想关系（associational），而真正有用的文档与查询之间存在因果关系（causal）。
AI.method: 1) 用Reichenbach共因原则构建因果图：查询与检索文档共享的关键词构成潜在共因A，文档的残差关键词构成潜在集合B，检索文档是collider（A→d←B）；2) 检索本身打开了查询与B之间的联想路径，由此导出无需训练的注意力式重打分规则：查询嵌入与B的加权质心嵌入的余弦相似度；3) 该图建模的是检索过程的因果结构，而非知识内容内部的因果关系（区别于现有因果增强RAG变体）；4) 提出语料库级校准门控（calibration gate）来选择适用场景。
AI.result: 在471篇文档的企业知识库上将相关指南从第6名提升至前3名；在复现关键词填充体制的诊断语料上，目标平均排名从2.88提升至1.25，而训练过的cross-encoder重排器仅提升至2.63；但在三个BEIR基准上表现不如相似度基线；语料库级校准门控以≥95%的可靠性选择正确体制；提出完全本地化的测试平台验证了可部署性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法专门守护增长中的专有知识库的关键词填充失效体制，与神经重排器互补而非替代；适用边界（BEIR上退化）由校准门控明确划出，强调了根据语料库特性选择检索策略的重要性。

title: SketchFlow: Zero-Shot Vector Sketch Generation via GMM Prior Flow in CLIP Latent Space
comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Conference Papers. 16 pages
summary: Vector sketches remain one of the most concise and immediate mediums for abstract human expression. However, generating high-quality vector strokes that exhibit human-like drawing styles remains an open challenge due to the severe scarcity of fine-grained, high-quality text-to-sketch paired data. Existing text-conditioned generation methods often rely on unstable, time-consuming optimization or struggle to generalize to unseen categories in a zero-shot manner. To address these limitations, we present SketchFlow, a novel generative framework rooted in Optimal Transport (OT) theory and flow matching. By leveraging pre-trained CLIP models to bypass labor-intensive image-level text annotations, we formulate cross-modal alignment as a continuous mapping problem directly within the CLIP latent space. To bridge the inevitable modality gap between discrete text concepts and continuous sketch features, we first inject noise into discrete category embeddings to construct a continuous Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) prior. We then utilize an Optimal Transport Conditional Flow Matching (OT-CFM) model to learn a deterministic vector field mapping from this continuous GMM prior to the target sketch feature distribution. Finally, a Hybrid Diffusion Decoder, fusing 1D U-Net and Transformer architectures, is designed to decode these features into fast and high-fidelity stroke trajectories. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SketchFlow substantially outperforms existing baselines in visual quality and adherence to natural human drawing styles. Furthermore, our geometry-preserving framework demonstrates promising local zero-shot synthesis for prompts beyond the QuickDraw training vocabulary, including unseen concept labels and semantic modifiers, while enabling smooth, continuous semantic interpolation between distinct concepts. Source code is available at: https://github.com/QiuHong-1202/SketchFlow.

AI.tldr: SketchFlow是一个基于最优传输理论和流匹配的新型生成框架，用于高质量矢量草图生成。它利用预训练CLIP模型在潜在空间中进行跨模态对齐，通过高斯混合模型先验和OT-CFM模型学习向量场映射，并使用混合扩散解码器将特征解码为笔画轨迹，在视觉质量和人类绘图风格遵循方面显著优于现有基线，并支持零样本合成和语义插值。
AI.motivation: 矢量草图是简洁直观的人类抽象表达媒介，但生成具有人类绘图风格的高质量矢量笔画仍面临挑战，主要原因是细粒度、高质量的文本-草图配对数据严重稀缺。现有文本条件生成方法要么依赖不稳定且耗时的优化过程，要么难以在零样本场景下泛化到未见类别。
AI.method: 1) 利用预训练CLIP模型在CLIP潜在空间中直接进行跨模态对齐，避免人工图像级文本标注；2) 将噪声注入离散类别嵌入以构建连续GMM先验，弥合文本和草图特征之间的模态鸿沟；3) 使用OT-CFM模型学习从GMM先验到目标草图特征分布的确定性向量场映射；4) 设计混合扩散解码器（融合1D U-Net和Transformer架构）将特征解码为快速且高保真的笔画轨迹。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SketchFlow在视觉质量和人类自然绘图风格遵循方面显著优于现有基线。该框架支持超出QuickDraw训练词汇的提示的局部零样本合成（包括未见概念标签和语义修饰符），并能实现不同概念之间平滑、连续的语义插值。
AI.conclusion: SketchFlow通过OT理论与流匹配的结合，有效解决了文本-草图数据稀缺和跨模态对齐的难题，提供了一种几何保持的生成框架，兼具高质量生成能力和零样本泛化能力。

title: Towards insect-like distributed proprioception in actuators and appendages for flapping-wing insect-scale aerial robots
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, this work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Modern flapping-wing insect-scale air vehicles display agility similar to that of their insect counterparts; however, these impressive maneuvers are only possible with off-board sensors like optical tracking cameras. In this manuscript, we introduce two embedded proprioceptive sensors for insect-scale aerial robots: thin film piezoelectric polymers integrated directly into a driving actuator and a pitching hinge which track stroke and pitch angle, respectively. We fabricate the aforementioned size-agnostic mechanically intelligent structures (sensor-actuator, sensor-flexure) using laminate stack fabrication methods. Chirp experiments with our sensors integrated into an insect-size flapping-wing robot show accurate tracking of stroke (RMSE = 0.44 deg) and pitch (RMSE = 2.44 deg) angles in the relevant frequency range. As the first step towards demonstrating the utility of these sensors for enabling numerous onboard autonomy applications, including closed-loop wingbeat control and sensor fusion with existing insect-scale sensor suites for more accurate proprioception and localization, we show one application for each sensor. The proprioceptive hinge enables collision detection, reducing the chance of permanent damage if the robot's wing collides with an object. The proprioceptive actuator enables asynchronous flapping, which is hypothesized to increase adaptability and efficiency in insects and robots alike. A microrobot equipped with our proprioceptive actuator allows us to test these hypotheses with potential for improving flapping aerial robot performance. We foresee proprioceptive sensors having an important role in progressing both the fields of insect-scale aerial robots and robo-physics due to the bio-inspired nature and high integration level of our sensors.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了两种嵌入式的本体感觉传感器（压电薄膜传感器-致动器和传感器-柔性铰链），用于昆虫尺度扑翼飞行机器人，能够分别追踪扑动角和俯仰角，精度分别达到RMSE 0.44度和2.44度。该传感器还展示了碰撞检测和异步扑动等应用。
AI.motivation: 现代昆虫尺度的扑翼飞行器虽然展现出与昆虫相似的敏捷性，但依赖外部传感器（如光学追踪相机）来实现这些动作。为了实现在机自主应用，需要嵌入式的本体感觉传感器。
AI.method: 利用层压堆叠制造方法，将薄膜压电聚合物直接集成到驱动致动器和俯仰铰链中，构建尺寸无关的机械智能结构（传感器-致动器、传感器-柔性铰链）。通过啁啾实验验证传感器在相关频率范围内对扑动角和俯仰角的准确追踪。
AI.result: 传感器集成到昆虫大小扑翼机器人后，扑动角追踪RMSE为0.44度，俯仰角追踪RMSE为2.44度。传感器实现了碰撞检测和异步扑动两种应用。
AI.conclusion: 这些本体感觉传感器由于仿生特性和高集成度，有望在昆虫尺度飞行机器人及机器人物理（robo-physics）领域发挥重要作用，推动闭环扑翼控制和传感器融合等自主应用的发展。

title: ATHENA: Knowledge-guided agentic neural architecture search for AutoFormer-based electronic health record modeling
summary: Transformer-based models are widely used for clinical prediction from electronic health records (EHRs), yet their architectures still require substantial manual tuning, and the optimal configuration may vary across tasks and hospitals. Neural architecture search (NAS) automates architecture design, but conventional methods are computationally costly for Transformer-based EHR models. Recent large language model (LLM)-guided NAS methods reduce manual search design but typically conduct each search independently, without reusing architecture knowledge across hospitals. In this study, we propose ATHENA (Agentic Transfer across Hospitals for EHR Neural Architecture Search), a knowledge-guided agentic NAS framework for Transformer-based EHR modeling. ATHENA uses a weight-sharing supernet that is pretrained once per hospital, allowing candidate architectures to be instantiated as inherited subnetworks and evaluated through fine-tuning rather than independent pretraining. It also incorporates a two-layer cross-hospital architecture prior. The first layer retrieves high-performing architecture examples from source sites based on task descriptors, while the second estimates the effects of architectural components using SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP)-based meta-regression. These priors guide a multi-agent LLM search together with validation feedback from the target hospital. Across six clinical prediction tasks and two independent health systems, ATHENA matches or outperforms four NAS baselines in 9 of 12 hospital-task evaluations at a search budget of 30. It also shows more consistent architecture selection across repeated searches. ATHENA provides a practical approach for reducing manual architecture tuning in Transformer-based EHR modeling. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/GatorAIM/ATHENA.

AI.tldr: 提出ATHENA框架，一种知识引导的代理式神经架构搜索（NAS）方法，用于Transformer-based电子健康记录（EHR）建模。通过权重共享超级网络实现跨医院架构知识迁移，利用两层跨医院架构先验（检索高绩效架构示例+SHAP元回归估计组件效果）引导多代理LLM搜索，在六个临床预测任务和两个独立医疗系统中匹配或超越四个NAS基线。
AI.motivation: Transformer-based EHR模型的架构需要大量手动调参，且最优配置因任务和医院而异。传统NAS方法对Transformer模型计算成本过高，而现有LLM引导的NAS方法每次搜索独立进行，没有复用跨医院的架构知识，导致资源浪费且搜索效率低。
AI.method: ATHENA包含三个核心组件：(1)权重共享超级网络（每个医院预训练一次），候选架构作为继承子网络通过微调评估而非独立预训练；(2)两层跨医院架构先验：第一层基于任务描述符从源医院检索高绩效架构示例，第二层使用SHAP元回归估计架构组件的影响；(3)多代理LLM搜索，结合这些先验和目标医院的验证反馈进行架构搜索。
AI.result: 在六个临床预测任务和两个独立医疗系统的12个医院-任务评估中，ATHENA在9个场景匹配或超越了4个NAS基线（搜索预算为30）。同时，ATHENA在重复搜索中展现出更一致的架构选择，表明其搜索稳定性更好。
AI.conclusion: ATHENA为Transformer-based EHR建模提供了一种实用的方法，通过跨医院知识迁移和知识引导的代理式搜索，有效减少了手动架构调优的需求，同时提升了搜索效率和稳定性。代码已公开。

title: Emotion Intensity Matters: Generating Realistic Expressions in Virtual Humans with CVAEs
summary: Generating expressive facial behavior in virtual humans (VHs) remains a central challenge in affective computing and character animation. This paper presents a novel approach based on Conditional Variational Autoencoders (CVAEs), trained on real human facial expression data, to synthesize controllable emotional expressions at varying intensities. Using a dataset comprising six basic emotions represented at two intensity levels (low and high), we train a CVAE model to generate synthetic facial expression data while preserving semantic consistency with real human expressions. Despite the limited amount of training data (only 7,680 facial expression samples), the proposed approach learns meaningful latent representations and generates coherent emotional variations. Our method enables control over emotional intensity, making it suitable for animating virtual characters without requiring actor performances or manual artistic intervention. Our research aimed to evaluate whether the method (CVAE) preserves the characteristics associated with the different intensity levels present in the dataset. Results show that the proposed model preserves key expressive characteristics across intensity levels while supporting generalization across emotional intensity levels, contributing to the creation of emotionally expressive virtual characters from relatively small datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于条件变分自编码器（CVAE）的方法，利用真实人类面部表情数据生成可控强度的虚拟人面部表情。仅用7,680个表情样本（六种基本情绪×两种强度级别），该方法即可学习有意义的潜在表征并生成连贯的情绪变化，无需演员表演或人工干预。
AI.motivation: 在虚拟人中生成富有表现力的面部行为仍是情感计算和角色动画领域的核心挑战。作者旨在解决传统方法依赖演员表演或人工艺术干预的问题，希望从相对小型的数据集中实现可控情绪的合成。
AI.method: 采用条件变分自编码器（CVAE），在包含六种基本情绪、两种强度级别（低和高）的真实人类面部表情数据集上训练。CVAE学习条件潜在表征，能够以情绪类型和强度为条件生成面部表情，实现情绪强度的可控调节。
AI.result: 尽管训练数据有限（仅7,680个样本），模型仍能学习有意义的潜在表征并生成连贯的情绪变化。实验结果表明该方法在不同强度级别间保持了关键的表情特征，并支持跨情绪强度的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: CVAE方法能够从相对小型的数据集中生成具有情绪表现力的虚拟角色表情，有效保留不同强度级别的表情特征，为情感计算和角色动画提供了一种无需演员和人工干预的可行方案。

title: Safety-Critical Bilateral Teleoperation for Omnidirectional Aerial Manipulation Using Force-Sensorless Haptic Feedback
comment: 8 pages, 10 figures. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: This paper presents a safety-critical bilateral teleoperation framework for omnidirectional aerial manipulators that integrates visual and force-sensorless haptic wrench feedback. Unlike existing approaches that either rely on onboard force/torque sensors or use model-dependent wrench estimates, which may become unreliable under model uncertainties or induce unintended feedback during free-flight, our method implements a hierarchical safety filter based on control barrier functions to avoid such limitations. The safety filter, being the key contribution, explicitly accounts for tracking errors arising from physical interaction between the aerial manipulator and its surroundings while enforcing thrust limits, a factor overlooked despite its critical importance for flight safety. This safety filter adjusts the command from the operator to ensure safe and stable aerial manipulation and avoid motor saturation. The adjustment made by the filter is mapped to haptic feedback, which is intuitive to the operator and conveys information on physical interaction and impending motor saturation. By actual experiments with a hexarotor-based omnidirectional aerial manipulator, we demonstrate that the proposed method avoids haptic feedback during free-flight, provides directionally consistent feedback under physical interaction, and can be operated for diverse manipulative tasks. Moreover, an ablation study further shows that the saturation filter improves interaction stability by explicitly preventing motor saturation and informing the operator of corrective actions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于全向空中机械臂的安全关键双边遥操作框架，集成了视觉和无力传感器触觉反馈。核心贡献是基于控制屏障函数的分层安全滤波器，它明确考虑物理交互引起的跟踪误差并强制执行推力限制，将滤波器调整映射为直观的触觉反馈。实验证明该方法在自由飞行时避免触觉反馈，交互时提供方向一致的反馈，并通过消融研究验证了饱和滤波器对交互稳定性的提升。
AI.motivation: 现有空中机械臂遥操作方案要么依赖机载力/扭矩传感器，要么使用依赖模型的力估计，这些方法在模型不确定下不可靠，或在自由飞行中诱导意外反馈。此外，物理交互产生的跟踪误差被忽视，而这对于飞行安全至关重要。
AI.method: 提出分层安全滤波器（基于控制屏障函数），显式考虑空中机械臂与周围环境物理交互引起的跟踪误差，同时强制执行推力限制以避免电机饱和。滤波器的命令调整被映射为触觉反馈，向操作者传达物理交互和即将发生的电机饱和信息。
AI.result: 通过六旋翼全向空中机械臂实际实验验证：方法在自由飞行中避免触觉反馈，物理交互下提供方向一致的反馈，可执行多种操作任务。消融实验表明饱和滤波器通过显式防止电机饱和并告知操作者纠正动作，改善了交互稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的安全滤波器框架实现了安全稳定的空中操作与直观触觉反馈，解决了现有方法依赖传感器或模型估计的局限性，为安全关键的双边遥操作空中机械臂系统提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Ask or Answer: A Decision Framework for Multi-Turn Health Misinformation Intervention
summary: Correcting health misinformation in dialogue requires more than producing a factual rebuttal: users differ in what they know, what they believe, and what they need to hear, so an effective intervention often depends on first asking the right clarifying question. Yet existing methods either respond immediately or probe indiscriminately, treating clarification as either unnecessary or always beneficial. We propose Reward-Optimized Probe-and-Respond (RO-PnR), a framework that learns when asking is worth its cost. At each turn, RO-PnR chooses between probing for more information and committing to a final correction, guided by a turn-level reward that weighs the expected gain from probing against its interaction cost. To capture how user heterogeneity affects probing value, we model each simulated user with a latent state along health literacy and belief commitment. Experiments show that RO-PnR achieves the highest cost-adjusted utility across three health-misinformation datasets and three base models, using 30% fewer turns than always-probe baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RO-PnR框架，用于在健康信息纠错对话中学习何时值得提问澄清。该框架通过回合级奖励权衡探询收益与交互成本，并对用户进行潜在状态建模（健康素养和信念承诺），实验表明在三个数据集上以更少轮次取得最高效用。
AI.motivation: 纠正健康错误信息不能仅靠事实性反驳，因为用户的知识水平、信念和需求各不相同。现有方法要么立即回应（忽略澄清的必要性），要么无条件探询（视澄清总是有益），两者都无法适应用户异质性，缺乏对"何时提问值得"的决策能力。
AI.method: 提出RO-PnR（Reward-Optimized Probe-and-Respond）框架：在每一轮中，模型在"继续探询获取更多信息"与"给出最终纠正"之间做选择，由回合级奖励函数驱动，该奖励权衡探询带来的预期信息增益与其交互成本。同时，通过潜在状态（健康素养与信念承诺）对模拟用户异质性进行建模，以捕捉不同用户的探询价值差异。
AI.result: 在三个健康错误信息数据集和三个基础模型上，RO-PnR取得了最高的成本调整后效用（cost-adjusted utility），并且相比总是探询的基线方法，减少了30%的对话轮次。
AI.conclusion: 证明"何时提问"与"如何回答"同样重要，自适应地决定是否探询能在降低交互成本的同时提升纠正效果，为对话式健康信息纠错提供了一种更高效、更个性化的策略框架。

title: StereoDiffuer: Diffusion-based Progressive Geometry Modeling with Saliency Attention Perception for Stereo Matching
comment: 17 pages, 9 figures, and 11 tables. Accepted by Signal Processing: Image Communication
summary: With the advance of deep neural networks, the quality of disparity maps obtained through stereo matching has steadily improved. However, existing stereo matching methods still struggle to preserve fine-grained geometric details, resulting in blurred edges and over-smoothed predictions in challenging regions. To address these limitations, we propose StereoDiffuer, an iterative diffusion-based stereo matching framework that explicitly models geometric details and progressively refines disparity estimates. The framework incorporates a Saliency Attention Perception (SAP) module to extract salient geometric cues, including object boundaries, thin structures, and sharp edges. Confidence-guided SAP features are combined with the initial disparity estimate to condition an iterative denoising diffusion process, which corrects residual disparity errors and restores geometric details suppressed during cost-volume regularization and upsampling. Experimental results on the Scene Flow and KITTI benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework and its competitive performance relative to the compared stereo matching methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StereoDiffuser，一个基于迭代扩散的立体匹配框架，通过显式建模几何细节并渐进式细化视差估计，解决现有立体匹配方法在边缘模糊和过度平滑方面的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有立体匹配方法虽然在深度神经网络推动下视差图质量不断提升，但在保留细粒度几何细节方面仍存在不足，导致在挑战性区域出现边缘模糊和过度平滑的预测结果。
AI.method: 提出StereoDiffuser框架，包含三个关键组件：(1) 显著性注意力感知(SAP)模块，提取物体边界、薄结构和尖锐边缘等显著性几何线索；(2) 置信度引导的SAP特征与初始视差估计结合；(3) 迭代去噪扩散过程，修正残差视差误差并恢复在代价体正则化和上采样过程中被抑制的几何细节。
AI.result: 在Scene Flow和KITTI基准上的实验结果表明，所提出的框架是有效的，并且相对于比较的立体匹配方法具有有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于扩散的迭代细化框架能够有效地保留和恢复立体匹配中的几何细节，为改善视差图的边缘质量提供了一种新思路。

title: CounterAlign: Counterfactual Supervision for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are typically trained with behavior cloning (BC) on expert demonstrations. However, BC provides only positive supervision for expert actions, without explicit negative supervision indicating which actions are instruction-inconsistent or otherwise inappropriate. Reinforcement learning (RL) can provide such corrective signals, but often relies on externally specified rewards or curated non-expert data, both of which are costly to obtain in robotics. We show that offline RL for VLA models need not rely on curated non-expert trajectories: successful expert demonstrations alone can be transformed into dense corrective supervision through instruction relabeling. Specifically, by pairing expert actions with mismatched alternative instructions, we synthesize counterfactual instruction-observation-action tuples from the dataset and combine them with adversarial discriminator training to learn an instruction-grounded reward model for offline RL, without collecting additional rollouts or annotations. On the robustness-focused LIBERO-PRO benchmark, our method improves robustness to object position and task perturbations over a strong state-of-the-art baseline. It also outperforms competitive baselines in real-robot experiments on the TX-G2 (compatible with AGIBot G2). More broadly, our results suggest that, for data-constrained VLA learning, extracting denser supervision from each demonstration can complement collecting additional data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需额外数据或标注的离线强化学习方法，通过指令重标注（instruction relabeling）将专家示范转化为密集的纠正性监督信号，配合对抗判别器训练学习指令导向的奖励模型，从而提升VLA模型在任务扰动下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: VLA模型通常使用行为克隆训练，但BC只提供正向监督（专家动作），缺乏负向监督（哪些动作与指令不一致或不恰当）。强化学习虽能提供纠正信号，但依赖外部奖励或精心筛选的非专家数据，在机器人领域获取成本高昂。因此需要一种不依赖额外数据来源的离线RL方法。
AI.method: 1) 通过将专家动作与不匹配的替代指令配对，从数据集中合成反事实的指令-观测-动作三元组，产生密集纠正性监督；2) 结合对抗判别器训练，学习一个指令导向（instruction-grounded）的奖励模型；3) 利用该奖励模型进行离线RL，无需收集额外rollouts或人工标注。
AI.result: 在鲁棒性评估基准LIBERO-PRO上，该方法在物体位置和任务扰动方面优于强state-of-the-art基线；在真实机器人TX-G2（兼容AGIBot G2）实验中，也优于多个竞争性基线。
AI.conclusion: 在数据受限的VLA学习场景中，从每个示范中提取更密集的监督信号可以作为采集更多数据的有效补充，为VLA模型提供纠正性反馈而不依赖昂贵的外部资源。

title: ECHO: A Cognitively Inspired, Auditable Memory Plane for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Long-horizon agents need memory that identifies relevant experience, resolves revisions, and exposes checkable provenance. We present ECHO (Embodied Context and History Orchestration), an auditable memory architecture and service prototype inspired by episodic encoding, consolidation, contextual reinstatement, reconsolidation, and executive control. This is functional inspiration, not neural equivalence; the empirical analysis focuses on retrieval and context construction. Development runs reach 96.29% Hit@10 and 73.64% turn Recall@5 on 1,536 LoCoMo category 1-4 questions, and 97.60% Hit@10, 88.84% turn Recall@5, and 88.71% session Recall@5 on all 500 LongMemEval-S questions. A five-history BEAM gate fails, and in a separate matched 91-question QA sample Mem0 OSS scores 64.84% versus ECHO's 41.76% (exact McNemar p = 0.00107), with a history-cluster interval crossing zero. A post-hoc audit found source-specific phrases in the query-expansion rules. Although no gold answer field entered the runtime, expansion-enabled retrieval scores are therefore descriptive development measurements, not independent confirmation.

AI.tldr: ECHO是一种可审计的记忆架构与服务原型，受情景编码、巩固、情境重述、再巩固和执行控制等认知机制启发（功能性启发而非神经对等），用于长时程智能体记忆管理。实验在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上取得较高检索指标，但存在数据污染问题，因查询扩展规则中发现了源文本特定短语，因此结果是开发性描述测量而非独立验证。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体需要记忆系统来识别相关经验、处理修订、并暴露可检验的来源。现有方法缺乏可审计性，无法在需要时追溯信息来源。
AI.method: 提出ECHO（Embodied Context and History Orchestration）记忆架构，借用情景编码、巩固、情境重述、再巩固和执行控制的认知概念（功能性启发，非神经等价），重点分析检索与上下文构建。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo 1,536个类别1-4问题上达到96.29% Hit@10和73.64% turn Recall@5；在LongMemEval-S全部500问题上达到97.60% Hit@10、88.84% turn Recall@5和88.71% session Recall@5。五历史BEAM门控失败；在91题配对样本中Mem0 OSS得分64.84%优于ECHO的41.76%（精确McNemar p=0.00107）。事后审计发现查询扩展规则包含源特定短语，检索结果被污染。
AI.conclusion: 尽管ECHO在检索指标上表现良好，但审计发现查询扩展规则中存在源文本特定短语，虽然没有金标准答案进入运行时，但扩展启用的检索分数只能视为开发性描述测量，不能作为独立验证。标准BEAM门控失败，且与Mem0对比实验中ECHO实际表现更差，结果需谨慎解读。

title: The Plan, Not the Decoder: Diagnosing and Repairing Compositional Failure in Reasoning-Augmented Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Reasoning-augmented text-to-image models such as GoT-R1 emit an explicit textual plan - object names, attributes, and bounding boxes - before generating image tokens. When such a model fails a compositional prompt, is the plan wrong, or is the plan right and the decoder unfaithful? Because the plan is machine-readable it can be edited before decoding, which makes the two separable. We first validate the ruler. Swapping the two bounding boxes inside the model's own chain demonstrably flips the generated layout: detector-based accuracy falls 0.75 -> 0.48 (p<1e-3), while a widely used VQA-based spatial metric rises. A five-rater human study agrees with the detector on 81% of items and with the VQA judge on 57%. All spatial results therefore use geometric scoring. Under sound measurement the decoder is a faithful executor: 94% of generated layouts realize the planned relation, and object-box binding survives reordering of the plan's object segments. The planner is the bottleneck. It writes wrong relations for phrasing-dependent reasons - 98% accuracy on "left" against 54% on "right" for semantically identical layouts, a raster-order bias we isolate with a mention-order control - and cluttered geometry that the decoder faithfully reproduces. Editing the plan therefore fixes the image without retraining: symbolic verification with resampling gives +5.0 points (p<1e-3), minimal in-place repair +6.0 (p=.02), rewriting only box geometry +10.7 (p<1e-4), and replacing the plan outright +13.3 (p=1e-4). Gains are indifferent to the plan's prose style and to its likelihood under the planner, but not to its geometry. Modular planner-decoder designs are therefore viable, provided the plan is internally consistent: box-text contradictions induce object duplication and identity fusion. We release the plan-fidelity evaluation protocol, all plans, and 12k generated images.

AI.tldr: 本文研究推理增强的文本到图像模型（如GoT-R1）在组合提示失败时，问题在于规划器（planner）还是解码器（decoder）。通过可编辑的机器可读计划，作者分离了两者，发现解码器是忠实的执行者（94%布局符合计划关系），真正的瓶颈是规划器——它在"右"等短语上准确率仅54%（对比"左"的98%），存在光栅序偏差。通过编辑计划而非重新训练即可修复图像，最高可提升+13.3分。
AI.motivation: 推理增强的文本到图像模型会先生成显式文本计划（对象名、属性、边界框）再生成图像。当此类模型在组合提示上失败时，无法确定是计划错误还是解码器不忠实地执行了正确的计划。由于计划可被机器读取和编辑，作者希望分离这两个环节，以定位真正的瓶颈并探索无需重新训练的性能改进途径。
AI.method: 作者通过编辑计划（交换边界框、重排对象段等）将计划错误与解码器不忠实分离。首先验证评估工具（检测器与VQA指标的可信度），然后通过符号验证、最小原地修复、仅改写框几何、直接替换计划等策略进行计划编辑修复，同时控制计划的散文风格和似然度等变量。
AI.result: 检测器评估比VQA更可靠（人类与检测器一致率81%，与VQA仅57%）。解码器忠实执行计划（94%布局实现计划关系）。规划器是瓶颈：'右'方向准确率仅54%（'左'为98%），存在光栅序偏差。计划编辑修复图像有效：符号验证+5.0、最小修复+6.0、改写几何+10.7、整体替换计划+13.3，增益取决于几何而非风格或似然度。
AI.conclusion: 模块化规划器-解码器设计是可行的，前提是计划内部一致（框-文本矛盾会导致对象重复和身份融合）。规划器-解码器两环节可分离分析，瓶颈在规划器，且可通过计划编辑规避重新训练成本。作者发布了计划保真度评估协议、所有计划和12k张生成图像。

title: Vision Guided Target Conditioned Control for Autonomous Excavation
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at ISCSIC 2026
summary: Autonomous excavation requires an intelligent control system that can convert spatial work intent into coordinated bucket motion under contact-rich soil interaction. This paper presents a target-conditioned intelligent control framework for autonomous excavation in a physics-based deformable-soil simulation workflow. An image-aligned target mask serves as a visual spatial command for the desired digging region, while a mask-conditioned Action Chunking Transformer maps multi-view RGB observations, proprioception, and the target mask to temporally extended joystick commands. To reduce target-ignoring behavior, demonstrations are organized with paired-condition supervision, where the same or closely matched scene is demonstrated with different target masks and corresponding action chunks. The framework is evaluated through both a diagnostic manipulation task and an excavation simulation benchmark with single-scoop and sequential pile-clearing protocols. In manipulation, target success is 4\% for no-condition ACT, 63\% for non-paired mask-conditioned ACT, and 96\% for paired-condition mask-conditioned ACT. In sequential pile clearing, paired-condition mask-conditioned ACT removes 76.8\% of the pile versus 27.4\% and 15.7\% for the two baselines, with 91.0\% human-normalized efficiency. The results show that visual target conditioning, paired demonstration structure, and action-chunk control form a practical cyber-physical simulation pipeline for excavator automation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于目标条件化的智能控制框架，用于自主挖掘作业。通过图像对齐的目标掩码作为空间指令，结合掩码条件的Action Chunking Transformer（ACT），将多视角RGB观测、本体感知和目标掩码映射为时序扩展的操纵杆命令。通过配对条件监督（同一场景对应不同目标掩码和动作块）减少目标忽略行为，在物理变形土壤仿真中验证了该框架的有效性。
AI.motivation: 自主挖掘需要智能控制系统在接触丰富的土壤交互下将空间作业意图转化为协调的铲斗运动。现有方法在将视觉空间意图准确转化为挖掘动作方面存在不足，特别是容易出现目标忽略（target-ignoring）行为。
AI.method: 1) 提出目标条件化的挖掘控制框架，使用图像对齐的目标掩码作为视觉空间命令；2) 采用掩码条件化的Action Chunking Transformer（ACT）将多视角RGB、本体感知和目标掩码映射为时序扩展的操纵杆命令；3) 设计配对条件监督（paired-condition supervision）的演示组织方式，即在同一或近似场景下以不同目标掩码和对应动作块进行演示；4) 在物理仿真环境中对单铲和连续清桩协议进行评估。
AI.result: 在诊断操作任务中，目标成功率从无条件的ACT的4%，提升到非配对掩码条件ACT的63%，再到配对条件掩码条件ACT的96%。在连续清桩任务中，配对条件ACT能清除76.8%的桩堆，远超两个基线的27.4%和15.7%，且达到91.0%的人标准化效率。
AI.conclusion: 视觉目标条件化、配对演示结构和动作块控制三者结合，构成了一个实用的挖掘机自动化物理-信息仿真管线，显著提升了自主挖掘的目标跟随能力和作业效率。

title: What Does CLIP Learn for Regional Geolocalization? Probing Visual Cues and Scene Configuration After Adaptation
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Manuscript under review
summary: Large collections of street-view imagery provide rich visual information about urban environments, but extracting fine-grained geographic information from such data remains challenging. In particular, fine-grained regional geolocalization is challenging because nearby areas often share coarse geographic cues. We study regional geolocalization within a metropolitan area and ask whether pretrained CLIP features are sufficient for regional discrimination, and what visual information supports performance after adaptation. Using 9,085 street-view images from eight Greater Los Angeles regions, we compare zero-shot CLIP, frozen-encoder readouts, partial encoder updating, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), and full fine-tuning. Frozen readouts remain near the 39.03% zero-shot accuracy, whereas encoder adaptation achieves 75.94-82.10%. Full fine-tuning also reduces the mean distance to the predicted region center from 12.30 km to 3.86 km. We probe these gains through semantic cue removal, appearance reduction using edge maps and blur, and scene-configuration disruption using patch scrambling. Adapted models achieve higher edge and blur accuracy and switch 42.92-45.56% of predictions after scrambling, compared with 10.79-14.60% for frozen methods. However, adaptation does not improve the fraction of performance retained after appearance reduction, while vegetation and sky remain influential. A Caltech101 control further shows that scrambling sensitivity is not unique to geolocalization. Overall, encoder adaptation substantially improves nearby-region discrimination and is associated with greater sensitivity to intact scene configuration, without evidence that coarse structure alone becomes sufficient for prediction. These conclusions concern viewpoint variation near known locations rather than geographically disjoint generalization.

AI.tldr: 本研究探索利用街景图像进行都市区内细粒度区域地理定位。通过比较零样本CLIP、冻结编码器、部分编码器更新、LoRA和全微调五种方法在8个洛杉矶区域9085张图像上的表现，发现编码器自适应可显著提升准确率（75.94-82.10% vs 零样本39.03%），并减少预测中心距离。通过语义移除、外观简化和场景扰乱等探针实验，揭示自适应模型对完整场景配置的敏感性增强，但粗粒度结构本身不足以支撑预测。
AI.motivation: 大规模街景图像蕴含丰富的城市环境视觉信息，但从这些数据中提取细粒度地理信息仍具挑战。特别是都市区内相邻区域共享粗粒度地理线索，使得细粒度区域地理定位尤为困难。现有研究缺乏对预训练CLIP特征是否足以区分区域、以及何种视觉信息支撑自适应后性能的系统性探究。
AI.method: 使用9,085张来自大洛杉矶八个区域的街景图像，比较五种方法：零样本CLIP、冻结编码器读出、部分编码器更新、LoRA和全微调。通过三类探针实验——语义线索移除、边缘图和模糊的外观缩减、补丁打乱的场景配置破坏——来分析模型性能提升背后的视觉信息支撑。
AI.result: 冻结读出接近零样本准确率39.03%，而编码器自适应达到75.94-82.10%。全微调将预测区域中心平均距离从12.30 km降至3.86 km。自适应模型在边缘和模糊准确率上更高，补丁打乱后切换42.92-45.56%预测（冻结方法仅10.79-14.60%）。但自适应未改善外观缩减后的性能保留比例，植被和天空仍具影响力。Caltech101对照实验表明打乱敏感性并非地理定位特有。
AI.conclusion: 编码器自适应显著改善近邻区域区分能力，与对完整场景配置的更高敏感性相关，但无证据表明粗粒度结构本身足以支撑预测。这些结论涉及已知位置附近的视角变化，而非地理上不连续区域的泛化。

title: Calibrate What You SHIP: Post-Selection Risk Control for Verifier-Guided Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Verifier-guided text-to-image systems increasingly use test-time search to select, refine, or stop among multiple candidates, yet release thresholds are often calibrated on individual images. This creates a candidate-to-policy calibration mismatch: search changes both which prompts receive an output and which candidate is released, so candidate-level risk control need not imply control of released-output risk. We formalize this estimand shift through prompt reweighting and within-prompt selection, and introduce SHIP, Selection-aware Held-out calibration of Inference Policies. SHIP runs or replays the complete deployed policy on held-out prompts, evaluates the image it actually releases using an independent target judge, and selects the most permissive threshold whose risk upper bound satisfies a prescribed budget. For replayable policies with a prespecified threshold grid, simultaneous confidence control provides finite-sample validity. Experiments across fixed, sequential, and adaptive T2I inference procedures show that policy-level calibration recovers lower-risk operating points while exposing policy-dependent tradeoffs among risk, coverage, and compute. On GenEval2 with FLUX at N=16, a pooled-candidate threshold yields released risk 0.310, whereas SHIP reduces it to 0.162. Across 200 cached-stream splits, the fixed-grid certificate has no target crossing. Reliable inference-time scaling therefore requires calibrating the output distribution induced by the complete deployed policy.

AI.tldr: 本文针对验证器引导的文本到图像(T2I)系统中测试时间搜索的校准错配问题，提出SHIP方法——一种选择感知的留出校准方法，用于校准完整部署策略下实际输出图像的推理阈值，而非仅校准单张候选图像。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I系统在测试时通过搜索从多个候选中选择、精炼或停止，但释放阈值往往基于单张图像校准。然而搜索过程同时改变了哪些提示获得输出以及哪个候选被释放，导致候选级风险控制无法保证释放输出的风险控制，存在候选到策略的校准不匹配问题。
AI.method: SHIP方法通过在留出提示上运行或重放完整的部署策略，使用独立的靶标评判器评估实际释放的图像，并选择满足预定预算的最宽松风险上界阈值。对于可重放策略且预设阈值网格的情况，采用同步置信控制提供有限样本有效性保证。
AI.result: 在GenEval2基准上结合FLUX模型（N=16）的实验中，池化候选阈值产生释放风险0.310，而SHIP将其降至0.162。在200个缓存流拆分中，固定网格证书没有目标交叉。实验覆盖固定、顺序和自适应T2I推理流程，表明策略级校准能恢复更低风险的工作点并暴露策略相关的风险/覆盖率/计算量权衡。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的推理时扩展需要对完整部署策略所诱导的输出分布进行校准，而非仅对候选图像进行校准。SHIP证明了策略级校准在有限样本下是可行且有效的。

title: Vision-Guided Morphing Quadcopter for Multi-Geometry Payload Transport through Narrow Passages
summary: Aerial payload transport using multirotor unmanned aerial vehicles is challenging because payload geometry, contact interaction, grasp stability, flight control, and narrow-passage traversal are strongly coupled during pickup and transport. Object-specific grippers often cannot adapt their footprint or grasp geometry when the payload shape or passage width changes. This paper presents a vision-guided morphing quadcopter for multi-geometry payload transport through narrow passages. The proposed platform uses four hybrid arm-leg structures that function as both landing supports and grasping members. A centrally placed actuator drives a tendon-based morphing mechanism, enabling all four arms to synchronously retract or expand for object grasping, footprint reduction, and post-transport release. Onboard vision estimates the payload geometry and passage width, while endpoint force feedback is used to confirm grasp contact during payload engagement. A phase-wise mission planner, PID-based flight stabilization, and morphology-adaptive grasp controller are implemented in a MuJoCo simulation environment. The framework is evaluated using box, cylindrical, and spherical payloads, representing flat-faced, rolling-curved, and fully curved contact conditions. Across the three cases, the simulated system completes the pickup-transport-release sequence with a maximum RMS position error of 0.31 m, a final drop-zone error below 0.18 m, a compact grasp footprint of 0.09-0.21 m2, and a footprint reduction of 75.0-89.7 percent. The results demonstrate that a single-actuator morphing quadcopter can adapt its grasp footprint for the transport of payloads with different geometries while reducing its overall footprint for narrow-passage traversal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种视觉引导的可变形态四旋翼无人机，通过四组混合臂腿结构和单执行器肌腱驱动机构，实现多几何形状载荷的抓取、抓取足迹压缩及窄通道穿越运输。
AI.motivation: 传统多旋翼空运存在载荷几何、接触交互、抓取稳定性、飞行控制与窄通道穿越强耦合的挑战，而物体专用夹具无法适应载荷形状或通道宽度变化，亟需一种能自适应多几何载荷且能缩小机身足迹的空中运输平台。
AI.method: 提出一个四组混合臂腿机构（兼作起落架与抓取臂）的变体四旋翼平台；由中央单执行器驱动肌腱式变体机构，四臂同步收缩/展开以完成抓取、足迹缩小与释放；采用机载视觉估计载荷几何与通道宽度，末端力反馈确认抓取接触；在MuJoCo仿真环境中实现阶段式任务规划器、PID飞行稳定与形态自适应抓取控制器。
AI.result: 在箱体、圆柱和球体三种载荷（分别对应平面接触、滚动曲面接触和全曲面接触）的仿真中，系统均完成拾取-运输-释放全流程：最大RMS位置误差0.31 m、最终投放区误差低于0.18 m、抓取足迹为0.09-0.21 m²、足迹缩减率达75.0-89.7%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，单执行器变体四旋翼能够适应不同几何载荷的抓取足迹需求，同时通过缩减整体足迹实现窄通道穿越，验证了该框架在多几何载荷空中运输中的有效性与通用性。

title: Physics-Knowledge-Guided Hybrid Neural Learning for Arctic Sea Ice Concentration Evolution and Short-Range Prediction
summary: Accurate modeling of sea ice concentration (SIC) evolution is essential for polar climate assessment and short?range sea ice prediction. Numerical and data-driven approaches constitute major foundations for SIC modeling, but the former often require complex parameterizations and substantial compu?tation, whereas the latter rarely encode physical dependencies explicitly. This study presents the Physics-Informed Hybrid Ice Model (PIHIM), a differentiable data-driven hybrid ice model for daily SIC evolution that organizes its network structure according to the physical dependencies encoded in the sea ice continuity equation and explicitly accounts for dynamical transport, ther?modynamically driven areal growth and loss, and unresolved local processes. PIHIM preserves the representation capacity of deep learning while providing a process-decomposed formulation of ice displacement, freeze-melt areal change, and local error closure. Two evaluation settings are adopted: reanalysis-forced simulation examines SIC evolution stability under reanalysis forcing, and forecast-forced prediction assesses short-range performance un?der forecast-forced conditions, with reanalysis and observational SIC serving as verification references. Results indicate enhanced ice-edge preservation and error-growth control in reanalysis?forced simulation, while PIHIM retains measurable short-range prediction skill under forecast-forced conditions. Our code will be made publicly available after the paper is accepted.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PIHIM（物理信息混合冰模型），一种可微分的混合数据驱动模型，用于每日海冰浓度（SIC）演变建模。该模型根据海冰连续性方程中的物理依赖关系组织网络结构，显式考虑动力输运、热力学驱动的面积增长与损失，以及未解析的局地过程，在保持深度学习表示能力的同时提供过程分解的冰位移、冻融面积变化和局地误差闭合公式。
AI.motivation: 数值方法模拟SIC需要复杂参数化和大量计算，而数据驱动方法很少显式编码物理依赖关系。作者希望结合两者优势：既有物理可解释性和过程分解能力，又保持数据驱动的表示能力和预测技能。
AI.method: PIHIM是一个可微分的混合数据驱动模型，其网络结构根据海冰连续性方程中的物理依赖关系组织，显式建模三个组分：动力输运、热力学驱动面积变化（增长/损失）、未解析的局地过程。采用两种评估设置：再分析强迫模拟（检验SIC演变稳定性）和预报强迫预测（评估短期预测技能）。
AI.result: 在再分析强迫模拟中，PIHIM增强了冰边缘保持和误差增长控制；在预报强迫条件下，PIHIM保持了可测量的短期预测技能。
AI.conclusion: PIHIM成功将物理依赖关系嵌入数据驱动模型，在保持深度学习表示能力的同时提供过程分解的物理解释，在SIC模拟和短期预测中均表现良好。代码将在论文被接收后公开发布。

title: Fidelity-Diversity-Consistency (FDC): Data Pruning for Remote Sensing Change Detection
summary: Despite the success of data pruning (DP) in reducing training data sizes and improving downstream model performance in classification and segmentation tasks, its potential in remote sensing change detection remains unexplored. For the first time, we benchmark six representative DP methods across building- and forest-change datasets, CNN- and transformer-based models, and three pruning budgets, and show that existing baselines yield no reliable advantage over random selection. Notably, even the strongest evaluated baseline, Feature Diversity, is matched or exceeded by $\sim$33\% of randomly sampled subsets. To understand the underlying mechanism, we conduct a systematic regression study over 540 randomly sampled data subsets, characterizing each with four descriptors covering label statistics, image diversity, and feature-space geometry. Random Forest models show that \emph{change distribution fidelity} is the most prominent factor in determining the quality of change detection data subsets, a property absent from the existing pruning literature. Our analyses further show that pixel-wise image diversity and label-feature consistency are secondary factors. We translate these findings into Fidelity-Diversity-Consistency (FDC), a simple two-stage pruning method that shows consistent improvements over existing baselines across change detection benchmarks and backbones, especially at lower pruning ratios. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/ddydyd32/fidelity-diversity-consistency}{https://github.com/ddydyd32/fidelity-diversity-consistency}.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在遥感变化检测任务中系统性地基准测试了六种数据剪枝（DP）方法，发现现有方法相比随机采样并无可靠优势。通过对540个随机子集的回归分析，揭示了"变化分布保真度"是决定子集质量的最关键因素，并据此提出了FDC（保真度-多样性-一致性）两阶段剪枝方法，在多个基准和骨干网络上取得一致改进。
AI.motivation: 数据剪枝在分类和分割任务中已被证明能减少训练数据规模并提升模型性能，但该技术在遥感变化检测领域的潜力尚未被探索。作者希望填补这一空白，系统性地评估现有DP方法在该任务中的有效性，并深入理解影响变化检测数据子集质量的内在机制。
AI.method: 1) 基准测试：在建筑物和森林变化数据集上，对六种代表性DP方法进行跨CNN和Transformer骨干网络、三种剪枝预算的系统性评估。2) 回归分析：对540个随机数据子集进行系统回归研究，用四个描述符（标签统计、图像多样性、特征空间几何）刻画每个子集，训练随机森林模型识别影响子集质量的关键因素。3) 提出FDC方法：基于"变化分布保真度"为核心发现，结合像素级图像多样性和标签-特征一致性，设计两阶段剪枝方法。
AI.result: 1) 现有六种DP基线在变化检测中相比随机选择无可靠优势，最强基线Feature Diversity甚至被约33%的随机子集匹配或超越。2) 回归分析表明"变化分布保真度"是决定子集质量的最重要因素，像素级图像多样性和标签-特征一致性是次要因素。3) FDC方法在变化检测基准和骨干网络上较现有基线表现出一致改进，尤其在低剪枝比率下效果更显著。
AI.conclusion: 数据剪枝在遥感变化检测中不能简单套用分类/分割任务的现成方法。变化分布保真度是这一任务独有的关键剪枝准则，值得在未来的DP方法设计中重点考虑。FDC方法验证了将任务特定属性（变化分布保真度）融入剪枝策略的有效性。

title: An Interpretable Deep Learning Framework for Material Perception and Classification from Multisensory Tactile Data
summary: Human tactile perception relies on complex multisensory cues. Yet the relationship between tactile signals and perceptual representations remains poorly understood, limiting the integration of touch in digital environments and human-like robotic perception. To address this gap, we developed a computational framework comprising three interconnected deep learning models that map multisensory touch data to material perception, without relying on hand-crafted features. The models represent progressively different routes from tactile signals to material class: from low-level interaction signals to perceptual attribute distributions (Model 1), from predicted attribute distributions to material classification (Model 2), and directly from tactile signals to material categories, bypassing intermediate representations (Model 3). By combining deep learning with Integrated Gradients, the framework achieved high accuracy while offering interpretability, revealing which sensory modalities most strongly drive its decisions. Our results show that deep learning can approach near-perfect material classification when unconstrained by intermediate perceptual stages, but matching human-like performance is harder once those stages are modeled explicitly. Notably, thermal cues emerged as particularly informative across all models, providing robust signals for material differentiation. The results offer a computational account of how tactile signals lead to material perception and show how interpretable deep learning can both approach human-level performance and reveal cues that robotic and haptic systems need to incorporate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个由三个互联深度学习模型组成的计算框架，用于将多感官触觉数据映射到材质感知，无需手工特征。结合集成梯度方法实现高精度与可解释性，发现热觉线索在材质区分中最具信息量。
AI.motivation: 人类触觉感知依赖复杂的多感官线索，但触觉信号与感知表征之间的关系仍不清楚，限制了触觉在数字环境和类人机器人感知中的整合。现有方法缺乏对从触觉信号到材质感知整个过程的计算理解。
AI.method: 构建三个互连的深度学习模型，代表从触觉信号到材质类别的三条渐进路径：模型1从低层交互信号映射到感知属性分布；模型2从预测的属性分布进行材质分类；模型3直接从触觉信号到材质类别（跳过中间表征）。结合集成梯度（Integrated Gradients）方法增强可解释性。
AI.result: 深度学习在不受中间感知阶段约束时可达近乎完美的材质分类精度，但显式建模中间阶段后匹配人类表现更为困难。热觉线索在所有模型中均表现出最强的信息量，为材质区分提供了稳健信号。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了触觉信号如何导致材质感知的计算解释，展示了可解释深度学习既能接近人类水平表现，又能揭示机器人和触觉系统需要整合的关键线索。

title: HIRA: A Human-in-the-Loop Retrieval-Augmented Cascade for Document Classification in Regulated Industries
summary:
Document classification in regulated industries is constrained by data residency, limited cold-start labels, scarce review capacity, and costly model-governance procedures. We present HIRA, a training-free, on-premises retrieval-augmented cascade for document classification in regulated deployments that combines BM25 over OCR text, dense text embeddings, and image-level representations through validation-calibrated weighted reciprocal-rank fusion. Confident documents are classified directly by retrieval; uncertain or visually confusable documents are passed to a locally hosted LLM verifier, which receives the OCR text, retrieved exemplars, label descriptions, and confusion-specific terms. When the verifier remains uncertain, the document is sent to human review. Each correction is stored as a margin-weighted retrieval exemplar and updates a Dirichlet-smoothed confusion graph, letting the system improve without updating model weights.
  On a private 80-class trade-finance corpus, HIRA processes the full 30,233-document production stream while requesting human correction for only 1,945 documents (6.4%), improving Macro-F1 from 0.6218 to 0.8548. On the corrected Tobacco-3482 benchmark, HIRA reaches 0.9423 Macro-F1 with a locally hosted DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B verifier, 17.4 percentage points above the zero-shot LLM baseline, while invoking the verifier for only about 40% of documents and reducing LLM calls by approximately 60%. With 518 human corrections (24.8% of the pool), HIRA matches the fully labelled pool oracle, in which all 2,086 pool documents are indexed with their ground-truth labels. These results show that selective human feedback and retrieval-memory adaptation can be a practical alternative to repeated model retraining for long-tail document classification in regulated deployments.

AI.tldr: HIRA是一个训练-free、本地部署的检索增强级联系统，用于受监管行业的长尾文档分类。它结合BM25、稠密文本嵌入和图像级表征的加权倒数融合进行检索，将不确定文档级联到本地LLM验证器，最后才转人工审核。通过存储修正样本和更新混淆图实现无需重训练的系统改进，在80类贸易融资语料上Macro-F1从0.6218提升到0.8548，仅需6.4%文档人工修正。
AI.motivation: 受监管行业的文档分类面临数据驻留限制、冷启动标签稀缺、人工审核能力有限和模型治理成本高昂等约束，传统依赖反复模型重训练的方法在这些场景中不可行，需要一种无需训练即可持续改进的分类方案。
AI.method: 采用三阶段级联架构：(1) 置信文档直接通过检索分类（BM25+稠密文本嵌入+图像表征，经验证校准的加权倒数融合）；(2) 不确定文档交由本地托管LLM验证器，输入包括OCR文本、检索样例、标签描述和混淆特定术语；(3) 仍不确定的文档送人工审核。每次修正被存储为边际加权检索样例并更新Dirichlet平滑混淆图，实现无需更新模型权重的系统自我改进。
AI.result: 在私营80类贸易融资语料上，处理全部30,233篇文档仅需1,945次人工修正（6.4%），Macro-F1从0.6218提升至0.8548。在Tobacco-3482基准上达到0.9423 Macro-F1，比零样本LLM基线高17.4个百分点，仅对约40%文档调用验证器，减少约60% LLM调用。仅需518次人工修正（占池24.8%）即匹配全标注池预言机性能。
AI.conclusion: 选择性人工反馈与检索记忆自适应可作为受监管部署中长尾文档分类中反复模型重训练的实际替代方案，在满足数据驻留和治理约束的同时实现显著的分类性能提升和推理成本节约。

title: Learning to Look Again: Loss-Gap Supervision for Free-form Crop Routing in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) fail many detail-centric questions for a concrete reason: the answer is visible in the image, yet lost after the image is compressed into a low-resolution global view. Allocating more visual tokens to every query improves some OCR and document cases, but it spends computation indiscriminately and can disturb tasks that rely on global context. We propose GapSight, a framework for learning visual re-reading: a VLM first takes a global glance, then selectively returns to a free-form region when the question calls for local evidence. The supervision comes from the target model's own failure signal. Offline, we compare answer loss or multiple-choice option margin under a global-only view and candidate crop-augmented views; crops that improve the target answer become model-specific review labels. A lightweight free-form crop router distills these labels into a one-shot inference policy that predicts whether to review, expected utility, and a continuous crop box from the global state. Across LLaVA-1.5-7B, InternVL2.5-8B, and Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct, GapSight improves the Base no-zoom baseline on six benchmarks spanning OCR, documents, charts, infographics, VStarBench, and MME-RealWorld-Lite. On InternVL2.5-8B, GapSight raises the six-benchmark average from 52.25 to 64.29, above CropVLM (57.16), ViCrop (55.84), and ZoomRefine (54.43). Mechanism analyses show that the router rescues concrete wrong answers, adapts its action rate by task, and forms a favorable token-performance profile. These results position loss-gap supervision as a practical route to teaching VLMs when and where to look again.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GapSight框架，让视觉语言模型(VLM)先全局浏览，再根据问题需求选择性地对图像特定区域进行"重读"。该方法利用目标模型自身的失败信号作为监督，离线比较全局视角与局部裁剪视角下的回答差异，生成模型特定的复习标签，并训练轻量级裁剪路由器来决定是否复习、复习价值以及裁剪框位置。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在细节密集问题上频繁失败的根本原因是：答案虽然可见于图像中，但在图像被压缩为低分辨率全局视图时信息丢失。现有方法对所有查询分配更多视觉token是低效的，会浪费计算资源并干扰依赖全局上下文的任务。需要一个选择性重读机制，只在必要时回顾图像局部区域。
AI.method: 1) 离线阶段：比较全局视角与候选裁剪增强视角下的答案损失或多选题选项边际，将能改善目标回答的裁剪作为模型特定的复习标签。2) 在线阶段：训练一个轻量级自由形式裁剪路由器，从全局状态预测是否复习、期望效用和连续裁剪框，实现单次推理策略。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B、InternVL2.5-8B和Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct上，GapSight在六个基准（OCR、文档、图表、信息图、VStarBench、MME-RealWorld-Lite）上均优于基线。在InternVL2.5-8B上，六基准平均分从52.25提升至64.29，超过CropVLM(57.16)、ViCrop(55.84)和ZoomRefine(54.43)。机制分析显示路由器能纠正具体错误答案、自适应任务调节动作率并形成有利的token-性能曲线。
AI.conclusion: 损失差距监督（loss-gap supervision）是训练VLMs在何时何地"再看一眼"的实用路径。GapSight验证了通过模型自身失败信号引导选择性视觉回顾这一思路的有效性和通用性。

title: CIDER: Continual Interactive Distillation for Embodied Reinforcement Learning
summary: Human-in-the-loop real-world reinforcement learning enables rapid acquisition of effective robotic manipulation policies for individual tasks, often within tens of minutes. Yet it remains unclear how to extend this paradigm to continual learning, where a single policy must acquire new skills without losing previously learned behaviors. Existing real-world continual learning methods do not explicitly constrain prior behaviors, leading to severe catastrophic forgetting. We introduce Continual Interactive Distillation for Embodied Reinforcement Learning (CIDER), a continual reinforcement learning framework that freezes the accumulated historical policy as a teacher before learning each new task and interleaves task learning with distillation-based retention. We further introduce gradient routing to separate the gradients used for acquiring new tasks from those used for preserving prior behaviors. We evaluate our method with a single shared actor on six real-world household and industrial manipulation tasks. Interactive Distillation maintains high measured success on previously learned tasks across our six-task real-robot sequence while acquiring each new task in 10 to 20 minutes, whereas every baseline forgets at least one previous task. Additional ablations reveal the key design choices that govern the tradeoff between stability and plasticity in real-world continual reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: CIDER是一个面向真实世界机器人持续强化学习的框架，通过冻结历史策略作为教师、结合蒸馏保留和梯度路由技术，在六项真实家用和工业操纵任务上实现了快速新技能获取的同时避免灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 人机交互的真实世界强化学习可以在数十分钟内快速获取单项机器人操纵技能，但现有方法无法将该范式扩展到持续学习场景——即单一策略需不断获取新技能而不遗忘旧行为。现有的真实世界持续学习方法缺乏对先前行为的显式约束，导致严重的灾难性遗忘问题。
AI.method: CIDER框架包含三个关键设计：(1) 在学习每个新任务前，冻结累积的历史策略作为教师；(2) 将任务学习与基于蒸馏的保留机制交错进行；(3) 引入梯度路由机制，将用于获取新任务的梯度与用于保留先前行为的梯度分离，以平衡稳定性和可塑性。
AI.result: 在六个真实世界家用和工业操纵任务上使用单一共享actor进行评估，CIDER在已学任务上保持高成功率，同时每个新任务仅需10至20分钟即可习得；所有基线方法均遗忘了至少一个先前任务。消融实验进一步揭示了影响真实世界持续强化学习稳定性和可塑性权衡的关键设计选择。
AI.conclusion: CIDER成功将人机交互强化学习扩展到持续学习场景，通过教师冻结策略和梯度路由有效解决了灾难性遗忘问题，为真实世界机器人持续技能获取提供了可行方案。

title: Hints, Critics, and Teachers: Prior Injection for Sparse-Reward RL in Vision-Language Math Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning for vision-language math reasoning starves under sparse reward: on a pool of 20,830 visual-math problems where Qwen2-VL-2B answers 3.6% of rollouts correctly, 85-97% of GRPO rollout groups are entirely wrong and contribute zero gradient. We train eleven methods under identical conditions in this regime, each injecting a different prior: text (reference-solution hints), distribution (on-policy distillation from a 7B teacher), and value (a value-pretrained critic with an MSE or HL-Gauss categorical loss). A prior helps exactly when it is delivered: the six arms whose prior effectively reaches the policy separate with no overlap from the remaining five -- the no-prior baseline and four arms whose prior is teacher-capped, gated away, or lost to a mis-parameterized critic -- both on the pooled in-domain metric and on cross-domain transfer (DynaMath). The central finding, however, concerns evaluation: one slice of the in-domain pool -- long used as this project's general-distribution check -- anti-correlates with genuine cross-domain transfer (Spearman rho = -0.74, n = 11 arms, permutation p = 0.011), while the hardest in-domain slice predicts it closely (rho = +0.89, p < 0.001). We attribute the inversion to a near-chance multiple-choice subset that rewards models for not having changed; read through it, the best cross-domain method looked mediocre and the worst looked like the champion. Among the methods, hint-guided exploration -- not UFT's auxiliary loss -- drives hint gains, and replacing the critic's MSE loss with HL-Gauss cross-entropy is worth +14.4 points in-domain. All accuracies are blind-judged, with paired exact tests.

AI.tldr: 本文研究视觉-语言数学推理在强化学习中的稀疏奖励问题。在20,830道视觉数学题中,Qwen2-VL-2B仅有3.6%的rollout正确,85-97%的GRPO组完全错误且梯度为零。作者训练了十一种注入不同先验的方法,发现先验有效与否直接决定性能分层。核心发现是评估指标的陷阱:一个常用的域内子集指标与跨域迁移真实表现显著负相关(rho=-0.74),而最难域内子集则高度正相关(rho=+0.89)。提示引导探索(而非UFT辅助损失)驱动了带提示的提升,HL-Gauss交叉熵损失比MSE提升14.4分。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言数学推理在强化学习训练中面临极端的稀疏奖励问题,大部分rollout完全错误导致梯度为零,使得模型难以有效学习。作者旨在系统研究不同先验(文本提示、分布蒸馏、价值函数)在此稀疏奖励机制下的作用效果,并揭示评估指标选择对方法排名的误导性影响。
AI.method: 作者在完全相同的条件下训练十一种方法,每种注入不同先验:(1)文本先验——参考解答提示;(2)分布先验——从7B教师模型在线蒸馏;(3)价值先验——价值预训练的critic,使用MSE或HL-Gauss分类损失。对先验的可达性进行控制(教师设上限、门控、critic参数化错误),并通过盲审配对精确检验评估准确率。
AI.result: 先验恰好到达策略的六个方法分支与其余五个无重叠地分离。发现常用域内评估子集与跨域迁移(DynaMath)呈显著负相关(rho=-0.74,p=0.011),而最难域内子集却高度正相关(rho=+0.89)。HL-Gauss损失比MSE在域内提升14.4分,提示引导探索是提示增益的驱动因素。
AI.conclusion: 在极稀疏奖励下,先验必须有效传递到策略才有价值;工程上"先验到达"是关键机制。更重要的是,评估指标的选择会彻底颠倒方法优劣排名——近乎随机的选择题子集使最佳跨域方法看起来平庸、最差方法看似冠军。研究者应使用最难域内子集或直接采用跨域指标进行可靠评估。

title: LiteEvent-AE: Lightweight Autoencoder for Event-Based Vision on Low-Latency Energy-Constrained Edge Devices
summary: Event-based vision has emerged as a promising paradigm for energy-aware artificial intelligence (AI), offering sparse, low-latency visual signals that reduce redundant data processing and support sustainable edge computing. However, the asynchronous and noise-prone nature of event streams creates challenges for conventional deep learning models, which are often too computationally intensive for low-power embedded platforms. This work presents a compact and configurable event-driven autoencoder that efficiently compresses neuromorphic data while preserving essential spatiotemporal structure for downstream inference. The architecture integrates lightweight convolutional encoding with robust performance under adaptive event thresholding and a minimal classifier head, enabling substantial reductions in computational cost without degrading recognition fidelity. Extensive evaluations on the Smart Event Face Dataset (SEFD) and Event-Based Crossing Dataset (EBCD) show that the proposed framework achieves competitive or superior accuracy compared to YOLOv9 while requiring up to 35.6$\times$ fewer parameters. To assess real-world sustainability, the model is deployed on resource-constrained hardware: a Raspberry Pi 4B and a NVIDIA Jetson Nano. On NVIDIA Jetson Nano, it delivers real-time throughput of 44.8 FPS. On a Raspberry Pi 4B CPU, the 50\% autoencoder classifier consumes 16.19 J for the evaluated inference workload, corresponding to approximately 726.3$\times$ lower energy consumption than YOLOv9 under the same evaluation protocol. These results demonstrate the potential of compact event-driven models to advance environmentally conscious, low-power AI systems for high-speed perception in autonomous, mobile, and embedded computing environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种紧凑且可配置的事件驱动自编码器，用于高效压缩神经形态数据，在保持识别精度的同时大幅降低计算成本和能耗。在SEFD和EBCD数据集上达到与YOLOv9相当或更优的精度，参数减少多达35.6倍，在Jetson Nano上实现44.8 FPS的实时吞吐，在树莓派4B上能耗比YOLOv9低726.3倍。
AI.motivation: 事件视觉作为一种有前景的节能AI范式，提供稀疏、低延迟的视觉信号，但其异步和含噪特性对传统深度学习模型构成挑战，且这些模型对低功耗嵌入式平台而言计算负担过重，需要一种轻量级且高效的事件流处理方法。
AI.method: 该架构采用轻量级卷积编码器与自适应事件阈值处理相结合，整合了紧凑的可配置事件驱动自编码器，在压缩神经形态数据的同时保留时空结构，并通过最小化分类器头实现计算开销的显著降低。
AI.result: 在SEFD和EBCD数据集上与YOLOv9相比达到竞争或更优的精度，参数减少最多35.6倍；在Jetson Nano上实现44.8 FPS的实时吞吐；在树莓派4B CPU上推理能耗约16.19 J，较YOLOv9降低约726.3倍。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明紧凑的事件驱动模型能够推动环保、低功耗AI系统在自动驾驶、移动和嵌入式计算环境中的高速感知应用，展示了神经形态数据高效压缩与低能耗推理的可行性。

title: Stakeholder Insights for Designing In-Home Social Robots for Dementia Disorientation Detection and Caregiver-Aware Intervention
summary: Disorientation is a common and distressing experience for people living with dementia. It often manifests as confusion about time, place, or personal context. These episodes can increase anxiety, agitation, and safety risks, especially for persons with dementia (PwDs) who live independently at home. While assistive technologies have explored reminders, monitoring, and activity support, little research has explored how socially assistive robots can support the detection and management of disorientation in everyday living contexts. Hence, disorientation detection and intervention remain under-examined as socio-technical challenges. We conducted 14 semi-structured interviews with dementia caregivers and practitioners, including family and professional caregivers, occupational therapists, mental health practitioners, dementia nurse practitioners, and well-being and technology leads. The findings reveal that recurrent and fluctuating. It often emerges through behavioural cues such as repeated questioning, inappropriate activity timing and disrupted daily routines. Caregivers described orientation as emotionally charged, and direct correction may increase distress. The participants were generally receptive to robotic assistance when framed as supportive rather than corrective. Based on the insights, we identify essential design implications for socially assistive robots that provide context-aware orientation support, integrate into daily routines and support caregivers through timely escalation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过14次半结构化访谈，探讨了失智症照护者对方向感迷失（disorientation）的认知与应对经验，并提出社交辅助机器人在检测和管理方向感迷失方面的设计启示。
AI.motivation: 失智症患者常经历方向感迷失，导致焦虑、躁动和安全风险，尤其是独立居家生活的患者。现有辅助技术多聚焦提醒、监控和活动支持，但社交辅助机器人如何支持方向感迷失的检测与管理尚未被充分研究，这一领域作为社会技术挑战仍待探索。
AI.method: 对14位失智症照护者及从业者进行半结构化访谈，对象包括家庭照护者、专业照护者、职业治疗师、心理健康从业者、失智症护士及福祉与技术负责人，分析其对方向感迷失的观察与应对策略。
AI.result: 研究发现方向感迷失具有反复性和波动性，常通过行为线索表现（如重复提问、活动时间不当、日常作息紊乱）；照护者视方向定位为情绪敏感议题，直接纠正可能加剧痛苦；参与者对以支持性（而非纠正性）定位的机器人辅助持开放态度。
AI.conclusion: 提出社交辅助机器人的关键设计启示：提供情境感知的方向支持、整合进日常作息、并通过及时升级机制支持照护者。

title: VisAdj: Learning Adjacency Matrices from Node-Link Images
summary: Learning adjacency matrices from node-link images is a fundamental problem for recovering structured graph information from visual observations. Existing methods typically rely on fixed KNN-based heuristics for candidate edge selection and fail to capture dependencies among edges. To overcome these limitations, we propose VisAdj, a new framework for topology-aware adjacency prediction. VisAdj introduces an attention-sparse neighbor sampler to adaptively select a high-recall set of candidate node pairs and performs joint edge inference using a line-graph transformer that treats candidate edges as tokens and explicitly models dependencies among incident edges. Extensive experiments on synthetic graphs, road networks, and vessel images demonstrate that VisAdj consistently outperforms existing baselines by clear margins.

AI.tldr: VisAdj是一个用于从节点-链接图像中预测邻接矩阵的新框架，通过注意力稀疏邻居采样器自适应选择高召回率的候选节点对，并利用线图Transformer将候选边视为token进行联合边推断，显式建模相邻边之间的依赖关系，在合成图、道路网络和血管图像上显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖固定的KNN启发式规则来选择候选边，无法适应不同图结构，且未能捕捉边之间的依赖关系，导致邻接矩阵恢复效果受限。
AI.method: 提出VisAdj框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 注意力稀疏邻居采样器，用于自适应选择高召回率的候选节点对；(2) 线图Transformer，将候选边作为token进行联合推断，显式建模入射边之间的依赖关系。
AI.result: 在合成图、道路网络和血管图像三类数据集上的大量实验表明，VisAdj一致性地大幅超越现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过自适应候选边选择与显式边依赖建模，VisAdj有效解决了图结构恢复中候选边选择不灵活和边间关系被忽略的问题。

title: SpatialDiff: 3D-Aware Object Movement via Implicit Spatial Modeling
summary: Recent advances in image editing allow impressive manipulation of objects, existing methods still struggle to handle spatial movement in complex scenes, such as objects span different depth layers or are partially occluded. Most image editing methods focus solely on prior information from 2D datasets, emphasizing planar features while lacking support for spatial structures. Even approaches that incorporate explicit positional information fail to capture true 3D spatial relationships, thus limiting accurate object movement in complex scenes. In this paper, we present SpatialDiff, a method that effectively captures 3D spatial structures, enabling precise and consistent object movements in complex scenes. Our core innovations are twofold: (1) Implicit 3D Spatial Modeling, which introduces 3D prior knowledge and enables the model to internally build a comprehensive understanding of the three-dimensional spatial structure; and (2) Global Spatial Supervision, which constrains the latent spatial features to enable the model to perceive changes in object spatial positions caused by editing operations. Experimental results demonstrate that our method significantly improves the accuracy and fidelity of spatial movement in complex scenes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpatialDiff方法，通过隐式3D空间建模和全局空间监督两大核心创新，实现在复杂场景（如对象跨越不同深度层或被部分遮挡）中精确且一致的空间移动编辑，显著提升了空间运动的准确性和保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有图像编辑方法在复杂场景中处理对象空间移动时效果不佳，主要原因有二：(1) 大多数方法仅依赖2D数据集的先验信息，强调平面特征而缺乏空间结构支持；(2) 即使引入显式位置信息的方法也无法捕捉真正的3D空间关系，限制了复杂场景中的精确对象移动。
AI.method: SpatialDiff包含两大核心创新：(1) 隐式3D空间建模——引入3D先验知识，使模型内部构建对三维空间结构的全面理解；(2) 全局空间监督——约束潜在空间特征，使模型能够感知编辑操作引起的对象空间位置变化。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，SpatialDiff在复杂场景中的空间移动任务上显著提升了准确性和保真度，验证了该方法在3D空间感知和编辑一致性方面的优越性。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入3D空间建模与全局空间监督，SpatialDiff有效克服了传统2D方法在复杂场景空间编辑中的局限，为图像编辑中的空间移动任务提供了更精确、更一致的解决方案。

title: Design of a Human-Assistance Robot System with Contextual Action Recognition
