comment: Published in Automation 2025: Recent Advances in Automation, Robotics and Measurement Techniques, Lecture Notes in Networks and Systems, vol. 1687, Springer Nature, 2025. DOI: 10.1007/978-3-032-08359-3_16
summary: This paper presents a conceptual design for a proactive human assisting robot system capable of recognizing human activities and responding proactively. The system leverages contextual human activity recognition to interpret human actions across diverse contexts, while behavior trees are utilized to define dynamic and interpretable robot behaviors. We outline the system architecture, incorporating contextual human action recognition (HAR), behavior trees (BTs), and ROS, using the Spot robot platform as a representative example. We explain how HAR enables the robot to provide proactive assistance, discuss its limitations, and introduce methodologies for contextual HAR to address these limitations, thereby enhancing the robot's decision-making in complex human activity scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种主动式人类辅助机器人系统的概念设计，该系统通过情境化人类活动识别（HAR）理解人类行为，并利用行为树（BTs）定义动态且可解释的机器人行为。系统基于ROS架构，以Spot机器人为代表平台进行说明，旨在提升机器人在复杂人类活动场景中的决策能力。
AI.motivation: 传统机器人系统缺乏对人类活动的主动理解和响应能力，难以在复杂多变的环境中提供及时、恰当的人类辅助服务。现有的人类活动识别方法在多样化情境下准确性和适应性不足，限制了机器人的主动决策能力。
AI.method: 采用情境化人类活动识别（contextual HAR）来跨不同情境解析人类行为，结合行为树（BTs）定义动态且可解释的机器人行为，并基于ROS构建整体系统架构，以Spot机器人平台作为实例验证。
AI.result: 论文介绍了系统架构设计，解释了HAR如何使机器人提供主动协助，讨论了现有方法的局限性，并展示了情境化HAR方法论如何弥补这些不足，从而增强机器人在复杂人类活动场景中的决策能力。
AI.conclusion: 情境化HAR结合行为树和ROS架构，为主动式辅助机器人系统提供了一种可行的概念设计方案，能够有效提升机器人在复杂场景中的主动辅助能力。

title: Beyond Success and Failure: Length-Aware Contrastive Learning for GUI Agents
summary: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents powered by Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for automating tasks across diverse digital environments, where reinforcement learning (RL) has become a dominant training paradigm. However, widely used methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) suffer from reward-gradient misalignment, leading to inefficient and unstable optimization. Recent work addresses this issue by reformulating RL with verifiable rewards (RLVR) as contrastive or classification-based objectives, which improve stability by eliminating problematic gradient behaviors. Despite this progress, existing contrastive RLVR methods rely primarily on outcome-level supervision and fail to capture fine-grained differences in trajectory quality within the same outcome category. In this paper, we propose Length-Aware Contrastive Learning for GUI Agents (LACL-GUI), a contrastive RLVR framework that incorporates trajectory-level quality signals into policy optimization. LACL-GUI introduces structured preferences within both successful and failed trajectories, encouraging concise successful executions and differentiating failure quality based on divergence from successful trajectories, while preserving optimization stability. Experiments on GUI agent benchmarks show that LACL-GUI provides more effective learning signals and consistently improves agent performance over prior methods, highlighting the value of trajectory-level supervision in contrastive RLVR.

AI.tldr: 提出LACL-GUI框架，一种长度感知的对比强化学习框架，在轨迹级别引入质量信号以改进GUI智能体的策略优化，优于现有对比RLVR方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的对比RLVR方法（如GRPO的改进版）主要依赖结果级别的监督信号，无法捕捉同一结果类别内轨迹质量的细粒度差异，导致学习信号不够精准。
AI.method: LACL-GUI在成功和失败的轨迹内部都引入结构化偏好：鼓励成功轨迹更简洁，并根据与成功轨迹的偏离程度区分失败轨迹的质量，同时保持优化的稳定性。
AI.result: 在GUI智能体基准测试上的实验表明，LACL-GUI提供了更有效的学习信号，并在智能体性能上持续优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级别的监督在对比RLVR中具有重要价值，LACL-GUI验证了这一方向的有效性。

title: DefaultShift: Auditing Semantic Default Shift in Accelerated Text-to-Image Models
summary: Few-step text-to-image models increasingly replace slower generators, yet acceleration can silently change distributions over unspecified attributes even when individual outputs remain plausible and aligned. We call these distributions semantic defaults and their change under replacement semantic default shift. Existing quality, preference, and diversity evaluations do not test whether a replacement preserves its reference model's semantic defaults. We introduce DefaultShift, a paired audit that labels repeated samples with closed semantic vocabularies, measures probability-mass movement, and separates interpretable ranking from confirmatory cross-fit inference. Across 14 reference and replacement pairs, adjusted color discrepancies range from 0.054 to 0.303 with recipe-specific directions. A 1,000-image human audit reproduces the ordering. We further introduce DefaultShift-Select, an offline calibration method that reduces human-measured shift by 10.3 percent to 35.1 percent across Turbo, DMD2, and FLUX without material quality loss. Under balanced evaluation, selected data recover 4.3 accuracy points and 7.5 worst-group points over uncalibrated replacement data. DefaultShift makes semantic preservation under acceleration measurable and actionable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DefaultShift框架，用于检测和校准文本到图像加速模型在替换慢速模型时产生的语义默认值偏移（semantic default shift），并通过离线校准方法DefaultShift-Select减少这种偏移。
AI.motivation: 加速的文本到图像生成模型越来越普及，但加速可能在保持个体输出合理的同时，悄悄改变未被指定的属性分布（语义默认值）。现有的质量、偏好和多样性评估无法检测这种替换是否保持了参考模型的语义默认值，需要一种专门的审计方法来衡量这种偏移。
AI.method: 提出DefaultShift配对审计方法：对重复样本打上封闭语义词汇标签，衡量概率质量移动，并分离可解释排序与确认性的交叉拟合推断。同时引入DefaultShift-Select离线校准方法，通过选择校准数据来减少人为测量的偏移。
AI.result: 在14组参考-替换模型对中，调整后的颜色差异范围为0.054至0.303，具有配方特定方向。1000张图像的人类审计复现了排序。DefaultShift-Select在Turbo、DMD2和FLUX上将人为测量的偏移减少10.3%至35.1%，且无明显质量损失。在平衡评估下，校准数据比未校准替换数据恢复4.3个准确率点和7.5个最差组点。
AI.conclusion: DefaultShift使加速条件下的语义保留变得可测量且可操作，为评估和校准加速生成模型提供了全新工具。

title: DELTA: Deformable Elevation-Based Local Terrain Attention Encoder for Sparse-Terrain Quadrupedal Locomotion
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to the 2027 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2027). This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Stable quadrupedal locomotion on sparse terrain requires selecting state-relevant terrain evidence for precise foot placement. Model-based foothold planners provide precise foothold selection but rely heavily on explicit model assumptions. Recent attention-based map encoding (AME) studies show that end-to-end reinforcement learning (RL) can learn implicit foothold guidance. However, the computational cost of dense AME encoding grows with map resolution, limiting its scalability to fine-grained sparse terrain. We propose DELTA, a Deformable Elevation-Based Local Terrain Attention encoder. DELTA predicts state-conditioned sampling locations, forms terrain evidence tokens from adaptive local elevation patches, and attends only to a fixed-size token set. With fixed sampling and patch settings, DELTA's encoder cost is independent of map resolution. Experiments show that DELTA achieves final traversal performance comparable to AME at the standard resolution while improving learning efficiency. This fixed encoder cost enables the use of higher-resolution terrain maps, improving traversal on fine-grained sparse terrain. DELTA also demonstrates strong generalization to unseen mixed evaluation courses composed of continuous and discrete terrain elements. Beyond simulation, DELTA demonstrates successful sim-to-real transfer on RAIBO2. Analysis of the learned sampling offsets and attention weights shows that DELTA samples steppable regions and attends to terrain evidence relevant to future touchdowns without foothold labels or attention supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DELTA，一种可变形基于高程的局部地形注意力编码器，用于四足机器人在稀疏地形上的稳定行走。DELTA预测状态相关的采样位置，从自适应局部高程块中形成地形证据令牌，并仅关注固定大小的令牌集，使得编码器计算成本与地图分辨率无关，同时提升了学习效率、穿越性能、泛化能力和sim-to-real迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 四足机器人在稀疏地形上行走需要选择与状态相关的地形证据进行精确的足部放置。基于模型的足部规划器依赖显式模型假设，而现有的基于注意力的地图编码(AME)方法虽然可以隐式学习足部引导，但其密集AME编码的计算成本随地图分辨率增长，限制了其在细粒度稀疏地形上的可扩展性。
AI.method: DELTA采用可变形机制：首先预测状态相关的采样位置，然后从自适应局部高程块中形成地形证据令牌，最后仅对固定大小的令牌集进行注意力操作。通过固定采样和补丁设置，编码器成本与地图分辨率无关。
AI.result: 实验表明，DELTA在标准分辨率下达到与AME相当的最终穿越性能，同时提高了学习效率。固定编码成本允许使用更高分辨率的地形图，提升细粒度稀疏地形上的穿越性能。DELTA还展现出对未见过的混合评估路线的强泛化能力，并在RAIBO2上成功实现sim-to-real迁移。分析显示DELTA无需足部标签或注意力监督即可采样可踩踏区域并关注与未来落脚点相关的地形证据。
AI.conclusion: DELTA通过可变形注意力机制有效解决了AME计算成本随分辨率增长的问题，在保持性能的同时提升学习效率和可扩展性，并在真实机器人上验证了其有效性，为四足机器人稀疏地形导航提供了一种高效可扩展的解决方案。

title: GameXpert-Bench: How Far Are Coding Agents from Expert Game Development?
summary: Recent large language models (LLMs) can operate as coding agents that build complete games from natural language requests. Game development is especially demanding because program logic, visual and audio content, interfaces, interaction and playability must function together in one executable artifact. Measuring this capability therefore requires evaluation of both game product and the development process. Existing benchmarks often assess the game development capabilities of LLMs by evaluating the final artifact or an isolated development stage. Our analysis of complete human-agent development trajectories identifies three stages that together span the lifecycle of game development with a coding agent: initial game generation, bug diagnosis and repair, and optimization over multiple turns. Therefore, we introduce GameXpert-Bench, which operationalizes the three lifecycle stages as three complementary benchmark tracks. GameGen evaluates complete game creation from a single request in an empty workspace. GameFix evaluates diagnosis and repair when defects are reported or left for the agent to discover. GameOpt evaluates cumulative optimization through request chains seeded by real development trajectories between users and agents. We evaluate each track using live game interaction, deterministic behavioral tests, or final product criteria with regression checks. The suite contains 97 generation tasks across 11 genres; 100 repair tasks from 50 game levels verified by humans, each with 19-27 injected bugs; and 17 optimization chains with six turns and 102 requests. Across the three tracks, current agents are more reliable at producing playable foundations and implementing explicit requirements than at discovering defects, verifying runtime behavior, and preserving functionality across changes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GameXpert-Bench，一个全面评估LLM游戏开发能力的基准测试框架，涵盖游戏开发生命周期的三个阶段：初始生成（GameGen）、缺陷诊断与修复（GameFix）、多轮优化（GameOpt）。基准包含97个生成任务、100个修复任务和17个优化链，通过多种评估方式发现当前智能体在生成可玩基础和实现明确需求方面表现较好，但在缺陷发现、运行时验证和功能保持方面存在不足。
AI.motivation: 现有基准通常只评估最终产物或孤立开发阶段，但完整的游戏开发需要程序逻辑、视觉音频内容、界面、交互和可玩性在单一可执行文件中协同工作。因此需要一个覆盖整个游戏开发生命周期的综合评估基准。
AI.method: 通过分析完整的人机开发轨迹，识别出三个阶段：初始游戏生成、缺陷诊断与修复、多轮优化。据此构建三轨基准：GameGen（从单一请求在空工作区创建完整游戏）、GameFix（报告缺陷或让智能体自行发现缺陷后进行诊断修复）、GameOpt（基于真实开发轨迹的请求链进行累积优化）。评估方式包括实时游戏交互、确定性行为测试和最终产品标准回归检查。
AI.result: 构建了包含97个生成任务（覆盖11种游戏类型）、100个修复任务（来自50个经过人工验证的游戏关卡，每个含19-27个注入缺陷）和17个优化链（每个6轮102个请求）的基准套件。实验发现当前智能体在生成可玩基础和实现明确需求方面较可靠，但在缺陷发现、运行时行为验证和变更中保持功能方面表现不足。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM编码智能体的游戏开发能力存在明显瓶颈：对显式需求的实现能力优于对隐式缺陷的发现和验证能力，且在多轮迭代中难以保持功能一致性。这指出了未来智能体需要加强的方向。

title: HP-UniIF: Hierarchical Prompt Learning for Unified Image Fusion
summary: General image fusion seeks to integrate complementary information from multiple source images, yet real-world applications often require a single system to support heterogeneous fusion, degradation restoration, and task-oriented perception simultaneously. Existing unified frameworks struggle with these orthogonal objectives, resulting in entangled representations and degraded performance across subtasks. We propose HP-UniIF, a unified vision framework that leverages diffusion priors to bridge heterogeneous fusion, visual restoration, and downstream perception. To address the limited adaptability of diffusion models to domain-, degradation-, and task-level objectives within one pipeline, HP-UniIF introduces a depth-wise hierarchical conditional modulation strategy that decouples these objectives across network stages. Task prompt modulation at bottleneck layers adapts the backbone to different fusion paradigms, the degradation prompt router at shallow layers injects degradation-aware constraints for local restoration, and the application prompt bank at decoding stages aligns generation with downstream tasks. This hierarchical design enables HP-UniIF to produce visually faithful results while preserving task-relevant semantics. Extensive experiments across multiple fusion tasks, diverse degradations, and various downstream applications demonstrate the superior performance of HP-UniIF.

AI.tldr: HP-UniIF是一个统一的视觉框架，利用扩散先验同时处理异构图像融合、退化恢复和下游感知任务。通过深度层次化条件调制策略（包括瓶颈层的任务提示调制、浅层的退化提示路由器和解码阶段的应用提示库），将不同目标解耦到网络各阶段，实现视觉保真与任务语义保持的兼顾。
AI.motivation: 现有统一框架难以同时支持异构融合、退化恢复和任务导向感知这三个正交目标，导致表征纠缠、各子任务性能下降。扩散模型虽然强大，但其在一个流程中对领域、退化和任务级目标的适应性有限，需要新的解耦机制。
AI.method: 提出深度层次化条件调制策略：(1) 瓶颈层的任务提示调制使主干适应不同融合范式；(2) 浅层的退化提示路由器注入退化感知约束用于局部恢复；(3) 解码阶段的应用提示库将生成与下游任务对齐。这种层次化设计将不同目标解耦到网络不同阶段。
AI.result: 在多种融合任务、多样退化场景和各类下游应用上的大量实验表明，HP-UniIF表现出优越的性能，能够产生视觉上忠实的结果同时保留任务相关语义。
AI.conclusion: 层次化条件调制是实现统一视觉框架中多目标解耦的有效方案，扩散先验可以作为连接异构融合、恢复和感知的桥梁，为通用视觉系统提供了一种新的设计范式。

title: Ludi${}_{\scriptscriptstyle 0.1}$: An Agentic System for Socially Intelligent Robots
summary: Robot foundation models have substantially advanced perception and control, but natural human-robot collaboration requires more than executing isolated commands. A robot must recognize ambiguity, maintain context across turns, communicate its intentions, and revise ongoing behavior as the user's intent changes. We present $\scriptstyle\mathsf{Ludi}_{\scriptscriptstyle 0.1}$, an agentic system for socially intelligent robots that integrates interactive speech, multimodal reasoning, memory, navigation, and learned manipulation. Its decision-making core is a fine-tuned vision-language model trained on multi-turn interaction traces spanning ambiguous requests, clarifications, corrections, interruptions, mixed social and task dialogue, and multi-step tasks. A purpose-built harness manages the model-tool interaction loop, while specialized navigation and manipulation policies execute physical skills. Ludi${}_{\scriptscriptstyle 0.1}$ demonstrates a practical path toward fluid human-robot collaboration today while producing the multimodal interaction traces needed to develop a more deeply integrated foundation model for robots and people.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Ludi₀.₁，一个面向社交智能机器人的智能体系统，整合交互式语音、多模态推理、记忆、导航和学习操作。其决策核心是微调的视觉-语言模型，训练数据涵盖多轮交互轨迹（模糊请求、澄清、纠正、打断、混合社交与任务对话及多步骤任务），配合专用工具交互框架和导航/操作策略执行物理技能，为流畅人机协作提供了可行路径。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人基础模型在感知和控制方面有显著进展，但自然的人机协作需要机器人在上下文保持、歧义识别、意图沟通和行为修正等方面具备更强能力，而不仅仅是执行孤立的指令。
AI.method: 构建一个智能体系统Ludi₀.₁，核心是微调的视觉-语言模型，训练数据为多轮交互轨迹，涵盖模糊请求、澄清、纠正、打断、社交与任务混合对话和多步任务。系统配备专用框架管理模型-工具交互循环，并利用专门的导航和操作策略执行物理技能。
AI.result: Ludi₀.₁展示了当前实现流畅人机协作的可行路径，同时生成了开发更深层人机基础模型所需的多样化多模态交互轨迹数据。
AI.conclusion: 该系统为构建更深度集成的机器人与人类基础模型提供了实际可行的中间步骤，通过交互轨迹数据的积累为未来更强大的协作模型奠定基础。

title: LLM4LLM: Bridging Kernel Benchmarks and Real Deployment via Closed-Loop Agentic Optimization
summary: Large language models have become increasingly capable agents for low-level code and kernel optimization, but isolated kernel benchmarks provide only a proxy for the deployment behavior that matters in language-model inference. We identify a benchmark-to-deployment gap: candidate kernels that appear correct and fast in standalone harnesses can exhibit different performance, safety, or phase behavior after integration into a real inference workload. We introduce LLM4LLM, a deployment-aware closed-loop optimization framework that starts from a target inference script, extracts phase-aware optimization tasks, searches with an experience-guided episodic agent, and accepts patches through in-model validation. Across ten language-model inference workloads on A100 and H100 GPUs, LLM4LLM improves end-to-end latency for every evaluated model, achieving 3.91$\times$/6.98$\times$ geometric-mean speedups on A100/H100; as supporting kernel-level evidence, it also attains up to 2.745$\times$ GeoMean speedup on KernelBench Level 2.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLM4LLM，一个部署感知的闭环优化框架，用于解决大语言模型推理中内核优化从基准测试到实际部署的差距问题，在A100/H100上实现端到端3.91×/6.98×加速。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM用于低层代码和内核优化时，仅在隔离的内核基准（如KernelBench）上评估，但候选内核在独立测试中看似正确快速，集成到真实推理工作负载后可能表现出不同的性能、安全性或阶段性行为，存在"基准到部署"的差距。因此需要部署感知的优化框架。
AI.method: LLM4LLM框架包含三个核心环节：(1)从目标推理脚本出发，提取阶段感知的优化任务；(2)使用经验引导的episodic agent进行搜索；(3)通过在模型内验证（in-model validation）接受补丁，形成闭环优化流程。
AI.result: 在A100和H100 GPU上的十个LLM推理工作负载中，对每个评估模型都实现了端到端延迟改进，A100/H100上几何平均加速分别达到3.91×/6.98×；在KernelBench Level 2上还取得最高2.745×的几何平均加速作为内核级佐证。
AI.conclusion: LLM4LLM证明了部署感知的闭环优化框架比仅依赖隔离内核基准的优化方法更有效，能确保优化成果在真实推理场景中落地，弥补了基准测试与部署行为之间的鸿沟。

title: SAFE-G: Structure-aware Faithful Evidence-guided Generation for Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering
summary: Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering (KB-VQA) aims to answer queries that necessitate reasoning over external knowledge sources beyond the visual content. Typically, current methods fuse multimodal features to retrieve external information, subsequently leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to derive answers from the retrieved evidence. However, these methods often struggle to capture structural associations within complex contexts to effectively filter noise. Furthermore, they frequently fail to ensure that the reasoning process remains strictly faithful to the retrieved evidence. To address these challenges, we propose SAFE-G, a Structure-Aware Faithful Evidence-guided Generation framework, which enables precise evidence localization and trustworthy reasoning. Specifically, we first employ a coarse-grained hybrid search fusing visual and textual modalities to recall candidate documents, and subsequently implement a structure-aware fine-grained graph retrieval that captures structural dependencies to filter noise and pinpoint precise evidence. Moreover, we introduce a reinforcement learning (RL) strategy with an evidence-grounded reward that assigns credit to correct answers only when the selected evidence is correct. This strict alignment constraint compels the model to anchor its response in the retrieved context, effectively enhancing its capability to locate evidence via multimodal features and perform faithful reasoning. Extensive experiments on the Encyclopedic-VQA and InfoSeek benchmarks demonstrate that SAFE-G outperforms prior methods by a margin of 8.9% and 3.5%, substantially enhancing the overall reasoning accuracy. Our source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/MINE-USTC/SAFE-G.

AI.tldr: SAFE-G是一个面向知识型视觉问答（KB-VQA）的结构感知忠实证据引导生成框架，通过粗粒度混合检索与结构感知细粒度图检索实现精确证据定位，并引入基于证据奖励的强化学习策略约束推理过程忠实于检索证据。在Encyclopedic-VQA和InfoSeek基准上分别超越先前方法8.9%和3.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有KB-VQA方法在融合多模态特征检索外部信息时，难以捕捉复杂上下文中的结构关联以有效过滤噪声；同时推理过程常无法严格忠实于检索到的证据，导致答案可靠性不足。
AI.method: 1) 粗粒度混合搜索：融合视觉和文本模态召回候选文档；2) 结构感知细粒度图检索：捕捉结构依赖关系以过滤噪声并精确定位证据；3) 强化学习策略：引入证据锚定奖励，仅在所选证据正确时给予正确解答相应奖励，强制模型将回答锚定在检索上下文中。
AI.result: 在Encyclopedic-VQA基准上超越先前方法8.9%，在InfoSeek基准上超越3.5%，显著提升整体推理准确性。
AI.conclusion: SAFE-G通过结构感知检索与证据锚定的强化学习约束，有效解决了KB-VQA中噪声过滤与推理忠实性的两大挑战，代码已公开。

title: Inferring Action from Future Latent State for Robotic Manipulation
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) build robot control on video-generation backbones, which jointly predict dense future visual trajectories and robot actions. We argue that video generation is an unnecessary intermediate objective for world-action modeling. For robotic manipulation, the goal of a world model is not to reproduce how the world looks at every intermediate moment, but to predict the state that the world will reach after an action is executed. The intermediate frames only describe the visual transition between physical states, which consumes substantial model capacity and computation, but do not directly specify the physical outcome that the robot action is intended to produce. In this paper, we propose DELE-w0.5, which infers robot actions from predicted future states without relying on video generation. Concretely, DELE-w0.5 infers the action sequence from its corresponding compact future latent state. The future latent state captures the action-relevant physical outcome of robot interaction and serves as an explicit bridge between world modeling and action generation. The core design principle of DELE-w0.5 is to model how the physical world changes under robot actions, rather than how its visual appearance evolves frame by frame. This formulation removes the high-dimensional visual redundancy introduced by dense video representations, and it therefore enables cheaper training and low-latency inference. Across 480 real-robot trials on four long-horizon manipulation tasks, our DELE-w0.5 achieves the best performance among all compared policies, attaining 62.5 overall full-task success and 81.3 macro ordered-stage progress, outperforming the strongest baseline by 47.5 and 30.7 percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DELE-w0.5，一种不依赖视频生成的世界-动作模型。它通过预测紧凑的未来潜在状态来推断机器人动作，避免了视频生成这一中间目标带来的高维视觉冗余，从而实现更廉价的训练和低延迟推理。在480次真实机器人实验和四个长时程操作任务中，DELE-w0.5取得了最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 现有世界-动作模型（WAMs）建立在视频生成骨干之上，需要逐帧预测密集的未来视觉轨迹。但作者认为视频生成对机器人操作而言是不必要的中间目标——目标不是复现世界在每个中间时刻的外观，而是预测动作执行后世界将达到的状态。中间帧只描述物理状态之间的视觉过渡，消耗大量模型容量和计算，却不直接指定机器人动作要产生的物理结果。
AI.method: DELE-w0.5的核心设计是从动作对应的紧凑未来潜在状态中推断动作序列。该未来潜在状态捕获与动作相关的物理结果，作为世界建模和动作生成之间的显式桥梁。其核心原则是建模物理世界在机器人动作下如何变化，而非视觉外观如何逐帧演变，从而消除了密集视频表示带来的高维视觉冗余。
AI.result: 在480次真实机器人实验、四个长时程操作任务中，DELE-w0.5在所有对比策略中取得最佳性能：整体全任务成功率62.5%，宏观有序阶段进度81.3%，分别比最强基线高出47.5和30.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: DELE-w0.5证明了视频生成并非世界-动作建模的必要条件，通过直接建模物理状态变化而非视觉外观演变，可以在显著降低计算成本的同时大幅提升机器人操作性能。

title: AI Watchdog: Agent Interfaces for Detecting and Defending Against Manipulative Dark Patterns in AI Conversations
summary: Conversational AI increasingly shapes consequential decisions, yet users have limited support for recognizing and resisting manipulation. We present AI Watchdog, a browser-based agent interface that monitors live conversations, detects five dark-pattern categories, including sycophancy, brand bias, anthropomorphization, sneaking, and harmful generation, and alerts users when they occur. Its open-weight turn-level classifier supports independent deployment and a path toward local inference, preserving user privacy while remaining separate from the conversational AI. We evaluated AI Watchdog in a preregistered, five-condition between-subjects experiment (N = 150) comparing a no-intervention control with four configurations varying nudge timing (prebunking vs. just-in-time) and engagement mode (without vs. with cognitive forcing). Results show that participants rarely flagged manipulative turns across all conditions, and post-task awareness did not differ significantly across groups. However, just-in-time warnings without cognitive forcing were the only intervention to significantly reduce compliance with AI-steered recommendations containing dark patterns, lowering compliance from 71.7% to 53.7%, an 18 percentage-point reduction. Exploratory analyses further showed that lower misinformation susceptibility was associated with greater flagging but not lower compliance, while higher AI trust was associated with greater compliance and lower reported awareness. Together, these findings suggest that explicit recognition of conversational dark patterns and behavioral resistance to AI steering may be distinct outcomes, motivating further investigation of timely, low-friction defensive interfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI Watchdog，一个浏览器端代理界面，用于监控对话式AI中的五大暗黑模式（奉承、品牌偏见、拟人化、偷偷引导、有害生成），并在预注册实验中（N=150）比较了四种干预配置。结果显示，仅即时警告（无需认知强制）能显著将用户对AI引导建议的遵从率从71.7%降至53.7%，但所有条件下参与者都很少主动标记操控性对话，且任务后意识无显著差异。
AI.motivation: 对话式AI日益影响重大决策，但用户缺乏识别和抵抗操控的支持，现有研究对如何设计防御性界面以帮助用户识别暗黑模式缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 开发AI Watchdog浏览器代理界面，使用开放权重的回合级分类器实时检测五类暗黑模式并发出警报。通过预注册的五条件组间实验（N=150），比较无干预控制组与四种配置（线索时机：预辟谣vs即时；参与模式：有/无认知强制）的效果。
AI.result: 所有条件下参与者很少标记操控性回合，任务后意识组间无显著差异；但仅即时警告（无认知强制）将遵从AI建议的比例从71.7%降至53.7%（降低18个百分点）。探索性分析显示，较低的虚假信息易感性关联更多标记行为但非更低遵从，较高的AI信任关联更高遵从和更低报告意识。
AI.conclusion: 对对话暗黑模式的显式识别与对AI引导的行为抵抗可能是两个独立的结果维度，提示应进一步研究及时、低摩擦的防御性界面设计。

title: FlashReg: GPU-Accelerated 3-Clique Point Cloud Registration for Real-Time Correspondence-to-Pose Estimation
summary: Graph-based point cloud registration achieves high robustness by identifying geometrically consistent correspondence sets, but constructing second-order compatibility graphs and enumerating candidate cliques remain compute- and memory-intensive. This work presents FlashReg, a GPU-oriented correspondence-to-pose estimator that avoids materializing the dense scored second-order graph. Its Fast First- and Second-Order Graph (FFSOG) construction builds a capacity-bounded sparse second-order graph directly from the binary first-order graph. A dataflow-optimized three-node clique (3-clique) search then selects pivots from compact per-row candidate pools and enumerates triples through sorted sparse-neighborhood intersections. Across indoor and outdoor benchmarks, FlashReg reduces correspondence-to-pose latency by 2--3x relative to TurboReg at comparable registration recall, while using about 50% of its peak allocated tensor memory on an embedded GPU. These results make FlashReg suitable as a high-throughput registration backend within onboard perception pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FlashReg，一种面向 GPU 的点云配准对应到位姿估计器，通过避免物化稠密二阶兼容图、构建容量受限的稀疏二阶图，并采用数据流优化的三节点团搜索，在嵌入式 GPU 上相较 TurboReg 降低 2-3 倍延迟、节省约 50% 峰值张量内存，同时保持相当的配准召回率。
AI.motivation: 基于图的点云配准虽鲁棒性强，但构建二阶兼容图和枚举候选团的计算与内存开销巨大，限制了其在高吞吐量机载感知管线中的应用。
AI.method: FlashReg 采用 GPU 导向设计：(1) FFSOG 构建直接从二值一阶图生成容量受限的稀疏二阶图，避免物化稠密打分二阶图；(2) 数据流优化的三节点团搜索从紧凑的按行候选池中选择枢轴，并通过排序的稀疏邻域交集枚举三元组。
AI.result: 在室内和室外基准上，FlashReg 相较 TurboReg 将对应到位姿延迟降低 2-3 倍，配准召回率相当，且在嵌入式 GPU 上仅使用约 50% 的峰值分配张量内存。
AI.conclusion: FlashReg 在保持配准鲁棒性的同时显著提升了效率，适合作为机载感知管线中的高吞吐量配准后端。

title: EndoNav: Semantic-to-Geometric Grounding for Language-Guided Robotic Endoscopic Examination
summary: Minimally invasive procedures performed within confined anatomical spaces depend on continuous endoscopic visualization. Current robotic endoscope systems can stabilize or reposition an endoscope, but they do not possess relevant context to provide effective visualization assistance. We present EndoNav, an anatomy-grounded natural-language framework that translates high-level surgeon commands into autonomous endoscopic visualization behaviors within patient-specific sinonasal anatomy. Spoken surgeon commands are transcribed and interpreted by an endoscopic viewpoint agent conditioned on a patient-specific anatomical scene representation. Rather than generating robot motion directly, the viewpoint agent generates structured visualization objectives that are converted into target viewpoints and inspection trajectories, which are then executed through geometry-constrained endoscope motion planning and joint-space control. We evaluate EndoNav using a structured three-pass sinus examination across three CT-derived anatomical models. For one cadaveric specimen, autonomous visualization is compared with sinus examinations performed by two resident surgeons. EndoNav achieved mean visualization IoUs of 87.04% and 84.37% relative to the two surgeon examinations, compared with an inter-surgeon IoU of 87.44%, while recovering 92.91% and 93.20% of surgeon-observed anatomical surfaces, respectively. These results demonstrate the feasibility of grounding high-level anatomical commands into patient-specific geometric objectives and translating them into anatomically constrained robotic visualization behaviors.

AI.tldr: EndoNav是一个基于解剖学的自然语言框架，能将外科医生高层命令转化为自主内窥镜可视化行为。该系统通过患者特定的解剖场景表示，将语音命令解释为结构化的可视化目标，再转换为目标视角和检查轨迹，通过几何约束的运动规划执行。在三个CT衍生解剖模型上进行评估，与外科医生检查相比获得了87.04%和84.37%的平均可视化IoU，接近外科医生间的一致性(87.44%)。
AI.motivation: 当前机器人内窥镜系统虽然能够稳定或重新定位内窥镜，但缺乏相关上下文来提供有效的可视化辅助。微创手术在受限解剖空间内进行，持续依赖内窥镜可视化，因此需要具有解剖学背景的自主可视化系统来更好地辅助外科医生。
AI.method: 1) 采用解剖学grounded的自然语言框架，将外科医生的语音命令转化为自主内窥镜可视化行为；2) 通过患者特定的解剖场景表示（CT-derived解剖模型）来条件化内窥镜视角智能体；3) 视角智能体生成结构化的可视化目标（而非直接生成机器人运动），然后转换为目标视角和检查轨迹；4) 通过几何约束的内窥镜运动规划和关节空间控制执行。
AI.result: 在三个CT衍生解剖模型上进行结构化三通道鼻窦检查评估。对一个尸体标本进行自主可视化与两位住院外科医生检查对比，EndoNav分别达到87.04%和84.37%的平均可视化IoU，而外科医生之间的IoU为87.44%；同时恢复了外科医生观察到的解剖表面的92.91%和93.20%。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了将高层解剖命令grounding到患者特异的几何目标，并将其转化为解剖约束的机器人可视化行为的可行性。EndoNav的性能接近外科医生间的水平，显示出自动化内窥镜可视化辅助的巨大潜力。

title: MemGuard: Persisting Verifier Signals for LLM-Agent Memory Governance
summary: LLM agents are moving from single-prompt use to long task streams in which reusable memory becomes a core capability for terminal, software-engineering, and web tasks. Such memory is useful only when stored experience remains reliable across hundreds of interactions, but two failure modes break that assumption in practice. The first is unreliable admission: failed trajectories,accidental successes, and misleading observations enter memory because they appear relevant, then mislead later decisions. The second is memory drift: long-running banks accumulate duplicate, stale, and conflicting records that retrieval alone cannot repair. MemGuard's key distinction is to treat verifier output not as a one-shot filter, but as persistent lifecycle metadata. It converts multi-criteria score-token verification into reward, confidence, label, and uncertainty descriptors that are attached to every candidate before activation and reused during retrieval, conflict resolution, summarization, and archival. We evaluate MemGuard on Terminal-Bench 2.0, SWE-Bench Verified, WebArena, and Mind2Web across four backbones, comparing against four memory baselines plus a verifier-only control under matched runtime budgets. Averaged over five seeds, MemGuard achieves the best success metric and lowest average steps in all 16 backbone-benchmark settings, improving over ReasoningBank, the strongest prior baseline among the memory methods we evaluate, with a largest gain of 7.9 success-rate points on WebArena, 5.6 step-success-rate points on Mind2Web, and 2.4-3.5 points on terminal and software-engineering benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/whyyyyy123/MemGuard.

AI.tldr: MemGuard 是一种将验证器输出转化为持久生命周期元数据（奖励、置信度、标签、不确定性）来管理 LLM 智能体长期记忆的系统，解决不可靠准入和记忆漂移两大问题。在 Terminal-Bench 2.0、SWE-Bench Verified、WebArena 和 Mind2Web 四个基准、四个骨干模型上，于全部 16 种 backbone-benchmark 组合中取得最佳成功率，相比最强基线 ReasoningBank 最高提升 7.9 个成功率点。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体正从单提示使用转向长任务流，可复用记忆成为核心技术能力。但两个失败模式破坏了记忆可靠性假设：(1) 不可靠准入——失败的轨迹、偶然的成功和误导性的观察因看似相关而进入记忆，后续误导决策；(2) 记忆漂移——长期运行的记忆库积累重复、陈旧、冲突的记录，仅靠检索无法修复。
AI.method: MemGuard 的核心区别在于将验证器输出视作持久的生命周期元数据，而非一次性过滤器。它将多准则的评分-令牌验证转化为奖励、置信度、标签和不确定性描述符，在激活前附加到每个候选记忆上，并在检索、冲突消解、摘要和归档阶段反复使用这些元数据。
AI.result: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.0、SWE-Bench Verified、WebArena 和 Mind2Web 四个基准上，跨越四个骨干模型，与四个记忆基线及一个仅验证器对照组（匹配运行时预算）对比。五个随机种子平均后，MemGuard 在所有 16 种 backbone-benchmark 设置中取得最佳成功指标和最低平均步数。相比最强先验基线 ReasoningBank，最大增益为 WebArena 上 7.9 个成功率点、Mind2Web 上 5.6 个步-成功率点、终端和软件工程基准上 2.4–3.5 个点。
AI.conclusion: MemGuard 通过将验证器输出转化为持久生命周期元数据，有效解决了长期记忆系统中的不可靠准入和记忆漂移问题，在多个基准和骨干模型上全面超越现有方法，展示了将验证信息从一次性过滤升级为持续生命周期管理的有效性。

title: Through the Schrödinger Bridge: Benchmarking Antemortem Image Restoration from Postmortem Autolysis to Enhance Forensic Diagnostics
summary: Forensic histopathology, essential for determining cause of death and disease diagnosis, is severely impeded by postmortem autolysis, i.e., an irreversible, stochastic degradation process that distorts tissue morphology and introduces diagnostic subjectivity, thereby underscoring the value of restoring autolyzed images to a diagnostically plausible, pre-autolysis state for improving objectivity in forensic practice. This restoration task is fundamentally challenging due to the large, non-deterministic morphological changes caused by autolysis and the infeasibility of pixel-wise paired data, which invalidates assumptions underlying supervised and cycle/structure-consistent unpaired translation methods. To address this, we formalize forensic histopathology autolysis restoration as a new task: under unpaired supervision, transform postmortem images with severe autolysis into diagnostically meaningful ``antemortem'' representations. We contribute AutoPath, the first homologous yet unpaired dataset for this problem, constructed by splitting specimens into adjacent tissue blocks---one processed immediately, the other exposed to induce autolysis---yielding nearly ten thousand $10\times$ patches from 69 cases with varying liver conditions. We further frame the problem as a Schrödinger Bridge between the autolyzed and non-autolyzed distributions, offering a principled approach to modeling stochastic, severe morphological degradation. Critically, we demonstrate the misalignment of generic image-level generative metrics (e.g., FID) with diagnostic utility and propose a forensically grounded, slide-level diagnostic distribution consistency evaluation. Overall, this work establishes a reproducible benchmark (encompassing task definition, a real-world dataset, and an evaluation methodology) toward rigorous and practically meaningful progress in autolysis restoration for forensic pathology.

AI.tldr: 本文提出法医组织病理学自溶恢复这一新任务：在无配对监督下，将严重自溶的尸检图像转化为有诊断意义的"生前"表示。作者构建了首个同源但非配对的数据集AutoPath（69例、近万个patch），并将问题建模为自溶分布与非自溶分布之间的Schrödinger Bridge，同时提出基于诊断一致性的评估方法。
AI.motivation: 法医组织病理学是死因判定和疾病诊断的关键，但死后自溶（不可逆的随机降解过程）会扭曲组织形态并引入诊断主观性。将自溶图像恢复为诊断上合理的生前状态，对提高法医实践的客观性具有重要价值。然而，自溶导致的形态变化大且非确定性，且无法获得像素级配对数据，使得监督方法和循环/结构一致性的非配对翻译方法均失效。
AI.method: 1) 形式化定义自溶恢复任务：在非配对监督下将严重自溶的尸检图像转化为诊断上有意义的抗生前表示；2) 构建AutoPath数据集：将标本分割为相邻组织块，一块立即处理、另一块诱导自溶，得到69例不同肝脏疾病状况的近万个10x patch；3) 将问题建模为自溶分布与非自溶分布之间的Schrödinger Bridge，以原理化地建模随机、严重的形态退化。
AI.result: 证明了通用图像级生成指标（如FID）与诊断效用不一致，并提出基于法医实践的、切片级别的诊断分布一致性评估方法。建立了包含任务定义、真实数据集和评估方法学的可复现基准。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为法医病理学的自溶恢复建立了首个可复现基准（涵盖任务定义、真实世界数据集和评估方法），为在该方向开展严格且有实际意义的进展奠定了基础。

title: Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation in Construction via Zero-Shot Learning: A Diffusion Policy-Guided Adaptive Control
summary: Construction robotics and automation offer promising means of improving productivity, alleviating workforce shortages, and reducing workers' exposure to physically demanding tasks. However, reliable contact-rich robotic assembly remains challenging under tight tolerances, fabrication inaccuracies, and uncertain contact dynamics. To address this challenge, we present a framework coupling diffusion policies trained on simulation-generated pose and force/torque data with an L1-inspired adaptive controller that corrects policy-predicted actions online to compensate for unmodeled contact dynamics. We benchmark the framework against baselines in timber joinery, pipe fitting, and sequential full-scale truss assembly. It achieves 100% success on single-task assemblies and 90-100% success across sequential truss assembly subtasks, with lower, more stable contact forces than the baselines. By enabling zero-shot sim-to-real transfer for force-aware contact-rich assembly, the framework reduces costly, labor-intensive real-world data collection for policy training and advances scalable, robust automation of multistage assembly, motivating extension to broader contact-rich manipulation tasks in construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合扩散策略与L1自适应控制器的框架，用于建筑领域的接触丰富装配任务。扩散策略在仿真生成的位姿和力/力矩数据上训练，L1自适应控制器在线修正策略预测的动作以补偿未建模的接触动力学。在木工接合、管道连接和全尺寸桁架顺序装配中实现90-100%成功率，接触力更低更稳定，并支持零样本仿真到现实迁移。
AI.motivation: 建筑机器人和自动化有望提升生产率、缓解劳动力短缺并减少工人从事费力任务，但在严格公差、制造误差和不确定接触动力学下，可靠的接触丰富机器人装配仍具挑战性，且现实数据采集成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出一种耦合框架：1) 在仿真生成的位姿和力/力矩数据上训练扩散策略；2) 结合L1启发式自适应控制器，在线修正策略预测的动作以补偿未建模的接触动力学。
AI.result: 在木工接合、管道连接及顺序全尺寸桁架装配中，单任务装配实现100%成功率，顺序桁架装配子任务实现90-100%成功率，且接触力比基线更低更稳定。
AI.conclusion: 该框架实现力感知接触丰富装配的零样本仿真到现实迁移，减少昂贵的现实数据采集，推动可扩展、稳健的多阶段装配自动化，并可扩展到更广泛的建筑接触丰富操作任务。

title: HiMA-MDD: A Hierarchical Multi-Agent Harness for Interpretable Multimodal Depression Detection in Clinical Interviews
summary: Depression assessment from multimodal clinical interviews requires integrating dispersed evidence from multiple symptoms into a coherent PHQ-8 profile. This process is hierarchical: relevant evidence is often sparse and context-dependent within local question-answer exchanges, multiple exchanges jointly support symptom-level judgments, and the final assessment depends on the coherence of the complete symptom profile. Existing LLM systems either process interviews holistically or distribute work across generic agent roles; neither design necessarily provides an explicit orchestration mechanism that coordinates evidence access, item-score authority, bounded feedback, and state recording across these levels. To address this gap, we introduce HiMA-MDD, a hierarchical multi-agent harness that aligns this assessment hierarchy with three agent layers. After non-agentic preprocessing constructs context-preserving multimodal QA units, Layer 1 identifies candidate QA-to-item relations and supports bounded item-grounded evidence routing. Layer 2 assigns symptom groups to operational factor specialists, with one specialist responsible for each provisional item score. Layer 3 audits the complete provisional profile, requests at most one round of targeted revision, and reconstructs the verified PHQ-8 profile. This layered design naturally yields a Hierarchical Evidence Trace, preserves all intermediate evidence, judgments, and revisions for auditability. The final item scores then deterministically produce the total score and screening decision. Using Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct as the harness backbone, our experiments on E-DAIC demonstrate that HiMA-MDD outperforms the compared state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HiMA-MDD，一种分层多智能体架构，用于从多模态临床访谈中评估抑郁症（PHQ-8量表）。该架构通过三层智能体（证据路由层、因子专家层、审计修订层）显式协调从局部问答证据到症状评分再到最终画像的分层评估过程，并在E-DAIC数据集上超越现有最优方法。
AI.motivation: 抑郁症评估需要将分散在多个症状中的稀疏证据整合成连贯的PHQ-8画像，这一过程本质上是分层的。现有LLM系统要么整体处理访谈，要么在通用智能体角色间分配任务，缺乏显式的编排机制来协调各层级之间的证据访问、条目评分的权威性、有界反馈和状态记录。
AI.method: HiMA-MDD采用三层多智能体架构：预处理阶段通过非智能体方式构造保留上下文的模态QA单元；Layer 1识别候选QA与条目的关系，支持有界的条目证据路由；Layer 2将症状组分配给因子专家，每位专家负责一个临时条目评分；Layer 3审计完整临时画像，最多请求一轮定向修订，重建验证后的PHQ-8画像。该设计自然产生分层证据追踪，保留所有中间证据、判断和修订以供审计。以Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct为骨干。
AI.result: 在E-DAIC数据集上的实验表明，HiMA-MDD优于所比较的最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 分层多智能体编排机制能够更好地对齐抑郁症评估的分层结构，通过显式的证据路由、领域专家评分和有界审计修订，不仅提升性能还提供了完整的可审计证据链。

title: PatchGate: Narrowing the Verbalization Gap with Intrinsic Object Inventories in Frozen Vision-Language Models
comment: 31 pages, 9 figures. Code will be available
summary: Reliable image captioning in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) requires captions to be both precise and complete, avoiding unsupported object mentions while covering visible objects. Existing training-free methods primarily address the former requirement, suppressing unsupported object words by intervening on model-predicted mentions during generation. Because they operate only on objects the model is already likely to mention, visible objects omitted from the output remain difficult to recover. We propose PatchGate, a training-free framework that extracts prompt-free object evidence intrinsic to a frozen VLM before generation and uses it to narrow the gap between an intrinsic object set and final object mentions. In the first stage, Visual Evidence eXtraction (VEX) reads patch-level lexical evidence from the latter half of LM decoder layers and constructs an image-conditioned object set without any task prompt. In the second stage, Visual-Evidence Inclusion-Exclusion Decoding (VIED) uses this object evidence to calibrate decoding logits, promoting evidence-supported but under-verbalized objects and suppressing weakly supported but over-verbalized objects. On AMBER, PatchGate improves both sides of object-level reliability, increasing visible-object coverage from 49.4 to 56.0 (+13.4%) and reducing object hallucination by lowering CHAIR from 7.5 to 6.6 (-12.0%), without external detectors or fine-tuning and with one extra forward pass.

AI.tldr: PatchGate是一个无需训练的框架，通过从冻结VLM内部提取与提示无关的视觉对象证据，并在解码阶段校准logits，同时提升物体级描述精度（减少幻觉）与完整性（提高可见物体覆盖率），无需外部检测器或微调。
AI.motivation: 现有无训练方法仅通过干预模型已预测到的物体提及来抑制幻觉，只能作用于模型本就可能提到的对象，对输出中遗漏的可见物体难以恢复，无法同时兼顾描述的精确性和完整性。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段VEX从LM解码器后半层的patch级词法证据中提取图像条件对象集合（无需任务提示）；第二阶段VIED利用该对象证据校准解码logits，提升有证据支持但未被充分表述的对象，抑制证据薄弱但过度表述的对象。
AI.result: 在AMBER数据集上，可见对象覆盖率从49.4提升到56.0（+13.4%），CHAIR指标从7.5降至6.6（-12.0%），即同时改善了对象级可靠性两方面，且无需外部检测器或微调，仅需一次额外前向传播。
AI.conclusion: PatchGate通过利用模型内部固有的视觉证据而非依赖外部信号，有效弥合了内在对象集合与最终对象提及之间的差距，证明了无需训练即可同时提升VLM图像描述的精确性与完整性。

title: Meta-Ctrl: Guaranteed Plan Generation by Decoupling Syntactic and Semantic Constraints
summary: LLMs generate fluent plans for robots but routinely violate the syntactic and se8mantic constraints they must satisfy to execute, and existing remedies trade formal guarantees against plan quality: soft methods (affordance scoring, grounded decoding) give no guarantee, while symbolic planners (LLM+P) discard the LM's commonsense. We propose \textbf{Meta-Ctrl}, a constrained-decoding framework that guarantees the encoded constraints while preserving the base LM's plan quality. Meta-Ctrl introduces \emph{meta-tokens}---a compact vocabulary of grounded actions---enforcing syntax at the token level and semantics (preconditions, goals, ordering) at the action level, an exact factorization that cuts the memory of constrained decoding from over 107TB to under 2GB. With it, a small open-weight LM becomes competitive where it otherwise sits at the bottom of the leaderboard: on WAH-NL under the LoTa-Bench protocol it reaches the highest reported subgoal success rate, exceeding GPT-4's, with consistent gains across the Embodied Agent Interface. We further demonstrate it on a real tabletop robot, where every generated plan satisfies its preconditions and goals by construction. Project website: https://meta-ctrlg.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Meta-Ctrl，一种约束解码框架，通过引入"元标记"（meta-tokens）紧凑词汇表，在保证编码约束的前提下保留基础语言模型的规划质量。该方法将约束解码的内存需求从超过107TB降至2GB以下，使小型开源权重模型在WAH-NL基准上达到最高子目标成功率（超过GPT-4），并在真实桌面机器人上得到验证。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM机器人规划方法存在两难：软方法（如affordance评分、grounded decoding）无法提供形式化保证，而符号规划器（如LLM+P）则丢弃了语言模型的常识推理能力。研究者希望同时获得形式化约束保证和保留LLM的规划质量。
AI.method: 提出Meta-Ctrl约束解码框架，引入"元标记"（meta-tokens）作为grounded动作的紧凑词汇表，在token层面强制语法约束，在动作层面强制语义约束（前提条件、目标、排序）。通过精确分解，将约束解码的内存需求从超过107TB大幅压缩至2GB以下。
AI.result: 在LoTa-Bench协议下的WAH-NL基准上，小型开源权重模型达到最高报告的子目标成功率，超过GPT-4；在Embodied Agent Interface上取得一致增益；并在真实桌面机器人上展示所有生成计划都满足前提条件和目标。
AI.conclusion: Meta-Ctrl证明约束解码可以在提供形式化保证的同时保留LLM的规划质量，使小型开源模型在机器人规划任务中超越大型专有模型，为LLM机器人规划提供了一个兼顾保真度与性能的可行方案。

title: From Solver Feedback to Faithful Plans: Multi-Role Reinforcement Learning for Symbolic Planning
summary: Reliable planning requires converting natural-language instructions into executable symbolic specifications, yet large language models remain brittle without costly PDDL annotations and may exploit solver success in semantically unfaithful ways. We study how to learn faithful natural-language-to-PDDL formalization using only solver feedback, without human-written demonstrations. We propose a solvergrounded multi-role reinforcement learning framework where a single language model acts as an Actor, Judge, and Editor for generation, verification, and repair. The Actor proposes PDDL specifications, the Judge provides a solver-calibrated quality signal, and the Editor performs bounded diagnostic-conditioned refinement. On PlanBench, our method improves average success from 35.5% for LLM+P to 70.8%, achieves 66.3% faithful success, and reduces semantic drift to 6.4%. These results show that organizing solver feedback into generation, verification, and repair roles enables more scalable and faithful annotation-free symbolic planning

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于求解器反馈的多角色强化学习框架，让单一语言模型同时扮演Actor、Judge和Editor三个角色，实现无需人工标注的自然语言到PDDL形式化转换，在PlanBench上将平均成功率从35.5%提升至70.8%。
AI.motivation: 可靠的规划需要将自然语言指令转换为可执行的符号规范，而现有LLM方法依赖昂贵的PDDL标注，且可能以语义不忠实的方式利用求解器成功，缺乏可扩展且免标注的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出求解器锚定的多角色强化学习框架：单一LLM同时作为Actor（生成PDDL规范）、Judge（提供求解器校准的质量信号）和Editor（执行有界诊断条件精化），仅使用求解器反馈而无人类演示。
AI.result: 在PlanBench上，平均成功率从LLM+P的35.5%提升至70.8%，忠实成功率达66.3%，语义漂移降至6.4%。
AI.conclusion: 将求解器反馈组织为生成、验证和修复三个角色，能够实现更可扩展且忠实、免标注的符号规划形式化。

title: Towards Alias-Free 4D Gaussian Representations with Motion-Aware Filtering
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project Page: https://maaf-4dgs.github.io/
summary: Novel-view synthesis of dynamic scenes, crucial for AR/VR applications, remains a challenging problem. Recent methods adapt representations like 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) and Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) for dynamic scenes by incorporating time as the fourth dimension (4D representations). These 4D representations still suffer from aliasing artifacts, especially when generating novel views from divergent viewpoints (zoom-in/zoom-out operations). While using 3D smoothing filters like those proposed in Mip-Splatting might seem like a possible solution, they fail to account for local motion and also exhibit aliasing. To address this, we propose a motion-aware 3D smoothing filter specifically designed for 4D representations. Our approach adapts the filter strength based on local motion information, effectively mitigating aliasing without compromising rendering quality. This is achieved by estimating the joint density function of time and focal-to-depth ratio using a non-parametric estimation method. During inference, we sample from this joint distribution to determine the appropriate smoothing filter. This flexible strategy can be integrated with various 4D representations. Our evaluations on standard datasets demonstrate superior performance compared to state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种运动感知的3D平滑滤波器，用于解决动态场景4D表示（如动态3DGS和NeRF）在极端视角变化下产生的混叠伪影问题。该方法通过非参数估计时间与焦距-深度比的联合密度函数，在推理时采样以自适应调整滤波器强度，从而在不损失渲染质量的前提下有效缓解混叠。
AI.motivation: 动态场景的新视角合成在AR/VR中至关重要，但现有的4D表示（将时间作为第四维度的3DGS/NeRF）在发散视角（缩放操作）下会产生混叠伪影。简单的3D平滑滤波器（如Mip-Splatting）无法处理局部运动，仍会出现混叠。
AI.method: 提出一种运动感知的3D平滑滤波器：1) 通过非参数估计方法计算时间与焦距-深度比的联合密度函数；2) 推理时从该联合分布中采样以确定合适的平滑滤波器强度；3) 滤波器强度根据局部运动信息自适应调整，可集成到各种4D表示中。
AI.result: 在标准数据集上的评估表明，该方法相比现有最先进方法具有更优越的性能，有效缓解了混叠伪影且保持了渲染质量。
AI.conclusion: 运动感知的3D平滑滤波器是一种灵活且有效的解决方案，能够与多种4D表示集成，在动态场景的极端视角变化下显著改善渲染质量。

title: BehaviorWorldGen: Closing the Loop between Action Models and World Simulators via Controllable Behavior-Aware Structured World Generation
summary: Modern driving action models are increasingly improved in a self-improvement loop, where a learned world simulator imagines future observations and the resulting data is fed back to refine the action model. However, the bottleneck of this loop lies in the simulators' inability to generate behaviorally plausible responses by surrounding agents, making generated data both unrealistic in interaction and imbalanced in distribution. We introduce BehaviorWorldGen, a framework that closes the loop between action models and world simulators through controllable behavior-aware structured world generation. Its core component is BehaviorFlow, a meta-action-conditioned traffic-flow model that injects interpretable behavior controls and jointly generates multi-agent rollouts. BehaviorFlow realizes the specified agent behaviors while allowing surrounding vehicles to respond to the ego and to one another. The resulting rollouts are rendered by a world simulator into realistic multi-view observations, which are paired with corrected interaction-aware trajectories for action-model refinement. Since BehaviorWorldGen uses structured trajectories as the interface between its modules, it is compatible with diverse action models and world simulators. Experiments on world generation, scene extrapolation, and policy refinement demonstrate consistent improvements, with the largest benefits concentrated on difficult interactive scenarios.

AI.tldr: BehaviorWorldGen是一个通过可控行为感知的结构化世界生成框架，用于闭环自动驾驶动作模型与世界模拟器。其核心组件BehaviorFlow是一个元动作条件交通流模型，能够注入可解释的行为控制并联合生成多智能体轨迹，使周围车辆既能实现指定行为又能对自车和其他车辆做出响应，从而改善生成数据的真实性和分布均衡性。
AI.motivation: 现代驾驶动作模型通过自改进循环不断提升，其中学习到的世界模拟器想象未来观测并反馈数据以优化动作模型。然而该循环的瓶颈在于模拟器无法生成周围智能体行为上合理的响应，导致生成数据在交互上不真实且分布不均衡。
AI.method: 提出BehaviorWorldGen框架，通过可控行为感知的结构化世界生成来闭环动作模型与世界模拟器。核心组件BehaviorFlow是元动作条件交通流模型，注入可解释行为控制并联合生成多智能体轨迹。生成的滚动数据由世界模拟器渲染为多视角观测，并与修正后的交互感知轨迹配对用于动作模型精炼。由于使用结构化轨迹作为模块间接口，兼容多种动作模型和世界模拟器。
AI.result: 在世界生成、场景外推和策略精炼等实验上均表现出一致的改进，最大的收益集中在困难的交互场景中。
AI.conclusion: BehaviorWorldGen通过引入可解释的行为控制，解决了自改进循环中模拟器生成周围智能体行为不真实的瓶颈，实现了更逼真、更均衡的生成数据，从而有效提升动作模型的精炼效果，尤其在困难交互场景中优势显著。

title: Training Needs Trustworthy Worlds: Verified Synthetic Web Environments for Agent Learning
summary: Web agents promise to automate complex digital workflows, but their training remains limited by synthetic environments that look plausible while hiding broken links, inconsistent states, or infeasible tasks. We address the gap between scalable environment generation and trustworthy agent learning by constructing synthetic web environments that are executable, auditable, and grounded in backend state. Our framework represents each generated website as a structured scaffold of pages, navigation links, database records, state-change markers, and task constraints, then verifies and repairs structural, semantic, consistency, and feasibility defects before policy training. During interaction, ordinary UI transitions are executed deterministically, while persistent backend updates are invoked only through validated state-change markers, enabling dense rewards compiled from verified task-progress predicates. Across 500 synthetic environments spanning six domains, our method reduces task-blocking defects and improves feasible-task rate from 48.6% to 94.8%, while producing stronger PPO policies and improving transfer to WebArena, WebShop, and MiniWoB++ without LLM calls at evaluation time. These results show that verified synthetic environments can serve as a scalable and reliable training substrate for compact web agents, shifting synthetic webagent learning from surface-level plausibility toward executable, state-grounded supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种构建可执行、可审计且基于后端状态的合成网页环境框架，通过结构化脚手架表示网站并验证修复结构、语义、一致性和可行性缺陷，使合成环境从表面合理转向可执行、状态可落地的监督信号，显著提升了Agent训练效果和跨环境迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的合成网页环境看起来合理，但存在断链、状态不一致或任务不可行等问题，导致Agent训练受限。需要弥合"可扩展的环境生成"与"可信的Agent学习"之间的差距。
AI.method: 将每个生成网站表示为包含页面、导航链接、数据库记录、状态变更标记和任务约束的结构化脚手架；在策略训练前验证并修复结构、语义、一致性和可行性缺陷；交互中UI转换确定性执行，持久化后端更新仅通过验证的状态变更标记触发，并编译密集奖励信号。
AI.result: 在500个跨六个领域的合成环境中，将任务阻塞缺陷降低，可行任务率从48.6%提升至94.8%；训练出更强的PPO策略，并在WebArena、WebShop和MiniWoB++上实现更好的迁移性能，且评估时无需LLM调用。
AI.conclusion: 经过验证的合成环境可以作为可扩展且可靠的训练基础，推动合成网页Agent学习从表面合理性转向可执行、状态可落地的监督方式。

title: Towards Bitstream-corrupted Harsh Visual Understanding: Through Bitstream Language Modeling as Robust Semantic Priors
summary: Bitstream-corrupted Harsh Visual Understanding (BcHVU) aims to understand harshly degraded videos originally decoded from a severely corrupted bitstream in real-world multimedia communication. The ill-posed nature of BcHVU poses a major challenge for existing vision models, as even subtle bitstream corruption can lead to irreversible pixel distortion and significant semantic loss. To address these challenges in BcHVU, we propose Bitstream Language Modeling as Robust Semantic Priors (BLMSP), a framework for learning and injecting bitstream-native semantic cues. Our proposed BLMSP framework learns to extract bitstream-native semantic cues by bitstream language modeling, and leverages them as priors by injecting into off-the-shelf vision models of BcHVU tasks. Specifically, we present a Video Bitstream Byte Model (VBBM) that integrates byte-level modeling and cross-codec semantic distillation, enabling it to interpret robust semantics from byte sequences in multiple corrupted bitstream formats. The learned bitstream semantics are leveraged as robust priors and fused into BcHVU model backbones for improving the quality of video restoration, captioning, and human pose estimation. To train BLMSP, we construct a large-scale multi-source Corrupted-bitstream Harsh-video Paired (CHP) dataset containing 607k corrupted bitstream segments and 287k paired harsh video clips. Extensive experimental results show that the learned bitstream priors improve video restoration, captioning, and human pose estimation by 2.51 dB in PSNR, 0.20 in CIDEr, and 0.18 in PCK@0.2 on average, respectively. These results demonstrate that corrupted bitstream can serve as robust semantic priors in solving pixel distortion and semantic loss in BcHVU.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BLMSP框架，通过比特流语言建模学习比特流原生语义线索，并将其作为鲁棒先验注入现成视觉模型，以解决比特流损坏下的恶劣视频理解（BcHVU）问题。该框架在视频恢复、描述和人体姿态估计三个任务上均取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: BcHVU任务中，损坏的比特流会导致不可逆的像素失真和严重的语义损失，由于问题的不适定性，现有视觉模型难以应对。即便是细微的比特流损坏也可能造成重大影响，因此需要新的方法来利用比特流本身的语义信息作为鲁棒先验。
AI.method: 提出BLMSP框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) Video Bitstream Byte Model (VBBM)，融合字节级建模和跨编解码器语义蒸馏，能够从多种损坏比特流格式的字节序列中解读鲁棒语义；(2) 将学习到的比特流语义作为先验注入BcHVU模型主干。同时构建了包含607k损坏比特流片段和287k配对恶劣视频片段的CHP大规模数据集进行训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，学习到的比特流先验在视频恢复、描述和人体姿态估计任务上分别平均提升2.51 dB (PSNR)、0.20 (CIDEr)和0.18 (PCK@0.2)，验证了损坏比特流可作为鲁棒语义先验解决像素失真和语义损失问题。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明损坏的比特流本身可以充当鲁棒语义先验，为BcHVU任务提供有效的解决方案，突破了传统仅从像素层面处理损坏视频的局限。

title: DreamMimic: Learning Visuomotor Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation via World Model
summary: Vision-based whole-body loco-manipulation on humanoid robots is challenging due to partial observability, contact-rich dynamics, and the difficulty of learning long-horizon behaviors from high-dimensional visual inputs. We present \href{https://github.com/DreamMimic/DreamMimic}{DreamMimic}, a framework that distills privileged teacher policies into vision-based humanoid controllers via world-model-assisted distillation. Instead of using a Dreamer-style RSSM for planning, we repurpose it to learn predictive latent dynamics that serve as both a representation space and an action-conditioned multi-step supervision signal, while exposing compact predictive features to the student policy to reduce long-term drift. Beyond standard reconstruction objectives for proprioceptive and visual observations, we add auxiliary prediction heads for privileged state, contact, object state, and reward estimation. These heads provide additional supervision related to agent--object interaction and task progress, encouraging the latent representation to retain signals that are useful for contact-rich loco-manipulation. We further introduce Performance-Conditioned Guidance (PCG), a reward-driven adaptive distillation schedule that computes performance scores for both teacher and student to dynamically balance guidance and exploration. PCG prevents both premature teacher annealing and excessive teacher interference in challenging visual settings. Experiments on OMOMO and BEHAVE show improved tracking-based loco-manipulation performance over strong vision-based baselines, without exposing online privileged interaction states to the student at deployment. Qualitative simulations further examine morphology and simulator changes. These results suggest that world models can provide a useful mechanism for stabilizing visual policy distillation in contact-rich humanoid behaviors.

AI.tldr: DreamMimic是一个将特权教师策略蒸馏为基于视觉的人形机器人控制器的框架，通过世界模型辅助蒸馏实现全身定位-操作任务。它将Dreamer风格的RSSM重构为预测性潜在动力学模型，既作为表征空间又作为多步监督信号，并引入性能条件引导(PCG)的自适应蒸馏调度。
AI.motivation: 基于视觉的人形机器人全身定位-操作任务面临部分可观测性、接触丰富动力学以及从高维视觉输入学习长时程行为的困难，现有方法难以有效将这些复杂行为从特权教师策略迁移到纯视觉的学生策略。
AI.method: 1) 将Dreamer风格RSSM重新用于学习预测性潜在动力学，同时作为表征空间和动作条件多步监督信号；2) 暴露紧凑的预测特征给学生策略以减少长期漂移；3) 增加特权状态、接触、物体状态和奖励估计的辅助预测头，增强与agent-物体交互和任务进展相关的监督；4) 引入Performance-Conditioned Guidance (PCG)，一种奖励驱动的自适应蒸馏调度，动态平衡引导与探索。
AI.result: 在OMOMO和BEHAVE基准上相比强视觉基线方法取得了改进的追踪式定位-操作性能，同时不向部署阶段的学生暴露在线特权交互状态。定性仿真进一步检验了形态学和模拟器的变化。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型可以为接触丰富的人形机器人行为中稳定视觉策略蒸馏提供有用的机制。

title: Consistency Is Not Coherence: Orientation Search for Certified Alignments Between 4D Defence Upper Ontologies
comment: 14 pages. Long paper accepted at the Ontology Matching 2026 workshop (OM 2026), co-located with ISWC 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/fabio-rovai/ies-hqdm-crosswalk
summary: We align three upper ontologies that sit under UK and NATO defence data infrastructure: the Information Exchange Standard (IES), the Higher Quality Data Model (HQDM) that underpins the National Digital Twin, and Basic Formal Ontology (BFO). No public alignment between IES and HQDM existed. Promoting a hand-curated 17-correspondence crosswalk to OWL and reasoning over the complete merged ontologies with HermiT produces three results that we believe matter beyond this pair.

AI.tldr: 本文对齐了英国和北约国防数据基础设施下的三个上层本体：IES、HQDM和BFO。作者将手工策划的17条对应关系转化为OWL，并使用HermiT推理器对完整合并后的本体进行推理，得出了三个超越这一特定配对的重要发现。
AI.motivation: IES与HQDM之间此前不存在公开的对齐关系，而这些本体分别支撑着不同的关键国防数据基础设施（IES用于信息交换标准，HQDM支撑国家数字孪生）。作者希望通过OWL形式和推理来建立系统性的对齐。
AI.method: 将手工策划的17条对应关系的交叉映射（crosswalk）转化为OWL本体，然后使用HermiT推理器对完整合并的三个本体进行推理分析。
AI.result: 通过HermiT推理器对合并后的完整本体进行推理，产生了三个被认为具有超越本特定对齐配对的重要结果。
AI.conclusion: 这项对齐工作不仅填补了IES与HQDM之间公开对齐的空白，而且其方法论和推理发现对更广泛的本体对齐实践具有参考价值。

title: FIRM-Video: Check Before You Score for Reliable Text-to-Video Reward Modeling
summary: Reliable reward models are essential for text-to-video evaluation and alignment. However, the trade-off between evaluation accuracy and inference efficiency places high demands on the quality of training supervision. Existing approaches often rely on holistic judges with fixed rubrics or open-ended reasoning, leading to incomplete inspection, unfaithful justification, and entangled attribution. We introduce FIRM-Video, a unified checklist-driven data construction framework based on a check-before-score principle: construct dimension-specific checklists, verify each criterion against temporal visual evidence, and aggregate only verified decisions. For Instruction Following, FIRM-Video decomposes prompts into weighted atomic requirements; for World Coherence, it constructs prompt-calibrated, target-specific checks grounded in visible entities and actions; and for Perceptual Quality, it applies a generic taxonomy of visual defects. The verified criteria and scores are further transformed into natural-language analyses for end-to-end reward modeling. Subsequently, we construct FIRM-Video-90K with 88,044 dimension-specific instances from 29,348 videos, and introduce FIRM-Video-Bench with 750 point-wise human annotations across 250 videos. The Qwen3-VL-based FIRM-Video-8B achieves the best overall MAE on FIRM-Video-Bench while consistently delivering the highest VBench Total, Quality, and Semantic Scores in Best-of-8 sampling across three video generators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FIRM-Video，一个基于check-before-score原则的统一清单驱动数据构建框架，用于文本到视频评估与对齐中的奖励建模。通过维度特定的检查清单验证时间视觉证据，并仅聚合经证实的决策，构建了FIRM-Video-90K数据集和FIRM-Video-Bench基准，其Qwen3-VL-based 8B模型在MAE和VBench评分上均达到最优。
AI.motivation: 现有视频奖励模型依赖固定评分规则的整体评估器或开放推理方法，导致检查不完整、论证不可信以及归因纠缠的问题。评估准确性与推理效率之间的权衡对训练监督质量提出了高要求，需要更可靠的奖励建模方法。
AI.method: 基于check-before-score原则：先构建维度特定检查清单，再对照时间视觉证据逐条验证标准，最后仅聚合经过验证的决策。对指令遵循将提示分解为加权原子需求；对世界一致性构建基于可见实体和动作的提示校准目标特定检查；对感知质量应用通用视觉缺陷分类。验证后的标准和分数进一步转化为自然语言分析用于端到端奖励建模。
AI.result: 构建了含88,044个维度特定实例的FIRM-Video-90K数据集（来自29,348个视频），以及含750个点级人工标注的FIRM-Video-Bench基准（覆盖250个视频）。基于Qwen3-VL的FIRM-Video-8B在FIRM-Video-Bench上取得最优整体MAE，并在三个视频生成器的Best-of-8采样中持续获得最高的VBench Total、Quality和Semantic分数。
AI.conclusion: 清单驱动的检查-再评分方法能有效提升视频奖励模型的评估准确性和可靠性，在准确性、推理效率和可解释性之间取得更好平衡。

title: Beyond Instance Slots: Semantically Rich World Models for Physical Interaction Planning
summary: World models for physical interaction are typically trained to predict future observations or latent features; however, a planning-oriented model must answer a fundamentally different question: whether a candidate action produces a task-consistent future while preserving essential relations.Monolithic state representations obscure the underlying entities, while standard instance-level object slots merely identify \emph{what} is present without specifying \emph{what role} each entity plays in the task context. To bridge this gap, we present the Semantically Rich World Model (SR-WM), a task-conditioned world model structured around five functional roles: gripper, target, goal, relation, and phase.Within SR-WM, a visual entity encoder extracts soft entity hypotheses from pretrained patch features, allowing segmentation masks to serve as optional proposal priors without mandating them as required state representations or inference inputs.A role binder subsequently maps these hypotheses to task-specific roles, while an action-conditioned dynamics model predicts role transitions alongside fine-grained semantics, including grasp/contact, predicate establishment, relation preservation, fixture state, and phase change.Crucially, this unified role state grounds downstream multi-candidate action generation, stage-aware reranking, and violation-aware suffix resampling.Our comprehensive evaluation protocol spans all four LIBERO simulation suites, cross-suite transfer, perception diagnostics, and action-sensitivity analysis.Ultimately, this formulation transforms object-centric prediction into a semantic interface linking visual dynamics with planning-oriented decision making.

AI.tldr: SR-WM是一个任务条件化的世界模型，围绕五个功能角色（抓取器、目标、目的、关系和阶段）构建。通过视觉实体编码器提取软实体假设，角色绑定器将这些假设映射到任务特定角色，动作条件动力学模型预测角色转换及细粒度语义。该模型支持多候选动作生成、阶段感知重排序和违规感知后缀重采样，并在LIBERO基准上全面验证。
AI.motivation: 传统世界模型预测未来观测或潜在特征，但规划导向的模型需要回答不同的问题：候选动作是否产生任务一致的未来并保持关键关系。单体状态表示掩盖了底层实体，而标准的实例级对象槽仅识别"什么"存在，未指定每个实体在任务上下文中扮演"什么角色"。
AI.method: SR-WM包含三个核心组件：(1)视觉实体编码器从预训练patch特征中提取软实体假设，分割掩码作为可选先验而非必需输入；(2)角色绑定器将实体假设映射到五个功能角色（抓取器、目标、目的、关系、阶段）；(3)动作条件动力学模型预测角色转换及精细语义（抓取/接触、谓词建立、关系保持、夹具状态、阶段变化）。该统一角色状态支撑多候选动作生成、阶段感知重排序和违规感知后缀重采样。
AI.result: 评估覆盖LIBERO全部四个仿真套件，包括跨套件迁移、感知诊断和动作敏感性分析，验证了所提公式的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该公式将对象中心预测转变为语义接口，连接视觉动力学与规划导向的决策制定。

title: ESCRAG-R1: Retrieval-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Emotional Support Conversation
summary: Emotional Support Conversation (ESC) systems aim to provide holistic support by balancing professional therapeutic competence with natural empathy. However, existing methods struggle to simultaneously achieve structured, stage-aware reasoning and seamless empathy-expertise alignment, often resulting in an artificial splicing of clinical strategies and generic reassurance. To overcome these limitations, we propose ESCRAG-R1, a unified framework that integrates retrieval-based psychological guidance into Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). By incorporating retrieval into the reinforcement learning loop, ESCRAG-R1 transforms external knowledge into a robust learning signal that stimulates explicit internal reasoning prior to generation and fundamentally reshapes the model's internal policy. To provide the reliable supervision required for this optimization, we construct ESC-Preference, a high-quality dataset based on a Client--Counselor--Judge evaluation framework that delivers precise, empathy-aware reward signals. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ESCRAG-R1 significantly outperforms existing baselines by mitigating superficial splicing and realizing a natural integration of professional guidance and empathetic expression. Code and datasets are released at https://github.com/Matcha-Liu/ESCRAG-R1.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ESCRAG-R1，一个将检索式心理指导整合进GRPO强化学习框架的统一情感支持对话系统，通过构建ESC-Preference数据集提供共情感知奖励信号，实现专业治疗能力与自然共情的深度融合。
AI.motivation: 现有情感支持对话系统难以同时实现结构化的阶段感知推理与自然的共情-专业性对齐，常常导致临床策略与通用安慰的生硬拼接，缺乏统一的推理与表达框架。
AI.method: 提出ESCRAG-R1统一框架，将基于检索的心理指导融入GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）强化学习循环中，使外部知识转化为稳健的学习信号，激发生成前的显式内部推理并重塑模型内部策略。同时构建基于Client-Counselor-Judge三层评估框架的ESC-Preference高质量数据集，提供精准的共情感知奖励信号以支撑优化。
AI.result: 大量实验表明ESCRAG-R1显著优于现有基线，有效缓解了表面拼接问题，实现了专业指导与共情表达的自然融合。代码和数据集已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过将检索增强与GRPO强化学习相结合，并以三评估者框架构建的高质量偏好数据为监督信号，ESCRAG-R1证明了检索知识可以作为强化学习的稳健学习信号，从而推动情感支持对话系统实现专业性与共情性的有机统一。

title: BC-IHV: Conditioning the Color Space for Stable Rectified-Flow Low-Light Enhancement
summary: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) must correct ambiguous exposure without overwriting structure already supported by the input. Generative transport can model exposure ambiguity; however, its flexibility may also alter observable geometry and chromatic content. Moreover, fixed invertible color coordinates are usually treated only as representations, although their inverse mappings reshape the RGB-domain gradients received by the enhancement network. To address these issues, we propose Structure-Anchored Rectified Flow (SA-RF), which maintains correspondence through separate chromaticity/intensity stems, a scale-matched condition pyramid, and HybridAda. HybridAda assigns location-specific retrieval to spatial cross-attention and global exposure modulation to pooled AdaLN. We further introduce BC-IHV, a learnable Box--Cox polar color space whose analytically invertible intensity mapping controls the inverse-gradient dynamic range through a single exponent. This allows the representation to balance dark-range expansion and gradient conditioning instead of adopting a fixed linear or logarithmic law. Experiments on three LOL benchmarks, blind image-quality evaluation, and cross-dataset tests demonstrate consistent reconstruction and perceptual advantages over the sota. Controlled studies further support the effectiveness of both the proposed framework and color representation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SA-RF（结构锚定整流流）框架用于低光图像增强，通过分离色度/强度双分支、尺度匹配条件金字塔和HybridAda模块保持结构一致性；同时引入可学习的Box-Cox极坐标色彩空间BC-IHV，用单个指数调控逆梯度动态范围，平衡暗区扩展与梯度条件化，在多项基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 低光图像增强需要校正模糊曝光但不能破坏输入中已有的结构。生成式传输能建模曝光模糊性，但灵活性可能改变可观测几何与色彩内容；此外固定可逆色彩坐标仅被视为表示，其逆映射会重塑RGB域梯度，影响增强网络训练。
AI.method: 提出SA-RF框架：(1)通过分离的色度/强度双分支维持对应关系；(2)尺度匹配条件金字塔；(3)HybridAda模块，将位置特定检索分配给空间交叉注意力，全局曝光调制分配给池化AdaLN。另提出BC-IHV——一种可学习的Box-Cox极坐标色彩空间，其解析可逆的强度映射通过单一指数控制逆梯度动态范围。
AI.result: 在三个LOL基准、盲图像质量评估和跨数据集测试中展现一致的图像重建和感知优势，超过现有最先进方法。消融研究验证了框架与色彩表示两方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 结构锚定与可学习色彩空间相结合，能同时解决曝光模糊与结构保持的矛盾，为低光增强提供了更稳健的表示与传输方案。

title: TONAV: Task-Oriented Navigation and Action-Velocity Chunk Learning for Articulated Object Quadrupedal Mobile Manipulation
comment: The project page is at https://haochen611.github.io/TONAV
summary: Quadruped mobile manipulation requires two tightly coupled capabilities: reaching manipulation-ready configurations and maintaining stable contact throughout articulated-object interaction. However, existing methods often terminate navigation near the target, leaving a gap between reachability and manipulation readiness, while tracking lag, motion jitter, and contact instability limit continuous interaction. To address these challenges, we present TONAV, a unified framework integrating task-oriented navigation with action-velocity chunk learning. First, we introduce a position-velocity-coupled teleoperation framework that explicitly captures motion dynamics to improve master-follower consistency and collect smooth, temporally consistent demonstrations. Next, task-oriented navigation leverages vision-language reasoning to decompose high-level instructions into executable subgoals and adaptively refine the robot base toward a manipulation-ready configuration. Finally, action-velocity chunk learning jointly models joint positions and their temporal transitions under velocity supervision, enabling smooth and stable sustained-contact manipulation. Real-world experiments across diverse articulated-object tasks demonstrate that TONAV achieves higher success rates in both task-oriented navigation and complete mobile manipulation, mitigating the navigation-manipulation gap and improving continuous-contact interaction. The project page is at https://haochen611.github.io/TONAV.

AI.tldr: TONAV是一个统一框架，将任务导向导航与动作-速度块学习相结合，解决四足移动操作中导航与操作就绪性之间的差距以及连续接触不稳定问题。通过位置-速度耦合遥操作、视觉语言推理分解子目标以及动作-速度块学习，在实际关节物体任务中取得了更高的成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有四足移动操作方法常在目标附近终止导航，导致可达性与操作就绪性之间存在差距；同时跟踪延迟、运动抖动和接触不稳定限制了与关节物体的连续交互。这些问题源于导航与操作两个能力缺乏紧耦合。
AI.method: 提出TONAV统一框架，包含三个关键组件：(1)位置-速度耦合的遥操作框架，显式捕获运动动力学以提升主从一致性并采集平滑时间一致的演示；(2)任务导向导航，利用视觉语言推理将高级指令分解为可执行子目标，并自适应调整机器人基座到操作就绪构型；(3)动作-速度块学习，在速度监督下联合建模关节位置及其时间变化，实现平滑稳定的持续接触操作。
AI.result: 在多种关节物体任务上的真实世界实验中，TONAV在任务导向导航和完整移动操作两方面均取得更高成功率，缓解了导航-操作差距并改善了连续接触交互。
AI.conclusion: TONAV通过统一导航与操作框架，有效弥合了可达性与操作就绪性之间的差距，实现了平滑且稳定的持续接触移动操作，为四足机器人复杂交互任务提供了可行方案。

title: GuardianBench: A Same-Scene Instruction-Contrastive Benchmark for Latent Contextual Risk in Embodied AI
summary: In embodied AI, safety risk can be latent: a benign instruction and a safe scene become hazardous only when composed. Prior work has advanced embodied safety by varying visual contexts or evaluating execution-time dynamics, but the complementary axis of fixing the scene and varying only the instruction remains underexplored. We introduce GuardianBench, an instruction-contrastive benchmark grounded in international safety standards that isolates this latent contextual risk through 3,024 instruction-scene examples organized as same-scene Safe/Unsafe contrastive pairs across various hazard categories. Benchmarking state-of-the-art vision-language models (VLMs) reveals instruction-insensitive verdicts: models disproportionately approve both instructions under a given scene; across the primary models, average pair accuracy is only 24.1%. Our systematic rationale audit localizes the dominant failure: models fail to bind the instruction-relevant cues that differentiate safe from unsafe compositions. As a post-training case study, Verdict Log-Odds Supervision (VLOS), a lightweight verdict-level objective, substantially improves performance on open-weight backbones. Together, our latent contextual risk task formulation, standards-grounded contrastive benchmark construction, pair-level and rationale-level failure diagnosis, and benchmark-enabled verdict calibration establish GuardianBench as a controlled evaluation suite for exposing and improving safety reasoning over instruction-scene compositions under latent contextual risk.

AI.tldr: GuardianBench是一个基于国际安全标准的指令对比基准，通过3024个同场景安全/不安全对比样本对，系统性地暴露并评估具身AI中"潜在情境风险"——即良性指令与安全场景组合后才显现的危险。基准测试显示主流VLM的配对准确率仅24.1%，并诊断出模型无法绑定指令相关线索这一核心失败原因，同时提出轻量级训练目标VLOS可显著提升开权重模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有具身安全研究工作主要从视觉情境变化或执行时动态两个维度进行评估，但忽略了固定场景、仅变化指令这一互补维度。这种潜在情境风险（指令和场景单独看都安全，组合后却危险）尚未被系统探索，需要专门的基准来暴露和评估这类风险。
AI.method: 1) 构建GuardianBench基准：基于国际安全标准，设计3024个指令-场景示例，组织为同场景下Safe/Unsafe对比对，覆盖多种危害类别；2) 对主流VLM进行系统基准测试；3) 进行系统的推理理由审计以定位失败模式；4) 提出VLOS（Verdict Log-Odds Supervision）轻量级判定级训练目标作为后训练案例。
AI.result: 主流VLM在GuardianBench上表现不佳，平均配对准确率仅24.1%，呈现"指令不敏感判定"现象——模型在给定场景下不成比例地批准两种指令。这导致VLM对指令-场景组合中的潜在情境风险缺乏有效的安全推理能力。VLOS后训练能显著提升开权重模型的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: GuardianBench作为一个受控评估套件，通过潜在情境风险任务形式化、标准支撑的对比基准构建、配对级与推理级失败诊断以及基准驱动的判定校准，为暴露和改善指令-场景组合下的安全推理提供了系统化的评估框架与改进路径。

title: GaussVid: Sparse-View Gaussian Splatting with 3D-Aware Video Diffusion Priors
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has achieved remarkable success in novel view synthesis; however, reconstructions under sparse views often exhibit noticeable artifacts. While recent video diffusion models provide strong spatio-temporal priors for 3DGS restoration, directly fine-tuning them for restoration is suboptimal, as they lack awareness of the underlying multi-camera geometry, resulting in multi-view inconsistencies. In this work, we propose a novel 3D-aware video restoration framework designed to enhance the quality of sparse 3DGS reconstruction. Specifically, we construct a large-scale 3DGS video dataset to enable specialized fine-tuning. To bridge the gap between 2D video generation and 3D multi-view constraints, we introduce a camera-conditioned geometric prior. By using the first and last frames as boundary anchors and encoding the corresponding camera relationships, we explicitly inject spatial structure into the video generation pipeline. This boundary-anchored, camera-aware prior guides the network toward geometrically grounded restoration that remains coherent across viewpoints. Extensive experiments show that, among video-prior restoration methods, our approach attains the best pixel- and structure-level fidelity (PSNR/SSIM) and improves multi-view consistency, while remaining competitive in perceptual quality (LPIPS).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种3D感知的视频修复框架，用于提升稀疏视角3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）重建质量。通过构建大规模3DGS视频数据集进行专门微调，并引入相机条件几何先验（以首尾帧为边界锚点并编码相机关系），将空间结构显式注入视频生成流程，实现跨视角一致且几何可靠的修复，在像素级和结构级保真度上达到最优。
AI.motivation: 已有的稀疏视角3DGS重建常出现明显伪影；虽然视频扩散模型提供了强大的时空先验，但直接微调它们进行修复并不理想，因为它们缺乏对底层多相机几何的感知，导致多视角不一致。
AI.method: 1)构建大规模3DGS视频数据集以支持专门微调；2)引入相机条件几何先验，利用首帧和末帧作为边界锚点，编码对应的相机关系，将空间结构显式注入视频生成管线，引导网络进行几何上有根据且跨视角一致的修复。
AI.result: 在视频先验修复方法中，所提方法在像素级和结构级保真度（PSNR/SSIM）上取得最佳效果，提升了多视角一致性，同时在感知质量（LPIPS）上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 边界锚定、相机感知的先验能够有效弥合2D视频生成与3D多视角约束之间的鸿沟，为稀疏3DGS重建修复提供了一种更几何可靠的方案。

title: The Imitator Game: Benchmarking Robot Imitative Ability Beyond Action Prediction
summary: Humans imitate at the level of intent: given a demonstration, we infer its goal and carry it out with whatever tools, objects, and layouts are at hand. Current robot policies instead learn observation-to-action mappings from visual inputs and language instructions, without explicitly inferring the demonstrated task. Learning from human video thus remains largely trajectory-level: models can replay motions in near-identical scenes, but still struggle to imitate what the demonstrator intends rather than merely what they do. We introduce The Imitator Game, a four-level benchmark (L0-L3) that progressively widens the gap between the human demonstration and the robot's own scene, isolating where trajectory replay ceases to suffice and task understanding becomes necessary. We pair it with IG-10K, the largest environment-aligned paired human-robot dataset to date and the only one instantiated across all four levels in both real and simulated settings (20,000+ paired episodes, 50+ tasks, 6 domains), and Imitator Arena, an open platform for blind A/B human evaluation. Across nine state-of-the-art models, performance is stable from L0 to L2 but collapses at L3, identifying functional substitution - achieving the same intent through a different object affordance - as the decisive barrier to intent-level imitation. Human-video-conditioned models outperform caption-conditioned ones, yet every model falls below 13% zero-shot success on unseen tasks; fine-tuning IG-10K-pretrained models with only $10$ paired human-robot demonstrations yields large gains that grow with pretraining scale. The project website and access to Imitator Arena are available at https://imitator-game.github.io.

AI.tldr: 本文提出The Imitator Game基准（L0-L3四级），用于评估机器人是否能在意图层面模仿人类演示。配套发布IG-10K数据集（最大规模环境对齐的人-机器人配对数据集）和Imitator Arena盲评平台。实验发现所有模型在L3（功能替代）阶段性能骤降，揭示当前模型缺乏意图级模仿能力。
AI.motivation: 人类模仿是基于意图的：推断演示的目标，然后用手头任何工具、物体和场景布局来完成。但当前机器人策略只学习从观察到动作的映射，无法显式推断演示任务，导致从人类视频学习停留在轨迹层面——只能在近乎相同的场景中回放动作，而无法模仿演示者的真实意图。现有基准缺乏系统性地隔离"轨迹回放"与"任务理解"差距的评估框架。
AI.method: 1) 设计The Imitator Game四层基准（L0-L3），逐步扩大人类演示与机器人场景之间的差距；2) 构建IG-10K数据集，包含20,000+配对片段、50+任务、6个领域，覆盖真实与仿真环境的全部四个层级；3) 开发Imitator Arena开放平台，用于盲评A/B人类评估；4) 对九个SOTA模型进行全面评估。
AI.result: 模型在L0到L2表现稳定，但在L3（功能替代——通过不同物体功能实现相同意图）性能崩溃。人类视频条件模型优于字幕条件模型，但所有模型在新任务上的零样本成功率均低于13%。用仅10对人类-机器人演示对IG-10K预训练模型进行微调，能带来随预训练规模增长的大幅性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 功能替代（以不同物体功能实现相同意图）是意图级模仿的决定性障碍，当前模型在此方面存在根本性缺陷。但IG-10K预训练配合少量配对演示微调展现了有希望的改进方向，说明更大规模的配对数据和预训练可能是通向意图级模仿的可行路径。

title: Multimodal Prompt Learning with Irregular EHRs for Robust Monitoring of Critical Care Patients
summary: Accurate assessment of patients in intensive care units (ICUs) is essential for timely clinical intervention and improved patient outcomes. Multimodal electronic health records (EHRs), including structured physiological time series and longitudinal clinical notes, provide complementary information for critical care prediction. However, in real-world clinical settings, individual modalities may be partially observed or entirely unavailable, resulting in substantial performance degradation for existing multimodal models. To address this challenge, we propose a multimodal prompt-learning framework for robust clinical prediction under diverse missing-modality scenarios. The proposed framework introduces four complementary types of prompts: generative prompts, missing-signal prompts, missing-type prompts, and temporal prompts. Generative prompts construct surrogate latent representations for unavailable modalities, while missing-signal prompts distinguish observed representations from generated ones. Missing-type prompts condition the model on different modality-availability configurations, whereas temporal prompts perform condition-specific aggregation over temporally encoded clinical sequences. Together, these prompts enable the model to capture missingness-aware intramodal dependencies and cross-modal interactions within a unified architecture. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches across evaluation metrics on two missingness settings. Ablation and robustness analyses further verify the complementary contributions of the four prompt types and the effectiveness of the proposed framework for clinical prediction from incomplete multimodal EHR data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多模态提示学习框架，用于在缺失模态场景下进行稳健的ICU临床预测。该框架引入四类互补提示（生成提示、缺失信号提示、缺失类型提示和时间提示），在统一架构中捕获缺失感知的模态内依赖和跨模态交互，实验证明其优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: ICU患者需要及时准确的临床评估，多模态电子健康记录（结构化生理时间序列+纵向临床笔记）能提供互补信息。然而真实临床环境中模态可能部分缺失或完全不可用，导致现有多模态模型性能严重下降，需要一种能应对缺失模态的稳健预测方法。
AI.method: 提出多模态提示学习框架，包含四类互补提示：(1) 生成提示（Generative Prompts）为缺失模态构造替代潜在表示；(2) 缺失信号提示（Missing-signal Prompts）区分观测表示与生成表示；(3) 缺失类型提示（Missing-type Prompts）根据不同模态可用性配置条件化模型；(4) 时间提示（Temporal Prompts）对时间编码的临床序列执行条件特定聚合。四类提示在统一架构中协同工作，捕获缺失感知的模态内依赖和跨模态交互。
AI.result: 在两种缺失设置下的广泛实验表明，该方法在评估指标上优于现有方法。消融研究和稳健性分析进一步验证了四类提示的互补贡献，以及该框架在不完整多模态EHR数据上进行临床预测的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该多模态提示学习框架能够有效应对真实临床环境中常见的模态缺失问题，通过四类互补提示实现稳健的临床预测，为不完整多模态EHR数据上的预测任务提供了新的解决方案。

title: Frame-Level Evaluation in Weakly Supervised Video Anomaly Detection Mostly Measures Video-Level Ranking
summary: Weakly supervised video anomaly detectors are trained with video-level labels but are commonly evaluated as temporal localizers using Micro-AUROC or AP over pooled test frames. Because these metrics compare frames from different videos, a detector can score well by separating videos without accurately ordering moments within them. We exactly decompose Micro-AUROC by video identity into Within-AUROC for temporal ordering within videos and Cross-AUROC for comparisons across videos. Across ShanghaiTech, XD-Violence, and UCF-Crime, only 0.071-0.388% of comparisons between anomalous and normal frames occur within the same video. When both classes remain distributed across V videos, this share decreases as O(1/V), a benchmark property we call temporal dilution. We train anomaly video binary classifiers under the same video-level supervision and repeat each video score across all frames. These video-constant outputs reach 81.40-97.18 Micro-AUROC despite having no within-video variation. Across 72 controlled runs, replacing every frame score with its video mean preserves a median 98.6% of the Micro-AUROC margin above chance. The same empirical pattern holds for author-released outputs and for XD-Violence under its official AP evaluation. A detector can therefore achieve a high pooled score even when it assigns the same score to every moment within each video.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示弱监督视频异常检测器使用的Micro-AUROC/AP评估指标存在严重缺陷：由于绝大多数异常帧与正常帧的比较发生在不同视频之间（仅0.071-0.388%在同一视频内），检测器只需给不同视频分配不同分数即可取得高分，甚至可以对视频内所有帧赋相同分数（无时间定位能力）却仍达到81.40-97.18的Micro-AUROC。
AI.motivation: 弱监督视频异常检测器在训练时使用视频级标签，但评估时却作为时间定位器使用Micro-AUROC或AP来评估帧级别预测。这些指标混合了不同视频的帧进行比较，可能掩盖检测器在视频内部时间排序能力上的不足——一个检测器即使无法准确定位异常时刻，只要能区分不同视频就能获得高分。
AI.method: 1) 将Micro-AUROC精确分解为Within-AUROC（视频内时间排序）和Cross-AUROC（跨视频比较）两部分；2) 在ShanghaiTech、XD-Violence、UCF-Crime三个数据集上量化两类比较的占比；3) 训练仅依赖视频级监督的二元分类器，为每个视频的所有帧赋相同分数，测试其Micro-AUROC表现；4) 进行72组受控实验，将所有帧分数替换为该视频均值，测量Micro-AUROC保留比例；5) 提出"时间稀释"（temporal dilution）基准性质，说明随视频数V增加，视频内比较比例以O(1/V)递减。
AI.result: 三个数据集中异常帧与正常帧的跨视频比较占比高达99.6%以上；纯视频级常数输出达到81.40-97.18 Micro-AUROC；将帧分数替换为视频均值后，中位数保留了98.6%的Micro-AUROC高于随机水平的余量；作者发布的输出和XD-Violence官方AP评估下也呈现相同模式。
AI.conclusion: 现有Micro-AUROC/AP评估指标无法有效衡量弱监督视频异常检测器的时间定位能力——检测器即使对视频内每个时刻赋予相同分数也能取得高分。研究呼吁需要新的评估协议，以真实反映模型在视频内部对异常时刻进行时间排序的能力。

title: GCS-Bridging: Restoring Connectivity of Disconnected Convex Sets for Graph-of-Convex-Sets Motion Planning
summary: Graph-of-Convex-Sets (GCS)-based trajectory optimization represents collision-free regions in configuration space as a finite collection of convex sets and directly performs collision-free trajectory planning over these sets, substantially simplifying the planning process.
