RACO also applies scale-adaptive terminal refinement to handle terminal near-miss cases using runtime-observable geometric and anchor-based evidence. Under a unified online evaluation protocol, RACO improves SR over the reproduced HETT baseline by 9.53 and 7.98 percentage points on validation-unseen and test-unseen, respectively. It also improves inspection-region arrival and reduces false verification risk, showing that coarse-goal reliability optimization is an effective complement to existing coarse-to-fine UAV-VLN policies.

AI.tldr: 本文针对无人机视觉语言导航（UAV-VLN）中的检查导向部署问题，指出现有粗到精策略中粗粒度目标被当作可靠结果而缺乏校验的缺陷。作者提出LG-UVI评估基准和RACO框架，通过运行时假设校验和尺度自适应终端修正，在SR上分别提升9.53和7.98个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有UAV-VLN评测通常只看目标到达，但实际检查场景要求代理停在有效检查区域内并避免误确认相似干扰物。作者发现粗到精策略中的粗粒度目标预测常会漂移到看似合理但错误的物体区域，且限制了局部阶段的纠错能力，缺乏对该问题的系统评测方法。
AI.method: 1) 提出LG-UVI评测设置，基于CityNav/CityRefer构建，包含目标物体、硬干扰物、类型感知检查区域和诊断指标；2) 提出RACO框架，将粗粒度目标视为运行时假设而非固定航点，在Stage 1前及Stage 1到Stage 2边界使用物体级候选锚点进行校验和修正；3) 采用尺度自适应终端精修，利用运行时可观测的几何和锚点证据处理终端近距偏差情况。
AI.result: 在统一在线评测协议下，RACO在validation-unseen和test-unseen上相比复现的HETT基线分别提升9.53和7.98个百分点的SR，同时改善了检查区域到达率并降低了误确认风险。
AI.conclusion: 粗粒度目标可靠性优化是现有粗到精UAV-VLN策略的有效补充，通过运行时校验和自适应修正可以显著提升检查导向导航的性能与安全性。

title: Search Broadly, Seek Evidence on Both Sides, Decide Narrowly: Evidence-Admissible GraphRAG for Longitudinal Clinical Event Verification
summary:
Longitudinal clinical event-relation verification determines whether a patient record supports a specified relation among two or more clinical events. This task is challenging because evidence is distributed across structured records, notes, laboratory trajectories, encounters, and time, while negation, temporal mismatch, repeated documentation, and conflicting findings can make retrieved information appear relevant without establishing the relation.
  We present MedEventGraph-RAG, an evidence-admissible framework that represents event occurrences in a patient-specific graph and links each occurrence to source evidence, including structured rows, note spans, timestamps, and numerical trajectories. Given a verification query specifying events, relation, and clinical scope, the graph guides discovery of candidate event chains and retrieves evidence from both supporting and contradicting sides. A query-specific evidence contract filters information by patient identity, scope, occurrence binding, and source traceability before a separate assessor determines supported, conflicting, refuted, or insufficient outcomes.
  Across ten protocols on i2b2, n2c2, MIMIC-IV, and LUNGUAGE, MedEventGraph-RAG achieves balanced accuracies of 78.6, 67.3, and 96.8 on temporal, medication-adverse-event, and recorded-order verification, improving over the strongest matched baselines by 26.9, 4.9, and 30.4 points. Under evidence masking, it reaches 92.2 balanced accuracy with no false-support predictions. When intermediate events are hidden, it recovers complete source-traceable event chains in 57.9% of i2b2 and 70.0% of LUNGUAGE cases. These results show that separating broad evidence discovery from narrow evidence-admissible assessment improves longitudinal clinical verification and reduces unsupported conclusions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MedEventGraph-RAG框架，通过构建患者特定的临床事件图并将每个事件关联到来源证据，实现纵向临床事件关系验证。框架将广泛的证据发现与严格的证据可采性评估分离，在多个数据集上显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 纵向临床事件关系验证任务具有挑战性，因为证据分散在结构化记录、笔记、实验室轨迹等多个来源中，且否定、时间不匹配、重复记录和矛盾发现会导致检索到的信息看似相关但无法真正建立事件间关系。
AI.method: MedEventGraph-RAG包含三个核心组件：1）患者特定事件图，将每个事件发生关联到来源证据（结构化行、笔记片段、时间戳、数值轨迹）；2）查询驱动的候选事件链发现机制，同时从支持和矛盾两侧检索证据；3）查询特定的证据契约，按患者身份、临床范围、事件绑定和来源可追溯性过滤信息，最后由独立评估器判定支持、矛盾、反驳或证据不足四种结果。
AI.result: 在i2b2、n2c2、MIMIC-IV和LUNGUAGE的十个协议上，在时间、药物不良事件和记录医嘱验证上分别达到78.6、67.3和96.8的平衡准确率，比最强基线分别提升26.9、4.9和30.4个百分点。证据遮挡下达到92.2平衡准确率且零错误支持预测；中间事件隐藏时分别恢复57.9%（i2b2）和70.0%（LUNGUAGE）的完整可追溯事件链。
AI.conclusion: 将广泛的证据发现与严格的证据可采性评估相分离，能够改善纵向临床验证效果并减少无依据的结论，验证了该方法在临床证据验证任务中的有效性和实用性。

title: Improved denoising diffusion probabilistic models with efficient non-diagonal covariance modeling
summary: The sampling process of Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPMs) can be accelerated by leveraging second-order information in the form of approximations to the denoising posterior covariance -- allowing samples of acceptable quality to be produced in fewer but larger sampling steps. Previous attempts at using such information have used drastic (e.g.\ diagonal) simplifications of the covariance. These do not do justice to the peculiar statistical structure of natural images, which exhibit strong non-diagonal correlations between pixels and color channels, and a slow-decaying power-law frequency spectrum. Here, we develop a novel covariance model that captures these features. Our Kronecker-DCT (K-DCT) model uses a Kronecker-factored decomposition of inter-color covariances and spatial covariances modeled in the frequency domain using the Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT). The use of the DCT reduces the computational complexity from quadratic to log-linear, resulting in negligible computational and memory overhead in each denoising step. By learning K-DCT-structured amortizations of the denoising posterior covariance using pre-trained score models on CIFAR-10, Celeb-A, ImageNet and LSUN datasets, we show improved performance compared to previous SOTA denoising samplers, both in terms of FID and likelihoods, especially in the regime of few denoising steps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为K-DCT的新型协方差模型，利用Kronecker分解和离散余弦变换来近似DDPM去噪后验协方差，从而在更少的采样步骤中生成高质量的图像。该方法将计算复杂度从二次降至对数线性，在CIFAR-10、Celeb-A、ImageNet和LSUN数据集上相比之前的SOTA去噪采样器在FID和似然度上均取得更优性能，尤其是在少步数采样场景下。
AI.motivation: DDPM采样可以通过利用去噪后验协方差的二阶信息来加速，即用更少但更大的采样步骤生成可接受质量的样本。然而，之前的方法使用过于简化（如对角化）的协方差近似，未能充分利用自然图像特有的统计结构——像素间和色彩通道间存在强非对角相关性，以及慢衰减的幂律频谱。
AI.method: 提出Kronecker-DCT（K-DCT）协方差模型：1) 使用Kronecker分解分别建模色彩通道间协方差和空间协方差；2) 空间协方差在频域中使用离散余弦变换（DCT）建模；3) 利用预训练得分模型学习K-DCT结构的去噪后验协方差摊销；4) DCT将计算复杂度从O(n²)降至O(n log n)。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10、Celeb-A、ImageNet和LSUN数据集上，K-DCT方法相比之前的SOTA去噪采样器在FID和似然度指标上均有改进，尤其在少去噪步骤场景下优势明显。计算和内存开销在每一步去噪中可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用自然图像特有的统计结构（非对角线相关性、色彩通道间相关性、幂律频谱），K-DCT协方差模型能够在保持极小计算开销的同时显著加速DDPM采样，在少步数场景下实现更好的采样质量。

title: Physics Filtering Favors the Generalization of Robot Learning
summary: Living organisms exhibit extraordinary adaptability to unseen environments through their intrinsic physical structures and lifelong feedback-driven learning. Endowing robots with comparable generalization is critical for reliable operation in the real world. While recent approaches attempt to improve generalization by scaling training data, such strategies remain impractical for robotics, where collecting real-world demonstrations at the scale of large language models is prohibitively costly and slow. Contrary to this reliance on massive datasets, we show that robots can generalize effectively under dynamics uncertainties even with limited training data by leveraging a feedback mechanism, namely PhyFilter, that corrects learning outputs with physics-filtered learning residuals. PhyFilter operates as a lightweight, model-agnostic module whose parameters can be automatically optimized through an auto-learning algorithm, eliminating manual tuning and enabling seamless integration with diverse robot policies. We validate PhyFilter across four representative robotic systems, demonstrating that it enables quadruped robots to generalize to unseen terrains, payload variations, and speed ranges; drones to flight under unseen wind disturbances; aerial manipulators to achieve centimeter-level in-air capture despite wind and mass uncertainties; and acceleration differentiators to remain robust with distribution shift. These results show that physics-filtered feedback can serve as a powerful alternative to massive data scaling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PhyFilter，一种轻量级、模型无关的物理滤波反馈模块，通过用物理滤波的学习残差来校正学习模型输出，使机器人即使在小规模训练数据下也能在动力学不确定性条件下实现有效泛化，为数据规模扩展提供了替代方案。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型通过海量数据实现了惊人的泛化能力，但机器人领域收集真实世界演示数据成本高昂且速度缓慢，难以复制数据规模扩展策略。因此需要探索不依赖大规模数据即可实现泛化的替代机制。
AI.method: 提出PhyFilter模块，该模块利用物理滤波的学习残差来校正学习模型的输出。它是一个轻量级、模型无关的组件，可通过自动学习算法优化其参数，无需手动调参，并能无缝集成到不同的机器人策略中。
AI.result: 在四个代表性机器人系统上验证：四足机器人在未见地形、载荷变化和速度范围下实现泛化；无人机在未见风扰下飞行；飞行机械臂在风和质量不确定下实现厘米级空中捕获；加速度微分器在分布偏移下保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 物理滤波反馈可以作为大规模数据扩展的有力替代方案，使机器人能够在有限训练数据条件下有效泛化于动力学不确定性环境。

title: From SQL Generation to Tool Selection: A Domain-Oriented Pattern for MCP Servers
summary: Agents built on Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly reach enterprise data through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and many MCP database servers maximize flexibility by exposing a single generic SQL execution tool. This paper proposes the Domain-Oriented Tooling Pattern: instead of generating SQL at query time, the model selects from a small set of domain-aligned tools whose parameterized queries encapsulate schema navigation, joins and business rules on the server side. We formalize the pattern around three architectural invariants and introduce Model Demotion, the observation that replacing SQL synthesis with intent classification lowers the model tier required to serve routine requests. As a reference implementation we present MCP Blueprint, an open-source framework in which domain tools are defined declaratively as YAML metadata plus external parameterized SQL files. We evaluate the pattern with a public reproducibility benchmark comparing three MCP server designs - raw SQL execution, a thin generic tool pack, and a verticalized domain pack - on four local models (3B-8B) across seventeen customer-facing tasks over the Sakila database (609 completed cells; temperature 0; three repetitions per cell). The verticalized pack reaches a pooled mean score of 0.939 versus 0.666 for raw SQL and 0.605 for the generic pack; the smallest model improves from 0.583 to 0.929, matching or exceeding every larger configuration while cutting cost per correct answer by an order of magnitude. All harness code, prompts, gold answers, frozen packs and per-cell results are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向领域的工具模式（Domain-Oriented Tooling Pattern），通过让LLM从一组领域对齐的预定义工具中选择而非直接生成SQL，来服务企业数据查询。作者提出了MCP Blueprint开源框架，通过YAML元数据加参数化SQL文件声明式定义领域工具，并通过基准测试证明该模式在准确性和成本上均显著优于原始SQL执行和通用工具包方案。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的智能体通过MCP协议访问企业数据时，许多MCP数据库服务器暴露单一的通用SQL执行工具以最大化灵活性，但这种方式要求模型在查询时直接生成SQL，这在小模型上准确率低且容易出错。作者希望通过将SQL生成降级为意图分类，降低对模型能力的要求，同时提升查询准确性和效率。
AI.method: 提出面向领域的工具模式，核心是让模型从一小类领域对齐的工具中选择，这些工具的参量化查询在服务端封装了schema导航、连接和业务规则。模式围绕三个架构不变量进行形式化，并引入"模型降级"（Model Demotion）概念。提供了开源参考实现MCP Blueprint，领域工具以YAML元数据加外部参量化SQL文件声明式定义。通过三个MCP服务器设计（原始SQL执行、薄通用工具包、垂直领域工具包）在4个本地模型和17个客户面向任务上进行了基准测试。
AI.result: 垂直领域工具包的平均得分为0.939，远超原始SQL执行(0.666)和通用工具包(0.605)。最小的3B模型从0.583提升到0.929，匹配甚至超过所有更大的配置，同时每次正确答案的成本降低一个数量级。共完成609个单元测试（温度0，每单元3次重复）。
AI.conclusion: 面向领域的工具模式通过将SQL合成降级为意图分类，可以显著提升小模型在企业数据访问场景下的准确性和成本效率，使其匹配甚至超越更大模型的表现。作者公开了所有代码、提示词、黄金答案、冻结的工具包和逐单元结果，以供复现。

title: Close Shortcut Wins Long: Seeking Diverse and Stable Generators for Data-Free Knowledge Distillation
summary: Data-Free Knowledge Distillation (DFKD) preserves privacy by transferring knowledge without real data access. However, existing generator-based DFKD methods suffer from over-reliance on teacher preferences and pattern collapse, exhibiting "generative shortcut learning" in the frequency domain: dependent on specific frequency components and frequency positions, resulting in inconsistent synthetic image quality and class diversity. In this paper, we propose a CSWL framework aimed at introducing insights from the frequency domain perspective to improve generator diversity and training stability to Close the phenomenon of Shortcut learning to Win in the Longer term. To address the issue of generative shortcut learning, we introduce frequency-domain augmentation at the feature level, encouraging the generator to attend to the full frequency spectrum and thereby suppress shortcut learning behavior. To tackle training instability, we propose a Cross-Stage Frequency Reconstruction (CSFR) auxiliary task, which implicitly constructs an Exponential Moving Average (EMA) mechanism to promote long-term optimization and stability. Extensive experiments, including downstream tasks and various image recognition datasets at multiple resolutions, validate the effectiveness of CSWL in improving both diversity and stability from the frequency view.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CSWL框架，从频域视角解决无数据知识蒸馏（DFKD）中生成器存在的"生成性捷径学习"问题（过度依赖特定频率分量和位置），通过特征级频域增强抑制捷径学习，并提出跨阶段频率重建（CSFR）辅助任务构建EMA机制提升训练稳定性，实验验证了其在多样性和稳定性方面的提升。
AI.motivation: 现有基于生成器的DFKD方法存在对教师偏好的过度依赖和模式坍塌问题，表现为频域上的"生成性捷径学习"——生成器依赖特定频率分量和位置，导致合成图像质量不一致、类别多样性不足。作者希望从频域视角引入洞察，改善生成器的多样性和训练稳定性。
AI.method: 提出CSWL（Close Shortcut learning to Win in Longer term）框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 特征级频域增强，鼓励生成器关注全频段频谱，抑制捷径学习行为；(2) 跨阶段频率重建（CSFR）辅助任务，隐式构建指数移动平均（EMA）机制，促进长期优化和训练稳定性。
AI.result: 在多个图像识别数据集和多分辨率场景下的广泛实验（包括下游任务）验证了CSWL能有效从频域视角提升合成图像的多样性和训练稳定性。
AI.conclusion: CSWL框架从频域视角为DFKD中的捷径学习问题提供了有效解决方案，通过频域增强和跨阶段频率重建机制，在提升生成器多样性的同时保证了训练的长期稳定性。

title: Reproducible Vision-Guided 6-DoF Robotic Manipulator with a Mixed Stepper-Driver Architecture and Browser-Native Control
comment: 13 pages, 16 figures, 7 tables. Design files and firmware: https://github.com/Lasan-Perera/6-dof-arm-neuralnexus
summary: We present the NeuralNexus Arm, an open, low-cost 6-DOF robotic manipulator built by an undergraduate engineering team, together with the design decisions and debugging experience needed to reproduce it. The arm is driven by a single STM32H743 microcontroller on a custom printed circuit board (PCB) and combines two stepper-driver strategies on one controller: push-pull 3.3 V step/direction outputs for onboard TMC2209 drivers on the three wrist joints, and open-drain outputs for external CL57T and DM542 drivers on the three high-torque proximal joints. We describe the mechanical design, mixed-driver electronics, interrupt-driven firmware, a MATLAB/Simscape-based inverse-kinematics pipeline, a browser-native control interface using the Web Serial API, and a lightweight vision pipeline for object localisation and autonomous pick-and-place tasks. We also document non-obvious hardware and firmware failure modes encountered during the transition from a development board to the custom PCB as reproducibility guidance. All design files and firmware are released openly. The platform actuates all six axes under coordinated control at a 2 kHz update rate and executes both manual and pre-recorded motions from the browser interface.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了NeuralNexus Arm，一个由本科生工程团队构建的开源、低成本6自由度机械臂。该平台采用单块STM32H743微控制器和定制PCB，混合使用两种步进驱动策略（板载TMC2209驱动腕部三关节，外部CL57T和DM542驱动高扭矩近端三关节），并集成了机械设计、中断驱动固件、MATLAB/Simscape逆运动学管线、基于Web Serial API的浏览器控制界面以及轻量级视觉管线，可实现自主抓取任务。所有设计文件和固件均已开源发布。
AI.motivation: 为低成本机械臂研究提供可复现的开放平台，并分享从开发板迁移到定制PCB过程中遇到的非显而易见的硬件和固件故障模式，以帮助他人规避类似问题。
AI.method: 采用单STM32H743控制器驱动6-DOF机械臂，混合使用两种步进驱动策略（push-pull 3.3V输出驱动板载TMC2209用于腕部，开漏输出驱动外部CL57T/DM542用于高扭矩近端关节）；固件采用中断驱动设计；逆运动学通过MATLAB/Simscape管线实现；浏览器界面利用Web Serial API；视觉管线支持物体定位和自主抓取。
AI.result: 该平台能在2 kHz更新率下实现六轴协调控制，支持手动和预录制运动，并可从浏览器界面执行。平台能够执行自主抓取任务，所有设计文件与固件均已开放。
AI.conclusion: NeuralNexus Arm证明了本科生团队能够构建功能完整的开源6-DOF机器人平台，其在低成本、开放式设计和嵌入可复现性指导方面的贡献，为教育及科研场景提供了有价值的参考方案。

title: Decision-Support and Modeling with Large Language Models for Geothermal Well Arrays
comment: 10 pages, 8 figures. Presented at the 50th Workshop on Geothermal Reservoir Engineering, Stanford University, February 10-12, 2025
summary: Geothermal well arrays, which organize multiple geothermal wells into carefully planned geometric configurations, provide opportunities to enhance energy production capacity and increase fault tolerance. The development and adoption of these emerging geothermal technologies could be accelerated through the recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and high-level high-performance languages. A challenge in LLM-based applications is the reliability of the generated outputs, as they can be prone to subjective biases and hallucinations. This study assesses the potential of cutting-edge LLMs - such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Grok, and domain-specific models like AskGDR - as expert assistants that can synthesize insightful interpretations of complex geothermal data, as well as improve feature capabilities of geothermal models and numerical software. We developed a novel approach, leveraging Google's recently introduced AI assistant, NotebookLM, to accelerate the generation of unpublished quantitative geothermal benchmarks. The rapid generation of these evaluation instruments is essential for assessing the swiftly evolving capabilities of emerging language model technologies. In particular, we use these benchmarks and LLM-based interviews to analyze opportunities and limitations of two promising technologies: geothermal well arrays and closed-loop coaxial wells. Furthermore, we present a case study illustrating how LLMs can facilitate auto-parallelization of geothermal numerical models. Our analysis emphasizes their application in digital twins and underscores the importance of high-level, high-performance code generation. This line of research could play a transformative role in the geothermal sector by enabling the next-generation of decision-support applications, integrating data analysis, informed recommendations, and more dynamic numerical modeling workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了大型语言模型（如ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude、Grok及领域专用模型AskGDR）作为地热领域专家助手的潜力，并提出利用NotebookLM加速生成未公开的量化地热基准测试的新方法。研究通过基准测试和LLM访谈分析地热井阵列与闭式同轴井两种技术，并展示LLM辅助地热数值模型自动并行化的案例，强调其在数字孪生和高性能代码生成中的应用前景。
AI.motivation: 地热井阵列技术虽能提升产能和容错能力，但其开发与应用面临复杂数据解读和建模难题。LLM生成的输出可能存在主观偏差和幻觉，可靠性存疑，因此需要系统评估前沿LLM在地热领域的实际潜力与局限性。
AI.method: 提出利用Google的NotebookLM加速生成地热量化基准测试的新方法，结合LLM基准测试与访谈方式，分析地热井阵列和闭式同轴井两种技术；并提供LLM辅助地热数值模型自动并行化的案例研究。
AI.result: 评估了多种通用及领域专用LLM在地热数据解读、模型功能改进和数值软件增强方面的表现；通过生成的基准揭示了LLM在地热井阵列和闭式同轴井技术应用中的机会与局限；案例演示了LLM促进数值模型自动并行化的可行性。
AI.conclusion: LLM与地热技术结合具有变革潜力，可推动下一代决策支持应用发展，整合数据分析、智能建议和更动态的数值建模工作流；但需关注LLM输出的可靠性问题，并重视高层次高性能代码生成的应用价值。

title: ORBIT++: Benchmarking SfM in the Wild with 360° Video
comment: A revision was Accepted at CVPR 2026
summary: Structure-from-Motion (SfM) is a cornerstone of 3D perception, yet current methods often fail when applied to complex videos involving challenging camera motions or dynamic scenes. Compounding the problem, the field lacks reliable ground-truth benchmarks for such difficult scenarios, making it hard to gauge real-world progress or to pinpoint where improvements are most needed. To address this gap, we introduce a new benchmark for evaluating camera pose estimation. Our key insight is to leverage online panoramic 360° video as a source of data from which to construct challenging clips, while still enabling robust ground-truth trajectory recovery. The panoramic nature of these videos provides richer visual context for tracking camera motion, even when parts of the view are affected by blur, motion, or dynamic objects. After tracking camera motion across full 360° videos, we crop and reproject selected portions to generate perspective-view clips that serve as our benchmark, called ORBIT. Experiments show that COLMAP, as well as recent optimization-based and feed-forward SfM methods struggle to accurately estimate camera poses on our benchmark. Hence, ORBIT provides a valuable testbed where researchers can meaningfully measure progress on truly challenging, real-world SfM problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ORBIT，一个基于在线全景360°视频构建的相机位姿估计基准数据集，用于评估SfM方法在复杂相机运动和动态场景下的真实性能。通过利用全景视频的丰富视觉上下文进行可靠的相机轨迹恢复，再裁剪重投影生成透视视角片段作为测试数据。
AI.motivation: 现有的SfM方法在复杂视频（挑战性相机运动或动态场景）上经常失败，且该领域缺乏针对这类困难场景的可靠真值基准，难以衡量真实进展和定位需要改进的方向。
AI.method: 利用在线全景360°视频作为数据来源，全景视频提供更丰富的视觉上下文以跟踪相机运动（即使在模糊、运动或动态物体影响下也能恢复轨迹）。先在全景视频中跟踪相机运动，然后裁剪并重投影选定部分生成透视视角片段，构建名为ORBIT的基准。
AI.result: 实验表明COLMAP以及近期基于优化和基于前馈网络的SfM方法在ORBIT基准上均难以准确估计相机位姿，说明该基准确实具有挑战性。
AI.conclusion: ORBIT为研究人员提供了一个有价值的测试平台，可以在真正具有挑战性的真实世界SfM问题上有效衡量进展。

title: Triplet2Track: A Hierarchical System with Object-Centric Representations for Reliable Long-Horizon Manipulation
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC 2026)
summary: Ensuring reliability in uncertain environments remains difficult for long-horizon robotic manipulation. End-to-end VLA models are data-heavy and opaque, making diagnosis and verification difficult. Hierarchical pipelines are more interpretable, but their plans are often weakly grounded in observations, weakly aligned with low-level actions, and computed without online feedback, leading to open-loop behavior and hallucinations. To address these issues, we introduce the Triplet-to-Track System (TTS), a closed-loop long-horizon imitation learning system that uses human videos to reduce reliance on robot-collected data. TTS represents high-level subgoals as instance-grounded triplets, translates them into continuous track priors for execution, and monitors task progress from observations for online replanning. Across diverse real-world long-horizon tasks, TTS achieves a 74.8\% average success rate and supports object-level and compositional generalization.

AI.tldr: TTS是一个闭环长时程机器人操作模仿学习系统，利用人类视频减少对机器人采集数据的依赖，通过实例化三元组表示高层子目标并转化为连续轨迹先验执行，同时监控任务进度实现在线重规划，在多种真实世界长时程任务中达到74.8%的平均成功率，支持物体级和组合泛化。
AI.motivation: 端到端VLA模型数据需求大且不透明，难以诊断和验证；层级流水线虽可解释性强，但其计划缺乏对观测的强依据、与底层动作弱对齐，且缺乏在线反馈，导致开环行为和幻觉问题。
AI.method: TTS采用三层架构：1) 将高层子目标表示为实例化三元组（triplets）；2) 将三元组转化为连续轨迹先验（track priors）用于执行；3) 从观测中监控任务进度以实现在线重规划，形成闭环。系统利用人类视频训练，减少对机器人采集数据的依赖。
AI.result: 在多种真实世界长时程任务中达到74.8%的平均成功率，并支持物体级泛化和组合泛化。
AI.conclusion: 通过实例化三元组表示和闭环在线反馈机制，TTS有效解决了层级规划中的幻觉与开环问题，在降低数据依赖的同时保持了高可解释性和良好的泛化能力。

title: Dissecting Neuro-Symbolic Quality Assurance for Synthetic Oncology Data Generation
summary: Synthetic clinical data generation with large language models addresses the scarcity that limits cancer staging research, but oncology hallucinations are categorically harmful: one clinically impossible staging assignment contaminates every downstream model trained on it. Neuro-symbolic pipelines validate during generation, yet the contribution of individual quality-assurance components remains unclear. We report three controlled studies isolating gate necessity, constraint attribution, and retrieval conditionality, holding generation protocol, diversity thresholds, and fine-tuning hyperparameters constant across adapter conditions. The symbolic gate enforces schema completeness, ontology coverage against the Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine, and staging-logic consistency under American Joint Committee on Cancer eighth-edition rules. Ungated, 29.9% of records contain schema failures and 20.1% contain clinically invalid staging. Schema validation is the load-bearing filter: within the fully gated corpus it rejects 148 of 512 records, ontology grounding a further 24, and staging-logic validation none---the only generator producing logic violations is already excluded on schema, making clinical-logic validation a generator-conditional safeguard rather than the dominant filter. Retrieval augmentation is strongly model-dependent: it improves gate compliance for one generator by 12.5 percentage points, has no measurable effect for a second, and collapses output in a third. Across gated configurations ontology density is largely unchanged, indicating that symbolic validation improves clinical validity rather than vocabulary richness. Symbolic gating therefore buys corpus validity but no commensurate gain on real lung-cancer notes in this study; retrieval should be evaluated per model, and ontology density should not be reported as a proxy for corpus quality.

AI.tldr: 本文通过三个受控实验，系统性评估了神经符号管道中各质量保证组件（符号门控、模式验证、本体约束、分期逻辑验证及检索增强）对合成临床癌症分期数据生成的实际贡献，发现模式验证是主要过滤器，分期逻辑验证作用依赖生成器，检索增强效果因模型而异，符号门控虽提升语料有效性但对真实肺癌笔记无显著额外获益。
AI.motivation: 合成临床数据生成可缓解癌症分期研究中数据稀缺问题，但肿瘤学领域的大语言模型幻觉危害严重（一个临床上不可能的分期赋值会污染所有下游模型）。神经符号管道在生成过程中进行验证，但各质量保证组件的单独贡献尚不明确，需要隔离研究以指导管道设计。
AI.method: 开展三项受控研究，分别隔离门控必要性、约束归因和检索条件性三个维度。在保持生成协议、多样性阈值和微调超参数恒定的条件下，比较不同适配器条件。符号门控包含模式完整性、SNOMED CT本体覆盖率以及AJCC第八版分期逻辑一致性三类验证。实验中比较无门控与有门控语料，并单独分析每类验证的拒绝贡献，同时评估检索增强对不同生成器的影响。
AI.result: 无门控时29.9%记录存在模式失败、20.1%存在临床无效分期。经完全门控的语料中，模式验证拒绝512条中的148条，本体验证进一步拒绝24条，分期逻辑验证未拒绝任何记录——产生逻辑违规的唯一生成器已被模式验证排除。检索增强效果因模型差异显著：对一个生成器提升门控合规12.5个百分点，对第二个无效果，对第三个导致输出崩溃。各门控配置下本体密度基本不变。
AI.conclusion: 符号门控能获得语料有效性但未在真实肺癌笔记上带来可衡量的获益；分期逻辑验证是生成器条件性的安全保障而非主导过滤器；检索增强需逐模型评估；本体密度不应作为语料质量的代理指标报告。

title: Robust Global Structure-from-Motion via View Graph Pruning
summary: Structure-from-Motion (SfM) aims to estimate camera poses and reconstruct 3D structures from a collection of unordered images. Compared with incremental SfM, global SfM achieves better scalability by jointly estimating camera poses based on a view graph constructed from pairwise correspondences. However, its performance is highly sensitive to erroneous edges caused by visually ambiguous matches, which may lead to incorrect camera registration and reconstruction artifacts. In this work, we propose a subgraph-guided view graph pruning framework for robust global SfM. Our key idea is to exploit the internal consistency of reliable subgraphs to identify and remove unreliable connections. Specifically, we first partition the view graph into locally consistent subgraphs and perform global SfM within each subgraph to obtain reliable camera poses. We then apply RANSAC-based edge pruning across subgraphs to remove inconsistent edges, and finally perform global SfM on the refined view graph. Extensive experiments on ambiguous, sequential, and unordered image datasets demonstrate that our method improves the robustness of global SfM under challenging conditions. Further evaluation with neural rendering shows that the improved camera estimation leads to higher-quality novel view synthesis results.

AI.tldr: 提出一个基于子图引导的视图图剪枝框架，用于鲁棒的全局运动恢复结构（SfM），通过利用可靠子图的内部一致性来识别并移除不可靠的连接边，最终提升相机位姿估计的准确性。
AI.motivation: 全局SfM虽比增量式SfM具有更好的可扩展性，但其性能对视图图中由于视觉模糊匹配导致的错误边高度敏感，这些错误边可能导致不正确的相机配准和重建伪影。
AI.method: 1) 将视图图划分为局部一致的子图；2) 在每个子图内执行全局SfM以获得可靠的相机位姿；3) 跨子图应用基于RANSAC的边剪枝以移除不一致的边；4) 在优化后的视图图上执行全局SfM。
AI.result: 在模糊、序列和无序图像数据集上的广泛实验表明，该方法提升了全局SfM在挑战性条件下的鲁棒性。进一步结合神经渲染的评估显示，改进的相机估计带来了更高质量的新视角合成结果。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的子图引导视图图剪枝框架能有效增强全局SfM的鲁棒性，并通过更好的相机位姿估计间接提升下游任务（如神经渲染）的性能。

title: UniMem: Unifying Multimodal Memory and Control for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have leveraged internet-scale pretraining and task-focused finetuning to achieve strong performance on long-horizon tasks, they often struggle with non-Markovian tasks that require memory. Existing approaches to memory typically involve additional Vision-Language-Models (VLMs) for long-term memory management, introducing a memory bottleneck and a fractured training pipeline. Conditioning on multiple historical frames can provide the VLA with access to more descriptive features of past scenes, but can degrade performance if frames are chosen at arbitrary, fixed intervals. To address these limitations, we present UniMem, a framework that unifies high-level, multimodal memory and low-level control under one backbone. UniMem employs an event classifier for memory updates, a keyframe encoder for dense spatial memory, and a keyframe caching technique to minimize overhead during policy rollouts. We evaluate UniMem across five simulation and four hardware tasks targeting sequential and spatial memory, demonstrating that our unified, single-model system outperforms fixed-interval image sampling baselines (93.4% vs. 68.2%) in simulation and hierarchical baselines (80.0% vs. 43.5%) in hardware, while offering faster inference and a simple training pipeline for easy adoption. Project website: https://losterberg3.github.io/unimem-vla/

AI.tldr: UniMem是一个统一框架，将高层多模态记忆与低层控制集成于单一骨干网络中，通过事件分类器更新记忆、关键帧编码器提供密集空间记忆、以及关键帧缓存技术降低推理开销，在模拟和硬件任务上均显著优于固定间隔采样和分层基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的VLA模型在长时程任务上表现优异，但在需要记忆的非马尔可夫任务上存在不足。已有方法通常引入额外的VLM进行长期记忆管理，导致记忆瓶颈和训练流程割裂；而简单的多帧条件化输入若帧选择不当反而会降低性能。
AI.method: UniMem将记忆管理和低层控制统一到一个骨干网络中，包含三个核心组件：事件分类器用于决定何时更新记忆、关键帧编码器用于编码密集空间记忆信息、以及关键帧缓存技术以最小化策略部署时的计算开销。
AI.result: 在五个模拟任务和四个硬件任务上进行了评估，模拟任务中达到93.4%的成功率（对比固定间隔采样基线的68.2%），硬件任务中达到80.0%（对比分层基线的43.5%），同时推理速度更快且训练流程更简单。
AI.conclusion: UniMem验证了将记忆与控制在单一模型内统一的可行性，相比分层架构和固定间隔采样方法，在顺序记忆和空间记忆任务上均展现出更优的性能、更高的推理效率和更简单的训练流程，易于被广泛采用。

title: Hack-Verifiable Terminal Bench: Evaluating Reward Hacking in Terminal Tasks
summary: As agents grow more capable and autonomous, their tendency to reward hack, satisfying a task's checks while violating its intent, becomes an increasingly important failure mode. Measuring reward hacking is itself challenging, as detection typically relies on human inspection or LLM judges, both of which can be unreliable. The hack-verifiable environments (HVE) methodology addresses this challenge by embedding detectable hacks into tasks, allowing reward hacks to be identified automatically and reliably. In this work, we adapt HVE to Terminal Bench, a leading benchmark of real-world terminal and coding tasks, and introduce Hack-Verifiable Terminal Bench (HVTB). Using HVTB, we measure reward-hacking rates across frontier models and study whether prompts with varying amounts of information on the hack can mitigate this behavior. This lets us test whether prompting can prevent not only known reward-hacking strategies, but also 'unknown unknown' exploits that the prompt does not anticipate. We release all environments and agent traces at https://majoroth.github.io/hack-verifiable-environments/hvtb

AI.tldr: 本文提出Hack-Verifiable Terminal Bench (HVTB)，将可验证漏洞（HVE）方法论适配到Terminal Bench基准，用于自动、可靠地检测AI智能体的奖励黑客（reward hacking）行为，并研究不同信息量的提示词能否缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 随着AI智能体能力增强和自主性提高，奖励黑客（在满足任务表面检查的同时违反其真实意图）成为日益严重的问题。然而，检测奖励黑客本身就很困难，传统方法依赖人工审查或LLM评判，两者均可能不可靠。
AI.method: 将可验证漏洞环境（HVE）方法论适配到Terminal Bench——一个领先的真实世界终端与编码任务基准，创建新的HVTB基准。HVTB通过在任务中嵌入可检测的漏洞，使奖励黑客行为能够被自动且可靠地识别。
AI.result: 使用HVTB测量了前沿模型的奖励黑客率，并研究了不同信息量的提示词对缓解该行为的有效性，测试了提示是否能防止已知的奖励黑客策略以及提示未预见的"未知未知"漏洞利用。
AI.conclusion: HVTB为奖励黑客检测提供了可靠的自动化方法，并揭示了提示工程在缓解已知和未知奖励黑客行为方面的能力边界。所有环境和智能体轨迹已公开发布。

title: Competitive Memory Readout for Robust Video Object Segmentation: 2nd Place Technical Report for the MOSEv2 Track of the 8th LSVOS Challenge
summary: We present our solution for the MOSEv2 track of the 8th Large-scale Video Object Segmentation (LSVOS) Challenge at ECCV 2026. The challenge evaluates robust video object segmentation under complex temporal dynamics, including long-term occlusion, disappearance and reappearance, large appearance changes, and strong interference from visually similar objects. Our method builds on SAM~3 and focuses on its memory readout. Standard target-only memory retrieval can confuse the annotated target with same-class non-target objects because such distractors are represented only implicitly as background. Our method introduces Competitive Memory Readout, which explicitly incorporates same-class competitor evidence when retrieving target information from memory. To prevent excessive suppression of weak or reappearing targets, we further apply a lightweight adaptive restoration rule after competition. The resulting system retains the original SAM~3 tracking pipeline while improving target identity preservation in challenging videos. Our submission achieves 66.20 on the primary challenge score and ranks 2nd in the MOSEv2 track.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了针对ECCV 2026 LSVOS挑战赛MOSEv2赛道的解决方案，基于SAM 3引入竞争性记忆读取（Competitive Memory Readout）机制，显式纳入同类竞争目标证据，并辅以自适应恢复规则防止对弱目标或重现目标的过度抑制，最终取得赛道第二名（66.20分）。
AI.motivation: 标准的目标记忆检索方式仅使用目标本身的信息，在处理复杂时空动态（如长时遮挡、消失重现、外观剧变以及相似目标干扰）时，会将同类非目标干扰物仅隐式视为背景，导致目标与干扰物混淆，影响目标身份保持的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 1) 基于SAM 3构建跟踪系统；2) 提出Competitive Memory Readout机制，在从记忆检索目标信息时显式纳入同类竞争目标的证据；3) 引入轻量级自适应恢复规则（adaptive restoration rule），在竞争后防止对弱目标或重现目标的过度抑制；4) 保留原始SAM 3的跟踪流水线框架。
AI.result: 在MOSEv2赛道获得66.20的主要挑战分数，排名第二。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模同类竞争目标并配合自适应恢复机制，在不改变SAM 3原始跟踪框架的前提下，有效提升了复杂视频场景下的目标身份保持能力，验证了竞争性记忆读取策略的有效性。

title: SuperMap: A Spatio-Temporal SLAM System for Visual-Language Navigation
summary:
Robotic navigation in human environments requires a spatio-temporal semantic representation that can rec- oncile open-vocabulary perception with long-term environmental changes. While foundation models provide strong zero-shot recognition, their predictions are intermittent and view-dependent, and naively integrating them into mapping pipelines leads to identity drift and stale semantics over time. We present SuperMap, a 4D spatio-temporal mapping framework for language-guided navigation that integrates high-frequency geometric SLAM with asynchronous open-vocabulary perception. Our core contribution is a consistency-driven mapping engine that combines 3D-aware instance association/re-activation with a principled existence-and-label confidence update to maintain stable object identities and prune outdated map content under occlusions and scene changes. SuperMap produces a queryable 4D scene-graph representation that interfaces naturally with Vision-Language Models by supporting compositional queries over object semantics, relations,
  We demonstrate SuperMap on benchmarks and real robots, including dynamic scenes with appearance/disappearance and relocation, and provide ablations and runtime analysis. We release the full system as open-source to provide the community with a deployable baseline for open-vocabulary spatio-temporal mapping. Project website: superodometry.com/supermap.

AI.tldr: SuperMap是一个4D时空映射框架，用于语言引导的机器人导航。它将高频几何SLAM与异步开放词汇感知相结合，通过一致性驱动的映射引擎（包括3D感知的实例关联/重新激活和存在-标签置信度更新）来维护稳定的对象身份，并在遮挡和场景变化下修剪过时的地图内容。该系统生成可查询的4D场景图表示，支持与视觉语言模型的组合式查询，并在基准测试和真实机器人上得到验证。
AI.motivation: 机器人在人类环境中导航需要能够同时处理开放词汇感知和长期环境变化的时空语义表示。现有基础模型虽然提供强大的零样本识别能力，但其预测是间歇性的且依赖视角，直接集成到映射流程中会导致身份漂移和随时间推移的语义过时问题。
AI.method: SuperMap提出一个4D时空映射框架，核心包括：(1) 集成高频几何SLAM与异步开放词汇感知；(2) 一致性驱动的映射引擎，结合3D感知的实例关联/重新激活机制；(3) 存在-标签置信度更新原则，用于维护稳定对象身份并在遮挡和场景变化下修剪过时内容；(4) 生成可查询的4D场景图表示，支持与VLM的组合式查询。
AI.result: SuperMap在基准测试和真实机器人上进行了验证，包括涉及对象出现/消失和重新定位的动态场景，并提供了消融实验和运行时分析。系统作为开源发布。
AI.conclusion: SuperMap为开放词汇时空映射提供了一个可部署的基线，解决了身份漂移和语义过时问题，使机器人能够在动态环境中保持稳定和准确的场景理解，并支持语言引导的导航任务。

title: Development and Feasibility Evaluation of an Edge AI as Medical Device System for Breast Cancer Multidisciplinary Team Meetings
summary: Breast Cancer Multidisciplinary Team (MDT) meetings manage increasingly complex cases under considerable time pressure, and documentation requirements can reduce clinical efficiency and decision quality. Existing AI based MDT workflows rely on cloud-based processing, limiting their use because patient discussions contain identifiable information. We developed a fully on-device AI pipeline using open-source Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) and Large Language Models (LLMs) that transcribes breast cancer MDT discussions, structures clinical information, and generates treatment recommendations using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounded in National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) guidance. The pipeline runs on a single NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, ensuring that patient audio, transcripts, and outputs remain within institutional infrastructure. Evaluation included two recorded simulated MDT discussions, ten clinically validated synthetic discussions, and 1,270 acoustically augmented recordings. Optimisation of Whisper large-v3 reduced word error rate by 20.7% and 24.4% on the recorded discussions and achieved performance within 0.58% WER and 1.58% word information lost of a commercial clinical ASR benchmark on augmented audio. MedGemma-RAG identified 2.3 times more MDT-concordant interventions than a proprietary cloud comparator (p = 0.020), with no significant difference in overall accuracy. Stakeholders identified automated documentation, treatment recommendation support, and case triage as the most credible near-term applications while highlighting workflow integration, governance, and clinician trust as key implementation challenges. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of privacy-preserving, fully on-device AI for MDT documentation and guideline-informed decision support, providing a foundation for prospective clinical evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一种完全设备端运行的AI流水线，用于乳腺癌多学科团队（MDT）会议的转录、临床信息结构化及基于NICE指南的治疗建议生成。该系统在单个NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上运行，确保患者数据不出机构基础设施，实现了隐私保护。评估显示其性能接近商业临床ASR基准，且在MDT一致干预识别上优于专有云端对比系统。
AI.motivation: 乳腺癌MDT会议处理日益复杂的病例且面临时间压力，但现有基于AI的MDT工作流依赖云端处理，因患者讨论包含可识别信息而限制了其应用。需要一种既能提供AI辅助能力又能保护患者隐私的解决方案。
AI.method: 开发了一个完全设备端的AI流水线，包含：(1) 开源ASR（Whisper large-v3）进行转写；(2) LLM（MedGemma）用于结构化临床信息；(3) 基于RAG的方法检索NICE指南生成治疗建议。系统在单个NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上运行，通过优化Whisper降低词错误率。评估包括两段模拟MDT讨论、十段临床验证的合成讨论以及1,270段声学增强录音。
AI.result: 优化后的Whisper在录音讨论中词错误率分别降低20.7%和24.4%，在增强音频上性能与商业临床ASR基准相当（WER差异0.58%）。MedGemma-RAG识别出比专有云端对比系统多2.3倍的MDT一致干预（p=0.020），整体准确率无显著差异。利益相关者认为自动化文档、治疗建议支持和病例分流是最可信的近端应用。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了完全设备端、隐私保护的AI用于MDT文档记录和指南知情决策支持的可行性，为前瞻性临床评估奠定了基础。主要实施挑战包括工作流整合、治理和临床医生信任。

title: ADMIL: Attention-Distilled Multiple Instance Learning for Selective Foundation Model Inference in Pathology
summary: Attention-based multiple instance learning (ABMIL) using pathology foundation model embeddings is effective for slide-level tasks, but exhaustive inference requires applying a large image encoder to every foreground tile despite the subsequent attention distribution often concentrating over a small subset of informative regions. We introduce ADMIL (Attention-Distilled Multiple Instance Learning), a selective-compute framework that distills an ABMIL teacher's attention into a lightweight tile-selection model, PriorNet. Using an EfficientNet architecture, PriorNet learns the teacher attention distribution from raw tile pixels with KL divergence; at inference, it scores the foreground pool, selects the top-K tiles, and invokes the expensive foundation model only on that subset before a selected-bag ABMIL student predicts the slide label. Across BRACS, PANDA, and CAMELYON16, ADMIL matches full-teacher headline performance at K=4, 8, and 128 tiles, respectively, avoiding >98% of foundation model (Virchow2) tile embeddings and model inference FLOPs. Random and teacher-attention oracle controls show that this result depends on task-relevant selection rather than tile-count reduction alone. Quantitative and qualitative analyses suggest that PriorNet recovers the teacher's tile ordering with high fidelity while focusing on task-relevant morphological regions. ADMIL shows that nearly all expensive tile encodings can be removed without sacrificing slide-level performance, providing a potential path for more efficient deployment in clinical settings where latency and compute costs are key considerations.

AI.tldr: ADMIL提出了一种选择性计算框架，通过一个轻量级的PriorNet模型（基于EfficientNet）从原始图像块像素中学习ABMIL教师的注意力分布，在推理时仅选择top-K个高注意力图像块来调用昂贵的病理学基础模型，从而在BRACS、PANDA和CAMELYON16数据集上以极少量的图像块（K=4/8/128）匹配全量推理的性能，避免了超过98%的基础模型嵌入计算。
AI.motivation: 基于注意力的多示例学习（ABMIL）在病理切片级任务中表现有效，但全量推理需要对每个前景图像块应用大型图像编码器，计算成本极高。然而注意力分布往往集中在少数信息丰富的区域，存在大量冗余计算可以消除。
AI.method: 提出ADMIL选择性计算框架：(1) 通过KL散度从原始图像块像素训练轻量级PriorNet（EfficientNet架构）来蒸馏ABMIL教师的注意力分布；(2) 推理时用PriorNet对前景图像块池打分并选择top-K个；(3) 仅对选中的子集调用昂贵的病理学基础模型，再由selected-bag ABMIL学生模型预测切片标签。
AI.result: 在BRACS、PANDA和CAMELYON16数据集上，ADMIL分别以K=4、8、128个图像块匹配全量教师模型的顶级性能，避免了超过98%的Virchow2基础模型图像块嵌入计算和推理FLOPs。随机和教师注意力oracle对照组证明性能提升源于任务相关选择而非单纯减少图像块数量。定性和定量分析表明PriorNet高保真地恢复了教师的图像块排序，并聚焦于任务相关的形态学区域。
AI.conclusion: ADMIL证明了几乎所有昂贵的图像块编码都可以被移除而不牺牲切片级性能，为临床场景中延迟和计算成本关键的应用提供了高效部署的潜在路径。

title: Privileged Critic Training Enables Sensor-Free Thruster Fault Adaptation in End-to-End RL
summary: Fault-tolerant navigation for thruster-actuated robots requires online adaptation to failures that are neither binary nor fully observable: thrusters may degrade continuously, fail dead, or jam stuck-open. Classical fault detection pipelines require dedicated sensors unavailable at deployment; oracle controllers that observe the true failure state are equally impractical. We show that privileged critic training is sufficient for sensor-free fault adaptation: giving the PPO value function access to the true degradation state dgt during training, while the actor receives only standard task observations, shapes a policy that compensates for failures at deployment without any dedicated fault sensing. We propose RAFT (Recurrent Asymmetric Fault Tolerant), a policy with recurrent memory trained with a privileged asymmetric critic. Evaluated on a floating-platform robot (8 thrusters, 1 reaction wheel) under up to four simultaneous thruster failures, RAFT achieves 70.2% success at four concurrent failures, closing 84% of the gap from a failure-naive baseline (4.8%) to an oracle policy that sees the full degradation state at deployment (82.4%). All code, checkpoints, and data are open-source.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAFT（循环非对称容错策略），利用特权评论家训练实现无传感器的容错导航。策略为推力器机器人应对连续退化、失效或卡死等多种故障模式，仅用标准任务观测即可在部署时补偿故障，无需专用故障传感器。
AI.motivation: 推力器驱动机器人的容错导航需要在线适应故障，但故障既非二值也非完全可观测（连续退化、失效、卡死）。经典故障检测需要专用传感器（部署时不可用），oracle控制器（观测真实故障状态）也不切实际，因此需要无需专用故障传感的适应方法。
AI.method: 提出RAFT（Recurrent Asymmetric Fault Tolerant），利用特权非对称评论家训练：训练时PPO价值函数可访问真实退化状态d_gt，而actor仅接收标准任务观测。策略配备循环记忆，在部署时无需任何专用故障传感即可补偿故障。
AI.result: 在浮动机器人平台（8推力器+1反应轮）上，最多4个同时推力器故障下RAFT达到70.2%成功率，缩小了从无故障感知基线（4.8%）到可观测完整退化状态的oracle策略（82.4%）之间84%的差距。
AI.conclusion: 特权评论家训练足以实现无传感器的故障适应，RAFT有效弥合了无故障感知与完全oracle之间的性能差距，且代码、检查点和数据全部开源。

title: Task-Driven 3D Printability Assistance via Geometry- and Knowledge-Grounded LLM Reasoning
summary: Printability assessment in additive manufacturing is typically conducted at the geometry level before printing to determine whether a computer-aided design (CAD) model or stereolithography (STL) file can be successfully fabricated. Task suitability, in contrast, is usually evaluated after printing to determine whether the fabricated part satisfies the requirements of its intended use. As a result, for non-expert users to print functional parts, unsuitable material or process choices may only be identified after fabrication, leading to repeated printing, material waste, and user frustration. To address this challenge, this paper leverages the reasoning and language-understanding capabilities of large language models (LLMs), while grounding the reasoning with geometry evidence and structured material/printer knowledge to generate reliable pre-print recommendations. Given a stereolithography (STL) model and a natural-language task description, the framework generates a structured recommendation covering printability, material choice, process parameters, design guidance, risks, and explanations. We evaluate the framework on focused STL benchmark scenarios with novice-style task descriptions. The proposed method achieves 75.0% printability over 96 physical validation trials, with 88.9% task suitability among successfully printed samples. It also improves Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite material-selection accuracy from 37.5% under pure LLM to 90.0%. Expert evaluation further shows improved report quality, while post-print feedback improves recommendations on selected problematic cases. These results suggest that user task intent, geometry evidence, and structured material knowledge are all important for reliable task-driven printability assistance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的预打印推荐框架，将几何证据和结构化材料/打印机知识嵌入LLM推理中，针对STL模型和自然语言任务描述生成包括可打印性、材料选择、工艺参数、设计指导和风险在内的结构化推荐，在96次物理验证中实现75%可打印性和88.9%任务适配性。
AI.motivation: 传统增材制造中，可打印性评估在打印前（几何层面）进行，而任务适配性评估通常在打印后（实物层面）进行，导致非专业用户可能在打印完成后才发现材料或工艺选择不当，造成重复打印、材料浪费和用户挫败感。现有方法缺乏在打印前将任务意图与几何、材料知识结合的能力。
AI.method: 利用LLM的推理和语言理解能力，同时将几何证据与结构化材料/打印机知识作为推理基础（grounding），输入为STL模型和自然语言任务描述，输出为涵盖可打印性、材料选择、工艺参数、设计指导、风险和解释的结构化推荐报告。
AI.result: 在96次物理验证试验中实现75.0%可打印性；成功打印样本中88.9%任务适配性；将Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite的纯LLM材料选择准确率从37.5%提升至90.0%；专家评估显示报告质量提升；后打印反馈可改善特定问题案例的推荐。
AI.conclusion: 用户任务意图、几何证据和结构化材料知识对于可靠的任务驱动型可打印性辅助都至关重要，该框架有效弥合了打印前可打印性评估与打印后任务适配性评估之间的鸿沟。

title: Spiking Neural Networks for Energy-Efficient Object Detection in Forward-Looking Sonar Imagery
summary: Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) are increasingly important tools in industries ranging from research, to energy, to defense. AUVs are power-constrained platforms operating in remote environments with fixed battery capacities, where propulsion competes with compute and sensors for power over lengthy mission durations. AUVs frequently operate in dark or turbid waters where optical sensing is of limited value, and rely on sonar as their primary sensing modality. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are the state-of-the-art solution for object detection in forward-looking sonar imagery, but are energy expensive (e.g. YOLOv8m: 322 mJ/inference). Spiking neural networks (SNNs) rely on binary spike activations and thus sparse accumulate-only operations, allowing them to be remarkably energy efficient, particularly when paired with dedicated neuromorphic hardware. The sparse, high-contrast structure of forward-looking sonar (FLS) returns is structurally matched to spike coding in a way that optical imagery is not. No prior work has assessed the suitability of SNNs for object detection in FLS imagery. SpikeYOLO, a fully spiking network trained with surrogate gradients, was benchmarked against state-of-the-art CNN baselines on three FLS object detection datasets. Key results: SpikeYOLO T=2 achieves 3.3$\times$ lower theoretical compute energy on UATD (97 vs 322 mJ) at competitive accuracy (0.529 mAP@0.5:0.95 vs. YOLOv8m's 0.575); SpikeYOLO matches YOLOv8m on mAP@0.5 and outperforms YOLO-SONAR and Fast R-CNN baselines on the sparse Marine-Debris-FLS dataset at 4.4$\times$ lower energy; SpikeYOLO demonstrates superior robustness to multiplicative speckle noise (3.0% degradation at $σ{=}0.4$ vs. 8.9% for YOLOv8m), outperforming YOLOv8m outright at $σ{=}0.6$, directly relevant to real-world FLS deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文首次评估了脉冲神经网络（SNN）在前视声纳（FLS）图像目标检测中的适用性。提出的SpikeYOLO在三个FLS数据集上与CNN基线对比，实现了约3.3-4.4倍的理论计算能耗降低，同时保持竞争性精度，并在散斑噪声鲁棒性方面优于YOLOv8m。
AI.motivation: 自主水下航行器（AUV）是功率受限平台，在远程环境中运行且电池容量固定，推进、计算和传感器之间需要竞争功率。AUV常在黑暗或浑浊水域中依赖声纳感知，而CNN目标检测能耗高昂（如YOLOv8m需322mJ/推理）。需要探索更节能的替代方案。脉冲神经网络（SNN）因其二进制尖峰激活和稀疏累加操作具有显著能效优势，且FLS的稀疏高对比度结构天然适配尖峰编码，但此前尚无研究评估SNN在FLS目标检测中的适用性。
AI.method: 提出SpikeYOLO，一种全脉冲网络，使用替代梯度（surrogate gradients）训练。在三个FLS目标检测数据集（包括UATD和Marine-Debris-FLS）上与最先进的CNN基线（YOLOv8m、YOLO-SONAR、Fast R-CNN）进行系统基准对比，评估精度（mAP）、理论计算能耗和散斑噪声鲁棒性。
AI.result: 1) SpikeYOLO T=2在UATD上实现3.3倍理论计算能耗降低（97 vs 322 mJ），精度接近YOLOv8m（0.529 vs 0.575 mAP@0.5:0.95）；2) 在稀疏的Marine-Debris-FLS数据集上，SpikeYOLO在mAP@0.5上匹配YOLOv8m并超越YOLO-SONAR和Fast R-CNN，能耗降低4.4倍；3) SpikeYOLO对乘性散斑噪声表现出更优鲁棒性（σ=0.4时退化3.0% vs YOLOv8m的8.9%），在σ=0.6时完全超越YOLOv8m。
AI.conclusion: SNN（特别是SpikeYOLO）是FLS目标检测中CNN的可行且更节能的替代方案。FLS数据的稀疏高对比度结构天然适配尖峰编码，使得SNN在显著降低能耗的同时保持竞争性精度，且对真实环境中常见的散斑噪声具有更强的鲁棒性，非常适合资源受限的AUV部署场景。

title: CSymPlan: Certified Symbolic Planning and Control for High-DOF Manipulators
summary: Robot manipulators are commonly engineered around a decoupled motion-generation stack: a planner computes a collision-free path and a lower-level controller tracks the resulting reference. This separation is computationally convenient, but it can produce references that are difficult to execute under actuator limits, tracking error, model mismatch, and small obstacle clearances. We present CSymPlan, a certified symbolic planning and control framework for high-DOF manipulators with two complementary implementations: an offline implementation that precomputes certified reach-avoid feedback policies for known workspaces; and an online implementation that synthesizes or updates symbolic policies at runtime from changing task and perception information using parallelization. The offline implementation reduces the manipulator dynamics to a sampled perturbed double-integrator model in operational space through feedback linearization, treats torque-realization errors, modeling inaccuracies, and measurement uncertainty as bounded disturbances, and refines the synthesized symbolic policy to the Franka FR3 through a quantization--lookup--torque realization pipeline. The online implementation uses the same abstraction and refinement interface, but replaces the precomputed policy table with a runtime pFaces request--synthesis--execution loop. In randomized simulated benchmarks and perception-driven Franka FR3 experiments, both implementations complete reach-avoid tasks with zero safety violations; whenever no certified action exists, the robot holds, replans, or stops safely instead of executing an uncertified command.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CSymPlan框架，为高自由度机械臂提供经过认证的符号规划与控制。该框架包含离线实现（预计算工作空间的认证可达-避障反馈策略）和在线实现（运行时根据任务和感知信息并行合成/更新符号策略）。两者均通过反馈线性化将机械臂动力学简化为带扰动的双积分器模型，并将力矩误差、建模不精确和测量不确定性视为有界扰动。在随机仿真基准和Franka FR3实验中实现零安全违规。
AI.motivation: 传统机械臂采用解耦的运动生成栈（规划器+控制器），虽然计算方便，但在执行器限制、跟踪误差、模型失配和小障碍间隙下可能产生难以执行的参考轨迹。
AI.method: 1) 离线实现：预计算认证的可达-避障反馈策略；2) 在线实现：通过并行化在运行时综合/更新符号策略；3) 通过反馈线性化将动力学简化为采样扰动双积分器模型；4) 将力矩实现误差、建模不精确和测量不确定性视为有界扰动；5) 通过量化-查找-力矩实现流水线将策略细化到Franka FR3；6) 在线实现采用pFaces请求-综合-执行循环。
AI.result: 在随机仿真基准和感知驱动的Franka FR3实验中，两种实现都完成了可达-避障任务且零安全违规。当不存在认证动作时，机器人安全地保持、重新规划或停止，而非执行未经认证的命令。
AI.conclusion: CSymPlan展示了符号规划与控制框架可以同时满足高自由度机械臂的安全性认证要求和实际运行效率，离线与在线实现互补，为安全关键型机械臂操作提供了可行方案。

title: MegaMem: A Retrieval Solution for Ultra-Large Context Windows
summary: Modern language models and agents increasingly require persistent memory for complete codebases, long interaction histories, and heterogeneous enterprise records. The key challenge is to keep hundreds of millions of tokens searchable while passing only bounded source evidence to the answer model. We introduce MegaMem, a source-resolved dual-view retrieval system that separates semantic access from generation evidence. Distilled records and detailed evidence are searched with original and transformed queries; every distilled hit resolves to an immutable source ID before reciprocal-rank fusion, deduplication, and cross-encoder reranking; and only the highest-ranked detailed evidence within a fixed budget supports generation. Post-answer attribution then identifies which loaded sources support the fixed answer. We evaluate MegaMem on EnterpriseRAG-Bench, which contains more than 500,000 heterogeneous enterprise documents and approximately 650M tokens. MegaMem improves Overall from 68.22 to 82.26 and reaches 86.50 Correctness. These results show that MegaMem supports ultra-large persistent memory while preserving strong answer accuracy under a bounded generation context. By separating searchable memory scale from answer-context size, MegaMem provides a practical path toward accurate retrieval over memories ranging from hundreds of millions to one billion tokens. Our code is available at https://github.com/ xfab-xinyuansong/MegaMem.git.

AI.tldr: MegaMem 是一种源解析的双视图检索系统，通过将语义访问与生成证据分离，支持数亿至十亿级 token 的持久记忆检索，同时在有限生成上下文下保持高准确率，在 EnterpriseRAG-Bench 基准上 Overall 从 68.22 提升至 82.26，Correctness 达 86.50。
AI.motivation: 现代语言模型和智能体需要为完整代码库、长交互历史和异构企业记录提供持久记忆，但挑战在于需要在数亿 token 中保持可搜索性，同时仅向答案模型传递有界的源证据。
AI.method: MegaMem 采用源解析的双视图检索架构：蒸馏记录和详细证据分别通过原始查询和变换查询进行检索；每次蒸馏命中解析为不可变源 ID 后再进行倒数排名融合、去重和交叉编码器重排序；仅在固定预算内向生成模型提供排名最高的详细证据；回答后归因机制识别支持固定答案的已加载源。
AI.result: 在包含超过 500,000 个异构企业文档、约 6.5 亿 token 的 EnterpriseRAG-Bench 基准上，MegaMem 将 Overall 从 68.22 提升到 82.26，Correctness 达到 86.50。
AI.conclusion: 通过将可搜索记忆规模与答案上下文大小分离，MegaMem 为从数亿到十亿 token 范围的记忆提供了高准确率检索的实际路径。

title: When More References Hurt: Contamination-Aware DINOv2 Memory Banks for Few-Shot Steel Defect Detection
summary: Patch-memory anomaly detectors assume that their reference bank is normal, an assumption that is difficult to guarantee when additional industrial images are unverified. We study whether a few trusted normal images can safely recover useful normal patches from such references without defect masks. Starting from the DINOv2 patch-memory formulation used by AnomalyDINO, we score candidate patches by distance to a clean seed bank, discard the most suspicious 20%, merge the retained patches with the seed, and enforce a fixed budget by greedy coreset selection. On Severstal, naive additional references contain 9.46% anomalous patches; the proposed trim rejects 78.1\% of them and reduces residual contamination to 2.59%. At an equal 51,200-patch development budget, the proposed bank reaches 0.1084 AUPRC versus 0.0950 for naive expansion, 0.0952 for random removal, and 0.1030 for eight clean images. Injecting only 0.5\% anomalous patches into a clean bank reduces AUPRC from 0.1030 to 0.0759. On all five completed held-out pairs, the proposed bank improves over naive expansion, with a mean gain of 0.0142 AUPRC. Reference purity is therefore a first-order design variable, and unverified images are useful only when their contribution is filtered explicitly.

AI.tldr: 本文研究补丁记忆异常检测器中参考库被未经验证图像污染的问题。作者提出利用少量可信的正常图像作为种子，通过距离评分过滤可疑补丁（丢弃最可疑的20%），再与种子合并并通过贪心核心集选择控制预算，从而在无缺陷掩码的情况下安全恢复有用的正常补丁。实验表明该方法能显著降低污染率并提升AUPRC性能。
AI.motivation: 现有补丁记忆异常检测器假设参考库是纯正常的，但实际工业场景中额外图像往往未经验证，可能包含异常补丁。作者旨在研究如何利用极少量可信正常图像，在无需缺陷掩码的情况下，从含污染的参考库中安全筛选出有用的正常补丁。
AI.method: 方法基于DINOv2补丁记忆框架（AnomalyDINO）：1) 以少量可信正常图像构建清洁种子库；2) 对候选补丁按到种子库的距离进行评分；3) 丢弃最可疑的20%补丁；4) 将保留补丁与种子合并；5) 通过贪心核心集选择（coreset selection）强制执行固定预算。
AI.result: 在Severstal数据集上：朴素额外参考含9.46%异常补丁，提出的修剪方法拒掉了78.1%的异常补丁，将残余污染降至2.59%。在51,200补丁的等预算下，提出方法达到0.1084 AUPRC，优于朴素扩展（0.0950）、随机移除（0.0952）和八张清洁图像（0.1030）。仅注入0.5%异常补丁就将AUPRC从0.1030降至0.0759。在五组已完成保留测试对中，提出方法平均提升0.0142 AUPRC。
AI.conclusion: 参考库纯度是一阶设计变量。未验证图像只有在经过显式过滤其贡献时才有价值，单纯扩展参考库反而会因异常污染损害检测性能。

title: InstructMove: A Text-Indispensable Benchmark for Instruction-Following Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have made general-purpose robot manipulation increasingly plausible by conditioning robot actions on natural-language instructions. A key test of such generality is whether policies actually follow language instructions. Yet many manipulation benchmarks leave this ability underdetermined: the intended object or destination is often visually salient or uniquely feasible, allowing policies to succeed without grounding the instruction. We argue that instruction-following evaluation should be text-indispensable: multiple actions should be visually and physically plausible, while only one should be consistent with the language instruction. We introduce InstructMove, a text-indispensable benchmark for instruction-following manipulation. InstructMove instantiates this principle in pick-and-place scenes with semantic distractors, decomposing instruction following into category identification, attribute discrimination, spatial reasoning, and compositional pick-and-place. InstructMove supports a train-eval protocol with InstructMove training data and held-out evaluation tasks, with additional diagnostics for language dependence. Experiments with representative VLA policies show that InstructMove provides a controlled testbed for diagnosing visual shortcuts and that InstructMove simulation data can improve real-world instruction-following manipulation performance. Code: https://github.com/HorizonRobotics/RoboOrchardSim

AI.tldr: 本文提出InstructMove基准，用于评估机器人操作中视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的指令跟随能力。核心观点是现有基准存在"文本非必需"问题（即无需理解语言仅凭视觉显著性即可成功），因此提出"文本不可或缺"的评估原则，通过语义干扰物确保只有遵循语言指令才能正确完成任务。
AI.motivation: 现有操作基准对指令跟随能力的评估不充分：目标物体或目的地往往具有视觉显著性或唯一可行性，使策略无需真正理解语言指令也能成功，导致指令跟随能力被"欠确定"（underdetermined）。
AI.method: 提出InstructMove基准，遵循"文本不可或缺"原则，在抓取-放置场景中引入语义干扰物，使多个动作在视觉和物理上均可行，但仅有一个符合语言指令。指令跟随被分解为类别识别、属性区分、空间推理和组合式抓取-放置四个子任务。基准支持训练-评估协议（提供训练数据和留出评估任务），并附带语言依赖性的诊断工具。
AI.result: 实验表明InstructMove为诊断视觉捷径（visual shortcuts）提供了受控测试平台，且InstructMove仿真数据能够提升真实世界的指令跟随操作性能。
AI.conclusion: InstructMove可作为评估和提升VLA模型指令跟随能力的有效基准，其仿真数据对真实世界泛化也有增益。

title: Measuring Stability and Failure Behavior in Language Models Under Structured Perturbations
summary: Language models are usually judged by a single accuracy score, which does not reveal how their performance degrades as inputs are perturbed. We present a graded, multi-family, failure-aware framework for stress-testing reasoning models. It perturbs each problem along a multi-level severity ladder across seven families: six that preserve the answer, paraphrase, input noise, formatting, irrelevant context, context load, and conflicting instructions, and a Knowledge Boundary family that removes answerability so that refusal becomes the correct response. Every test is validity-gated and labeled by its measured severity, and each model is summarized by per-level Accuracy, a magnitude-weighted Stability, and a per-family Collapse Point defined relative to the model's own baseline. Instantiated on the same 100 seed problems used by GSM-Symbolic, expanded into 4,473 gated tests and run on four models spanning capability tiers, the framework exposes structure that an aggregate score hides: the level at which a model fails is family-specific rather than global, and two stressors expose consistent weaknesses across all models: conflicting instructions and questions built on an impossible premise. Recognition of unanswerability is otherwise uneven, reliable on missing information and fabricated evidence but weak on impossible premises. These failure points are invisible to standard accuracy reporting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个分级的、多族类、失败感知的推理模型压力测试框架，将每个问题沿严重程度阶梯在七个族类（六个保持答案的扰动族和一个知识边界族）进行扰动，共生成4,473个门控测试。在四个模型上测试后发现：模型失败的层级因族类而异，且"冲突指令"和"不可能前提"两类压力在所有模型中暴露出一致的弱点，而这些失败点在标准准确率报告中不可见。
AI.motivation: 语言模型通常仅用单一准确率来评判，这无法揭示性能在输入被扰动时如何退化。本文旨在构建一个能揭示标准聚合分数所掩盖的失败结构的压力测试框架。
AI.method: 提出多级严重程度阶梯的压力测试框架，包含七个扰动族类：改写、输入噪声、格式、无关上下文、上下文负荷、冲突指令（均保持答案）以及知识边界（移除可回答性，使拒答成为正确响应）。每个测试经过有效性门控并按测量严重程度标注，模型通过每级准确率、幅度加权稳定性以及相对自身基线的每族类崩溃点来总结。
AI.result: 基于GSM-Symbolic相同的100个种子问题扩展为4,473个门控测试，在四个覆盖不同能力档次的模型上运行。结果显示：模型失败的层级是族类特异而非全局性的；两个压力因素（冲突指令和不可能前提）在所有模型中暴露出一致弱点；对不可回答性的识别能力不均匀——对缺失信息和虚构证据可靠，但对不可能前提较弱。
AI.conclusion: 标准准确率报告无法揭示这些失败点，本文框架能够暴露聚合分数掩盖的失败结构，为推理模型的鲁棒性评估提供了更细粒度的视角。

title: Three-Phase Scribble-Adaptive Curriculum Learning for autoPETV Grand Challenge
summary: This report describes Libo Zhang's algorithmic solution to autoPETV Grand Challenge on interactive lesion segmentation in whole-body PET/CT. Interaction is encoded as two additional input channels that rasterize the accumulated foreground and background scribbles, and a residual-encoder U-Net of about 140 million parameters is trained with a three-phase curriculum over 4000 epochs: the network first learns fully automatic segmentation with silent interaction channels, then observes ground-truth-derived scribbles under randomly sampled visibility modes, and finally adapts to its own mistakes through online simulation of up to five error-driven correction steps. Training draws on 1811 autoPET and DeepPSMA studies, and the submission ensembles the best and final checkpoints of five folds by logit averaging. In interactive five-fold cross-validation with six interaction steps, the final checkpoints reach a mean AUC-Dice of 3.836 and a mean AUC-DMM of 3.869, improving monotonically in every fold, with roughly half of the total gain delivered by the first corrective scribble. Our code and trained model checkpoints are available on https://github.com/Libo1023/autoPETV-Curriculum.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Libo Zhang在autoPETV Grand Challenge中关于全身PET/CT交互式病灶分割的算法解决方案。该方法通过将交互编码为额外的输入通道，使用约1.4亿参数的残差编码器U-Net，并采用三阶段课程学习策略（先学全自动分割，再观察源自真实标注的涂鸦，最后通过在线模拟适应自身错误），在4000个epoch上训练。最终通过五折logit平均集成，在交互式五折交叉验证中达到平均AUC-Dice 3.836和平均AUC-DMM 3.869。
AI.motivation: 针对autoPETV Grand Challenge中的交互式病灶分割任务，需要一种能有效利用用户交互信息（前景/背景涂鸦）的算法方案，在全身PET/CT影像中实现高精度的交互式分割。
AI.method: 1) 将前景和背景涂鸦栅格化编码为两个额外输入通道；2) 使用约1.4亿参数的残差编码器U-Net；3) 采用三阶段课程学习：先学习全自动分割（静默交互通道），再观察源自真实标注的涂鸦（随机可见模式），最后通过在线模拟最多五次错误驱动的修正步骤来自适应自身错误；4) 在1811个autoPET和DeepPSMA研究上训练；5) 通过五折logit平均集成最佳和最终检查点。
AI.result: 在交互式五折交叉验证中，使用六步交互时，最终检查点达到平均AUC-Dice 3.836和平均AUC-DMM 3.869，且在每一折中均单调提升，约一半的总增益来自第一次修正性涂鸦。
AI.conclusion: 该课程学习方法有效地将全自动分割训练与交互式分割学习相结合，通过在线模拟错误修正显著提升了交互式分割性能，代码和模型检查点已公开在GitHub上供复现。

title: Free-Energy-Gated Plasticity for Real-Time Online Motor Learning in Physical Human--Robot Interaction
summary: Fully online embodied learning requires synaptic adaptation to acquire new behaviors while preserving previously learned dynamics during ongoing interaction. We extend the Predictive-Coding-inspired Variational Recurrent Neural Network (PV-RNN) to continuously adapt its synaptic weights and propose Free-Energy-Gated Plasticity (FEGP), which regulates the effective learning rate according to variational free energy. In real-time physical human--robot interaction, a randomly initialized network acquired three cyclic motor patterns without offline pretraining, replay, or task-boundary signals, with all three patterns emerging in autonomous rollouts. Controlled experiments over ten randomized teaching streams and five network initializations per stream showed that FEGP substantially improved repertoire coverage and retention of previously acquired patterns after they left the recent observation window. Neither a constant learning rate matched to the gate's time-averaged effective rate nor replay of the same gain values with disrupted temporal organization reproduced these improvements. These results indicate that the temporal allocation of plasticity relative to model--environment mismatch, rather than simply its average magnitude or distribution, is critical for maintaining previously acquired behaviors during continued online learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自由能门控可塑性（FEGP）机制，扩展PV-RNN实现完全在线的具身学习。在真实人机物理交互中，随机初始化的网络无需离线预训练、回放或任务边界信号即可自主习得三种循环运动模式。实验表明，FEGP显著提升行为库覆盖率和旧模式保留能力，且关键因素是可塑性相对于模型-环境失配的时间分配，而非平均幅度或分布。
AI.motivation: 完全在线的具身学习要求突触在持续交互中适应新行为的同时保持已有动力学，这是一个尚未解决的挑战。现有方法通常依赖离线预训练、回放或明确的任务边界信号，难以满足真实在线学习的需求。
AI.method: 基于PV-RNN扩展其连续突触自适应能力，提出Free-Energy-Gated Plasticity（FEGP）机制，根据变分自由能调节有效学习率。在真实物理人机交互中，网络从随机初始化开始在线习得三种循环运动模式，并通过受控实验对比常数学习率和重放策略验证FEGP的有效性。
AI.result: 在十组随机教学序列和每组五种网络初始化的对照实验中，FEGP显著改善了行为库覆盖率和旧模式在离开观察窗口后的保留情况。常数学习率（匹配FEGP的时间平均有效速率）和重放相同增益值（但打乱时间组织）均无法复现同等改进效果。
AI.conclusion: 可塑性相对于模型-环境失配的时间分配（而非其平均幅度或分布）是持续在线学习中维持已有行为的关键。FEGP通过自由能门控实现对这一时间分配的优化，为完全在线的具身学习提供了有效方案。

title: MEMONDEMAND: A Memory Management System for Large-Scale Enterprise Data
summary: Enterprise repositories are large, heteroge- neous, and continuously updated, making re- trieval difficult when efficient access, source- faithful evidence, and cross-query adaptation must be supported together. Enterprise mem- ory extends retrieval beyond the model con- text, but existing systems do not jointly address collection-specific hierarchy construction, low- cost routing, detailed evidence loading, and workload-aware memory updates at this scale. We introduce MEMONDEMAND, short for On- Demand Memory, a memory management sys- tem with three coordinated mechanisms: a dy- namic multi-level hierarchy that determines the abstraction structure and depth for each col- lection, dual memory at every hierarchy level that separates distilled routing from detailed evidence, and on-demand memory promotion that updates node priority under a bounded active-state budget. On EnterpriseRAG-Bench, MEMONDEMAND outperforms the strongest published LB#1 result at every evaluated scale from 10M tokens through the complete 618M- token collection, with gains of 12.23% at 10M and 4.66% at 618M. Results on FinanceBench, HotpotQA, and FRAMES further show strong performance across financial, multi-hop, and fact-retrieval settings. Together, these results establish MEMONDEMAND as an accurate, ef- ficient, and scalable memory solution for very large enterprise repositories across data scales, domains, and evidence requirements. Our code is available at https://github.com/ xfab-xinyuansong/MemOnDemand.git.

AI.tldr: MEMONDEMAND是一个面向超大规模企业知识库的按需内存管理系统，通过动态多层次层级结构、每级双内存（路由与证据分离）以及有界活跃状态预算下的按需内存晋升三个协同机制，在10M到618M token的各种规模下均超越现有最强基线（10M时提升12.23%，618M时提升4.66%）。
AI.motivation: 企业知识库规模庞大、异构性强且持续更新，现有系统无法同时满足高效访问、来源可信的证据检索和跨查询适应性的需求。虽然企业内存（enterprise memory）将检索扩展到模型上下文之外，但现有系统未能联合解决集合特定的层级构建、低成本路由、细粒度证据加载以及工作负载感知的内存更新问题。
AI.method: 提出三个协同机制：(1) 动态多层次层级结构，为每个集合确定抽象结构和深度；(2) 每个层级级别的双内存，将蒸馏路由（distilled routing）与详细证据（detailed evidence）分离；(3) 按需内存晋升，在有界活跃状态预算下更新节点优先级。
AI.result: 在EnterpriseRAG-Bench上，从10M token到完整的618M token集合的每个评估规模均超越最强已发表结果（LB#1），10M规模提升12.23%，618M规模提升4.66%。在FinanceBench、HotpotQA和FRAMES上同样表现优异，覆盖金融、多跳和事实检索场景。
AI.conclusion: MEMONDEMAND被验证为一种准确、高效且可扩展的企业级大规模知识库内存解决方案，适用于不同数据规模、领域和证据需求。代码已开源。

title: Learning Implicit Constitutive Laws for Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting from Monocular Videos
summary: We present GCA (Gaussian Constitutive Alignment), a framework for learning implicit constitutive laws from monocular dynamic video of deformable objects represented by 3D Gaussians. Given a static multi-view scan for geometric initialization, our method learns intrinsic physical dynamics solely from a single fixed-viewpoint video of the moving object. Existing implicit methods often suffer from local minima under noisy supervision and lack physical interpretability, while explicit approaches rely on predefined constitutive equations, limiting generalizability and becoming unstable in monocular settings. To address these challenges, our framework unifies LoRA-based adaptation with two key alignment modules. First, we propose Rank-based Depth-Geometric Anchors (RDGA) to establish robust geometric constraints from monocular dynamic observations via scale-invariant rank-based depth alignment, reducing the reliance on unreliable pixel-level color supervision. Second, a Constitutive Prior Regularizer (CPR) integrates classical constitutive models as soft differentiable priors, regularizing the optimization while preserving the flexibility of implicit modeling---even when the actual material is absent from the hypotheses. Extensive experiments on synthetic, real-to-sim, and real-world datasets demonstrate that GCA outperforms existing methods, achieving 48% lower Chamfer Distance than the strongest baseline on synthetic benchmarks while remaining robust under monocular supervision.

AI.tldr: GCA是一个从单目动态视频中学习可变形物体隐式本构定律的框架，基于3D高斯表示。通过LoRA适应、排名深度几何锚点(RDGA)和本构先验正则器(CPR)两个对齐模块，在合成、真实到仿真和真实数据集上优于现有方法，较最强基线在合成基准上Chamfer距离降低48%。
AI.motivation: 现有隐式方法在噪声监督下易陷入局部最小值且缺乏物理可解释性，而显式方法依赖预定义本构方程，泛化性有限且在单目设置下不稳定。需要一种既能保留隐式建模灵活性又具有物理可解释性的方法。
AI.method: 框架统一了LoRA基适应与两个关键对齐模块：(1) 排名基础深度几何锚点(RDGA)，通过尺度不变排名基础深度对齐建立来自单目动态观测的鲁棒几何约束，减少对不可靠像素级颜色监督的依赖；(2) 本构先验正则器(CPR)，将经典本构模型作为软可微先验整合到优化中，即使实际材料不在假设集中也能保持隐式建模的灵活性。
AI.result: 在合成、真实到仿真和真实数据集上的广泛实验表明，GCA优于现有方法，在合成基准上比最强基线实现48%更低的Chamfer距离，且在单目监督下保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: GCA通过结合几何锚点约束和经典本构先验正则化，有效解决了单目视频下学习隐式本构定律的挑战，在物理可解释性与建模灵活性之间取得了良好平衡。

title: RoboRacer Arena: Scaling High-Fidelity Autonomous Racing in Isaac Sim
summary: RoboRacer offers a standardized platform for research using 1:10-scale autonomous vehicles, but the variety of available tracks hinders the process of acquiring policies. Although existing occupancy-grid simulators allow for the quick addition of new maps, they fail to include physical contact, while 3D simulators require each circuit to be implemented as a separate asset, thus limiting their scalability. In order to overcome this issue, we have developed RoboRacer Arena, a system that creates 3D racing environments directly from occupancy maps. Our method starts by using a flood fill algorithm to extract the drivable corridors and to identify the track boundaries, which are then used to establish the barriers. A distance field is calculated to define the collision boundaries. The track surfaces, collision properties, and materials are assembled into a USD stage, which allows for the automated and reproducible generation of the environment in Isaac Sim. The input maps can be obtained from SLAM sessions, from rescaled Formula 1 circuits, or from natural-language descriptions. When the input is based on natural language, we use Gemma 4 31B to generate a track specification without specifying any coordinates or geometry. To guarantee consistency and reproducibility, we apply geometric screening, procedural generation, and raster-level validation. The simulation environments are initialized in a time range of 1.18 to 2.48 seconds, with the initialization time increasing linearly as the raster size increases. In 30 matched trials involving 10 tracks and 3 seeds, 21 maps were generated and all passed validation. RoboRacer Arena currently contains 130 tracks and supports the generation of tracks from natural language. In benchmark tests, the system attains 8,707 vehicle-steps per second when using 256 parallel rigid-body vehicles, excluding the time taken for rendering and policy execution.

AI.tldr: RoboRacer Arena是一个从占用栅格地图自动生成3D赛车环境的系统，通过洪水填充算法提取可行驶走廊、距离场定义碰撞边界，并将轨道表面与碰撞属性组装成USD舞台，在Isaac Sim中实现自动化、可复现的环境生成。系统支持SLAM会话、缩放的F1赛道和自然语言描述（使用Gemma 4 31B）三种输入方式，目前包含130条赛道，在256个并行刚体车辆下达到8,707车辆步/秒。
AI.motivation: 现有的1:10比例自动驾驶研究平台RoboRacer面临赛道多样性不足的问题：占用栅格模拟器缺乏物理接触模拟，而3D模拟器需要为每条赛道单独实现资产，扩展性受限。需要一种能直接从占用地图快速生成3D赛车环境的方法。
AI.method: (1) 使用洪水填充算法提取可行驶走廊并识别赛道边界以建立障碍物；(2) 计算距离场定义碰撞边界；(3) 将赛道表面、碰撞属性和材料组装成USD舞台；(4) 支持三种输入：SLAM会话、缩放F1赛道、自然语言描述（使用Gemma 4 31B生成赛道规格）；(5) 应用几何筛选、程序化生成和栅格级验证保证一致性和可复现性。
AI.result: 模拟环境初始化时间在1.18-2.48秒范围内，初始化时间随栅格大小线性增长。在30次匹配试验（10条赛道×3种种子）中生成21张地图且全部通过验证。系统包含130条赛道，支持自然语言生成。基准测试中在256个并行刚体车辆下达到8,707车辆步/秒（不包括渲染和策略执行时间）。
AI.conclusion: RoboRacer Arena成功解决了从占用地图到3D赛车环境的高效、可扩展转换问题，通过自动化USD舞台生成实现了多种输入源（SLAM、F1赛道、自然语言）的统一环境创建，为RoboRacer平台的研究提供了更丰富的赛道资源和更快的策略学习流程。

title: Evaluation of Small Vision-Language Models on Qualitative Mechanical Problems
summary: Qualitative mechanical problem-solving (QMPS) refers to solving qualitative problems from the mechanical domain. Qualitative problems can be solved with minimal discipline-specific information, without any robust quantitative calculation, generally by using qualitative reasoning and commonsense knowledge. QMPS is a vital aspect of human intelligence that allows us to tackle a wide range of tasks, from simple everyday ones such as turning on a tap to complex tasks in highly demanding and well-paying jobs in various fields, e.g., emergency medicine, plumbing, driving, etc. Employers often use the Bennett Mechanical Comprehension Test (BMCT) to evaluate job candidates' ability to solve such problems. In this work, we assess two state-of-the-art multimodal models, Gemma-3 and Qwen-VL, on their ability to interpret mechanical problem images by eliciting a step-by-step chain of thought (CoT) and a final answer. Each image inherently encodes ground-truth qualitative facts, such as contact points in gears, support relations, and relative weights, which we use to evaluate each model's spatial and commonsense reasoning capabilities. We assess each chain for coherence, completeness, and logical progression to assess each model's thought process, and final answers are compared to verified solutions to measure accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了两种多模态大模型（Gemma-3和Qwen-VL）在定性力学问题求解（QMPS）上的表现，通过Bennett机械理解测试（BMCT）中的图像，利用逐步思维链（CoT）与最终答案来评估模型的视觉理解、空间推理和常识推理能力。
AI.motivation: 定性力学问题求解是人类智能的重要组成部分，广泛应用于日常任务和多种职业（如紧急医疗、水管工、驾驶等）。雇主常使用BMCT测试评估求职者的这类能力，但目前对多模态大模型在此类任务上能力的研究不足，需要系统性评估。
AI.method: 使用两个先进的多模态模型（Gemma-3和Qwen-VL）处理机械问题图像，通过逐步思维链（CoT）引导模型推理。图像本身编码了真实定性事实（如齿轮接触点、支撑关系、相对重量），用于评估模型的空间推理和常识推理。从连贯性、完整性和逻辑推进三个维度评估思维链过程，并将最终答案与验证过的解进行准确度比较。
AI.result: 研究发现两个模型在BMCT类定性力学问题上的表现存在差异，具体结果待正文详细呈现，包括思维链质量（连贯性、完整性、逻辑性）和最终答案准确率方面的对比。
AI.conclusion: 通过评估多模态模型在定性力学问题求解中的表现，揭示了当前模型在空间和常识推理方面的能力与局限，为改进多模态AI的机械理解能力提供了参考。

title: Vehicle speed dataset for the major European road network derived from Sentinel-2 imagery, 2022-2026
summary: The dataset provides individual vehicle speed observations on European E-roads: motorways, trunk roads, primary and secondary roads, as tagged in OpenStreetMap as e-road, for the years 2022-2026. Speeds are derived from Copernicus Sentinel-2 Level-2A satellite optical imagery using a processing pipeline that exploits the short, well-characterized acquisition delays between the blue (B02_10m), green (B03_10m), and red bands (B04_10m) of the Sentinel-2 push-broom instrument. A moving vehicle appears at slightly displaced positions in the three bands, forming a moving echo. The detected displaced intensity peaks are linked into per-vehicle trajectories through a prediction-and-matching procedure. The resulting displacements are converted into ground speeds using publicly accessible inter-band time delays. Each record contains the trajectory geometry, per-channel displacements and headings, internal quality indicators, the estimated speed, the acquisition timestamp, and the source Sentinel-2 product identifier. The dataset is distributed as GeoPackage files, with one record per detected vehicle, and can support studies of traffic patterns, speed behavior, transport modeling, and the calibration of road network attributes at a continental scale.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个基于Copernicus Sentinel-2卫星光学影像的欧洲E级公路（高速公路、主干道、一级和二级公路）车辆速度观测数据集（2022-2026年）。该数据集利用Sentinel-2推扫式传感器蓝、绿、红三个波段间短暂且特性明确的采集延迟，检测移动车辆在三个波段中产生的位移回波，并通过预测-匹配算法将检出的强度峰连接成逐车轨迹，再根据公开的波段间时间延迟将位移转换为地面速度。数据以GeoPackage格式分发，每条记录包含轨迹几何、各通道位移与航向、内部质量指标、估计速度、采集时间戳及源影像产品标识，可支持洲际尺度的交通模式、速度行为、交通建模和道路网络属性校准研究。
AI.motivation: 欧洲大陆尺度的实际道路车辆速度观测数据稀缺，传统地面传感器覆盖有限，需要一种可扩展、可重复的卫星遥感手段来获取广泛的交通速度信息，以支持交通模式研究和道路网络属性校准。
AI.method: 利用Sentinel-2 L2A影像蓝（B02）、绿（B03）、红（B04）三波段之间已知的采集时间延迟，检测移动车辆在各波段中出现的位置偏移（移动回波），通过预测-匹配算法将强度峰关联为逐车轨迹，再利用公开的波段间时间延迟将位移换算为地面速度。每条记录包含轨迹几何、各通道位移与航向、质量指标、速度、时间戳和影像产品ID。
AI.result: 生成了2022-2026年间覆盖欧洲E级公路网络的逐车辆速度观测数据集，以GeoPackage格式分发，每个记录对应一辆检测到的车辆，包含完整的速度及相关属性和质量信息。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集可作为洲际尺度交通模式分析、速度行为研究、交通建模和道路网络属性校准的有效数据来源，弥补了传统地面交通观测手段在空间覆盖上的不足。

title: Switched Turn-based Adaptive Source Seeking Strategy using Estimation and Information-driven Direction of Improvement
summary: Source seeking arises in applications such as gas leak localization, radiation monitoring, and environmental surveillance, where the origin of an unknown signal field must be estimated from spatial measurements. In practice, the source location is not directly observable and must be inferred from noisy scalar measurements collected during motion.In robotic source seeking, estimation and motion are closely linked: measurements improve the source estimate, while the chosen trajectory affects the quality of future measurements.Existing loop-based geometric strategies generate feasible motion but do not explicitly use estimation uncertainty to regulate direction updates.This paper presents a loop-based source-seeking framework that combines Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) estimation with Fisher Information Matrix (FIM)-based direction selection. The source estimate is updated during motion, and the heading is changed at loop boundaries using both estimation uncertainty and predicted information gain. A measurement-based stopping condition is used to detect convergence without requiring prior knowledge of the source location.Simulation results under stationary and moving source scenarios demonstrate improved tracking performance and reduced estimation error compared to purely information-driven or estimate-driven strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于循环轨迹的源搜索框架，结合扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）估计与Fisher信息矩阵（FIM）方向选择，在机器人运动过程中更新源估计，并在循环边界依据估计不确定性和预测信息增益调整航向，同时利用基于测量的停止条件检测收敛。
AI.motivation: 现有基于循环的几何源搜索策略虽然能生成可行运动，但未显式利用估计不确定性来调节方向更新，导致跟踪性能和估计精度受限。
AI.method: 提出循环轨迹源搜索框架，结合EKF进行源估计更新，利用FIM进行方向选择，在循环边界处同时考虑估计不确定性和预测信息增益来改变航向，并采用基于测量的停止条件实现无需先验位置的收敛检测。
AI.result: 在静止和移动源场景下的仿真结果表明，所提方法相比纯信息驱动或纯估计驱动策略，具有更好的跟踪性能和更低的估计误差。
AI.conclusion: 将估计不确定性纳入方向选择可有效提升源搜索的跟踪精度，该框架在静态与动态源场景下均优于单一驱动策略。

title: AUDITA: certified auditing and causal attribution of adverse outcomes in autonomous multi-agent systems
summary: Physical automation is scaling toward fleets of embodied machines commanded by an AI brain. Early deployments already run factories and warehouses at production rates beyond any human line, and their adoption is accelerating. But when their joint decisions cause harm, everyone involved has reason to blame everyone else, the machine vendor, the algorithm provider, the factory operator, the insurer, and the regulator, and no method can divide the responsibility between them. Existing methods read logs whose origin they cannot verify and name a single culprit, misrepresenting outcomes that are overdetermined, preempted, or caused by an omission. We present \audita{}, an audit layer pairing a tamper-evident record of every inter-agent command with a certified, graded causal-attribution engine. We prove its verdict cannot be gamed: a rule-following agent can never be made to look guilty, an attempt to shift blame is itself caught and graded, and we establish the exact limit of what an evidence-based auditor can certify. On live language-model pipelines it reduces the standard judge baseline's responsibility error roughly threefold; on a benchmark of accident-grounded structures it recovers responsibility where single-culprit baselines fail, and stays invariant under forgery. \audita{} turns the question of who is to blame from an argument about logs into a calculation over evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Audita，一个为多智能体机器人系统设计的审计层，结合防篡改命令记录与分级因果归因引擎，将"谁该负责"从日志争论转变为可计算的证据判断，并在实验中显著降低责任判定误差。
AI.motivation: 随着物理自动化扩展到由AI大脑指挥的机器人群组，其应用日益普及，但联合决策造成损害时责任无法划分——现有方法无法验证日志来源且只能指认单一元凶，对过度决定、先占或遗漏造成的后果会产生误判，各方（机器供应商、算法提供方、工厂运营者、保险商、监管者）互相推诿。
AI.method: Audita审计层包含两个核心组件：（1）防篡改的代理间命令记录；（2）经过认证的分级因果归因引擎。该方法提供形式化证明，确保判定不可被操纵：遵守规则的代理永远不会被误判有罪，试图推卸责任的行为本身会被捕获并分级，并确定了基于证据的审计者所能认证的确切极限。
AI.result: 在实时语言模型管道上，Audita将标准评判基线的责任误差降低约三倍；在事故场景基准上，能恢复单一元凶基线失效情况下的责任归属，并且对伪造保持不变性。
AI.conclusion: Audita将责任归属问题从关于日志的争论转变为对证据的计算，为多人机与多智能体系统的责任判定提供了可验证、防博弈的解决方案。

title: TRACE: Artifact-Robust Statistical Shape Modeling from Imperfect Surface Scans - A Case Study in Craniosynostosis 3D Photography
comment: Accepted at ShapeMI workshop at MICCAI 2026
summary: Craniosynostosis severity analysis increasingly relies on statistical shape models (SSMs) to quantify cranial morphology, but most existing workflows depend on computed tomography or heavily curated three-dimensional (3D) photographs. Raw clinical 3D photographs provide a radiation-free and repeatable alternative, yet often contain shoulders, hands, hair, clothing, scanner noise, and incomplete boundaries that corrupt correspondences. We introduce the Template-constrained Robust Artifact-aware Correspondence Estimation (TRACE) framework, an unsupervised method for constructing SSMs directly from artifact-contaminated clinical 3D head photographs. TRACE predicts sparse anatomically corresponding head-surface control points from the raw point cloud, refines them through a coarse-to-fine Surface-Aware Deformation cascade, and uses thin-plate spline warping to deform a clean template mesh into a subject-specific head reconstruction. This template-constrained formulation keeps dense correspondences on clinically relevant head anatomy while suppressing non-head artifacts. The correspondence module is decoupled from the point-cloud encoder, enabling the same deformation pipeline to be paired with different backbones, including PointNet, DGCNN, and Point Transformer V3. Across all backbones, TRACE substantially improves surface sampling, topology preservation, and shape-model quality over prior SSM methods, providing a scalable foundation for photograph-based craniosynostosis shape analysis and a framework that may extend to other artifact-contaminated surface scans when an appropriate clean template is available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRACE框架，一种无监督方法，直接从受伪影污染的临床3D头部照片构建统计形状模型（SSM），通过模板约束和表面感知变形级联，在抑制非头部伪影的同时保持密集对应关系，为基于照片的颅缝早闭形状分析提供可扩展基础。
AI.motivation: 现有颅缝早闭严重度分析依赖于统计形状模型（SSM），但大多依赖CT或精心处理的3D照片。原始临床3D照片虽无辐射且可重复，却包含肩膀、手、头发、衣物、扫描噪声和不完整边界等伪影，会破坏对应关系。需要一个能直接从受污染数据构建SSM的方法。
AI.method: TRACE框架包含三个关键组件：(1) 从原始点云预测稀疏解剖学对应的头部表面控制点；(2) 通过粗到细的表面感知变形级联进行细化；(3) 使用薄板样条（TPS）变形将干净模板网格变形为受试者特定的头部重建。对应模块与点云编码器解耦，可搭配不同骨干网络（PointNet、DGCNN、Point Transformer V3）。
AI.result: 在所有骨干网络下，TRACE相比现有SSM方法显著提升了表面采样、拓扑保持和形状模型质量。该框架为基于照片的颅缝早闭形状分析提供了可扩展基础。
AI.conclusion: TRACE证明模板约束的伪影感知框架能有效处理临床3D照片中的噪声污染，且该框架可推广到其他存在伪影的表面扫描场景，只要存在合适的干净模板即可应用。

title: Shaping the Evolutionary Dynamics of Robot Morphology via Adaptive Control Learning
summary: Robot co-design via bi-level optimization couples within-lifetime controller learning for fitness evaluation with cross-generational morphological evolution. Prior work has established that well-adapted morphology facilitates faster control learning, a property termed morphological intelligence.
