Yet how control learning reciprocally shapes morphological evolution remains unexplored. This paper examines both directions for a holistic account of brain-body interplay. We first show that morphological contributions to control learning decouple into two orthogonal dimensions. We formalize the convergence speed as morphological intelligence and identify the performance ceiling as a complementary quantity termed true potential. A concise functional relation is then established to jointly characterize both quantities from individual learning curves, which, when aggregated at the population level, capture evolutionary profiles. Through extensive experiments on simulated voxel-based soft robots, we reveal that premature fitness evaluation systematically underestimates true potential and biases selection towards fast learners. This restricts design space exploration, compromising both optimization efficiency and morphological diversity. Notably, the widely recognized morphological Baldwin effect emerges as an artifact of this bias rather than a general evolutionary tendency. We therefore propose AdaControl, which monitors disproportionate selection for morphological intelligence during evolution and allocates minimally sufficient control learning for unbiased fitness evaluation. With AdaControl, a simple genetic algorithm rivals state-of-the-art generative-model-based co-design methods in discovering diverse high-performing designs while cutting computation by up to 80% versus exhaustive control.

AI.tldr: 本文通过双层优化的机器人协同设计框架，研究了形态与控制的相互影响，提出了形态智能与真实潜力两个正交维度，并发现早期适应度评估会系统性低估真实潜力并偏向快速学习者，从而造成形态Baldwin效应这一假象。作者提出AdaControl方法，通过监测形态智能的不成比例选择，自适应分配最小必要控制学习量，使简单遗传算法在发现多样高性能设计上媲美SOTA生成模型方法，同时最多节省80%计算量。
AI.motivation: 以往研究关注形态如何促进控制学习（形态智能），但控制学习如何反向影响形态进化尚未被探索。作者旨在全面理解脑-体交互，特别是揭示早期评估对进化过程的潜在偏差及其后果。
AI.method: 1) 将形态对控制学习的贡献解耦为形态智能（收敛速度）和真实潜力（性能上限）两个正交维度；2) 建立简洁的函数关系从个体学习曲线联合表征两量，并在种群层面聚合为进化画像；3) 在体素软体机器人仿真上进行大量实验验证偏差效应；4) 提出AdaControl算法，监测形态智能的不成比例选择，动态分配最小充分的控制学习量以实现无偏适应度评估。
AI.result: 实验揭示过早适应度评估系统性低估真实潜力并偏向快速学习者，限制设计空间探索，损害优化效率和形态多样性；广泛认知的形态Baldwin效应是此偏差的产物而非普遍进化趋势。AdaControl使简单遗传算法在性能上媲美基于生成模型的最先进协同设计方法，且比穷举控制最多减少80%计算量。
AI.conclusion: 控制学习的足量分配对无偏形态进化至关重要。AdaControl提供了一种高效且自适应的协同设计策略，能够同时保证性能与多样性，挑战了此前关于形态Baldwin效应的认知。

title: Aggregation-Aware Synthetic Text Generation Against Authorship Re-Identification
comment: Proceedings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
summary: Online users often release multiple texts under the same identity, giving attackers an author profile that can reveal more than any single text. Existing authorship obfuscation methods optimize privacy independently for each document, leaving them blind to cross-document correlations that make aggregation dangerous. We propose Aggregation-Aware Synthetic Text Generation (AAST), a framework that addresses this gap by jointly selecting synthetic texts at the bundle level rather than optimizing each text in isolation. AAST targets attribution and verification attacks, including cross-genre settings where attacker references come from a genre not observed during generation or selection. Experiments across same-genre, cross-genre, neural, and independent non-neural stylometric attacks show that AAST lowers account-level linkability as bundle size grows, while preserving semantic quality, linguistic acceptability, and sentiment alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AAST框架，针对在线用户发布多个文本导致的跨文档聚合隐私泄露问题，通过束级别（bundle-level）联合选择合成文本来降低账户级别的可链接性，同时保持文本质量。
AI.motivation: 现有作者混淆方法独立优化每篇文档的隐私，忽视了跨文档相关性。攻击者可以利用同一身份下的多个文本来构建更强大的作者画像，使聚合分析比单文档分析更具威胁性。
AI.method: 提出聚合感知合成文本生成（AAST）框架，在束级别（bundle level）联合选择合成文本，而非孤立地优化每篇文本。该框架针对归属攻击（attribution）和验证攻击（verification），并支持跨体裁场景。
AI.result: 在同体裁、跨体裁、神经网络以及独立非神经网络文体攻击实验中，AAST在束规模增大时降低了账户级可链接性，同时保持了语义质量、语言可接受性和情感对齐。
AI.conclusion: AAST证明了束级别联合优化比独立文档优化更有效，为多文档场景下的作者隐私保护提供了新的解决方案。

title: When Does Visual Generation Help Visual Understanding in Unified Multimodal Models?
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) can perform both understanding and generation, raising a central question: can visual generation improve understanding? Existing evaluations provide mixed evidence, but confound task difficulty, reasoning paradigms, and the closed-loop interaction between generation and understanding. We introduce VGAU-Diag, a fine-grained evaluation framework for vision generation-assisted understanding. It stratifies samples by difficulty, enables unified evaluation of multiple reasoning paradigms, and uses Oracle-Assisted Reference Protocols. Our analysis shows that generated visual aids help on easier instances but become unreliable as reasoning complexity increases. Oracle-assisted diagnosis further reveals that the main bottleneck often lies on the visual-understanding side rather than the visual-generation side, as current UMMs struggle to leverage even faithful visual aids. We also show that effective visual generation should target visual-understanding bottlenecks rather than add more reasoning steps, and identify a three-stage transition from task-irrelevant noise, to misleading plausible guidance, and finally to useful assistance. These findings would be useful to guide the development of better UMMs.The code is available at https://github.com/zyb1029/VGAU-Diag.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了VGAU-Diag，一个细粒度的评估框架，用于诊断视觉生成是否能辅助统一多模态模型（UMMs）的理解能力。通过按难度分层、统一评估多种推理范式、并使用Oracle辅助参考协议，研究发现：生成的视觉辅助在简单实例上有帮助，但随着推理复杂度增加变得不可靠；主要瓶颈在于视觉理解端而非视觉生成端；有效的视觉生成应针对视觉理解瓶颈而非增加推理步骤；并识别出从任务无关噪声到误导性合理引导再到有用辅助的三阶段转变。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）能同时进行理解和生成，但现有评估对"视觉生成能否改善理解"这一问题给出混合证据，原因是混淆了任务难度、推理范式和生成与理解之间的闭环交互因素，缺乏细粒度的诊断方法。
AI.method: 提出VGAU-Diag框架，包括三个关键设计：(1) 按难度对样本分层；(2) 支持多种推理范式的统一评估；(3) 引入Oracle辅助参考协议，用于区分瓶颈在视觉生成端还是视觉理解端。
AI.result: 发现生成的视觉辅助在较简单实例上有帮助，在推理复杂度增加时变得不可靠；Oracle诊断显示主要瓶颈在视觉理解端，当前UMMs即使面对忠实的视觉辅助也难以有效利用；有效的视觉生成应针对视觉理解瓶颈而非增加推理步骤；观察到从任务无关噪声到误导性引导再到有用辅助的三阶段转变。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现为开发更好的统一多模态模型提供了指导方向，强调应聚焦于提升模型的视觉理解能力，并针对性地设计视觉生成辅助策略。

title: Pointing-VLA: Typed Spatial Grounding Interfaces for Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models often expose spatial grounding through autoregressive text coordinates or opaque action tokens, creating brittle interfaces between multimodal reasoning and robot execution. We present Pointing-VLA, a typed hidden-state spatial readout built on Embodied-R1. Geometry-specific heads predict normalized points, object-functional grounding (OFG) heatmaps, and visual trajectories without serializing geometry as text. For the evaluated Bridge/WidowX and physical pick-place deployments, an explicit execution contract assigns PICK to source-conditioned OFG and PLACE to Pointing, providing direct stage-aligned spatial targets. Pointing-VLA achieves SOTA performance on Bridge/WidowX, averaging 72.9\% across the evaluated four-task set without Bridge-specific finetuning under collision-enabled CuRobo execution. Pointing and OFG show complementary strengths across native and cross-dataset evaluations. The OFG/contact readout transfers to NORA-1.5, preserving or improving success while reducing recorded controller time by more than 20$\times$; typed heads are also 6.68--6.90$\times$ faster than Embodied-R1 text decoding on a shared external suite. When integrated as spatial guidance for a $π_{0.5}$ action policy, Pointing-VLA raises autonomous real-robot success from 52.7\% to 80.7\% across three visual contexts. These results establish typed spatial readouts as an efficient, inspectable interface between embodied reasoning and robot execution.

AI.tldr: Pointing-VLA 提出了一种基于类型化隐藏状态的空间读出机制（typed hidden-state spatial readout），通过几何专用预测头直接输出归一化点、目标功能接地（OFG）热力图和视觉轨迹，避免将几何信息序列化为文本。在Bridge/WidowX和真实机器人拾放任务上取得SOTA性能，平均72.9%，且比Embodied-R1文本解码快6.68-6.90倍。作为π0.5策略的空间引导时，将真实机器人成功率从52.7%提升至80.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型通过自回归文本坐标或不透明的动作token进行空间接地，在多模态推理与机器人执行之间形成了脆弱接口。作者希望建立更高效、可检查的空间读写接口，避免几何信息的文本序列化带来的低效和不稳定问题。
AI.method: 基于Embodied-R1构建Pointing-VLA，使用几何专用预测头（heads）输出三类空间信号：(1) 归一化点（Pointing），(2) 目标功能接地OFG热力图，(3) 视觉轨迹。通过显式执行契约将PICK阶段分配给源条件OFG、PLACE阶段分配给Pointing，提供阶段对齐的空间目标。在碰撞启用的CuRobo执行下，无需Bridge特定微调即可评估。
AI.result: 在Bridge/WidowX四任务集上平均72.9%的SOTA性能；OFG/接触读出迁移到NORA-1.5保持或提升成功率，同时控制器时间减少20倍以上；类型化头比Embodied-R1文本解码快6.68-6.90倍；作为π0.5的空间引导时，真实机器人成功率从52.7%升至80.7%。
AI.conclusion: 类型化空间读出机制（typed spatial readouts）是连接具身推理与机器人执行的高效、可检查接口，能够替代文本坐标序列化，同时提升性能和效率。

title: MCP-Universe RL: A Framework for Training MCP Tool-Use Agents via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become an effective way to improve the tool-use ability of large language models (LLMs), but most existing RL frameworks stop at the policy update. For every new domain, the user is left with two hard systems problems: standing up an isolated environment for each of hundreds of concurrent trajectories and connecting it to training, and scheduling the rollout so that the GPU stays busy across long, multi-turn episodes that spend much of their time stalled on slow tool calls. We present MCP-Universe RL (MCP-U RL), an open-source framework that takes over both. It uses the Model Context Protocol (MCP) as the interface to the environment, so any tool already exposed as an MCP server plugs into training with no RL-specific integration code. It builds the two missing layers once and reuses them across domains: an environment-orchestration layer that provisions, isolates, and recycles the MCP environments over a pluggable container backend, and a rollout-orchestration layer whose staged pipeline overlaps trajectories to keep the GPU busy while episodes wait on tools. A backend-agnostic training layer then applies the update through an existing RL backend, with veRL and slime integrations. With one configuration, changing only the task specification, we train software-engineering, deep-research, and general tool-use agents on gpt-oss-20b and improve task reward in all three.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MCP-Universe RL（MCP-U RL），一个开源强化学习框架，解决了LLM工具使用训练中环境编排和rollout调度两大系统难题。它利用MCP协议统一环境接口，通过容器后端管理环境生命周期，并通过分阶段流水线重叠轨迹以保持GPU繁忙，在gpt-oss-20b上对软件工程、深度研究和通用工具使用三个领域均提升任务奖励。
AI.motivation: 现有RL框架在LLM工具使用训练中仅关注策略更新，却遗留两个关键系统问题：一是每个新领域都需要为数百个并发轨迹搭建隔离环境并接入训练；二是长序列、多轮对话的rollout中，大量时间因慢速工具调用而停滞，导致GPU利用率低下。
AI.method: MCP-U RL采用MCP协议作为环境统一接口，使任何已暴露为MCP server的工具无需RL专用集成代码即可接入训练。框架构建两个可跨领域复用的层：环境编排层通过可插拔容器后端完成环境的配置、隔离与回收；rollout编排层采用分阶段流水线重叠轨迹，使GPU在等待工具调用时保持忙碌。训练层通过后端无关设计接入现有RL后端（veRL和slime）。
AI.result: 仅通过修改任务配置（单一配置文件），在gpt-oss-20b模型上分别训练了软件工程、深度研究和通用工具使用智能体，三个领域均获得了任务奖励的提升，验证了框架的通用性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: MCP-U RL通过将环境编排和rollout调度抽象为可复用层，利用MCP协议统一接口，有效解决了LLM工具使用RL训练中的基础设施瓶颈问题，让用户只需变更任务配置即可跨领域复用完整的训练流程，显著降低了系统复杂度。

title: VERDICT: Agreement Beats Pixel-Space Verification in Real-Document OCSR
summary: Optical Chemical Structure Recognition (OCSR) converts 2D molecular depictions in the published literature into SMILES, and is increasingly important for constructing large-scale chemical training datasets. Automation at that scale requires identifying unreliable predictions in the absence of ground truth. Three families of label-free signals were compared on $263$ ACS journal depictions with verified ground truth: model confidence, re-rendering similarity, and agreement among recognizers. Pixel-space re-rendering performed little better than chance (AUROC $0.547$, $95\%$ CI $[0.465,0.629]$), and an oracle-tuned threshold on it reduced correct labels per image from $0.745$ to $0.205$. Agreement among four architecturally distinct recognizers instead reached an AUROC of $0.916$ ($[0.880,0.952]$). The two-of-four rule accepted $81.7\%$ of images at $88.8\%$ precision, the three-of-four rule $52.1\%$ at $98.5\%$. The same pattern held on CLEF-IP, UOB, and USPTO. This distinction is obscured on synthetic benchmarks, where re-rendered predictions naturally resemble their inputs. A substance filter removed $2{,}193$ false agreements on wildcards and R-group fragments, after which the three-of-four rule rejected all $68$ generic depictions. VERDICT was then applied to PMC Open Access, producing $6{,}146$ structure labels for $4{,}833$ molecules; chemist adjudication of $400$ released labels in two independent samples yielded precisions of $0.995$ for the three-of-four tier and $0.958$ for the two-of-four tier. VERDICT therefore enables validated labels for multimodal molecular databases linking structure images, machine-readable representations, and source-publication information. In SES AI's Molecular Universe platform, VERDICT further serves as an image-based interface for searching and retrieving molecular records.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VERDICT方法，用于在无真实标签条件下验证光学化学结构识别（OCSR）的预测可靠性。比较了三种无标签信号，发现识别器间一致性远超像素级重渲染相似度（AUROC 0.916 vs 0.547），并通过二选三规则在PMC开放获取数据集上生成高精度结构标签，应用于分子数据库平台。
AI.motivation: 大规模化学训练数据集的构建需要自动化OCSR，但缺乏地面真值，难以识别不可靠的预测。现有方法（如重渲染相似度）在真实文献图像上表现欠佳，需要更可靠的标签验证信号。
AI.method: 比较三类无标签信号：模型置信度、重渲染相似度、识别器间一致性。采用四种架构不同的OCSR识别器进行投票（两选三/三选四规则），并添加物质过滤器剔除通配符和R基团片段的假一致性，形成VERDICT验证流程。
AI.result: 像素级重渲染AUROC仅0.547，而识别器间一致性达0.916。两选三规则在81.7%图像上达到88.8%精度，三选四规则在52.1%图像上达98.5%精度。在PMC上生成6,146个结构标签，化学家审核显示三选四层级精度0.995，两选三层级0.958。
AI.conclusion: VERDICT通过多识别器一致性验证，能在无地面真值条件下为OCSR提供高可靠性标签，支持大规模多模态分子数据库的构建，并可作为图像化分子检索界面。

title: Spinning Quadrotor: Hover Thrust Augmentation with Passive Lifting Surfaces
summary: Conventional multirotor aerial vehicles actively suppress yaw rotation during hover, expending power to maintain a fixed heading despite the fact that yaw regulation is not required for force balance or altitude control. This paper challenges that paradigm by proposing a spinning quadrotor architecture that intentionally operates at a sustained yaw rate, converting power traditionally spent on yaw regulation into useful aerodynamic effects. A dynamic model of the spinning quadrotor is developed, analysis for low Re range is conducted to choose an airfoil for lifting surfaces. Preliminary hardware tests show a 22% reduction in thrust required. These findings suggest that intentional yaw rotation, rather than being suppressed, can be exploited as a design mechanism for efficient and robust multirotor flight.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"自旋四旋翼"架构，让飞行器在悬停时主动保持持续偏航旋转，而非传统地抑制偏航。通过将原本用于偏航调节的功率转化为有用的气动效应，结合低雷诺数气动分析和翼型选择，初步硬件测试表明所需推力降低22%，证明主动偏航旋转可作为提升多旋翼效率和鲁棒性的设计机制。
AI.motivation: 传统多旋翼飞行器在悬停时需要主动抑制偏航旋转以保持固定航向，这消耗了额外的功率。然而偏航调节对于力平衡或高度控制并非必要，因此这些功率本质上是浪费的。作者挑战这一传统范式，探索能否将有意的偏航旋转转化为有益的气动效果。
AI.method: 1) 提出自旋四旋翼的动力学模型；2) 针对低雷诺数（low Re）范围进行气动分析以选择合适的翼型用于升力面；3) 搭建初步硬件平台进行实验验证。
AI.result: 初步硬件测试显示，自旋四旋翼架构相比传统方案所需推力降低了22%。
AI.conclusion: 有意的偏航旋转不应被抑制，而可以作为一种设计机制被利用，以实现更高效、更鲁棒的多旋翼飞行。该发现为多旋翼飞行器设计提供了新的思路。

title: Role-Specialized Mixture-of-Agents with Open-Weight LLMs for Clinical Prediction
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to clinical prediction tasks such as in-hospital mortality and readmission from electronic health records (EHRs). Privacy and compliance constraints motivate systems that can be deployed locally, which has increased interest in open-weight multi-agent designs. However, most medical multi-agent systems are evaluated as a single block, leaving unclear which agent role contributes to prediction and whether retrieval drives observed gains. We study a role-specialized Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) that combines medical knowledge retrieval with contrastive similar-patient reasoning. By varying the role design while holding the retrieval setup fixed, we localize the main effect to the final integrator. Pairing large open-weight analysts with a small open-weight integrator matches closed-model prompting on F1 for mortality prediction while flagging substantially more true high-risk patients. Mechanism analysis shows the role assignment directly yields a high-recall operating point without threshold tuning. The effect is task-dependent, with smaller gains for readmission because the available records correlate weakly with this longer-horizon outcome. These results position role design as a key factor in privacy-constrained, training-free clinical LLM prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了面向临床预测任务（如院内死亡率、再入院）的角色专业化Mixture-of-Agents（MoA）系统，通过固定检索设置并变化角色设计，发现最终整合器（integrator）是预测效果的主要贡献者。将大型开放权重分析师与小型开放权重整合器配对，在死亡率预测的F1指标上可与闭源模型提示相媲美，同时标记出更多真正的高风险患者。
AI.motivation: 隐私与合规约束促使临床LLM系统可本地化部署，因此开放权重多智能体设计受到关注。然而，大多数医学多智能体系统作为整体被评估，无法明确各智能体角色对预测的贡献，也不清楚检索是否真正驱动了效果提升。
AI.method: 构建角色专业化的Mixture-of-Agents（MoA）系统，结合医学知识检索与对比相似患者推理。通过保持检索设置固定、变化角色设计的方式，将主要效应定位到最终整合器，并进行机制分析。
AI.result: 主要效果来自最终整合器；大型开放权重分析师加小型开放权重整合器的组合在F1上与闭源模型持平，并能标记显著更多的真正高风险患者；角色分配可直接获得高召回工作点而无需阈值调整；该效应具有任务依赖性，在再入院预测上增益较小。
AI.conclusion: 角色设计是在隐私约束、免训练的临床LLM预测中的关键因素。

title: SAM3Dual: A 3rd Place Solution to the MOSEv2 Track, 8th LSVOS Challenge
comment: 3rd place solution to the MOSEv2 Track of the 8th LSVOS Challenge at ECCV 2026
summary: We present SAM3Dual, our third-place solution to the MOSEv2 track of the 8th Large-scale Video Object Segmentation (LSVOS) Challenge at ECCV 2026. SAM3Dual is a training-free inference extension of pretrained SAM 3 that explicitly separates temporal memory into a short-term branch for recent observations and a long-term branch for interval-sampled historical representations. The two memory responses are combined using a deterministic sequence-relative fusion schedule and conservatively modulated by the previous-frame object confidence. All pretrained SAM 3 parameters remain frozen, requiring no task-specific training, fine-tuning, test-time training, or online parameter optimization. The complete system achieved an official J&F score of 64.37 and ranked third in the MOSEv2 track. This result highlights the potential of reorganizing temporal memory entirely at inference time to obtain competitive long-term VOS performance while preserving the pretrained model.

AI.tldr: SAM3Dual是ECCV 2026第八届大规模视频目标分割挑战赛MOSEv2赛道第三名的解决方案，通过将预训练SAM 3的时序记忆显式分为短期分支和长期分支，在推理阶段以零训练方式重组记忆中不同时间尺度的信息，在冻结全部参数的情况下获得64.37的J&F分数。
AI.motivation: 长时视频目标分割（long-term VOS）面临记忆漂移和计算开销的挑战，现有方法通常需要任务特定的训练或微调来适应长时间序列。作者希望探索能否在不进行任何训练的前提下，仅通过推理阶段重新组织预训练模型的时序记忆结构来提升长时序分割性能，从而保留预训练模型的能力并避免额外的训练成本。
AI.method: SAM3Dual在预训练的SAM 3之上构建训练无关（training-free）的推理扩展：1) 将时序记忆显式分离为短期分支（近期观测）和长期分支（间隔采样的历史表征）；2) 通过确定性的序列相对融合调度（sequence-relative fusion schedule）结合两条记忆分支的响应；3) 使用前一帧的目标置信度对融合结果进行保守调制。所有SAM 3预训练参数完全冻结，无需任务特定训练、微调、测试时训练或在线参数优化。
AI.result: 官方J&F分数达到64.37，在MOSEv2赛道中排名第三，验证了纯推理阶段重组时序记忆获得竞争力的长时VOS性能的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，完全在推理阶段重新组织时序记忆结构，即可在不触碰任何预训练参数的前提下取得有竞争力的长时视频目标分割性能，为利用预训练大模型的时序能力提供了轻量级、免训练的替代路径。

title: Guided Riemannian Optimization (GuRO): Bridging Model Predictive Control and Decision Transformers
summary: Decision-making in high-dimensional, nonlinear systems remains a central challenge in robotics. While model-based methods like Model Predictive Control (MPC) offer sample efficiency and interpretability, their performance degrades when the dynamics model is inaccurate or long-horizon predictions are required. Conversely, model-free reinforcement learning (RL) learns policies directly from interaction but suffers from high sample complexity and unstable optimization. Recent advances in sequence modeling have inspired transformer-based decision-making frameworks that can unify MPC and RL, but their training typically faces significant optimization challenges due to highly non-convex loss landscapes. In this work, we propose a novel framework that integrates MPC with RL in a sequence decision-making framework and leverages a curvature-aware optimization to efficiently tackle non-convex loss landscapes. MPC provides predictions of locally optimal trajectories that guide the decision transformer, removing the need for extensive offline pretraining. To address the slow and unstable convergence of traditional optimizers, we train the policy in a Riemannian parameter space using an efficient Riemannian (curvature-aware) method, leading to faster and more robust optimization. We evaluate our framework on high-dimensional quadruped control tasks and demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines, including TRPO, SAC, and Online Decision Transformer, achieving higher returns and faster convergence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个将MPC与强化学习集成的序列决策框架，通过黎曼曲率感知优化方法高效训练决策变换器，在高维四足机器人控制任务上超越TRPO、SAC和在线决策变换器等基线。
AI.motivation: 高维非线性系统的决策制定仍是机器人学的核心挑战。基于模型的MPC方法在模型不准确或需要长时域预测时性能下降；无模型的RL方法样本效率低且优化不稳定；基于Transformer的决策框架面临高度非凸损失景观带来的优化困难。
AI.method: 提出一个统一MPC与RL的序列决策框架：MPC提供局部最优轨迹预测来引导决策变换器，避免大规模离线预训练；在黎曼参数空间中采用曲率感知的优化方法训练策略，以应对非凸损失景观，实现更快更稳的收敛。
AI.result: 在高维四足机器人控制任务上进行了评估，相比TRPO、SAC和Online Decision Transformer等强基线，框架在回报和收敛速度上均取得了一致的改进。
AI.conclusion: 通过将MPC的样本效率与RL的灵活性相结合，并借助黎曼优化解决非凸优化难题，该框架有效提升了高维控制任务中的学习性能与稳定性。

title: Disagree to Explore, Agree to Commit: Routing-Guided Test-Time Scaling for Software Agents
summary: Software-engineering agents solve repository-level tasks through long, stochastic tool-use trajectories, and repeated attempts often find fixes missed by one run. Test-time scaling is difficult because patches lack canonical answer forms, while sibling actions from a shared prefix are correlated. We study whether native MoE router traces can guide steering and selection without an external judge or selection-time test execution. Our analysis shows that routing provides a robust behavioral role signal; token-granular readouts and decision-matched comparison sets turn it into effective control. We therefore introduce Risa (Routing-Informed Steering and Arbitration): within trajectories, routing encourages diverse exploration and controlled convergence during patch commitment; across separately sampled trajectories, agreement at informative patch positions selects a final candidate. We evaluate on SWE-bench Verified using open-weight sparse MoE agents across scales and reasoning-effort settings. Risa's routing arbitration raises the macro-average resolved rate from 44.9% under uniform sampling to 48.2% on the gpt-oss family, matching text consensus without answer-string matching, and it transfers to Qwen3.6, where it improves on uniform choice and matches text consensus on the full 500-task benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Risa方法，利用MoE（混合专家）模型的路由痕迹（router traces）来引导和挑选软件工程智能体的补丁，无需外部评判器或测试执行。在SWE-bench Verified基准上，Risa将宏平均解决率从44.9%提升至48.2%，与文本共识方法效果相当。
AI.motivation: 软件工程智能体解决仓库级任务需要长时间、随机的工具使用轨迹，多次尝试往往能发现单次运行漏掉的修复。测试时扩展计算困难，因为补丁缺乏标准的答案形式，而同前缀的兄弟动作之间存在相关性。作者希望探索是否可以利用原生MoE路由器的痕迹来引导和选择，而不依赖外部评判器或选择时的测试执行。
AI.method: 提出Risa（Routing-Informed Steering and Arbitration）方法，包含两部分：1）轨迹内：利用路由信息鼓励多样化探索，并在补丁提交阶段控制收敛；2）轨迹间：在信息丰富的补丁位置上，通过路由一致性来选择最终候选补丁。核心思想是利用token粒度的路由读出和决策匹配的比较集合，将路由模式转化为有效的控制信号。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Verified基准上，使用开放权重的稀疏MoE智能体在不同规模和推理努力设置下评估。Risa的路由仲裁将宏平均解决率从均匀采样的44.9%提升至48.2%（gpt-oss系列），与文本共识方法相当（无需答案字符串匹配）；该方法还迁移到Qwen3.6，在完整的500任务基准上优于均匀选择并匹配文本共识。
AI.conclusion: MoE路由痕迹提供了稳健的行为角色信号，可在不需要外部评判器或测试执行的情况下，有效引导和仲裁软件工程智能体的补丁选择，为测试时计算扩展提供了一种新的可行路径。

title: UR$^{2}$-MLLM: Uncertainty-aware Revisit Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models for Radiology Report Generation
summary: Radiologists generate diagnostic reports through iterative and selective revisiting of suspicious regions to refine their interpretations. Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for radiology report generation (RRG) have shifted from text-only reasoning toward a ``Thinking-with-Images'' paradigm, incorporating visual evidence into the reasoning process. However, existing methods provide static visual evidence without a dynamic revisit mechanism during reasoning, neglecting how radiologists re-examine uncertain observations. To this end, we propose an Uncertainty-aware Revisit Reasoning MLLM (UR$^{2}$-MLLM) framework that dynamically revisits uncertain regions during reasoning for RRG. UR$^{2}$-MLLM is first equipped with uncertainty perception by training on an uncertainty-aware dataset. We then construct a multimodal reasoning trajectory dataset together with a detect-and-copy mechanism, which guides when and where to revisit. Finally, a visual grounding reward refines this behavior through reinforcement learning, aligning the revisited regions with corresponding anatomical structures. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR and IU-Xray show that UR$^{2}$-MLLM achieves state-of-the-art performance, highlighting the value of uncertainty-aware visual revisit reasoning for reliable and clinically aligned report generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UR²-MLLM框架，通过动态重访不确定区域来模拟放射科医生的诊断推理过程，用于放射报告生成（RRG）。该框架包含不确定性感知训练、多模态推理轨迹数据集与检测-复制机制，以及视觉定位奖励的强化学习，在MIMIC-CXR和IU-Xray上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有放射报告生成的多模态大语言模型虽然已转向"带图思考"范式，但提供的是静态视觉证据，缺乏动态重访机制，未能模拟放射科医生在遇到不确定观察时反复检查可疑区域的行为。
AI.method: 1) 通过不确定性感知数据集训练赋予模型不确定性感知能力；2) 构建多模态推理轨迹数据集配合检测-复制机制，指导何时何地重访；3) 使用视觉定位奖励通过强化学习优化重访行为，使其与对应解剖结构对齐。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-CXR和IU-Xray两个基准数据集上取得最先进（SOTA）性能，验证了不确定性感知视觉重访推理对可靠和临床对齐报告生成的价值。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性感知的动态视觉重访推理是提升放射报告生成可靠性和临床对齐度的有效途径，为RRG领域提供了新的推理范式。

title: Think Only When Needed: Prompt-Authority Control for Selective Slow-Path Intervention in Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
summary: Retrieval can efficiently and effectively augment a frozen vision--language--action (VLA) policy without retraining, yet retrieved text becomes a control intervention once it enters the executed prompt. In a matched audit, raw appended text reduces mean success from 92.47\% to 3.00\%, while meaningful and length-matched meaningless appends both fail on all 500 states. This result identifies \emph{prompt-form collapse}: changing the instruction form, rather than adding useful semantics, can dominate execution. We introduce TOWN-VLA (Think Only When Needed), a prompt-authority interface that separates candidate generation from permission to alter the policy input. A fixed compatibility rule authorizes a canonical compact instruction; otherwise, the interface restores the original Base prompt exactly. Across 900 audited routes, every route follows this contract: 525 routes recover Base with matching hashes, and all 375 authorized prompts preserve the task signature. On a matched $4\times7$ LIBERO-Plus evaluation with 10{,}030 episodes per method, success rises from 69.5\% to 73.1\% ($+362$ episodes; 95\% CI 1.89--5.45 points), improving on six perturbation axes and all four suites. On a physical PiPER arm with a frozen \pizerofive{} checkpoint, success rises from 52.7\% to 78.7\% over 150 trials per method ($p=3.16\times10^{-6}$). Prompt authority is enforceable for a frozen controller; oracle-free admission calibration is the next deployment target.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TOWN-VLA（Think Only When Needed），一种提示词权威（prompt-authority）接口，用于分离候选生成的与修改策略输入的权限。研究发现"提示词形式坍缩"（prompt-form collapse）现象：改变指令形式而非添加语义信息会主导执行结果，甚至导致成功率从92.47%骤降至3.00%。TOWN-VLA通过固定兼容性规则授权规范的紧凑指令，否则恢复原始Base提示词，在LIBERO-Plus仿真和物理PiPER机械臂上均显著提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 检索可以有效增强冻结的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，但检索到的文本一旦进入执行提示词就成为一种控制干预。作者发现原始追加文本和长度匹配的无意义文本都会导致失败，揭示了"提示词形式坍缩"问题：改变指令形式本身就会主导执行，而非增加语义信息。这促使需要一种机制来分离候选生成与改变策略输入的权限。
AI.method: 提出TOWN-VLA接口，其核心是一个固定兼容性规则：如果候选检索文本符合规则则授权使用规范紧凑指令，否则精确恢复原始Base提示词。该接口将"候选生成"与"变更权限"分离，确保只有被授权的提示词能改变策略输入。
AI.result: 在900条审计路线上，525条恢复Base且哈希完全匹配，375条授权提示词保留任务签名。在匹配的4×7 LIBERO-Plus评估中（每方法10,030个episode），成功率从69.5%提升至73.1%（+362 episode，95% CI 1.89-5.45分）。在物理PiPER机械臂上（每方法150次试验），成功率从52.7%提升至78.7%（p=3.16×10⁻⁶）。
AI.conclusion: 提示词权威（prompt authority）对冻结控制器是可执行的，能够有效防止提示词形式坍缩带来的性能退化。下一步部署目标是无Oracle的准入校准（oracle-free admission calibration）。

title: Query-Driven Multimodal Information Extraction from Long Documents
summary: In domain-specific multimodal long documents, images and text jointly convey complex knowledge that cannot be fully captured by plain text alone. However, existing paradigms like DocVQA primarily focus on generating textual answers or localizing evidence regions, rather than outputting query-specific textual attribute values and corresponding images. To address this gap, we propose query-driven image-text joint extraction from long documents, requiring models to output query-requested textual attribute values and corresponding image bounding boxes. Based on challenges related to both user intent and document content, we designed a two-level taxonomy that operates at the query and instance levels. Further, we construct ITJoint, the first high-quality, manually annotated benchmark for this new task, comprising 2,455 pages of domain-specific documents with numerous non-decorative images, 316 queries, and 910 answer instances. Finally, we evaluate representative standalone Vision-Language Models from different providers and further design Q2IT, a multi-agent collaborative framework consisting of three progressively collaborating agents for evidence collection, page selection, and target-image localization. Using a joint evaluation approach that assesses both text extraction and image localization, our experiments show that standalone VLMs struggle with this task, while Q2IT significantly improves performance on ITJoint, although a substantial gap remains toward perfect results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的任务——查询驱动的图文联合抽取（query-driven image-text joint extraction），即从长文档中同时输出查询所需的文本属性值和对应的图像边界框。作者构建了首个高质量人工标注基准ITJoint（2,455页文档、316个查询、910个答案实例），并设计了多智能体协作框架Q2IT，由证据收集、页面选择和目标图像定位三个渐进协作的智能体组成。实验表明独立VLM在该任务上表现不佳，Q2IT显著提升性能但仍有较大提升空间。
AI.motivation: 现有范式（如DocVQA）主要侧重于生成文本答案或定位证据区域，无法同时输出查询特定的文本属性值和对应的图像。在领域特定的多模态长文档中，图像和文本共同传达复杂知识，纯文本无法完全捕捉，因此需要一种新的任务设定来弥补这一空白。
AI.method: 1) 提出查询驱动的图文联合抽取任务；2) 设计了两级分类体系（查询级和实例级）以应对用户意图和文档内容相关的挑战；3) 构建了ITJoint基准数据集，包含2,455页领域特定文档（含大量非装饰性图像）、316个查询和910个答案实例；4) 设计了Q2IT多智能体协作框架，包含证据收集、页面选择和目标图像定位三个渐进协作的智能体；5) 采用联合评估方法同时评估文本提取和图像定位性能。
AI.result: 实验表明独立VLM在该任务上表现不佳，而Q2IT框架在ITJoint上显著提升了性能，但距离完美结果仍有较大差距。
AI.conclusion: 查询驱动的图文联合抽取是一个重要但具挑战性的新任务，独立VLM难以胜任，需要更复杂的协作框架才能取得更好效果，但当前方法仍有改进空间。

title: Hyper^2: Unleashing Hyperbolic Geometry's Full Potential via Dual-Space Consistency
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Accepted to BMVC 2026
summary: HyperbolicCD pioneered hyperbolic geometry for point cloud completion by replacing the Euclidean Chamfer distance with arcosh(1+alpha||x-y||^2), but the reported gains are modest (3-7% Chamfer reduction across SeedFormer, PointAttN and PMP-Net backbones on PCN and ShapeNet-55). We argue the bottleneck lies elsewhere: the loss is hyperbolic but the encoder it back-propagates through is Euclidean, so the position-dependent supervision of the loss is averaged away by the chain rule before it reaches the parameters. We call this a cross-geometry mismatch, and make it testable through two model-agnostic indicators, feature-loss correlation r_FL and effective gradient utilisation u_G. On an SVDFormer backbone trained with HyperbolicCD's loss alone we measure (r_FL, u_G) = (0.68, 39%). We propose Hyper^2, a dual-space consistency framework that extends HyperbolicCD by reusing the identical arcosh(1+alpha d^2) functional form as a positional bias on the refinement attention (a hyperbolic distance encoding), paired with HyperbolicCD's hyperbolic Chamfer loss under a single shared curvature alpha. Both operators are O(N log N) scalar non-linearities on Euclidean distances and together add only ~1.6% FLOPs over SVDFormer. Hyper^2 delivers -22.9% Chamfer on ShapeNet-55 over SVDFormer (well above the 13.2% linear sum of the -12.0% loss-only and -1.2% encoding-only single-space ablations) and -37.5% on the 21 unseen ShapeNet-34 categories. The two indicators remain essentially flat for any single-space configuration but jump together to (0.95, 87%) only when both encoder and loss are hyperbolic, supporting the claim that geometric consistency across encoder and loss, rather than either operator alone, is what enables hyperbolic supervision in point cloud completion. Code is available at https://github.com/Ethan-Zheng136/Hyper-2.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Hyper²框架，指出HyperbolicCD在点云补全中收益有限的根本原因是"跨几何不匹配"（损失是双曲的但编码器是欧几里得的）。通过复用arcosh形式的双曲距离编码作为注意力位置偏差，并与双曲Chamfer损失共享单一曲率，实现编码器与损失的双空间一致性，在ShapeNet-55上相对SVDFormer降低22.9%的Chamfer距离。
AI.motivation: HyperbolicCD将双曲几何引入点云补全，但其收益有限（仅3-7%的Chamfer降低）。作者分析认为瓶颈在于损失是双曲的，但反向传播经过的编码器是欧几里得的，链式法则将位置相关的监督信号平均化，导致有效梯度利用不足。这一"跨几何不匹配"问题尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 提出两个模型无关的指标：特征-损失相关性r_FL和有效梯度利用u_G来量化几何不匹配。在此基础上提出Hyper²双空间一致性框架：1）复用与HyperbolicCD相同的arcosh(1+alpha*d²)函数形式作为精炼注意力中的双曲距离位置偏差；2）配合HyperbolicCD的双曲Chamfer损失，两者共享单一曲率alpha。两种算子都是O(N log N)的标量非线性操作，仅增加约1.6%的FLOPs。
AI.result: Hyper²在ShapeNet-55上相对SVDFormer降低22.9%的Chamfer距离，远超单空间消融的线性加和（13.2%）；在21个未见过的ShapeNet-34类别上降低37.5%。指标(r_FL, u_G)从(0.68, 39%)提升至(0.95, 87%)，且仅当编码器和损失均为双曲时才同时跳升。
AI.conclusion: 几何一致性（编码器与损失同时为双曲）而非任一算子单独作用，才是双曲监督在点云补全中发挥作用的关键。该发现为双曲几何在点云领域的应用提供了可测试的诊断框架和可行的改进方案。

title: Design of a Biomimetic Joint-Covering Skin with Tissue-Like Structure to Enhance Proprioception in a Musculoskeletal Humanoid
summary: Proprioception in musculoskeletal humanoids is typically estimated primarily from muscle sensing, while the role of cutaneous deformation around joints remains insufficiently explored. In biological systems, mechanoreceptors distributed within soft tissue complement muscle feedback and support reliable joint state estimation. This study presents the design of a biomimetic joint-covering skin with a tissue-like layered structure that integrates pressure- and stretch-sensitive elements within the joint-covering tissue. The proposed skin is implemented on the musculoskeletal humanoid Musashi-W, and its independent proprioceptive capability as well as its integration with muscle sensing are evaluated. Experimental results show that the proposed skin alone achieves joint angle estimation with an average error of approximately 3 degrees. Furthermore, integration with muscle sensing improves estimation accuracy. Owing to its joint-covering structure, the skin may mechanically mitigate the influence of external disturbances on the muscles, and the integration of multiple modalities suggests the possibility of contributing to the identification of external stimuli that are difficult to interpret using muscle sensing alone. This work presents a design methodology for biomimetic joint-covering skin and demonstrates that such tissue-structured skin can serve as an effective approach for extending proprioceptive systems in musculoskeletal humanoids.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种仿生关节覆盖皮肤，采用组织样分层结构集成压力和拉伸敏感元件，应用于肌肉骨骼人形机器人Musashi-W上。该皮肤单独即可实现约3度平均误差的关节角度估计，与肌肉传感集成后可进一步提高精度，并可能辅助识别仅靠肌肉传感难以解释的外部刺激。
AI.motivation: 肌肉骨骼人形机器人的本体感觉主要依赖肌肉传感估计，而关节周围皮肤形变信息尚未被充分探索。在生物系统中，软组织内分布的机械感受器补充了肌肉反馈并支持可靠的关节状态估计，这启发研究者探索关节覆盖皮肤的仿生设计。
AI.method: 设计了具有组织样分层结构的仿生关节覆盖皮肤，将压力敏感和拉伸敏感元件集成在覆盖关节的组织层中；将该皮肤实现在肌肉骨骼人形机器人Musashi-W上，并评估其独立的本体感觉能力以及与肌肉传感的集成效果。
AI.result: 该皮肤单独使用时关节角度估计平均误差约为3度；与肌肉传感集成后估计精度得到提升。此外，关节覆盖结构可能在机械上减轻外部扰动对肌肉的影响，多模态集成有助于识别仅靠肌肉传感难以解释的外部刺激。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种仿生关节覆盖皮肤的设计方法，证明组织结构化皮肤可作为扩展肌肉骨骼人形机器人本体感觉系统的有效途径。

title: Beyond What Meets the Eye: Unveiling Situational Illusions for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Real-world situation appearances can deviate from their underlying physical states, challenging the reliability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in practical applications. In this paper, we term this phenomenon situational illusions and investigate: (1) how MLLMs perform under such illusions, and (2) how to mitigate the limitations. We first develop a comprehensive where-what-how taxonomy that characterizes where situational illusions occur, what targets they take, and how they arise. Building on this taxonomy, we introduce MSIBench, a benchmark designed to assess the discrimination, understanding, and reasoning capabilities of MLLMs under situational illusions. Evaluations of 27 model configurations reveal that current MLLMs are highly vulnerable to these illusions and exhibit 6 typical failure modes related to visual observation, grounding, and reasoning. To mitigate the limitations, we build on the core idea of systematically inspecting and reasoning over visual evidence for contextual understanding, developing prompting for closed-source models and supervised fine-tuning for open-source models, respectively. These two simple yet effective methods improve model performances by 20% at most, suggesting a practical path toward more reliable multimodal perception and reasoning in complex real-world environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"情境错觉"（situational illusions）概念，指现实世界外观偏离其底层物理状态的现象，并系统研究多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在此类情境下的表现与改进方法。作者构建了where-what-how分类法，并基于此开发MSIBench基准，评估27种模型配置后揭示MLLMs普遍易受影响且存在6种典型失败模式。为缓解限制，提出针对闭源模型的提示工程和针对开源模型的监督微调两种方法，最高可提升20%性能。
AI.motivation: 现实世界的外观可能与底层物理状态不一致（如视觉假象），这严重挑战了多模态大语言模型在真实应用中的可靠性。作者希望系统性地认识这一现象，评估现有模型的局限性，并寻找缓解方案。
AI.method: 1) 提出"情境错觉"（situational illusions）概念，构建where-what-how三维分类法来刻画错觉发生位置、作用对象和产生方式；2) 基于分类法构建MSIBench基准，用于评估MLLMs在情境错觉下的辨别、理解和推理能力；3) 提出两种缓解方法：对闭源模型使用系统性视觉证据检查与推理提示，对开源模型采用相应的监督微调。
AI.result: 评估27种模型配置后发现，当前MLLMs对情境错觉高度敏感，存在6种典型的失败模式，涉及视觉观察、定位（grounding）和推理等方面。所提出的两种缓解方法最高能提升模型性能20%。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统化的视觉证据检查与推理，可以有效提升MLLMs在复杂真实环境下的多模态感知与推理可靠性，为构建更稳健的多模态系统提供了可行路径。

title: Training-Free VLM Personalization via Calibrated Residual Decoding
summary:
Vision-language models can be personalized in a training-free manner by directly providing user profiles, preferences, or visual references at inference time, without updating model parameters. However, direct personalized prompting does not guarantee that the model will reliably exploit such evidence. The predictive distribution under the positive user profile often mixes two sources: personalized signals genuinely supported by the current profile, and the model's generic visual or linguistic priors. As a result, from the positive-profile response alone, it is difficult to determine whether a high-confidence answer is supported by the user profile or merely reflects the model's default preference. To address this problem, we propose a training-free calibrated residual decoding framework. Given the same image and question, we construct three evidence conditions: a positive profile , a counterfactual profile , and an empty profile . Our method keeps the prediction under
  as the anchored base, and explicitly estimates the marginal contribution of personalization from score differences across the three conditions. We further introduce normalized-entropy-based uncertainty calibration, allowing the strength of personalized enhancement to adapt to the reliability of the residual signal. Experiments on MMPB, YoLLaVA, and MyVLM show that the proposed method improves personalized multimodal understanding without fine-tuning, with consistent gains on identity-sensitive visual personalization tasks. Additional analysis shows that entropy calibration stabilizes residual decoding when the contrastive personalization signal is uncertain.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需训练的校准残差解码框架，通过正/反事实/空三种profile条件下的分数差异估计个性化的边际贡献，并结合归一化熵不确定性校准，在MMPB、YoLLaVA和MyVLM基准上提升了多模态个性化理解性能。
AI.motivation: 训练免费的个性化提示不保证模型可靠利用用户profile证据——正profile下的预测分布混合了真正的个性化信号和模型的通用先验，导致难以判断高置信度回答究竟由用户profile支撑还是仅反映模型默认偏好。
AI.method: 提出训练免费的校准残差解码框架：(1) 在相同图像和问题下构造三种证据条件——正profile、反事实profile和空profile；(2) 以正profile下的预测为锚定基线，通过三种条件之间的分数差异显式估计个性化的边际贡献；(3) 引入基于归一化熵的不确定性校准，使个性化增强强度适应残差信号的可靠性。
AI.result: 在MMPB、YoLLaVA和MyVLM上，该方法无需微调即提升了个性化多模态理解性能，在身份敏感的视觉个性化任务上取得一致增益；额外分析表明熵校准在对比个性化信号不确定时能稳定残差解码。
AI.conclusion: 通过构造反事实对比条件和熵基不确定性校准，可以有效分离个性化信号与模型通用先验，实现训练免费的可靠个性化多模态理解。

title: ROS2SmolVLA: Enabling Small Vision-Language-Action Models for Integration into Industrial-Grade Lightweight Robots
comment: Accepted at 8th International Conference on Industry of the Future and Smart Manufacturing, Padua & Venice, 2026
summary: Industrial demand changes the paradigms of production. Due to smaller batch sizes and more variations in products, companies face a growing challenge to adopt more adaptive production systems. In particular, robot-based automation is usually static and fails to respond to constantly changing processes. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) Models are a promising opportunity to mitigate this challenge by generating robot actions based on the observed system state. However, current research either focuses on large models that cannot be computed on premise, creating compliance and security challenges, or use lab-grade robot hardware that obscures exploitation in real industrial settings. In this work, we adapt Hugging Face's SmolVLA for Universal Robots lightweight robots. Further, we release the open-source repository ROS2SmolVLA that implements an interface for ROS 2 to SmolVLA, and makes it applicable for industrial-grade hardware. By this, we allow a lenient adoption into lab and industrial environments. We validate the functionality of SmolVLA for a Universal Robots UR10e using a pick-and-place task and give implementation guidelines. Our findings support that SmolVLA is a well-suited option for small-sized tasks that need to be computed on premise.

AI.tldr: 本文针对工业环境中机器人自动化系统静态、难以适应多变生产需求的问题，将Hugging Face的SmolVLA视觉-语言-动作模型适配到Universal Robots轻量级机器人上，并开源了ROS2SmolVLA接口库，使模型能够在本地（on-premise）计算并适用于工业级硬件。作者通过UR10e机器人的拾取放置任务验证了模型功能，并提供了实施指南。
AI.motivation: 工业需求变化导致小批量、多品种生产成为常态，传统机器人自动化系统静态、难以适应频繁变化的生产流程。虽然VLA模型有望解决这一挑战，但现有研究要么依赖无法本地计算的大型模型（带来合规与安全隐患），要么使用实验室级硬件（无法真实反映工业场景）。因此需要一种能在本地计算且适用于工业级硬件的轻量级VLA解决方案。
AI.method: 作者将Hugging Face的SmolVLA模型适配到Universal Robots轻量级机器人上，并开发了开源的ROS2SmolVLA接口库，该库实现了ROS 2与SmolVLA之间的接口，使其适用于工业级硬件。随后在UR10e机器人上通过拾取放置（pick-and-place）任务验证了模型功能，并给出了实施指南。
AI.result: SmolVLA成功在UR10e机器人上实现了拾取放置任务，验证了其在工业级硬件上的可行性和功能有效性。研究结果表明SmolVLA是适用于需要在本地（on-premise）计算的小型任务的理想选择。
AI.conclusion: SmolVLA搭配ROS2SmolVLA接口库为工业环境提供了一种轻量级、可本地计算的VLA方案，兼顾了合规性和实用性，为工业机器人自适应生产系统的落地提供了一条切实可行的路径。作者开源了相关代码，支持实验室和工业环境的宽松采用。

title: Read Less, Solve More: Token-Efficient Sparse Reading for AI Agents
summary: Long-horizon agents increasingly rely on repeated access to external artifacts, yet current reading interfaces often expose entire objects even when only sparse evidence is needed. This over-reading increases token and latency costs and can dilute task-relevant evidence, while existing context-reduction methods mainly intervene after broad content has already entered the trajectory. We present SparseRead, a training-free, model-transparent reading layer that controls content admission before unnecessary evidence reaches the model context. SparseRead combines a regime-aware Read Gate, extensible Reader Backends, and a stateful protocol for bounded, source-anchored evidence acquisition with explicit refinement, verification, stopping, and fallback. Across six frontier models, including Claude Opus 5, and five workload scenarios, SparseRead reduces token volume by up to 92.9% and wall time by up to 89.0%, while preserving or improving task quality. Its consistent gains across three agent frameworks further demonstrate broad portability.

AI.tldr: SparseRead是一个无需训练、模型透明的阅读层，通过在内容进入模型上下文之前控制信息准入，减少长时程智能体在读取外部工件时的过度阅读。它结合Regime-aware Read Gate、可扩展的Reader Backends和有状态协议，在六个前沿模型和五个工作负载场景中最多减少92.9%的token量和89.0%的墙钟时间，同时保持或提升任务质量。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体频繁重复访问外部工件，但现有阅读接口往往暴露整个对象，即使只需少量证据。这导致token和延迟成本增加，并稀释任务相关证据。现有上下文缩减方法主要在大范围内容已进入轨迹后进行干预，缺乏在内容进入模型上下文之前就进行控制的机制。
AI.method: SparseRead由三部分组成：(1) Regime-aware Read Gate——在内容进入上下文前控制信息准入；(2) 可扩展的Reader Backends——支持多种读取后端实现；(3) 有状态协议——实现有界、源锚定的证据获取，包含明确的细化、验证、停止和回退机制。整体是训练无关且模型透明的方法。
AI.result: 在六个前沿模型（包括Claude Opus 5）和五个工作负载场景中，SparseRead将token量减少最多92.9%，墙钟时间减少最多89.0%，同时保持或提升任务质量。在三个智能体框架中的一致提升证明了其广泛的可移植性。
AI.conclusion: SparseRead通过在读取阶段而非处理阶段控制信息流，有效解决了长时程智能体的过度阅读问题，在显著降低资源消耗的同时保持甚至改善任务性能，并且具有跨模型和跨框架的良好通用性。

title: GAN-Diff : Coupling Pretrained WGAN-GP Features with Conditional Diffusion U-Nets
summary: Generative adversarial networks (GANs) can provide efficient image generation, while diffusion models offer high-quality image restoration but require iterative sampling. This paper presents a hybrid GAN-guided diffusion framework that uses a pretrained Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty (WGAN-GP) as a feature prior for conditional diffusion-based image restoration. Intermediate features from the frozen WGAN-GP generator are incorporated into a diffusion U-Net through cross-attention and remain fixed during the DDIM sampling process. The framework is evaluated on two restoration tasks, Gaussian denoising and 2Xsuper-resolution, using CelebA face images. During development, several sources of instability were identified and addressed, including adversarial learning-rate imbalance, inappropriate diffusion initialization, excessive corruption, and insufficient parameter averaging. The resulting framework consistently improves the quality of both degraded and low-resolution images. In particular, it improves denoising performance by 4.40 dB in PSNR and super-resolution performance by 3.70 dB over their respective input baselines. These results demonstrate the potential of a frozen GAN feature prior to guide diffusion models toward stable and effective image restoration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种混合GAN引导的扩散框架，利用预训练的WGAN-GP作为特征先验，通过交叉注意力将冻结的生成器中间特征融入扩散U-Net，用于条件扩散图像复原，在去噪和超分辨率任务上分别提升了4.40 dB和3.70 dB的PSNR。
AI.motivation: GAN能高效生成图像但质量有限，扩散模型复原质量高但需要迭代采样，两者各有优劣。作者希望结合两者优势，利用GAN的特征先验来引导扩散模型，实现稳定且高效的图像复原。
AI.method: 使用预训练的WGAN-GP作为特征先验，将其冻结生成器的中间特征通过交叉注意力机制融入扩散U-Net中，并在DDIM采样过程中保持固定。开发过程中识别并解决了多个不稳定性来源，包括对抗学习率不平衡、不当的扩散初始化、过度损坏以及参数平均不足等问题。
AI.result: 该框架在CelebA人脸图像上分别进行了高斯去噪和2倍超分辨率两个复原任务的评估，去噪性能较输入基线提升4.40 dB PSNR，超分辨率性能提升3.70 dB PSNR，一致改善了退化图像和低分辨率图像的质量。
AI.conclusion: 冻结的GAN特征先验能够有效引导扩散模型实现稳定且有效的图像复原，证明了GAN与扩散模型混合框架的可行性和潜力。

title: OptiSight: Bridging Semantic Reasoning and Geometric Control for Embodied Navigation
summary: Autonomous indoor navigation requires both semantic understanding and precise geometric control. We propose OptiSight, a hybrid framework that combines Vision-Language Model reasoning with deterministic visual servoing through a finite-state Chain-of-Thought architecture. Grounded-SAM localizes open-vocabulary targets, while camera projection geometry converts visual observations into navigation commands without requiring dense mapping. The VLM is queried only at key decision points, reducing computational overhead while geometric control handles continuous navigation. Experiments in AI Habitat demonstrate reliable zero-shot navigation across diverse indoor scenarios, including obstacle avoidance and semantic ambiguity, while operating within an 8~GB VRAM budget. The source code is available at https://github.com/avanalperen/OptiSight-Python-Multimodal-CoT-for-Visual-Reasoning.

AI.tldr: OptiSight是一个混合框架，结合了视觉语言模型（VLM）推理与确定性视觉伺服技术，通过有限状态链式思维架构实现自主室内导航，在无需密集建图的情况下支持零样本导航，且能在8GB显存预算内运行。
AI.motivation: 自主室内导航需要同时具备语义理解和精确几何控制，现有方法要么依赖密集建图计算量大，要么VLM推理开销过高，难以在轻量级硬件上实现高效可靠的导航。
AI.method: 采用混合框架：Grounded-SAM负责开放词汇目标定位，相机投影几何将视觉观测转换为导航指令（无需密集建图），VLM仅在关键决策点被查询以降低计算开销，通过有限状态链式思维架构协调语义推理与几何控制。
AI.result: 在AI Habitat环境中展示了跨多种室内场景的可靠零样本导航能力，包括避障和语义歧义处理，同时显存占用控制在8GB VRAM之内。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了将VLM推理与几何控制轻量结合的有效性，在保持语义理解能力的同时显著降低了计算资源需求，为实际部署提供了可行方案。

title: Clarify User Expertise: Towards Proactive Conversational Agents Tailoring Responses to User Proficiency
summary: In the context of information seeking, conversational agents are undergoing an evolution from reactive tools to proactive, personalized assistants. A critical aspect of this evolution is the ability to tailor strategic interactions to a user's unique needs and expectations. Unlike existing studies that focus on proactively clarifying query ambiguities, we center on clarifying the user's expertise in order to tailor responses for better user comprehension. We find that existing agents struggle to determine user expertise from queries alone, a limitation that prevents them from dynamically adapting their responses. To address this gap, we introduce PASSING to empower the agent to proactively clarify a user's expertise through targeted inquiries. This is achieved by our What-to-ask and How-to-ask strategies, induced by LLM self-play. Our extensive experiments also show our superiority. We believe that PASSING represents a crucial step towards creating more human-centric conversational agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PASSING框架，用于对话代理通过主动询问用户专业水平来定制个性化响应，而非仅澄清查询歧义，从而提升用户理解。
AI.motivation: 现有对话代理从被动工具向主动个性化助手演进，但现有研究聚焦于澄清查询歧义，忽略了澄清用户专业水平这一关键方面；已有代理难以仅从查询中判断用户专业水平，限制了响应动态适配能力。
AI.method: 提出PASSING框架，通过What-to-ask和How-to-ask两种策略使代理主动澄清用户专业水平，策略由LLM自我博弈（self-play）诱导生成。
AI.result: 大量实验表明PASSING优于现有方法，表现出更优越的性能。
AI.conclusion: PASSING标志着向更以人为本的对话代理迈出的关键一步，通过明确用户专业水平实现更好的个性化交互。

title: OVIBench: Benchmarking Online Video Question Answering under Interruption
summary: Recent vision language models (VLMs) have achieved strong progress in video understanding. However, most existing video QA research and benchmarks still follow an offline, single-round paradigm, overlooking realistic interactions where users may interrupt the model during answer generation. To address this gap, we formulate the task of Online Video Question Answering under Interruption and introduce OVIBench, the first standardized benchmark for evaluating VLMs in this setting. OVIBench categorizes interruptions into three types: Cancellation, False Trigger, Correction and supports both open-ended and multiple-choice evaluations. To enable large-scale and reproducible testing, we develop an offline simulation protocol that reproduces interruption during generation under a unified temporal setup, together with a multi-dimensional metric suite for assessing interruption understanding and response generation. Experiments demonstrate that OVIBench effectively distinguishes models' interruption-handling abilities, especially in following correction requests. Finally, we construct a train set OVI-Train for interruption-aware fine-tuning. Models fine-tuned on this dataset achieve significant gains on OVIBench, validating the effectiveness of our benchmark and data design. OVIBench, OVI-Train, and the evaluation code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在线视频问答中断任务（Online Video QA under Interruption），并构建了首个标准化基准OVIBench，用于评估视觉语言模型在答案生成过程中被用户中断（取消、误触发、纠正）时的处理能力，同时配套了离线模拟协议、多维评估指标以及用于中断感知微调的训练集OVI-Train。
AI.motivation: 现有视频问答研究和基准大多遵循离线、单轮问答范式，忽视了真实交互场景中用户可能在模型生成答案过程中打断模型的情况。这一差距导致当前VLM在真实世界交互中的中断处理能力未被充分评估。
AI.method: 1) 形式化定义在线视频问答中断任务；2) 构建OVIBench基准，将中断分为取消、误触发、纠正三类，支持开放式和多项选择评估；3) 设计离线模拟协议，在统一时间设置下复现生成过程中的中断；4) 开发多维指标套件评估中断理解和响应生成；5) 构建OVI-Train训练集用于中断感知微调。
AI.result: 实验表明OVIBench能有效区分各模型的中断处理能力，尤其在遵循纠正请求方面。基于OVI-Train微调的模型在OVIBench上取得显著提升，验证了基准和数据设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: OVIBench填补了视频QA研究中对交互中断场景评估的空白，提供了可复现的大规模评测方案和有效的训练数据，推动了VLM向真实交互场景的适配。相关资源将公开发布。

title: Reward-Free Continual Adaptation for Resilient Space Robots
comment: Accepted for publication at the Third Conference on AI in and for Space (SPAICE 2026) | The source code is available at https://github.com/AndrejOrsula/space_robotics_bench
summary: Space robots operate in extreme environments where hardware degradation can critically compromise traditional control strategies. While continual reinforcement learning offers a promising mechanism for online adaptation, it inherently requires access to a reward signal during deployment. However, precise reward computation in space is often infeasible due to the lack of external tracking systems and the overall complexity of the environment. To address the challenge of unobservable rewards, we introduce a reward-free continual learning framework that leverages latent-state world models. By pre-training a model-based agent across diverse simulations, the world model learns a robust predictor of the reward structure within its latent space. Upon deployment to an environment with severe hardware degradation, we freeze the observation encoder and reward predictor to update only the transition dynamics of the world model through unsupervised rollouts. By training the policy entirely on imagined trajectories generated by this updated world model, the agent adapts to altered dynamics without receiving new rewards. We demonstrate our approach across simulated planetary traversal, orbital navigation, and precision assembly tasks subjected to severe morphological failures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种免奖励的持续强化学习框架，通过预训练潜在状态世界模型来预测奖励结构，部署时仅更新转移动力学，使空间机器人能够在硬件退化且无法获取真实奖励的环境中通过想象轨迹完成在线适应。
AI.motivation: 空间机器人处于极端环境中，硬件退化会严重破坏传统控制策略。持续强化学习虽能在线适应，但部署时需要奖励信号，而太空中由于缺乏外部跟踪系统和环境复杂，精确计算奖励往往不可行。
AI.method: 1) 在多样化仿真中预训练基于模型（world model）的智能体，让世界模型在潜在空间中学习鲁棒的奖励结构预测器。2) 部署到硬件严重退化的环境后，冻结观测编码器和奖励预测器，仅通过无监督推演更新世界模型的转移动力学。3) 策略完全在更新后的世界模型生成的想象轨迹上训练，从而无需新奖励即可适应变化的动力学。
AI.result: 在模拟的行星穿越、轨道导航和精密装配任务中，面对严重形态故障时验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过在潜在空间中分离"奖励结构"与"环境动力学"的学习，成功实现了免奖励信号的持续适应，为空间机器人在极端环境下的在线自适应提供了可行方案。

title: HERO: Human-profile Enhanced Retrieval Optimization Framework for Long-term Agent Memory
summary: Long-term memory is crucial for personalized responses and long-horizon agent interactions. Existing methods often rely on LLMs to compress or rewrite dialogue histories and use the transformed memories as retrieval evidence. Despite the progress in organizing fragmented contexts, two major drawbacks persist: (1) information loss from compression, which discards fine-grained but later useful details, and (2) semantic drift from rewriting, which erodes the original tone and situated context. In this work, we propose a novel Human-profile Enhanced Retrieval Optimization framework for long-term agent memory (HERO). Specifically, HERO converts the dialogue history into a traceable heterogeneous memory graph that preserves raw dialogue text as evidence for reasoning, thereby mitigating information loss. For retrieval, HERO extracts initial anchors from the current query and incorporates human profiles via an iterative graph traversal; these anchors and profiles provide guidance signals that adaptively activate the most informative regions of the graph. Experiments on two benchmark datasets show that HERO outperforms strong baselines on both factual and personalized reasoning, while providing more faithful access to raw dialogue evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HERO框架，通过将对话历史转换为可追踪的异构图记忆（保留原始对话文本作为证据），并利用人类画像增强的迭代图遍历进行检索，从而解决长时记忆中的信息丢失和语义漂移问题。
AI.motivation: 现有长时记忆方法依赖LLM压缩或重写对话历史，导致两个主要缺陷：(1)压缩造成的信息丢失，丢失了细粒度但有价值的信息；(2)重写造成的语义漂移，侵蚀了原始语气和情境上下文。这限制了个性化响应和长视野智能体交互的质量。
AI.method: HERO框架包含两个核心组件：(1)将对话历史构建为可追踪的异构图记忆，保留原始对话文本作为推理证据，减轻信息丢失；(2)检索阶段从当前查询提取初始锚点，并通过迭代图遍历融入人类画像，利用锚点和画像作为引导信号，自适应激活图中最有信息量的区域。
AI.result: 在两个基准数据集上的实验表明，HERO在事实性推理和个性化推理任务上均优于强基线模型，并且能更忠实地访问原始对话证据。
AI.conclusion: 保留原始对话证据并结合人类画像引导的图检索，是提升长时记忆智能体在事实性和个性化推理能力上的有效途径，该方法同时解决了信息丢失和语义漂移两大顽疾。

title: DECO: Depth-Guided Co-Visibility Reasoning for Low-Altitude UAV Visual Localization
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) increasingly require robust visual localization in GNSS-denied environments. A common solution estimates UAV poses by matching keypoints between UAV images and geo-tagged orthographic reference maps derived from satellite or aerial imagery, followed by Perspective-\(n\)-Point (PnP) pose solving. However, such reference maps mainly record top-down surfaces such as roofs and ground planes, while vertical structures such as facades and walls are often compressed or missing. Consequently, many visually distinctive keypoints in low-altitude UAV images have no valid counterparts in the reference map, leading to redundant matches and inaccurate pose estimation. To address this issue, we propose DECO, a DEpth-guided CO-visibility reasoning framework for low-altitude UAV visual localization. DECO uses monocular depth priors to infer local surface geometry and estimate co-visible regions between UAV images and the reference map. Based on this prior, a Geometry-Saliency Coupled Co-visibility Score is introduced to jointly consider geometric co-visibility and detector saliency for keypoint ranking. In this way, DECO retains keypoints that are both visually distinctive and geometrically co-visible, improving feature matching and PnP-based pose estimation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DECO achieves superior localization performance and can be integrated with different depth models, feature detectors, and matchers. The source code will be available at https://github.com/UAV-AVL/DECO.

AI.tldr: DECO是一个用于低空无人机视觉定位的深度引导共可见性推理框架。它利用单目深度先验推断局部表面几何，估计无人机图像与参考地图之间的共可见区域，并提出几何-显著性耦合的共可见性评分来筛选既视觉独特又几何共可见的关键点，从而提升特征匹配和PnP位姿估计精度。
AI.motivation: GNSS拒止环境下无人机需要鲁棒的视觉定位。现有方法通过匹配无人机图像与正射参考地图（卫星/航空影像）上的关键点并求解PnP来估计位姿，但正射地图主要记录俯视表面（如屋顶、地面），垂直结构（如立面、墙面）常被压缩或缺失。这导致低空无人机图像中许多视觉上独特的关键点在参考地图中无有效对应，造成冗余匹配和不准确的位姿估计。
AI.method: DECO框架包含三个核心要素：(1) 使用单目深度先验推断局部表面几何；(2) 估计无人机图像与参考地图之间的共可见区域；(3) 提出几何-显著性耦合共可见性评分（Geometry-Saliency Coupled Co-visibility Score），联合考虑几何共可见性和检测器显著性对关键点进行排序，保留既视觉独特又几何共可见的关键点，从而改进特征匹配和PnP位姿估计。
AI.result: 大量实验表明DECO在定位性能上优于现有方法，并且可以灵活集成不同的深度模型、特征检测器和匹配器，展现出良好的通用性和可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: DECO有效解决了低空无人机视觉定位中正射参考地图缺乏垂直结构信息导致的关键点冗余匹配问题，通过深度引导的共可见性推理显著提升了定位精度，且源码已开源供社区使用。

title: Act with Intent: Distilling Behavior Intent for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can turn multimodal context into robot actions, but their action decoders are still trained largely by behavior cloning. This supervises which motor command was demonstrated while leaving implicit the local objective served by the behavior under the instruction. Future-based supervision enriches action learning with frames, latent observations, trajectories, or motion representations, but these signals capture particular realizations of what may happen rather than the shared semantic objective of the forthcoming behavior. We propose Intention Distillation (INDI), which distills behavior-level intent into the action decoder. During training, a frozen teacher VLM interprets a demonstrated segment from the current observation, instruction, coarse action summary, and corresponding execution video. From its standard inputs, the deployed VLA recovers the resulting multimodal intent representation at an intermediate decoder layer and uses it to organize action prediction together with representations of how the behavior unfolds and what it achieves. On SimplerEnv-Bridge, INDI improves GR00T-N1.7 from 64.3% to 84.7%, and on RoboCasa Kitchen it improves the controlled GR00T-N1.7 baseline from 64.1% to 70.3%, with consistent gains on $π_{0.5}$ across both benchmarks. In real-world tasks, INDI improves average success from 62.0% to 68.7%, with gains of up to 12.0 pp on longer-horizon tasks. Further analyses show that the recovered latent is used by the decoder, captures behavior objective and execution progress, and organizes downstream predictions in an objective-dependent manner. These results show that action decoders benefit from explicitly modeling the semantic objective of the behavior they generate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出意图蒸馏（INDI）方法，将行为级别的语义意图蒸馏到VLA模型的动作解码器中，利用冻结的教师VLM从演示片段中提取多模态意图表示，并在部署时通过与行为展开和达成结果表征的结合来组织动作预测，在多个基准和真实世界任务中显著提升了性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型的动作解码器主要依赖行为克隆进行训练，仅监督演示的电机指令，忽略了行为所服务的局部目标。未来帧、潜在观测、轨迹等监督信号只能捕捉行为的具体实现，而非共享的语义目标。作者认为动作解码器应显式建模行为生成的语义目标。
AI.method: INDI方法包含两阶段：训练时使用冻结的教师VLM，从当前观测、指令、粗略动作摘要和对应执行视频中解读演示片段，蒸馏出行为级意图；部署时，VLA在中间解码器层恢复多模态意图表示，并与行为如何展开及实现什么的表征共同组织动作预测。
AI.result: 在SimplerEnv-Bridge上，INDI将GR00T-N1.7从64.3%提升至84.7%；在RoboCasa Kitchen上从64.1%提升至70.3%；在两个基准上对π0.5均有持续提升。真实世界任务中平均成功率从62.0%提升至68.7%，长时程任务提升高达12.0个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 分析表明，恢复的潜在表示被解码器实际使用，能够捕捉行为目标和执行进度，并以目标依赖的方式组织下游预测。这证明了动作解码器受益于显式建模其生成行为的语义目标。

title: Where Cognition Lives: Dissecting Emergent from Computed Function in a Minimal Complete Cognitive Architecture
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures. Code, preregistrations and results: https://github.com/fmarrabal/miuracognitive
summary: A cognitive architecture is more than the module that reasons: it must also decide how long to think and what deserves the effort. We built a minimal but complete system - a recurrent reasoner with adaptive halting, a homeostatic control field, and a value module - and asked of each part: does this function emerge from gradient descent, or must it be computed? Competence emerges. Stopping appears to emerge too, and to be worth more than everything decidable in advance, but that appearance is instrumentation: payoff at matched mean compute climbs from 0.467 (uniform) through 0.546 (difficulty) to 0.698 (ex-ante value), and the further climb to 0.921 (posterior self-observation) does not survive audit. PonderNet-style halting returns a halting-weighted mixture of hidden states while forced-depth baselines return one, and the language head is trained on the mixture alone; equalizing the readout annihilates the apparent advantage of native execution (residual +0.000 [0.000, 0.000]). Value does not emerge: trained couplings capture zero of a payoff an explicit allocator captures completely (+0.151, routing correlation +0.79), so the second-order decisions that pay must be computed, at least where value is orthogonal to content, as here by construction. On a frozen LLM actuator the same instruments show self-consistency voting to be a measured bound (+0.0236 [+0.0150, +0.0326]) and inter-sample agreement nearly worthless as a stopping signal, its mass concentrating on wrong answers. Every null we assert carries a mechanism and a positive control, and the protocol is part of the contribution. Executing our own falsifiable prediction, value under commitment pays +0.1312 [+0.1124, +0.1502] in a cliff-cost family, some seven times the smooth-family estimate - not because the cliff shifts information ex ante, but because it multiplies the attainable range fivefold (5.1x [3.4, 8.2]).

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个最小但完整的认知架构（循环推理器+自适应停止+稳态控制场+价值模块），系统性地检验每个部分的功能是"涌现"于梯度下降还是必须"被计算"。结果发现：能力与停止行为看似涌现，但停止的优势经审计后是仪器假象；价值模块则明确不能涌现，必须显式计算。文章还提出了严格的可证伪协议和正对照，作为贡献的一部分。
AI.motivation: 认知架构不应只关注推理模块本身，还需要决定"思考多久"和"什么值得思考"。作者希望区分：这些高阶决策能力是能通过梯度下降自然涌现，还是必须显式设计计算？这一区分对架构设计有根本性意义。
AI.method: 构建最小完整系统，包含：(1)循环推理器+自适应停止（PonderNet风格）；(2)稳态控制场；(3)价值模块。通过系列对照实验和严格审计协议，逐一检验每个组件的涌现性。包括等化读出控制、匹配均值计算、显式分配器对照、冻结LLM执行器上的自洽性投票验证等。
AI.result: 竞争力和停止行为看似涌现；但停止的优势（0.467→0.698→0.921）经审计后残余为0.000，是仪器假象。价值不涌现：隐式耦合只捕获0%收益，而显式分配器完全捕获（+0.151，相关0.79）。在LLM执行器上，自洽投票是受限的（+0.0236），样本间一致性作为停止信号几乎无用。作者执行自身的可证伪预测：悬崖成本族中价值承诺收益+0.1312，是平滑族的7倍，原因是可达范围放大5.1倍。
AI.conclusion: 认知架构中，内容层面的能力可以从梯度下降涌现，但二阶决策（何时停止、什么值得投入）中，价值相关的部分必须被显式计算，至少当价值与内容正交时如此。协议本身（正对照、机制说明、可证伪预测）是方法论贡献。

title: Targeted Iterative Filtering
summary: The assessment of image denoising results depends on the respective application area, i.e. image compression, still-image acquisition, and medical images require entirely different behavior of the applied denoising method. In this paper we propose a novel, nonlinear diffusion scheme that is derived from a linear diffusion process in a value space determined by the application. We show that application-driven linear diffusion in the transformed space compares favorably with existing nonlinear diffusion techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新颖的非线性扩散去噪方案，该方案源自应用驱动变换空间中的线性扩散过程，并在图像压缩、静态图像采集和医学图像等不同应用场景中与现有非线性扩散技术相比表现更优。
AI.motivation: 图像去噪结果的评估依赖于具体应用领域（如图像压缩、静态图像采集、医学图像），不同应用对去噪方法的行为要求完全不同，而现有方法未能充分适配这些差异。
AI.method: 提出一种从应用确定的值空间中的线性扩散过程推导出的非线性扩散方案，即先在应用定义的值空间中进行线性扩散，再映射回原始空间，从而获得具有应用特性的非线性扩散行为。
AI.result: 实验表明，在变换空间中的应用驱动线性扩散方法在性能上优于现有的非线性扩散技术。
AI.conclusion: 应用驱动变换空间的线性扩散方法可以作为一种有效的替代方案，优于传统非线性扩散技术，且能够根据不同应用场景灵活调整去噪行为。

title: Addressing the Selection Problem in Explainable AI
comment: Accepted to the Workshop on Explainable Artificial Intelligence at the International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence 2026 (XAI@IJCAI26)
summary: Explainable AI (XAI) research has produced a plethora of explanation techniques, yet user studies repeatedly show that available explanations are not effective in practice. We argue that, given the siloed nature of conventional XAI, users are struggling to select the appropriate XAI technique. Viewing XAI through a philosophical lens, we offer a formalization of what we call the selection problem: the systematic failure of XAI interfaces to bridge the gap between a user's natural-language uncertainty and the explanation technique that resolves it. Following a logical premise-conclusion format, we show that conventional interfaces require users to translate their uncertainty into a technique selection, a challenging prerequisite to meet. We also propose a structural solution: a multi-agent LLM orchestration tool that translates the user's query to the proper XAI explanation technique. We provide an example of how this structural solution could be instantiated to address the selection problem.

AI.tldr: 本文指出可解释AI（XAI）研究虽然产生了大量解释技术，但用户研究反复表明这些解释在实践中并不有效。作者从哲学视角将问题形式化为"选择问题"：XAI界面无法弥合用户自然语言的不确定性与合适的解释技术之间的鸿沟。作者提出一个多智能体LLM编排工具作为结构性解决方案，将用户查询转化为合适的XAI解释技术。
AI.motivation: 传统的XAI研究各自为政（siloed），用户难以选择适合自己需求的具体XAI技术。尽管产生了解释技术，但用户研究中解释效果不佳，作者认为根本原因在于"选择问题"——用户需要将自己的自然语言不确定性翻译成技术选择的认知负担过重。
AI.method: 作者采用逻辑前提-结论格式形式化定义了"选择问题"，展示传统XAI界面要求用户将不确定性转化为技术选择这一困难前提。随后提出结构性解决方案：一个多智能体LLM编排工具，该工具自动将用户的自然语言查询翻译为适当的XAI解释技术。
AI.result: 作者提供了一个结构性解决方案的实例化示例，展示如何将该多智能体LLM编排工具用于解决选择问题。
AI.conclusion: XAI的困境不在于缺乏解释技术本身，而在于缺乏帮助用户选择合适技术的桥梁。通过LLM多智能体编排，可以自动弥合用户自然语言与XAI技术选择之间的鸿沟，从根本上解决"选择问题"。

title: Self-Calibrating Dense Displacement Fields for Reliable Co-Registration of Large Optical Satellite Imagery
summary: Co-registration underlies nearly every multi-temporal and multi-sensor use of optical satellite imagery, and operational products still carry documented offsets well above the fraction-of-a-pixel scale at which change detection, time series, and data fusion degrade. Real image pairs differ along several axes at once (sensor response, scene content, viewing geometry, resolution, mosaic seams), and the last of these is not a single global motion. Existing tools embed a motion model and constants tuned to their development data; a pair that fits is registered precisely, while one that does not either fails to match or returns a result wrong by tens of pixels with no failure reported. Learned matchers add a GPU requirement and carry no accuracy guarantee outside their training distribution. We present SCDF (self-calibrating displacement fields), a training-free, GPU-free estimator whose motion model is the dense per-pixel displacement field itself, so no scene motion falls outside the model. A single predict--measure--filter loop runs over a resolution pyramid: the accumulated field predicts where each patch of the moving image falls in the reference, RootSIFT matching and a correlation pass measure the displacement there to sub-pixel precision, and filters whose thresholds are all calibrated on the image pair itself decide what survives. One configuration, with no per-dataset tuning, processes full $8192^2$ scenes on a single CPU core. On 584 constructed-ground-truth pairs built from real Sentinel-2, Landsat-8/9, and NAIP imagery, against seven classical baselines and two zero-shot pretrained matchers, SCDF registers every pair with zero failures, reduces the best baseline's real-pair median end-point error from 6.83 to 4.17m, and cuts its 90th percentile from 17.8 to 7.77m.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCDF（自校准位移场），一种无需训练、无需GPU的高精度图像配准方法。它直接估计稠密的逐像素位移场作为运动模型，通过"预测-测量-滤波"循环在分辨率金字塔上迭代，所有滤波阈值均在图像对自身上校准。在584个真实场景构建的测试对上，SCDF零失败，中位端点误差降至4.17m，90百分位降至7.77m，优于全部经典基线和零样本预训练匹配器。
AI.motivation: 现有配准工具将固定的运动模型和常数嵌入到开发数据中，当图像对不符合该模型时要么配准失败，要么返回偏差数十像素的错误结果而不报告失败；学习型匹配器需要GPU且超出训练分布时无精度保证。真实图像对同时在传感器响应、场景内容、视角、分辨率、镶嵌接缝等多个维度存在差异，且镶嵌接缝并非单一全局运动，因此需要一种不预设运动模型约束、无需训练且精度有保障的配准方法。
AI.method: SCDF以稠密逐像素位移场本身作为运动模型，确保任何场景运动都不超出模型范围。算法在一个分辨率金字塔上执行单一的预测-测量-滤波循环：累积的位移场预测移动图像每个patch在参考图像中的位置；RootSIFT匹配和相关性分析在亚像素精度上测量该位置的位移；所有滤波阈值均在当前图像对上自适应校准，以决定哪些测量结果被保留。该方法无需训练、无需GPU，单CPU核心即可处理完整的8192²场景。
AI.result: 在基于真实Sentinel-2、Landsat-8/9和NAIP影像构建的584个真实地面真值测试对上，SCDF配准了所有图像对，零失败；与七个经典基线和两个零样本预训练匹配器相比，将最佳基线的中位端点误差从6.83m降至4.17m，并将90百分位误差从17.8m降至7.77m。
AI.conclusion: SCDF通过将运动模型替换为稠密位移场本身，并利用逐图像对自校准的滤波阈值，克服了传统配准工具的模型假设限制和深度学习方法的数据策略限制，在精度和鲁棒性上均显著超越现有方法，且无需训练和GPU，具有广泛的实用性。

title: Analyzing and Mitigating Cross-Lingual Degradation in Multilingual Medical VQA
summary: Medical visual question answering (VQA) is a crucial task in clinical AI, yet its evaluation has so far centered almost exclusively on English, limiting its relevance to linguistically diverse patients and clinicians. Recent multilingual medical VQA benchmarks show that large vision-language models (LVLMs) degrade in non-English languages, but lack a fine-grained analysis of how cross-lingual variation affects the distinct capabilities that medical VQA requires. To this end, we construct a multilingual medical VQA benchmark over eight languages, organized into four representative scenarios that isolate the core capabilities medical VQA requires. Evaluating five open- and closed-source LVLMs, we find that cross-lingual degradation is not uniform but highly scenario-dependent. We therefore propose MedVL-XLRepE, a training-free scenario-aware representation engineering method, leveraging LVLMs' superior English medical VQA capability to steer non-English representations toward their English counterparts at inference time. Across three LVLMs and eight languages, MedVL-XLRepE consistently mitigates cross-lingual degradation, with gains of up to 6.33\%.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个覆盖8种语言的多语言医学VQA基准，将问题组织为四种代表场景以隔离核心能力。通过评估5个开源和闭源LVLM，发现跨语言性能下降具有场景依赖性。提出训练免费的MedVL-XLRepE方法，利用英文医学VQA能力在推理时引导非英语表征回归英文表征，在三个LVLM和八种语言上持续缓解跨语言退化，最高提升6.33%。
AI.motivation: 现有医学VQA评测几乎完全基于英语，限制了其对多语言患者和临床医生的适用性。已有多语言医学VQA基准虽显示LVLM在非英语语言中性能下降，但缺乏对跨语言差异如何影响医学VQA所需不同核心能力的细粒度分析。
AI.method: 构建覆盖八种语言的多语言医学VQA基准，将其组织为四种代表性场景以隔离医学VQA所需的核心能力；评估五个开源和闭源LVLM；提出MedVL-XLRepE，一种训练免费的场景感知表征工程方法，利用LVLM在英文医学VQA上的优势能力，在推理时引导非英语表征向英语表征靠拢。
AI.result: 跨语言退化并非均匀分布，而是高度依赖于具体场景；MedVL-XLRepE在三个LVLM和八种语言上持续缓解跨语言退化，最高提升6.33%。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言性能退化具有明显的场景依赖性，而通过表征工程方法在不进行训练的情况下利用英文能力可以有效迁移至非英语语言，为多语言医学VQA提供了可行的改善路径。

title: On Tensor-Based PDEs and their Corresponding Variational Formulations with Application to Color Image Denoising
summary: The case when a partial differential equation (PDE) can be considered as an Euler-Lagrange (E-L) equation of an energy functional, consisting of a data term and a smoothness term is investigated. We show the necessary conditions for a PDE to be the E-L equation for a corresponding functional. This energy functional is applied to a color image denoising problem and it is shown that the method compares favorably to current state-of-the-art color image denoising techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文研究偏微分方程（PDE）能否被视为某一能量泛函（包含数据项和平滑项）的欧拉-拉格朗日（E-L）方程的判定条件，并将该能量泛函应用于彩色图像去噪问题，结果表明该方法与当前最先进的彩色图像去噪技术相比具有竞争力。
AI.motivation: 在许多图像处理任务中，PDE方法被广泛使用，但并非所有PDE都能找到一个对应的能量泛函作为其E-L方程。作者希望建立必要条件来判断一个PDE是否可以从变分原理导出，从而为PDE方法提供更坚实的理论基础，并进一步利用该能量泛函进行彩色图像去噪。
AI.method: 论文首先推导了一个PDE能够成为某能量泛函（由数据项和平滑项构成）E-L方程的必要条件。然后基于该能量泛函构建彩色图像去噪模型，并通过数值方法求解该变分问题。
AI.result: 作者证明了PDE作为E-L方程所需满足的必要条件，并将所得的能量泛函应用于彩色图像去噪，实验表明该方法的去噪性能优于或可与当前最先进的彩色图像去噪技术相媲美。
AI.conclusion: 论文建立了PDE与变分能量泛函之间的理论联系，给出了PDE可作为E-L方程的必要条件，并通过彩色图像去噪实验验证了该能量泛函在实际应用中的有效性和优越性。

title: WAM-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for World Action Models
summary: World action models (WAMs) couple visual future prediction with robot action generation, but accelerated students can lose task capabilities during distillation and later encounter states that are poorly represented by offline data. We study whether on-policy distillation (OPD) can repair such a student without requiring sparse-reward reinforcement learning. We introduce WAM-OPD, a deployment-consistent post-training recipe for a video-first WAM. The student acts in the environment and therefore determines the history distribution. A frozen teacher labels those student histories with coherent video and action targets, while the student action branch is trained under its own generated video plan, as it is at deployment. Joint video and action losses update lightweight adapters in the shared backbone, together with an action flow-matching regularizer. In preliminary RoboTwin 2.0 studies on two tasks, the released one-video/one-action-step Flash-WAM improves from 0.0% to 58.3% success on HANDOVER MIC, and from 16.7% to 33.3% on PUT OBJECT CABINET. These task-specific results are an initial capability proof rather than evidence of broad or uniform generalization. They nevertheless suggest that dense teacher supervision on student-induced histories is a promising post-training interface for video-first WAMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WAM-OPD，一种部署一致的on-policy蒸馏后训练方法，用于修复视频优先的世界动作模型（WAM）学生模型在蒸馏后丢失的任务能力。学生模型在环境中行动并决定历史分布，冻结的教师模型为这些学生历史生成一致的视频和动作目标，学生动作分支在其自身生成的视频计划下训练。初步实验表明在RoboTwin 2.0两个任务上性能显著提升（0%→58.3%和16.7%→33.3%）。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型（WAMs）将视觉未来预测与机器人动作生成相结合，但在蒸馏过程中，加速的学生模型可能丢失任务能力，并且会遇到离线数据中表示不佳的状态。现有方法依赖稀疏奖励强化学习进行修复，但这不是理想方案。
AI.method: WAM-OPD采用on-policy蒸馏：1）学生模型在真实环境中行动并决定历史分布；2）冻结的教师模型为学生的历史生成连贯的视频和动作目标；3）学生动作分支在自身生成的视频计划下训练（与部署一致）；4）联合视频和动作损失更新共享骨干网络中的轻量适配器，并辅以动作流匹配正则化器。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin 2.0两个任务上的初步结果：Flash-WAM在HANDOVER MIC任务上成功率从0.0%提升到58.3%，在PUT OBJECT CABINET任务上从16.7%提升到33.3%。作者明确指出这些是任务特定的初步能力证明，而非广泛或均匀泛化的证据。
AI.conclusion: 密集教师监督学生诱导的历史分布是一种有前景的、面向视频优先WAM的后训练接口。该方法避免了稀疏奖励强化学习的需求，通过部署一致的训练范式有效恢复了蒸馏学生的任务能力。

title: Adapting Dense Vision-Language Relationships for Multi-label Classification with Partial Label
summary: Learning multi-label image classification with incomplete annotations is a challenging task that has been widely studied for its superior trade-off between high efficiency and less labor consumption on large-scale datasets. Predominant methods rely on strong prior assumptions to recover the missing semantics from partial annotations. However, these statistic priors suffer from unstable semantic mistakes and thus lead to catastrophic overfitting. Toward this end, we propose a Language-driven Dense Semantic Adaptor (LDSA) that excavates prior-adaptive relationships from multimodal pretrained CLIP models. In our approach, the densely contrastive adaptor is first proposed to construct dense visual contrastive constraints, transferring the task-specific knowledge to visual domains. We then propose a language-driven interactive decoder with the help of class-specific prompt tuning, which adapts language proxies with visual domains. With the collaborative learning of proposed modules, experimental results demonstrate our proposed LDSA achieves a new state of the art on public multi-label classification benchmarks, and interpretable analyses reveal that our LDSA discovers implicit semantic relationships with the prior-adaptive learning scheme.

AI.tldr: 本文提出语言驱动的密集语义适配器（LDSA），利用CLIP多模态预训练模型中的先验自适应关系，解决不完整标注下的多标签图像分类问题。通过密集对比适配器和语言驱动交互解码器，在多个基准上达到SOTA效果。
AI.motivation: 不完整标注的多标签图像分类具有高效与低劳动成本的优点，但现有方法依赖强统计先验来恢复缺失语义，这些先验容易产生不稳定的语义错误，导致严重的过拟合问题。
AI.method: 1) 提出密集对比适配器，构建密集视觉对比约束，将任务特定知识迁移到视觉领域；2) 提出语言驱动交互解码器，利用类别特定提示调优，将语言代理与视觉领域自适应结合；3) 两个模块协同学习，从CLIP多模态预训练模型中挖掘先验自适应关系。
AI.result: 在公开多标签分类基准上取得新的最先进表现，且可解释性分析表明LDSA能够通过先验自适应学习方案发现隐含的语义关系。
AI.conclusion: LDSA通过利用多模态预训练模型中的先验自适应关系，有效克服了传统统计先验带来的过拟合问题，为不完整标注下的多标签分类提供了更鲁棒和可解释的解决方案。

title: LLMs for Survey Text Analysis - A Performance Comparison Between Humans and GPT-5 on Inductive Content Analysis
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support text analysis in qualitative research, yet evidence on their performance in inductive content analysis remains limited. This study compares human and LLM-based inductive coding of open-ended survey responses from 903 answers across six variables from a European PhD student survey. Five human coders performed inductive content analysis following a standardized coding scheme, while an LLM (GPT-5.4) conducted the same task using an established prompting procedure. Agreement between human and LLM outputs was assessed using the Adjusted Rand Index (ARI). Results showed an alignment between humans and the LLM, with ARI values of 0.61 for coding and 0.54 for theme generation. These values were close to the internal consistency of coding and theme results within humans (ARI = 0.68) and the LLM (ARI = 0.76). Agreement varied widely across variables, with low within-entity consistency consistently linked to low between-entity agreement, underscoring the role of data characteristics and individual performance in reliability. Overall, the findings suggest that LLMs can approximate human coding in this case-specific setting, particularly at the coding level, and may serve as a scalable support tool for inductive qualitative analysis.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了人类编码员与LLM（GPT-5.4）在归纳式内容分析中的表现，基于903条欧洲博士生开放题调查回复。结果显示人机一致性（ARI=0.61编码、0.54主题生成）接近人类内部一致性（0.68）和LLM内部一致性（0.76），表明LLM可近似人类编码，尤其在编码层面，可作为可扩展的归纳式质性分析辅助工具。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地被用于支持质性研究中的文本分析，但关于其在归纳式内容分析中的表现证据仍然有限，缺乏系统的人机对比研究。
AI.method: 使用903条来自欧洲博士生调查的开放题回复，涵盖六个变量。五名人类编码员按照标准化编码方案进行归纳式内容分析，同时使用LLM（GPT-5.4）通过既定提示程序完成相同任务。采用调整兰德指数（ARI）评估人机输出一致性。
AI.result: 人类与LLM之间的一致性与人类内部及LLM内部一致性相近（编码：人机ARI=0.61 vs 人类内部0.68；主题生成：人机ARI=0.54 vs 人类内部0.68 vs LLM内部0.76）。一致性在不同变量间差异较大，低内部一致性总是对应低人机一致性。
AI.conclusion: LLM在特定情境下能够近似人类编码表现，尤其在编码层面，可作为可扩展的归纳式质性分析支持工具。数据特征和个体表现对可靠性有重要影响。

title: On the Choice of Tensor Estimation for Corner Detection, Optical Flow and Denoising
summary: Many image processing methods such as corner detection, optical flow and iterative enhancement make use of image tensors. Generally, these tensors are estimated using the structure tensor. In this work we show that the gradient energy tensor can be used as an alternative to the structure tensor in several cases. We apply the gradient energy tensor to common image problem applications such as corner detection, optical flow and image enhancement. Our experimental results suggest that the gradient energy tensor enables real-time tensor-based image enhancement using the graphical processing unit (GPU) and we obtain 40% increase of frame rate without loss of image quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用梯度能量张量（Gradient Energy Tensor）作为结构张量（Structure Tensor）的替代方案，应用于角点检测、光流估计和图像增强等常见图像处理任务，并在GPU上实现了实时张量图像增强，帧率提升40%且不损失图像质量。
AI.motivation: 许多图像处理方法（如角点检测、光流、迭代增强）都依赖图像张量，传统上这些张量通过结构张量来估计。作者希望探索梯度能量张量能否在多种场景中作为结构张量的替代方案，以带来性能提升。
AI.method: 将梯度能量张量应用于三类常见图像问题：角点检测、光流估计和图像增强，并与传统的结构张量方法进行比较，同时在GPU上实现张量图像增强以评估实时性能。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，梯度能量张量能够在这些应用中有效替代结构张量，并且在GPU上实现了实时张量图像增强，帧率提升了40%且图像质量没有损失。
AI.conclusion: 梯度能量张量是结构张量的可行替代方案，能够在保持图像质量的同时显著提升计算效率，特别适合GPU并行加速下的实时图像处理应用。

title: Where World Models Break: Natural-Input Failure Discovery
summary: World models predict action-conditioned futures and serve as critical internal simulators for downstream planning and control. However, catastrophic prediction failures of world models could dangerously propagate through the control pipeline, as subsequent agent or model training and decision-making depend heavily on the continuous environment evolution forecasted by these world models. Existing evaluations overlook this systemic risk: by aggregating average errors over benign generations from general queries, they fail to stress-test the model against catastrophic collapses under rare or unobserved condition-action combinations. To bridge this gap, we formalize the natural-input failure discovery problem: under a finite query budget, finding environment-valid conditions and action prefixes that induce severe prediction risk, verifying whether these failures reproduce on fresh seeds, and testing their persistence under nearby valid edits. Discovering such critical failures is computationally challenging, as valid condition-action combinations explode exponentially, rendering exhaustive search or standard sampling infeasible given the high cost of noisy rollouts. To tackle this, we propose BasinLens, which exploits the underlying structure of valid inputs, where each coordinate possesses environment-defined semantic types and admissible domains, by pairing uncertainty-guided global search with typed local replacements. Across diverse benchmarks and world-model families, BasinLens exposes reproducible and locally persistent failure modes that conventional evaluations fail to reveal, showing that average-case benchmarks can mask important vulnerabilities in world-model-driven control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自然输入失败发现问题，并设计BasinLens方法，在有限查询预算下发现世界模型在罕见或未观测的条件-动作组合下的灾难性预测失败，证明平均性能评估会掩盖关键漏洞。
AI.motivation: 世界模型是下游规划与控制的关键内部模拟器，但其灾难性预测失败可能危险地传播到控制管道中。现有评估通过对一般查询的良性生成进行平均误差聚合，忽略了在罕见或未观测条件下模型发生灾难性崩溃的系统性风险。
AI.method: 形式化自然输入失败发现问题，在有限查询预算下寻找环境有效条件和动作前缀以诱发严重预测风险，并验证失败可复现性及在邻近有效编辑下的持续性。提出BasinLens方法，利用有效输入的结构（每个坐标具有环境定义的语义类型和合法域），结合不确定性引导的全局搜索和类型化局部替换。
AI.result: 在多种基准和世界模型家族上，BasinLens暴露了传统评估无法发现的可复现且局部持久的失败模式，证明平均性能基准可能掩盖世界模型驱动控制中的重要漏洞。
AI.conclusion: 平均情况基准评估无法充分揭示世界模型在罕见条件下存在的关键脆弱性，需要专门的压力测试方法来发现和验证这些灾难性失败模式。

title: MedReaMM: Evaluating Large Multimodal Models on Expert-Level Clinical Diagnostic Synthesis
