summary: The application of Large Language Models (LLMs) to diagnostic decision-making has garnered growing interest. However, existing benchmarks largely focus on textual reasoning or isolated visual question-answering (VQA) tasks, lacking holistic integration of clinical narratives and medical imaging, and thus failing to assess the multimodal diagnostic synthesis capability central to expert clinical judgment. To bridge this gap, we introduce MedReaMM, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate models' ability to synthesize heterogeneous clinical evidence consisting of detailed patient histories alongside multiple medical images into accurate differential diagnoses under a complete-information paradigm. Constructed from case reports sourced from top-tier medical journals and curated clinical case databases, MedReaMM comprises 625 expert-validated cases with an average of 2.79 medical images per case and a total of 1,042 standardized diagnoses annotated with ICD-11 codes. These cases predominantly represent rare, atypical, or multi-system presentations that demand expert-level evidence integration beyond routine pattern recognition. We evaluate 23 Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) and find that most achieve diagnostic accuracy scores below 50%, underscoring a substantial gap in multimodal diagnostic synthesis capability. Further analysis reveals that medical knowledge proficiency, medical image understanding, and evidence integration are all highly correlated with diagnostic performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MedReaMM基准，用于评估大语言模型在完整信息范式下，将患者病史与多张医学图像综合为鉴别诊断的能力。该基准包含625个专家验证病例（平均每例2.79张图像，共1,042个ICD-11注释诊断），主要涵盖罕见、非典型或多系统表现。对23个LMM的评估显示，多数模型诊断准确率低于50%，揭示了多模态诊断综合能力的显著缺口。
AI.motivation: 现有基准要么侧重纯文本推理，要么只关注孤立的视觉问答任务，缺乏将临床叙述与医学影像进行整体性整合的评估，无法衡量专家级临床判断所依赖的多模态诊断综合能力。
AI.method: 从顶级医学期刊病例报告和临床病例数据库中构建625个专家验证病例，每例包含详细患者病史和平均2.79张医学图像，用ICD-11编码进行1,042个标准化诊断标注，设计为完整信息范式下的鉴别诊断任务，并评估23个大型多模态模型。
AI.result: 大多数大型多模态模型在MedReaMM上的诊断准确率低于50%，表明当前模型在多模态诊断综合方面存在显著能力缺口。进一步分析表明，医学知识熟练度、医学图像理解和证据整合能力均与诊断性能高度相关。
AI.conclusion: MedReaMM揭示了现有LMM在复杂多模态临床诊断综合方面的不足，为未来模型在该方向的能力提升提供了评估基准和方向指引。

title: Contextrast++: Robust Multi-Scale Contextual Contrastive Learning for Semantic Segmentation
comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI), 2026
summary: Semantic segmentation has rapidly advanced with deep learning; however, challenges remain in effectively capturing local and global contexts as well as addressing the long-tailed distribution problem. To tackle these issues, we present Contextrast++, a robust contrastive learning method for semantic segmentation that improves multi-scale feature integration and mitigates class imbalance issues. Our method consists of two key components: 1) contextual contrastive learning (CCL) and 2) boundary-aware negative (BANE) sampling. CCL includes three subcomponents: adaptive fusion module, pixel-to-anchor (PA) loss, and anchor-to-anchor (AA) loss. The adaptive fusion module dynamically balances local and global feature integration, resulting in a more context-aware representation. While the PA loss leverages the fused multi-scale features to improve feature representation learning, the AA loss focuses on addressing the long-tailed distribution problem by utilizing a memory bank that stores a fixed number of class-balanced representative anchors. Meanwhile, BANE sampling enhances segmentation precision by selecting hard negatives from misclassified boundary regions, which refines fine-grained details during contrastive learning. As verified in extensive experiments using public datasets, we demonstrate that Contextrast++ substantially improves semantic segmentation performance over existing contrastive learning-based state-of-the-art approaches, while introducing no additional computational overhead during inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Contextrast++，一种用于语义分割的鲁棒对比学习方法，通过上下文对比学习（CCL）和边界感知负样本（BANE）采样两大组件，分别解决多尺度特征融合和长尾分布问题，在公共数据集上超越现有对比学习方法且推理时无额外计算开销。
AI.motivation: 语义分割虽有深度学习推动快速发展，但仍面临两大挑战：一是难以有效捕捉局部与全局上下文信息，二是长尾分布（类别不平衡）问题影响了分割性能。
AI.method: Contextrast++包含两个核心组件：(1) 上下文对比学习（CCL），含三个子组件：自适应融合模块（动态平衡局部与全局特征）、像素-锚点（PA）损失（利用融合的多尺度特征提升表征学习）、锚点-锚点（AA）损失（通过存储类平衡代表性锚点的记忆库解决长尾分布问题）；(2) 边界感知负样本（BANE）采样，从误分类的边界区域选择困难负样本，在对比学习中细化细节。
AI.result: 大量公共数据集实验表明，Contextrast++在语义分割性能上显著优于现有基于对比学习的最先进方法，且在推理阶段不引入额外计算开销。
AI.conclusion: Contextrast++通过上下文对比学习和边界感知采样有效解决了多尺度上下文融合和长尾分布两大挑战，实现了高性能且高效推理的语义分割。

title: Think with Structured Grounding: Perceptual Reinforcement Learning for Chart and Visual-Tabular Understanding
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) capable of thinking with images often rely on external tools for fine-grained perception. However, this reliance introduces significant inference latency and fails to effectively resolve the spatial-structural gap-a fundamental challenge in text-dense and structurally relational visuals (e.g., charts and visual tables) where strict relative spatial arrangements bind textual elements. Without external tools, standard MLLMs struggle with such fine-grained visual reasoning tasks. To address these issues, we propose Think with Structured Grounding (TwSG), a novel fine-grained image perception framework designed to internalize complex images's tool-use capabilities within the model. TwSG distills the benefits of multi-step reasoning and micro-cropping into a single efficient forward pass during inference. Specifically, we use an MLLM to identify key regions guided by ground-truth answers, and then prompt a teacher model to generate high-quality visual question-answering (VQA) data. These fine-grained, region-based supervisory signals are subsequently distilled back into the full-image representation. Our training pipeline consists of two stages: (1) a cold-start supervised fine-tuning (SFT) phase using multi-turn data with focused area descriptions to foster complex reasoning and error recovery; and (2) a reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) phase driven by a novel process reward mechanism, TL-GRPO, which encourages strategic reasoning. Extensive experiments across various MLLM architectures demonstrate that TwSG reduces inference latency while substantially improving accuracy and robustness, endowing models with native fine-grained region description and flexible reasoning capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TwSG（Think with Structured Grounding）框架，通过将多步骤推理和微裁剪能力蒸馏到单个前向传播中，使多模态大语言模型无需外部工具即可实现细粒度图像感知，同时降低推理延迟并提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态大语言模型在处理细粒度视觉推理时往往依赖外部工具，这不仅引入了显著的推理延迟，还未能有效解决空间结构差距问题——即在图表和视觉表格等文本密集且结构相关的视觉场景中，文本元素受严格的相对空间排列约束，标准MLLM难以应对此类任务。
AI.method: TwSG框架包含两个训练阶段：（1）冷启动监督微调阶段，使用多轮对话数据配合重点区域描述，培养复杂推理和错误恢复能力；（2）基于新颖过程奖励机制TL-GRPO的强化微调阶段，鼓励策略性推理。训练过程中先用MLLM根据真实答案识别关键区域，再让教师模型生成高质量VQA数据，最后将这些细粒度区域监督信号蒸馏回全图表示。
AI.result: 在多种MLLM架构上的大量实验表明，TwSG在降低推理延迟的同时显著提升了准确率和鲁棒性，使模型具备原生的细粒度区域描述和灵活推理能力。
AI.conclusion: TwSG成功地将外部工具的能力内化到模型中，在不牺牲推理效率的前提下，解决了文本密集和结构相关视觉中的空间结构差距问题，为细粒度图像感知提供了一种高效且有效的解决方案。

title: AcroMELD: Recovering Interactive PDF Forms with Structure-Aware Graph Set Transformers
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Source compiles to a tagged PDF 2.0 document with MathML embedded as associated files
summary: Interactive PDF form fields are often absent from documents that visually resemble forms, leaving users unable to enter data without printing or external editing tools. Detecting the missing widgets is difficult because a field may be indicated by several overlapping cues, born-digital PDFs expose useful but incomplete drawing structure, and dense pages can contain hundreds of fields. We introduce AcroMELD (AcroForm Multi-source Evidence Linking Decoder), a 39.4M-parameter detector that combines a high-resolution visual transformer with label-free PDF primitives. Its 896-query set comprises 384 visual proposals, 384 structure-seeded proposals, and 128 learned recovery queries. Four graph-set layers exchange information over geometry-biased sparse neighborhoods and cross-attend to PDF structure. A learned same-field relation links co-referent candidates, while a localization-quality head is trained on the containment-aware overlap used by the downstream recovery decision. We define a hash-bound evaluation protocol with disjoint development, calibration, internal-test, and quarantined external-holdout roles. The sealed, single-seed candidate reaches native containment micro-$F_1$ 0.9344 on the internal test and 0.8477 on the one-shot external holdout (95% PDF-cluster bootstrap interval [0.8339, 0.8605]). This passes the registered historical FFGBT-v8 reference by 0.0186 absolute $F_1$. Under the stricter external adapter, however, performance is 0.7786 IoU-$0.5$ $F_1$ and 0.2900 COCO mAP, below a locally evaluated CommonForms-L reference; the signature class receives no prediction at the selected threshold. Thus the result supports the registered operational gate while exposing substantial domain and rare-class limitations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AcroMELD，一个39.4M参数的检测器，用于检测PDF中缺失的表单字段（AcroForm widgets）。它结合高分辨率视觉transformer和PDF原始结构信息，通过896个查询（384视觉提议、384结构种子提议、128学习恢复查询）和四层图集网络实现字段检测。在内部测试中达到0.9344的containment micro-F1，外部保留测试0.8477，但在更严格的外部适配器条件下性能下降明显，暴露出领域泛化和稀有类别的局限性。
AI.motivation: 交互式PDF表单字段经常缺失于视觉上类似表单的文档中，用户无法直接输入数据。检测这些缺失widgets很困难，因为字段可能由多个重叠线索指示，生成本地PDF暴露了有用但不完整的绘图结构，密集页面可能包含数百个字段。现有方法难以有效解决这些问题。
AI.method: AcroMELD采用39.4M参数架构，结合高分辨率视觉transformer与无需标签的PDF原始结构。使用896个查询集合（384视觉提议+384结构种子提议+128学习恢复查询），通过四层图集层在几何偏置稀疏邻域交换信息并与PDF结构交叉注意。学习到的同字段关系用于链接共引用候选，定位质量头在包含感知重叠上训练。
AI.result: 密封单种子候选在内部测试达到原生containment micro-F1 0.9344，一次性外部保留测试0.8477（95% PDF簇bootstrap区间[0.8339, 0.8605]），超过注册的历史FFGBT-v8基线0.0186绝对F1。但在更严格外部适配器下性能降至0.7786 IoU-0.5 F1和0.2900 COCO mAP，低于本地评估的CommonForms-L参考；签名类别在选定阈值下未获得预测。
AI.conclusion: 该结果支持注册的操作门槛，同时暴露了显著的领域泛化和稀有类别局限性。虽然AcroMELD在主要评估上超过历史基线，但在外部适配和稀有类（如签名）上的不足表明仍需进一步改进以应对实际部署中的多样性和极端类别不平衡问题。

title: LLM-Based Selection of Incongruent Verbal and Nonverbal Behavior for Virtual Humans
summary: Nonverbal behavior generation systems for virtual agents often take an utterance as input and generate nonverbal behaviors that emphasize or illustrate the content of the verbal channel. However, human nonverbal behavior is shaped by more than the content of the speech. It is also influenced by speaker roles, interpersonal relationships, social context, and the cognitive and emotional states of the interactants. As a result, the nonverbal channel may reinforce, weaken, qualify, or even contradict the verbal channel. It may also reveal internal states that are hidden or only indirectly implied in speech, including emotional "leakage" that may be incidental to the immediate interaction. Modeling this richer relationship between verbal and nonverbal behavior is important for designing virtual agents that exhibit realistic, human-like behavior. It is especially critical in training contexts that require nuanced social interpretation, such as counseling simulations involving virtual patients. Drawing on Ekman's framework of verbal nonverbal relationships, we propose a taxonomy of categories in which mismatches between verbal and nonverbal behavior can occur. We then examine alternative approaches for realizing these behaviors using large language models, focusing on whether LLMs can select contextually appropriate mismatched verbal and nonverbal behaviors from a given dialogue and social interaction context. Finally, we evaluate the resulting behaviors in a human-subject study, assessing whether context-driven nonverbal behavior, when embodied in a virtual human, produces the intended effects on observers.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Ekman的言语-非言语关系框架，提出了一种关于虚拟代理言语与非言语行为不匹配的分类体系，并探讨了如何利用大语言模型（LLM）从对话和社交语境中选择合适的非言语行为，最后通过人类被试实验评估了这些行为在虚拟人身上的实际效果。
AI.motivation: 现有非言语行为生成系统通常仅以话语内容为输入，忽略了人类非言语行为还受说话者角色、人际关系、社会情境以及认知情感状态等多种因素影响。这种简化建模无法捕捉非言语行为与言语行为之间复杂的关系（如强化、削弱、修饰甚至矛盾），在需要细腻社交解读的训练场景（如心理咨询模拟）中尤为关键。
AI.method: （1）借鉴Ekman的言语-非言语关系框架，提出言语与非言语行为不匹配的分类体系；（2）考察利用大语言模型从给定对话和社交互动语境中选择情境合适的不匹配言语/非言语行为的多种实现途径；（3）通过人类被试研究评估这些情境驱动的非言语行为在虚拟人身上是否产生预期效果。
AI.result: 研究提出了言语-非言语不匹配行为的分类体系，并通过LLM实现行为选择，最后在人类被试研究中验证了情境驱动的非言语行为在虚拟人化身中对观察者产生的效果。
AI.conclusion: 建模言语与非言语行为之间更丰富的关系（包括不匹配乃至矛盾的情形）对设计具有真实人类行为的虚拟代理至关重要，尤其在心理咨询等需要细致社交解读的训练情境中具有重要意义。

title: When Persona Simulations Are Informative: Graph-Structured Signals for Pluralistic Opinion Sensing
summary: Persona-conditioned large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate survey responses across diverse domains. However, apparent response variation can reflect unconditioned model priors or token sampling noise rather than systematic persona conditioning. We argue that persona-conditioned variation is informative when semantically similar personas exhibit concordant response shifts. To operationalize this principle, we introduce Persona-Conditioned Informativeness (PCI), an unsupervised diagnostic metric that measures whether semantically similar personas deviate in concordant directions relative to item-level sample baselines. By modeling personas as a similarity graph, PCI uses Local Moran's I to quantify local spatial coherence and extract compact persona subsets without using construct labels. To evaluate PCI without external human benchmarks, we test its ability to recover established latent value structure using the 57-item Portrait Values Questionnaire-Revised (PVQ-RR). Confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) shows that a PCI-selected 10% subset substantially improves overall construct recovery relative to response-stability and random selection. These findings support PCI as a principled internal diagnostic for screening synthetic respondents in survey pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Persona-Conditioned Informativeness (PCI)，一个无监督诊断指标，通过衡量语义相似人格是否产生一致的响应偏移来评估人格条件化LLM响应的信息量，而非仅依赖模型先验或采样噪声。
AI.motivation: 人格条件化LLM越来越多用于模拟调查响应，但表面上的响应变异可能反映的是无条件的模型先验或token采样噪声，而非系统的人格条件化效应。需要一个原则性指标来区分真正由人格驱动的变异与噪声。
AI.method: 将人格建模为相似度图，使用Local Moran's I量化局部空间自相关性，测量语义相似人格相对于逐题样本基线的偏离方向是否一致（concordant），从而提取紧凑的人格子集，无需构造标签。
AI.result: 在57题Portrait Values Questionnaire-Revised (PVQ-RR)上，通过验证性因素分析（CFA）表明，PCI选择的10%子集相比响应稳定性选择和随机选择，能显著提高整体构念恢复质量。
AI.conclusion: PCI可作为筛选调查管线中合成受访者的原则性内部诊断工具，用于评估人格条件化LLM响应的信息量。

title: TransHands: Repurposing Human Pose Encoders as Hand Pose Encoders
summary: Lifting 3D hand poses from 2D monocular representations remains challenging due to the limited availability of large-scale, diverse 3D-annotated hand datasets, in contrast to the abundance of human body motion data. We address this limitation by transferring motion representations learned from large body pose corpora to the hand domain. We introduce TransHands, a backbone-agnostic transfer learning framework that enables pre-trained human motion encoders to be effectively adapted for 3D hand pose estimation from 2D pose inputs. Rather than training hand-specific biomechanical models from scratch, TransHands combines a two-stage training and fine-tuning strategy with a lightweight hand-specific input adaptation module that aligns hand kinematics with the representation space learned for full-body motion. We evaluate TransHands across four state-of-the-art motion modeling architectures, including transformer-based, graph-based, and frequency- domain models. Results demonstrate that motion priors learned from body pose data transfer consistently across architectures, yielding consistent accuracy gains, strong cross-domain generalization, particularly in challenging egocentric settings, and applicability for downstream tasks in real-world contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TransHands，一个与骨干网络无关的迁移学习框架，通过将大规模人体姿态数据中学到的运动表征迁移到手部领域，实现从2D姿态输入估计3D手部姿态，从而克服3D手部标注数据稀缺的问题。
AI.motivation: 3D手部姿态估计面临标注数据稀缺的挑战，而人体运动数据却非常丰富。本文旨在利用人体运动数据中学到的表征迁移到手部领域，避免从零训练手部特有的生物力学模型。
AI.method: TransHands框架包含两个关键设计：(1)两阶段训练与微调策略；(2)轻量级手部特定输入适配模块，用于将手部运动学与全身体运动表征空间对齐。该框架与骨干网络无关，可适配Transformer、图网络和频域模型等多种架构。
AI.result: 在四种先进运动建模架构（Transformer、图网络、频域模型）上均验证了有效性，表明人体姿态运动先验能够稳定跨架构迁移，带来一致的精度提升，并在具有挑战性的自我中心（egocentric）场景中展现强跨域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: TransHands证明了将人体运动表征迁移到手部3D姿态估计的有效性和通用性，不仅在不同架构上表现一致，还具备良好的跨域泛化能力，可用于真实场景中的下游任务。

title: MIVIFI: Bridging Perspective and Fisheye Domains for Training Multi-View Fisheye Image Generation Models
comment: Accepted at the IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC) 2026
summary: Achieving 360° coverage is critical for the visual perception systems of autonomous vehicles. Fisheye cameras offer a cost-effective solution by enabling full surround coverage with as few as two sensors. However, existing multi-view fisheye datasets are limited, and synthesizing rare corner cases typically requires computationally expensive 3D simulations, hindering the training. While generative models have achieved significant success in standard perspective imagery, their application to wide-angle distortion remains unexplored. In this work, we formally introduce the novel problem of multi-view fisheye image generation conditioned on volumetric semantic representations and present two distinct methods. We first propose SyntheOcc-FE, which adapts the SyntheOcc architecture to fisheye data. While effective, this method is constrained by the scarcity of fisheye datasets, which limits its generalization. To overcome these limitations, we propose our second method, MIVIFI (multi-view fisheye), which leverages cross-domain learning with Equirectangular Projections. By bridging the gap between dataset domains using KITTI-360 fisheye images alongside nuScenes multi-view standard images, our approach enables high-fidelity manipulation of scene content. This framework enables the structural modification of semantic occupancy inputs to introduce or eliminate specific actors and facilitates the rendering of diverse meteorological conditions and illumination scenarios absent in the limited fisheye datasets. Quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that our methods achieve robust photorealistic multi-view fisheye image generation and highlight the specific advantages of our cross-domain strategy for handling data scarcity.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出多视角鱼眼图像生成问题，基于体素语义占用进行条件生成。提出了两种方法：SyntheOcc-FE（适配现有架构）和MIVIFI（利用等距投影的跨域学习策略），后者通过结合KITTI-360鱼眼图像与nuScenes标准图像克服鱼眼数据集稀缺问题，实现高保真场景内容操控，包括增删目标、渲染多样天气和光照场景。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶视觉感知系统需要360°覆盖，鱼眼相机以两个传感器即可实现全包围视野，是经济高效的解决方案。然而多视角鱼眼数据集稀缺，合成罕见边缘场景通常依赖计算昂贵的3D模拟，阻碍了训练。虽然生成模型在标准透视图像上取得显著成功，但尚未应用于广角畸变领域。
AI.method: 提出两种方法：(1) SyntheOcc-FE，将SyntheOcc架构适配到鱼眼数据；(2) MIVIFI，利用等距柱状投影进行跨域学习，桥接KITTI-360鱼眼图像与nuScenes多视角标准图像之间的域差距。该框架支持对语义占用输入进行结构化修改以引入或消除特定目标，并渲染鱼眼数据集缺失的各种气象条件和光照场景。
AI.result: 定量和定性实验表明，所提方法实现了鲁棒的照片级真实感多视角鱼眼图像生成，并突显了跨域策略在处理数据稀缺问题上的特定优势。
AI.conclusion: 跨域学习策略（MIVIFI）是应对鱼眼数据稀缺的有效手段，为自动驾驶鱼眼感知系统的训练数据增强提供了可行路径。

title: Small Reasoning Models are Instruction Followers in Function Calling
summary: Function calling represents the core capability of agentic large language models (LLMs). Existing research has focused on enhancing LLMs function-calling accuracy through fine-tuning, reinforcement learning (RL), and multi-agent frameworks, particularly for native function-calling LLMs. This work demonstrates that LLMs achieve superior accuracy in function calling in instruction-following contexts (i.e., standard user-assistant interactions) rather than a tool calling context. We introduce Instruction-Followed Function Calling (IFFC), a novel framework that decouples function-calling logic from the primary LLM and delegates it to a dedicated smaller model operating within the instruction-following paradigm. Our method consistently outperforms both native function calling (NFC) and prompt-based function calling (PFC) baselines, with particularly strong gains on reasoning-oriented LLMs. Furthermore, we demonstrate that IFFC maintains robust performance under aggressive quantization, enabling efficient on-device deployment without significant accuracy degradation. This work establishes a new paradigm for reliable, resource-efficient function calling in edge-computing scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IFFC框架，将函数调用逻辑从主LLM中解耦，委托给一个专门的较小模型在指令跟随范式中运行，实验证明该方法在函数调用准确性上优于原生函数调用（NFC）和基于提示的函数调用（PFC），并在激进量化下仍保持稳健性能。
AI.motivation: 现有研究集中于通过微调、强化学习和多智能体框架提升LLM的函数调用准确率，但忽视了指令跟随上下文（标准用户-助手交互）在函数调用中的潜在优势。作者希望探索一种更可靠且资源高效的函数调用范式。
AI.method: 提出IFFC（Instruction-Followed Function Calling）框架，将函数调用逻辑从主LLM中解耦，委派给一个专门的较小模型，该模型在指令跟随范式下运行。
AI.result: IFFC在函数调用准确性上一致优于原生函数调用（NFC）和基于提示的函数调用（PFC）基线，尤其在推理导向的LLM上提升显著；且在激进量化下仍保持稳健性能，支持高效的设备端部署。
AI.conclusion: 本研究建立了边缘计算场景下可靠、资源高效的函数调用新范式，表明函数调用在指令跟随上下文中比工具调用上下文能获得更优的准确性。

title: Fast and Compact 3D Gaussian Splatting with Polarized Opacity Prior
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) achieves state-of-the-art rendering quality at real-time speeds but suffers from "model bloat" - a large number of redundant, low-opacity Gaussians that inflate memory usage and training costs. This inefficiency stems from the standard "densify-then-prune" paradigm, which expands the model aggressively before relying on pruning to achieve compactness. To mitigate this problem, we present an efficient training framework that builds an intrinsically compact representation, replacing the conventional densify-then-prune cycle. Our method leverages a synergistic design: an L2 reconstruction loss to provide error-proportional gradients that stabilize optimization, and a novel Polarized Opacity Prior (POP) to actively manage the Gaussian population. POP steers informative primitives toward full opacity and uninformative ones toward transparency, enabling natural pruning and accelerating rendering through Early Ray Termination. Experiments on three public datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently achieves accelerated 3DGS training with significantly fewer Gaussians while maintaining comparable visual reconstruction quality. These results show that the proposed framework provides a simple and effective path toward fast and inherently compact 3DGS training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高效的3D高斯泼溅(3DGS)训练框架，通过L2重建损失和新型极化不透明度先验(POP)构建固有紧凑的表示，替代传统的"先稠密后剪枝"范式，在加速训练的同时显著减少高斯数量并保持视觉质量。
AI.motivation: 3DGS虽然实现了实时渲染质量，但存在"模型臃肿"问题——大量冗余、低不透明度的Gaussians导致内存占用和训练成本过高。这一低效源于标准的"densify-then-prune"（先稠密化再剪枝）范式，该范式先激进扩展模型，再依赖剪枝实现紧凑性。
AI.method: 提出一个协同设计：(1)使用L2重建损失提供与误差成比例的梯度，以稳定优化；(2)提出新型极化不透明度先验(POP)，主动管理高斯群体——将信息丰富的图元推向完全不透明，将无信息的图元推向透明，从而实现自然剪枝，并通过早期光线终止加速渲染。
AI.result: 在三个公开数据集上的实验表明，该方法在维持可比视觉重建质量的同时，持续实现加速的3DGS训练和显著更少的高斯数量。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的框架为快速且内在紧凑的3DGS训练提供了一条简单有效的路径。

title: MomADv2: Reliable Temporal Memory for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Long-horizon planning is critical for safe autonomous driving in complex scenarios. Existing methods improve planning continuity with temporal memory, but such memory may become invalid and mislead decisions when the driving command changes. Thus, selectively leveraging useful history while suppressing command-inconsistent memory remains a key challenge. To address this issue, we propose MomADv2, a reliable state-space memory framework for long-horizon end-to-end autonomous driving. At its core, MomADv2 introduces a Selective State-Space Planning Memory Query Module, which filters historical planning queries based on temporal continuity and command consistency, selects planning modes relevant to the current command, and models the evolution of planning intentions through a selective state-space mechanism. To further alleviate local trajectory deviations and error accumulation in long-horizon planning, we design a Flow-Matching Trajectory Residual Refiner. It learns a continuous residual correction field from the refined planning output to the expert trajectory, enabling fine-grained trajectory refinement while preserving the stability of anchor-based planning. Extensive experiments on closed-loop NAVSIM and Bench2Drive, as well as open-loop nuScenes, demonstrate that MomADv2 improves long-horizon planning consistency and reduces the average collision rate by 15.6% over MomAD under 6-second planning.

AI.tldr: MomADv2是一种面向长时域端到端自动驾驶的可靠状态空间记忆框架，通过选择性状态空间规划记忆查询模块过滤与当前驾驶指令不一致的历史记忆，并引入流匹配轨迹残差精化器缓解长时域规划中的轨迹偏差与误差累积。实验表明，在6秒规划下，相比MomAD将平均碰撞率降低15.6%。
AI.motivation: 现有方法虽然通过时序记忆提升规划连续性，但记忆可能在驾驶指令变化时失效并误导决策。因此关键在于选择性利用有效历史信息，同时抑制与当前指令不一致的记忆。
AI.method: 提出两个核心模块：(1) 选择性状态空间规划记忆查询模块——基于时序连续性和指令一致性过滤历史规划查询，选择与当前指令相关的规划模式，并通过选择性状态空间机制建模规划意图的演化；(2) 流匹配轨迹残差精化器——从精化输出到专家轨迹学习连续残差校正场，在保持锚定规划稳定性的同时实现细粒度轨迹精化。
AI.result: 在闭环NAVSIM和Bench2Drive以及开环nuScenes上的大量实验表明，MomADv2提升了长时域规划一致性，并在6秒规划下较MomAD将平均碰撞率降低15.6%。
AI.conclusion: MomADv2通过记忆选择性过滤与流匹配残差精化，有效解决了长时域规划中指令变化导致的记忆失效问题，提升了自动驾驶规划的可靠性与安全性。

title: When Does AI for PDEs Yield Scientific Evidence?
summary: Existing AI-for-PDE benchmarks primarily assess models in terms of predictive or approximation accuracy. In physics research, however, AI outputs often serve as evidence for scientific claims. These two objectives are not equivalent: the former measures an output's agreement with a reference target or satisfaction of governing constraints; the latter asks whether, given a specified object of study, scientific claim, assumptions, and evidence standard, the output provides sufficient evidence for that claim. To bridge this gap, we extend a widely used PDE-simulation benchmark and a comprehensive benchmark for PDE inverse problems to enable, for the first time in AI for PDEs, evaluation of whether and to what extent model outputs support specified scientific claims. Our results show that numerical accuracy and evidential support can rank models differently, explain when and why they do so, and reveal that existing benchmarks can favor methods whose outputs provide weaker support for the scientific claims of interest. Together, we formalize, empirically demonstrate, and explain this evaluation--use mismatch in AI for PDEs.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在AI for PDE领域引入"证据支持"评估维度，对比数值精度与科学主张证据支持两种评估标准的差异，发现二者可能对模型排名产生不同结果，揭示了现有基准可能青睐对科学主张证据支持较弱的模型。
AI.motivation: 现有AI for PDE基准仅评估预测或逼近精度，但在物理研究中AI输出常被用作科学主张的证据。这两种目标不等价：精度衡量输出与参考目标的一致性或约束满足度，而证据支持衡量输出是否为特定科学主张提供充分证据。这一评估与使用之间的不匹配尚未被正式化和实证研究。
AI.method: 扩展了广泛使用的PDE仿真基准和一个综合性的PDE逆问题基准，使其首次支持评估模型输出在给定研究对象、科学主张、假设和证据标准下，是否为该主张提供充分证据及其程度。
AI.result: 实证发现数值精度与证据支持对模型的排名可能不同；解释了两种标准何时及为何产生分歧；揭示现有基准可能偏好那些对感兴趣的科学主张证据支持较弱的模型。
AI.conclusion: 正式化、实证展示并解释了AI for PDE中存在的"评估-使用不匹配"问题，倡导将证据支持作为独立于数值精度的评估维度。

title: Multimodal examination answer data with expert-designed Outcome-Based Education rubrics for criterion-level assessment
summary: This data article describes a multimodal collection of scanned examination answers paired with expert-designed Outcome-Based Education (OBE) grading metadata. The collection contains 485 answer submissions from 415 consenting students at four academic institutions. Eight faculty contributors supplied examination materials covering nine subjects and 12 distinct question templates. Each answer-level item links a scanned PDF to a randomized identifier, subject label, question, model answer, criterion definitions, performance-level descriptions, criterion marks, and a total mark. The 12 rubrics contain 47 criteria in total. The scans retain realistic academic content, including handwriting, printed text, equations, tables, code, figures, sketches, and diagrams. CamScanner, Adobe Scan, and conventional scanners contributed variation in illumination, contrast, orientation, compression, and resolution. Diverse handwriting, crossed-out work, revised calculations, and inserted corrections add further visual variability for robustness and generalization studies. Preparation involved heterogeneous-source consolidation, label and text standardization, score validation, identifier randomization, filename randomization, and JSON-to-PDF integrity checks. An answer-level audit confirmed 485 unique identifiers, 485 unique PDF filenames, agreement between each total mark and its criterion-mark sum, and scores within the applicable rubric maximum. The data can support rubric-aware automated evaluation, multimodal document understanding, criterion-level feedback, score prediction, and privacy-aware OBE assessment research. Access is restricted to research use and is available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个多模态考试答卷扫描数据集，包含4所院校485份答卷，配以专家设计的OBE（成果导向教育）评分元数据。数据集涵盖9个科目、12种题目模板、47个评分标准，支持自动化评分、多模态文档理解等研究。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集缺乏同时包含真实考试扫描答卷与精细化OBE评分元数据的资源，限制了基于成果导向教育的自动化评估和评分预测研究的发展。
AI.method: 从4所院校收集485份书面答卷，8位教师提供9个科目的考试材料。每份答卷关联随机化标识符、题目、模型答案、评分标准定义、等级描述及分数。扫描来源包括CamScanner、Adobe Scan和传统扫描仪，保留真实学术内容及视觉变异。经过异构整合、文本标准化、分数验证、标识符随机化和完整性检查等流程。
AI.result: 数据集中包含485个唯一标识符和485个唯一PDF文件名，每个总分与标准分数总和一致，分数均在评分标准最大值范围内，通过答案级审计验证了数据质量。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集可用于基于评分标准的自动评估、多模态文档理解、标准级反馈、分数预测以及隐私感知的OBE评估研究，但访问受限于研究用途。

title: GeoWAM: Visual Geometry World Action Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: World action models (WAMs) have recently gained increasing attention as a framework for jointly modeling scene evolution and ego actions in autonomous driving. Most existing WAMs learn scene dynamics in pixel space by combining a video-generation backbone for future-observation prediction with an action head for ego-trajectory prediction. Pixels, however, provide only an indirect representation of these dynamics: they entangle geometry and motion with appearance, texture, and illumination, forcing the model to infer three-dimensional transformations from two-dimensional observations. We argue that geometry, represented by point clouds, offers a more natural state space for driving because it explicitly captures spatial structure and the rigid and non-rigid transformations that govern scene evolution while directly aligning with the space in which driving actions are executed. Building on this insight, we introduce \textbf{GeoWAM}, a visual geometry world action model for autonomous driving. Rather than predicting future images, GeoWAM is pretrained to forecast future scene geometry, yielding representations that jointly encode spatial structure and temporal evolution. A geometry-conditioned action head then leverages these learned geometric dynamics to predict future ego trajectories. Extensive open-loop and closed-loop evaluations show that visual geometry world modeling yields substantially stronger driving policies than image-based alternatives, establishing future-geometry prediction as an effective pretraining objective for autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GeoWAM，一种基于视觉几何的世界动作模型，用于自动驾驶。与传统基于像素预测未来图像的方法不同，GeoWAM通过预测未来场景几何（点云）来建模场景演化，并利用几何条件动作头预测未来自车轨迹。实验表明，视觉几何世界建模比基于图像的方法能产生更强的驾驶策略。
AI.motivation: 现有的世界动作模型（WAMs）主要在像素空间学习场景动态，但像素只是间接表示动态：它们将几何、运动与外观、纹理、光照纠缠在一起，迫使模型从二维观测推断三维变换。作者认为几何（点云）是驾驶更自然的状态空间，因为它显式捕获空间结构和场景演化的刚体及非刚体变换，且直接与驾驶动作执行的空间对齐。
AI.method: GeoWAM包含两个核心组件：(1) 预训练的未来场景几何预测模块，用于预测未来点云而非未来图像，从而联合编码空间结构和时间演化；(2) 几何条件动作头，利用学习到的几何动态来预测未来自车轨迹。
AI.result: 在开环和闭环评估中，视觉几何世界建模产生的驾驶策略显著优于基于图像的替代方法，验证了未来几何预测作为自动驾驶预训练目标的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 作者得出结论：未来几何预测是自动驾驶中一种有效且优于像素预测的预训练目标，通过直接建模场景几何动态，可以获得更强的驾驶策略。

title: ClawProBench: Trace-Aware Evaluation of AI Agents with Runtime Coverage and Frozen Workplace-Style Holdouts
summary: Agent benchmarks often evaluate only final answers even when agents run on stateful runtimes. We argue this under-specifies what is being evaluated: the proper unit is a declared model-plus-runtime configuration whose failures can occur in evidence acquisition, runtime routing, safety boundaries, or repeated execution. We present ClawProBench, a trace-aware benchmark for runtime-native agent evaluation instantiated on OpenClaw, a live agent runtime with workspace tools and native surfaces for browsing, memory, messaging, scheduling, skills, and subagents. ClawProBench defines two tracks: a 102-scenario full profile with live workspace and native-runtime routing tasks, and a frozen 68-scenario holdout with closed-world JSON output contracts for robust ranking. Trials are scored from execution traces via a safety-gated formula combining correctness, process quality, and efficiency, preserving failure evidence for audit. Our anonymous artifact includes benchmark definitions, scoring code, manifests and sanitized traces. We evaluate 68 configurations on the full profile and 37 on holdout. The top safety-gated average trace score is 0.7671. Native-runtime tasks underperform workspace-live tasks (0.5238 vs. 0.6415). On holdout, pass@k-any outperforms strict three-trial pass (0.6638 vs. 0.2890), while full-profile and holdout rankings show weak alignment (Spearman 0.1300). Rankings based purely on correctness differ substantially from process-aware, safety-gated and strict-pass views. Final-answer leaderboards may hide native-surface weaknesses, one-off successes and trace-local agent failure modes.

AI.tldr: ClawProBench是一个基于OpenClaw实时智能体运行时的trace感知基准测试框架，包含102场景全配置和68场景冻结测试集，通过安全门控的trace评分公式评估智能体的正确性、过程质量和效率，揭示最终答案排行榜无法捕捉的运行时缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准测试往往仅评估最终答案，忽视了智能体运行在有状态运行时（stateful runtime）上的事实。这种做法对评估对象的定义不够精确——正确的评估单元应为"模型+运行时配置"的组合，其失败可能发生在证据获取、运行时路由、安全边界或重复执行等环节。
AI.method: 在OpenClaw实时智能体运行时上实例化ClawProBench。定义两个测试轨道：102场景完整配置（含实时工作区和原生运行时路由任务）和68场景冻结测试集（封闭世界JSON输出契约）。通过安全门控公式从执行trace中评分，综合正确性、过程质量和效率，并保留失败证据供审计。
AI.result: 评估68个配置（完整配置）和37个配置（冻结集）。最佳安全门控平均trace分数为0.7671。原生运行时任务表现低于工作区实时任务（0.5238 vs 0.6415）。冻结集上pass@k-any优于严格三试通过（0.6638 vs 0.2890），但完整配置与冻结集排名弱对齐（Spearman 0.1300）。纯正确性排名与过程感知、安全门控及严格通过视图存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 仅看最终答案的排行榜会掩盖原生表面弱点、一次性成功和trace局部智能体失败模式。智能体评估应采用trace感知、过程感知的方式，以"模型+运行时配置"为评估单元，综合考虑安全门控下的正确性、过程质量与效率。

title: Pre-Decoding Acoustic Triage for Budgeted Vision-Language Captioning of Untrimmed Egocentric Video
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Under review at IEEE BigData 2026, Industrial and Government Track. Code: https://github.com/masjalayer/PreDecoding-AcousticTriage
summary: Automatically analyzing hours-long egocentric video is increasingly essential for progress monitoring, quality control, and safety in logistics, construction, and manufacturing. Yet current pipelines that process short, fixed-size windows with a vision-language model (VLM) are prohibitively expensive because cost scales with the number of model calls. To reduce this cost, prior work proposes triage policies to select which windows merit a VLM invocation. However, these policies either sample uniformly or rank windows using visual features, which ironically requires the video decoding that the budget constraints are meant to avoid. We propose audio-first triage: select windows using the lightest modality, scored before any video frame is decoded, so the approach composes naturally with token compression or quantization. The novelty lies in the objective, not the representation: rather than a per-frame sound-event detector, we train the selector to trigger once per action. This objective shift improves action coverage by 4.0-10.8 percentage points across all evaluated call rates, using frozen AudioSet-pretrained features without domain-specific sound-event labels. Using fewer than half of the available calls, the triage cuts 9-20% of VLM calls at matched coverage on EPIC-KITCHENS-100 (EK-100), surpasses uniform sampling through the mid-range on Ego4D over 247 clips, and outperforms two recent visual keyframe selectors. Code, the reference implementation and every results file this manuscript reads are at https://github.com/masjalayer/PreDecoding-AcousticTriage.

AI.tldr: 提出了音频优先分流（audio-first triage）方法，在解码任何视频帧之前，仅使用音频特征来选择需要调用视觉语言模型（VLM）的窗口，从而降低长时间沉浸式视频分析的推理成本。核心创新在于训练目标：不是逐帧声音事件检测，而是每次动作触发一次选择，显著提升了动作覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 长时间沉浸式视频分析（如进度监控、质量控制、安全监测）需要处理数小时视频，现有基于VLM的流水线成本随模型调用次数线性增长，过于昂贵。虽然已有triage策略尝试减少VLM调用，但要么均匀采样效果差，要么依赖视觉特征排序，反而需要昂贵的视频解码，违背了节省成本的初衷。
AI.method: 提出音频优先分流方法：1）使用最轻量的音频模态，在视频帧解码之前进行窗口打分/选择；2）与token压缩或量化自然兼容；3）关键创新在训练目标而非表示——不训练逐帧声音事件检测器，而是训练选择器每次动作触发一次；4）使用冻结的AudioSet预训练特征，无需领域特定的声音事件标签。
AI.result: 1）在所有评估的调用率下，相比基线将动作覆盖率提升4.0-10.8个百分点；2）在EPIC-KITCHENS-100上，用不到一半的可用调用，在匹配覆盖率下削减9-20%的VLM调用；3）在Ego4D的247个片段中，在中段范围内超越均匀采样；4）优于两种近期的视觉关键帧选择器。
AI.conclusion: 音频优先分流是一种高效且实用的降低VLM调用成本的方案，其目标导向的训练方式（每动作触发一次）比传统逐帧检测更有效，证明了"轻模态优先+目标优化"在长时间视频分析中的巨大潜力。

title: HANSARD: A Reference Architecture for Forensic Readiness, Runtime Witnessing, and Graded Attribution in Autonomous Multi-Agent AI Systems
summary: Autonomous multi-agent systems nowadays act in finance, software supply chains, and security operations. Already, the first largely AI-orchestrated intrusion campaigns have been reported. Yet, when such a system causes harm, no method can robustly establish what happened, what caused it, or who is accountable. This is because provenance forensics works at the wrong abstraction, formal causality assumes the causal model, and agent auditing trusts self-recording. The target failure mode is, thus, attribution laundering, i.e., spreading an act across redundant agents until none is a but-for cause. Worse, the record is produced by the suspects, which comprises the assumption adopted throughout this work. Agents may therefore anticipate the investigation and the part of logging infrastructure may itself collude. In this paper, HANSARD is proposed, a reference architecture treating accountability as a life-cycle property. First, a readiness profile sealed before operation bounds what later findings may claim. Second, capturing at five choke points beyond the agents' reach makes omissions detectable, not only tampering. Third, a typed PROV-DM-aligned causal graph accrues as the system runs, and three indicators read it live to gate oversight without adjudicating. Fourth, post-incident replay yields contingent effects under the modified Halpern-Pearl definition, together with a compensation-set size. Finally, a synergy residual measures harm due to the combination rather than to individuals, making laundering visible. Cause, responsibility and accountability are then reported separately, each capped by an evidentiary tier, while a future research agenda is also provided.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HANSARD参考架构，将问责制视为生命周期属性，通过运行前密封就绪档案、代理不可触达的五个扼流点捕获、类型化因果图、修改后的Halpern-Pearl因果定义的事后重放以及协同残差度量，来解决多智能体系统中"归因洗白"（attribution laundering）问题——即行为分散在冗余代理中导致无人成为but-for原因，同时假设日志记录本身可能被嫌疑方操纵。
AI.motivation: 自主多智能体系统已应用于金融、软件供应链和安全运营等领域，甚至已出现AI编排的攻击活动，但当前方法无法稳健地建立发生了什么、原因是什么或谁应负责。现有方法的三个缺陷：溯源取证工作于错误抽象层次、形式因果关系假设因果模型已知、代理审计信任自我记录。核心目标失效模式是归因洗白，且记录由嫌疑人产生，日志基础设施本身可能串通。
AI.method: 提出HANSARD参考架构，包含五个部分：(1) 运行前密封的就绪档案，约束后续发现可声明的范围；(2) 在代理不可触及的五个扼流点捕获数据，使遗漏（而非仅篡改）可被检测；(3) 类型化PROV-DM对齐因果图在运行中累积，通过三个指标实时门控监督；(4) 事后重放基于修改后的Halpern-Pearl定义产生条件效应及补偿集大小；(5) 协同残差度量衡量因组合而非个体造成的伤害，使洗白可见。最终将原因、责任和问责分开报告，各由证据层级封顶。
AI.result: 该架构能够使归因洗白可见，区分个体伤害与协同伤害，分离报告原因、责任和问责，并通过证据层级进行限定。基于修改的Halpern-Pearl定义和补偿集大小量化责任，同时协同残差使组合效应导致的伤害可见。
AI.conclusion: HANSARD是首个将问责制视为生命周期属性而非事后活动的参考架构，在日志基础设施可能串通的假设下仍能工作，并提供了未来研究议程。

title: When Do VLMs Help Arabic Manuscript OCR? A Cross-Dataset Study
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly being used for document understanding, yet their role in Arabic and Islamic manuscript recognition remains underexplored. To address such a gap in this paper, we evaluate traditional OCR, general-purpose VLMs, Arabic-specialized VLMs, and OCR-conditioned VLM correction across eight Arabic text datasets spanning historical manuscripts, aged printed books, clean print, multi-domain documents, and handwriting. The results show that no single approach dominates across setups. On line-level historical manuscripts, VLMs are close to Tesseract; on page-level manuscript images, they perform better; and in several settings, an OCR-conditioned corrector improves over both standalone OCR and standalone VLMs. The central finding is an OCR-prior recoverability principle: OCR conditioning helps when the OCR output remains visually and textually recoverable, providing anchors that the VLM can refine against the image. It improves recognition on aged print, clean print, mixed-domain Arabic, and some Naskh manuscripts, but degrades performance when the prior is script-mismatched or systematically misleading, as in Maghribi manuscripts and realistic student handwriting. Additional diagnostics show that Arabic VLM-OCR is sensitive to diacritics, preprocessing, generation budget, and repetition loops. These findings support an adaptive OCR-VLM workflow that routes pages according to script, OCR-prior recoverability, length diagnostics, and failure-mode indicators.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了传统OCR、通用VLM、阿拉伯语专用VLM以及OCR条件VLM纠正在八个阿拉伯语文本数据集上的表现，涵盖历史手稿、旧版印刷书、清晰印刷、多领域文档和手写体。核心发现是"OCR先验可恢复性原理"：当OCR输出在视觉和文本上可恢复时，OCR条件纠正能提升识别效果；当先验与脚本不匹配或系统性误导时则性能下降。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）越来越多地用于文档理解，但它们在阿拉伯语和伊斯兰手稿识别中的作用尚未被充分探索。现有研究缺乏对这一特定领域VLM能力的系统评估，存在明显的研究空白。
AI.method: 对八种阿拉伯语文本数据集（涵盖历史手稿、旧版印刷书、清晰印刷、多领域文档和手写体）进行评估，比较四类方法：传统OCR、通用VLM、阿拉伯语专用VLM、以及OCR条件VLM纠正。同时进行附加诊断实验，考察变音符、预处理、生成预算和重复循环等因素的影响。
AI.result: 没有单一方法在所有设置中占优。行级历史手稿上VLM接近Tesseract；页级手稿图像上VLM表现更好；多种场景下OCR条件纠正优于单独的OCR和单独VLM。OCR条件纠正提升了旧版印刷、清晰印刷、混合领域阿拉伯语和部分Naskh手稿的识别，但在Maghribi手稿和真实学生手写体中性能下降。VLM-OCR对变音符、预处理、生成预算和重复循环敏感。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持一个自适应的OCR-VLM工作流，根据脚本类型、OCR先验可恢复性、长度诊断和失败模式指标对页面进行路由选择，以实现阿拉伯语和伊斯兰手稿的更优识别。

title: CONTRAMEM: Learning Self-Evolving Procedural Memory from Contrasting Multi-Model Trajectories
summary: Autonomous computer-use agents are increasingly applied to long-horizon tasks requiring coordinated application calls, persistent state tracking, and verifier-sensitive writes, yet they remain prone to procedural failures: misreading application state, tool semantics, or task progress. Procedural memory promises more consistent decisions and less redundant exploration, but constructing high-quality memory without model training remains challenging. We introduce CONTRAMEM, a source-flexible, training-free framework for self-evolving procedural memory that treats same-task outcome variation as supervision: differences in correctness, efficiency, recovery, and failure modes expose outcome-relevant procedural distinctions, distilled into a compact bank of app-level Function Cards and task-level Skill Cards that evolves through localized curation rather than append-only accumulation or whole-bank rewriting. On held-out GAIA2/ARE computer-use tasks, CONTRAMEM more than doubles the success rate across the three source-model targets (26.2% to 55.3%), with consistent per-model gains (GPT-5.5: 27.5 to 61.0; Claude Sonnet 4.6: 28.0 to 52.5; DeepSeek V4 Pro: 23.0 to 52.5). The same bank transfers unchanged to the unseen Qwen3.7 Plus (18.5 to 35.5), indicating transferable procedural knowledge rather than model-specific behavior. The same construction carries over unchanged to AppWorld, beating both no memory and its own single-source self-memory variant for all three mid-tier agents on both public test splits. Under a matched trajectory budget, heterogeneous multi-model trajectories yield stronger memory than self- or same-model multi-rollout memory: the margin comes from contrastive behavioral diversity, not stronger source agents or more sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CONTRAMEM，一个无需训练、源灵活的框架，通过将同任务不同结果的变化作为监督信号，构建自我演进的程序性记忆（包括应用级Function Cards和任务级Skill Cards），在GAIA2/ARE和AppWorld基准上显著提升计算机使用智能体的成功率，并证明异构多模型轨迹带来的对比行为多样性比更强的源模型或更多采样更有效。
AI.motivation: 自主计算机使用智能体在长时程任务中容易产生程序性错误（误读应用状态、工具语义或任务进度）。程序性记忆有望带来更一致的决策和更少的冗余探索，但在不进行模型训练的情况下构建高质量记忆仍具挑战性。
AI.method: CONTRAMEM将同任务的结果差异视为监督信号：正确性、效率、恢复能力和失败模式的差异揭示了与结果相关的程序性差异，并被蒸馏为紧凑的、应用级Function Cards和任务级Skill Cards记忆库。记忆通过局部策展（localized curation）演进，而非仅追加式累积或整体重写。
AI.result: 在GAIA2/ARE任务上，CONTRAMEM将三个源模型目标的成功率从26.2%提升至55.3%（翻倍以上），各模型均有提升（GPT-5.5: 27.5→61.0；Claude Sonnet 4.6: 28.0→52.5；DeepSeek V4 Pro: 23.0→52.5）。同一记忆库迁移到未见过的Qwen3.7 Plus也有提升（18.5→35.5）。在AppWorld上也一致优于无记忆和单源自记忆变体。在匹配轨迹预算下，异构多模型轨迹产生的记忆优于自模型或多rollout记忆。
AI.conclusion: CONTRAMEM证明无需训练即可构建可迁移、可演进的程序性记忆，其有效性源自对比性行为多样性而非源模型强度或采样数量，为计算机使用智能体的长时程任务能力提升提供了可行的记忆蒸馏路径。

title: DiD It in 87 Minutes: A Label-Free Softmax-to-Linear Adaptation of Vision Transformers for Object Detection
summary: While linear attention is a compelling mechanism for high-resolution object detection due to its reduced cost for global token mixing, converting the Softmax-attention ViT backbone of a trained detector into a linear-attention one is not a trivial drop-in replacement. Directly swapping the attention operator leads to severe performance degradation, and generic label-free distillation, though effective for classification, often fails on detection tasks. We argue that the central challenge is \textit{detector-interface preservation}: the converted backbone must reproduce the exact feature tensors expected by the fixed downstream detector, rather than merely imitating internal Softmax hidden states. To address this, we introduce Detector-Interface Distillation (DiD), a label-free conversion method that exclusively trains the linear-attention backbone by aligning detector-facing interface tensors with those of a frozen Softmax teacher. On DOTA-v1.5, DiD substantially outperforms established baselines and matches supervised, fully trained linear models. Adaptation completes in roughly 87 minutes on 4 GPUs, and the linearized backbone cuts inference latency by ~62% and peak memory by ~49%. We hope our findings offer the community a simple, label-free route to reusing trained Softmax detectors as efficient linear ones, and encourage interface-aware objectives in future architecture-conversion work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Detector-Interface Distillation (DiD)，一种无标签蒸馏方法，通过仅对齐检测器接口特征张量（而非内部隐藏状态），将已训练的 Softmax 注意力检测器骨干转换成线性注意力骨干，在 DOTA-v1.5 上超越基线并匹配全监督线性模型，推理延迟降低约 62%，峰值内存降低约 49%。
AI.motivation: 线性注意力虽因其低成本的全局 token 混合机制对高分辨率目标检测极具吸引力，但将训练好的检测器中 Softmax-attention ViT 骨干直接替换为线性注意力并非简单的替代操作，会导致严重性能退化；而通用的无标签蒸馏对分类有效，却常难以适用于检测任务。核心挑战在于"检测器接口保持"：转换后的骨干必须复现固定下游检测器所期望的精确特征张量，而非仅仅模仿内部 Softmax 隐藏状态。
AI.method: 提出 Detector-Interface Distillation (DiD)，一种无标签转换方法，专门训练线性注意力骨干，通过将检测器面对的接口张量与冻结的 Softmax 教师模型对齐来实现蒸馏，不依赖任何标签数据。
AI.result: 在 DOTA-v1.5 上，DiD 大幅超越已有基线方法，并达到与全监督完全训练的线性模型相当的性能。转换过程在 4 块 GPU 上约 87 分钟完成，线性化骨干将推理延迟降低约 62%，峰值内存降低约 49%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为社区提供了一种简单、无标签的途径，将训练好的 Softmax 检测器复用为高效的线性检测器，并鼓励未来架构转换工作中采用接口感知的目标函数。

title: STAGE: Stateful Translation to Agentic Graph Execution with Policy-Scoped Context and Deterministic Control
summary: Policy-governed agents must interpret case evidence while following an authorized procedure. We present \textsc{Stage}, an executable-graph framework that confines model judgment to policy-scoped nodes while placing procedural control in deterministic code. At each node, the model receives task-relevant policy context and returns a typed result, while the coordinator enforces the reviewed execution contract. We evaluate \textsc{Stage} on SOP-Bench Referral Abuse, two $τ^2$-bench domains, and Smart Dispute, a proprietary banking benchmark. Compared with monolithic full-policy execution, \textsc{Stage} generally improves task success and repeated-run reliability across workflows of varying procedural complexity. The largest gains occur on the deeper Telecom and Smart Dispute workflows, where $\mathrm{Pass}^3$ increases by 7.5--55.0 and 57.2--65.7 percentage points, respectively, depending on the model. These results show that combining policy-scoped context with deterministic procedural control can improve the reliability of policy execution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Stage框架，一个可执行图谱框架，将模型判断限制在策略范围内的节点上，同时将程序性控制交给确定性代码。在多个基准测试上，与单片全策略执行相比，Stage在任务成功率和重复运行可靠性方面普遍有所提升，尤其在深层工作流上提升显著。
AI.motivation: 策略约束的智能体需要解读案例证据并遵循授权程序，但传统单片全策略执行方式在程序性控制和模型判断之间缺乏清晰边界，导致在复杂工作流中可靠性不足。
AI.method: Stage采用可执行图谱框架，将模型判断限制在策略范围内的节点上（每个节点模型接收任务相关策略上下文并返回类型化结果），而将程序性控制交由确定性代码协调器执行，强制遵循审查过的执行契约。
AI.result: 在SOP-Bench Referral Abuse、两个τ²-bench域以及专有银行基准Smart Dispute上评估，Stage相比单片全策略执行普遍提升任务成功率和重复运行可靠性。在较深的Telecom和Smart Dispute工作流中Pass³分别提升7.5-55.0和57.2-65.7个百分点（取决于模型）。
AI.conclusion: 将策略范围内的上下文与确定性程序控制相结合，可以提高策略执行的可靠性，特别是在程序复杂度较高的工作流中收益最大。

title: LiST: Local-Simplex Test-Time LoRA Fusion
summary: Task-specific LoRA adapters offer a modular way to specialize large language and vision-language models. However, existing adapter composition methods are mostly static and cannot adapt to individual test inputs. To address these issues, we propose \textbf{LiST}, a label-free test-time LoRA fusion framework that converts an existing LoRA bank into a target-conditioned local simplex and searches sample-specific fusion weights at inference time. LiST builds joint task representations from LoRA parameter anchors and prompt-level behavior vectors, retrieves neighboring adapters as a local search space, and performs branch-preserving fusion without updating the backbone or adapters. Candidate weights are selected by a prompt-level energy with prior, geometric, and stochastic-consistency constraints, and are deployed only when they pass a safe acceptance rule. Otherwise, LiST falls back to a target-conditioned prior. Experiments on multimodal and language benchmarks show that LiST outperforms static LoRA merging and conventional test-time adaptation baselines, while preserving task-specific adapter utility and improving robustness on unseen tasks.

AI.tldr: LiST是一个无标签的测试时LoRA融合框架，将LoRA银行转化为目标条件下的局部单纯形，在推理时搜索样本特定的融合权重，无需更新主干网络或适配器即可实现动态适配。
AI.motivation: 现有LoRA适配器组合方法大多是静态的，无法根据单个测试输入进行自适应调整，缺乏对个体样本的灵活性和鲁棒性。
AI.method: LiST将LoRA银行转换为目标条件下的局部单纯形；构建由LoRA参数锚点和提示级行为向量组成的联合任务表示；检索邻近适配器作为局部搜索空间；采用无分支融合；通过带有先验、几何和随机一致性约束的提示级能量选择候选权重；仅当通过安全接受规则时才部署，否则回退到目标条件先验。
AI.result: 在多模态和语言基准上，LiST优于静态LoRA合并和传统测试时自适应基线，同时保持任务特定适配器的效用，并提高在未见任务上的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: LiST通过测试时的动态LoRA融合，实现了比静态方法更强的输入自适应能力，为LoRA适配器组合提供了更灵活、更具鲁棒性的解决方案。

title: Scaling Curriculum Learning For Autonomous Driving
comment: 31 pages, 18 figures. Under review at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Batched simulators for autonomous driving have recently enabled training reinforcement learning (RL) agents at scale, encompassing thousands of traffic scenarios and billions of interactions within a matter of days. Although such high-throughput feeds RL algorithms faster than ever, their sample-efficiency has not kept pace: As the standard training scheme, domain randomization uniformly samples scenarios, thereby consuming a vast number of interactions on cases that contribute little to learning. Curriculum learning offers a remedy by adaptively prioritizing scenarios that matter most to policy improvement. We present CL4AD, the first integration of curriculum learning into batched autonomous driving simulators by framing scenario selection as an unsupervised environment design problem. We introduce utility functions that shape curricula based on success rates and the realism of the agent's behavior, in addition to existing regret-estimation functions. Large-scale experiments in GPUDRIVE demonstrate that curriculum learning achieves a 99% success rate a billion steps earlier than domain randomization, reducing wall-clock time by 77%, and outperforms heuristic curricula with static and dynamic attributes, with only one exception at the largest scale. An ablation under limited compute shows that curriculum learning improves sample efficiency by 67%. We also investigate how utility functions behave at scale, and how prioritized scenarios evolve during training. We release an implementation of CLForAD in GPUDRIVE.

AI.tldr: CL4AD是首个将课程学习集成到批量式自动驾驶模拟器中的方法，通过将场景选择建模为无监督环境设计问题，并引入基于成功率和行为真实性的效用函数，在GPUDRIVE中实现了比域随机化提前10亿步达到99%成功率，减少77%墙钟时间，并提升67%样本效率。
AI.motivation: 批量式自动驾驶模拟器虽能大规模训练强化学习智能体，但域随机化均匀采样场景导致样本效率低下，大量交互浪费在收益甚微的案例上，急需自适应的课程学习来优先选择对策略提升最有价值的场景。
AI.method: 将场景选择形式化为无监督环境设计问题，引入基于成功率、行为真实性和现有遗憾估计的效用函数来塑造课程，并将其集成到批量式自动驾驶模拟器中。
AI.result: 在GPUDRIVE大规模实验中，课程学习比域随机化提前10亿步达到99%成功率，墙钟时间减少77%；在有限计算下样本效率提升67%，并优于静态和动态属性的启发式课程（仅在大规模下有一例例外）。
AI.conclusion: 课程学习能显著提升批量式自动驾驶模拟器中RL训练的样本效率和收敛速度，效用函数在高规模下行为值得深入研究，研究团队已开源实现。

title: M$^3$ISR: A Multi-Modal Multi-View Benchmark for 3D/4D Gaussian Splatting and Feedforward Compression
summary: High-fidelity free-viewpoint video (FVV) and interactive rendering increasingly rely on explicit Gaussian representations, yet practical deployment remains constrained by representation size, dynamic updates, and computational cost. Existing multi-view video benchmarks provide valuable real-captured content, but they make it difficult to isolate the effects of controlled camera geometry, representation efficiency, and temporal redundancy. We introduce M$^3$ISR, a controlled synthetic benchmark for 3D and 4D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS/4DGS). The benchmark contains 25 scenes from five indoor and outdoor scene groups, two camera/motion configurations, six synchronized 1080p views, and dense ground-truth annotations including RGB, camera parameters, depth, semantic and instance segmentation, and static--dynamic masks. The shared-center camera design intentionally isolates angular view variation and enables controlled evaluation of novel-view synthesis and representation efficiency. We organize M$^3$ISR into five complementary tracks covering 3DGS synthesis, 4DGS synthesis, 4DGS streaming, 3DGS compression, and 4DGS compression. Representative baseline results show small differences in static reconstruction quality but substantial differences in representation storage, while the evaluated streaming methods exhibit substantially higher reported training or reconstruction cost than the corresponding offline dynamic reconstruction baselines. We further define feedforward compression tasks for 3DGS and 4DGS and provide reference rate--distortion formulations and preliminary baseline evaluations. The benchmark is intended as a controlled and complementary testbed for systematic study of Gaussian-based FVV reconstruction, compression, and streaming.

AI.tldr: 本文提出M³ISR，一个用于3D和4D高斯泼溅（3DGS/4DGS）的受控合成基准，包含25个室内外场景、两种相机/运动配置、六路同步1080p视图以及密集的真值标注（RGB、深度、语义/实例分割、静态-动态掩码）。基准设计了五个互补赛道（3DGS合成、4DGS合成、4DGS流式传输、3DGS压缩、4DGS压缩），并提供基准评估结果，旨在为基于高斯的自由视角视频重建、压缩和流式传输提供可控且互补的系统性测试平台。
AI.motivation: 现有自由视角视频（FVV）与交互式渲染越来越依赖显式高斯表示，但实际部署受限于表示大小、动态更新和计算成本。已有的多视图视频基准提供真实采集内容，却难以隔离受控相机几何、表示效率和时间冗余等因素的影响，因此需要一个受控的合成基准来系统性地评估这些因素。
AI.method: 构建M³ISR受控合成基准：包含25个场景（来自5组室内外场景）、2种相机/运动配置、6个同步1080p视图，以及稠密真值标注（RGB、相机参数、深度、语义和实例分割、静态-动态掩码）。采用共享中心相机设计以隔离角度视角变化，组织为五个互补赛道（3DGS合成、4DGS合成、4DGS流式传输、3DGS压缩、4DGS压缩），并定义前馈压缩任务及参考率-失真公式。
AI.result: 基线结果显示：静态重建质量在不同方法间差异较小，但表示存储量差异显著；评估的流式传输方法相比对应的离线动态重建基线，在训练或重建成本上明显更高。同时提供了参考率-失真公式和初步基线评估。
AI.conclusion: M³ISR作为受控且互补的测试平台，能够系统性地研究基于高斯的自由视角视频重建、压缩与流式传输，弥补了现有基准在可控性方面的不足，为3DGS/4DGS的实际部署研究提供了坚实的基础。

title: ExecRubrics: Executable Tool-Augmented Rubrics for Verifiable and Efficient Long-Form Evaluation
summary: Rubrics aim to make language-model evaluation transparent by decomposing response quality into interpretable criteria. However, natural-language rubrics are often ambiguous, require black-box LLM judges, and typically assume criteria aggregate independently through linear weighted sums, limiting their ability to capture dependencies, alternatives, penalties, and override conditions. We propose ExecRubrics, a framework for representing rubrics as compact executable programs. ExecRubrics encodes evaluation logic as verifiable Python scoring functions, giving natural-language rubric intent an operational semantics: a fixed decision procedure that can be inspected, executed, and edited. On three long-form response benchmarks-HealthBench, HelpSteer, and ArgQuality-we show that ExecRubrics can substitute for expensive black-box judges in ranking preferred over dispreferred responses, matching or improving NL rubric baselines with best preference accuracies of 53%, 78%, and 92%, respectively, while reducing evaluation latency by up to 320 times. We show that incorporating external logic and resources from text processing libraries such as NLTK and spaCy further improves preference accuracy. Our results suggest a novel way of looking at evaluation, by offering a faster, more explainable, and less ambiguous alternative to black-box rubric evaluation, particularly in high-stakes domains such as healthcare and banking where precision and auditability are critical.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ExecRubrics框架，将自然语言评估标准（rubrics）表示为可执行的Python评分程序，为评估逻辑提供可检查、可执行、可编辑的确定性决策程序。在三个长文本响应基准（HealthBench、HelpSteer、ArgQuality）上，ExecRubrics在偏好排序任务中匹配或超越自然语言rubrics基线（最佳准确率分别为53%、78%、92%），并将评估延迟降低最多320倍。
AI.motivation: 现有自然语言rubrics存在三个局限：一是歧义性问题，自然语言标准含糊不清；二是依赖不透明的黑盒LLM裁判；三是通常假设标准以线性加权独立聚合，无法捕捉依赖关系、替代方案、惩罚条件和覆盖条件等复杂评估逻辑。
AI.method: ExecRubrics将rubrics编码为紧凑的Python评分函数，为自然语言的rubric意图赋予操作语义——一种固定的决策程序，可以被检查、执行和编辑。该方法还支持整合外部逻辑和资源，例如NLTK和spaCy等文本处理库的功能。
AI.result: 在HealthBench、HelpSteer和ArgQuality三个基准上，ExecRubrics在偏好排序中匹配或改进自然语言rubric基线，最佳偏好准确率分别达到53%、78%和92%，同时将评估延迟降低最多320倍。整合外部文本处理库（NLTK、spaCy）可进一步提升偏好准确率。
AI.conclusion: ExecRubrics提供了一种新颖的评估视角，相比黑盒rubric评估，它更快、更可解释、歧义更少，尤其适用于医疗、银行等对精确性和可审计性要求极高的高风险领域。

title: HeatTok: Enhancing Remote Sensing Image Understanding via Thermodiffusion-based Tokenization
comment: 19 pages (10 pages main text + appendix), 10 figures. Accepted at the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026), Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, November 10--14, 2026
summary: Current visual tokenizers in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) predominantly rely on patch-based partitioning, which causes severe semantic mixture and object fragmentation in remote sensing imagery due to the irregular contours of geo-objects. Moreover, existing adaptive methods struggle to extract precise object-level tokens and lack dedicated geometric positional encodings for irregular regions. In this paper, we propose HeatTok, a semantic-aware tokenizer driven by thermodiffusion aggregation. Inspired by the physical principles of heat conduction, HeatTok adaptively merges adjacent homogeneous regions to generate semantically independent, object-aligned irregular tokens. To enable MLLMs to perceive these irregular shapes, we design the Gaussian Multimodal Rotary Positional Embedding (G-MRoPE), which models token spatial distributions via 2D Gaussians and explicitly injects center, scale, and orientation cues. Extensive evaluations on the VRSBench and EarthVQA datasets demonstrate that HeatTok effectively preserves object-level semantic integrity and achieves state-of-the-art performance under a reasonable token budget. The code is available: https://github.com/YingyingYan1/HeatTok.

AI.tldr: HeatTok是一种面向遥感图像的新型语义感知视觉分词器，基于热扩散聚合原理，将相邻同质区域自适应合并为语义独立、与目标对齐的不规则token，并设计了G-MRoPE位置编码以感知不规则形状，在VRSBench和EarthVQA数据集上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM视觉分词器主要依赖基于patch的划分方式，在遥感图像中由于地物轮廓不规则，会导致严重的语义混合和对象碎片化问题。此外，现有的自适应方法难以提取精确的对象级token，且缺乏针对不规则区域的几何位置编码。
AI.method: 1) 提出HeatTok分词器，受热传导物理原理启发，通过热扩散聚合自适应合并相邻同质区域，生成语义独立、对象对齐的不规则token。2) 设计Gaussian Multimodal Rotary Positional Embedding (G-MRoPE)，利用2D高斯分布建模token空间分布，显式注入中心、尺度和方向线索。
AI.result: 在VRSBench和EarthVQA数据集上的广泛实验表明，HeatTok有效保留了对象级语义完整性，并在合理的token预算下取得了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: HeatTok通过热扩散聚合实现了遥感图像中语义感知的不规则token生成，配合G-MRoPE位置编码，显著提升了MLLM对遥感地物对象的理解和生成能力。

title: CausalCache: Conditional High-Fidelity Restoration for Long-Horizon GUI Agents
summary: Long-horizon GUI agents can retain a complete interaction trace cheaply as textual action records, but expose only a few past events to the policy in high-fidelity pixels. We formulate this as conditional fidelity restoration: each event persists in summary-only form and is linked to an archived screenshot, while an active visual-context budget $B$ limits how many events may be promoted to summary-plus-image form. Recent-$B$ spends every slot on the latest events. CausalCache instead reallocates the same $B$ promotions over the complete trace, evicting a recent image only when a distant event has higher conditional marginal utility. Its history-gated key/value (HGKV) adapter modifies only restored history-image tokens and is exactly bypassed with no history image. Matched-budget replacement groups and per-arm-anchored difference-in-differences supervision make uniform history amplification worth zero; a budget-aware selector then chooses which summarized events to restore. On desktop, the frozen policy shows no reliable preference for a task-relevant archived screenshot over the recent frame it would displace; HGKV learns exactly that selectivity inside a pre-specified drift envelope. On OSWorld-Verified, restoring history to high fidelity is worth about $13$ success points over summary-only memory, while same-budget allocations remain indistinguishable. Zero-shot on a cross-application mobile benchmark, CausalCache significantly improves overall success over the same-budget recent allocation ($+3.7$ points on the full roster), and the gain concentrates where it should: $+8.6$ points on the memory-critical split fixed by benchmark metadata at construction, no detectable effect on matched controls, and a significant split-by-method interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CausalCache方法，在长时序GUI代理中，通过因果推断在有限的视觉上下文预算内智能分配历史事件的图像恢复，显著提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 长时序GUI代理可以廉价地以文本形式保存完整交互轨迹，但只能以高保真像素形式向策略暴露少数过去事件。作者希望解决如何在有限的视觉上下文预算下，最优地选择哪些历史事件需要被恢复为高保真图像的问题。
AI.method: 提出条件保真恢复框架：事件以摘要形式持久化并链接到存档截图，视觉上下文预算B限制可提升为摘要+图像形式的事件数量。CausalCache将预算从最近的B个事件重新分配到完整轨迹中，仅当远处事件的边际效用更高时才会驱逐近期图像。核心组件包括：(1) 历史门控键值(HGKV)适配器，仅修改恢复的历史图像token；(2) 匹配预算的替换组和每臂锚定的差异-差异监督，使均匀历史放大效应为零；(3) 预算感知选择器决定恢复哪些摘要事件。
AI.result: 在桌面端，冻结策略对任务相关的历史截图与近期帧无明显偏好；HGKV在预设漂移包络内学习选择性。在OSWorld-Verified上，恢复历史图像相比纯摘要记忆提升约13个成功点，而同预算分配方案无显著差异。在跨应用移动基准的零样本测试中，CausalCache相比同预算近期分配显著提升总体成功率(+3.7点)，其中记忆关键子集提升+8.6点，对照组无显著影响，交互效应显著。
AI.conclusion: CausalCache通过因果导向的预算再分配，能够在有限的视觉上下文预算下更有效地恢复对任务真正重要的历史事件图像，从而提升长时序GUI代理的性能，并验证了效果集中在记忆关键场景。

title: Learning Sample-wise Rank-aware Interpolation Weights for Composed Visual Data Retrieval
summary: At the heart of composed visual data retrieval is the fusion of a reference visual input and a textual modification into a single query. While current state-of-the-art methods utilize multimodal large language models for this fusion, their complexity introduces prohibitive querytime latency, limiting their scalability. We instead revisit the efficacy of simple linear interpolation within an embedding space, and introduce SRAIN, the first framework that dynamically predicts query-specific interpolation weights. The key challenge lies in the fact that the quality of an interpolation weight should be measured by the interpolated embedding's discriminability from negatives as well as its proximity to true targets; this makes collecting and predicting optimal weights intractable. We overcome this bottleneck through two key innovations: batch-wise rank-aware weight estimation during training, and a compact memory bank that synthesizes hard negatives during inference. SRAIN achieves the best in composed video retrieval and matches the current state of the art in composed image retrieval, all while substantially reducing querytime latency compared to MLLM-based alternatives.

AI.tldr: SRAIN是一个用于组合视觉检索的框架，通过动态预测查询特定的线性插值权重，取代了复杂的多模态大语言模型，在保持最佳性能的同时大幅降低查询延迟。
AI.motivation: 当前最先进的组合视觉数据检索方法依赖于多模态大语言模型进行参考视觉输入和文本修改的融合，虽然效果好但引入了不可接受的查询延迟，限制了其可扩展性。作者希望探索更轻量级的替代方案。
AI.method: SRAIN框架包含两个关键创新：(1) 训练期间的批量级排序感知权重估计（batch-wise rank-aware weight estimation），用于学习预测最优插值权重；(2) 一个紧凑的记忆库（memory bank），在推理期间合成难负样本。其核心思想是权重质量应由插值嵌入对负样本的判别力及其与真实目标的接近度来衡量。
AI.result: SRAIN在组合视频检索中达到最佳性能，在组合图像检索中与当前最先进方法持平，同时相比基于MLLM的方法大幅降低了查询延迟。
AI.conclusion: 简单的线性插值配合动态预测的查询特定权重，可以有效替代复杂的大语言模型方法，在保持检索性能的同时实现更高的可扩展性和效率。

title: Weakly supervised concept Bottleneck Learning for Robust Two stage Object centric visual reasoning
summary: Two-stage neuro-symbolic architectures provide an elegant paradigm for visual problem solving by cleanly separating connectionist perception of predefined symbols from possibly later defined relational reasoning thereon. However, anchoring high-level predicates into visual frames typically necessitates annotations that are expensive to acquire. In this work, we introduce the Dynamic Orthogonal Concept Bottleneck (D-OCB), an object-centric slot- VAE framework designed to extract human-aligned symbolic predicates under extremely weak supervision. D-OCB eliminates the arduous manual tuning of loss-balancing coef- ficients by dynamically learning optimal hyperparameter allocations during training. To infuse prior knowledge on independence of concept categories, in addition to standard re- construction self-supervision we penalize correlation across concept subspaces. Crucially, to combat the instability of very low supervision regimes, D-OCB incorporates a dynamic di- mensionality allocation mechanism; this adaptive formulation allows well-represented con- cepts to yield latent dimensions to underperforming concepts that are lagging behind, effectively preventing representation collapse and significantly improving overall concept accuracy. Through an extensive empirical evaluation, we demonstrate that our framework achieves high concept alignment and downstream visual reasoning accuracy using minimal label budgets, matching or outperforming end-to-end paradigms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出D-OCB（动态正交概念瓶颈）框架，这是一个基于对象中心slot-VAE的模型，用于在极弱监督条件下提取与人类对齐的符号谓词。通过动态学习最优超参数分配、惩罚概念子空间相关性、以及动态维度分配机制，该框架在极低标注预算下实现了高概念对齐和视觉推理精度，匹配或超越端到端范式。
AI.motivation: 两阶段神经符号架构将感知与推理分离，但将高层谓词锚定到视觉帧通常需要昂贵的标注。现有方法还需要繁琐的手动调参（如损失平衡系数），且在极低监督下易出现表征崩溃。
AI.method: 1) 动态学习损失平衡超参数分配，消除手动调参；2) 在标准重建自监督之外惩罚概念子空间相关性，注入概念类别独立性先验；3) 动态维度分配机制，允许表现好的概念让出潜在维度给落后概念，防止表征崩溃并提升整体概念准确率。
AI.result: 在极少的标注预算下实现了高概念对齐和下游视觉推理精度，匹配或超越端到端范式。
AI.conclusion: D-OCB证明了在极弱监督下动态自适应机制（超参数与维度分配）能够有效稳定训练、防止表征崩溃，并在视觉推理任务中达到与强监督端到端方法相当的性能。

title: TRACE: Temporal Retrieval with Anchored and Convergent Evidence for Long-Horizon Video Understanding
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. 19 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Project page: https://buaa-colalab.github.io/TRACE/
summary: A long-video answer is evidence-supported only when the frames decoded from the video cover every event the answer depends on. Existing evaluations score final-answer correctness or predicted evidence intervals, but the frames a method decodes before answering are rarely audited, so correct answers can still rest on incomplete observation. We introduce VES-Bench, a 600-question benchmark of Temporal Ordering and Event Counting items over 348 public long videos. Each item carries a jointly necessary set of evidence intervals, letting us audit at three strictness levels whether a method's decoded frames cover every one of them. We also propose TRACE, a training-free agent that grounds answers in raw visual clips, builds an evidence bundle round by round, and stops only when the answer stabilises as the bundle grows and a final pass over the same clips returns the same answer. Under a same-backbone audit, TRACE answers 50.7% of questions correctly with at least two decoded frames inside every evidence interval, at 98.7 frames per question: over 10 points above uniform decoding at 128 frames (40.2%), and within 2.6 points of uniform decoding at 256 frames at 0.39x its frame cost, while reaching the highest answer accuracy in the audit (63.5%). TRACE also stays competitive on Video-MME (86.1), LVBench (75.6), and LongVideoBench (75.1).

AI.tldr: 本文提出VES-Bench基准（600个时序排序与事件计数问题，覆盖348个长视频）来审计长视频问答中解码帧是否覆盖所有证据区间，并提出TRACE——一个无需训练的自适应解码代理，逐轮构建证据包并在答案稳定后停止解码。在同等骨干下，TRACE以98.7帧/题达到50.7%准确率且每一证据区间内至少有两帧被解码，比128帧均匀解码高10个百分点，且以0.39倍的帧成本逼近256帧均匀解码的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频问答评估只关注最终答案正确性或预测的证据区间，而忽略了方法实际解码的帧是否覆盖答案所依赖的所有证据。一个正确答案可能建立在观察不完整的基础上，这种"证据不充分但答案正确"的情况缺乏审计手段。
AI.method: 提出两个核心组件：(1) VES-Bench——600个问题的基准，每个问题附带一组联合必要的证据区间，可在三个严格级别下审计解码帧是否覆盖所有证据；(2) TRACE——无需训练的代理，基于原始视觉片段逐轮构建证据包，仅当证据包增长时答案稳定且对同一片段进行最后一轮验证返回相同答案时才停止解码。
AI.result: 在相同骨干网络下，TRACE以98.7帧/题达到50.7%准确率（每个证据区间内至少解码两帧），比128帧均匀解码（40.2%）高10个百分点以上，且以256帧均匀解码0.39倍的帧成本达到仅2.6个百分点的差距；同时达到最高答案准确率63.5%。在Video-MME（86.1）、LVBench（75.6）和LongVideoBench（75.1）上也保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: VES-Bench首次实现了对长视频问答中"解码帧是否覆盖所有所需证据"的直接审计，TRACE证明通过自适应的证据驱动解码可以在大幅降低帧成本的同时保持甚至提升答案质量，为长视频问答的证据充分性提供了新的评估与推理范式。

title: Coalition-Aware Skill Reliability for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Agent skills, structured artifacts distilled from interaction trajectories and dynamically reused from skill banks, have become a central mechanism for enabling large language model (LLM)-based self-evolving agents to learn from past experience. Yet existing work has largely focused on the operational aspects of skills, such as acquisition, evolution, and retrieval, while leaving a more fundamental reliability question unresolved: Do accumulated skills in an agent's skill bank actually make positive mechanistic contributions? We investigate this question through systematic skill-bank audits across alternative bank compositions and deployment domains, measuring the resulting changes in agent behavior. These audits reveal two recurring reliability failures: coalition pollution, where bank-level gains conceal negative coalition-level skill contributions, and cross-domain utility reversal, where source-beneficial skills reverse their effects after transfer. These findings motivate two reliability interventions: coalition-aware skill selection during skill accumulation and label-free skill masking after transfer. Coalition-Aware Skill Selection (CASS) selects more reliable candidate skills for the current bank using sampled Shapley marginals. Unsupervised Skill-Masked Coalition Optimizer (u-SMCO) masks transferred skills whose exclusion improves retrieval quality on unlabeled target-domain data. Agentic experiments on LoCoMo, LongMemEval, HotpotQA, and ALFWorld show that CASS and u-SMCO consistently improve task performance and cross-domain generalization over strong skill-based self-evolving agent baselines. Beyond accuracy, coalition-conditioned reliability modeling reduces sensitivity to noisy outcome-reward fluctuations during reinforcement learning and exposes the limits of isolation-based skill evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文系统审计了LLM自进化代理中技能库的可靠性问题，发现两类反复出现的失败模式（联盟污染和跨域效用反转），并提出两种可靠性干预方法（CASS和u-SMCO），在多个基准上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注技能的操作层面（获取、演化、检索），但忽略了更根本的可靠性问题：技能库中积累的技能是否真正产生正向机制贡献？作者通过系统性技能库审计发现，技能库层面的收益可能掩盖负面的联盟级贡献，且源域有益的技能在迁移后可能产生效用反转。
AI.method: 提出了两种可靠性干预方法：(1) 联盟感知技能选择（CASS），利用采样Shapley边际选择更可靠的候选技能；(2) 无监督技能掩蔽联盟优化器（u-SMCO），在未标记目标域数据上通过排除技能是否改善检索质量来决定掩蔽决策。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo、LongMemEval、HotpotQA和ALFWorld上的Agentic实验表明，CASS和u-SMCO相较于强技能型自进化代理基线，一致性地提升了任务性能和跨域泛化能力。此外，联盟条件可靠性建模降低了强化学习中对噪声结果奖励波动的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 技能集效应并非简单可加，联盟级效应决定了整体可靠性；孤立式技能评估存在局限性，应采用联盟条件视角进行可靠性建模；所提出的CASS和u-SMCO方法能有效缓解技能库中的可靠性失败。

title: VISTA: Test-Time Compositional Alignment for Visual Autoregressive Generation
summary: Visual autoregressive (VAR) models have emerged as a fast, high-quality alternative to diffusion for text-to-image generation, but like diffusion models they exhibit persistent compositional failures, producing images that violate the attribute bindings and spatial relations specified in the prompt. While a rich line of test-time alignment methods has developed for diffusion, no comparable approach exists for next-scale VAR generation, whose stateful, discrete, multi-resolution sampling process makes existing techniques inapplicable. We close this gap with \textbf{VISTA} (\textbf{Vi}sual Autoregressive \textbf{S}emantic \textbf{T}est-time \textbf{A}lignment), the first gradient-based test-time alignment framework for next-scale autoregressive image generation. Built on Infinity, VISTA intervenes directly in the generation process, optimizing intermediate representations through the frozen transformer to steer visual predictions toward compositional constraints, without modifying model parameters or requiring additional training. VISTA introduces the mechanisms needed to make such optimization stable across scales, together with an extensible objective space that any differentiable constraint on cross-attention can plug into. Across two benchmarks and two model scales, VISTA improves every targeted compositional category, raising the mean targeted score by nearly 20\% on a 2B backbone and almost 6\% on an 8B backbone, with the largest gains on spatial relations. Image quality is preserved: an independent preference model VISTA never optimizes scores its outputs nearly 20\% higher. Notably, the 2B model with VISTA surpasses a backbone four times its size, indicating that a substantial part of the compositional gap between model scales is recoverable at test time.

AI.tldr: VISTA是首个针对next-scale自回归图像生成模型的基于梯度的测试时对齐框架，通过优化中间表示来引导视觉预测满足组合约束，无需修改模型参数或额外训练。在两个基准和两个模型规模上，VISTA提升了所有目标组合类别，平均目标分数在2B主干上提升近20%，在8B主干上提升近6%，同时保持图像质量。
AI.motivation: 视觉自回归（VAR）模型已成为文本到图像生成的快速高质量替代方案，但与扩散模型一样存在组合性失败问题（属性绑定和空间关系违反）。扩散模型已有丰富的测试时对齐方法，但next-scale VAR生成因其有状态、离散、多分辨率采样过程而无法应用现有技术，需要专门的测试时对齐框架。
AI.method: VISTA构建在Infinity之上，直接介入生成过程，通过冻结的transformer优化中间表示，将视觉预测引导向组合约束。引入了跨尺度稳定优化的机制，并提供可扩展的目标空间，任何可微的交叉注意力约束都可以插入其中。
AI.result: 在两个基准和两个模型规模上，VISTA提升了所有目标组合类别：2B主干上平均目标分数提升近20%，8B主干上提升近6%，空间关系类别收益最大。独立偏好模型评分显示输出质量提升近20%。2B模型加VISTA超越了四倍规模的骨干模型。
AI.conclusion: VISTA填补了next-scale自回归图像生成缺乏测试时对齐方法的空白，证明模型规模之间的组合性差距在很大程度上可以在测试时恢复，为VAR模型提供了无需训练的组合性改进途径。

title: DeepSAGE: Stage-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Structured CBT Counseling Dialogue
summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based counseling agents can generate fluent and supportive responses, but they often lack the structured, goal-directed progression required to conduct a coherent therapeutic session. We present DeepSAGE (Strategic AI Guidance Engine), a hybrid LLM--Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) framework for stage-aware counseling dialogue grounded in the first session of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT). DeepSAGE represents the session as eleven stages with explicit therapeutic objectives, with an external controller determines stage completion and the DRL model selects therapeutic intentions that guide LLM response generation. We evaluate DeepSAGE against six retrieval-, prompting-, stage-, and policy-based alternatives. DeepSAGE elicits higher simulated client engagement and openness and achieves the strongest balance of stage-goal completion and dialogue efficiency among stage-structured systems. Domain expert review further indicates that the generated conversations exhibit broadly plausible emotional trajectories and recognizable CBT processes. Because the evaluation relies primarily on simulated clients and model-based metrics, these findings demonstrate comparative dialogue-control improvements rather than clinical effectiveness. These results suggest that combining stage-structured dialogue with learned strategy selection is a promising approach for AI counseling, though clinical effectiveness, safety, and real-world utility require further human evaluation.

AI.tldr: DeepSAGE是一个混合LLM与深度强化学习的框架，用于基于认知行为疗法（CBT）首诊会话的阶段感知咨询对话。该框架将治疗会话划分为11个明确目标的阶段，外部控制器判断阶段完成度，DRL模型选择治疗意图以引导LLM生成响应。实验表明其在模拟客户端参与度和开放性上优于六种基线，在阶段目标完成与对话效率之间取得最优平衡，但临床有效性仍需人工评估验证。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的咨询智能体虽能生成流畅且支持性的回应，但缺乏结构化、目标导向的进展，难以进行连贯的治疗性会话。现有方法未能将治疗过程的阶段性目标与对话策略选择有效结合。
AI.method: 采用混合LLM与深度强化学习（DRL）的框架。将会话表示为具有明确治疗目标的11个阶段，外部控制器负责判断阶段完成情况，DRL模型选择治疗意图，进而引导LLM生成上下文相关的响应。
AI.result: 与六种基于检索、提示、阶段和策略的基线相比，DeepSAGE在模拟客户端参与度和开放性上表现更优，并在阶段结构化系统中取得阶段目标完成与对话效率的最佳平衡。领域专家评审认为生成的对话具有合理的情感轨迹和可识别的CBT过程。
AI.conclusion: 将阶段结构化对话与学习型策略选择相结合是AI咨询的有前景方向，但临床有效性、安全性和现实实用性仍需进一步的人类评估。

title: RS$^3$-Prune: Read-Sparse, Store-Sparse Token Pruning for Video Object Segmentation
summary: We introduce RS$^3$-Prune, a training-free token-pruning recipe that instantiates as a small set of inference time hooks atop existing video object segmentation (VOS) networks. Modern VOS models have converged on a common, expensive design: an image encoder produces a dense token grid for every frame, and a memory bank accumulates these tokens across all previously processed frames to condition future predictions. As a video grows longer, the resulting token budget governs both per-frame latency and peak GPU memory. Hence these models break on use cases such as --- long-form video or real-time deployment on memory-bounded accelerators. In this work we argue that the right axis along which to compress memory-bank VOS is the token budget itself. RS$^3$-Prune operates in two precise locations within an arbitrary memory-bank VOS pipeline: at the boundary between the image encoder and the memory-attention readout, where we restrict the queries that participate in the cross-frame attention to only a small, geometrically informed subset; and at the boundary between the memory encoder and the memory bank, where we restrict which tokens are ever permitted to enter the bank to those that lie within the object's spatial extent. Over various established benchmarks, RS$^3$-Prune delivers up to $38.8\%$ FPS speedup and reduces $13.1\%$ peak memory usage, while preserving a competitive $\mathcal{J}$&$\mathcal{F}$ compared to the unmodified VOS networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RS³-Prune，一种无需训练的token剪枝方法，通过在记忆银行视频目标分割（VOS）网络的关键位置添加推理时钩子，显著提升推理速度和降低峰值内存，同时保持竞争力的分割性能。
AI.motivation: 现代VOS模型（图像编码器生成密集token网格+记忆银行累积历史token）的计算开销随视频长度增长而急剧增加，导致在长视频或内存受限硬件上的实时部署难以实现。现有方法忽略了token预算本身才是压缩的关键轴。
AI.method: RS³-Prune在两个精确位置进行剪枝：(1) 图像编码器与记忆注意力读取之间的边界——仅保留几何信息指导下的少量查询token参与跨帧注意力；(2) 记忆编码器与记忆银行之间的边界——仅允许位于目标空间范围内的token进入记忆银行。
AI.result: 在多个既有基准上，RS³-Prune实现了高达38.8%的FPS加速和13.1%的峰值内存降低，同时保持与未修改VOS网络相竞争的J&F分割性能。
AI.conclusion: 压缩token预算本身是提升记忆银行VOS效率的有效且可行的方向，RS³-Prune以训练免费、即插即用的方式实现了显著的速度与内存收益，为长视频和实时场景下的VOS部署提供了实用解决方案。

title: CAI-DLLM: Convergence Aware Inference for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models can generate many tokens in parallel, but they still require repeated denoising steps during inference. This makes generation costly, especially when the model continues to recompute tokens that are already stable. To address these limitations, we propose CAI-DLLM, a training-free inference method that uses first-step confidence to guide denoising and reduce inference time. Specifically, CAI-DLLM commits easy tokens earlier, allocates more denoising steps to harder tokens, and adjusts decoding schedules across output blocks. As it relies only on first-step confidence signals, it does not require retraining, extra predictors, or weight updates. We evaluate CAI-DLLM on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-7B-Instruct across math, code, reasoning, commonsense, and long-context tasks. CAI-DLLM achieves up to 18.2x wall clock inference speedup on LLaDA GSM8K while improving accuracy from 76.27% to 77.41%, and up to 13.1x speedup on Dream HumanEval while achieving higher pass@1 than no-cache inference, 48.17% compared with 46.95%. On harder reasoning tasks, speedups reach 44.8x, with a largest accuracy drop of 4.4 points, while energy consumption is reduced by up to 95.3%.

AI.tldr: CAI-DLLM是一种无需训练的扩散语言模型推理加速方法，利用首次去噪步骤的置信度信号来引导去噪过程，提前提交简单token、对困难token分配更多去噪步数，并调整解码调度。在LLaDA-8B-Instruct和Dream-7B-Instruct上实现最高18.2倍（LLaDA GSM8K）和13.1倍（Dream HumanEval）的墙钟推理加速，同时提升准确率，能耗最高降低95.3%。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型虽然可以并行生成多个token，但推理时仍需重复去噪步骤，而且会对已经稳定的token进行不必要的重复计算，导致生成成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出CAI-DLLM，一种无需训练的推理方法：利用首次去噪步骤的置信度信号来指导去噪过程——提前提交简单token、为困难token分配更多去噪步数、跨输出块调整解码调度。该方法仅依赖首步置信度信号，无需重新训练、额外预测器或权重更新。
AI.result: 在LLaDA-8B-Instruct和Dream-7B-Instruct上，覆盖数学、代码、推理、常识和长上下文任务。LLaDA GSM8K上实现最高18.2倍墙钟加速，且准确率从76.27%提升至77.41%；Dream HumanEval上实现13.1倍加速，pass@1从46.95%提升至48.17%。更难推理任务上加速达44.8倍，最大准确率下降仅4.4个百分点，能耗最高降低95.3%。
AI.conclusion: CAI-DLLM通过置信度感知的自适应去噪调度，在保持甚至提升生成质量的同时大幅加速扩散语言模型推理，是一种高效且实用的训练免费加速方案。

title: SymmAdapt: Symmetrical Flow Matching for Source-Free Domain Adaptation in Medical Image Segmentation
comment: Accepted at SASHIMI 2026, held in conjunction with MICCAI 2026. To appear in the Springer LNCS proceedings of the MICCAI 2026 Satellite Events
summary: Domain shift across imaging modalities and acquisition sites remains a significant barrier to the clinical deployment of segmentation models. Source-free unsupervised domain adaptation (SFUDA) addresses this by adapting a pretrained model to an unlabeled target domain without requiring access to sensitive source data. We introduce a novel SFUDA framework built on Symmetrical Flow Matching, a unified generative model that segments an input image and synthesizes a source-like image from a mask within the same learned flow. By initializing inference from a domain-agnostic Gaussian origin, the model preserves structural consistency across domains and grounds predictions in learned anatomy rather than shifted texture statistics.
