Our pipeline leverages this symmetry to generate reliable pseudo-labels and corresponding source-like synthetic images from unlabeled target data, creating a generative replay buffer that anchors source knowledge during a generative self-training stage that fine-tunes on a joint set of real target and synthetic source-like images. We evaluate on abdominal multi-organ and cardiac segmentation, covering cross-modality MRI<->CT shifts, and multi-site prostate segmentation. Our approach outperforms SFUDA baselines and is competitive with conventional UDA methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于对称流匹配（Symmetrical Flow Matching）的无源无监督域适应（SFUDA）分割框架，通过统一的生成模型同时完成图像分割和源像图像合成，利用生成重放缓冲区和生成自训练阶段，在无源数据条件下实现跨模态、跨站点的高鲁棒性医学图像分割。
AI.motivation: 跨模态和跨采集站点的域偏移严重阻碍了分割模型的临床部署。现有的SFUDA方法虽然避免了访问敏感源数据，但在医学图像上仍然面临结构保持和伪标签可靠性的挑战。作者旨在利用生成模型的对称性来保持跨域的结构一致性，并克服难以获得的源域监督。
AI.method: 构建一个对称流匹配（Symmetrical Flow Matching）统一生成模型，在同一学习流中同时执行两个任务：(1) 对输入图像进行分割；(2) 从掩膜合成源风格图像。推理时从域无关的高斯原点初始化，保持跨域结构一致性。利用对称性从未标注的目标数据生成可靠的伪标签和对应的源像合成图像，构建生成重放缓冲区锚定源域知识，然后进行生成自训练阶段，在真实目标图像和合成源像图像的联合集上微调模型。
AI.result: 在腹部多器官分割（MRI<->CT跨模态）、心脏分割以及多站点前列腺分割任务上评估，该方法优于现有SFUDA基线方法，并与传统UDA方法性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 对称流匹配生成框架能够有效解决医学图像分割中的域偏移问题，通过域无关的高斯原点初始化和生成重放机制，在不访问源数据的情况下达到了与传统有源UDA方法竞争的性能，具有良好的临床部署潜力。

title: A-CPES: A Reference Framework for Agentic AI in Cyber-Physical Energy Systems
summary: Energy system operation contains a loop of work that automation has never taken over: posing the optimization problem the current cycle should solve, disposing of infeasibility, sequencing a solution into interlocked switching orders, assembling evidence no single model holds, negotiating adjustable capacity with many parties, and settling experience into practice. Licensed dispatchers carry all of it in person, and the rising share of variable renewable generation is making that loop turn faster than their number can grow. Agentic AI supplies the abilities it requires, but enters as the outer loop of control: it calls SCED and the other decision models rather than being called by them. We propose A-CPES, three nested rings, an authorization and accountability frame around an agentic control outer loop around a six-layer CPES core. We argue the loop is indivisible, tune where and how tightly it may close, state eight structural failure modes as falsifiable predictions, and specify six governance modules that rebuild the authorization frame until it covers the loop, before the loop starts turning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出A-CPES框架，针对电力系统调度中尚未被自动化的完整工作闭环（包括问题建模、不可行性处理、操作排序、证据整合、容量协商和经验沉淀），引入代理式AI作为控制外环，构建三层嵌套结构（授权问责框架+代理控制外环+六层CPES核心），并提出八个结构性失效模式作为可证伪预测，以及六个治理模块。
AI.motivation: 电力系统运行中始终存在一个未被自动化覆盖的工作循环，完全依赖持证调度员人工完成。随着可变可再生能源占比上升，这一循环的运转速度超过调度员数量增速，迫切需要自动化解决方案。代理式AI具备所需能力，但需要明确其作为控制外环的定位与治理框架。
AI.method: 提出A-CPES架构：三层嵌套结构——授权与问责框架作为最外层，代理式AI控制外环居中，六层CPES核心位于内层。论证该工作循环不可分割，分析闭环的可能位置与紧密程度，归纳八个结构性失效模式作为可证伪预测，并设计六个治理模块以在循环启动前重建完整的授权框架。
AI.result: 论文提出了完整的A-CPES框架设计，包括架构分层、闭合度调节机制、八个可证伪的结构性失效模式预测，以及六个治理模块的规格说明。
AI.conclusion: 电力调度的工作循环是完整且不可分割的，代理式AI应当以控制外环的形式介入，但必须在授权与问责框架的覆盖下运行。该框架需在循环启动前就构建完备，以防止结构性失效。

title: Vision-Language Models for Occupational Physical Exposure Assessment: Estimating External Hand Forces in Manual Material Handling Tasks from RGB Video
summary: External hand forces are important inputs to biomechanical analyses of occupational physical exposure and injury risk, yet continuous force measurements during manual material handling (MMH) typically requires instrumented objects or specialized sensing. We evaluated a vision-language model (VLM)-based pipeline that combines task-specific textual cues, visual representations, and known box mass to estimate dynamic, triaxial, bilateral external hand forces from RGB video. Thirty-five healthy young adults performed five MMH tasks involving lifting, carrying, pushing, and pulling with box masses of 6, 9, and 12 kg. The pipeline used text-guided localization of participant and handled-object regions of interest (ROIs), pretrained vision-transformer feature extraction, and transformer-based temporal regression. Performance was evaluated using leave-one-subject-out validation across seven camera-view conditions (three single-view and four multi-view conditions) and four ROI strategies. Overall, root mean square error was ~4.7-5.6 N for the horizontal and mediolateral force components and ~10.6-11.0 N for the vertical component. Including the handled object as a second ROI generally improved force estimation, with some of the largest benefits under single-camera conditions, whereas pixel-level segmentation provided little additional improvement. Multi-camera capture provided the clearest benefit for peak-force estimation, particularly for the vertical component, whereas differences in overall frame-level error among camera configurations were comparatively modest. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of estimating continuous, bilateral, directional hand-force estimates from RGB video and known load mass without requiring sensors on the worker or handled objects as model inputs, supporting the development of more scalable occupational physical exposure and risk assessments.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了一种基于视觉语言模型(VLM)的管线，通过RGB视频和已知箱体质量来估算动态、三轴、双侧的外部手部力量。在35名健康青年执行的5种手工物料搬运任务中，该方法的水平方向误差约4.7-5.6N，垂直方向误差约10.6-11.0N，验证了无需传感器即可从视频估算手部力量的可行性。
AI.motivation: 外部手部力量是职业体力暴露和伤害风险生物力学分析的重要输入，但连续力测量通常需要仪器化物体或专门传感设备，限制了大规模应用。研究旨在开发一种无需在工人或物体上安装传感器的方法，使职业体力暴露评估更具可扩展性。
AI.method: 采用视觉语言模型(VLM)管线，包含三个核心组件：1)文本引导的参与者与手持物体感兴趣区域(ROI)定位；2)预训练视觉Transformer特征提取；3)基于Transformer的时间序列回归。研究包含35名参与者、5种MMH任务（提举、搬运、推、拉）、3种箱体质量（6/9/12kg），并使用留一受试者交叉验证评估7种摄像头视角条件和4种ROI策略。
AI.result: 整体均方根误差：水平方向约4.7-5.6N，内侧-外侧方向类似，垂直方向约10.6-11.0N。关键发现：(1)将手持物体作为第二ROI通常改善力估计，在单相机条件下收益最大；(2)像素级分割带来的改善有限；(3)多相机在峰值力估计方面优势最明显，尤其对垂直分量；(4)相机配置之间的整体帧级误差差异相对较小。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了从RGB视频和已知负载质量估算连续、双侧、方向性手部力量的可行性，无需传感器作为模型输入，为开发更可扩展的职业体力暴露和风险评估方法提供了支持。

title: Robustness Analysis of Agentic AI to Inconsistent and Incomplete Tool Responses
summary: Robustness to a bad tool return means answering it in the way that return calls for, which depends on how the tool went wrong. A tool that has failed and a tool that returns a well-formed falsehood are different problems with different remedies. We ask whether the two already differ at the moment the return arrives. This is a qualitative pilot study: we score single decision points rather than running agents to completion. We inject controlled faults into a retail customer-service domain and read two channels off the model's log-probabilities: the likelihood of the returned content under the tool schema alone and under the whole trajectory, and its distribution over the legal actions, read for both shape and where the mass sits. An incomplete return is legible in every case, being improbable under the schema alone in a range no other condition enters, and it moves the mass toward the tools that re-read state wherever there is room to move. An inconsistent return leaves the schema channel untouched and registers in the likelihood comparison on the field whose true value the context already carries verbatim, not on the one whose contradiction runs through the domain policy. The action distribution gives each condition a distinct signature, but orders them by how far the return bears on the next action rather than by fault family. Recognition is therefore asymmetric: each condition is legible in some channel, and no channel is legible on all of them.

AI.tldr: 这是一项关于工具返回结果鲁棒性的定性试点研究。作者在零售客服领域注入受控故障，通过从模型log概率中读取两个通道（工具schema下的返回内容似然性、整个轨迹下的似然性，以及合法动作上的分布）来考察：工具失败与工具返回格式良好的虚假信息在返回到达时刻是否已经可区分。研究发现识别是不对称的：每种故障条件在某个通道上是可读的，但没有一个通道能读取所有条件。
AI.motivation: 工具返回结果出错是agent系统中常见问题，但"工具失败"和"工具返回了格式良好但内容虚假的信息"是两类不同的问题，需要不同的应对方式。作者希望探究这两类错误在返回到达模型的那一刻是否就已经可以被区分，从而为针对性补救提供依据。
AI.method: 采用定性试点研究方法：在零售客服领域注入受控故障，而非运行完整agent流程；只针对单一决策点进行评分。作者读取两个通道：1）返回内容在工具schema单独条件下的似然性，以及在整个轨迹条件下的似然性；2）合法动作空间上的概率分布，同时分析分布的形状和质量分布位置。故障类型包括：不完整返回和不一致返回（矛盾贯穿领域策略）。
AI.result: 不完整返回在所有情况下都是可读的：它在schema单独条件下极不可能，该范围无其他条件进入；并且只要有空间，它会将概率质量移向"重新读取状态"的工具。不一致返回不影响schema通道，而是在似然性比较中记录在上下文已逐字携带真实值的字段上，而非矛盾贯穿领域策略的字段上。动作分布为每种条件提供了独特的签名，但其排序依据是返回对下一步动作的影响程度，而非故障家族。
AI.conclusion: 识别是不对称的：每种故障条件在某个通道上是可读的，但没有一个通道对所有条件都可读。这意味着对坏工具返回的鲁棒性不能依赖单一的检测信号，而需要针对不同故障类型的多通道监控与差异化应对策略。

title: AI-based worker guidance in assembly and disassembly operations using multimodal ego/exo-centric data capture and structured task knowledge
comment: 5 pages. Published in CIRP Annals - Manufacturing Technology
summary: Assembly and disassembly processes rely on expert knowledge that is difficult to document, reuse, and transfer. This paper presents a data-centric approach for extracting structured task knowledge from expert demonstrations using egocentric and exocentric recordings. Temporal and multimodal information from video and narration is jointly encoded to derive structured task representations that enable procedural documentation and context-aware worker guidance. The approach is evaluated on a real-world disassembly case study, demonstrating that video-based representations capture procedural structure and execution context beyond static image-based methods. The results highlight the potential of egocentric video understanding for repair, training, and circular manufacturing applications. Project website: https://indego-assistant.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种数据驱动的方法，利用第一视角（egocentric）和第三视角（exocentric）视频记录，从专家演示中提取结构化任务知识，实现程序文档化和情境感知的工人指导。
AI.motivation: 装配与拆卸过程依赖难以记录、重用和转移的专家知识，传统静态图像方法无法捕捉程序结构和执行上下文。
AI.method: 联合编码来自视频和叙述的时间与多模态信息，推导出结构化任务表示，以支持程序文档化和上下文感知的工人指导。
AI.result: 在真实世界的拆卸案例研究中，视频表示在捕捉程序结构和执行上下文方面优于静态图像方法。
AI.conclusion: 第一视角视频理解在维修、培训和循环制造应用中具有潜力，为专家知识转移和自动化指导提供新途径。

title: Does Rank Still Matter? Position Bias When AI Agents Shop on Our Behalf
summary: Search rankings are valuable because human attention is scarce and sequential. Higher-placed alternatives are easier to find, so they are examined and bought more often. Consumers are now delegating search to AI agents that can ingest an entire results page at once. Randomizing the order of one hundred hotel listings across 5,000 AI agent sessions, we compare four large language models against human field data. AI agents search more deeply than humans and never decline to buy. Position still predicts which listings are inspected, but weakly and non-monotonically: the middle of a results page has the lowest probability of inspection, not the bottom. Position reaches the choice stage for some models and not others, a heterogeneity that tracks neither provider nor capability. All models nonetheless converge on the same undominated listing. For agentic search, the attributes displayed on a results page matter more than placement within it.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对比四个大型语言模型与人类在100个酒店列表（5000次AI会话）中的搜索行为，发现AI代理搜索更深、从不拒绝购买，位置对检查概率的影响微弱且非单调（中间最低），且不同模型对位置的影响力存在异质性，但所有模型最终都选择相同的占优列表。
AI.motivation: 传统搜索排序因人类注意力稀缺且顺序化而至关重要，但AI代理可以一次性消费整个结果页，这改变了位置效应的根本机制。理解AI代理如何搜索和决策，对搜索排名、经济学和平台设计有重大影响。
AI.method: 实验中对100个酒店列表的排序进行随机化，在5000个AI代理会话中对比四个大型语言模型，并与人类现场数据进行比较，分析位置对检查阶段和选择阶段的影响。
AI.result: AI代理比人类搜索更深且从不拒绝购买；位置虽能预测检查但效应微弱且非单调（页中间检查概率最低而非底部）；位置对选择阶段的影响因模型而异，且该异质性既不与提供商相关也不与能力相关；所有模型最终收敛于同一个未被支配的列表。
AI.conclusion: 在代理式搜索中，结果页面上显示的属性比其在页面中的位置更重要，这表明传统的位置驱动排序策略在AI代理场景下需要根本性重新设计。

title: OmniCAD: A Large-Scale Benchmark for 3D Spatial Reasoning in Robotics Assemblies
summary: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) show strong capabilities in robotic perception and spatial reasoning, yet their ability to reason about complex mechanical assemblies remains underexplored. We introduce OmniCAD, a large-scale benchmark for assembly-aware 3D spatial reasoning across diverse industrial systems, including robotic mechanisms, automotive components, aerospace structures, and agricultural machinery. OmniCAD contains 25k mechanical assemblies, with an average of 12 parts per assembly and 21 types of mate relationships. Each assembly includes a human-verified ground-truth 3D model and renderings from 20 viewpoints. The benchmark evaluates three capabilities: (1) component-level 3D spatial reasoning, requiring prediction of part positions and orientations; (2) part-to-part relational reasoning, requiring identification of mating relationships and assembly constraints; and (3) tool-augmented agentic reasoning, where models iteratively select viewpoints, inspect visual evidence, and refine predictions. Experiments show that current VLMs struggle with industrial assembly reasoning, often producing inaccurate poses, invalid mating relationships, part interpenetration, and degraded performance as assembly complexity increases. We will open-source the benchmark, evaluation code, and tool interfaces to support research on accurate, physically valid, and scalable 3D assembly reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OmniCAD，一个大规模装配感知3D空间推理基准，包含25k个机械装配体（平均12个部件/装配，21种配合关系），从三个能力维度评估VLM：部件级3D空间推理、部件间关系推理和工具增强的智能体推理。实验表明当前VLM在工业装配推理上表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型（VLM）在机器人和空间推理任务中表现出色，但它们在复杂机械装配体的推理能力尚未被充分探索。缺乏一个专门针对工业级装配场景的基准来评估VLM的3D空间推理能力。
AI.method: 构建OmniCAD基准，包含25k个机械装配体，覆盖机器人机构、汽车部件、航空航天结构和农业机械等工业系统。每个装配包含人工验证的3D真值模型和20个视角的渲染图。从三个层面评估：(1) 部件级3D空间推理（预测位置和姿态）；(2) 部件间关系推理（识别配合关系和装配约束）；(3) 工具增强的智能体推理（迭代选择视角、检查视觉证据、细化预测）。
AI.result: 实验发现当前VLM在工业装配推理中表现不佳，常见问题包括：产生不准确的姿态、无效的配合关系、部件相互穿透，并且随着装配复杂度增加性能显著下降。
AI.conclusion: OmniCAD揭示了VLM在机械装配推理方面的显著不足，该基准将开放源代码和工具接口，以支持准确、物理有效且可扩展的3D装配推理研究。

title: CacheRouter: A Dual-Path Tool Routing Architecture with Cache-Preserving Main-Model Isolation for Long-Tail Tool Discovery
summary: Tool use in LLM systems faces a structural trade-off. Progressive disclosure keeps the prompt small by showing only the tools relevant to the current task, while prompt caching rewards a request prefix that stays fixed across calls; every change to the visible tool list invalidates the cached prefix. This paper treats the trade-off as a problem of request architecture and proposes a dual-path routing design that assigns tool selection and tool delivery to separate channels. The main model always sees a small, fixed set of core tools, so the head of its request is unchanged across calls; all other tools are reached through an independent routing channel, in which a router sub-model searches the full tool list, selects one tool, executes it, and returns the result. Tool registration is automated from source code and supports runtime updates, so the tool set can grow without modifying the main model's request prefix. The design generalizes progressive disclosure: capabilities are disclosed through the routing channel, and the main model's prefix stays stable. A prototype implementation was exercised on 55 functional queries and a 30-turn dialogue; token-level cache hit rates reached 90.99% and 95.2%, cutting input cost to about 12.0% and 8.0% of a no-cache baseline under DeepSeek's pricing, where cache-hit input tokens cost roughly 1/30 of cache-miss tokens.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM系统中工具使用与提示缓存之间的结构性权衡，提出一种双路径路由设计：主模型始终看到固定的小型核心工具集（保持请求前缀不变以维持缓存命中），所有其他工具通过独立的路由通道进行选择、执行和返回结果。原型在55个功能查询和30轮对话中分别达到90.99%和95.2%的缓存命中率，输入成本降至无缓存基线的约8%-12%。
AI.motivation: 工具使用面临结构性权衡：渐进式披露（仅显示当前任务相关工具）可以保持提示词小，但每次可见工具列表变化都会使缓存前缀失效；而提示缓存则要求请求前缀在调用间保持不变。这两种需求相互冲突，现有方案无法同时满足。
AI.method: 提出双路径路由设计：1) 主路径：主模型始终看到固定的小型核心工具集，保证请求头部在所有调用间不变以维持缓存命中；2) 路由路径：独立的路由子模型搜索完整工具列表，选择工具、执行并返回结果。工具注册从源代码自动化完成，支持运行时更新，无需修改主模型的请求前缀。
AI.result: 在55个功能查询和30轮对话上进行原型测试，令牌级缓存命中率分别达到90.99%和95.2%，在DeepSeek定价下（缓存命中输入令牌约为未缓存令牌成本的1/30），输入成本降至无缓存基线的约12.0%和8.0%。
AI.conclusion: 该设计推广了渐进式披露的概念：能力通过路由通道披露，主模型的请求前缀保持稳定，从而同时实现小提示词和高缓存命中率，显著降低LLM工具调用的输入成本。

title: Multiple View Neural Regression of a Facial Shape Model
summary:
Creating re-topologized 3D facial meshes is essential for high-quality facial animation but remains labor-intensive and time-consuming. This dissertation explores more efficient approaches for capturing production-ready facial meshes through: (1) the development of VarIS, a custom light sphere for capturing high-resolution stereo geometry and reflectance maps; (2) analysis of camera parameters affecting automatic 2D and 3D landmarking; (3) synthetic-data methods for training neural face regression; and (4) techniques for improving neural multi-view face-shape regression.
  While VarIS enables photorealistic face capture, its operational and processing costs motivate a more scalable approach. A deep learning framework is therefore proposed to directly predict re-topologized facial meshes from synthetic multiview images generated with Visage Craft, an in-house physically based rendering system using an Appearance 3D Morphable Model (A3DMM). The system produces standardized meshes ready for rigging and animation with minimal human supervision. Results show that incorporating accurate camera intrinsics and extrinsics improves landmark accuracy and geometric consistency, while 3D landmark regularization further improves reconstruction quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种深度学习框架，利用合成多视图图像直接预测重新拓扑的3D面部网格，替代传统劳动密集型的重拓扑流程。系统基于VarIS光球采集高分辨率几何和反射率数据，并结合Visage Craft物理渲染系统和外观3D可变形模型（A3DMM），生成可直接用于绑定和动画的标准网格。实验表明，引入准确的相机内参和外参可提升地标点精度和几何一致性，3D地标正则化进一步改善了重建质量。
AI.motivation: 创建重新拓扑的3D面部网格对高质量面部动画至关重要，但传统方法劳动密集且耗时。虽然VarIS光球系统能实现逼真的面部捕捉，但其运行和处理成本高昂，需要更可扩展的方案。
AI.method: 提出一个深度学习框架，直接从合成多视图图像预测重新拓扑的面部网格。该方法利用Visage Craft物理渲染系统生成合成数据，基于外观3D可变形模型（A3DMM），并整合相机内参和外参信息，同时通过3D地标正则化提升重建质量。
AI.result: 准确的相机内参和外参能提高地标点精度和几何一致性；3D地标正则化进一步改善重建质量。系统能以最少的人工监督生成标准化网格，可直接用于绑定和动画。
AI.conclusion: 该深度学习框架为可扩展的面部捕捉提供了一条更高效的路径，在保持高重建质量的同时大幅减少人工干预，为生产级面部动画管线提供了实用解决方案。

title: SEAM: Shot Entity-Attribute Memory for Consistent Short-Drama Generation at Scale
summary: Short-drama generation has grown into a large, industrialized pipeline, and as it scales from isolated shots to the episode level, visual continuity has become a critical bottleneck. Current agent frameworks generate each shot in isolation, so context drifts across shots and props, character posture, and blocking turn inconsistent. Once assembled, these small discrepancies amplify into severe visual breaks. We present SEAM (Shot Entity-Attribute Memory), a training-free, model-agnostic memory graph that repairs continuity entirely at the prompt-text layer by extracting a multi-dimensional state for every shot, retrieving only causally prior context over the resulting graph, filtering it selectively, and injecting the surviving constraints by natural-language prompt rewriting. We further release SEAM-Bench, a double-blind continuity storyboarding benchmark, on which SEAM raises cross-episode continuity recall from 0.700 to 0.946, generalizes across six mainstream text models, and yields consistent, though not yet significant, gains at the generated-image layer. Deployed as a mandatory stage in CreativeFitting's SEAM-Agent production pipeline over 201 shots, SEAM reaches a 96.5% director-acceptance rate with zero unsafe injections; a conservative counterfactual attributes at least 21.9 percentage points of that rate to its cross-episode memory.

AI.tldr: SEAM（镜头实体-属性记忆）是一种无需训练、与模型无关的记忆图方法，通过在提示文本层提取镜头状态、检索因果上下文并重写提示词，修复短视频剧集生成中的视觉连续性问题。在SEAM-Bench上跨集连续性召回率从0.700提升至0.946，并在生产管线中达到96.5%导演接受率。
AI.motivation: 短视频剧集生成已发展为大规模工业化流程，从单镜头扩展到剧集级别时，视觉连续性成为关键瓶颈。现有智能体框架孤立生成每个镜头，导致跨镜头的道具、角色姿态和场景调度不一致，这些小差异在组装后会被放大为严重的视觉断裂。
AI.method: SEAM通过四个步骤实现连续性修复：(1) 为每个镜头提取多维状态；(2) 在生成的记忆图上检索仅因果先前的上下文；(3) 对检索到的约束进行选择性过滤；(4) 通过自然语言提示重写注入保留的约束。该方法是训练-free且模型无关的，完全在提示文本层操作。
AI.result: SEAM在SEAM-Bench（双盲连续性分镜基准）上将跨集连续性召回率从0.700提升至0.946，在六个主流文本模型上泛化良好，并在生成图像层取得一致但尚不显著的效果提升。在生产管线中（201个镜头）达到96.5%导演接受率，零不安全注入；保守反事实估计至少21.9个百分点的接受率归因于跨集记忆。
AI.conclusion: SEAM证明了在纯提示文本层面构建记忆图可以有效修复短视频生成中的跨集视觉连续性，无需训练且适用于多种模型，已成功部署于实际生产管线，展示了从研究到工业落地的可行性。

title: Hyperbolic Hierarchical Clustering for Visual Representation Learning
summary: We investigate the token mixer in vision backbones by revisiting clustering, one of the most classic approaches in machine learning. An effective token mixer is a fundamental component of modern vision backbones like vision Transformers, facilitating information exchange between image patches. Mainstream token mixers, which rely on convolution, attention, MLP, or their hybrids, primarily focus on navigating the trade-off between accuracy and computational cost. However, a significant drawback of these methods is their black-box nature; their encoding process is opaque and lacks interpretability. Diverging from these opaque designs, we introduce ClusterMixer, a transparent token mixer that is grounded in a clustering paradigm and interpretable by design. ClusterMixer explicitly formulates the token mixing process through a hierarchical clustering mechanism. To model the natural, tree-like relationships inherent in visual data, the clustering is performed in hyperbolic space, which is well-suited for embedding hierarchies with low distortion. Building on this innovation, we present HCFormer, a new backbone architecture that integrates ClusterMixer with a series of meticulously designed clustering strategies to ensure robust performance across tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HCFormer consistently outperforms its counterparts across diverse tasks, including image classification, object detection, instance segmentation, and semantic segmentation. Considering its transparency and efficacy, we hope HCFormer can facilitate a paradigm shift toward interpretable backbones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ClusterMixer，一种基于层次聚类、在双曲空间中运行的透明token混合器，并构建了HCFormer骨干网络，在图像分类、目标检测、实例分割和语义分割等任务上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉骨干网络中的token mixer（如卷积、注意力、MLP及其混合）虽然能平衡精度与计算成本，但本质上都是黑盒模型，编码过程缺乏可解释性。作者希望回归机器学习中最经典的聚类方法，设计一种透明且可解释的token混合机制。
AI.method: ClusterMixer通过层次聚类机制显式地形式化token混合过程。由于视觉数据具有自然的树状层级关系，聚类在双曲空间中进行，因为双曲空间能以低失真度嵌入层级结构。基于此构建HCFormer骨干架构，集成ClusterMixer并配合一系列精心设计的聚类策略以保证各任务上的稳健性能。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，HCFormer在图像分类、目标检测、实例分割和语义分割等多个任务上均一致优于同类方法。
AI.conclusion: HCFormer兼具透明性和有效性，有望推动视觉骨干网络向可解释方向转变。

title: The Compaction Cliff in Long-Running AI Agent Memory
summary: A safety rule and an episodic log compete for the same tokens in an AI agent's context. When the budget overflows, both are summarized at the same rate; only the rule needs exact wording to remain enforceable. On 20 production agent configurations, Claude Code's /compact prompt on Sonnet 4.6 preserves 53\% of safety rules after one compaction round and 10\% after five. We name this the Compaction Cliff. We address it with Knowledge Triage, a framework that classifies each line of an agent's knowledge base by type and routes each type through its own retention policy. Three deterministic operators implement this triage across the three context-management operations: TypeCompact rewrites items in place under per-type fidelity, TypeDecompose partitions a topic too large to compact safely, replicating in-scope safety rules across partitions, and TypeRetrieve fetches items from external storage with in-scope rules pinned ahead of relevance. On five public corpora, TypeCompact preserves 2--4$\times$ more safety rules than the strongest single-shot LLM compactor at every ratio, with 96\% recall over five rounds. TypeDecompose reaches 0\% locality violations against 93\% under uniform partitioning. TypeRetrieve reaches 100\% recall@50 against 73\% for the best single-shot LLM retriever. On three downstream behavioral benchmarks, we outperform the production Sonnet compactor on medical compliance (paired McNemar $p < 10^{-8}$ on preservation, $N = 200$), the full-policy and hierarchical baselines on retail task pass rate ($p < 0.01$, $N = 115$), and the hierarchical compaction on the airline domain ($p = 0.024$). We release AgentArtifactCorpus (396{,}934 agent configurations from 54{,}628 public GitHub repositories), the classifier, and the reference implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"压缩悬崖"(Compaction Cliff)问题：AI代理的上下文压缩会以相同速率丢弃安全规则和对话日志，导致安全规则快速丢失（5轮后仅剩10%）。作者提出Knowledge Triage框架，通过类型分类和差异化保留策略（TypeCompact/TypeDecompose/TypeRetrieve三个算子）实现按类型分流的上下文管理，显著提升安全规则保留率和下游任务表现。
AI.motivation: 安全规则需要精确措辞才能保持可执行性，而日志只需概要。当前压缩机制对两者一视同仁，导致安全规则在多次压缩后迅速丢失（单轮仅保留53%，5轮后仅10%），形成"压缩悬崖"问题。这在不安全的生产AI代理配置中构成严重风险。
AI.method: 提出Knowledge Triage框架：1）分类器将代理知识库的每一行按类型分类；2）三种确定性算子对应三种上下文管理操作——TypeCompact按类型保真度就地重写、TypeDecompose将过大主题分区并跨分区复制安全规则、TypeRetrieve从外部存储获取时优先固定范围内规则。此外发布AgentArtifactCorpus数据集（396,934个代理配置）。
AI.result: TypeCompact在5个公开语料上比最强单次LLM压缩器多保留2-4倍安全规则，5轮后96%召回率；TypeDecompose实现0%局部性违规（基线为93%）；TypeRetrieve达到100%召回率@50（基线73%）。在医疗合规、零售任务通过率、航空领域三个下游基准上均显著优于生产Sonnet压缩器及基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过类型感知的知识分诊策略，可以在上下文管理过程中有效保护安全规则，克服压缩悬崖问题。该框架在保留率、召回率和下游任务表现上均超越现有单一压缩方法，为AI代理上下文管理提供了更安全的设计范式。

title: MorphoCLIP: Text-Supervised Contrastive Learning for Perturbation Matching in Cell Painting Images
summary: Cell Painting microscopy captures how cells change after a chemical or genetic perturbation. Connecting these images to the perturbations that produced them could make large imaging screens easier to search and interpret, but the task remains difficult because biological effects are subtle and technical variation is substantial. We introduce MorphoCLIP, a contrastive model that links Cell Painting profiles with text descriptions of compounds, CRISPR knockouts, and ORF overexpressions. The model keeps its vision and language backbones frozen and trains only a compact cross-channel module and projection layers, so it can be trained on a single consumer GPU. On held-out CPJUMP1 data, MorphoCLIP searches in both directions: from a cell image to its perturbation description and from a description to matching cell images. In both cases, a correct match appears among the top ten results much more often than expected by chance. Adding a replicate-alignment loss makes profiles from repeated experiments more consistent, although this improvement does not yet translate into reliable gene-compound matching. Gene-aware labels and plate correction also show no consistent retrieval benefit. These findings suggest that text supervision can help organize chemical and genetic Cell Painting data. Matching compounds with genetic perturbations, however, remains an open problem.

AI.tldr: MorphoCLIP是一个对比学习模型，通过冻结视觉和语言骨干网络，仅训练紧凑的跨通道模块和投影层，将Cell Painting显微图像与化合物、CRISPR敲除和ORF过表达的文本描述进行关联。在CPJUMP1数据上实现了双向搜索（图像到描述、描述到图像），正确匹配位列前十的频率显著高于随机水平。复制对齐损失提高了重复实验的一致性，但基因-化合物匹配仍是未解难题。
AI.motivation: Cell Painting显微镜图像记录了化学或遗传扰动后细胞的变化，但将这些图像与产生它们的扰动联系起来非常困难，因为生物效应微妙且技术差异显著。如果能建立这种连接，将使大规模成像筛选更容易搜索和解释。
AI.method: 采用对比学习架构，保持视觉和语言骨干网络冻结，仅训练紧凑的跨通道模块和投影层，从而使模型可在单个消费级GPU上训练。同时引入复制对齐损失以提高重复实验之间的一致性，并尝试基因感知标签和板校正策略。
AI.result: 在CPJUMP1数据上，MorphoCLIP实现了双向检索（图像到描述、描述到图像），正确的匹配位列前十的频率远高于随机水平。复制对齐损失使重复实验的profile更加一致，但未转化为可靠的基因-化合物匹配。基因感知标签和板校正未带来一致的检索收益。
AI.conclusion: 文本监督有助于组织化学和遗传的Cell Painting数据，但将化合物与遗传扰动匹配仍是一个开放问题。

title: Compositional Chain-of-Relations for Faithful Knowledge Graph Question Answering with Large Language Models
summary: Knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) is a key task for evaluating KG-augmented Large Language Models (LLMs), and complex KGQA that requires multi-hop reasoning is especially challenging. Solving a complex query involves two coupled phases: candidate retrieval, which locates answer candidates over the KG, and constraint handling, which filters these candidates against the query constraints. Faithful reasoning requires grounding both phases in the KG. However, existing agent-based methods ground candidate retrieval through entity-centric exploration, while leaving constraint handling to the LLM's internal knowledge, which leads to two critical limitations. (1) Unreliable entity pruning: entity-centric exploration uses entities as search units and must prune them to a fixed-size subset at each hop. Because entity information in KGs is often incomplete and a fixed-size subset cannot retain all valid entities, such pruning inevitably drops valid entities and ultimately leads to wrong answers. (2) Ungrounded constraint handling: query constraints are resolved from the LLM's internal knowledge rather than the KG, leaving the final answers unverifiable and prone to hallucination. To address these limitations, this paper introduces a relation-centric exploration paradigm, which uses relations rather than entities as search units and thus avoids unreliable entity pruning. Built on this paradigm, this paper proposes Compositional Chain-of-Relations (CCoR), a simple and effective framework that grounds both phases in the KG with two relation chains: a main chain for candidate retrieval and a constraint chain that verifies query constraints through explicit KG exploration. Experiments on four KGQA benchmarks show that CCoR consistently improves accuracy, faithfulness, and efficiency over strong baselines, with more pronounced gains on complex queries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种以关系为中心的探索范式（Relation-centric Exploration），并在此基础上构建了组合式关系链（CCoR）框架，用于解决复杂知识图谱问答（KGQA）中的多跳推理问题。CCoR通过主链进行候选检索、约束链进行显式KG探索验证查询约束，将候选检索和约束处理两个阶段都建立在KG之上，避免了传统实体中心方法中不可靠的实体剪枝和无根据的约束处理问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于智能体的KGQA方法存在两个关键局限：（1）实体中心探索导致的不可靠实体剪枝——以实体为搜索单元需要在每跳剪枝到固定大小子集，但KG中实体信息不完整且固定大小子集无法保留所有有效实体，导致错误答案；（2）约束处理未接地——查询约束依赖LLM内部知识而非KG，导致答案不可验证且易产生幻觉。
AI.method: 提出以关系（relation）而非实体（entity）作为搜索单元的探索范式，避免不可靠的实体剪枝。在此范式上构建CCoR框架，包含两条关系链：主链（main chain）负责候选检索，约束链（constraint chain）通过显式KG探索验证查询约束，从而将两个阶段都接地在KG上。
AI.result: 在四个KGQA基准上的实验表明，CCoR在准确性、忠实性和效率方面一致优于强基线，且在复杂查询上优势更为明显。
AI.conclusion: 以关系为中心的探索范式结合双关系链设计，能够有效解决复杂KGQA中实体剪枝不可靠和约束处理未接地的问题，实现更忠实、准确且高效的推理。

title: Hybrid Generative-Discriminative Object Placement
summary: As an important operation of image composition, object placement aims to predict the plausible placement (location, scale) for the inserted foreground object. Previous object placement methods can be divided into generative methods and discriminative methods, both of which cannot balance efficiency and effectiveness well. In this work, we propose a semi-generative method in the middle ground between them. In particular, we assign uniformly distributed anchors on the background. Then, we fuse foreground and background features to predict the rationality score for each anchor and predict plausible placement sets for positive anchors. Extensive experiments on the OPA dataset show that our method can strike a good balance between efficiency and effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种半生成式物体放置方法，通过在背景上均匀分布锚点，融合前景和背景特征预测每个锚点的合理性分数，并为正锚点预测合理的放置位置集合，在效率和效果之间取得良好平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的物体放置方法分为生成式和判别式两类，但两者都难以兼顾效率与效果，需要一种能在中间地带平衡两者的新方法。
AI.method: 采用半生成式方法：在背景上均匀分布锚点，融合前景与背景特征，为每个锚点预测合理性分数，并为正锚点预测合理的放置位置集合（位置和尺度）。
AI.result: 在OPA数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法能够在效率和效果之间取得良好平衡。
AI.conclusion: 半生成式方法是生成式与判别式方法之间的有效折中方案，能够同时兼顾效率与效果。

title: The Retriever Should Remember: Experience-Amortized Reranking for Long-Term Agent Memory
summary: Long-term language-model agents accumulate memories across interactions, but their retrievers typically do not accumulate retrieval experience. Semantic retrieval is efficient, but embedding similarity does not always reflect whether a memory contains evidence relevant to the current query. Large language model (LLM) rerankers provide stronger query-conditioned relevance scores, yet stateless reranking repeatedly scores a large candidate pool and discards these scores after each query. We introduce EARM, an experience-amortized reranking framework that treats previously acquired LLM relevance scores as reusable retrieval experience. EARM stores sparse query--memory relevance scores in an online matrix, learns their shared structure through causal matrix completion, and combines a small set of newly observed scores with estimated scores to rerank the remaining candidates. The scoring budget decreases as experience accumulates, changing LLM reranking from a repeated per-query expense into a retrieval capability learned over an agent's lifetime. Experiments on long-term conversational memory show that mixed observed-and-estimated reranking improves answer accuracy over semantic retrieval by up to 6.62% and remains effective when only 17.5% of candidates receive direct LLM relevance scores, thereby substantially reducing the inference overhead of LLM reranking. These results motivate a broader view of agent memory: a long-lived agent should remember not only past content, but also how that content has proved useful for retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EARM（经验摊销重排序）框架，将以往LLM重排序产生的相关性分数作为可复用的检索经验存储起来，通过因果矩阵补全学习其共享结构，将LLM重排序从每次查询的重复开销转变为agent生命周期中习得的检索能力，在长期对话记忆中相比语义检索提升高达6.62%的答案准确率，且仅需17.5%的候选直接获得LLM分数即可保持有效。
AI.motivation: 现有的长期语言模型agent会累积跨交互的记忆，但其检索器不会累积检索经验。语义检索高效但嵌入相似度并不总能反映记忆是否包含与当前查询相关的证据。LLM重排序器虽能提供更强的查询条件相关性分数，但无状态重排序每次都要对大量候选池打分并在查询后丢弃分数，造成高昂的重复推理开销。
AI.method: EARM将先前获得的LLM相关性分数视为可复用的检索经验。具体地，它将稀疏的查询-记忆相关性分数存储在一个在线矩阵中，通过因果矩阵补全学习其共享结构，然后将少量新观测到的分数与估计分数结合，对剩余候选进行重排序。随着经验累积，打分预算逐渐减少。
AI.result: 在长期对话记忆实验中，混合的观测-估计重排序相比语义检索在答案准确率上提升高达6.62%，且当仅17.5%的候选获得直接LLM相关性分数时仍然有效，大幅降低了LLM重排序的推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果支持对agent记忆的更广视角：一个长寿的agent不仅应记住过去的内容，还应记住这些内容在检索中被证明有用的方式，即将检索经验本身作为记忆的一部分加以累积和利用。

title: LoViF 2026 The First Challenge on Unified Removal of Raindrops and Reflections: Methods and Results
summary: This workshop paper comprehensively reviews the First Challenge on Unified Removal of Raindrops and Reflections. The challenge aims to address a frequently encountered practical problem in the field of autonomous driving, i.e., raindrop-reflection composite degradation on rainy days. This competition attracted 149 registered participants and received 12 valid final submissions with corresponding fact sheets, significantly contributing to the progress of unified removal of raindrops and reflections. All the methods are developed and evaluated on our real-shot RainDrop and ReFlection (RDRF) dataset. A detailed analysis of the submitted methods and corresponding results is provided in this report, which highlights effective approaches and provides interesting insights for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文全面回顾了首届雨滴与反射统一去除挑战赛，该挑战针对自动驾驶中雨天雨滴-反射复合退化问题。比赛吸引了149名注册参与者，收到12份有效提交。所有方法在真实拍摄的RDRF数据集上开发和评估，报告详细分析了各提交方法及结果，为未来研究提供了有效思路和有趣见解。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶在雨天常面临雨滴和反射同时存在的复合图像退化问题，这是一个实际且尚未充分解决的任务。举办该挑战赛旨在推动雨滴与反射统一去除研究的发展，汇集社区力量解决这一实际问题。
AI.method: 组织首届雨滴与反射统一去除挑战赛，构建真实拍摄的RDRF数据集，吸引全球参与者提交方法，并对所有提交的方法进行系统性的结果分析和对比评估。
AI.result: 共149名参与者注册，收到12份有效最终提交及相关fact sheets，各方法在RDRF数据集上完成开发和评估，报告呈现了详细的性能对比分析。
AI.conclusion: 该挑战赛显著推动了雨滴与反射统一去除研究的进展，通过详细分析突出了有效的方法路径，并为未来相关研究提供了有价值的见解和方向指引。

title: TailSieve: Partial-Rollout-Guided Tail Routing for LLM Rollouts
summary:
Large-scale rollouts have become a core component of modern LLM systems, spanning reinforcement learning (RL) post-training, on-policy distillation (OPD), and sampling-heavy evaluation pipelines. Unlike online serving, which is typically optimized for request-level latency and throughput, a small number of long-tail generations can dominate the end-to-end makespan of an entire rollout step. In practice, rollout requests are often routed uniformly across replicas, which can place extremely long generations inside high-concurrency decoding batches.
  To address this, we present TailSieve, a partial-rollout-guided framework that jointly controls tail routing and replica allocation for LLM rollouts. In an idealized setting with known completion lengths, we show that makespan-optimal routing in the long-tail regime combines tail isolation with load balancing, and that a simple top-k policy closely approximates this offline optimum. Leveraging the observation that long-tail prompts tend to remain long-tailed across policy updates, TailSieve uses partial rollouts as a training-free signal for identifying candidate tail groups. A hierarchical controller then jointly adapts the number of isolated groups and the replica split between the tail and bulk pools using collected response-work history and a measured concurrency-throughput model. TailSieve achieves up to 1.67x routing-only speedup over uniform group routing. The resulting low-concurrency tail pool further enables route-specialized speculative decoding with MTP or DFlash, achieving up to 2.59x speedup over uniform routing. Selected prompts are regenerated under the current policy, preserving on-policy generation and avoiding additional routing-induced length bias in steady state.

AI.tldr: TailSieve是一个面向LLM大规模rollout场景的偏态路由与副本分配框架，通过部分rollout识别长尾提示，采用层级控制器联合调整隔离组数量和副本分配，实现长尾请求与常规请求的分离处理，相比均匀路由最高获得1.67x路由加速和2.59x整体加速。
AI.motivation: 大规模rollout已成为现代LLM系统的核心组件（RL后训练、on-policy蒸馏、采样评估等），但与在线服务不同，rollout中少数长尾生成会主导整个阶段的端到端makespan。实践中rollout请求通常均匀路由到各副本，导致极长生成被放入高并发的解码批次中，造成严重的效率瓶颈。
AI.method: TailSieve采用部分rollout引导的框架：(1) 在已知完成长度的理想化设置下，证明长尾区域makespan最优路由需要结合尾部隔离与负载均衡，简单top-k策略可接近离线最优；(2) 利用长尾提示在策略更新间保持长尾的特性，用部分rollout作为无训练信号识别候选尾组；(3) 层级控制器基于响应工作历史和并发-吞吐量模型，联合自适应调整隔离组数量和尾部/常规池之间的副本分配；(4) 通过当前策略重新生成选中提示，保持on-policy生成并避免长度偏差。
AI.result: TailSieve在路由层面相比均匀组路由实现最高1.67x加速；由此产生的低并发尾部池支持路由特化的投机解码（MTP或DFlash），整体相比均匀路由最高获得2.59x加速。
AI.conclusion: TailSieve通过将长尾请求从高并发批次中隔离出来并自适应分配副本资源，显著提升了LLM rollout阶段端到端的效率，同时保持了on-policy生成的一致性，为大规模rollout系统提供了一种实用的尾部管理方案。

title: Seeing the Unseen: Semantic-in-Gaussian for Sparse-View 3D Generalization
comment: Accepted at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on 3DWM
summary: Generalizable 3D Gaussian Splatting (G-3DGS) has emerged as a promising approach for novel view synthesis undersparse-view settings. However, existing frameworks remain restricted by pixel-aligned Gaussian estimation, whichstruggles in partially observed or occluded regions and often leads to incomplete surfaces or structural collapse. Toaddress these challenges, we propose SeeU (Seeing the Unseen), a novel G-3DGS framework. We frame its core design asSemantic-in-Gaussian: semantic-conditioned refinement in Gaussian space. Specifically, we introduce a Cross-viewEntropy-Aware (CEA) module that aggregates multi-view semantic and geometric cues into compact embeddings. Theseembeddings guide the Conditional Gaussian Transformer, which applies residual updates to coarse Gaussians, helpingrecover under-constrained regions of partially observed structures while preserving surface consistency. Comprehensiveexperiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SeeU consistently improves rendering quality and structuralcompleteness while retaining efficient feed-forward inference. Especially under challenging extrapolation settings,SeeU achieves an average improvement of 2.44 dB in PSNR compared to recent SOTA G-3DGS methods.

AI.tldr: 提出了SeeU，一个基于语义条件化的通用3D高斯泼溅（G-3DGS）框架，通过跨视角熵感知模块和条件高斯Transformer来恢复部分被遮挡或观察不足区域的几何结构，提升渲染质量和结构完整性。
AI.motivation: 现有G-3DGS框架局限于像素对齐的高斯估计，在部分观察或遮挡区域表现不佳，容易导致表面不完整或结构坍塌。需要一种能够"看到未见区域"的方法来缓解这一问题。
AI.method: 提出SeeU框架，核心设计为"语义在高斯中"（Semantic-in-Gaussian）：1）引入跨视角熵感知（CEA）模块，聚合多视角语义和几何线索为紧凑嵌入；2）这些嵌入引导条件高斯Transformer，对粗略高斯进行残差更新，恢复约束不足区域的局部结构并保持表面一致性。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，SeeU持续提升渲染质量和结构完整性，同时保持高效的前馈推理。在具有挑战性的外推设置下，相比最新SOTA G-3DDS方法，PSNR平均提升2.44 dB。
AI.conclusion: SeeU通过将语义信息融入高斯空间进行条件化精炼，有效解决了稀疏视角下部分观察或遮挡区域的结构恢复问题，在不牺牲推理效率的前提下显著提升了G-3DGS方法的表现。

title: Performance of a domain-specific large language model in answering patient questions in psychiatry
summary: Background This study was designed to evaluate whether a domain-specific large language model (LLM) trained exclusively on patient education resources can answer questions about psychiatric medications, in a manner superior to LLM chatbots. We developed an LLM ("MIND") fine-tuned for clinical fidelity, trained on patient education resources from authoritative medical organizations. Methods We compared the responses of MIND, ChatGPT, and OpenEvidence to patient questions about escitalopram, using two methods: (1) computer analysis according to a rubric measuring accuracy, clarity, completeness, nuance, safety, and referral appropriateness; (2) ratings from N=10 board-licensed psychiatrists on similar metrics. Results When rated by rubric, MIND was rated highest in all domains (p<0.001). When rated by psychiatrists, ChatGPT was rated accurate more often than MIND with a negligible effect size (p=0.021, r=0.073); MIND was rated complete more often than ChatGPT with a small effect size (p<0.001, r=0.160); and MIND and ChatGPT were rated safe with the same frequency (p=0.955, r=0.002). The majority of psychiatrists preferred the responses generated by ChatGPT (57.6%) compared to MIND (42.4%, p=0.003). Conclusions MIND was able to answer many questions about escitalopram in a manner deemed accurate, complete, and safe by psychiatrists the majority of the time. However, despite MIND's ability to provide more complete responses, psychiatrists preferred ChatGPT's responses. MIND represents a step towards building safe LLM systems to enhance patient education in psychiatry.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个专门用于精神病学患者教育的领域特定大语言模型"MIND"，并与ChatGPT和OpenEvidence进行比较。通过计算机评分标准和10位精神科医生的评估，MIND在客观评分上表现最佳，但精神科医生主观上更偏好ChatGPT的回答，尽管MIND的回答更完整且同样安全。
AI.motivation: 评估领域特定的大语言模型（仅基于权威患者教育资源训练）是否能在回答精神科药物相关问题时优于通用LLM聊天机器人，以探索构建更安全、更专业的患者教育AI系统的可能性。
AI.method: 开发了针对临床保真度微调的MIND模型，使用来自权威医疗组织的患者教育资源训练。将MIND、ChatGPT和OpenEvidence对艾司西酞普兰相关患者问题的回答，通过两种方式进行评估：(1)基于准确性、清晰度、完整性、细致度、安全性和转诊适当性的计算机评分标准分析；(2)由10位委员会认证的精神科医生进行评分。
AI.result: 在客观评分标准下，MIND在所有领域得分最高（p<0.001）。在精神科医生评估中：ChatGPT在准确性上略优于MIND（效应量极小，r=0.073）；MIND在完整性上优于ChatGPT（效应量小，r=0.160）；两者安全性评分相同（r=0.002）。但多数精神科医生（57.6%）偏好ChatGPT的回答，而非MIND（42.4%）。
AI.conclusion: MIND能够以精神科医生认可的方式回答关于艾司西酞普兰的多数问题，体现了构建安全LLM系统的可能性。但尽管MIND回答更完整，精神科医生仍偏好ChatGPT的回答，说明通用模型在用户体验或风格上可能有优势。MIND是向提升精神病学患者教育的安全LLM系统迈出的一步。

title: Object-Uni: A Unified Model for Object-Centric Spatial Understanding and Controllable Generation
summary: Unified models for visual understanding and generation have made rapid progress, yet they still lack the ability to understand and manipulate the spatial states of object instances. Existing models can describe objects in natural language, but they struggle to precisely represent continuous object poses and generate geometrically consistent images under target viewpoints. To mitigate this, we propose \emph{Object-Uni}, a unified model for object-centric spatial understanding and controllable generation. Specifically, we formulate object-centric spatial intelligence as a unified problem connecting pose perception, spatial reasoning, pose-conditioned generation, and object-centric novel view synthesis. We treat object pose as an explicit geometric variable shared by understanding and generation, rather than merely a prediction label or control signal. To make pose usable by multimodal large language models, we propose a viewpoint-based orientation abstraction that maps orientation into structured viewpoint descriptions while preserving continuous geometric supervision. We further construct an object-centric spatial benchmark (UniSpatial-80K) and train a unified model with an object-token-grounded pose anchor to associate each instance with its pose state. Experiments show that our model improves object-level pose understanding and pose-controllable generation, moving unified models from describing objects toward manipulating spatial states.

AI.tldr: 提出了Object-Uni，一个统一的物体中心空间理解与可控生成模型，将物体姿态作为显式几何变量连接理解和生成，实现姿态感知、空间推理、姿态条件生成和物体中心新视角合成。
AI.motivation: 现有统一视觉理解与生成模型虽然能描述物体，但无法精确表示连续物体姿态，也难以生成在目标视角下几何一致的图像。需要弥合从描述物体到操纵物体空间状态之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 将物体姿态作为理解和生成共享的显式几何变量；提出基于视点的方向抽象方法，将方向映射为结构化视点描述同时保留连续几何监督；构建物体中心空间基准UniSpatial-80K；训练统一模型，使用物体token锚定的姿态锚点将每个实例与其姿态状态关联。
AI.result: 实验表明该模型在物体级姿态理解和姿态可控生成方面均有提升，使统一模型从描述物体进阶到操纵空间状态。
AI.conclusion: 通过将姿态作为跨理解和生成的显式几何中间变量，统一模型能够实现物体中心的空间智能，突破了纯语言描述物体的局限。

title: Beyond the Harness: End-to-End Optimization of Context Artifacts for Enterprise Text-to-SQL
summary: Deploying LLMs for enterprise Text-to-SQL is bottlenecked less by the model than by what context reaches it: business logic spans thousands of tables, and no model can ingest a full catalog at once. We argue that the most effective place to intervene is therefore the \emph{knowledge-base context} the model consumes, and that this context should be \emph{constructed} from historical usage rather than tuned for as a fixed input. Using a query-DAG decomposition--the same family of intermediates that enterprise benchmarks like BEAVER annotate, here recovered from production SQL--we compare the value of oracle query graphs versus retrieved knowledge-base context. In this ablation, retrieved knowledge-base context provides the largest marginal improvement when added to the full oracle graph. Building on this, we optimize a distillation procedure that turns historical query profiles into reusable SQL reference cards. On a benchmark of 5176 production queries from a major online retailer, optimizing these context artifacts yields larger gains (${\sim}12$--$25\%$ AST similarity) than optimizing the retrieval harness (${\sim}3$--$12\%$). On the public BEAVER benchmark, which lacks the production-usage signals available in our internal setting, the picture is more mixed: table cards alone perform about the same as raw historical SQL. The best optimized variant retrieves both cards and raw SQL, scoring $9.00\%$ versus $6.33\%$ (p-value $0.12$) for the comparable baseline on a held-out $N{=}300$ subset, using retrieved context and harness changes but no agentic loop.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过构建知识库上下文（而非优化模型本身）来提升企业级Text-to-SQL性能。核心方法是将历史查询蒸馏为可复用的SQL参考卡片，实验表明在5176条生产查询上优化上下文工件比优化检索机制带来更大增益（12-25% vs 3-12% AST相似度），在BEAVER公开基准上最佳变体结合卡片与原始SQL获得9.00% vs 6.33%的效果。
AI.motivation: 企业级Text-to-SQL的瓶颈不在于模型本身，而在于模型接收到的上下文——业务逻辑跨越数千张表，模型无法一次性摄入完整目录。因此最有效的干预点应是模型消费的知识库上下文，且该上下文应从历史使用中构建而非作为固定输入调优。
AI.method: 采用查询DAG分解（从生产SQL中恢复，与BEAVER等企业基准标注的中间表示同族）。首先进行消融实验比较oracle查询图与检索到的知识库上下文的价值；在此基础上优化蒸馏流程，将历史查询画像转化为可复用的SQL参考卡片。
AI.result: 在5176条来自大型在线零售商的生产查询基准上，优化上下文工件比优化检索机制带来更大收益（约12-25% vs 3-12% AST相似度）。在BEAVER公开基准上结果较混合：仅用表格卡片与用原始历史SQL效果相当；最佳优化变体同时检索卡片与原始SQL，在N=300的预留子集上得分为9.00% vs 6.33%（p值0.12），使用了检索上下文与机制改动但无agentic循环。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在具备生产使用信号的内部环境中，从历史查询构建的知识库上下文工件（SQL参考卡片）能显著提升Text-to-SQL性能，且优于单纯优化检索机制。但在缺乏生产使用信号的公开基准上效果不明确，说明历史使用信号是该方法发挥效力的关键前提。

title: ByteAction: Byte-space Action Recognition Foundation Model
summary: Byte-space Action Recognition (BAR) aims to recognize human actions directly from compressed image bitstreams without any pixel decoding. By operating entirely in byte space, BAR is inherently independent of file integrity and pixel-level reconstruction, making it naturally applicable to privacy-sensitive scenarios and robust against bitstream corruption. In this paper, we propose ByteAction, a BAR foundation model that achieves accurate action recognition on corrupted image bitstreams. ByteAction follows a dual-view byte-level recognition framework. It constructs weakly and strongly corrupted bitstream views, which are augmented by Bitstream Pattern Augmentation (BPA) and encoded with a shared ByteFormer backbone. The model is optimized with both classification and corruption consistency objectives. Specifically, we propose Bitstream Pattern Augmentation (BPA), which reshapes one-dimensional byte sequences into two-dimensional byte matrix and applies region-level erasure to encourage the model to learn robust cross-region byte dependencies. We further propose a Corruption Consistency Training strategy that constrains the model to maintain stable predictions across different corruption severities through bidirectional KL divergence. Experiments on the image bitstream from Stanford40, PPMI, and PASCAL VOC 2012 Action demonstrate that ByteAction achieves state-of-the-art corruption robustness across all scenarios while maintaining competitive intact bitstream performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ByteAction，一个面向字节空间动作识别（BAR）的基础模型，无需像素解码即可直接从压缩图像比特流中识别人类动作，在损坏比特流上实现最先进的鲁棒性，同时在完整比特流上保持有竞争力的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有动作识别通常依赖像素级解码，这在隐私敏感场景下存在风险，且在面对比特流损坏时表现脆弱。BAR通过在字节空间直接操作，天然具备隐私保护和抗损坏能力，但目前缺乏高性能的BAR基础模型。
AI.method: ByteAction采用双视角字节级识别框架：1）构建弱损坏和强损坏两种比特流视角，通过Bitstream Pattern Augmentation (BPA)增强——将一维字节序列重塑为二维字节矩阵并应用区域级擦除，促使模型学习鲁棒的跨区域字节依赖；2）提出Corruption Consistency Training策略，通过双向KL散度约束模型在不同损坏严重程度下保持稳定预测。模型使用共享的ByteFormer骨干网络编码，结合分类损失和损坏一致性目标进行优化。
AI.result: 在Stanford40、PPMI和PASCAL VOC 2012 Action的图像比特流实验中，ByteAction在所有场景下实现了最先进的损坏鲁棒性，同时保持了有竞争力的完整比特流性能。
AI.conclusion: ByteAction证明了直接在字节空间进行动作识别的可行性，通过区域级字节增强和一致性训练，同时兼顾了隐私保护、损坏鲁棒性和识别精度，为BAR领域提供了新的基础模型方案。

title: Let the Bullets Fly: Multimodal Fake News Detection with Temporal-Aligned Generative Danmaku
summary: The social interactions among crowds via \textit{Danmaku} (a.k.a., bullet comments) on modern multimedia platforms can facilitate both viewpoint conflicts and consensus, providing fine-grained discriminative social signals that can benefit fake news detection. However, the inherent accumulation latency of \textit{Danmaku} in real-world scenarios violates the real-time necessity of fake news detection, making the studies of \textit{Danmaku}-related fake news detection underexplored. To break this violation, we simulate this temporal-aware user interactive process by proposing a novel temporal \textbf{Gen}erative \textbf{da}nmaku framework, called \textbf{Genda}, which consists of: (1) a \textit{Danmaku} Trigger for predicting the timing and intensity of user reactions; and (2) a \textit{Danmaku} Generator for synthesizing corresponding semantic and emotional expressions, thereby mutually constructing a temporally aligned and human-like pseudo \textit{Danmaku} streams. To make the generated \textit{Danmaku} useful for identifying fake news videos, we further design a \textit{Danmaku}-guided Temporal Multimodal fake news detection model - \textbf{DM-FEND}, which enables fine-grained multimodal interactions among video, audio, text, and \textit{Danmaku}, enhancing dynamic modalities alignment and semantic noise inhibition. The experimental results demonstrate that \emph{DM-FEND} consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across both Chinese (FakeSV) and English (FakeTT) benchmarks. Further ablations validate the crucial role of temporal \textit{Danmaku} modeling in enhancing robustness and discriminative capability. Finally, this study offers a bright and robust solution for multimodal fake news detection in modern social interactive fashions by bridging the temporal inconsistency between news and user behaviors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Genda框架，通过时间感知的生成式弹幕模拟（包含弹幕触发器预测用户反应时机与强度，以及弹幕生成器合成语义和情感表达）来解决真实场景中弹幕累积延迟与假新闻检测实时性需求之间的矛盾。同时设计了弹幕引导的时间多模态假新闻检测模型DM-FEND，实现视频、音频、文本与弹幕的细粒度多模态交互，在中英文基准上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 弹幕（bullet comments）作为现代多媒体平台上用户社交互动的载体，蕴含丰富的观点冲突与共识信号，可有效辅助假新闻检测。然而，真实场景中弹幕的累积存在固有延迟，违背了假新闻检测的实时性需求，导致相关研究尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 提出Genda框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 弹幕触发器（Danmaku Trigger）—预测用户反应的时机与强度；(2) 弹幕生成器（Danmaku Generator）—合成对应的语义与情感表达，两者共同构建时间对齐且类人的伪弹幕流。在此基础上设计DM-FEND检测模型，实现视频、音频、文本与弹幕间的细粒度多模态交互，增强动态模态对齐并抑制语义噪声。
AI.result: DM-FEND在中文基准（FakeSV）和英文基准（FakeTT）上均一致优于最先进基线方法。消融实验验证了时间弹幕建模在增强模型鲁棒性和判别能力方面的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 本研究通过弥合新闻与用户行为之间的时间不一致性，为现代社交互动场景下的多模态假新闻检测提供了明亮且稳健的解决方案。

title: LagrangeGS: Non-Conservative Lagrangian System on Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) achieves photorealistic reconstruction of time-varying scenes, and recent physics-aware extensions improve extrapolation by explicitly predicting velocity fields. However, these extensions merely fit vector fields to visual deformations without satisfying Lagrangian mechanics, leading to three major issues: (i) physically inconsistent trajectories, (ii) lack of time-reversibility, and (iii) geometric collapse during long-term extrapolation. In this paper, we propose LagrangeGS, which formulates dynamic 3DGS as a non-conservative Lagrangian system. While this Lagrangian formulation fundamentally solves (i), a direct application of general LNNs to dynamic 3DGS requires a large velocity-Hessian inversion for millions of Gaussian particles. To overcome this computational bottleneck, we approximate the velocity-Hessian as an identity matrix, decoupling particle dynamics for computational tractability. For (ii), we restrict the non-conservative forces to be explicitly time independent, enabling consistent backward integration. Finally, to address (iii), we introduce local rigid alignment that regularizes particle trajectories. Extensive evaluations on dynamic scene benchmarks demonstrate that LagrangeGS enables stable long-term extrapolation, consistent time reversal, and counterfactual physics-based editing without retraining.

AI.tldr: LagrangeGS将动态3D高斯泼溅(Dynamic 3DGS)建模为非保守拉格朗日系统，通过近似速度-海森矩阵为单位矩阵解决计算瓶颈，引入局部刚性对齐实现稳定的长期外推、时间可逆性及物理编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有物理感知的动态3DGS扩展仅将向量场拟合到视觉形变上，未满足拉格朗日力学，导致三个问题：(i)物理不一致的轨迹、(ii)缺乏时间可逆性、(iii)长期外推时的几何塌缩。
AI.method: 1. 将动态3DGS形式化为非保守拉格朗日系统，从根本上解决轨迹不一致问题；2. 将速度-海森矩阵近似为单位矩阵，解耦粒子动力学以克服数百万高斯粒子的计算瓶颈；3. 将非保守力限制为显式时间无关，实现一致的向后积分（时间可逆）；4. 引入局部刚性对齐来正则化粒子轨迹，防止长期外推几何塌缩。
AI.result: 在动态场景基准上的大量评估表明，LagrangeGS实现了稳定的长期外推、一致的时间反转以及无需重训练的反事实物理编辑。
AI.conclusion: 通过将物理约束以拉格朗日力学形式引入动态3DGS，LagrangeGS在保持计算可行性的同时，显著提升了动态场景重建的物理一致性和时间可逆性，并支持无需重训练的物理编辑能力。

title: FinixDoc: Rethinking Financial Document Parsing Beyond Saturated Benchmarks
summary: Financial document parsing requires accuracy, structural consistency, and verifiability that current benchmarks often fail to reflect. We present FinixDoc, an end-to-end agentic parsing system for real-world financial documents, with FinixDoc-VL, a 4B-scale vision-language model built on Qwen3-VL-4B, as its core parser. To characterize the gap between benchmark and deployment performance, we introduce a Document Parsing Capability Matrix organized along two practical axes: visual quality and document scale. Guided by this matrix, FinixDoc-VL is trained with a domain-adapted recipe combining homoglyph-aware contrastive learning and multi-stage reinforcement learning with composite domain-specific rewards. To better leverage our accumulated advantage in low-quality financial-document data and support large-scale, high-quality data production, we further build a human-in-the-loop Data Factory pipeline with confidence-aware expert review. For evaluation, we construct FinixDocBench, a financial-domain evaluation suite covering digital-native, camera-captured, ultra-large-page, and internal-workflow scenarios, with a compliance-reviewed subset released alongside this technical report. On its main subsets, FinixDoc-VL achieves the highest overall score (81.43) among evaluated baselines, outperforming the next-best open-source model by 5.13 points, with the largest gains on internal financial workflows (FinixInner: 84.08 vs. 78.73).

AI.tldr: 本文提出FinixDoc，一个端到端的智能体金融文档解析系统，其核心解析器FinixDoc-VL是基于Qwen3-VL-4B构建的4B规模视觉语言模型。通过引入文档解析能力矩阵、领域自适应训练配方（包括同形字感知对比学习和多阶段强化学习）、人机协同数据工厂流水线，以及金融领域评估套件FinixDocBench，在多个子集上达到了最优性能（总体得分81.43，超越次优开源模型5.13分）。
AI.motivation: 现有基准无法反映金融文档解析在真实部署中对准确性、结构一致性和可验证性的要求，存在基准性能与部署性能之间的差距。作者旨在构建一个能在真实金融场景中高效工作的解析系统。
AI.method: 1) 提出文档解析能力矩阵，沿视觉质量和文档规模两个维度组织；2) FinixDoc-VL采用同形字感知对比学习+多阶段强化学习（复合领域特定奖励）的训练配方；3) 构建人机协同Data Factory流水线，包含置信度感知的专家审核机制；4) 构建FinixDocBench评估套件，覆盖数字原生、相机拍摄、超大页面和内部工作流等场景。
AI.result: FinixDoc-VL在FinixDocBench主要子集上获得最高总体得分81.43，超越次优开源模型5.13分；在内部金融工作流（FinixInner）上优势最大，得分84.08对比78.73。
AI.conclusion: FinixDoc系统通过针对性的领域自适应训练和数据生产流水线，有效缩小了金融文档解析在基准测试与真实部署之间的性能差距，尤其在内部金融工作流场景中表现突出。

title: Can We Perform Online RL for Image Editing without Editing Rewards?
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables direct preference optimization for image editing through editing-specific rewards, which remain less developed due to costly triplet supervision and complex task-dependent calibration. In contrast, text-to-image (T2I) generation benefits from a mature and diverse reward ecosystem spanning semantic alignment, aesthetics, realism, glyph shape, and other visual preferences. Extending this ecosystem to image editing would substantially broaden the range of visual preferences accessible to RL-based optimization, prompting the central question: \emph{Can We Perform Image Editing RL without Editing Rewards?} In this paper, we argue that the standard image editing dimensions have potential to be mapped to the T2I reward space: image quality can transfer directly, prompt following can be aligned through a description of the desired visual state, and reference consistency admits a coarse semantic conversion by encoding the source content to preserve. However, editing instructions specify relative changes, whereas T2I rewards require self-contained target descriptions; moreover, semantically valid captions from generic vision-language models may be incompatible with the frozen reward. Hence, we further introduce Lever-Edit, a two-stage framework that learns a reward-aligned captioner for counterfactual target descriptions, freezes it, and optimizes the editing policy solely with the transferred T2I reward. Experiments show competitive editing alignment and source preservation against editing-reward-based fine-tuning, while outperforming intuitive transfer baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Lever-Edit框架，通过将成熟的T2I奖励生态系统迁移到图像编辑领域，无需编辑特定的奖励即可进行强化学习优化。核心思路是将编辑维度映射到T2I奖励空间，并学习一个与奖励对齐的描述器来生成反事实目标描述，从而用T2I奖励直接优化编辑策略。
AI.motivation: 图像编辑的强化学习优化受限于缺乏开发良好的编辑特定奖励，因为三元组监督成本高且任务相关校准复杂；而T2I生成领域拥有成熟多样的奖励生态（语义对齐、美学、真实感等），作者希望将这种奖励生态扩展到图像编辑领域以拓宽可优化的视觉偏好范围。
AI.method: 提出Lever-Edit两阶段框架：(1) 将编辑维度映射到T2I奖励空间——图像质量直接迁移，提示遵循通过期望视觉状态描述对齐，参考一致性通过编码源内容进行粗略语义转换；(2) 学习一个奖励对齐的描述器生成反事实目标描述并冻结，仅用迁移后的T2I奖励优化编辑策略。
AI.result: 实验表明，Lever-Edit在编辑对齐和源内容保持方面与基于编辑奖励的微调方法竞争力相当，同时优于直觉性的迁移基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了T2I奖励生态可以成功迁移到图像编辑领域，无需专门的编辑奖励即可实现有效的强化学习优化，为图像编辑RL开辟了新的研究方向。

title: GSAR: Goal-State-Anchor Rewards for Mobile GUI Agents with Self-Evolving Data Synthesis
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) based GUI agents stand to benefit significantly from online reinforcement learning (RL). However, their training is bottlenecked by two fundamental issues: current data synthesis methods for GUI Agents rely on specific environments and struggle to generate diverse data, while existing evaluators either suffer from limited scalability or provide inaccurate and unreliable reward signals. To overcome these challenges, we introduce GSAR (Goal-State-Anchor Reward), a RL reward framework that supports scalable task generation and delivers reliable reward signals for stable and efficient policy optimization. Our approach features self-evolving data synthesis, which produces multiple environments through task execution and generates diverse tasks and goal states. Complementing this, a state-anchor mechanism automatically annotates task-relevant UI elements in successful goal states as reference anchors. During RL training, these reference anchors provide accurate, scalable reward signals that substantially enhance efficiency. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our framework achieves over 90% accuracy on offline trajectory verification and performs closest to rule-based methods. Furthermore, agents trained using our reward framework exhibit strong performance on both AndroidWorld and our constructed benchmark, establishing a scalable approach for GUI agent training.

AI.tldr: GSAR是一个为GUI智能体设计的RL奖励框架，通过自进化数据合成生成多样化的任务和状态，并利用状态锚点机制提供准确的奖励信号，实现了可扩展的任务生成和可靠的策略优化。
AI.motivation: 现有的VLM-based GUI智能体在在线强化学习训练中面临两大瓶颈：(1) 数据合成方法依赖特定环境，难以生成多样化数据；(2) 现有评估器要么扩展性有限，要么奖励信号不准确不可靠。
AI.method: 提出GSAR框架，包含两个关键组件：(1) 自进化数据合成——通过任务执行生成多个环境，产生多样化的任务和目标状态；(2) 状态锚点机制——自动标注成功目标状态中的任务相关UI元素作为参考锚点，在RL训练中提供准确且可扩展的奖励信号。
AI.result: 在离线轨迹验证上达到90%以上的准确率，表现最接近基于规则的方法。使用该奖励框架训练的智能体在AndroidWorld和自建基准上都表现出强劲性能。
AI.conclusion: GSAR建立了一种可扩展的GUI智能体训练方法，通过锚定目标状态提供可靠奖励信号，有效解决了数据多样性不足和奖励不准确的问题。

title: OmicSync: Reliability-Aware Spatial Multi-Omics Clustering with Evidence-Constrained LLM Reasoning
summary: Spatial multi-omics technologies jointly profile gene expression, surface proteins, and histology at each tissue spot, yet most spatial domain discovery methods provide only cluster assignments, without indicating assignment reliability, modality contributions, or why a domain decision should be trusted. We present OmicSync, a reliability-aware spatial multi-omics framework that couples unsupervised domain clustering with evidence-constrained LLM reasoning using model-derived per-spot signals, including assignment confidence, epistemic routing uncertainty, and modality-routing weights. These signals are converted into structured evidence dictionaries and used to generate standard, stepwise, counterfactual, contrastive, and uncertainty-focused explanations. OmicSync integrates a KAN-GCN backbone with spatial encoding, cross-modal fusion, uncertainty-aware routing, cell-type supervision, and missing-modality imputation. We further introduce OmicSync-R, which closes the reasoning-clustering loop by using automatically computed reasoning-quality scores as REINFORCE rewards, allowing reasoning coherence to shape the latent structure without backpropagating through the language model. Across four 10x CytAssist FFPE spatial proteomics benchmarks, OmicSync achieves the best average rank on Human Tonsil (1.44), Glioblastoma (1.78), and Tonsil Add-on (1.22), and second-best on Human Breast Cancer (2.33). OmicSync-R further improves ARI on Human Breast Cancer from 45.73 to 46.72 and outperforms existing methods on six of nine clustering metrics. Together, OmicSync and OmicSync-R enable reliability-aware, spot-level auditable spatial domain discovery guided by evidence-constrained reasoning.

AI.tldr: OmicSync是一个可靠性感知的空间多组学域发现框架，将无监督聚类与证据约束的LLM推理相结合，利用模型导出的逐点信号（如分配置信度、认知路由不确定性和模态路由权重）生成多种解释，并通过OmicSync-R用推理质量分数作为强化学习奖励来闭环优化聚类结构。
AI.motivation: 现有的空间域发现方法通常只提供聚类标签，缺乏对分配可靠性的指示、模态贡献的说明，以及域决策为何可信的解释，导致模型结果难以审计和信任。
AI.method: OmicSync采用KAN-GCN骨干网络，整合空间编码、跨模态融合、不确定性感知路由、细胞类型监督和缺失模态插补；模型衍生信号被转换为结构化证据字典，生成标准、逐步、反事实、对比和不确定性聚焦等五类解释。OmicSync-R进一步用自动计算的推理质量分数作为REINFORCE奖励，在不通过语言模型反向传播的情况下，让推理连贯性塑造潜在结构。
AI.result: 在四个10x CytAssist FFPE空间蛋白质组学基准上，OmicSync在人类扁桃体（1.44）、胶质母细胞瘤（1.78）和扁桃体附加（1.22）上取得最佳平均排名，在人类乳腺癌（2.33）上排名第二。OmicSync-R将乳腺癌ARI从45.73提升至46.72，并在九个聚类指标中的六个上优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: OmicSync和OmicSync-R共同实现了可靠性感知、逐点可审计的空间域发现，由证据约束的推理驱动，为空间多组学分析提供了可解释且值得信赖的解决方案。

title: Your AI, On a Dial: Controlling Investment Bias in LLMs with a Single Neuron
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in investment decision-making, yet prior work shows that they exhibit systematic, model-specific investment preferences. We study whether a model's overall investment stance can be calibrated to a specified direction and strength. We introduce an investment-bias dial, an inference-time intervention on a single neuron that continuously adjusts a model-level decision prior---its overall tendency toward buying or selling---without targeting specific firms or investment attributes. Using matched positive and negative evidence, we evaluate five open-weight LLMs and find that the dial produces monotonic changes in investment stance without modifying prompts or model parameters. At the response level, the dial shifts both investment decisions and the evidential emphasis of generated rationales under identical inputs. In an agentic retrieval setting, the dial also changes what information the model searches for, which evidence it selects, and which evidence is reflected in its final analysis. In a long-context evaluation, the dial maintains stable stance control as context length increases, whereas a matched system-prompt instruction progressively attenuates. We further show that changes in the dial propagate to security rankings and downstream portfolio composition in an exploratory backtest. Overall, our results show that an LLM's aggregate investment stance can be calibrated toward a specified target at inference time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"投资偏见旋钮"（investment-bias dial），通过在推理时对单个神经元进行干预，连续调整LLM整体的买卖倾向，无需修改提示词或模型参数，即可在多个LLM上实现单调的投资立场校准。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在投资决策中表现出系统性的、模型特定的投资偏好，这种不可控的偏好可能带来偏差和风险。因此需要一种能够在推理时对模型整体投资立场进行校准的方法，而不需要针对特定公司或投资属性进行干预。
AI.method: 提出"投资偏见旋钮"机制：对单个神经元进行推理时干预，连续调整模型层面的决策先验（买卖倾向）。使用匹配的正负证据对五个开源LLM进行评估，并在多种场景中验证：响应级分析、智能体检索场景、长上下文评估，以及探索性回测。
AI.result: 该旋钮在不修改提示词或参数的情况下产生单调的投资立场变化；影响投资决策和论证中的证据强调；改变智能体检索的信息、证据选择和分析；在长上下文中保持稳定的立场控制（而系统提示指令则逐渐衰减）；变化可传播至证券排名和投资组合构成。
AI.conclusion: LLM的总体投资立场可以在推理时被校准到指定方向和强度，为控制AI投资决策偏好提供了一种有效且可操作的手段。

title: GuidedFlow: An Attention-Guided Framework for Anomaly Detection in Additive Manufacturing
summary: Additive Manufacturing (AM) plays a vital role in the ongoing industrial revolution. However, quality control remains crucial and challenging due to printing defects or potential cyber-physical intrusions. Image or video-based anomaly detection is a key effort towards addressing these challenges. Various approaches have been explored in this domain, including reconstruction-based, embedding-based, and flow-based methods. Though normalizing flow-based methods address some of the core challenges of unforeseen defects and generalization while maintaining detection performance, existing approaches struggle with tiny/stringing defects common in 3D printing. In a small-data setting, this poses a limitation in generalization. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{GuidedFlow}, a novel attention-guided normalizing flow model for anomaly detection and localization. GuidedFlow employs a pre-trained ResNet model, fine-tuned on the domain dataset. An attention-guided spatial and temporal flow framework models the dynamics across multiple scales and frames. A Spatio-Temporal Attention Network (SAN) enables the flow model to prioritize relevant contextual cues from input frames. We evaluate GuidedFlow on our AM3D-AD dataset, consisting of benign and anomalous real 3D printed object images and videos. We also conduct a comparative study using the MVTec-AD industrial image anomaly detection dataset. Experimental results demonstrate that GuidedFlow outperforms most of the state-of-the-art models with enhanced detection accuracy and AUROC.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GuidedFlow，一种基于注意力引导的归一化流（normalizing flow）模型，用于3D打印增材制造中的异常检测与定位。该方法使用预训练ResNet微调，结合空间-时间注意力网络和多尺度流框架，解决现有方法对微小/拉丝缺陷检测不佳及小数据场景泛化不足的问题。在AM3D-AD和MVTec-AD数据集上验证了优越性能。
AI.motivation: 增材制造（3D打印）中质量监控至关重要，但存在打印缺陷和网络物理入侵等挑战。现有基于图像/视频的异常检测方法（重建式、嵌入式和流式）中，归一化流方法虽能处理未知缺陷和提升泛化能力，但对3D打印中常见的微小/拉丝缺陷检测效果不佳，且在小数据环境下泛化受限。
AI.method: 提出GuidedFlow模型，包含三个关键组件：(1) 在领域数据集上微调的预训练ResNet作为特征提取器；(2) 注意力引导的空间和时间归一化流框架，用于建模多尺度多帧的动态变化；(3) 空间-时间注意力网络（SAN），使流模型能够优先关注输入帧中的相关上下文线索。
AI.result: 在自建的AM3D-AD数据集（包含真实3D打印物体的良品和异常图像/视频）以及MVTec-AD工业图像异常检测数据集上进行评估，GuidedFlow在检测准确率和AUROC指标上优于大多数现有最先进模型。
AI.conclusion: GuidedFlow通过注意力引导的归一化流方法有效解决了3D打印微小缺陷检测和小数据泛化问题，为增材制造质量监控提供了更可靠的异常检测方案，并在标准工业数据集上展示了良好的迁移能力。

title: Proxy reliance in large language model decisions is uncalibrated to predictive evidence
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are entering decisions in triage and lending, where task-relevant inference must be distinguished from impermissible proxy use. Current audits ask whether decisions change when demographics change. But attributes correlated with a protected group carry predictive value, so a changed decision can be discrimination or sound inference. We measure causal proxy effects in four LLMs on a clinical-ranking task with known ground truth, where the reliance the evidence warrants can be computed exactly and used as the reference. One audit signal yields three verdicts: over-reliance, warranted and under-reliance. Under neutral labels every model relies on proxies with no information. Informative proxies draw all three. Social field names push reliance down, below the reference in one model. Two findings explain this. Reliance severely undertracks the evidence, and social-label suppression is fragile, since in-context examples raise it above zero in every model. Accuracy-based evaluation detects none of this.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一种新的审计信号，用于区分LLM在决策中的合理推断与不当代理使用，并通过临床排序任务精确测量四个LLM对受保护属性代理的依赖程度，发现过度依赖、合理依赖和依赖不足三种情况。
AI.motivation: 当前审计方法仅检查决策是否会因人口统计学特征改变而改变，但无法区分这是歧视行为还是合理的统计推断，因为与受保护群体相关的属性本身就携带预测信息。需要更精确的方法来区分合理推断与不当代理使用。
AI.method: 在具有已知真实标签的临床排序任务中测量LLM的因果代理效应。由于任务有确定的ground truth，可以精确计算证据所支持的依赖程度作为参考基准，进而将审计信号分类为过度依赖、合理依赖和依赖不足三种判定。
AI.result: 在中立标签下，所有模型都会依赖无信息的代理；在信息性代理下出现三种依赖情况。社会领域名会降低依赖，其中一个模型低于参考基准。发现两个关键问题：依赖严重低估了证据支持程度，以及社会标签抑制机制脆弱——上下文示例即可将其提升到零以上。基于准确率的评估无法检测到这些问题。
AI.conclusion: 现有基于准确率的审计方法无法捕捉LLM在代理使用上的细微偏差，需要采用基于证据参考的因果代理效应测量方法来更准确地评估LLM决策中的歧视性行为。

title: VersaDB: A High-Performance AI Storage Database for Unifying Mutimodal Datasets
summary: The AI field has been rapidly developing, leading to the emergence of a large number of AI training datasets of various types. These datasets contain different modalities, including text, images, audio, etc., and may come in various data storage formats. With the advancement of AI hardware, AI computation units like GPUs, TPUs, and NPUs can greatly accelerate the training speed of AI models, which in turn increases the demand for faster data processing. When using existing AI processing frameworks to handle datasets with different modalities and storage formats, processing speeds may be suboptimal due to issues such as data layout and the way users handle the data. Therefore, using a unified database to store multiple data formats can better manage and optimize data access. In this paper, we introduce VersaDB, a database designed specifically for AI datasets with various modalities. We implemented a page-based storage system, separating structured and unstructured data. Additionally, we generated B+ tree-based index files to accelerate data access. VersaDB supports automatic sharding and maintains a hierarchical metadata management system, with corresponding metadata maintained at the page, shard, and global levels, forming the foundation for the efficient operation of the database. We also focused on ease of use by providing APIs for directly converting datasets into VersaDB, as well as APIs for converting popular AI data storage formats (e.g., CSV, TFRecord, .bin) into VersaDB.Our experiments show that using VersaDB can achieve up to 5.35x acceleration and maintain consistent performance across different parallelism levels.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了VersaDB，一个专为多模态AI数据集设计的统一数据库系统。它采用基于页面的存储架构，分离结构化与非结构化数据，使用B+树索引加速访问，支持自动分片和多层级元数据管理，并提供API将常见AI数据格式（CSV、TFRecord、.bin等）直接转换入库。实验表明VersaDB可带来最高5.35倍的加速效果。
AI.motivation: 随着AI领域快速发展，涌现出大量包含不同模态（文本、图像、音频等）和多种存储格式的训练数据集。虽然GPU/TPU/NPU等硬件大幅加速了模型训练，但现有AI处理框架在处理异构格式数据时，因数据布局和用户处理方式等问题导致处理速度不理想。因此需要统一的数据库系统来存储多种数据格式，以更好地管理和优化数据访问。
AI.method: VersaDB采用以下核心设计：1) 基于页面的存储系统，将结构化与非结构化数据分离存储；2) 生成基于B+树的索引文件以加速数据访问；3) 支持自动分片（sharding）；4) 维护页面级、分片级和全局级别的层级化元数据管理系统；5) 提供便捷API，支持直接将数据集转换进VersaDB，以及将流行AI数据格式（CSV、TFRecord、.bin等）转换入库。
AI.result: 实验表明，使用VersaDB可以实现最高5.35倍的数据处理加速，并且在不同并行度下都能保持一致的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: VersaDB通过统一存储管理和优化数据访问，有效解决了多模态、多格式AI数据集处理速度不理想的问题，同时兼顾了易用性和性能稳定性，为AI数据管理提供了新的解决方案。

title: CDEG: Learning Decision-Critical Evidence for Long-Horizon Diagnostic Agents
summary: Unlike static medical question answering, long-horizon diagnosis captures the sequential nature of clinical practice: evidence is progressively acquired, integrated, and evaluated over multiple rounds of interaction before reaching a final diagnosis. However, existing doctor agents often fail when critical evidence is either not acquired or not adequately incorporated into diagnostic reasoning. Recent agentic approaches attempt to address these failures by reusing historical trajectories or distilled memories. But their diagnostic gains remain constrained because such experience may contain noisy or incidental information and is typically reused without validating which evidence actually drives diagnostic decisions. To address this limitation, we introduce CDEG, a graph-based framework that learns reusable decision-critical evidence from historical diagnostic trajectories. CDEG contrasts successful and failed trajectories from the same case to identify candidate evidence, validates their diagnostic impact through controlled counterfactual interventions, and organizes the resulting diagnosis--evidence--action relations into a structured graph. During inference, CDEG tracks the evolving patient evidence state to retrieve relevant diagnostic relations and selectively guide missing evidence acquisition or overlooked evidence reappraisal. Across in-domain and out-of-distribution benchmarks with multiple doctor agent backbones, CDEG consistently improves diagnostic performance, achieving up to an 11.5% accuracy gain over vanilla agents. These results demonstrate that reliable long-horizon diagnosis requires moving beyond trajectory-level experience reuse toward evidence-level learning of the factors that truly shape clinical decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CDEG框架，通过从历史诊断轨迹中学习决策关键证据来提升长时程诊断能力。CDEG对比成功与失败轨迹识别候选证据，通过反事实干预验证其诊断影响，并将诊断-证据-行动关系组织成结构化图来指导推理过程。在多个基准和医生智能体骨干上取得了最高11.5%的准确率提升。
AI.motivation: 现有医生智能体在长时程诊断中常因关键证据未被获取或未充分融入诊断推理而失败。已有的基于历史轨迹或记忆复用的方法因包含噪声或偶然信息，且未验证哪些证据真正驱动诊断决策，其性能提升受限。
AI.method: CDEG框架包含三个核心步骤：(1) 对比同一病例的成功与失败轨迹，识别候选关键证据；(2) 通过受控反事实干预验证这些证据的诊断影响；(3) 将诊断-证据-行动关系组织成结构化图。推理时跟踪患者证据状态，检索相关诊断关系，选择性指导缺失证据的获取或遗漏证据的重新评估。
AI.result: 在域内和分布外基准测试中，配合多种医生智能体骨干，CDEG一致性地提升了诊断性能，相比基础智能体最高获得11.5%的准确率提升。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的长时程诊断需要超越轨迹级经验复用，转向证据级学习，聚焦于真正塑造临床决策的关键因素。

title: Direct, Parallel, or Sequential? A Comparative Study of Training-Free Multi-Subject Image-to-Video Generation
summary: Text-conditioned image-to-video (I2V) generation has advanced rapidly, yet generating videos with multiple subjects remains challenging. A model must simultaneously preserve the appearance of each subject, assign distinct motions, and maintain coherent spatial and temporal interactions. This paper presents a systematic study of three representative paradigms for training-free multi-subject I2V generation: direct, parallel, and sequential generation. Direct generation applies a pretrained I2V model to the complete reference image and prompt, requiring all subjects and motions to be synthesized jointly. Parallel and sequential generation instead decompose the reference image and prompt into subject-specific visual and textual conditions. Parallel generation synthesizes each subject independently and subsequently composes the resulting videos, reducing the complexity of each generation step at the cost of weaker inter-subject context. Sequential generation first synthesizes a background video and then progressively introduces individual subjects. This preserves accumulated scene context but introduces sensitivity to subject ordering and error propagation. We empirically evaluate the three paradigms across diverse multi-subject scenes, comparing appearance preservation, motion fidelity, temporal consistency, and inter-subject coherence, while also characterizing their distinct failure modes. Our findings reveal the strengths and limitations of each paradigm and offer practical insights for designing controllable multi-subject video generation systems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了三种免训练的多主体图像到视频（I2V）生成范式：直接生成、并行生成和顺序生成。通过实验比较各范式在主体外观保持、运动保真度、时间一致性和主体间连贯性方面的表现，并分析各自失败模式，为可控多主体视频生成系统的设计提供实践指导。
AI.motivation: 文本条件图像到视频（I2V）生成快速发展，但多主体视频生成仍具挑战性。模型需要同时保持每个主体的外观、分配不同运动并维持时空交互的连贯性。现有研究缺乏对这些生成范式的系统性比较和深入分析。
AI.method: 论文提出三种免训练的多主体I2V生成范式：(1) 直接生成——将预训练I2V模型直接应用于完整参考图像和提示词，联合合成所有主体与运动；(2) 并行生成——将参考图像和提示词分解为主体特定的视觉和文本条件，独立合成每个主体后组合视频；(3) 顺序生成——先合成背景视频，再逐步引入各个主体，保留累积的场景上下文。论文在多样化的多主体场景中实证评估三种范式。
AI.result: 研究揭示了三种范式各自的优势与局限：直接生成简单但难以处理复杂多主体协调；并行生成降低了每一步生成复杂度但主体间上下文较弱；顺序生成保留了场景上下文但受主体排序和错误传播影响。研究系统比较了外观保持、运动保真度、时间一致性和主体间连贯性四个维度。
AI.conclusion: 每种范式都有其独特的优势与局限性，该研究为设计和选择多主体视频生成系统提供了实践见解，有助于推进可控的多主体视频生成技术发展。

title: Beyond Observed Auxiliary Relations: Environment-Conditioned Modeling for Multi-Behavior Recommendation
comment: Accepted at CIKM 2026 (35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management). 11 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables
summary: Multi-behavior recommendation (MBR) leverages auxiliary behavioral signals, such as clicks and add-to-cart, to enhance target behavior prediction like purchases. While recent graph neural network-based approaches have achieved strong performance by systematically propagating auxiliary behavior signals, they still suffer from two fundamental challenges inherent to auxiliary behaviors: (1) missing auxiliary signals, which hinder generalization to items without auxiliary observations, and (2) unreliable auxiliary signals, which amplify noise misaligned with the target behavior. To address these challenges in a unified manner, we propose BOAR, an environment-conditioned MBR framework that addresses missing and unreliable auxiliary signals through two complementary modules conditioned on auxiliary observability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BOAR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving up to 7.82% gains in HR@10 overall and up to 44.2% gains for target items without auxiliary observations, highlighting its ability to capture hidden preferences beyond observed auxiliary relations. Our code is available at: https://github.com/LSH0411/BOAR.

AI.tldr: BOAR 是一个环境条件化的多行为推荐框架，通过两个互补模块分别处理辅助行为信号缺失和不可靠的问题，实验证明其在 HR@10 上最高提升 7.82%，对无辅助观测的目标物品最高提升 44.2%。
AI.motivation: 多行为推荐依赖辅助行为信号（如点击、加购）来增强目标行为（如购买）的预测，但现有图神经网络方法面临两个根本挑战：辅助信号缺失（无法泛化到无辅助观测的物品）和辅助信号不可靠（噪音与目标行为不对齐）。
AI.method: 提出 BOAR 框架，采用环境条件化设计，通过两个基于辅助可观测性的互补模块分别处理信号缺失和信号不可靠问题，以统一的方式同时解决上述两个挑战。
AI.result: 广泛实验表明 BOAR 一致优于最先进基线，HR@10 整体最高提升 7.82%，对无辅助观测的目标物品最高提升 44.2%，展示了超越可观测辅助关系捕获隐藏偏好的能力。
AI.conclusion: BOAR 有效解决了辅助行为信号缺失和不可靠两大挑战，能捕捉超出可观测辅助关系的隐藏用户偏好，代码已开源。

title: SiZeUp: Fast 3D Proxy from Aerial Images via Depth Ordinal Loss
comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Conference Papers
summary: We present SiZeUp, a fast and scalable approach for constructing large-scale 3D urban proxy models directly from calibrated oblique aerial imagery. Our method adopts a height-from-footprint representation, reducing 3D building abstraction to a low-dimensional optimization problem in which building footprints are extruded by a single height parameter. To enable efficient and robust height estimation, we introduce an ordinal depth consistency loss that enforces agreement between the relative depth ordering of rendered proxies and depth priors predicted by a monocular depth model. This is realized through a differentiable renderer that maps parametric building proxies into multi-view depth images, allowing gradients to be propagated from depth supervision to building heights. Our ordinal formulation produces stable optimization in practice and avoids explicit feature matching or dense point cloud reconstruction. Rather than relying on metric depth, which can be unreliable under monocular scale ambiguity, our ordinal depth consistency loss operates on relative depths, providing a more reliable signal across views. Combined with an efficient dynamic view selection, our approach achieves a 23-52$\times$ speedup over state-of-the-art proxy reconstruction pipelines while maintaining comparable proxy-level coverage and volume consistency, making it well suited for large-scale urban modeling tasks.

AI.tldr: SiZeUp是一种快速可扩展的3D城市代理模型构建方法，从倾斜航空影像中直接构建大规模3D城市代理模型。它采用高度-足迹表示，将3D建筑抽象简化为低维优化问题，并通过序数深度一致性损失和可微渲染器实现高效的高度估计，相比现有方法获得23-52倍的加速。
AI.motivation: 现有的大规模3D城市代理模型重建方法通常依赖显式特征匹配或密集点云重建，计算成本高、速度慢，难以适用于大规模城市建模场景。此外，单目深度估计存在尺度模糊性问题，直接使用度量深度作为监督信号不可靠。
AI.method: 1) 采用高度-足迹（height-from-footprint）表示，将3D建筑抽象降维为仅优化单个高度参数的优化问题。2) 引入序数深度一致性损失，确保渲染代理与单目深度模型预测的深度先验之间的相对深度排序一致。3) 使用可微渲染器将参数化建筑代理映射为多视角深度图像，实现梯度从深度监督传播到建筑高度。4) 结合高效的动态视图选择策略。
AI.result: 相比最先进的代理重建管道实现23-52倍的加速，同时保持可比的代理级覆盖率和体积一致性。
AI.conclusion: 序数深度一致性损失在单目尺度模糊下提供可靠的跨视图信号，避免显式特征匹配和密集点云重建，使SiZeUp特别适合大规模城市建模任务。

title: Concepts for Securing Agentic AI Coding and the Terok Environment
comment: to be published in the proceedings of the AGENSYS workshop (Workshop on Knowledge Discovery, Maintenance and Distributed Intelligence in Multi-Agent Systems) at ECML PKDD 2026 conference in Sept. 2026
summary:
Agentic AI is a fascinating new tool for software development. It is a huge step forward compared to "conventional" AI assisted coding, which in turn was a considerable breakthrough earlier. AI support through LLMs is a young and very fast-moving field. The "conventional" (non-agentic) flavor became useful and productive in early 2025 (around 18 months ago) and the agentic flavor followed in fall 2025 (approximately 9 months ago). Besides all its benefits and potential, it also carries some fundamental risks for IT security. And the agentic approach added very severe risks while making others much more dangerous.
  With all the motivation to explore this fascinating new tool we should not ignore the risks but actively address them.
