We present (I) an assessment of the IT security risks, (II) a concept for mitigating them without breaking its benefits, and (III) an overview about an implementation of our concept. In this very dynamic field this is likely not the final and once-and-for-all answer to the identified issues but still a substantial step forward in responsible usage of Agentic AI for software development. It should also be a contribution to the community to allow early and eager evaluation of the potential of agentic AI for software development without actually suffering from its implied IT security risks.

AI.tldr: 本文针对Agentic AI在软件开发中的应用进行了IT安全风险评估，提出了缓解安全风险的概念方案并给出了实现概述，旨在让开发者能够安全地利用Agentic AI的开发潜力而不遭受其固有的网络安全风险。
AI.motivation: Agentic AI作为软件开发的新工具相比传统AI辅助编程有巨大进步，但同时也引入了严重且更具危险性的IT安全风险。作者认为不应忽视这些风险，而应主动应对，以实现负责任地使用Agentic AI进行软件开发。
AI.method: 本文从三个方面展开：(I) 对Agentic AI在软件开发中IT安全风险的系统评估；(II) 提出一个在保持其优势的同时缓解安全风险的概念方案；(III) 对该概念的实现进行概述。
AI.result: 作者指出在快速发展的动态领域中，该方案可能不是最终的一次性解决方案，但代表了在负责任使用Agentic AI进行软件开发方面的实质性进展，并可为社区提供早期评估其潜力而不遭受安全风险的途径。
AI.conclusion: 在享受Agentic AI带来的开发效率提升的同时，必须主动应对其特有的IT安全风险。本文提出的风险评估、缓解概念及实现概述是该方向的重要贡献，有助于社区在不承担不必要安全风险的前提下探索Agentic AI的潜力。

title: VeCAS: Vessel-Focused Contrast-Free Angiogram Synthesis for Vascular Interventions
summary: X-ray angiography relies on iodinated contrast agents to visualize vascular structures during image-guided interventions. However, contrast administration carries risks of adverse events, motivating the development of contrast-free alternatives. Generating X-ray angiograms directly from non-contrast X-ray images offers a potential solution, but existing approaches remain limited by (i) insufficient control over vascular localization and (ii) inefficient modeling of redundant background content. To address these challenges, we propose VeCAS, a two-stage vessel-focused contrast-free angiogram synthesis framework that separates vascular structure localization from angiographic appearance synthesis. In Stage I, a discriminative model localizes vascular structures in non-contrast X-ray images, while cross-modality latent distillation transfers vessel-sensitive knowledge from X-ray angiograms during training. In Stage II, a vessel-focused inpainting model synthesizes angiographic appearance within the localized vascular regions while preserving the non-vascular background. Experiments on an in-house lower-limb vascular intervention dataset show that VeCAS outperforms the comparison methods in terms of vascular structural fidelity and image quality. Visual Turing tests and physician assessments indicate the perceptual realism of the synthesized angiograms. In addition, robotic guidewire navigation experiments in vascular phantoms show that VeCAS guidance reduces the time to target by 41.4% and the number of operation steps by 40.7% compared with non-contrast guidance. Together, these results suggest the potential of VeCAS to serve as ``meta contrast agent'' for vascular interventions.

AI.tldr: 提出VeCAS，一种两阶段的无造影剂血管造影合成框架，通过分离血管结构定位与造影外观合成，直接从非造影X光图像生成血管造影图像，在结构保真度、图像质量及机器人导丝导航实验中均显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 碘造影剂在X射线血管造影中虽然广泛使用，但存在不良事件风险。现有无造影剂生成方案受限于两方面：对血管定位控制不足，以及对冗余背景内容建模效率低下。因此需要一种能精确控制血管结构并高效建模背景的造影剂替代方案。
AI.method: 提出VeCAS两阶段框架：Stage I使用判别模型在非造影X光图像中定位血管结构，并通过跨模态潜在蒸馏在训练时从X射线血管造影中转移血管敏感知识；Stage II使用血管聚焦的修复模型在定位的血管区域内合成造影外观，同时保留非血管背景。
AI.result: 在内部下肢血管介入数据集上，VeCAS在血管结构保真度和图像质量上优于对比方法；视觉图灵测试和医生评估证实合成血管造影的感知真实感；在血管体中进行的机器人导丝导航实验中，VeCAS引导相比非造影引导将到达目标时间缩短41.4%，操作步骤减少40.7%。
AI.conclusion: VeCAS展现出作为血管介入"元造影剂"的潜力，不仅能生成感知上真实的血管造影图像，还能在实际介入场景中显著提升导航效率，为无造影剂血管介入提供了可行路径。

title: What Process Evaluation of Coding Agents Actually Measures: Action, Task, and Step Are Three Different Levels
summary: Coding agents are increasingly evaluated not only by whether they solve a task, but also by how they execute it. However, existing process-level evaluations often treat action prediction, task uncertainty, and step attribution as if they were the same problem, which makes it unclear what such evaluations actually measure. In this paper, we introduce a measurement framework for process evaluation in coding agents and instantiate step-level causal attribution with SCAE, a replay-based estimator derived from a structural causal model of agent execution. Our framework combines prefix-conditioned identification, replay/intervention-based estimation, and controlled judge-information manipulation to study process evaluation at the action, task, and step levels. Experiments on 499 file-localization episodes from 12 repositories show that next actions are driven primarily by execution provenance rather than code-graph transitions, execution uncertainty is structured at the task rather than step level, and full-trace judges exhibit systematic collider bias, suggesting that current process evaluation often measures semantic relevance rather than certified causal contribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个编码智能体过程评估的测量框架，并引入SCAE（基于结构因果模型的重放式估计器）来实现步骤级因果归因。实验表明，下一步行动主要由执行溯源而非代码图转换驱动，执行不确定性在任务层面而非步骤层面结构化，且全轨迹评判存在系统性collider偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有编码智能体的过程级评估将动作预测、任务不确定性和步骤归因混为一谈，导致评估结果的实际含义不清晰。作者旨在厘清这些不同层面的评估维度，并为步骤级因果归因提供严格的方法论。
AI.method: 提出三部分框架：(1)前缀条件化识别（prefix-conditioned identification）；(2)基于重放/干预的估计方法（SCAE，源自智能体执行的结构因果模型）；(3)受控评判信息操纵。框架在动作、任务和步骤三个层面研究过程评估。
AI.result: 在12个仓库的499个文件定位回合上的实验发现：下一步动作主要由执行溯源（execution provenance）驱动而非代码图转换；执行不确定性在任务层面而非步骤层面结构化；全轨迹评判存在系统性collider偏差，表明当前过程评估往往测量的是语义相关性而非认证的因果贡献。
AI.conclusion: 当前编码智能体的过程评估可能并未真正测量其声称的因果关系，而是测量了语义相关性。这提示需要更严格的因果框架来设计和解读过程级评估指标。

title: Following Motion for Sequential Modeling in Video Frame Interpolation
summary: State Space Models (SSMs) have surfaced as a promising architecture in Video Frame Interpolation (VFI), as they can capture long-range dependencies with linear computational complexity. However, their predefined scanning order limits their effectiveness in modeling the dynamic motion trajectories inherent in VFI problems. To tackle this challenge, we propose Motion-Guided Mamba for Video Frame Interpolation (MGMVFI), an adaptation of the selective state space model tailored explicitly for VFI. MGMVFI introduces Motion-Guided Serialization (MGS), which leverages optical flow to define a motion-adaptive 1D input order for the SSM. This aligns the causal state updates with semantically related tokens, enabling motion-consistent feature propagation, particularly for large and dynamic motions. Additionally, to mitigate the unreliable feature representations caused by inaccurate optical flow estimates, we introduce contextual synthesis that utilizes the surrounding spatial context for robust inter-frame feature synthesis. These components are seamlessly integrated within our tailored Mamba architecture, which also employs a lightweight refinement block to enhance local detail reconstruction at a reduced computational cost. Extensive experiments on standard VFI benchmarks demonstrate that MGMVFI achievesstate-of-the-artperformance,particularly on complex and dynamic motions, thereby establishing a new direction for sequence modeling in video interpolation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MGMVFI，一种针对视频帧插值定制的选择性状态空间模型（Mamba）架构。通过运动引导序列化（MGS）利用光流定义运动自适应的1D输入顺序，对齐因果状态更新与语义相关token，并引入上下文合成以减轻光流估计不准确带来的不可靠特征表示。在标准VFI基准上达到SOTA性能，尤其在复杂动态运动场景下表现突出。
AI.motivation: 状态空间模型（SSM）因其线性计算复杂度擅长捕获长距离依赖，已被应用于视频帧插值（VFI）。然而，SSM预定义的扫描顺序无法有效建模VFI中固有的动态运动轨迹，限制了其在运动场景下的表现。本文旨在解决SSM固定扫描顺序与VFI动态运动建模需求之间的矛盾。
AI.method: 1) 提出Motion-Guided Serialization (MGS)，利用光流定义运动自适应的1D输入顺序，使SSM的因果状态更新与语义相关token对齐，实现运动一致的特征传播。2) 引入上下文合成（contextual synthesis），利用周围空间上下文进行鲁棒的帧间特征合成，缓解光流估计不准确带来的问题。3) 采用轻量级精化模块（refinement block）增强局部细节重建，同时降低计算成本。这些组件集成在定制的Mamba架构中。
AI.result: 在标准视频帧插值基准上进行的大量实验表明，MGMVFI达到了最先进的性能，特别是在复杂和动态运动场景下表现显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: MGMVFI通过运动引导的序列化方式解决了SSM在VFI中预定义扫描顺序的局限，为视频插值中的序列建模开辟了新的方向，证明了将运动先验融入状态空间模型的有效性。

title: Buried in Textual Debt: Context Pruning with Visual Evidence Preservation for MLLM Agents
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed as multi-step agents, where explicit reasoning supports task decomposition and tool coordination but also accumulates self-generated text. Over long trajectories, this text can dominate the context and suppress visual evidence, creating textual debt. We observe that reasoning becomes redundant once task-relevant visual evidence is grounded, while stale hypotheses can misguide later inference when grounding remains uncertain. Pruning must therefore remove redundant text without discarding visual evidence. We propose SPARE, a Kullback--Leibler (KL)-guided framework for pruning accumulated reasoning in multimodal tool-use agents. SPARE uses a compact task-state summary as privileged diagnostic context. For each candidate segment, it replays the same model under the original and summary-conditioned contexts. Reverse-KL divergence from on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) then tests whether the summary sufficiently covers the segment without disrupting future reasoning. We further fine-tune the summarizer with supervised fine-tuning (SFT), enabling more compact summaries, broader coverage, and more aggressive pruning. Across multi-step visual tool-use benchmarks, SPARE achieves the highest average accuracy among pruning methods while removing 37.89--64.58\% of reasoning tokens. This favorable accuracy--context trade-off shows that reducing textual dominance restores reliance on visual evidence and mitigates over-conditioning on self-generated language.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPARE框架，通过KL散度引导的推理修剪方法，解决多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在多步工具使用中自我生成文本积累导致的"文本债务"问题。SPARE使用紧凑任务状态摘要作为诊断上下文，通过反向KL散度测试摘要是否充分覆盖候选段落，配合SFT优化摘要器，在保持精度的同时移除37.89%-64.58%的推理token。
AI.motivation: MLLMs作为多步agent部署时，显式推理虽有助于任务分解和工具协调，但会在长轨迹中积累自我生成文本，导致文本主导上下文并压制视觉证据，形成"文本债务"。冗余推理和过时假设会误导后续推理，因此需要在不丢弃视觉证据的前提下修剪冗余文本。
AI.method: SPARE框架包含三个关键组件：(1) 使用紧凑任务状态摘要作为特权诊断上下文；(2) 对每个候选段落，在同一模型下分别使用原始上下文和摘要条件上下文进行重放，通过来自on-policy自蒸馏（OPSD）的反向KL散度测试摘要是否充分覆盖段落且不干扰未来推理；(3) 使用SFT微调摘要器，实现更紧凑的摘要、更广的覆盖范围和更激进的修剪。
AI.result: 在多步视觉工具使用基准上，SPARE在修剪方法中取得了最高的平均准确率，同时移除了37.89%-64.58%的推理token，展现了良好的准确率-上下文权衡。
AI.conclusion: 减少文本主导性能够恢复模型对视觉证据的依赖，并缓解对自我生成语言的过度条件化，验证了修剪冗余推理可以有效改善MLLMs在长轨迹任务中的表现。

title: Toward Sub-1 kB Identity-Preserving Face Compression: A Benchmark of Codecs, a Custom Learned Codec, and Studies of Resolution, Demographic Fairness, Recompression, and Adversarial Robustness
summary:
Storing face images under a hard sub-kilobyte budget, as required for identity documents, smart-card biometrics and bandwidth-constrained verification, forces a codec to discard most of the signal while keeping what a face matcher actually reads: identity. Generic codecs optimize pixel fidelity, not the embedding distances that drive verification, so which codec, resolution and setting best preserve identity at 1024 bytes or less, and how that degrades at 512, is unclear.
  We benchmark ten general and face-specific codecs across resolutions, byte budgets, two datasets (controlled Color FERET, in-the-wild AI-Solutions-KK) and four anchor face matchers, with a fourteen-model ViT and CNN roster confirming the ranking is backbone-invariant. We then train a custom identity-preserving codec that hits the byte budget exactly via binary search over a frozen gain table, and run four studies: resolution, demographic fairness, recompression, and no-box adversarial robustness.
  Sub-kilobyte identity preservation is feasible, but which codec to deploy depends entirely on the budget. At 1024 bytes and the 112 px working resolution the problem is close to solved: modern codecs hold Color FERET equal-error rate under 0.35 percent on the ArcFace anchor. At 512 bytes the field re-sorts: AVIF, HEIF, JPEG XL and legacy JPEG collapse to 28 to 98 percent false-non-match rate at FMR 1e-4, while WebP, JPEG-AI and our byte-budgeted learned codecs stay out of that band, with 24.3 percent for WebP against 6.9 percent for our accurate variant in the wild. That re-sort, not the 1024-byte ranking, is the operational result: a codec chosen at 1 kB is not the codec to deploy at half that.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了亚千字节（512-1024字节）预算下的面部图像压缩，比较了十种通用和面部专用编解码器在多个分辨率、字节预算、数据集和匹配器上的身份保持性能，并训练了自定义的身份保持编解码器。关键发现是：在1024字节下问题接近解决（Color FERET等错误率低于0.35%），但在512字节下编解码器的性能排序完全重排，1kB下的最佳选择在512字节下并不适用。
AI.motivation: 身份证件、智能卡生物识别和带宽受限的验证场景需要在亚千字节预算下存储面部图像，但通用编解码器优化的是像素保真度而非身份验证所依赖的嵌入距离。目前缺乏对此预算范围内不同编解码器身份保持性能的系统性比较和明确结论。
AI.method: 作者首先在两种数据集（受控的Color FERET和野外AI-Solutions-KK）上，用四种锚定面部匹配器和14个ViT/CNN模型的组合，系统评测了10种通用和面部专用编解码器在不同分辨率和字节预算下的性能。随后训练了一个自定义的身份保持编解码器，通过冻结增益表上的二分搜索精确命中字节预算。最后进行了四项研究：分辨率、人口统计公平性、重复压缩和无框对抗鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在1024字节和112像素工作分辨率下，现代编解码器在ArcFace锚定器上的Color FERET等错误率可保持在0.35%以下。但在512字节下排序重排：AVIF、HEIF、JPEG XL和传统JPEG的误拒率在FMR 1e-4下达到28-98%，而WebP（24.3%）和JPEG-AI以及作者提出的字节预算学习编解码器（精确变体在野外数据上为6.9%）仍保持在安全范围内。该排序重排被14个模型的阵容确认与骨干网络无关。
AI.conclusion: 亚千字节的身份保持压缩是可行的，但编解码器的选择完全取决于字节预算。1kB下表现良好的编解码器在512字节下可能完全失效，因此部署决策必须基于目标预算而非更大的预算下的评测结果。作者提出的学习型编解码器在精确字节预算下的表现尤为突出。

title: ParallelWorld: Test-Time Scaling for Embodied Reasoning
summary: Embodied Reasoning constitutes a fundamental capability of embodied intelligence, serving as the basis for autonomous perception, reasoning, and interaction within physical environments. Recent studies have shifted the paradigm of embodied reasoning from static perception toward dynamic exploration, where agents acquire task-relevant information through interactions with the environment. However, existing active reasoning approaches generally generate exploration trajectories incrementally without long-horizon planning. Even recently emerged test-time scaling frameworks often resort to myopic, single-step lookaheads, which struggle to resolve the delayed feedback inherent in complex, occluded spatial environments. To address this limitation, we propose ParallelWorld, a multi-horizon test-time scaling framework for embodied reasoning. Instead of greedy, single-step trials, ParallelWorld empowers agents to simulate and evaluate multi-step future trajectories in parallel before committing to an action. Specifically, we introduce a verifier-guided tree-search paradigm. Starting from the current state, ParallelWorld branches into multiple parallel trajectories and rolls them out continuously across a multi-step horizon. At each simulation step, a verifier agent evaluates the intermediate state transitions, dynamically pruning unpromising branches and prioritizing paths with the highest information gain. Once the multi-step prospective simulation is complete, the agent synthesizes the long-horizon outcomes to commit to the optimal action sequence. Finally, an answer agent performs reasoning over the selected trajectory to produce the final reasoning. Extensive experiments on ESI-Bench demonstrate that ParallelWorld consistently improves active perception and reasoning performance.

AI.tldr: ParallelWorld是一个多视界测试时扩展框架，用于具身推理。它通过验证器引导的树搜索范式，让智能体在采取行动前并行模拟和评估多步未来轨迹，而非贪婪的单步试错，从而解决复杂遮挡空间环境中的延迟反馈问题。
AI.motivation: 现有主动推理方法通常增量生成探索轨迹，缺乏长期规划能力。即使最新的测试时扩展框架也往往采用短视的单步前瞻，难以解决复杂遮挡空间环境中固有的延迟反馈问题。
AI.method: ParallelWorld采用验证器引导的树搜索范式：从当前状态出发，分支为多条并行轨迹并跨多步视界持续展开；在每个模拟步骤中，验证器智能体评估中间状态转换，动态剪枝低价值分支并优先选择信息增益最高的路径；多步前瞻模拟完成后，智能体综合长期结果选择最优动作序列；最后由答案智能体在选定轨迹上进行推理产生最终答案。
AI.result: 在ESI-Bench上的大量实验表明，ParallelWorld持续提升了主动感知和推理性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过多步并行前瞻模拟代替贪婪单步策略，ParallelWorld有效解决了具身推理中的延迟反馈问题，为测试时扩展在具身环境中的应用提供了新范式。

title: Large-Small Model Collaboration for Zero-Shot Surgical Phase Recognition
summary: Task-specific lightweight models for surgical phase recognition excel at capturing temporal dynamics but generalize poorly under domain shift. Conversely, surgical foundation models (FMs) offer superior transferability via large-scale pretraining, yet their lack of explicit temporal modeling often yields temporally inconsistent predictions, leading to degraded performance. To exploit the complementary strengths of both paradigms, we propose \textbf{La}rge-\textbf{S}mall \textbf{T}emporal adaptation (\textbf{LaST}), a novel large-small collaborative framework that enables zero-shot adaptation to unseen clinical domains. In LaST, the FM initiates the pipeline by generating frame-level phase priors that serve as initial weak supervision. To effectively utilize these noisy phase priors, we introduce an iterative temporal refinement scheme that integrates dynamic quality control to filter reliable predictions and dual-model cross-learning to mitigate confirmation bias. Simultaneously, the lightweight model leverages its intrinsic temporal modeling ability to progressively correct inconsistent predictions and enhance overall accuracy across iterations. At the end, a cycle replay strategy is employed to close the loop: the refined, more accurate predictions are utilized as upgraded supervision signals for the subsequent iterations, fostering a self-reinforcing evolution of both label quality and model capability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LaST achieves robust adaptation to unseen domains for zero-shot surgical phase recognition, outperforming the baseline (PeskaVLP) by 24.85\%-43.17\% in accuracy and even surpassing fully supervised linear probing and several state-of-the-art few-shot approaches. Codes will be released at https://github.com/YIYIZH/LaST.

AI.tldr: 提出LaST（Large-Small Temporal adaptation）框架，将大规模手术基础模型（FM）与轻量级时序模型协同，通过迭代时序精炼和循环回放策略，实现零样本手术阶段识别在未知临床领域的鲁棒适应。
AI.motivation: 任务特化的轻量级手术阶段识别模型擅长捕捉时序动态但在域偏移下泛化差；而手术基础模型虽通过大规模预训练具备优越迁移能力，却缺乏显式时序建模导致预测时序不一致。两者互补优势未被充分利用。
AI.method: LaST框架包含三个关键组件：(1) FM生成帧级阶段先验作为初始弱监督；(2) 迭代时序精炼方案，集成动态质量控制筛选可靠预测与双模型交叉学习缓解确认偏差；(3) 循环回放策略，将精炼后的准确预测作为升级监督信号，形成自强化进化闭环。
AI.result: 在零样本手术阶段识别任务上实现鲁棒适应，相比基线PeskaVLP在准确率上提升24.85%-43.17%，超越全监督线性探测及多种SOTA少样本方法。
AI.conclusion: 大-小模型协同的迭代精炼框架能够有效结合基础模型的迁移能力与轻量模型的时序建模能力，实现无需标注数据的零样本域适应，为手术阶段识别提供了新范式。

title: Toward Effective and Reliable LLM Agents via Dynamic Ontology
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents rely heavily on knowledge encoded in model parameters or presented as unstructured context. In domain-specific tasks, this leaves important semantic connections implicit. This often results in incomplete evidence use and brittle multi-step decisions. Ontologies offer a way to externalize domain concepts and relations as machine-interpretable structures, but constructing task-usable ontologies traditionally requires substantial effort from domain experts and is difficult to scale. Automatic construction is also challenging: an ontology that appears semantically plausible may not contain the relational structures needed for actual decision making. We present OaK, an ontology-as-a-kernel framework that dynamically constructs and refines task-oriented ontologies for LLM agents. Given task requirements and training data, OaK constructs an ontology and its knowledge graph, generates task-adaptation functions for graph reasoning, and uses judge feedback to iteratively refine both. By making relevant concepts and relations explicit, the ontology grounds knowledge retrieval and multi-step decision making. We evaluate OaK on TravelPlanner, CRMArenaPro, and ToolQA. Results show that OaK improves standard LLM agents, strengthens evidence grounding, and boosts the reliability of multi-step reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OaK框架，一种以本体为核心（ontology-as-a-kernel）的方法，为LLM智能体动态构建和精炼面向任务的本体。给定任务需求和训练数据，OaK构建本体及其知识图谱，生成任务自适应函数用于图推理，并通过评判反馈迭代精炼两者，从而显式化领域概念与关系，增强证据检索和多步决策的可靠性。在TravelPlanner、CRMArenaPro和ToolQA上的实验表明，OaK提升了标准LLM智能体的性能、证据基础和多步推理的可靠性。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体严重依赖模型参数中编码的知识或以非结构化上下文呈现的信息，这导致在领域特定任务中重要的语义联系被隐式化，造成证据使用不完整和多步决策脆弱。虽然本体可以将领域概念和关系外部化为机器可解释的结构，但传统上构建任务可用本体需要领域专家的大量投入且难以扩展；自动构建也很困难，因为语义上看似合理的本体可能不包含实际决策所需的关系结构。
AI.method: OaK框架包含三个核心环节：1）根据任务需求和训练数据动态构建本体及其知识图谱；2）生成任务自适应函数以支持图推理；3）利用评判者（judge）反馈对本体和知识图谱进行迭代精炼。通过使相关概念和关系显式化，本体为知识检索和多步决策提供基础锚定。
AI.result: 在TravelPlanner、CRMArenaPro和ToolQA三个基准上的评估显示，OaK相比标准LLM智能体有显著提升，具体体现为：改善标准LLM智能体的性能、增强证据锚定能力和提升多步推理的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: OaK通过将本体作为智能体推理的"内核"，成功解决了LLM智能体在领域任务中语义联系隐式和证据使用不完整的问题。实验证明，动态构建和迭代精炼任务导向本体的方法能够有效提升多步决策的可靠性，为LLM智能体的知识外部化提供了可行的自动化路径。

title: FOVEA: Focused On-Demand Visual Evidence Adaptation for Cache-Friendly Multimodal Speculative Decoding
summary: Multimodal speculative decoding accelerates vision-language models by allowing a lightweight draft model to propose candidate tokens for parallel verification by a larger target model. Existing methods typically condition the drafter on a fixed visual interface, such as a predefined visual-token budget or a static compressed representation. However, our controlled visual-budget analysis shows that visual demand varies substantially across tasks and decoding stages, which means more visual input is not always beneficial. Actually, insufficient evidence may weaken visual grounding, while excessive context adds overhead and may disrupt drafting. We propose FOVEA (Focused On-demand Visual Evidence Adaptation), a cache-friendly approach that builds a reusable visual memory and dynamically retrieves a bounded subset for a draft state. A cumulative-mass rule determines both how many and which entries are selected. The selected entries are aggregated into a visual readout and fused with the current draft hidden state through a lightweight gated residual correction. Rather than inserting visual tokens into the autoregressive context, the correction modifies only the representation passed to the language-model head. Experiments across multiple vision-language backbones and multimodal benchmarks show that FOVEA improves draft acceptance and end-to-end decoding speed, achieving up to $2.13\times$ speedup over autoregressive decoding. These results demonstrate that state-conditioned evidence retrieval is an effective alternative to reusing a fixed visual representation throughout multimodal generation.

AI.tldr: 提出FOVEA方法，一种缓存友好的多模态投机解码方案，通过构建可复用的视觉记忆并动态检索有界子集来替代固定视觉表示，实现最高2.13倍端到端解码加速。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态投机解码方法将draft模型固定在一个视觉接口上（如固定token预算或静态压缩表示），但视觉需求在不同任务和解码阶段差异显著：视觉输入过少会削弱视觉接地，过多则增加计算开销并可能干扰草稿生成。作者通过可控视觉预算分析验证了这一点。
AI.method: FOVEA构建可复用的视觉记忆库，根据当前draft状态动态检索有界子集。使用累积质量规则（cumulative-mass rule）决定检索条目的数量与选择。选中的条目聚合成视觉读出（visual readout），通过轻量级门控残差校正与当前draft隐藏状态融合。关键设计是校正仅修改传递给语言模型头的表示，而非将视觉token插入自回归上下文。
AI.result: 在多个视觉-语言骨干网络和多模态基准上，FOVEA提升了草稿接受率和端到端解码速度，相比自回归解码实现最高2.13倍加速。实验证明状态条件化证据检索是复用固定视觉表示的有效替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 本文展示了按需检索视觉证据而非固定重用视觉表示，能更高效地适应不同任务和解码阶段的视觉需求变化，是多模态投机解码的一个有效新方向。

title: Budget-Constrained Embodied Perception: Four Resource Walls and a Pre-Registered Evaluation of Access-Structured Perception on Open Models at less than 31B
summary: Embodied multimodal agents must answer from growing observation streams under a fixed per-decision token budget. We formalize this constraint through four resource walls: a perceptual Shannon wall for bounded state, a horizon wall for query-independent frame selection, a round wall for non-adaptive retrieval, and a conditional composition wall for fixed-depth inference. We introduce ASP, a training-free wrapper for frozen multimodal models that combines a capped structured state, a verbatim episodic index, and query-conditioned budget allocation with iterative access. Following a pre-registered protocol, we evaluate seven open-weight models from 3B to 31B on SEW-Bench, a license-free synthetic long-horizon walkthrough benchmark constructed to instantiate these walls. The registered natural-video benchmarks were not run because their frames require dataset agreements; our evidence therefore concerns access mechanisms, not natural-scene perception. Under a 4,096-token decision budget, ASP reaches 75 to 94% episodic retrieval accuracy, compared with 3 to 19% for equal-budget query-independent sampling, and budget reallocation outperforms quadrupling the sampling budget on every backbone. However, the full three-component architecture does not validate channel duality: removing the compressive state raises the flagship mean from 35.4 to 58.0, ASP does not outperform the verbatim-only baseline on any backbone, and two of four pre-registered falsification criteria fire. These results show that query-conditioned access, rather than parameter count or context growth alone, is decisive under a fixed budget, while prompted online compression does not earn its cost in this setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ASP框架，一种无需训练的包装器，用于冻结多模态模型在固定决策token预算下处理长视野观测流。通过在SEW-Bench基准上对7个3B-31B开源模型进行评估，ASP达到了75-94%的情景检索准确率（对比查询无关采样仅3-19%），验证了查询条件访问的决定性作用。然而，完整的三个组件架构未能验证通道对偶性假设——移除压缩状态反而将旗舰模型均值从35.4提升至58.0，且ASP在所有骨干网络上均未超越仅逐字索引基线，四条预注册证伪标准中有两条被触发。
AI.motivation: 具身多模态智能体必须在固定每决策token预算下从不断增长的观测流中作答，这引入了四个资源壁垒（感知Shannon墙、视界墙、回合墙和条件组合墙）。现有模型缺乏在严格预算约束下进行高效情景检索的机制，需要一种不需重新训练的解决方案。
AI.method: ASP是一种训练免费的包装器，将冻结多模态模型与三组件架构结合：封顶的结构化状态（压缩性状态）、逐字情景索引、以及查询条件化预算分配与迭代访问。遵循预注册协议，在SEW-Bench（合成长时间步行基准）上评估七个开源模型。
AI.result: 在4,096 token决策预算下，ASP达到75-94%情景检索准确率（基准查询无关采样仅3-19%）；预算重分配在所有骨干网络上优于将采样预算翻四倍。但移除压缩状态使旗舰模型从35.4升至58.0，ASP不优于仅逐字索引基线，四条预注册证伪标准中两条被触发。
AI.conclusion: 在固定预算下，查询条件访问机制（而非参数规模或上下文增长）是决定性因素；然而提示式在线压缩在此设置中未能体现成本效益，不支持通道对偶性假设。证据涉及访问机制而非自然场景感知，因为注册的自然视频基准因数据集协议未能运行。

title: DRAgent: Discriminative Reasoning Agent for Referring Expression Segmentation
summary: Referring Expression Segmentation (RES) aims to generate a pixel-level mask for the object specified by a language expression. Recent methods based on multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often rely on one-pass coordinate prediction for visual localization, which serializes continuous spatial locations as discrete text tokens and may lead to localization bias and alignment errors. To address these issues, we propose DRAgent, an MLLM-driven discriminative reasoning (DR) framework for RES. Instead of requiring the MLLM to generate localization coordinates, DRAgent first constructs a detector-generated candidate space and then uses the MLLM as a visual-semantic target discriminator. Specifically, the MLLM performs reliable target selection among potential distractors through a two-stage DR mechanism, which first screens high-recall candidates and then performs instance-wise verification. The selected target box is subsequently used as a spatial prompt for a foundation segmentation model to produce the final pixel-level mask. Furthermore, we construct a self-consistency-filtered reasoning-chain data pipeline for LoRA-based fine-tuning, providing more reliable supervision for enhancing the MLLM's discriminative reasoning capability. Experiments demonstrate that DRAgent achieves competitive performance on RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg.

AI.tldr: 提出DRAgent框架，通过将MLLM从坐标生成者转变为视觉语义判别器，结合检测器候选空间和两阶段判别推理机制，解决了RES任务中坐标预测导致的对齐误差问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于MLLM的RES方法依赖一次性坐标预测进行视觉定位，将连续空间位置序列化为离散文本token，导致定位偏差和对齐错误，需要更可靠的定位策略。
AI.method: 1) 利用检测器生成候选空间而非让MLLM直接预测坐标；2) MLLM作为视觉语义判别器，通过两阶段判别推理（先高召回筛选再逐实例验证）进行目标选择；3) 用选定目标框作为空间提示输入基础分割模型生成像素级掩码；4) 构建自一致性过滤的推理链数据流水线用于LoRA微调。
AI.result: 在RefCOCO、RefCOCO+和RefCOCOg三个基准数据集上取得了有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将定位任务分解为"生成候选+判别选择"的模式，避免了直接坐标预测带来的对齐误差，验证了判别式推理在RES任务中的有效性。

title: SA-RSQ: A Versatile Sparse Representation Framework for Multi-modal Recommender Systems
summary: Deploying high-dimensional multimodal features in industrial recommender systems incurs substantial storage and latency overhead. Hard quantization is compact but introduces boundary distortion, whereas dense soft quantization couples representation quality to the limited storage budget. We propose Sparse Activation-based Residual Soft Quantization (SA-RSQ), which uses Top-K sparse routing and softmax weights to store compact (Index, Probability) tuples. The stored tuples decouple per-item storage from codebook dimensionality; for a fixed selected support, gradients propagate through the routing weights and weighted reconstruction without relying on a straight-through estimator. Experiments on a proprietary food-delivery advertising dataset show favorable reconstruction-performance and CTR trade-offs across storage budgets of 8-48 bytes per item. A preliminary Next-Distribution Prediction study and a one-week online A/B test further demonstrate the practical potential of SA-RSQ, with relative lifts of +2.51% in CTR and +3.66% in CPM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SA-RSQ（稀疏激活残差软量化）方法，通过Top-K稀疏路由和softmax权重存储紧凑的(Index, Probability)元组，在工业推荐系统中实现高维多模态特征的紧凑表示，在8-48字节/项的存储预算下取得良好的重建与CTR权衡，并在在线A/B测试中获得CTR +2.51%和CPM +3.66%的提升。
AI.motivation: 工业推荐系统部署高维多模态特征会带来大量存储和延迟开销。现有的硬量化（hard quantization）虽紧凑但存在边界失真问题；而密集软量化（dense soft quantization）将表示质量与有限的存储预算绑定，难以兼顾。因此需要一个既能压缩存储又不牺牲表示质量的量化方案。
AI.method: SA-RSQ采用Top-K稀疏路由和softmax权重，仅存储紧凑的(Index, Probability)元组。该存储方式将每项存储量与码本维度解耦；对于固定的选中的支持集，梯度可直接通过路由权重和加权重建进行传播，无需依赖straight-through estimator。
AI.result: 在专有的外卖广告数据集上，在8-48字节/项的存储预算范围内表现出良好的重建性能和CTR权衡。初步的Next-Distribution Prediction研究和一周在线A/B测试进一步验证了实用性，CTR相对提升+2.51%，CPM相对提升+3.66%。
AI.conclusion: SA-RSQ通过稀疏软量化的方式有效解决了工业推荐系统中高维特征存储开销大的问题，在保持紧凑性的同时缓解了量化失真，并在真实在线场景中验证了其实际价值，展示了工业落地的潜力。

title: NemoSplat: Feed-Forward 4D Gaussian Splatting for Media-Aware Underwater Reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing photorealistic scenes in unconstrained underwater environments remains challenging due to severe media-induced light scattering and unpredictable dynamic objects. Recent feed-forward visual foundation models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in generalized novel view synthesis and tracking. However, when directly applied to aquatic videos, optical attenuation and motion interference fatally corrupt their feature aggregation, leading to severe tracking and reconstruction failures. To overcome these limitations, we present NemoSplat, the first feed-forward 4D Gaussian Splatting framework tailored for media-aware dynamic reconstruction directly from uncalibrated marine videos. Beyond providing robust estimations of camera poses and dense scene depth, we devise a Promptable Dynamic Disentangler that utilizes a confidence-aware fusion strategy of learned dynamic probabilities and optional semantic text priors, effectively isolating massive transient entities. Furthermore, to counteract visual degradation, a Media-Aware Gaussian Predictor is formulated to jointly estimate intrinsic 3D Gaussian attributes alongside physical media parameters, rendering pristine scene appearance in a single forward pass. Additionally, we introduce a large-scale underwater dataset with massive dynamic elements to facilitate training and evaluation. Extensive experiments on our dataset demonstrate that NemoSplat achieves state-of-the-art tracking accuracy and high-fidelity rendering.

AI.tldr: NemoSplat 是首个面向无约束水下动态场景的前馈式 4D 高斯泼溅框架，通过媒体感知的动态解耦与物理参数联合估计，直接从未标定海洋视频中实现高保真实时重建与追踪。
AI.motivation: 水下环境中介质引起的光散射和不可预测的动态物体导致现有前馈视觉基础模型（如新视角合成和追踪模型）在特征聚合时遭受光学衰减和运动干扰的严重破坏，直接应用会导致追踪和重建失败。
AI.method: 提出 NemoSplat 框架，包含三个核心组件：1）Promptable Dynamic Disentangler，利用置信度感知融合策略结合学习到的动态概率与可选的语义文本先验来隔离大规模瞬态实体；2）Media-Aware Gaussian Predictor，联合估计 3D 高斯属性与物理介质参数，单次前向传播渲染纯净场景外观；3）大规模含大量动态元素的水下数据集用于训练与评估。
AI.result: 在自建大规模水下数据集上，NemoSplat 在追踪准确度和渲染保真度方面均达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: NemoSplat 证明了通过媒体感知设计和动态解耦策略，前馈式 4D 高斯泼溅能够有效克服水下光学退化与运动干扰，实现高质量动态重建。

title: PatchWrite: One Line, Not One Section -- Compile-Gated, Validity-Preserving Editing for AI-Drafted Manuscripts
summary: Automated manuscript pipelines often regenerate an entire section to repair a local defect, allowing unrelated metrics and citations to change even when the resulting PDF still builds. PatchWrite instead constrains how candidate edits become committed manuscript states: it reuses bounded EDIT N M editing and rollback, but tightens compilation acceptance with fatal-log checks and adds evidence locks that require every cited key and experimental numeric token to be attested by a reference registry or experimental log. Candidates that fail either check are rejected and the previous HEAD is retained. On a 24-manuscript x 8-fault oracle stress test (768 jobs, evenly split between compile-breaking and content-only faults), whole-slot rewriting mutated an unrelated "12-layer" line in every case (0/192 preserved; numeric Jaccard 0.6667), whereas PatchWrite preserved it in 192/192 cases. Removing the compile gate reduced acceptance to 0, while removing the evidence gate allowed a hallucinated citation to pass. The same pattern held across all eight faults. To test the protocol with generation rather than oracle edits, we reran the 192 jobs with the writer model proposing the edits. The model's candidates were accepted in 75% of cases; nearly all rejections came from one reproducible failure mode in which the model attempted to delete a line using an empty replacement unsupported by the current grammar. Every accepted candidate passed both gates, and 93.75% fixed the injected fault; the remaining cases involved a technically valid but sentence-inappropriate citation and one markup-changing near-miss. In a blind evaluation of sixteen PDF pairs, both raters preferred PatchWrite for preserving lab-grounded facts (C1 Likert 5.0 vs. 2.0), while rating prose quality nearly identically. Logs from 193 in-product drafting tasks show the same classes of failures occurring in practice.

AI.tldr: PatchWrite提出了一种约束稿件编辑提交的自动化管线方法，通过有界编辑和回滚机制，结合致命日志检查和证据锁（要求引用键和实验数字都被参考注册表或实验日志证实），从而防止无关指标和引文在修复局部缺陷时被意外修改。在24个手稿×8种故障的测试中，PatchWrite在192/192情况下保留了无关内容，而去除编译门或证据门分别导致接受率降为0或幻觉引用通过。
AI.motivation: 传统自动化稿件管线在修复局部缺陷时常会重新生成整个章节，导致无关的指标和引用被意外更改，即使PDF仍然能成功编译。这种"为修局部而破坏全局"的问题需要更细粒度的编辑控制来保证稿件内容的稳定性和一致性。
AI.method: PatchWrite采用两层约束机制：(1) 有界EDIT N M编辑与回滚，并通过致命日志检查收紧编译验收标准；(2) 证据锁机制，要求每个引用键和实验数字标记都必须由参考注册表或实验日志证明。候选编辑若未通过任一检查则被拒绝并保留原HEAD状态。
AI.result: 在768个任务的基准测试中，整槽重写每次都会改变无关的"12-layer"行（0/192保留），而PatchWrite在192/192情况下保留。移除编译门导致接受率降为0，移除证据门则允许幻觉引用通过。在实际生成测试中75%的候选被接受，93.75%修复了注入故障。盲评中两位评分者都更偏好PatchWrite在保留实验室依据事实方面的表现（Likert 5.0 vs 2.0），而散文质量评分几乎相同。
AI.conclusion: PatchWrite证明通过编译门和证据锁的组合约束，可以在修复稿件缺陷的同时严格保护无关内容不被意外修改。该方法在实践中有效，但也揭示了当前语法不支持空替换删除行这一可复现的限制，提示未来需要扩展编辑操作的语法能力。

title: AquaFlow: A Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Underwater Streaming Reconstruction
summary: Recent monocular 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) streaming reconstruction methods have achieved impressive performance by balancing reconstruction quality and efficiency. However, extending these frameworks to underwater scenes remains challenging due to severe visual degradation, such as light attenuation and scattering, which degrades camera pose tracking and distorts scene geometry. To address these challenges, we propose AquaFlow, a monocular Gaussian Splatting streaming reconstruction framework for efficient and high-fidelity underwater reconstruction. Specifically, AquaFlow fine-tunes a 3D vision foundation model on large-scale underwater data for robust pose and pointmap estimation, and introduces a medium-guided incremental Gaussian initialization strategy for streaming mapping. Furthermore, we develop a streaming-compatible hybrid scene representation that integrates structured, distance-conditioned neural Gaussians with a physics-inspired optical model to compensate for underwater image formation effects, enabling accurate scene reconstruction. We evaluate AquaFlow on a comprehensive dataset of 62 diverse underwater trajectories, collected from both public benchmarks and in-the-wild web videos across various scales. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AquaFlow achieves state-of-the-art tracking and rendering performance, reducing average localization error by 13.2% and improving PSNR by 4.74 dB compared to WaterSplat-SLAM.

AI.tldr: AquaFlow是一个面向水下场景的单目3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）流式重建框架，通过微调3D视觉基础模型实现鲁棒的位姿和点图估计，并引入介质引导的增量高斯初始化策略及混合场景表示（结构化的距离条件神经高斯+物理启发光学模型），在水下62条多样化轨迹数据集上实现了SOTA的跟踪和渲染性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的单目3DGS流式重建方法在常规场景表现优异，但直接扩展到水下场景时面临严重挑战：光衰减和散射等视觉退化会降低相机位姿跟踪精度并扭曲场景几何结构。
AI.method: 1）在水下大规模数据上微调3D视觉基础模型，用于鲁棒的位姿和点图估计；2）提出介质引导的增量高斯初始化策略用于流式建图；3）开发流式兼容的混合场景表示，将结构化的距离条件神经高斯与物理启发的光学模型相结合，补偿水下图像形成效应。
AI.result: 在62条多样化水下轨迹（涵盖公共基准和野外网络视频，多种规模）上的实验表明：相比WaterSplat-SLAM，平均定位误差降低13.2%，PSNR提升4.74 dB，达到SOTA的跟踪和渲染性能。
AI.conclusion: AquaFlow通过结合基础模型微调、介质感知初始化和物理启发的混合表示，有效解决了水下场景中3DGS流式重建面临的视觉退化问题，实现了高效且高保真的水下场景重建。

title: PsychJail: Exploring Psychological Jailbreaks via Multi-Turn Persuasion of LLM Policies
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in education, healthcare, policy advising, and other interactive settings, where users engage them as sustained social interlocutors rather than one-shot query engines. This shift makes jailbreaks a growing safety threat, yet most research emphasizes single-turn prompt optimization or iterative attack refinement, leaving psychologically grounded multi-turn vulnerabilities underexplored. We present PsychJail, a psychology-guided framework for red teaming aligned LLMs through theory-grounded, multi-turn persuasion. PsychJail maps established social-psychological persuasion techniques into a tactic-conditioned attack policy. It factorizes each attacker action into a Change-of-Meaning analysis, tactic selection, and victim-visible message, operationalizing the Persuasion Knowledge Model (PKM). The policy is refined with trajectory-level reinforcement learning using a PKM-gated reward that credits early jailbreak success only when every turn contains a well-formed Change-of-Meaning analysis. Across four aligned victim models, PsychJail achieves the highest average attack success rate (87.3%) and outperforms strong single-turn and multi-turn baselines on every model. We also measure susceptibility at the action that breaks each victim, revealing four distinct model-level fingerprints that identify which persuasion levers affect each model and how broadly. These fingerprints help explain cross-model transfer asymmetry. We interpret them as four candidate psychological profiles-rationalist, credibility-driven, narrative-monoculture, and broadly persuadable-while treating this interpretation as a conjecture requiring future validation. Our findings establish psychological jailbreaks as a distinct red-teaming frontier for increasingly interactive LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PsychJail，一个基于心理学理论的多轮对话越狱框架。它通过将社会心理学说服技术映射为策略条件化的攻击策略，利用轨迹级强化学习和PKM门控奖励进行优化，在四个对齐模型中达到87.3%的平均攻击成功率，并揭示了四种模型级"心理学画像"来解释跨模型迁移不对称性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地部署在交互式场景中（教育、医疗、政策咨询等），用户将其视为持续社交对话者而非一次性查询引擎。这种转变使得越狱攻击成为日益严重的安全威胁，但现有研究多聚焦于单轮提示优化或迭代攻击改进，忽略了基于心理学理论的多轮对话漏洞。
AI.method: PsychJail框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 将社会心理学说服技术映射为战术条件化的攻击策略（tactic-conditioned attack policy）；(2) 将每次攻击行动分解为Change-of-Meaning分析、战术选择和受害者可见消息三个部分，操作化说服知识模型（PKM）；(3) 使用轨迹级强化学习优化策略，采用PKM门控奖励——仅当每轮都包含结构良好的Change-of-Meaning分析时才对早期越狱成功给予奖励。
AI.result: 在四个对齐的受害者模型上，PsychJail实现了最高的平均攻击成功率（87.3%），在每个模型上都优于强单轮和多轮基线。此外，通过测量每个受害者的"破坏行动"（即导致越狱成功的具体动作），揭示了四种不同的模型级指纹，识别出哪些说服杠杆影响每个模型以及影响范围有多广。
AI.conclusion: 这些指纹有助于解释跨模型迁移不对称性，并被解释为四种候选心理学画像：理性主义者型、可信度驱动型、叙事单一文化型和广泛可说服型（该解释被视为猜想，需未来验证）。研究确立了心理学越狱作为交互式LLM时代一个独特的红队前沿方向。

title: Results of the 1st Asynchronous CASTLE Challenge at the Joint Egocentric Vision Workshop in Conjunction with CVPR 2026
summary: This report summarizes the contributions and results of the 1st Asynchronous CASTLE Challenge at the Joint Egocentric Vision Workshop in conjunction with CVPR 2026.

AI.tldr: 本文总结了在CVPR 2026联合自我中心视觉研讨会上举办的第一届异步CASTLE挑战赛的贡献与结果。
AI.motivation: 作为挑战赛总结报告，旨在汇总赛事组织、参赛队伍贡献及最终成果，为社区提供参考。
AI.method: 在Joint Egocentric Vision Workshop上组织异步CASTLE挑战赛，收集并分析各参赛队伍的方法与表现。
AI.result: 报告展示了第一届异步CASTLE挑战赛的参赛情况及最终结果。
AI.conclusion: 总结挑战赛的经验与成果，为后续相关工作提供借鉴。

title: Artificial Empathy: Towards a Framework for Unsupervised Agency Detection and Policy Reconstruction
summary: We study how an AI system can identify and model other agents in its environment from observation alone, which is a capability necessary for cooperative behaviour in the real world. This problem is less constrained than inverse reinforcement learning and remains largely unexplored. We propose a framework that uses a reinforcement learning agent, trained on an independent task as a prior about agentic dynamics, to perform agency detection and policy reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文研究AI系统如何仅通过观察来识别和建模环境中的其他智能体，并提出一个利用在独立任务上训练的强化学习智能体作为先验的框架，用于执行智能体检测和策略重建。
AI.motivation: 在现实世界中，协作行为需要AI能够识别和建模其他智能体。该问题比逆向强化学习约束更少且尚未被充分探索，因此需要新的研究框架。
AI.method: 提出一个框架，使用在独立任务上训练的强化学习智能体作为关于智能体动力学的先验，用于进行智能体检测（agency detection）和策略重建（policy reconstruction）。
AI.result: 论文尚未在摘要中给出具体实验结果，主要贡献在于提出了这一新问题的框架性解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为识别和建模其他智能体的开放性问题提供了新的研究方向和可行的方法论基础。

title: Motion-Based Tokenization for Cross-Dataset Egocentric Gaze Modeling
summary: Gaze is increasingly used as an input signal for vision and multimodal models, yet no consensus exists on how to represent it across datasets. Raw traces preserve detail but are noisy and device-dependent, while coarse event labels are easy to model but can discard local motion structure. We formulate event-aligned, fixed-horizon angular displacement as an interpretable, event-conditioned motion vocabulary and compare it with event-only, spatial, absolute-angle, learned vector-quantized, and continuous representations. To assess transfer alongside target predictability and token collapse, our evaluation combines next-token prediction with target-domain regret, low-order target references, paired bootstrap, order sensitivity, motif overlap, and frozen structural probes. In an event-aligned headset benchmark, angular-motion tokens have lower target-domain regret than frozen-codebook VQ tokens in one transfer direction, while the reverse direction is inconclusive. The probes reveal complementary representation properties, and event-only tokens show that low perplexity can retain little motion information. On a third egocentric dataset, a matched comparison of I-VT, native, and frame-span interfaces shows that event construction materially changes transfer: native events have the lowest regret into EGTEA, while frame-span events have zero motif overlap and fail severely as a source. Motion-based tokenization therefore provides a compact representation for event-aligned egocentric gaze streams, while the evaluation identifies how target predictability and event construction shape cross-dataset conclusions.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了视界（gaze）作为视觉与多模态模型输入信号的表示方式问题。作者提出了一种事件对齐、固定时域角位移的"运动词汇"表示方法，并将其与事件仅、空间、绝对角、学习向量量化及连续表示进行比较。通过结合下一词预测、目标域遗憾值、低阶目标参考、配对自助法、顺序敏感性、基序重叠和冻结结构探针等多维度评估，发现角运动令牌在事件对齐头戴设备基准中具有较低的目标域遗憾值，且事件构造方式会显著影响跨数据集迁移结论。
AI.motivation: 视线数据作为视觉与多模态模型的输入信号日益普及，但数据集中视线表示方式缺乏统一共识。原始轨迹保留细节但噪声大且依赖设备，粗粒度事件标签易于建模但可能丢失局部运动结构。需要一个可解释、事件条件的统一表示方法，并需要全面的评估框架来衡量表示质量及其跨数据集迁移能力。
AI.method: 提出事件对齐、固定时域角位移的运动词汇表示方法。评估框架综合了下一词预测（目标可预测性）、目标域遗憾值（跨数据集迁移）、低阶目标参考、配对自助法、顺序敏感性、基序重叠及冻结结构探针。在多个基准上对比了六种表示形式，并在第三个自我中心数据集上比较了I-VT、原生和帧跨三种事件接口。
AI.result: 在事件对齐头戴设备基准中，角运动令牌在某一迁移方向上的目标域遗憾值低于冻结码本VQ令牌，但反向迁移结果不确定。探针显示不同表示具有互补性质；事件仅令牌表明低困惑度可能保留很少运动信息。在第三方自我中心数据集中，原生事件对EGTEA的遗憾值最低，而帧跨事件零基序重叠且作为源域时严重失败。
AI.conclusion: 基于运动的令牌化方法为事件对齐的自我中心视线流提供了紧凑且可解释的表示。评估框架揭示了目标可预测性与事件构造方式如何共同影响跨数据集结论，为视线表示的选择提供了方法论指导。

title: MobilePA-Bench: Benchmarking Mobile Planner Agents on Complex Real-World Tasks
summary: As on-device LLM agents evolve into personal copilots, the mobile operating system has become a key testbed for this paradigm, making rigorous capability evaluation essential. Yet existing benchmarks fall into two camps, each with a critical blind spot: GUI-centric benchmarks test surface-level screen manipulation while overlooking background tool use and long-horizon planning, whereas static function-calling benchmarks rely on offline API matching that is detached from real runtime constraints. To close this gap, we present \textbf{MobilePA-Bench}, an interactive, stateful, and tool-centric benchmark for evaluating the tool-calling and planning abilities of mobile planning agents. MobilePA-Bench runs on an executable sandbox that maintains live application databases and returns structured feedback, spanning $13$ functional domains and $212$ realistic mobile tools. Beyond basic tool use, it evaluates a central planning agent along three advanced dimensions: \emph{(1)~Sub-agent Collaboration}---decomposing a complex task and delegating specialized work to capable sub-agents; \emph{(2)~Memory Usage}---recalling stored memories, user profiles, and past preferences to resolve implicit requests; and \emph{(3)~Skill Usage}---invoking pre-packaged composite skills instead of planning every step from scratch. Extensive experiments show that current frontier LLMs remain unreliable in mobile settings: performance drops sharply under strict tool ordering, permission limits, and unexpected runtime errors. By pairing an interactive function-calling sandbox with evidence-based verification, MobilePA-Bench serves as both a practical diagnostic benchmark and an interactive foundation for agentic reinforcement learning---accelerating the development of dependable mobile agents.

AI.tldr: MobilePA-Bench 是一个交互式、有状态、以工具为中心的移动端智能体基准测试平台，运行在可执行的沙盒环境中，覆盖13个功能域和212个真实移动工具。它评估规划智能体在三个高级维度的能力：子智能体协作、记忆使用和技能使用，并通过实验揭示当前前沿LLM在移动端环境下仍不可靠，尤其在严格工具排序、权限限制和意外运行时错误下表现急剧下降。
AI.motivation: 现有移动端LLM智能体基准测试存在两类关键盲区：GUI-centric基准只测试表面屏幕操作而忽略后台工具使用和长程规划；静态函数调用基准依赖离线的API匹配，与真实运行时约束脱节。需要一个新的基准来弥合这一差距。
AI.method: MobilePA-Bench构建于可执行沙盒之上，维护实时应用数据库并返回结构化反馈。基准覆盖13个功能域和212个移动工具，除基础工具使用外，还从三个高级维度评估规划智能体：(1)子智能体协作（任务分解与委派）；(2)记忆使用（回忆存储记忆、用户画像和过往偏好）；(3)技能使用（调用预打包的复合技能）。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，当前前沿LLM在移动端环境下仍不可靠：在严格工具排序、权限限制和意外运行时错误条件下，性能急剧下降。
AI.conclusion: MobilePA-Bench通过将交互式函数调用沙盒与基于证据的验证相结合，既可作为实用的诊断基准，也可作为智能体强化学习的交互基础，加速开发可靠的移动端智能体。

title: Quality Inspection of Printed Circuit Board Pin Insertion via Semantic Segmentation and Board-Level Feature Extraction
summary: Quality control during printed circuit board (PCB) assembly is a critical step in ensuring reliable electronic products. Detecting misaligned pins during or after pin insertion remains a particularly challenging inspection task. This paper presents an automated defect detection method for identifying incorrectly inserted pins on PCBs. The proposed pipeline combines semantic segmentation using a U-Net architecture with contour-based feature extraction and logistic regression for board-level pass/fail classification. Segmentation masks are used to derive contour representations of individual pins, from which board-level features -such as average contour size- are extracted and used to train a logistic regression classifier. We evaluate the method on two datasets: an industrial collection of real-world PCB images, and a publicly available PCB pin-inspection dataset with substantially different visual characteristics. To assess the effectiveness of the proposed approach, a comparison against PatchCore, an anomaly detection technique new to be applied to pin inspection, as well as instance segmentation-based pin detection is made. The developed method achieved Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (ROC-AUC) values of 0.990 on a random test set split from the industrial data and 1.000 on the public dataset indicating strong separation between pass and fail boards. The results indicate that the proposed approach is a promising candidate for automated pin inspection in industrial environments and achieves strong performance on datasets with substantially different visual characteristics after dataset-specific training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于PCB引脚插入缺陷检测的自动化方法，结合U-Net语义分割、基于轮廓的特征提取和逻辑回归分类器，在两个差异显著的数据集上分别达到0.990和1.000的ROC-AUC值，表现优于PatchCore异常检测和实例分割方法。
AI.motivation: PCB组装中的质量控制至关重要，引脚错位检测是装配过程中一项具有挑战性的检测任务，需要自动化缺陷检测方法来确保电子产品的可靠性。
AI.method: 采用U-Net架构进行语义分割获得引脚掩码，从中提取轮廓表示和板级特征（如平均轮廓大小），然后训练逻辑回归分类器进行板级合格/不合格判定。并与PatchCore异常检测和实例分割方法进行对比。
AI.result: 在工业数据集随机测试集上达到0.990的ROC-AUC，在公共数据集上达到1.000的ROC-AUC，表现出对合格和不合格板卡的强区分能力，且优于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在视觉特征差异显著的不同数据集上均表现出强性能，是工业环境中自动化引脚检测的有前景方案，但需要针对特定数据集进行训练。

title: AutoSaddler: Automatic Harness Optimization with Durable Updates from Agent Execution Traces
comment: 44 pages, 15 figures. Project website and code: https://aka.ms/AutoSaddler-website
summary: LLM agents remain unreliable on long-horizon tasks, where small local failures can compound over extended interactions and lead to overall task failure. Although external harnesses can substantially improve robustness, harness design remains a manual and expensive process that requires searching over a large space of prompts, tool configurations, and control logic. We propose AutoSaddler, an automatic harness optimization framework that formulates harness improvement as an offline learning problem and iteratively updates the harness using failure signals from mini-batches. AutoSaddler combines failure-trace diagnosis, structured patch generation that treats the harness as code, and validation-based update selection. Experiments on GAIA2, SWE-Bench Pro, and Terminal-Bench 2.0 show that AutoSaddler substantially improves agent performance over the corresponding base harnesses, achieving gains of 9.0, 9.6, and 10.0 percentage points, respectively. Ablation studies further suggest that effective harness optimization benefits from three ingredients: deep debugging rather than shallow reflection, targeted modifications rather than unconstrained editing, and generalization-aware selection rather than trajectory-specific repair. Together, these results suggest that automatic harness optimization is a promising path toward more performant and reliable agent systems.

AI.tldr: AutoSaddler是一个自动优化LLM智能体外围控制器（harness）的框架，将其视为离线学习问题，通过失败痕迹诊断、结构化补丁生成和验证选择迭代更新harness，在GAIA2、SWE-Bench Pro和Terminal-Bench 2.0上分别提升9.0、9.6和10.0个百分点。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在长时程任务中不可靠，局部小失败会累积导致整体失败。虽然外部harness能显著提升鲁棒性，但harness设计是手工且昂贵的过程，需要在大量提示、工具配置和控制逻辑中搜索。作者希望将harness优化自动化。
AI.method: 将harness改进建模为离线学习问题，通过三个关键组件迭代更新harness：（1）失败痕迹诊断（failure-trace diagnosis），（2）将harness视为代码的结构化补丁生成（structured patch generation），（3）基于验证的选择机制（validation-based update selection）。
AI.result: 在GAIA2、SWE-Bench Pro和Terminal-Bench 2.0三个基准上分别获得9.0、9.6和10.0个百分点的提升。消融实验表明有效优化需要三个要素：深度调试而非浅层反思、定向修改而非无约束编辑、泛化感知选择而非针对特定轨迹的修复。
AI.conclusion: 自动harness优化是提升LLM智能体性能和可靠性的有前景路径，三个关键成分（深度调试、定向修改、泛化感知选择）对有效优化至关重要。

title: WADE: A Reasoning-Annotated Benchmark for Multi-Instance Floating-Waste Grounding with Compact Vision-Language Models
summary: Floating waste in inland waterways threatens aquatic ecosystems and requires timely monitoring under cluttered, multi-object conditions. Existing aquatic-waste datasets provide limited geographic coverage, sparse multi-instance annotations, and little supervision beyond boxes and labels. Compact vision-language models (VLMs) therefore remain insufficiently evaluated for jointly localizing, classifying, counting, and explaining floating waste. We introduce WADE, a reasoning-annotated benchmark containing 2,167 images from rural Bangladesh, 13,608 bounding boxes, and ten waste categories. Each annotation is associated with class-level recognition rules covering visual cues, likely confusions, and discriminative features. We evaluate six VLMs under zero-shot, two-shot, reasoning-guided, and fine-tuned settings using detection, counting, and hallucination metrics. For resource-efficient adaptation, we jointly fine-tune Qwen3-VL-2B on boxes, labels, and reasoning chains using QLoRA. Fine-tuning increases recall from 0.0248 to 0.2339 and F1 from 0.0257 to 0.2163, while reducing image-level hallucination from 0.6836 to 0.0883. However, over three-quarters of instances remain undetected, establishing WADE as a challenging benchmark for dense floating-waste grounding with compact VLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WADE基准，一个包含2,167张孟加拉国农村图像、13,608个边界框和10类废弃物类别的推理注释数据集，用于评估紧凑型视觉语言模型（VLM）在内陆水道漂浮废弃物检测、计数和解释方面的能力。
AI.motivation: 内陆水道漂浮废弃物威胁水生生态系统，需要及时监测，但现有数据集地理覆盖有限、多实例注释稀疏，且紧凑型VLM在联合定位、分类、计数和解释漂浮废弃物方面评估不足。
AI.method: 构建WADE基准，包含类级识别规则注释；评估六种VLM在零样本、两样本、推理引导和微调设置下的性能；使用QLoRA对Qwen3-VL-2B进行边界框、标签和推理链的联合微调。
AI.result: 微调后召回率从0.0248提升至0.2339，F1从0.0257提升至0.2163，图像级幻觉从0.6836降至0.0883；但超过四分之三的实例仍未被检测到。
AI.conclusion: WADE是紧凑型VLM进行密集漂浮废弃物定位的具有挑战性的基准，当前紧凑型VLM在此任务上仍有显著性能差距。

title: From Inertia to Objectivity: Improving Deep Research Agents with Noise Isolation
summary: Web search agents powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) show strong promise, but deep research tasks expose a recurring failure mode: once an agent has produced a query, plan, or intermediate conclusion, it becomes less objective when later judging the consequences of that same action. We term this phenomenon \textbf{inertia bias}. To make it measurable, we introduce the IBIS benchmark, which controls the search observations while varying whether the model is evaluating the outcome of its own prior action. We find that models are substantially worse when they ``own'' the preceding search step, showing that self-authored action history can systematically distort subsequent judgment. We further show that this bias propagates into two forms of system-level degradation: search noise at the worker level and contextual noise at the manager level. To address this problem, we propose NIS-Agent, which applies context isolation at the two decision points most vulnerable to inertia bias: webpage triage and final-answer validation. Across GAIA, WebWalkerQA, BrowseComp, and BrowseComp-zh, NIS-Agent achieves competitive performance while reducing token cost by 33\% compared to our baseline. We further train an 8B model to be intrinsically more resistant to inertia bias; under the same NIS-Agent framework, it attains average performance comparable to GPT-4o on deep research benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"惯性偏差"(inertia bias)概念，指LLM智能体在评估自己先前行动后果时会丧失客观性。作者引入IBIS基准来量化该偏差，并提出NIS-Agent框架通过上下文隔离来缓解这一问题，在多个基准上取得有竞争力的性能并降低33%的token成本。
AI.motivation: 深度研究任务中，LLM驱动的搜索智能体存在系统性缺陷：一旦模型产生了查询、计划或中间结论，它在评估后续结果时就变得不够客观。这种"自我行动污染"导致判断失真，但目前缺乏量化和解决该问题的系统性方法。
AI.method: 1) 提出IBIS基准：通过控制搜索观察内容、同时改变模型是否评估自身先前行动的结果来量化惯性偏差。2) 提出NIS-Agent框架：在两个最易受惯性偏差影响的决策点（网页分类和最终答案验证）实施上下文隔离。3) 训练一个8B参数的模型使其从本质上对惯性偏差更具抵抗力。
AI.result: 模型在"拥有"先前搜索步骤时表现显著更差，证明自我撰写的行动历史会系统性扭曲后续判断。NIS-Agent在GAIA、WebWalkerQA、BrowseComp和BrowseComp-zh上取得有竞争力的性能，同时相比基线降低33%的token成本。训练后的8B模型在NIS-Agent框架下达到与GPT-4o相当的平均性能。
AI.conclusion: 惯性偏差是LLM搜索智能体中的真实且可量化的系统性缺陷，会从工作层（搜索噪声）和管理层（上下文噪声）两个层面传播为系统级退化。通过上下文隔离和有针对性训练的模型，可以有效缓解该偏差，实现高性能与低成本的平衡。

title: WildHandBench: A Benchmark for Handwritten Text Understanding that Challenges MLLMs and Humans
summary:
While the top model on OmniDocBench now reaches 96.34% overall on printed-document parsing, the ability of current models to handle challenging handwritten documents remains largely uncharacterized. Existing benchmarks focus on isolated text or formulas, overlook handwritten tables and real-world degradation, and report aggregate accuracy without explaining why models fail.
  We present WildHandBench, a benchmark containing 500 handwritten documents across three structures (free text, tables, formulas), four languages, and nine real-world scenarios. We introduce a Prior-Driven Error (PDE) metric that quantifies whether errors originate from language priors rather than visual evidence. Evaluating 18 state-of-the-art models together with calibrated human baselines, we find: (1) the best model achieves only 71.85% overall; (2) humans outperform all models yet the gap is narrow (77.09% vs. 71.85%); and (3) model errors are qualitatively different from human errors -- 63-91% of model errors are prior-driven versus only 49% for humans, exposing systematic reliance on language priors that conventional accuracy metrics cannot capture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WildHandBench基准，包含500份手写文档（涵盖自由文本、表格、公式三种结构，四种语言，九个真实场景），并引入Prior-Driven Error (PDE)指标来量化错误是源于语言先验还是视觉证据。评估18个SOTA模型和人类基线，发现最佳模型仅达71.85%准确率，人类虽优于模型但差距不大（77.09% vs 71.85%），且模型63-91%的错误是先验驱动型，而人类仅为49%。
AI.motivation: 现有benchmark过于聚焦打印文档或孤立文本/公式，忽视了手写表格和真实世界退化问题，且仅报告聚合准确率而无法解释模型失败的根本原因。手写文档解析能力尚未被充分刻画。
AI.method: 构建WildHandBench基准（500份手写文档，覆盖3种结构、4种语言、9个真实场景）；提出Prior-Driven Error (PDE)指标以区分语言先验错误与视觉证据错误；评估18个SOTA模型及校准后的人类基线。
AI.result: （1）最佳模型仅达71.85%整体准确率；（2）人类优于所有模型但差距较窄（77.09% vs 71.85%）；（3）模型63-91%的错误为先验驱动型，人类仅为49%，揭示模型系统性依赖语言先验，这是传统准确率指标无法捕捉的。
AI.conclusion: 当前SOTA模型在手写文档解析上仍有显著不足，且其错误模式与人类有本质差异——过度依赖语言先验而非视觉证据，提示未来研究需要关注视觉鲁棒性和先验偏差问题。

title: LLM-based Agents for Forecasting and Prediction: Methods, Training, Evaluation, and Applications
summary: Large language models (LLMs) now support forecasting systems that combine language-based reasoning with temporal data, evidence retrieval, external tools, and iterative prediction. We investigate LLM-based forecasting agents, meaning systems in which a language model contributes to a scored prediction about a future or currently unobserved target. We organize architectures into three groups. Standalone LLM workflows operate on encoded time series or event context. Tool- and retrieval-augmented agents incorporate external evidence. Hybrid systems pair LLMs with statistical or foundation models. We then review training methods and evaluation protocols. We examine negative as well as positive evidence, including sensitivity to small input perturbations, ablations in which the LLM component does not improve accuracy, and benchmark gains that may reflect contamination instead of temporal reasoning. We cover applications in finance, weather, health, energy, and operations, and we summarize the benchmarks and datasets used for evaluation. The evidence indicates that measurement is a central limitation. Future work requires calibration under distribution shift, contamination-resistant live evaluation, explicit reporting of cost and accuracy together, and methods for handling feedback between deployed forecasts and the outcomes being forecast.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了基于大语言模型（LLM）的预测智能体系统，将其分为三类架构：独立LLM工作流、工具与检索增强智能体、LLM与统计/基础模型混合系统。文章回顾了训练方法和评估协议，并重点分析了负面证据（如对输入扰动的敏感性、消融实验中LLM组件未提升精度、基准增益可能源于数据污染而非时间推理）。应用领域涵盖金融、天气、健康、能源和运营。核心结论是测量是主要瓶颈，未来需要分布偏移下的校准、抗污染实时评估、成本与精度联合报告，以及处理预测反馈效应的方法。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM被越来越多地用于时间序列预测和未来事件预测，需要系统性地梳理现有的LLM预测智能体架构、训练方法和评估协议，同时正视负面证据——许多基准性能可能源于数据污染而非真正的时间推理能力，以识别该领域的关键限制和未来方向。
AI.method: 本文采用系统性综述方法，将LLM预测智能体按架构分为三类（独立LLM工作流、工具/检索增强智能体、混合系统），并分别从训练方法、评估协议、正面与负面证据、应用领域和基准数据集五个维度进行总结与分析。
AI.result: 识别出三类主要架构范式及各自特点；发现负面证据普遍存在，包括对输入扰动敏感、LLM组件在消融中不总是提升精度、基准增益可能反映数据污染；汇总了金融、天气、健康、能源、运营等领域的应用与评估基准。
AI.conclusion: 测量是该领域的核心限制。未来工作应聚焦于：分布偏移下的校准、抗数据污染的实时评估、成本与精度联合显式报告、以及处理已部署预测对预测目标产生的反馈效应。

title: Simplified Cross-Modal Calibration for Heterogeneous Event-RGB Stereo Systems
comment: Accepted to the 37th British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026
summary: Accurate extrinsic calibration between event-based and frame-based cameras remains a practical bottleneck for heterogeneous stereo systems. Existing approaches often require sensor or target motion, precise synchronization, or computationally expensive event-to-image reconstruction. We propose a simple, motion-free cross-modal calibration framework that uses a temporally modulated, blended ChArUco target presented on standard consumer displays. By alternating between the original pattern and a partially blended version, the target reliably triggers events while remaining continuously observable to a frame-based camera, avoiding blank frames and reducing synchronization constraints to a coarse, trigger-based alignment. We discretize events into frames coarsely aligned with the RGB images, apply lightweight denoising, and perform ChArUco-based intrinsic and stereo extrinsic calibration. Extensive experiments assess robustness to blending opacity, display brightness, external illumination, viewing angle, and handheld acquisition. Compared to the strongest motion-based reference (E2Calib + Kalibr) and a non-motion-based reference (Plasberg et al.), our approach reduces the mean reprojection error by $44\%$ and $6\%$, respectively, while substantially simplifying the calibration procedure. Finally, we demonstrate practical utility in a robotic eye-to-hand calibration case study, showing consistent transformations and stable downstream geometric measurements even under partial occlusions. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/nhessenthaler/simple-evrgb-cal.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需运动的跨模态（事件相机-帧相机）标定框架，利用标准显示器上时间调制的混合ChArUco靶标，交替显示原始图案和部分混合版本以触发事件，同时保持帧相机持续可见。该方法无需传感器运动、精确同步或事件重建，通过粗略触发对齐即可完成内外参标定。
AI.motivation: 事件相机与传统帧相机之间的精确外参标定是异构立体系统的实际瓶颈。现有方法需要传感器或靶标运动、精确同步或昂贵的计算开销，缺乏简单、无运动且低同步要求的标定方案。
AI.method: 使用标准消费级显示器呈现时间调制的混合ChArUco靶标：在原始图案和部分混合版本之间交替切换以可靠触发事件，同时保持靶标对帧相机持续可见。将事件离散化为与RGB图像粗略对齐的帧，应用轻量级去噪，然后进行基于ChArUco的内参和立体外参标定，仅需粗略的触发式同步对齐。
AI.result: 大量实验评估了混合透明度、显示亮度、外部光照、视角和手持采集等条件下的鲁棒性。相比最强的基于运动的方法（E2Calib + Kalibr），平均重投影误差降低了44%；相比非基于运动的方法（Plasberg et al.），降低了6%。在机器人眼-手标定案例中展示了实际效用，即使在部分遮挡下也能获得一致的变换和稳定的下游几何测量。
AI.conclusion: 该无运动、低成本同步要求的跨模态标定框架显著简化了标定流程，同时提升了精度，并在机器人眼-手标定等实际场景中验证了实用性，代码已公开。

title: Improving O-RADS Risk Stratification from Ultrasound Reports: A Comparative Evaluation of Hybrid versus End-to-End LLM Reasoning Strategies
comment: Main manuscript: 20 pages, 5 figures, and 2 tables; supplemental material: 11 pages, 1 figure, and 3 tables
summary: Background: Automating clinical guideline-based decision-making with large language models (LLMs) remains challenging because of reliability, hallucination, and limited interpretability. We compared the performance of LLMs and reasoning strategies for automated Ovarian-Adnexal Reporting and Data System (O-RADS) classification from free-text pelvic ultrasound reports. Methods: In this retrospective study, consecutive patients with ovarian masses who underwent pelvic ultrasound were included. Eight LLMs were tested with three reasoning strategies: implicit-knowledge end-to-end, rule-informed end-to-end, and a feature-based hybrid architecture that decoupled feature extraction from rule-based classification. The reference standard was O-RADS categorization established by expert consensus. Results: A total of 310 women with 390 ovarian masses were evaluated. The feature-based hybrid architecture using Gemini 3.6 Flash demonstrated the best performance, achieving an accuracy of 99.2% (387 of 390) and almost perfect agreement with the reference standard (weighted kappa = 1.00; 95% CI: 0.99-1.00). Its performance surpassed that of original clinical reports (accuracy, 87.7% [342 of 390]; weighted kappa = 0.94; 95% CI: 0.91-0.96) and end-to-end LLM strategies (accuracy range, 65.6% [256 of 390] to 95.9% [374 of 390]). For structured feature extraction, Gemini 3.6 Flash demonstrated higher overall accuracy than Claude Fable 5 (98.9% vs 97.8%; P < 0.001). The hybrid architecture reduced misclassification errors and mitigated the overstaging tendency observed in original reports. Conclusion: The feature-based hybrid LLM architecture that separates clinical feature extraction from deterministic guideline execution enables highly accurate, reliable, and interpretable automated O-RADS classification, providing a promising approach for standardized, guideline-based clinical decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了8种大语言模型和3种推理策略在自动化O-RADS分类中的性能，发现采用特征提取与规则分类解耦的混合架构（使用Gemini 3.6 Flash）表现最佳，准确率达99.2%，显著优于原始临床报告和端到端LLM策略。
AI.motivation: 基于临床指南的决策自动化在LLM应用中面临可靠性、幻觉和可解释性等挑战，需要探索更稳健的方法来实现从自由文本超声报告中自动进行O-RADS分类。
AI.method: 回顾性纳入310名女性共390个卵巢肿块，测试8种LLM和3种推理策略：隐式知识端到端、规则知情端到端、以及特征提取与规则分类解耦的基于特征的混合架构。以专家共识的O-RADS分类作为参考标准。
AI.result: 基于特征的混合架构配合Gemini 3.6 Flash表现最佳，准确率99.2%（387/390），加权kappa=1.00（95%CI:0.99-1.00），超过原始临床报告（准确率87.7%）和端到端LLM策略（准确率65.6%-95.9%）。Gemini 3.6 Flash在结构化特征提取方面优于Claude Fable 5（98.9% vs 97.8%，P<0.001）。混合架构减少了误分类并缓解了原始报告的过度分期倾向。
AI.conclusion: 将临床特征提取与确定性指南执行分离的基于特征的混合LLM架构，能够实现高度准确、可靠且可解释的自动化O-RADS分类，为标准化的临床决策支持提供了有前景的方案。

title: Optimize Surgical Triplet Recognition: A Knowledge-Driven Mixture-of-Experts Solution
summary: Surgical action triplet recognition constitutes a critical task in context-aware robot-assisted surgery, facilitating automatic surgical action perception by identifying instrument, verb, target, and their association. However, existing works struggle to analyze such complex surgical scenes due to three main issues: (1) component-level optimization conflicts caused by entangled feature spaces, (2) category-level optimization conflicts arising from severe data imbalance, and (3) lack of domain knowledge guidance that limits model interpretability and robustness. To address these challenges, we propose a Mixture-of-Experts-guided Co-Optimization (\textit{MoeCo}) framework powered by knowledge-driven learning. Within the co-optimization pipeline, to first mitigate component-level conflicts, we introduce a component-tailored adapter that disentangles task-specific features across spatial-temporal regimes, facilitating effective component specialization. Next, we develop a coordinated gradient learning strategy to handle category-level conflicts, which adaptively rebalances positive-negative gradients to enhance the perception of rare categories. Notably, inspired by surgical domain expertise, we introduce a knowledge-driven mixture-of-experts mechanism that dynamically integrates multimodal large language model-guided knowledge via activated experts, thereby enriching the co-optimization pipeline with more expressive and robust representations. Extensive experiments on the public CholecT45 and CholecT50 datasets confirm the effectiveness of the proposed co-optimization pipeline and the superiority of dynamic priors integration via the knowledge-driven mixture-of-experts mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MoeCo框架，通过组件自适应适配器、协调梯度学习和知识驱动混合专家机制，解决手术动作三元组识别中的组件级和类别级优化冲突，在CholecT45和CholecT50数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有手术动作三元组识别方法面临三个主要挑战：(1)组件级优化冲突——特征空间纠缠导致各组件（器械、动词、目标）难以独立优化；(2)类别级优化冲突——数据严重不平衡影响稀有类别识别；(3)缺乏领域知识引导——模型可解释性和鲁棒性受限。这些问题的存在限制了复杂手术场景的自动感知能力。
AI.method: 提出Mixture-of-Experts-guided Co-Optimization (MoeCo)框架，包含三个核心组件：(1)组件自适应适配器（component-tailored adapter），在时空维度上解缠任务特定特征，实现组件专业化；(2)协调梯度学习策略（coordinated gradient learning），自适应平衡正负梯度以增强稀有类别感知；(3)知识驱动混合专家机制（knowledge-driven mixture-of-experts），通过激活专家动态整合多模态大语言模型引导的领域知识，丰富协同优化管道的表征能力。
AI.result: 在公开的CholecT45和CholecT50数据集上进行的大量实验确认了所提出的协同优化管道的有效性，以及通过知识驱动混合专家机制进行动态先验集成的优越性。
AI.conclusion: MoeCo框架通过将组件级和类别级优化解耦，并结合领域知识驱动的专家机制，有效提升了手术动作三元组识别的性能和鲁棒性，为复杂的上下文感知机器人辅助手术场景提供了更可靠的自动感知方案。

title: From Generation to Simulation: How Far Are World Models from Being True Simulators?
summary: With the rapid progress of diffusion models and large-scale video generation, generative world models are increasingly expected to replace traditional simulators, including physics engines, game engines, and reinforcement-learning environments. Yet the remaining distance from generation to simulation lacks a systematic assessment. We present a capability-based study using an external yardstick: eight capabilities of a traditional simulator, namely asset construction, physics engine, interaction, controllability, stability, state feedback, diversity, and evaluation metrics. We trace three main technical routes--latent dynamics, video generation, and joint-embedding prediction--and map exactly 200 representative works published from 2018 to June 2026 onto these capabilities. Our analysis shows that world models have achieved functional substitution in interaction and controllability for specific scenarios, but remain short of traditional simulators in formal guarantees of physical laws, structured state feedback, and reproducible long-horizon evolution. State feedback is the most neglected cross-route shortcoming: only 6 of 163 implementation papers expose a runtime interface for querying entity states or physical parameters. We identify six research directions: formalized physics, a unified action interface, first-class state feedback, long-horizon stability, downstream-utility evaluation, and cross-route hybridization. Project page: https://github.com/AtongWang/world-model-simulators

AI.tldr: 本文对生成式世界模型作为传统模拟器替代品的可行性进行了系统性评估，通过八项模拟器能力指标（资产构建、物理引擎、交互、可控性、稳定性、状态反馈、多样性和评估指标）对2018至2026年间的200篇代表性工作进行能力映射分析。研究发现世界模型在特定场景的交互和可控性上已实现功能性替代，但在物理规律的形式化保证、结构化状态反馈和可复现的长时程演化方面仍落后于传统模拟器，其中状态反馈是最被忽视的跨路线短板。
AI.motivation: 随着扩散模型和大规模视频生成技术的快速发展，生成式世界模型被认为有望替代物理引擎、游戏引擎和强化学习环境等传统模拟器，但生成到模拟之间仍有多大差距缺乏系统性的评估。作者希望通过建立外部标准并系统映射现有工作，为这一领域提供清晰的进展图景和未来方向。
AI.method: 采用基于能力的分析方法，提出传统模拟器的八项核心能力作为外部评判标准；梳理三条主要技术路线（潜在动力学、视频生成、联合嵌入预测）；并对2018年至2026年6月间发表的200篇代表性工作进行能力映射和系统分析。
AI.result: 世界模型在特定场景的交互性和可控性方面已实现功能性替代；但在物理规律的形式化保证、结构化状态反馈和可复现的长时程演化方面仍不足；状态反馈是最被忽视的跨路线短板——163篇实现论文中仅6篇暴露了用于查询实体状态或物理参数的运行时接口。
AI.conclusion: 提出六个未来研究方向：形式化物理、统一动作接口、一等公民状态反馈、长时程稳定性、下游效用评估以及跨路线混合，以推动世界模型从生成走向真正的模拟。

title: ENCORE: Entropy-Guided Cropping and Attention Regularization for Robust Vision--Language Understanding
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform well on diverse vision-language tasks, but transformer-based visual encoders split images into fixed-resolution sub-images, compromising object integrity in lightweight VLMs. Existing methods only focus on the visual modality and fail to dynamically preserve the integrity of prompt-relevant regions, limiting performance. In this work, we observe that the early-layer image-text entropy of cross-modal attention strongly correlates with answer grounding quality and task accuracy. Building on this finding, we propose \textbf{ENCORE}, an entropy-guided framework with two components: At inference, an \textbf{Entropy-based Cropping Strategy} (ECS) evaluates a small set of candidate crops and selects the one with minimal entropy, preserving contiguous regions relevant to the prompt. At training, \textbf{Entropy Regularization Training} (ERT) augments next-token prediction with an entropy term that sharpens attention on key visual tokens while down-weighting irrelevant ones. Experiments on ten VQA benchmarks show that ENCORE, fine-tuning only 0.14\% of parameters, achieves an average 1.43\% accuracy gain and state-of-the-art performance among recent 2B-parameter VLMs. Our code is released in https://github.com/baokou-fw2/ENCORE.

AI.tldr: ENCORE是一个熵引导框架，通过推理时的基于熵的裁剪策略（ECS）和训练时的熵正则化训练（ERT）来动态保留提示相关区域的完整性，仅微调0.14%的参数即在十个VQA基准上平均提升1.43%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有的轻量级VLM中，基于Transformer的视觉编码器将图像分割为固定分辨率的子图像，破坏了物体的完整性。已有方法仅关注视觉模态，无法动态保留与提示相关区域的完整性，限制了模型性能。
AI.method: 提出ENCORE框架，包含两个组件：(1) 推理时的Entropy-based Cropping Strategy (ECS)，评估少量候选裁剪并选择熵最小的方案；(2) 训练时的Entropy Regularization Training (ERT)，在下一个token预测中增加熵项，强化对关键视觉token的注意力并降低无关token的权重。
AI.result: 在十个VQA基准上，仅微调0.14%的参数，ENCORE平均取得1.43%的准确率提升，并在近期2B参数VLM中达到最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 交叉注意力早期层的图像-文本熵与答案基础质量及任务准确率高度相关，利用这一发现指导裁剪和训练正则化可以有效提升轻量级VLM的性能。

title: AgentWeave: Routing Before Reasoning for Efficient Function Calling in Tool-Rich Language Models
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Open-source implementation and reproducibility artifacts available in the AgentWeave repository
summary: Large language models increasingly operate over large collections of tools, functions, APIs, and specialized agents. As the candidate action space grows, a function-calling model must process more schemas, consume more prompt tokens, and distinguish among increasingly similar or irrelevant alternatives. We study a complementary systems strategy: reduce the candidate set before language-model inference while leaving the downstream model unchanged. We introduce AgentWeave, a deterministic pre-inference routing layer that constructs a bounded model-visible action space using eligibility, requirement, capability, and routing signals. We evaluate AgentWeave with a frozen BFCL-derived routing-pressure protocol using the public MadeAgents/Hammer2.1-1.5b model. On 48 fresh BFCL V4 multiple-function tasks, AgentWeave achieves 6/48 (12.5%) native BFCL successes, whereas all-tools, deterministic random top-8, and semantic top-8 baselines each achieve 0/48. The paired success difference is +12.5 percentage points with a 10,000-resample paired bootstrap 95% confidence interval of +4.17 to +22.92 points and exact McNemar p=0.03125. Relative to all-tools exposure, AgentWeave presents 70.18% fewer tools, uses 61.70% fewer input tokens, and exhibits 50.95% lower mean local-model latency. The result is deliberately narrow: this is a BFCL-derived routing-pressure study rather than an official full BFCL leaderboard score, and absolute task success remains low. The evidence nevertheless shows that candidate-space construction can materially affect a fixed model's function-calling behavior and motivates evaluating routing as a distinct stage before model reasoning.

AI.tldr: AgentWeave是一个确定性的推理前路由层，通过使用资格、需求、能力和路由信号构建有界的模型可见动作空间，在推理前减少候选工具集而不改变下游模型。在48个BFCL V4多函数任务上，相比全工具基线的0/48，AgentWeave达到6/48成功率，同时减少70%工具、61.7%输入token和50.95%延迟。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在大量工具、函数、API和专用智能体集合上运行时，候选动作空间不断增长，导致模型需要处理更多schema、消耗更多提示token，并需要在越来越相似或无关的候选项中做区分。作者提出一种互补的系统策略：在语言模型推理之前减少候选集，同时保持下游模型不变。
AI.method: 引入AgentWeave，一个确定性的推理前路由层，通过资格、需求、能力和路由信号构建有界的模型可见动作空间。使用冻结的BFCL衍生路由压力协议，配合公共的MadeAgents/Hammer2.1-1.5b模型进行evaluation。
AI.result: 在48个BFCL V4多函数任务上，AgentWeave取得6/48（12.5%）原生BFCL成功率，而所有基线（全工具、确定性随机top-8、语义top-8）均为0/48。配对成功差异+12.5个百分点，bootstrap 95%置信区间为+4.17至+22.92，McNemar确切检验p=0.03125。同时减少70.18%工具暴露、61.70%输入token和50.95%的平均本地模型延迟。
AI.conclusion: 候选空间构建能实质性影响固定模型的函数调用行为，并激励将路由视为模型推理之前的一个独立阶段进行评估。但作者强调这是BFCL衍生路由压力研究而非官方完整BFCL榜单评分，绝对任务成功率仍然较低。

title: Coarse Indexing, Fine Evidence: Decoupling Temporal Granularity in Long-Video RAG
summary: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) provides a scalable paradigm for long-video understanding, but existing systems typically inherit a fixed temporal granularity from video segmentation when constructing their retrieval index. We argue that this design unnecessarily couples indexing granularity with evidence granularity: coarse representations can often suffice for locating relevant temporal regions, while fine-grained evidence remains important for downstream reasoning. We propose \textbf{Density-Aware Graph Construction (DAGC)}, a training-free approach that decouples a query-independent coarse retrieval index from the original fine-grained evidence space. DAGC constructs a compact, density-adaptive graph index by merging visually redundant neighboring chunks, while preserving mappings to the original temporal units. Retrieved coarse regions are subsequently expanded back to the original chunk granularity for fine-grained evidence refinement and answer generation. Experiments on MLVU, VideoMME, and LongVideoBench show that DAGC retains only about 40--50\% of the original graph nodes and achieves $1.3$--$1.7\times$ end-to-end wall-clock acceleration while preserving approximately 99\% of the original QA performance. The gains transfer across different LVLM backbones and video RAG pipelines, suggesting that long-video RAG need not maintain the same temporal granularity for indexing and evidence reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DAGC（密度感知图构建），一种无需训练的方法，通过解耦粗粒度检索索引与细粒度证据空间来加速基于图RAG的长视频理解。DAGC合并视觉冗余的相邻块构建紧凑的密度自适应图索引，保留原始时间单元的映射，检索后扩展回原始粒度进行推理。在MLVU、VideoMME和LongVideoBench上，仅保留约40-50%的图节点，实现1.3-1.7倍端到端加速，同时保持约99%的QA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于图的RAG系统在构建检索索引时继承了视频分割产生的固定时间粒度，导致索引粒度与证据粒度不必要地耦合。作者认为粗粒度表示足以定位相关时间区域，而细粒度证据对下游推理仍然重要，因此需要解耦这两种粒度以提升效率。
AI.method: DAGC通过合并视觉冗余的相邻块构建紧凑的密度自适应图索引（查询无关），同时保持到原始时间单元的映射。检索到的粗粒度区域会被扩展回原始块粒度，用于细粒度证据精炼和答案生成。整个过程无需训练。
AI.result: 在MLVU、VideoMME和LongVideoBench上，DAGC仅保留约40-50%的原始图节点，实现1.3-1.7倍端到端时间加速，同时保持约99%的原始QA性能。该增益在不同LVLM骨干和视频RAG流水线上均可迁移。
AI.conclusion: 长视频RAG系统不需要在索引和证据推理中保持相同的时间粒度，解耦索引粒度与证据粒度可在显著加速的同时几乎不损失性能，为长视频理解提供了一种更高效可扩展的范式。

title: POOL: Propagated Uncertainty Over Lookalikes
summary: Black-box large language models need confidence scores that can separate likely-correct from likely-incorrect outputs, enabling systems to prioritize human review, route uncertain cases to stronger models, or choose abstention thresholds on development data. Yet existing confidence estimators face a cost-quality trade-off: verbal confidence is cheap but is often overconfident, while sampling-based uncertainty is more informative but scales linearly with the number of samples per query. We propose \textsc{POOL} (\emph{Propagated Uncertainty Over Lookalikes}),a cost-efficient framework that addresses this trade-off taking inspiration from group-testing.\textsc{POOL} clusters query stems with overlaps, evaluates a base estimator on representative medoids, softly propagates confidence scores to nearby queries, and selectively evaluates high-disagreement cases. We instantiate this framework with \textsc{Hy@}$p$, a hybrid estimator that combines verbal confidence with spectral answer diversity computed from the negative von Neumann entropy of sampled answer embeddings.Across six domains from three datasets and five black-box LLMs, \textsc{Hy@}5 achieves higher average AUROC than verbal confidence and \textsc{Vn@}10 sampling while using half as many samples as \textsc{Vn@}10. \textsc{POOL}-\textsc{Hy@}5 retains 93.5--97.9\% of its AUROC while saving 19.3--39.3\% of generations. On paraphrase-dense workloads, generation savings rise to 73-76\%, showing that semantic redundancy can be leveraged to lower confidence-estimation costs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出POOL框架（基于"群体测试"思想），通过聚类查询、代理样本评估、软传播置信度以及选择性评估高分歧案例，实现低成本高效率的黑盒LLM置信度估计。其核心组件Hy@p混合估计器结合了语言置信度与基于负von Neumann熵的谱系答案多样性。实验表明Hy@5在六个领域、五类黑盒LLM上超越了口头置信度与Vn@10采样方法，且样本量只需后者一半；POOL-Hy@5在保留93.5%-97.9% AUROC的同时节省19.3%-39.3%的生成量，在释义密集任务中可节省73-76%的生成。
AI.motivation: 现有置信度估计方法存在成本-质量权衡：口头置信度（verbal confidence）便宜但容易过度自信；基于采样的不确定性更可靠但计算成本随样本数线性增长。需要一个能兼顾成本与质量的框架。
AI.method: 提出POOL框架，借鉴群体测试（group-testing）思想：1）对查询进行聚类（含重叠）；2）在代表性medoid上评估基础估计器；3）将置信度软传播到邻近查询；4）选择性评估高分歧案例。同时提出Hy@p混合估计器，结合口头置信度与从负von Neumann熵计算的谱系答案多样性。
AI.result: Hy@5在六个领域三个数据集和五个黑盒LLM上取得比口头置信度和Vn@10更高的平均AUROC，且只使用Vn@10一半的样本。POOL-Hy@5保留93.5%-97.9%的AUROC同时节省19.3%-39.3%的生成量；在释义密集工作负载下生成节省达73-76%。
AI.conclusion: 文本语义冗余可被利用来显著降低置信度估计成本，POOL框架有效平衡了置信度估计的成本与质量，为黑盒LLM的可信部署提供了高效方案。

title: Misanthrope: A Privacy-Preserving Keypoint Detector
comment: Accepted to Privacy preserving Visual Localization (PPVLM) workshop at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
summary: Image matching is a core component of applications such as Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM), Visual Localization, and Structure from Motion (SfM). However, the local image features central to this task are vulnerable to inversion attacks, which enable adversaries to reconstruct privacy-sensitive scene content from local features. These attacks pose a particular threat in distributed computing scenarios where the pre-computed features leave edge devices to be processed by remote servers. In this work, we introduce Misanthrope, a novel privacy-preserving keypoint detector trained through self-distillation to avoid detecting keypoints on people---a predominant source of privacy-sensitive content in most localization scenarios---thus mitigating inversion attacks at the source rather than through post-hoc obfuscation. We demonstrate how inverted images from traditional feature detection pipelines can be used to detect and re-identify people in the scene, while Misanthrope is able to mitigate these attacks. Furthermore, Misanthrope maintains image matching performance on par with the state of the art and even surpasses it in challenging settings where people act as distractors, such as phototourism and in-the-wild odometry. On the Image Matching Challenge 2021 Phototourism test set, Misanthrope is the top-performing sparse feature extractor in 7 out of 9 scenes. We make our model and its evaluation script available here: https://github.com/fratopa/misanthrope

AI.tldr: 本文提出Misanthrope，一种通过自蒸馏训练的新型隐私保护关键点检测器，旨在避免检测人物身上的关键点，从源头上缓解特征反转攻击，同时保持与最先进的图像匹配性能相当甚至更优。
AI.motivation: 局部图像特征容易受到反转攻击，攻击者可以从中重建隐私敏感的场景内容。在分布式计算场景中，预计算的特征离开边缘设备被远程服务器处理，这种威胁尤为严重。现有方法多采用事后混淆（post-hoc obfuscation），而非从源头缓解。
AI.method: 提出Misanthrope，一个通过自蒸馏（self-distillation）训练的隐私保护关键点检测器，其设计目标是不在人物（隐私敏感内容的主要来源）上检测关键点，从源头缓解反转攻击。
AI.result: 实验证明反转图像可被用于检测和重新识别场景中的人物，而Misanthrope能够缓解这些攻击。Misanthrope在图像匹配性能上与最先进方法相当，在人物作为干扰物的挑战性场景（如摄影旅游和野外里程计）中甚至超越现有方法。在IMC 2021 Phototourism测试集中，Misanthrope在9个场景中的7个是最佳稀疏特征提取器。
AI.conclusion: Misanthrope通过避免在人物上检测关键点，能够从源头上有效缓解反转攻击，同时不牺牲甚至提升图像匹配性能，特别是在人物作为干扰物的场景中表现更优。

title: Jiuge-Tuiqiao: An Interpretable Human-AI System for Classical Chinese Poetry Refinement
comment: Accepted to the System Demonstrations Program at EMNLP 2026. Code and demo: https://github.com/jiangli-va/Jiuge-Tuiqiao
summary: Classical Chinese poetry composition has long valued Tuiqiao, the iterative refinement of words, imagery, and prosody. However, many current AI poetry systems follow a one-shot generation paradigm, which reduces users to prompt providers and weakens their creative agency. We present Jiuge-Tuiqiao, an interactive human-AI collaborative system for classical Chinese poetry composition.
