The system is designed around a triadic model: user-driven control, ancient-guided evidence, and AI-assisted generation. Users can lock characters or lines, receive real-time prosody feedback, and obtain interpretable refinement suggestions grounded in high-frequency collocations, PPL-ranked classical lines, and structured knowledge extracted from classical encyclopedias. This design turns AI from an autonomous generator into a background assistant that supports the user's own process of poetic refinement. Preliminary experiments and user feedback suggest that Jiuge-Tuiqiao improves controllability, interpretability, and user engagement in classical poetry composition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Jiuge-Tuiqiao，一个交互式人机协作系统，用于古典中文诗歌创作。系统围绕三元模型设计：用户驱动控制、古籍引导证据、AI辅助生成，将AI从自主生成器转变为支持用户推敲过程的背景助手。
AI.motivation: 古典诗歌创作历来重视"推敲"——对字词、意象和格律的迭代打磨。然而当前许多AI诗歌系统采用一次性生成范式，将用户降级为提示提供者，削弱了用户的创作能动性。
AI.method: 设计了三元交互模型：(1) 用户驱动控制——用户可锁定字或诗句；(2) 古籍引导证据——基于高频搭配、PPL排序的经典诗句、以及从古典百科全书中提取的结构化知识；(3) AI辅助生成——提供实时格律反馈和可解释的润色建议。
AI.result: 初步实验和用户反馈表明，Jiuge-Tuiqiao在可控性、可解释性和用户参与度方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 该系统成功将AI角色从自主生成者转变为支持用户自身推敲过程的背景助手，更好地契合了古典诗歌创作中"推敲"的核心精神。

title: AnaDiffusion: Anatomically CompositionalLatent Diffusion for Controllable 3D Brain MRI Generation
summary: 3D brain MRI generation has made significant advances in medical imaging, simulation, and controllable anatomical analysis. However, existing generative models typically synthesize 3D volumes monolithically, often overlooking regional anatomical structures and limiting local controllability. To address these limitations, we introduce AnaDiffusion, an anatomically compositional latent diffusion framework that factorizes the generation process into distinct, anatomically meaningful regions, followed by part-to-whole assembly and global refinement. Our approach first trains part diffusion models to capture local structural priors. We then inject an assembled anatomical composite of the parts into the whole-brain latent representation and continue denoising. This mechanism enables the model to resolve global context while preserving the injected anatomy. As a result, AnaDiffusion produces both explicit part assets and a globally coherent volume, thereby enabling controllable part editing without requiring subject-specific dense segmentation maps at inference time while maintaining consistent part-to-whole brain structure. On the subject-disjoint ADNI test split, AnaDiffusion achieves the lowest FID across the whole brain, left and right hemispheres, cerebellar-brainstem complex, and seam regions. It also achieves the best cerebellar and second-best ventricular and brainstem absolute Cohen's d values among the evaluated methods. In localized editing experiments, paired MS-SSIM demonstrates high target transfer and off-target preservation, supporting controllable part replacement with minimal unintended anatomical alterations.

AI.tldr: AnaDiffusion是一个解剖学组合式潜扩散框架，将3D脑部MRI生成分解为不同解剖学上有意义的部分，然后进行部分到整体的组装和全局细化，实现可控的部分编辑和全局一致的脑部体积生成。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型通常整体合成3D脑部体积，忽视了区域解剖结构，限制了局部可控性。作者希望实现既能生成全局一致脑部图像，又能对特定解剖区域进行独立控制和编辑的生成框架。
AI.method: 首先训练多个部分扩散模型捕获局部结构先验，然后将解剖学组装的各部分注入到全脑潜表示中继续去噪，使模型在解决全局上下文的同时保持注入的解剖结构，实现部分到整体的组装和全局细化。
AI.result: 在subject-disjoint ADNI测试集上取得最低的FID（全脑、左右半球、小脑-脑干复合体和接缝区域），在小脑绝对Cohen's d值上最佳，脑室和脑干上第二佳。局部编辑实验中高MS-SSIM支持可控部分替换且最小化非预期解剖改变。
AI.conclusion: AnaDiffusion实现了可控的部分级生成与编辑，同时保持全局脑部结构一致性，无需推理时的subject-specific密集分割图，为临床可解释的精细脑部生成和编辑提供了新途径。

title: AI emotional support is better only when chosen, but shifts preferences even when it is not
summary: People increasingly face a novel decision when seeking emotional support: human or AI. In existing studies, AI's empathic messages are rated as well as or better than humans'. But these studies either assigned the support source or honored people's choice. In real life, support is often incongruent with choice, as people want one source and receive the other. Across three experiments (N = 1,951), participants chose whether to share an emotional experience with a human or an AI, then were randomly assigned to a congruent or incongruent partner. AI support was rated as superior only among those who had chosen it. Yet regardless of congruence, interacting with AI increased willingness to choose it again. In a 28-day study with OpenAI (N = 981), daily conversations shifted preferences toward AI and away from humans, but only when conversations turned personal. Emotional support choices are thus path-dependent, progressively redirecting away from human connection.

AI.tldr: 通过三项实验（N=1,951）和一项28天纵向研究（N=981），发现情感支持来源（人类vs AI）的选择具有路径依赖性：AI的支持仅在人们主动选择它时才被评价为更优，但无论选择是否一致，与AI互动都会增加再次选择AI的意愿，且长期互动会逐渐将偏好从人类转向AI（仅在对话涉及私人话题时）。
AI.motivation: 现有研究显示AI的共情信息评分不亚于甚至优于人类，但这些研究要么指定支持来源，要么尊重被试的选择，忽视了现实情境中支持来源常常与个人意愿不一致（即选择不一致）的情况。作者旨在探究选择与实际收到的支持来源不一致时，人们对AI情感支持的评价如何变化，以及这种互动对后续偏好选择的影响。
AI.method: 采用三项受控实验（N=1,951）：参与者先选择向人类或AI分享情感经历，随后被随机分配到一致或不一致的支持伙伴（即人类选人类/AI选AI为一致组，交叉条件为不一致组），测量对支持的评价及再次选择意愿。另与OpenAI合作开展28天纵向研究（N=981），记录每日对话是否涉及私人话题，追踪偏好随时间的变化。
AI.result: AI支持仅在参与者原本选择AI时才被评价为优于人类支持；无论选择是否一致，与AI互动后参与者再次选择AI的意愿均增加；28天纵向研究中，日常对话使偏好从人类转向AI，但仅在对话内容涉及个人/私人话题时才发生。
AI.conclusion: 情感支持的选择具有路径依赖性：人们对支持来源的评价受初始选择影响，且与AI的互动会形成正反馈循环，逐步将偏好从人类亲缘支持导向AI，暗示人们可能在不知不觉中逐渐远离人类情感连接。

title: When the Edit Changes the Patient: Measuring Identity Preservation in Counterfactual Retinal Images
summary: Counterfactual medical image generation aims to modify an existing image to reflect a hypothetical scenario in which certain characteristics of the imaged subject are altered, while keeping their identity fixed. Most existing works repurpose established image editing methods, which do not directly supervise identity preservation. Instead, they assume that identity is implicitly preserved by anchoring generation to the source image. This assumption is rarely tested and may fail in domains where biometric cues are subtle, such as retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT). In this work, we explicitly measure identity preservation for three groups of text-conditioned editing methods - source-anchored, structured-prompt, and paired-training - using referee classifiers, embedding alignment scores, and a blind reader study. We find that all methods produce high-quality OCT images with comparable editing success, yet their identity preservation differs markedly. Source-anchored editing frequently alters the depicted subject, while paired-training preserves it best. We argue that future work on medical counterfactual generation must explicitly measure and report identity preservation alongside image realism and editing success.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了医学反事实图像生成中的身份保持问题，针对视网膜OCT图像，系统评估了三类文本条件编辑方法（源锚定、结构化提示、配对训练）的身份保持能力，发现配对训练方法保持身份最佳，而源锚定方法常改变受试者身份，并呼吁未来工作必须明确测量和报告身份保持。
AI.motivation: 现有医学反事实图像生成方法大多借用通用图像编辑技术，假设通过锚定源图像即可隐式保持身份，但该假设从未被严格检验。在视网膜OCT等生物特征线索微妙领域，这一假设可能失效，因此需要显式测量不同方法在身份保持上的表现。
AI.method: 对三类文本条件编辑方法（源锚定、结构化提示、配对训练）进行系统评估，采用三种评估手段：裁判分类器（referee classifiers）、嵌入对齐分数（embedding alignment scores）以及盲法读者研究（blind reader study），以显式测量身份保持能力。
AI.result: 所有方法均能生成高质量的OCT图像且编辑成功率相当，但身份保持差异显著：源锚定编辑经常改变所描绘的受试者，而配对训练方法最能保持身份。
AI.conclusion: 医学反事实生成领域未来必须将身份保持作为与图像真实性和编辑成功并列的显式评估指标进行测量和报告，而非默认假设其隐式成立。

title: Cognitive Profiling of LRMs' Reasoning Traces Using Bloom's Taxonomy
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have revolutionized reasoning in LLMs, and the increasing public availability of reasoning traces creates valuable opportunities to study model behavior not only at the surface level but also at the granularity of individual reasoning steps. However, understanding the types of thinking employed during reasoning - which offers critical insights into models' reasoning patterns and enables actionable applications - remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce a framework for automatic annotation of reasoning steps through the lens of Bloom's Taxonomy, which classifies thinking into six cognitive levels, such as Remembering, Applying and Evaluating. Using this framework, we perform a large-scale analysis across models and datasets, revealing both similarities and differences in thinking patterns across models and tasks. Moreover, we demonstrate that thinking-type information derived from reasoning traces correlates with correctness, paving the way for improved reasoning. Our findings establish a fine-grained framework for analyzing thinking patterns in LRMs and provide actionable insights for enhancing reasoning quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于Bloom分类法的框架，用于自动标注大型推理模型（LRMs）推理过程中的思维类型，将思维分为六个认知层面（如记忆、应用、评估等）。通过大规模跨模型跨数据集的分析，揭示了不同模型和任务中思维模式的异同，并证明思维类型信息与推理正确性相关，为改进推理质量提供了可操作的见解。
AI.motivation: 虽然大型推理模型（LRMs）的推理轨迹日益公开可用，使我们能够从单步粒度研究模型行为，但对推理过程中所采用的思维类型（如记忆、应用、评估等）的理解仍然不足。这种思维类型层面的理解对洞察模型推理模式并实现可操作的应用至关重要，因此需要填补这一研究空白。
AI.method: 提出一个自动注释框架，基于Bloom的分类法将推理步骤的思维类型分为六个认知层面（如Remembering、Applying、Evaluating等）。利用该框架对多个模型和数据集进行大规模分析，并研究思维类型信息与推理正确性之间的关联。
AI.result: 跨模型和跨数据集的大规模分析揭示了不同模型和任务中思维模式的相似性与差异性；同时证明从推理轨迹中提取的思维类型信息与推理正确性存在相关性，可用于改进推理质量。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了细粒度的思维模式分析框架，为理解LRMs的推理行为提供了新视角，并为提升推理质量提供了可操作的指导性见解。

title: Cultural Moment Benchmark: Evaluating Video Cultural Reasoning and Grounding in Southeast Asia
summary: Cultural understanding in video means more than recognizing what is visible; it requires grasping the symbolic and temporal significance of cultural concepts. We decompose this into three abilities: naming what a concept symbolizes, visually recognizing it on video, and locating its sub-events in time. Existing video-cultural benchmarks tend to test what is seen, collapsing these three abilities into a single score that hides the bottleneck. We introduce the Cultural Moment Benchmark (CMB): 306 expert-curated concepts from seven countries in Southeast Asia across five categories. We evaluate each concept through three stages, one per ability. Given a description, Stage 1 (S1) selects from four candidate concept names, Stage 2 (S2) selects from four candidate video moments, and Stage 3 (S3) predicts the start and end times of the moment in a video. To keep each stage focused on a distinct ability, we use three design choices: semantic-similarity distractors (S1, S2), unlabeled video moments (S2), and free-form localization on a different example video (S3). Across six vision-language models, failure modes vary by ability and modality. i) Even the strongest closed-source models score below 30% when all three stages must be correct; ii) The three abilities do not fully cascade: naming a concept correctly helps half the models recognize it on video, but recognizing it has little effect on locating the sub-event in time; iii) Audio is complementary, redundant, or distracting depending on the concept, more often distracting in non-Latin-script countries; removing both audio and subtitles hurts Games and Music the most. Our 14-rater human study shows that even Expert raters score below chance on concepts from a neighboring country, indicating that CMB requires country-specific cultural knowledge. CMB acts as a diagnostic harness, attributing failures to a specific ability or modality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出文化时刻基准（CMB），将视频文化理解分解为命名符号意义、视觉识别和时间定位三个能力，通过306个东南亚专家精选概念和三个阶段评估六种视觉语言模型，发现即使最强模型三项全对得分低于30%，且三能力并非级联关系，音频作用因概念而异。
AI.motivation: 现有视频文化基准只测试"看到什么"，将命名、视觉识别和时间定位三种能力混为一个分数，掩盖了模型真正的瓶颈所在。为了精确诊断模型在文化理解上的失败根源，需要将三种能力解耦评估。
AI.method: 构建CMB基准：306个来自东南亚七国的专家精选文化概念（五类），每个概念通过三个阶段评估——S1从四个候选名称中选择（测试文化符号知识）、S2从四个候选视频片段中选择（测试视觉识别）、S3预测视频中子事件的起止时间（测试时间定位）。通过语义相似干扰项、未标注视频片段和不同示例视频上的自由定位三个设计选择确保各阶段独立测试单一能力。
AI.result: 六个视觉语言模型的失败模式因能力和模态而异：最强闭源模型三阶段全对时得分低于30%；命名正确只对一半模型在视觉识别上有帮助，识别对时间定位几乎没有级联效果；音频对某些概念是补充对某些是冗余或干扰，在非拉丁字母国家更常是干扰；移除音频和字幕对Games和Music类伤害最大。14位专家评估显示，专家对邻国概念的评分低于随机水平，说明CMB需要国家特定的文化知识。
AI.conclusion: CMB作为诊断工具，能将模型失败归因于特定能力或模态，揭示了现有VLM在文化视频理解上的深层次局限，并表明文化理解需要国家特定的文化知识，而非通用的视觉语言能力。

title: What is mathematics now, and what should it be?
summary: Advances in neural theorem provers have been impressive, but the successes obscure a broader vision of what AI can do for mathematics and how mathematicians can engage with AI. This essay advances a more expansive and optimistic point of view.

AI.tldr: 本文认为神经定理证明器的进展虽然令人印象深刻，但掩盖了AI在数学领域更广阔的愿景，并提出一个更具扩展性和乐观主义的观点。
AI.motivation: 神经定理证明器的成功掩盖了AI在数学中的更广阔可能性，作者希望提出一个更宏大、更乐观的视角，探讨数学家如何与AI互动。
AI.method: 以散文/论文（essay）形式提出论述，从更广阔的视角探讨AI在数学中的应用前景。
AI.result: 提出了一种比当前的神经定理证明更扩展、更乐观的AI与数学结合的观点。
AI.conclusion: 主张超越仅仅关注定理证明，拥抱AI在数学中更广泛的作用，并鼓励数学家更积极地参与AI技术。

title: Grounding Isn't Knowing: Do VLMs Need Object Localization for Spatial Reasoning?
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can answer spatial questions, yet the mechanisms connecting object grounding to spatial reasoning remain poorly understood. It is underexplored whether spatial reasoning internally requires precise objects localization, or can bypass explicit localization through global layout cues. In this work, we investigate two representative model families, LLaVA-1.5 and Qwen2.5-VL, using a suite of mechanistic interpretability tools, including token ablation, layer-wise probing, attention knockout, and causal mediation analysis. We find that spatial relation prediction follows a staged grounding-to-reasoning process in which object-aligned tokens establish coarse target-reference anchors, while precise bounding-box boundaries are not required. Positional information becomes decodable before relation decisions emerge, and a small set of attention heads mediates the causal effects of both localization and spatial reasoning. The two tasks share early grounding-related processing but ultimately rely on partially distinct specialized pathways. Through rigorous experiments, we provide a token-, layer-, and head-level account of how VLMs transform object grounding into spatial relations, showing that knowing where objects are is not equivalent to knowing how they relate.

AI.tldr: 本文通过机制可解释性工具（token消融、层级探测、注意力消除、因果中介分析）研究VLM空间推理机制，发现空间关系预测遵循"锚定到推理"的分阶段过程，精确边界框并非必需，且定位与关系推理共享早期处理但依赖部分不同的专门通路。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型虽能回答空间问题，但从目标锚定到空间推理的底层机制尚不清楚，尤其是空间推理是否必须在内部依赖精确目标定位，还是可以绕过显式定位仅依赖全局布局线索。
AI.method: 对LLaVA-1.5和Qwen2.5-VL两个模型家族，综合运用token消融、层级探测、注意力消除和因果中介分析等多种机制可解释性工具，从token、层、注意力头三个粒度系统剖析空间推理的内部处理过程。
AI.result: 发现空间关系预测遵循分阶段过程：对象对齐token建立粗略的目标-参照锚点，但精确的边界框并非必需；位置信息在关系决策出现前即可被解码；少量注意力头中介了定位与空间推理的因果效应；两个任务共享早期锚定处理，但最终依赖部分不同的专门通路。
AI.conclusion: 提供了token、层、注意力头层级的VLM空间推理机制全貌，关键洞见是"知道物体在哪里"并不等同于"知道它们如何关联"，空间推理可以绕开精确的局部定位而依赖全局布局线索来实现。

title: Is Next-Chunk Reasoning RL Really Better than SFT? Revisiting Training Strategies under no-CoT Data
summary: Recent work proposes next-chunk reasoning RL for leveraging no-CoT data---corpora such as worked solutions and textbook derivations that contain reasoning-rich content but lack explicit chain-of-thought annotations. The method trains a model to generate implicit reasoning traces and rewards them by their ability to predict the next chunk of text. While promising, existing evaluations primarily compare against conventional SFT baselines, leaving open whether the gains come from the RL formulation itself or from more effectively exposing the model to no-CoT data. We address this question with a controlled study of next-chunk reasoning RL and a simple but previously overlooked alternative: Mixed SFT, a single supervised fine-tuning stage that jointly trains on no-CoT and long-CoT data. Despite its simplicity, Mixed SFT achieves a clearly higher post-RLVR performance ceiling than next-chunk reasoning RL while requiring over 60 times less training compute. The advantage is consistent across in-domain mathematical reasoning and out-of-domain reasoning tasks. Moreover, we show that higher pre-RLVR accuracy does not necessarily translate into higher post-RLVR accuracy, highlighting the need to evaluate no-CoT training strategies in the context of the full post-training pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控实验比较了"下一块推理强化学习"（next-chunk reasoning RL）和简单的"混合SFT"（Mixed SFT）两种利用no-CoT数据的方法，发现后者在RLVR后的性能上限明显更高，且训练计算量减少了60倍以上，说明先前工作声称的收益主要来自数据暴露方式而非RL公式本身。
AI.motivation: 现有研究工作提出使用next-chunk reasoning RL来利用no-CoT数据（如解题过程和教科书推导），但这些评估主要与传统的SFT基线对比，无法确定性能提升是来自RL公式本身，还是仅仅因为更有效地暴露模型于no-CoT数据。本文旨在解开这一混淆因素。
AI.method: 采用受控研究设计，对比两种方法：(1) next-chunk reasoning RL——训练模型生成隐式推理轨迹，并根据其预测下一块文本的能力给予奖励；(2) Mixed SFT——一个简单的单阶段监督微调，同时使用no-CoT和long-CoT数据进行训练。两者在相同的数据和模型设定下进行公平比较。
AI.result: Mixed SFT在RLVR后的性能上限显著高于next-chunk reasoning RL，同时训练计算量减少超过60倍。该优势在领域内数学推理和领域外推理任务中均保持一致。此外，研究还发现更高的pre-RLVR准确率并不一定转化为更高的post-RLVR准确率。
AI.conclusion: 简单的方法（Mixed SFT）可以超越更复杂的RL方法，说明在评估no-CoT训练策略时必须在完整的后训练流水线（包括RLVR阶段）的背景下进行衡量。研究还强调了pre-RLVR评估结果可能具有误导性，需要结合post-RLVR性能来综合判断。

title: Loopy: Seamless Video Loop Generation via Anchored Looping Shift of Positional Embedding
comment: 15 pages, 21 figures, accepted by ACM TOG
summary: Looping videos are essential for practical applications such as web graphics, game development, and social media. However, existing approaches typically fail to generate high-quality looping videos due to the neglect of how video generation models perceive temporal order and how this relates to the looping behavior. In this work, we are the first to reveal that position embedding at different attention layers within DiT exhibits varying levels of positional control, with the most pronounced layer acting as an anchor. We formulate this anchored layer as the reference point of the looping video, offering strong contextual priors for the remaining layers to facilitate the generation of seamless and coherent video content. Based on this insight, we propose an anchored position embedding shifting strategy that applies layer-specific shift lengths according to each layer's temporal control effect, effectively transforming DiT's temporal perception from a straight line to a circle. Leveraging this strategy, we develop a general framework, Loopy, for high-quality looping video generation, supporting both RGB and RGBA videos, while also enabling advanced AIGC features such as identity control and style transfer. Experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly improves temporal consistency and visual fidelity in generated looping videos. The released model is available on our website: https://donghaotian123.github.io/Loopy.

AI.tldr: 本文首次揭示了DiT模型中不同注意力层的位置嵌入具有不同的时序控制能力，并提出锚定位置嵌入平移策略（Loopy框架），将DiT的时序感知从直线变为圆形，从而生成高质量的无缝循环视频，支持RGB和RGBA视频以及身份控制和风格迁移等AIGC功能。
AI.motivation: 现有循环视频生成方法质量不佳，根本原因在于忽略了视频生成模型如何感知时序顺序以及这如何与循环行为相关联，缺乏对模型内部时序感知机制的深入理解。
AI.method: 1) 首次揭示DiT中不同注意力层的位置嵌入具有不同的时序控制强度，其中最显著的层作为"锚点"；2) 提出锚定位置嵌入平移策略，根据各层的时序控制效果施加逐层不同的平移长度；3) 将DiT的时序感知从直线变换为圆形，实现无缝循环。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法显著提升了生成循环视频的时序一致性和视觉保真度，同时支持RGB和RGBA视频，并支持身份控制和风格迁移等高级AIGC功能。
AI.conclusion: 通过深入理解DiT中位置嵌入的层级时序控制机制，提出锚定平移策略可以有效地将线性时序感知转化为循环感知，为高质量循环视频生成提供了通用且有效的解决方案。

title: Automated Construction of FAIR Digital Object Knowledge Graphs from Flat Cultural Heritage Records
comment: Accepted for publication as a short paper at CIKM 2026 (The 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management)
summary: The FAIR Digital Object (FDO) framework mandates that metadata attribute values be expressed as persistent identifiers (PIDs) wherever possible, to produce a fully machine-actionable graph in which every reference is resolvable. The Europeana Data Model was designed long before the FDO specification, and it stores most metadata values as plain text. This serves human browsing well enough, but gives an automated agent nothing to follow across records or collections. We present a pipeline that transforms flat Europeana records into an FDO-compliant knowledge graph structured with CIDOC-CRM. Following the FDO specification, we model every heritage entity as a discrete FDO with its own PID, type, profile, and metadata layer. The core technical challenge is automating the FDO-prescribed distinction between values that must become PID references (resolvable entities) and those that may remain literals (terminal leaves such as notes, measurements, and dates). We address this with a large language model that classifies each metadata value, routes it to a controlled vocabulary (Getty AAT, Wikidata, VIAF, PeriodO), and links it to a shared entity FDO. We evaluate using 637 archaeological records from five Europeana providers, processing each with the LLM. The pipeline links 86% of metadata slots, resolving 58.5% of values Europeana had not already enriched. It also merges cross-lingual surface forms that byte-identical matching keeps apart, where 17 of 33 such merges are correct on manual review. Graph connectivity does not separate this from string matching; what distinguishes the FDO graph is that every node is typed and resolvable.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个将欧洲数字图书馆（Europeana）的扁平记录转换为符合FAIR数字对象（FDO）规范的CIDOC-CRM知识图谱的流水线。该流水线利用大语言模型自动区分哪些元数据值应转为PID引用、哪些保持为字面量，并通过受控词表（Getty AAT、Wikidata、VIAF、PeriodO）进行实体链接。在637条考古记录上的评估显示，流水线链接了86%的元数据槽，解决了58.5%原本未被欧洲数字图书馆丰富化的值，并成功合并了跨语言的表面形式。
AI.motivation: 欧洲数字图书馆数据模型在设计时早于FDO规范，大多数元数据值以纯文本存储，虽然适合人工浏览，但自动化代理无法跨记录或集合进行检索。需要将扁平记录转换为完全机器可操作的FDO合规知识图谱。
AI.method: 提出一个流水线：(1) 将每条遗产实体建模为独立的FDO，包含PID、类型、配置文件和元数据层；(2) 使用LLM自动分类每个元数据值，决定其应成为PID引用（可解析实体）还是保持为字面量（终端叶子）；(3) 将需引用的值路由到受控词表（Getty AAT、Wikidata、VIAF、PeriodO）并链接到共享实体FDO；(4) 使用CIDOC-CRM作为本体结构。
AI.result: 在来自五个欧洲数字图书馆提供方的637条考古记录上评估：流水线链接了86%的元数据槽，解决了58.5%原本未丰富化的值；跨语言表面形式合并中33例有17例经人工审核正确；FDO图谱与字符串匹配的主要区别在于每个节点都有类型且可解析。
AI.conclusion: 该流水线成功将扁平遗产记录转换为FDO合规的知识图谱，证明了LLM能有效自动化FDO规范中关于PID引用与字面量的区分。FDO图谱的独特价值不在于图连通性本身，而在于每个节点都被类型化且可解析，这为机器代理提供了真正可操作的语义基础。

title: Training-Free Pseudo-Fusion for Composed Image Retrieval with Diffusion Models and Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) is an emerging paradigm in content-based image retrieval that enables users to formulate compositional queries by combining a reference image with an auxiliary modality, usually text-based. This approach supports fine-grained search where the target image shares structural elements with the user-provided image while incorporating the modifications specified by the auxiliary text. Conventional CIR methods rely on multimodal fusion to combine visual and textual features into a joint query embedding, which requires training modules that align composed queries with the targets. In this work, we propose PeFuse (for pseudo-fusion), a training-free framework that leverages pretrained Diffusion Models and Multimodal Large Language Models to bridge modalities via generative conversion. We introduce two novel strategies: uni-directional and bi-directional conversion, which convert CIR into four single-modality retrieval problems. These methods reformulate CIR as either intra-modal or cross-modal single-query retrieval tasks, bypassing the need for dedicated task-specific training. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that converting CIR into text-to-image retrieval tasks is more effective than alternative conversion strategies, achieving competitive or superior performance compared with state-of-the-art methods, while maintaining high flexibility thanks to replaceable components of the conversion pipeline. These results highlight the effectiveness of the pseudo-fusion paradigm for zero-shot CIR. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/StevenXuf/PeFuse4CIR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PeFuse，一个无需训练的伪融合框架，利用预训练的Diffusion Models和Multimodal Large Language Models，通过生成式转换将组合图像检索（CIR）转化为单模态检索任务，实现零样本CIR。
AI.motivation: 传统CIR方法依赖多模态融合模块训练，需要专门的联合查询嵌入对齐，成本高且灵活性差。作者希望利用现成的大模型能力，通过生成式转换绕过任务特定的训练。
AI.method: 提出PeFuse框架，引入单向和双向转换两种策略，将CIR转换为四种单模态检索问题（模态内或跨模态单查询检索），利用预训练扩散模型和多模态大语言模型进行模态桥接。
AI.result: 在标准基准上的实验表明，将CIR转换为文本到图像检索任务比其他转换策略更有效，达到与最先进方法相当或更优的性能，同时保持高灵活性。
AI.conclusion: 伪融合范式（pseudo-fusion）在零样本CIR中非常有效，且由于转换管道的组件可替换，框架具有极高的灵活性和可扩展性。

title: Hidden in the Request: Explaining Unethical LLM Compliance through Token Relevance
summary: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) are aligned to optimize for both helpfulness and harmlessness, these dual objectives may conflict, inevitably leading to alignment failures. This work systematically investigates instances where LLMs fail to exhibit ethical behavior. To understand the underlying mechanics of these vulnerabilities, we introduce a probing methodology that presents unethical scenarios to LLMs in three distinct structural modalities: objective classification tasks, subjective first-person statements, and direct requests for assistance. We find that model performance degrades in the request-for-assistance-based form. Using Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP), we trace this discrepancy to an attribution bias: the model places greater emphasis on benign task-framing tokens (e.g., "Can you help me...") than on tokens signaling the underlying unethical behavior (e.g., "without getting caught"), which we term cue-tokens. We hypothesize that this under-attribution contributes to harmful compliance. To test this, we introduce two LRP-guided decoding methods that steer generation toward trajectories more relevant to cue tokens. Empirical evaluations show that these interventions promote safer responses, supporting cue-token attribution's role in compliance failures.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了LLM在有害性对齐中的失败机制，提出了一种基于三种不同结构形态（客观分类、主观第一人称陈述、直接请求帮助）的探测方法，并利用层相关性传播（LRP）发现模型存在属性偏差——过度关注良性的任务框架词元而忽视指示不道德行为的线索词元，进而提出两种LRP引导的解码方法以缓解这一偏差并促进更安全的生成。
AI.motivation: LLM对齐中"有用性"与"无害性"这两个目标存在潜在冲突，导致对齐失败时有发生。现有研究缺乏对这类漏洞内在机制的深入理解，作者希望系统性地揭示模型为何在面对不道德场景时会失效。
AI.method: 1) 提出三模态探测方法（客观分类任务、主观第一人称陈述、直接请求帮助）呈现不道德场景；2) 使用Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP)追踪模型内部归因，识别出"属性偏差"——模型过度关注任务框架词元而低估线索词元；3) 提出两种LRP引导的解码方法，引导生成轨迹朝向与线索词元更相关的方向。
AI.result: 模型在"请求帮助"形式下性能显著下降；LRP揭示模型对"Can you help me..."等良性框架词元的归因权重高于"without getting caught"等线索词元；两种LRP引导解码方法均能有效促进更安全的模型回应，验证了线索词元归因不足与有害顺从之间的因果联系。
AI.conclusion: 线索词元的低归因是LLM有害顺从行为的重要机制性原因，通过LRP引导解码可以干预这一偏差并提升模型安全性，为对齐失败提供了可解释的归因视角和可操作的缓解方案。

title: Bridge Damage Detection from Low-Light UAV Imagery via Degradation-Aware Mixture-of-Experts Enhancement
summary: Poor illumination obscures small, low-contrast defects in UAV bridge imagery, reducing the reliability and operational flexibility of automated inspection. This paper investigates whether degradation-aware image restoration can improve bridge damage detection under low-light conditions and transfer from synthetic degradations to real inspection scenes. We propose DaL- MoE, a detector-agnostic restoration front end trained with an ISP-aware low-light synthesis pipeline and equipped with degradation-aware guidance estimation and complementary experts for noise suppression, color adjustment, and structural-detail recovery. On paired synthetic data, DaL-MoE achieves 23.12 dB PSNR and 0.8482 SSIM, increasing YOLOv11m box mAP50 from 0.3097 to 0.4923 and mask mAP50 from 0.2281 to 0.3529. On real low-light UAV imagery without paired normal-light references, sim-to-real evaluation shows improved defect visibility and more complete detections than direct inference on raw low-light inputs. Future work will develop low-light-aware bridge damage detectors with stronger cross-scene generalization across bridge sites, imaging conditions, and illumination levels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DaL-MoE，一种与检测器无关的图像修复前端，通过ISP感知的低光合成流程和退化感知的混合专家（MoE）架构，提升无人机桥梁图像在低光条件下的缺陷检测性能，并在合成数据到真实场景的迁移中验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 低照度环境下无人机桥梁图像中细小、低对比度的缺陷不清晰，严重削弱了自动化检测的可靠性和操作灵活性。现有研究较少探讨退化感知的图像修复是否能提升低光条件下的桥梁损伤检测，以及能否从合成退化迁移到真实检测场景。
AI.method: 提出DaL-MoE，它是一个与检测器无关的修复前端，包含三个核心组件：(1) ISP感知的低光合成训练流程，用于生成配对数据；(2) 退化感知的引导估计模块；(3) 互补专家模块，分别负责噪声抑制、颜色调整和结构细节恢复。检测器（如YOLOv11m）固定不变，仅在修复后端接检测。
AI.result: 在配对合成数据上，DaL-MoE达到23.12 dB PSNR和0.8482 SSIM，将YOLOv11m的box mAP50从0.3097提升至0.4923，mask mAP50从0.2281提升至0.3529。在无配对正常光参考的真实低光无人机图像上，sim-to-real评估显示缺陷可见性和检测完整性均优于直接在原始低光输入上推理。
AI.conclusion: 退化感知的图像修复能够有效提升低光条件下无人机桥梁缺陷检测性能，且具备从合成退化到真实场景的迁移能力。未来工作将开发低光感知的桥梁损伤检测器，以增强跨场景（不同桥梁地点、成像条件和光照水平）的泛化能力。

title: Apodex 1.1: Scaling Agentic Intelligence for Complex Work
summary: General-purpose language models can reason and synthesize knowledge, but complex work also requires sustained interaction with files, information sources, and executable code, together with state maintenance, failure recovery, and verifiable delivery. We call this \emph{working capability}: sustained, verifiable progress toward a real-world objective. Apodex 1.1 develops this capability along two complementary dimensions. \emph{Environment Scaling} expands the diversity and verifiability of executable file, search, and code environments, while \emph{Agentic Coordination Scaling} trains agents to decompose long-horizon tasks, delegate parallel work, integrate asynchronous results, and replan. A shared execution harness and AgentOS maintain task state and provenance across tools and agents, and training turns environment trajectories and coordination traces into reliable behavior. Across complex professional work, finance, scientific research, mathematics, coding, and search, Apodex 1.1 reaches the leading performance band despite using a substantially smaller model than many frontier systems. The 35B-parameter Apodex 1.1 Mini further retains strong working capability in a locally deployable form. These results ground agentic intelligence in useful, verifiable work completed over time and advance our goal of building a \emph{Heavy-Duty Solver} for ambitious, long-running tasks.

AI.tldr: Apodex 1.1 是一个专注于"工作能力"的通用语言模型，通过环境缩放和智能体协调缩放两个维度，训练模型完成长时程、可持续且可验证的真实世界任务。该模型在多个专业领域达到领先性能，其35B参数的迷你版也保持了强大的本地可部署工作能力。
AI.motivation: 通用语言模型虽然能够推理和综合知识，但复杂工作还需要与文件、信息源和可执行代码进行持续互动，并具备状态维护、失败恢复和可验证交付能力。论文旨在建立这种"工作能力"——对真实世界目标持续、可验证的进展。
AI.method: 方法包含两个维度：(1) 环境缩放——扩展可执行的、可验证的文件、搜索和代码环境的多样性与可验证性；(2) 智能体协调缩放——训练智能体分解长时程任务、委派并行工作、整合异步结果并进行重新规划。共享执行框架AgentOS维护跨工具和智能体的任务状态与来源，训练过程将环境轨迹和协调痕迹转化为可靠行为。
AI.result: 在复杂专业工作、金融、科学研究、数学、编码和搜索等多个领域达到领先性能水平，尽管使用的模型规模远小于许多前沿系统。35B参数的Apodex 1.1 Mini在本地可部署形式下仍保持较强的工作能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，将智能体智能建立在持续、可验证的实用工作上是有成效的，推进了构建"H重载求解器"（Heavy-Duty Solver）的目标，以应对雄心勃勃的长时程复杂任务。

title: A Simulator-Grounded Framework For Constructing Verifiable Muscle-Grounded QA From 3D Tongue Meshes
summary: Existing articulatory corpora based on real-time MRI and electromagnetic articulography capture tongue shape and motion but do not provide traceable labels for the muscle-driven process that generated an observed configuration. We introduce a simulator-grounded data-construction framework and instantiate it as 3DTongueQA. Controlled 11-dimensional muscle activations are mapped to fixed-topology tongue meshes with the ArtiSynth Badin finite-element model, converted into structured biomechanical records, and rendered as deterministic QA on muscle state, geometry, and target-directed change. We screen 295,157 configurations, retain 295,115 valid meshes, and construct 891,156 QA records per language. Language naturalization changes only surface form and is verified against the source records; English and Korean instantiations demonstrate construction-level portability. A swappable SpiralNet++--Qwen3-8B baseline reaches 62.9 $\pm$ 9.2 Muscle EM, 74.0 $\pm$ 0.2 Value Accuracy, and 65.9 $\pm$ 4.7 Direction EM, while mismatching the paired mesh reduces Muscle EM to 2.2; a dataset-leakage-controlled anchor-held-out model retains 80.4--98.6\% of the full-inventory scores on unseen anchors. Task-specific structured readouts further reach 88.7 $\pm$ 0.7 Muscle EM and 93.3 $\pm$ 1.0 Direction EM. These complementary results show that the constructed supervision supports both efficient structured prediction and heterogeneous natural-language QA rather than being tied to a particular decoder architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于模拟器的数据构建框架3DTongueQA，利用11维肌肉激活控制生成舌头网格，构建约89万条QA记录，支持肌肉状态、几何和目标导向变化的确定性问答。实验表明该框架与具体解码器架构解耦，支持结构化预测和自然语言QA。
AI.motivation: 现有基于实时MRI和电磁关节描记术的发音语料库虽然能捕捉舌头的形状和运动，但无法提供生成观察配置的肌肉驱动过程的可追溯标签。缺乏可追踪的肌肉状态标签阻碍了对发音机制的理解和建模。
AI.method: 提出模拟器驱动的数据构建框架：使用11维肌肉激活可控参数映射到固定拓扑结构的舌头网格（基于ArtiSynth Badin有限元模型），转换为结构化生物力学记录，并渲染为确定性QA。筛选295,157个配置，保留295,115个有效网格，每语言构建891,156条QA记录。语言自然化仅改变表层形式并通过源记录验证，英韩实例展示构建级可移植性。使用可替换的SpiralNet++--Qwen3-8B基线评估。
AI.result: 基线达到62.9±9.2 Muscle EM、74.0±0.2 Value Accuracy、65.9±4.7 Direction EM；配错网格时Muscle EM降至2.2；防数据泄漏的锚点保留模型在未见锚点保持80.4-98.6%的全量分数。任务特定结构化读出达到88.7±0.7 Muscle EM和93.3±1.0 Direction EM。
AI.conclusion: 构建的监督数据支持高效的结构化预测和异质自然语言QA，而非绑定特定解码器架构，证明了框架的通用性和可移植性。

title: EviSafe: Evidence-Grounded Safety Evaluation for Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language model safety benchmarks typically evaluate only final responses: whether a model refuses, warns, or complies. This outcome-level view cannot tell whether a model is safe for the right multimodal reason. Safelooking behavior may reflect keyword-triggered refusal, missed visual hazards, or over-refusal of benign-sensitive inputs. We introduce EviSafe, an evidence-grounded framework for VLM safety that jointly evaluates natural user-facing behavior, explicit grounding in textual and visual evidence, and behavioral sensitivity to counterfactual changes in safety-critical evidence. EviSafeBench instantiates the framework as a controlled benchmark with 1,181 gold image-text scenarios and 2,452 targeted counterfactual variants across eight safety domains and eight risk-source types. Each scenario includes a gold safety decision, evidence annotations, a safe-response policy, and counterfactual interventions. The three-probe protocol queries models with natural-response, evidencereporting, and counterfactual-response prompts, then scores them using an evidence-aware judge. Across eleven evaluated VLMs, natural severity accuracy ranges from 27.6% to 52.8%, relaxed diagnostic consistency from 6.1% to 29.3%, and unsafe-to-safe counterfactual transition success from 30.4% to 58.4%. These gaps show that the evaluated VLMs are not reliably safe for the right multimodal reason and motivate evaluation beyond refusal counts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EviSafe，一个基于证据的视觉语言模型（VLM）安全评估框架，通过联合评估自然用户行为、文本与视觉证据的显式锚定，以及对安全关键证据反事实变化的行为敏感性，来检验模型是否出于正确的多模态原因而安全。EviSafeBench包含1,181个黄金图像-文本场景和2,452个反事实变体，覆盖8个安全域和8种风险来源类型，并采用三探针协议（自然回答、证据报告、反事实回答）配合证据感知裁判进行评分。在11个VLM上的实验表明，自然严重度准确率仅27.6%-52.8%，诊断一致性6.1%-29.3%，不安全到安全的反事实转换成功率30.4%-58.4%，说明现有VLM并未可靠地出于正确的多模态原因而安全。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM安全基准仅评估最终响应（是否拒绝、警告或遵从），属于结果层面的评估，无法判断模型是否因正确的多模态原因而安全。可能存在关键词触发的拒绝、遗漏视觉危险或对良性敏感输入的过度拒绝等"看似安全"但实际不安全的行为，因此需要证据层面的细粒度安全评估框架。
AI.method: 提出EviSafe框架，包含三个维度：自然用户行为、文本与视觉证据的显式锚定、对安全关键证据反事实变化的行为敏感性。构建EviSafeBench基准（1,181个黄金场景+2,452个反事实变体，8个安全域、8种风险来源类型），采用三探针协议（自然回答、证据报告、反事实回答提示）和证据感知裁判进行评分。
AI.result: 在11个评估的VLM上，自然严重度准确率27.6%-52.8%，宽松诊断一致性6.1%-29.3%，不安全到安全的反事实转换成功率30.4%-58.4%。这些结果表明被测VLM在"出于正确多模态原因而安全"方面存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: 现有VLM并未可靠地出于正确的多模态原因而安全，评估应超越单纯的拒绝计数，转向证据感知的安全评估，以更全面地理解和改进VLM的安全行为。

title: Agent-G$^2$: Gaussian Guidance for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Hint-based reinforcement learning addresses reward sparsity in long-horizon agentic tasks by retaining a prefix of an expert trajectory before each rollout, letting the policy explore from a state closer to success. Its effectiveness hinges on the guidance depth: how much of the trajectory to keep. Existing methods treat this depth as a deterministic scalar. Scheduled approaches share one value across samples and ignore per-task heterogeneity; per-sample probing estimates it separately at the cost of extra rollouts. We find that useful guidance occupies a band of depths whose informativeness profile is approximately Gaussian around the band center, rather than concentrating at a single optimal point. We propose Agent-G$^2$, a Gaussian guidance framework that draws the depth per task from a Gaussian whose center and spread are estimated online from rollouts already collected for policy optimization, requiring no probe rollouts or learned depth predictor. The center combines a global baseline with per-cluster difficulty, and the spread tracks within-cluster variance. We evaluate Agent-G$^2$ on ALFWorld and WebShop on Qwen2.5-1.5B / 7B-Instruct. Agent-G$^2$ outperforms the strongest hint-based, hint-free, and Aux-RL baselines on ALFWorld by 2.3 / 3.9 / 7.4 points at under one-third the rollout cost of per-sample probing.

AI.tldr: 提出Agent-G$^2$框架，将提示深度建模为高斯分布而非确定性标量，无需探测回放即可在线估计分布参数，在ALFWorld和WebShop上以更低的回放成本超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于提示的强化学习方法将提示深度视为确定性标量，要么对所有样本共享单一值（忽略任务异质性），要么逐样本探测（额外回放成本高）。作者发现有用提示深度实际上分布在一个区间内，其信息量轮廓近似高斯分布，而非集中在单一最优点。
AI.method: 提出Agent-G$^2$框架：从已用于策略优化的回放中在线估计每个任务的高斯分布（中心+方差）。中心结合全局基线与簇间难度，方差跟踪簇内方差。无需探测回放或学习深度预测器。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop上基于Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct评估。在ALFWorld上相比最强提示基线、无提示基线和Aux-RL基线分别提升2.3/3.9/7.4分，同时回放成本不到逐样本探测方法的三分之一。
AI.conclusion: 提示深度应建模为高斯分布而非单点，Agent-G$^2$以更低成本更准确地反映任务的异质性，验证了高斯建模假设的有效性。

title: How Merge-Tolerant Are Vision Transformers for Wheat Phenotyping?
comment: Accepted to the CVPPA workshop at ECCV 2026
summary: Vision-based wheat phenotyping requires repeated measurements under deployment constraints, from growth-stage recognition to wheat-head counting and organ segmentation. Plain Vision Transformers (ViTs) provide a common architecture for these tasks, but quadratic attention limits high-throughput and edge inference. Training-free token merging is attractive because it can be inserted into trained models without retraining. We provide a systematic benchmark of ToMe and Mutual Pair Merging across growth-stage classification, wheat-head detection, and wheat-organ segmentation, measuring task quality, throughput, token count, and peak GPU memory, with additional Raspberry Pi 5 measurements. The benchmark reveals a clear hierarchy: classification is highly merge-tolerant, while detection and segmentation are constrained by repeated instances, thin organs, dense boundaries, reconstruction, and runtime overhead. Optimized attention backends can erase apparent speedups, so deployment value must be profiled on the target runtime rather than inferred from token count.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了训练无关的token合并方法（ToMe和Mutual Pair Merging）在基于视觉的小麦表型分析任务中的表现，涵盖生长阶段分类、麦穗检测和麦穗器官分割，并测量了任务质量、吞吐量、token数量和峰值GPU内存，还包含Raspberry Pi 5上的实际部署测量。
AI.motivation: 基于视觉的小麦表型分析任务需要重复测量且受部署约束，尽管Plain ViT提供了统一架构，但二次方注意力复杂度限制了高通量和边缘推理。训练无关的token合并方法具有吸引力，因为它可以无缝插入已训练模型而无需重训练，但缺乏系统性的评估基准来指导实际应用。
AI.method: 对ToMe和Mutual Pair Merging两种训练无关token合并方法进行系统基准测试，覆盖三个小麦表型任务（生长阶段分类、麦穗检测、麦穗器官分割），从任务质量、吞吐量、token数量和峰值GPU内存多个维度评估，并额外在Raspberry Pi 5上进行实际部署测量。
AI.result: 基准测试揭示了清晰的层级：分类任务对token合并高度容忍，而检测和分割任务受到重复实例、细薄器官、密集边界、重建需求和运行时开销的制约。同时发现优化后的注意力后端可能抵消表面上的速度提升，token数量的减少不必然带来实际部署加速。
AI.conclusion: token合并方法的部署价值必须在目标运行时上进行分析评估，而非仅通过token数量推断。不同任务对token合并的容忍度差异显著，检测和分割任务需谨慎使用token合并策略。

title: Walking on the DARKSIDE
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) recognise patterns but do not natively track the path of exclusions that a coherent discourse demands. When an input rests on a fabricated authority, a misapplied mechanism, or a surreptitious analogy, an unsteered LLM tends to engage with it as if it were grounded, and to reify the misstep into any structured output it generates. Logic-Augmented Generation (LAG) with POLANYI++, an LLM-steering method that uses heuristics, ontologies and problem solving methods for tacit knowledge extraction, produces an Extended Knowledge Graph (XKG) in OWL2, but inherits the same vulnerability: a sophisticated nonsensical input is reified into the graph alongside the legitimate triples, and is hardly detectable by automated reasoners since the XKG is generated jointly with the wrong assumptions. We introduce DARKSIDE, a coherence auditing method on top of POLANYI++. It formalises the trail as an explicit data structure of accumulated exclusions over discourse time, complemented by a warrant axis that classifies each named referent as Warranted, Unattested, Misattributed or Fabricated, with an escalation rule that pushes the DelegationRiskAssessment to UNSAFE when the fabricated rate is positive or the unsupported rate exceeds a threshold. We evaluate DARKSIDE as a steering layer over a Gemini 3 on BSBench, a 100-item adversarial corpus of sophisticated-sounding nonsense across software engineering, finance, healthcare, physics and law, with Claude Sonnet 4.6 as an independent judge. The empirical evidence supports an architectural claim: when an LLM forward pass is wrapped in an ontology-mediated negative-trail apparatus, the structural pattern-vs-path gap can be partially scaffolded. The XKG functions as the missing memory, and the warrant axis as an epistemic firewall.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DARKSIDE，一种在POLANYI++（逻辑增强生成框架）之上的连贯性审计方法。它通过显式的数据结构和"warrant axis"（将命名指称分类为Warranted/Unattested/Misattributed/Fabricated），并在高风险时输出UNSAFE风险等级，从而识别和阻止LLM在结构化输出中固化虚假假设。在BSBench对抗性语料上基于Gemini 3和Claude Sonnet 4.6评审验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: LLM善于识别模式但不擅长追踪话语中排除路径所需的连贯性。未受引导的LLM会将看似合理的虚假输入（如伪造权威、误用机制、隐性类比）当作有根据的内容看待，并将其固化为结构化输出。即便POLANYI++这样的逻辑增强方法也难以检测这种"精致的胡言乱语"，因为它与合理的三元组一同被生成进扩展知识图谱（XKG），难以被自动化推理器发现。
AI.method: DARKSIDE在POLANYI++之上增加了：(1) 排除轨迹的显式数据结构，累积话语时间上的排除记录；(2) warrant轴，将每个命名指称分类为Warranted（有根据）、Unattested（未证实）、Misattributed（误归因）或Fabricated（捏造）；(3) 升级规则：当捏造率为正或未支持率超阈值时，将DelegationRiskAssessment推至UNSAFE。评估采用Gemini 3作为被审计层，BSBench（涵盖软件工程、金融、医疗、物理和法律的100条对抗性语料）作为测试集，Claude Sonnet 4.6作为独立评审。
AI.result: 实证证据支持一个架构性主张：当LLM的前向传播被包裹在基于本体的负面轨迹装置中时，结构上的"模式vs路径"鸿沟可以被部分地搭建起来。XKG充当了缺失的记忆，warrant轴充当了认知防火墙。
AI.conclusion: LLM的"模式-路径"差距可以通过本体介导的负面轨迹装置得到部分弥补。XKG提供了记忆支撑，warrant轴提供了认知防御机制，但该方案仅是"部分搭建"，说明该方法虽有效，仍存在局限性。

title: An end-to-end-trained vision-language model for native-language prostate pathology report generation
summary: Prostate cancer is among the most frequently diagnosed malignancies worldwide, and structured reporting of each biopsy core burdens pathologists. Existing tools frame this as classification, leaving pathologists to assemble coherent reports, while many slide-level vision-language models rely on English-centric encoders that transfer poorly to other clinical languages. We present a slide-level framework generating prostate biopsy reports that is language-independent by construction: tokenizer and model are trained from scratch, demonstrated here in German. To address paired-data scarcity, an automated pipeline uses a locally deployed large language model to split composite reports into core-specific image-text pairs, yielding 17,344 pairs from 2,402 historical cases without manual annotation. Evaluated for clinical attributes rather than linguistic similarity, the model achieves 96.2% F1 for malignancy detection and 65.2% for Gleason grading, competitive with an FDA-cleared classifier. Grading is further validated on three external cohorts with latent-space augmentation. Institutions can thus train native-language reporting models on their own archives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种语言无关的前列腺癌活检报告生成框架，从零训练tokenizer和模型（以德语演示），通过本地部署的大语言模型自动拆分复合报告为17,344对核心级图文对，在恶性检测上达到96.2% F1，Gleason分级65.2%，与FDA批准的分类器相当。
AI.motivation: 前列腺癌是常见恶性肿瘤，结构化报告加重病理医生负担。现有工具将活检报告视为分类任务，需医生自行整合报告；且现有slide-level视觉语言模型依赖英文编码器，在非英语临床环境中迁移效果差。需一种语言无关且不依赖人工标注的自动报告生成框架。
AI.method: 1) 构建slide-level框架，tokenizer和模型均从零训练，天然语言无关；2) 利用本地部署的LLM将复合报告自动拆分为核心级(KCV)图像-文本对，从2,402例历史病例生成17,344对，无需人工标注；3) 评估时关注临床属性（恶性检测、Gleason分级）而非语言相似度；4) 对Gleason分级在三个外部队列上使用潜空间增强进行验证。
AI.result: 恶性检测F1达96.2%，Gleason分级达65.2%，与FDA批准的临床分类器性能相当；Gleason分级在三个外部队列上得到进一步验证。
AI.conclusion: 机构可以利用自身历史档案训练母语报告生成模型，无需依赖英文编码器或人工标注，实现语言无关的本地化病理报告生成。

title: Modalities Should Talk to Each Other: Dual-Stream Multimodal Learning for Long-Horizon Influenza Forecasting
summary: Forecasting long-range influenza-like illness (ILI) matters for public health readiness. Publicly available surveillance datasets typically pair numeric epidemiological signals with textual information that is noisy, loosely structured, only indirectly related to near-term trends, and often lagged relative to the numeric signal. Fusing the two therefore requires careful design. We propose Dual-Stream Attention (DSA), a multimodal deep learning framework that forecasts 12-week-ahead ILI activity from a 36-week multimodal history by letting the numerical and textual streams condition each other. Using the Time-MMD health-domain dataset, DSA separately encodes the two modalities with a Transformer-based numerical encoder and a domain-adapted headline encoder, then couples them through a bidirectional Cross-Modal Attention (CMA) mechanism: the text (news headlines) conditions the interpretation of the numeric signal and vice versa. The CMA output then passes to a causal temporal model for forecasting. Evaluated across ten random seeds, DSA achieves a median test MSE of 0.416, versus 0.668, 0.607, and 0.851 for iTransformer, TaTS, and GPT4MTS, corresponding to mean-error reductions of 54.95%, 37.29%, and 67.23%, with paired Cohen's d of 0.555, 0.337, and 0.345, respectively, and ranks first in 100% of bootstrap draws. It also has substantially lower worst-window error than all baselines. On an external-geography dataset, DSA again ranks first among nine evaluated baselines. Ablations show the advantage does not depend on text-encoder choice or language-model fine-tuning, and that bidirectional attention outperforms either direction alone. Finally, perturbation-based faithfulness analysis shows the learned CMA is functionally informative under targeted masking, with a stronger effect in the text-to-numerical direction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Dual-Stream Attention (DSA)框架，一种用于流感样疾病(ILI)长期预测的多模态深度学习模型。该模型通过双向跨模态注意力机制融合数值流行病学信号与文本新闻标题，在12周前瞻预测中显著优于多个强基线模型。
AI.motivation: 公开的流感监测数据通常同时包含数值流行病学信号和文本信息，但文本信息噪声大、结构松散、与短期趋势关联间接且常存在滞后。如何有效融合这两种模态进行长期ILI预测是一个需要精心设计的重要问题。
AI.method: DSA框架采用双流架构：一个基于Transformer的数值编码器和一个领域适配的标题编码器分别编码两种模态，然后通过双向跨模态注意力(CMA)机制让文本和数值信号互相条件化（文本影响数值解释，数值也影响文本解释），CMA输出再送入因果时序模型进行12周前瞻预测。
AI.result: 在Time-MMD健康领域数据集上，DSA的中位测试MSE为0.416，相较于iTransformer(0.668)、TaTS(0.607)和GPT4MTS(0.851)，平均错误分别降低54.95%、37.29%和67.23%。在100%的bootstrap抽样中排名第一，且在外部地理数据集上也排名第一。消融实验证明了双向注意力的优势，扰动分析验证了注意力机制的功能有效性。
AI.conclusion: DSA证明了精心设计的双向跨模态注意力机制能够有效融合数值与文本信息进行长期ILI预测，且其优势不依赖于特定的文本编码器选择或语言模型微调，模型具有通用性和鲁棒性。

title: BenthicFlow: Generating Extensible Underwater Environments via Flow Matching
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026 in the 2nd Workshop on Marine Vision
summary: Computer vision applications for 3D scene understanding in underwater environments remain challenging due to the lack of high-quality 3D data and the inability of surface-trained models to generalize to underwater scenes. To address this challenge, an emerging trend is to employ generative models to close the data domain gap. However, existing methods assemble large scenes by stitching independently generated tiles post hoc with separately trained models, while demonstrating heterogeneous landscapes only within individual survey sites. We introduce BenthicFlow, a unified framework based on a single conditional flow-matching model that jointly generates aligned textures and depth maps. A MultiDiffusion-inspired sampling procedure reconciles overlapping windows throughout the generative trajectory, enabling spatially extensible RGBD mosaics without a separate stitching model. The generated mosaics are subsequently lifted into explicit 3D benthic environments using surface-aligned Gaussian surfels. Experiments across geographically distinct survey sites demonstrate that BenthicFlow preserves site-specific appearance while generating coherent, large-scale 3D scenes that closely match the target distributions. Code and trained models are available at https://github.com/jacomof/BenthicFlow.

AI.tldr: BenthicFlow是一个基于条件流匹配模型的统一框架，能联合生成对齐的纹理与深度图，并通过MultiDiffusion启发的采样过程实现空间可扩展的RGBD马赛克，最终将生成结果提升为显式的3D海底环境。
AI.motivation: 水下3D场景理解面临高质量3D数据缺乏和表面训练模型泛化能力差的双重挑战，现有生成方法需要将独立生成的图块用单独训练的模型拼接，且只能在单个调查点内展示异质景观，无法生成大规模一致场景。
AI.method: 提出统一框架BenthicFlow，基于单一条件流匹配模型联合生成对齐的纹理与深度图；采用MultiDiffusion启发的采样过程在生成轨迹中调和重叠窗口，无需独立拼接模型即可生成空间可扩展的RGBD马赛克；最后使用表面对齐的高斯surfel将生成的马赛克提升为显式3D海底环境。
AI.result: 在地理位置不同的调查站点上进行实验，结果表明BenthicFlow能够保留站点特定外观，同时生成连贯的大规模3D场景，且与目标分布紧密匹配。
AI.conclusion: BenthicFlow有效解决了水下3D场景生成中数据域差距和拼接一致性问题，为水下场景理解提供了可扩展的生成式解决方案。

title: MediSkill-Evo: Process-Constrained Self-Evolution for Evidence-Grounded Clinical Interaction
summary: Interactive clinical agents must gather decisive evidence and convert it into grounded actions under partial observability. A correct final diagnosis alone does not show that an agent respected evidence and care-process constraints. We introduce MediSkill-Evo, a clinical agent that evolves governed process knowledge without backbone fine-tuning. It separates experience into four typed banks for clinical skills, process rules, symbolic schemas, and measurement procedures. Provenance, support, replay, and controller-defined safety checks govern publication to a frozen test-time snapshot. A Process-Constrained Preference Harness binds evidence to its source, rejects controller-invalid candidates, and ranks actions with a safety-prioritized Clinical Process Critic. We evaluate complete agent systems across two backbone endpoints and six controlled stress dimensions under the same Doctor-turn limit. On 300 held-out Qwen encounters, MediSkill-Evo improves diagnosis accuracy from 61.33 percent to 69.00 percent and treatment-intent coverage from 33.62 percent to 66.44 percent, while reducing automatically scored critical failures from 31.00 percent to 16.33 percent relative to AgentClinic. On 180 hard-isolation conditions derived from 30 cases, target recovery reaches 93.61 percent under patient-behavior pressure, 100.00 percent for temporal evidence, and 92.22 percent for triage red flags. An exploratory 100-case MedSAM comparison evaluates request-gated tool-interface feasibility. These results provide descriptive end-to-end evidence for the complete system on fixed evaluation suites, not causal evidence for an individual bank or clinical validation of the automatic judge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MediSkill-Evo，一种无需骨干微调的临床代理系统，通过将经验分为四个类型化知识库（临床技能、流程规则、符号模式、测量程序）并采用过程约束偏好框架，在部分可观测条件下提升诊断准确性和治疗意图覆盖率，同时减少关键失败率。
AI.motivation: 交互式临床代理必须在部分可观测条件下收集决定性证据并将其转化为有依据的行动。正确的最终诊断本身并不能证明代理尊重了证据和护理过程约束，因此需要一种系统化的方法来确保代理遵循临床流程规范。
AI.method: MediSkill-Evo将经验分离为四个类型化知识库：临床技能、流程规则、符号模式、测量程序。通过来源追踪、支持度、回放和控制器定义的安全检查来管理到冻结测试时快照的发布。采用过程约束偏好框架将证据绑定到其来源，拒绝控制器无效的候选方案，并使用安全优先的临床过程批评者对动作进行排序。
AI.result: 在300个Qwen场景中，诊断准确率从61.33%提升至69.00%，治疗意图覆盖率从33.62%提升至66.44%，关键失败率从31.00%降至16.33%。在180个硬隔离条件下，患者行为压力下目标恢复率达93.61%，时间证据场景达100.00%，分诊红旗场景达92.22%。另进行了100例MedSAM比对以评估请求门控工具接口的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 结果为完整系统在固定评估套件上提供了描述性的端到端证据，但并非针对单个知识库的因果证据，也未对自动评分器进行临床验证。

title: Neighbor-Aware View Synthesis for Restoring Missing Views in Light-Field Camera Arrays
summary: In light-field (LF) imaging systems, dense spatial sampling from a camera array enables powerful post-capture capabilities such as refocusing and depth estimation. However, real-world LF capture is often affected by hardware malfunctions, where one or more cameras in the array fail, leading to missing sub-aperture images and degraded reconstruction quality. This paper addresses the problem of defective or missing view restoration in light-field camera arrays. We propose a novel generative framework that synthesizes the absent views by exploiting information from a carefully selected subset of neighboring cameras. These selected images, along with a positional encoding map indicating both their locations and the desired target view, are fed into a conditional Generative Adversarial Network (cGAN) trained to generate the missing viewpoint in a geometrically consistent manner. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world LF datasets demonstrate that our method produces visually plausible and photometrically accurate reconstructions, outperforming baselines for view interpolation both quantitatively and qualitatively. The proposed framework thus offers a robust and efficient solution for fault-tolerant light-field image acquisition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于条件生成对抗网络（cGAN）的框架，用于恢复光场相机阵列中因硬件故障缺失的子孔径图像，通过利用精心挑选的相邻相机图像和位置编码图生成几何一致的缺失视角，实现容错的光场采集。
AI.motivation: 光场成像系统中，相机阵列的硬件故障会导致缺失子孔径图像，从而降低重建质量，影响重聚焦和深度估计等后期处理能力。
AI.method: 提出一个生成式框架：从相邻相机中精心选择子集图像，连同表示其位置和目标视角的位置编码图一起输入到条件GAN（cGAN）中，训练生成几何一致的缺失视角图像。
AI.result: 在合成和真实光场数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法能产生视觉上合理且光度准确的重建，在定量和定性上均优于视角插值基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为光场图像采集提供了一种鲁棒且高效的容错解决方案，能够有效应对相机阵列硬件故障。

title: SkillAlchemy: Open-World Agent Skill Creation
summary: Agent skills are reusable procedural artifacts that extend language agents with specialized workflows, tool conventions, and domain behaviors at inference time. However, creating reliable skills still depends largely on human authorship, model priors, or execution traces. These sources are often unavailable for unfamiliar tasks, suggesting the need to create skills from open-world materials. In this paper, we study open-world skill creation: given an underspecified skill brief and a source-access specification, a creator must discover behavior-relevant requirements omitted by the brief and determine how broadly each source-derived procedure is justified. We propose SkillAlchemy, an admission-centered framework for source-grounded skill creation. SkillAlchemy identifies implicit requirements through contrastive evidence, admits candidate procedures based on evidence-supported scope, and compiles the admitted content into a grammar-guided skill package. Extensive experiments across 87 SkillsBench v1.1 tasks demonstrate that SkillAlchemy improves pass rate over no-skill execution by 19.9 percentage points and the strongest automated baseline by 8.6 percentage points, while achieving performance comparable to human-curated skills.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SkillAlchemy框架，用于从开放世界材料中创建源驱动的智能体技能。该框架通过对比证据识别隐含需求、基于证据支持范围接纳候选流程，并将内容编译为语法引导的技能包。在87个SkillsBench v1.1任务上，相比无技能执行提升19.9个百分点，相比最强自动化基线提升8.6个百分点，性能可与人工策划技能相媲美。
AI.motivation: 现有技能创建工作主要依赖人类作者、模型先验或执行轨迹，这些来源对于不熟悉的任务往往不可用，因此需要从开放世界材料中创建技能，以发现技能简介中遗漏的行为相关需求。
AI.method: 提出SkillAlchemy框架，采用"接纳中心"（admission-centered）方法：1) 通过对比证据识别隐含需求；2) 基于证据支持的适用范围接纳候选流程；3) 将接纳的内容编译为语法引导的技能包。
AI.result: 在87个SkillsBench v1.1任务上，SkillAlchemy相比无技能执行提升19.9个百分点通过率，相比最强自动化基线提升8.6个百分点，性能与人工策划技能相当。
AI.conclusion: SkillAlchemy证明从开放世界材料进行技能创建是可行的，且能达到与人工策划技能相当的性能，为语言智能体技能构建提供了不依赖人工或执行轨迹的新路径。

title: EchoWM: Open and Enterable Omnimodal World Models
summary: We present EchoWM, an omnimodal world model for enterable generative media that responds to continuous navigation while jointly generating 720p video, environmental sound, music and speech. We organize interaction around camera intent: in first-person scenes, it specifies observer motion, while in third-person scenes, camera--character dynamics are learned from data without view-specific controllers. Discrete commands and continuous poses are mapped to a shared metric-scale relative 6-DoF trajectory, with dataset-level calibration preserving motion magnitude across heterogeneous data. To jointly learn audio-visual generation and trajectory control, we construct a complementary data engine and adopt progressive training followed by autoregressive post-training for long-horizon generation. Extensive evaluations show that \model achieves strong trajectory following and high visual quality on public world-model benchmarks, supporting both first- and third-person interaction across varied subjects, and maintaining synchronized environmental sound and speech over long-horizon generation.

AI.tldr: EchoWM是一个全能模态世界模型，支持可进入的生成式媒体，能够根据用户的连续导航输入，联合生成720p视频、环境音、音乐和语音。它围绕"相机意图"组织交互，支持第一人称和第三人称场景，将离散命令和连续姿态映射到统一的度量尺度6-DoF轨迹，并通过数据引擎、渐进式训练和自回归后训练实现长期音频-视觉生成与轨迹控制。
AI.motivation: 现有的世界模型大多局限于纯视觉生成或单一交互模式，难以支持用户连续导航下的多模态（音视频）联合生成，也无法同时处理第一人称和第三人称的交互需求，缺乏统一的轨迹表示和长期生成的稳定性。
AI.method: 1) 以相机意图为核心组织交互，第一人称场景指定观察者运动，第三人称场景从数据中学习相机-角色动态，无需特定视角控制器；2) 将离散命令和连续姿态映射到共享的度量尺度相对6-DoF轨迹，通过数据集级校准保持运动幅度一致性；3) 构建互补数据引擎并采用渐进式训练，随后进行自回归后训练以支持长时域生成。
AI.result: 在公开世界模型基准上实现了强轨迹跟随能力和高视觉质量，支持第一人称和第三人称交互，适用于多种主体，并在长时域生成中保持环境音和语音的同步。
AI.conclusion: EchoWM证明了统一轨迹表示结合渐进式训练策略可以有效实现可进入生成媒体中的多模态长期生成，为交互式视听内容生成提供了新的技术路径。

title: Characterizing Necessary Losers to Explain Tournaments Losers
comment: This paper is the extended version of Contet, Grandi, Mengin. Characterizing Necessary Losers to Explain Tournaments Losers. In: Proceedings of the 9th International Conference on Algorithmic Decision Theory (ADT) (2026)
summary: We study the problem of formally explaining why a candidate was not selected by a given tournament rule, by identifying sub-tournaments in which the candidate loses independently of how the rest of the tournament is completed. We define destructive minimal supports as any minimal sub-tournaments satisfying this property, which in formal explainable artificial intelligence correspond to abductive explanations for the question "Why does the loser lose the tournament?". For six common tournament solutions (maximin, uncovered set and its weighted variant, top-cycle, Copeland, and Borda) we provide characterizations of when a candidate is either a necessary loser or a possible winner, we determine the size of the smallest destructive minimal supports, complemented by polynomial-time algorithms for their computation except for the case of the Borda rule which is suspected to be NP-complete.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何形式化解释候选人在锦标赛规则下落选的原因，通过识别"破坏性最小支持集"（即候选人在该子锦标赛中无论如何补全都会落败的最小集合），为六种常见锦标赛规则（maximin、未覆盖集及其加权变体、top-cycle、Copeland和Borda）提供了必要失败者和可能获胜者的刻画、最小破坏性支持集的大小估计及多项式时间算法。
AI.motivation: 在锦标赛（如体育赛事、选举或博弈）中，理解候选人为何落选对于透明度和可解释性至关重要。传统解释方法缺乏形式化保证，作者希望利用可解释人工智能（XAI）中的溯因解释框架，为"失败者为何失败"这一问题提供严格的形式化答案，从而填补锦标赛规则可解释性研究的空白。
AI.method: 作者将问题转化为形式化可解释人工智能中的溯因解释问题。他们定义了"破坏性最小支持集"——即满足候选人在该子锦标赛中锁定失败的最小候选子集。对六种锦标赛规则，分别刻画了必要失败者和可能获胜者的条件，并分析了最小破坏性支持集的大小，设计了多项式时间计算算法（Borda规则除外，其计算复杂度疑似NP完全）。
AI.result: 对六种锦标赛规则提供了完整的理论刻画：确定了候选人是必要失败者或可能获胜者的充要条件，给出了最小破坏性支持集的大小范围，并为除Borda外的五种规则提供了多项式时间算法。Borda规则的最小破坏性支持集计算被认为可能是NP完全的。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将形式化溯因解释引入锦标赛规则分析，为锦标赛结果的透明性和可解释性奠定了理论基础。研究结果不仅揭示了不同锦标赛规则的解释复杂度差异（多数多项式可解，Borda可能困难），也为实际系统中自动生成失败原因解释提供了算法工具。

title: Toward a Foundation Plug-and-Play Prior for Computed Tomography Reconstruction via a Multimodal Diffusion Model
summary: Computed tomography (CT) throughput is limited by scan time, which grows with both the number of projections acquired and the detector integration time for each. Reconstructing high-quality volumes from sparse-view or low-dose measurements therefore depends on an informative prior, typically a neural network trained for one specific scan setting and retrained whenever the modality, geometry, or material changes. We investigate whether a single diffusion model trained across several imaging domains can instead serve as a prior for many CT problems simultaneously. We evaluate the proposed method using the same frozen model on three datasets that differ in modality, beam geometry, material, and degradation type, spanning flaw analysis in additively manufactured metal parts imaged with cone-beam X-ray CT and concrete microstructure imaged with parallel-beam neutron CT. Our proposed method out-performs analytic reconstructions in all three cases, providing a step toward a reusable foundation prior for heterogeneous CT reconstruction problems.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨是否可以用一个跨多个成像域训练的单一扩散模型，作为多种CT重建问题的通用先验，而无需针对每种扫描设置重新训练。作者在三个不同数据集（不同模态、几何、材料、退化类型）上用同一个冻结模型进行测试，结果显示该方法在所有三个案例中均优于解析重建方法。
AI.motivation: CT重建质量依赖于信息丰富的先验知识，但传统方法中神经网络通常针对单一扫描设置训练，一旦模态、几何或材料改变就需要重新训练。这严重限制了神经网络的泛化性和可重用性，因此需要探索是否能用单一模型服务多种CT问题。
AI.method: 提出使用一个跨多个成像域训练的单一扩散模型作为通用先验。采用同一个冻结的（frozen）扩散模型，应用于三个不同的数据集进行评估，这些数据集在模态（X射线CT与中子CT）、光束几何（锥束与平行束）、材料（金属与混凝土）以及退化类型上均有差异。
AI.result: 该方法在三个不同场景下均优于解析重建方法，覆盖了增材制造金属零件的锥束X射线CT缺陷分析，以及混凝土微观结构的平行束中子CT成像。
AI.conclusion: 单一扩散模型可以跨多种CT重建任务作为可复用的基础先验（foundation prior），为异构CT重建问题提供了一种通用解决方案，向可重用的基础先验方向迈出了重要一步。

title: StrategyBench: Evaluating Explicit Strategy Induction in Large Language Models
summary: As large language models are increasingly used in data-scarce and evolving task scenarios, few-shot in-context learning (ICL) has become a key paradigm for task adaptation. However, direct ICL often uses a small set of examples without explicitly abstracting task rules, making it sensitive to example construction. In contrast, human learners often reduce such sensitivity by first summarizing task rules from examples and then applying them to new instances. To evaluate this ability, we propose StrategyBench, which selects strategy-inducible tasks from BIG-Bench, constructs reference strategies, and defines evaluation metrics along two dimensions: strategy quality and downstream utility. We further analyze strategy induction from three perspectives: task variation, model configuration, and adaptation setting, covering category-wise differences, generator-executor choices, demonstration design, and SFT-based adaptation. Experiments show that explicit strategy utility differs substantially across task categories and depends on both strategy generation and execution conditions. The benchmark is released at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/StrategyBench-D53C.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StrategyBench基准，用于评估大语言模型从少数示例中显式归纳任务策略（规则）的能力，并从策略质量与下游效用两个维度进行评测，同时从任务变体、模型配置和适应设置三个视角展开系统分析。
AI.motivation: 直接ICL对示例构建很敏感，缺乏对任务规则的显式抽象；而人类学习者通过先总结规则再应用的方式降低敏感性。现有研究缺乏对这一能力的系统评测基准。
AI.method: 从BIG-Bench中筛选策略可归纳的任务，构建参考策略，定义策略质量与下游效用两个评测维度；并从任务类别差异、生成器-执行器选择、演示设计和SFT适应设置等角度分析策略归纳。
AI.result: 实验发现显式策略效用在不同任务类别间差异显著，且同时依赖于策略生成条件与执行条件。
AI.conclusion: 显式策略归纳是ICL的一种重要补充能力，其效果受任务类别、生成与执行配置等多因素影响，StrategyBench为后续研究提供了系统化评测平台。

title: Learning Spherical Occupancy Profiles for Multi-View 3D Reconstruction and Generation
comment: 12 pages,5 figures,5 tables. Code and data will be released
summary: We study spherical occupancy profiles-the ray-wise occupancy probability profiles P(r) = T(r) o(r) distilled from multi-view 3D Gaussian reconstructions-as a unified intermediate representation for both discriminative and generative 3D reconstruction from images. On a 999-object subset of Google Scanned Objects with 48 turntable views each, we train (i) a discriminative per-ray decoder that injects global view-averaged and ray-specific image evidence into a FiLM-conditioned profile head, reaching median soft depth error 0.035 (normalized) on an independent 90-object test split, and (ii) a generative pipeline built on a profile VAE and a latent diffusion model, which supports unconditional sampling that matches the reconstruction manifold and image-conditioned multi-solution reconstruction whose per-object solution spread is quantifiable and tunable via classifier-free guidance. We further analyze the morphology of predicted profiles: post-hoc power sharpening and a learned sharpening target both recover ground-truth profile width without degrading depth, exposing a monotonic width-peak frontier in the L1-per-ray loss family and motivating a principled redefinition of morphology gates. Real-photo validation on two DTU scenes confirms the pipeline transfers to non-synthetic input. Our results suggest that ray-wise occupancy profiles offer a compact, learned, and uncertainty-aware interface between multi-view reconstruction and generative priors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出球面占有率轮廓（spherical occupancy profiles）作为判别式与生成式三维重建的统一中间表示，在999个Google Scanned Objects物体上训练了判别式解码器和基于VAE+潜在扩散模型的生成式流水线，并分析了轮廓形态学特性。
AI.motivation: 三维重建中，判别式与生成式方法通常分离，缺少一个紧凑、可学习且具有不确定性感知的中间表示来统一二者，从而难以在重建中利用生成先验。
AI.method: 从多视角3D高斯重建中提取逐光线占有率概率轮廓P(r)=T(r)o(r)。判别式部分采用FiLM条件化的逐光线解码器，注入视角平均和光线特定图像信息；生成式部分基于轮廓VAE和潜在扩散模型，支持无条件采样和条件多解重建，通过分类器自由引导调节解空间。
AI.result: 判别式解码器在90物体测试集上达到归一化中位软深度误差0.035；生成式流水线成功匹配重建流形并支持可量化、可调节的多解重建；形态学分析揭示了L1逐光线损失族中的单调宽度-峰值前沿，并提出形态门控的重新定义；在DTU场景的实拍照片上验证了跨域迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 逐光线占有率轮廓为多视角重建与生成先验之间提供了一个紧凑、可学习且具有不确定性感知的接口，可统一判别式与生成式三维重建。

title: Multi-Modal Semantic Expansion with Constrained LLM Reranking for Conversational Music Recommendation
summary: We present Team Semiintelligencn's solution for the ACM RecSys 2026 TalkPlayData Challenge, addressing conversational music recommendation through a multi-modal and personalized conversational recommender system. Our submitted system employs a three-stage pipeline: (1) multi-modal retrieval constructing decay-weighted centroids across seven dense embedding spaces - track- and user-level CF-BPR, Qwen3 (metadata, lyrics, attributes), CLAP audio, and SigLIP visual - supplemented by BM25 lexical retrieval and an artist substring-match signal, all fused via weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) with optimized signal weights; (2) lightweight reranking (history filtering, popularity smoothing, and catalog diversity penalization); and (3) persona-diversified response generation using GPT-4o-mini. Beyond this submitted configuration, we report development-time experiments with additional components - constrained LLM-guided artist injection, album continuation signals, XGBoost LambdaMART, and a superior GPT-4.1 response prompt - that were not deployed to Blind B due to cost and complexity constraints. We optimize RRF weights on a 500-session development split via differential evolution, improving MRR by +19.5%. On Blind A, we observe that unconstrained LLM-guided injection across 54 sessions causes catastrophic nDCG regression (-18.9%), while conservative injection on only 9 sessions yields the best observed Blind A nDCG - a finding we present as a Blind A observation warranting further validation. The submitted system achieves a Blind B composite score of 0.3213.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Team Semiintelligencn在ACM RecSys 2026 TalkPlayData挑战赛中的解决方案，构建了一个多模态个性化对话式音乐推荐系统。系统采用三阶段流水线：多模态检索（七个稠密嵌入空间加权质心融合RRF）、轻量级重排序和基于人设的响应生成。通过差分进化优化RRF权重，MRR提升19.5%，最终在Blind B上取得0.3213的复合分数。文中还报告了未部署的扩展组件实验与Blind A上的重要观察发现。
AI.motivation: 对话式音乐推荐面临多模态信息融合、个性化匹配和对话生成的多重挑战。作者旨在构建一个综合三阶段流水线的推荐系统，以应对ACM RecSys 2026 TalkPlayData挑战赛，探索如何有效整合文本、音频、视觉等多模态信号以及用户级和条目级协同过滤信息来提升推荐质量。
AI.method: 采用三阶段流水线：(1)多模态检索阶段，在七个稠密嵌入空间（CF-BPR双重粒度、Qwen3多模态元数据、CLAP音频、SigLIP视觉）上构建衰减加权质心，辅以BM25词法检索和艺术家子串匹配，通过加权RRF融合；(2)轻量级重排序，包括历史过滤、流行度平滑和目录多样性惩罚；(3)使用GPT-4o-mini进行人设多样化响应生成。RRF权重通过差分进化在500会话开发集上优化。
AI.result: 差分进化优化RRF权重使MRR提升19.5%。在Blind A上发现：无约束LLM引导注入（54个会话）导致nDCG严重回归（-18.9%），而保守注入（9个会话）取得最佳Blind A nDCG。提交系统在Blind B上获得0.3213的复合分数。
AI.conclusion: 多模态融合检索结合轻量级重排序和LLM生成的框架是有效的对话式音乐推荐方案。关键发现是LLM引导注入需谨慎使用，过度注入会导致性能大幅下降，保守策略反而更优。开发者实验中包含更优的GPT-4.1提示和LambdaMART等组件，但受成本和复杂度限制未部署。

title: Bee Detection and Tracking at Hive Entrance using YOLO11 and ByteTrack
summary: This work presents an automatic bee entrance monitoring system based on YOLO11 transfer learning and the ByteTrack tracking algorithm. The study investigates the influence of data augmentation, backbone freezing, and tracker parameter optimization on the detection and counting of small, fast-moving bees. The detector with progressive backbone unfreezing strategy achieved about 97.0% precision and 98.7% mAP50, while providing more stable convergence than full fine-tuning. Experiments also showed that light augmentation outperformed heavy augmentation. For tracking, ByteTrack parameters were optimized to improve trajectory continuity under low-confidence detections. On an independent 25 FPS side-view video, the optimized YOLO11-ByteTrack system correctly counted 43 of 47 incoming bees (91.5%) and 7 of 30 outgoing bees (23.3%). Error analysis showed that most counting errors were caused by missed detections due to rapid bee motion and motion blur, while tracking failures became less frequent after parameter optimization. Overall, the results indicate that moderate augmentation, progressive backbone unfreezing, and ByteTrack tuning improve the reliability of automatic bee entrance monitoring under realistic recording conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于YOLO11迁移学习和ByteTrack跟踪算法的蜜蜂入口自动监测系统，通过渐进式骨干网络解冻策略实现约97.0%精度和98.7% mAP50，并在独立视频中正确计数了91.5%的进巢蜜蜂。实验表明适度数据增强、渐进式骨干解冻和ByteTrack参数优化能提升真实条件下蜜蜂监测的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 蜜蜂入口监测对生态研究和农业具有重要意义，但小体积、高速运动的蜜蜂在真实录像条件下（特别是低置信度检测和运动模糊）难以被准确检测和计数，现有方法在检测精度和跟踪连续性方面存在不足。
AI.method: 采用YOLO11迁移学习作为检测器，结合ByteTrack算法进行目标跟踪。研究系统性探讨了三个关键因素：数据增强策略（轻量vs重度）、骨干网络解冻策略（渐进式解冻 vs 完全微调）、以及ByteTrack跟踪器参数优化，旨在提升小目标高速运动的检测和计数性能。
AI.result: 渐进式骨干解冻策略达到约97.0%精度和98.7% mAP50，且收敛更稳定；轻量数据增强优于重度增强。优化后的系统在25 FPS侧视视频中正确计数43/47只进巢蜜蜂（91.5%）和7/30只出巢蜜蜂（23.3%）。误差分析显示主要计数错误源于运动模糊导致的漏检，跟踪参数优化后跟踪失败显著减少。
AI.conclusion: 适度数据增强、渐进式骨干解冻和ByteTrack参数调优的组合策略能有效提高自动蜜蜂入口监测系统在真实录制条件下的可靠性，但出巢蜜蜂的计数精度仍有较大提升空间，主要受限于快速运动和运动模糊造成的检测丢失。

title: SRPO: Self-Reflective Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Reasoning
summary: Self-reflection is a powerful mechanism for credit assignment in human learning, converting sparse outcome feedback into actionable guidance. However, its potential for post-training Large Language Models (LLMs) remains underexplored. We propose Self-Reflective Policy Optimization (SRPO), a framework that internalizes this capability. SRPO enables LLMs to analyze their own completed trajectories, synthesize errors into concise "reflection patches," and use reflection-conditioned teacher scores on student on-policy rollouts as dense token-level training signals. This process effectively transforms sparse terminal supervision into dense, token-level learning signals without requiring external critics, separate reward models, or larger teacher models. We demonstrate that SRPO achieves state-of-the-art performance across mathematical reasoning and long-horizon agentic benchmarks with exceptional data efficiency. Using a Qwen3-8B base model, SRPO attains 73.3% on AIME'24 using only 8% (0.08x) of the training FLOPs required by scaled supervised fine-tuning, while significantly improving success rates on WebShop (64.7%), ALFWorld (76.8%), and SWE-Bench-Lite (31.2%). Code is available at https://github.com/Galleons2029/SRPO

AI.tldr: 提出自反思策略优化（SRPO）框架，将稀疏的终端奖励转化为稠密的token级训练信号，无需外部批判器、奖励模型或更大教师模型，在数学推理和智能体基准上取得SOTA性能和高数据效率。
AI.motivation: 人类学习中的自我反思能将稀疏的反馈转化为可操作指导，但这在post-training LLM中的潜力尚未被充分探索，现有方法往往依赖外部奖励模型或更大的教师模型。
AI.method: SRPO让LLM分析自身完成的轨迹，将错误综合为简洁的'反思补丁'，使用反思条件下的教师分数对学生on-policy rollout提供稠密token级训练信号，将稀疏终端监督转化为稠密学习信号。
AI.result: 在数学推理和长程智能体基准上达到SOTA。Qwen3-8B在AIME'24达到73.3%（仅用8%的训练FLOPs），WebShop 64.7%、ALFWorld 76.8%、SWE-Bench-Lite 31.2%。
AI.conclusion: SRPO证明自反思机制可被内化为LLM训练框架，以极高数据效率实现SOTA性能，无需额外模型资源，为post-training提供了新范式。

title: BenthicDINO: Physics-Informed Self-Distillation for View-Invariant Side-Scan Sonar Representations
summary: Automated perception in side-scan sonar (SSS) imagery is severely hindered by physical acoustic artifacts, resulting in representations that inextricably mix intrinsic seabed reflectivity with transient viewing geometries. Existing self-supervised learning (SSL) frameworks rely on augmentations designed for natural images, failing to account for acoustic degradation and explicitly enforce view-invariance. To address this gap, we introduce a physics-informed self-distillation framework built upon the DINOv3 architecture utilizing a ConvNeXt-v2-Tiny backbone to maximize data efficiency. The proposed methodology enforces view-invariance through two primary mechanisms: physically motivated augmentations that simulate speckle noise, range-dependent attenuation, and radiometric miscalibration; and a Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion (HSIC) penalty that explicitly decouples learned dense patch features from physical viewing parameters. Furthermore, we propose a dense, hierarchical feature fusion strategy across all four network stages to preserve fine-grained sediment details alongside deep semantic abstractions. Extensive evaluation demonstrates that the framework natively groups complex benthic topographies into stable, noise-free semantic clusters without relying on manual annotations. During supervised downstream tasks on the S3Seg dataset, the fused representations exhibited exceptional data efficiency, achieving 96% of its absolute peak performance using only 10% of the available annotated data, ultimately reaching a mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) of 71.4% and an overall accuracy of 86.5%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于物理信息的自蒸馏框架，用于侧扫声纳(SSS)图像的自动感知。该框架基于DINOv3架构和ConvNeXt-v2-Tiny骨干网络，通过物理启发的数据增强（模拟散斑噪声、距离相关衰减和辐射定标误差）以及希尔伯特-施密特独立性准则(HSIC)惩罚来强制视图不变性，并采用跨四阶段的分层稠密特征融合策略。在S3Seg数据集上实现了71.4%的mIoU和86.5%的总体精度，仅用10%标注数据即达到峰值性能的96%。
AI.motivation: 侧扫声纳图像受到物理声学伪影的严重干扰，现有自监督学习框架使用为自然图像设计的增强方法，无法处理声学退化问题，也不能显式地强制视图不变性，导致海底反射率与瞬态观测几何混合难以分离。
AI.method: 1) 基于DINOv3架构构建物理信息自蒸馏框架，采用ConvNeXt-v2-Tiny骨干；2) 物理启发的增强：模拟散斑噪声、距离相关衰减和辐射定标误差；3) HSIC惩罚项显式解耦稠密patch特征与物理观测参数；4) 跨四个网络阶段的稠密分层特征融合策略，保留细粒度沉积物细节与深层语义抽象。
AI.result: 在S3Seg数据集上，融合表示展现出卓越的数据效率：仅用10%标注数据即达到绝对峰值性能的96%；最终mIoU达71.4%，总体精度达86.5%。框架无需人工标注即可将复杂海底地形自然地聚类为稳定、无噪声的语义簇。
AI.conclusion: 物理感知的自监督方法能够有效克服声学伪影干扰，实现高数据效率的海底语义感知，为侧扫声纳自动解译提供了可行方案。

title: Mitigating Reasoning-Induced Misalignment via Safety-Direction Penalty
summary: Reasoning-Induced Misalignment, where fine-tuning on reasoning data containing no harmful content, including mathematics, code, and problem-solving with chain-of-thought traces can induce harmful behaviors of LLM, posing a serious challenge to the safety of LLM reasoning. Cross-architecture, cross-scale, and cross-dataset checks show that RIM does not always emerge. Previous work attributed RIM to neuron-level entanglement, but did not identify the geometry of the representation space underlying this entanglement or propose a training-time fix. We provide both: a representation-space analysis of RIM and the Safety-Direction Penalty (SDP), which penalizes movement along a learned safety direction during reasoning fine-tuning. The analysis extracts two activation-space directions, one encoding reasoning ability and the other safety behavior. These directions are coupled: fine-tuning that improves reasoning shifts safety representations, and prompts with larger shifts show larger safety degradation. CKA distance ratios and probes locate the safety-decision layers where this shift is most relevant. These findings guide the design of SDP: the coupling motivates penalizing displacement along the safety direction, and the layer localization sets the initial scope. When the initial scope leaves compensatory shifts beyond the penalized layers, the same diagnostics guide iterative expansion. On Qwen2.5-3B and 7B, SDP restores safety while preserving benchmark reasoning performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了推理诱导的错位（RIM）问题——在纯推理数据（数学、代码、思维链）上微调会诱发有害行为。作者通过表征空间分析识别出推理能力方向和安全行为方向，发现两者耦合，并提出安全方向惩罚（SDP）方法，在训练时惩罚沿安全方向的移动，从而在Qwen2.5-3B和7B上恢复安全性同时保持推理性能。
AI.motivation: RIM对LLM推理安全构成严重挑战，但先前工作仅将RIM归因于神经元级纠缠，未解释表征空间的几何结构，也未提出训练时修复方案。作者旨在填补这一空白，提供表征空间层面的理论分析和训练时修复方法。
AI.method: 1) 表征空间分析：提取两个激活空间方向（推理能力方向和安全行为方向），通过CKA距离比率和探针定位安全决策层；2) 安全方向惩罚（SDP）：在推理微调期间惩罚沿学习到的安全方向的位移，利用层定位设定初始惩罚范围，并通过诊断指导迭代扩展范围以处理补偿性位移。
AI.result: 跨架构、跨规模、跨数据集验证表明RIM并非总是出现；SDP在Qwen2.5-3B和7B上成功恢复安全性，同时保持基准推理性能。表征分析证实推理改善会使安全表征发生偏移，且偏移越大安全退化越严重。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次从表征空间的几何结构角度解释RIM，证明推理与安全方向之间的耦合是根因，并提出了有效的训练时修复方法SDP，为LLM推理安全提供了新视角和实用解决方案。

title: MLLM-Assisted Audio VOS: A 3rd Place Report for the MeViS-Audio Track, 8th LSVOS Challenge
summary: In this technical report, we present a training-free framework for audio-guided video object segmentation, which integrates Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) with SAM-based segmentation models. We decompose the task into several stages and identify suitable foundation models for each stage. Without introducing additional model training or task-specific fine-tuning, our approach leverages the strong multimodal reasoning capabilities of MLLMs to model text-visual correspondence and employs SAM-based models for accurate object mask generation. The proposed framework demonstrates the effectiveness of leveraging foundation models for audio-guided video segmentation and achieves competitive performance in the MeViS-Audio Track of the 8th LSVOS Challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个无需训练的音频引导视频目标分割框架，整合多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）与SAM系列分割模型，通过将任务分解为多个阶段并分别选用合适的基座模型，利用MLLM的多模态推理能力建模文本-视觉对应关系，再由SAM生成精确的目标掩码，在MeViS-Audio赛道取得有竞争力的成绩。
AI.motivation: 音频引导的视频目标分割是一个具有挑战性的多模态任务，传统方法通常需要针对特定任务进行模型训练或微调，成本高且泛化性有限。本文旨在探索利用现有基座模型（如MLLMs和SAM）构建无需训练的通用框架，从而降低任务门槛并验证基座模型在多模态分割任务中的潜力。
AI.method: 将音频引导视频目标分割任务分解为多个阶段，每个阶段选用合适的基座模型：利用MLLM强大的多模态推理能力建模文本与视觉之间的对应关系（包括音频到文本的转换与语义理解），结合SAM系列模型进行精确的目标掩码生成。整个过程不引入额外的模型训练或任务特定的微调。
AI.result: 该框架在第八届LSVOS挑战赛的MeViS-Audio赛道中取得了具有竞争力的性能表现，验证了无需训练、仅靠基座模型组合的方案在实际任务中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，通过合理地将复杂多模态任务分解并组合现有的基座模型（MLLMs + SAM），可以在不进行额外训练的情况下实现有效的音频引导视频目标分割，展示了基座模型在多模态理解与分割领域的强大潜力。

title: EarthVerse: Benchmarking Scientific Agents Across Dynamic Earth Systems and Natural Hazards
summary: Earth-system analysis reconstructs changing physical processes from observations that differ in source, scale, timing, and modality. Natural hazards make this work consequential because incomplete evidence can change estimates of severity, exposure, and mechanism. We introduce EarthVerse, a benchmark that evaluates scientific agents through package-scoped investigations. Its 405 reproducible tasks are grounded in 199 documented events and 19 hazard families. Agents inspect heterogeneous event packages, choose compatible evidence, execute transparent calculations, reconcile source differences, and preserve provenance in the final answer. We provide executable ground truth that decomposes each task into fine-grained answer units, together with task-specific rubrics that assess the supporting research process while allowing multiple valid paths. We evaluate 25 model and agent systems under a controlled tool-using protocol, then use controlled studies to locate failures in evidence access, tool selection, memory, reasoning, interaction, and scientific execution. Across systems, the best mean answer-unit accuracy is 84.65%, while the highest Strict@95 is only 34.81%. The gap shows that current agents often complete individual steps without maintaining a consistent chain across evidence, scales, units, calculations, and physical interpretation. EarthVerse provides a reproducible basis for measuring end-to-end scientific reliability in dynamic Earth systems.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍EarthVerse基准测试，用于评估科学智能体在地球系统分析中的端到端能力。它包含405个可复现任务，基于199个记录事件和19类灾害，智能体需检查异构事件包、选择兼容证据、执行透明计算并保留来源。评估25个模型系统后发现最佳平均答案单元准确率为84.65%，但最高Strict@95仅34.81%，表明现有智能体未能保持跨证据、尺度、单位和物理解释的一致链条。
AI.motivation: 地球系统分析需从不同来源、尺度、时间和模态的观测中重建变化的物理过程，而自然灾害使不完整证据可能改变严重性、暴露和机制的估计。现有智能体缺乏一个标准化基准来衡量其在动态地球系统中处理异质证据并保持一致科学推理链的可靠性。
AI.method: 构建EarthVerse基准：405个可复现任务基于199个记录事件和19个灾害家庭；智能体需要检查异质事件包、选择兼容证据、执行透明计算、调和来源差异、保持来源记录。提供可执行真值（分解为细粒度答案单元）和任务特定评分规则（支持多条有效路径），并在受控工具使用协议下评估25个模型和智能体系统。
AI.result: 在25个系统评估中，最佳平均答案单元准确率为84.65%，最高Strict@95仅为34.81%。受控研究定位了证据访问、工具选择、记忆、推理、交互和科学执行方面的失败点。关键差距在于智能体常能完成独立步骤却无法维持跨证据、尺度、单位、计算和物理解释的一致链条。
AI.conclusion: EarthVerse提供了衡量动态地球系统中端到端科学可靠性的可复现基准。当前智能体在整体科学推理链一致性上仍有显著不足，该基准为改进科学智能体的端到端可靠性提供了基础。

title: Mover360: Controllable Object Manipulation in 360° Panoramic Images
summary: We present Mover360, a controllable object manipulation framework for 360° images. Unlike perspective images, 360° images in equirectangular projection (ERP) exhibit horizontal wrap-around, latitude-dependent distortion, and global scene continuity, which makes object-level edits difficult for existing perspective editors to produce and for users to specify. To address this, Mover360 centers on object Translation (relocating a specified object within an existing panorama) while supporting reference-guided Insert and Remove as auxiliary tasks. Its interface unifies point-, bbox-, and mask-guided control by encoding each task into a fixed prompt and a compact, ERP-aligned instruction map. In the default point mode, a single click relocates an object, allowing the model to infer a plausible size, support, and illumination using panoramic context and an auxiliary depth condition. Structurally, Mover360 is a lightweight adaptation of a pretrained diffusion transformer. To generate paired supervision, we construct a UE5 data-generation pipeline with surface-aware object placement and randomized illumination, yielding large-scale paired data and a dual-domain benchmark of synthetic and real panoramas with ground truth for all three tasks. Across both test domains and two evaluation protocols, Mover360 outperforms strong baselines for perspective editing, insertion, and inpainting in reconstruction fidelity, semantic consistency, and distributional quality. Code and our benchmark dataset are available at https://zhonghaoyi.github.io/Mover360/.

AI.tldr: Mover360是一个面向360°全景图像的可控物体操作框架，核心支持物体平移（重定位），并辅助支持参考引导的插入和移除任务。它通过统一界面将点、边界框和掩码引导编码为固定提示和紧凑的ERP对齐指令图，默认点模式下单击即可重定位物体。该方法是对预训练扩散Transformer的轻量适配，并利用UE5数据生成管线构建大规模配对数据及合成/真实全景双域基准。实验表明其在重建保真度、语义一致性和分布质量上优于多种强基线。
AI.motivation: 与透视图像不同，360°等距柱状投影（ERP）图像具有水平环绕、纬度相关畸变和全局场景连续性等特点，使得现有透视图像编辑器难以处理物体级编辑，用户也难以指定编辑操作。因此需要一个专门针对360°图像的可控物体操作框架。
